ref: He finds fault with his servants and even with his angels.
text: Wen dan kan mariŋ wa tomteerɔma, wa dan weeni wa maarɔma ayen ba kaasi,

ref: Humans are formed from clay and are fragile as moths, so what chance do you have?
text: ka baai ale bo tanta yie po la, ate ŋa nyuba a bo tantaŋa po la, ŋaai ale kaa daliŋ ŋɔriŋ loka ase jayirim la.

ref: Your tent pegs are pulled up, and you leave this life, having gained no wisdom.”
text: Ba viuku miisaŋa an dari daa ŋmai ya, ate ba kan kpi ale yammoa?>

ref: Job, call out for help and see if an angel comes!
text: <<Wi ase fi le a yaali, alege ka wana ale wa tulisi fu? Fi le cheem ka ŋan weleŋsaŋa wana jigi ya?

ref: Envy and jealousy will kill a stupid fool.
text: Suipuurum a ko ka beruk, ate nyuri a ko baai ale kan ta popola la.

ref: I have seen fools take root. But God sends a curse, suddenly uprooting them
text: Mi dek nya beruk kama ate wa piilim nalimnyiini, alege ku an beni ya ate wa yenni a nya kikaasa.

ref: and leaving their children helpless in court.
text: Wa bisaŋa a yaalima kama ale maarika, nuru karo a vari ba a basi.

ref: Our suffering isn't caused by the failure of crops;
text: Dila ninam a kan nyini tanta po a nyini, yaase daanika a nyini tɛŋka a jueli.

ref: it's all part of life, like sparks shooting skyward.
text: Alege ba biak nurubiik a te ka daanika ase bolim ale na a yiti wen diila.

ref: Job, if I were you, I would ask God for help.
text: <<Alege ku dan poom ka mi, mi ale ta m wanni ga te Wen.

ref: God sends showers on earth and waters the fields.
text: Wa basi ate ŋmoruk a ni tɛŋka zuk. Wa basi ate nyiam a jam tattaŋa po.

ref: He protects the sorrowful and lifts up those who have been disgraced. *
text: Wa basi ate baai ale kan daa nuruba la a nya badek ate baai ale a kum la wa vari ba a basi.

ref: Darkness is their only companion, hiding their path at noon.
text: Ate legi ale jam ba zuk kantueŋ. Kantueŋ mɛ ba ale tuinti ase yok la.

ref: God rescues the needy from the words of the wicked and the fist of the mighty.
text: Wa ale vari baai ale a silim la gebi kaai ale bo ba noaŋa po la jigi a basi. Wa vari ba pagrɔma ale yik ba nna giŋgiŋ la po a basi.

ref: The poor are filled with hope, and injustice is silenced. Consider Yourself Fortunate
text: Dila ŋanjaksaŋa a ta yiila kama, ate baai ale kan ta nyemagsika la a mum ba noaŋa.

ref: He may cause injury and pain, but he will bandage and heal your cuts and bruises.
text: Wa le kɔni alege wa le pob mɛ, wa le te tuem alege wa nisaŋa ale tebi mɛ.

ref: God will protect you from harm, no matter how often trouble may strike.
text: Kaasuŋ a dan poom paari buyuebi wa le vari fu a basi, ku dan poom ka buyopɔi biem a kan paari fu.

ref: In times of war and famine, God will keep you safe.
text: Kɔm a dan poom jam, wa le da tuesi fu kum po, kpaliŋ po wa le lik fu ate fi kan kpi.

ref: You will be sheltered, without fear of hurtful words or any other weapon.
text: Wa le lik fu velim teka po, ate fi kan chali yɔgsum ase kaasuŋ a nin jam.

ref: You will laugh at the threat of destruction and famine. And you won't be afraid of wild animals—
text: Fi le la kaasuŋ ale kɔm, ate fi be kan chali duŋ sii nyeka ale toa.

ref: they will no longer be fierce, and your rocky fields will become friendly.
text: Diila fi kan ta tintana fi laŋka po, ate duŋ sii nyeka ale toa la ale ta suiyɔgni ale fu.

ref: Your home will be secure, and your sheep will be safe.
text: Fi le seba ayen jaab a kan nye fi viuku, fi be le chiini ŋantaŋa ate jaab a kan bɛ.

ref: You will have more descendants than there are blades of grass on the face of the earth.
text: Fi le seba ayen fi bisaŋa ale piisi, ate fi ŋaaŋbisaŋa a nye ase tɛŋka wuuku la.

ref: You will live a very long life, and your body will be strong until the day you die.
text: Fi le kpaŋ kama abe fi siŋ vɔrup ale pagrim, ase ba le tigsi ŋanta a bobi cheka wen la.

ref: Our experience has proven these things to be true, so listen and learn.
text: <<Tama kpesi kude nya kama, ku be ka wensie. Dila nyiŋ wom, abe fi siak.>>

ref: It's impossible to weigh my misery and grief!
text: <<Ase m popola kaasimaŋa a dan baga a magsi ate m niniŋŋa a vi ŋanmagsinta zuk.

ref: They outweigh the sand along the beach, and that's why I have spoken without thinking first.
text: Ŋa le dobra a gaam nyakpiemu tintain busuŋku dila ale soa ate mi biisi wie a nin yik m dega.

ref: The fearsome arrows of God All-Powerful have filled my soul with their poison.
text: Wen Dii Ale A Niak La peemaŋa a kali ka m nyiŋ ate m nyiŋka a dari ŋa yaamu, Wen nyinyigsa ale tu chaab ale mu.

ref: Do oxen and wild donkeys cry out in distress unless they are hungry?
text: Bon waarik ale nya wuuk ale a kumu yaase naab a nya wukosik ale a ŋuuni?

ref: What is food without salt? What is more tasteless than the white of an egg?
text: Ŋandiinta ale masa ase yesa a nin kan karo, yaase masim a bo jein peeluk po?

ref: That's how my food tastes, and my appetite is gone. *
text: Mi zɛri kama mi an tiri ya, ŋandiin tila chaab a basi kama ate mi a yuak.

ref: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.
text: Mi yaa ti le ta suiyɔgni de, m sui ale peenti m nyiŋdommaŋa a nin poom zuak dii ya, diila mi an diem zɛri Waai Ale Welema La wieŋa.

ref: I am not strong as stone or bronze,
text: Mi ta ka buntain pagrimoa? Mi nyiŋ lammu ka kutuk mɔnuŋŋoa?

ref: and I have finally reached the end of my rope. My Friends, I Am Desperate
text: Mi ta pagrim a maari m dega, yɔgyɔgla de ate nye paarika a yalima ale mi la?

ref: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *
text: <<Nuru waai ale jɔk yiila la a yaali ka ŋmanteka a nyini wa doaba jigi, ase wa nin poom basi Wen Dii Ale A Niak La yɔgsum chalika.

ref: like streams that swell with melting snow,
text: ŋmoruk tanaŋa ale nyaliŋ la nyiamu yaa sueri a waaŋ,

ref: I am like a caravan, lost in the desert while searching for water.
text: Nyeendɔba a cheem basi ba suita. Ba cheŋ jueli tɛŋ kottaŋa po a kpi.

ref: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared. What Have I Done Wrong?
text: Yɔgyɔgla de fi mɛ a sak kama ayen fi ka maarika, fi nya ka kpazinagsuk jaab a yaa chali yɔgsum.

ref: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift
text: Mi diem weeni ayen, <<Pai jaab a te mi nyiŋŋa, tuni m pami te mu a nyini fi jigsika po.

ref: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.
text: <<Sak mu ate m nye diki. Sak mu kauk kuui ate m nye kaasi la.

ref: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.
text: Wensie wie a toa kama. Alege fi nampaŋŋa a sak ka boa?

ref: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.
text: <<Alege yɔgyɔgla de ta jiirim abe fi nya mi. Mi ni velim fi nimbie po?

ref: Stop accusing me falsely; my reputation is at stake.
text: Fi cheŋ ti ku yalima zuak kama. Basi venta ŋman poli. Mi ta wensie kama.

ref: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.
text: Fi a poli ayen mi a velim kama. Fi pai a chim ayen mi an baga a gaari wamaŋ ale wakaasuŋŋoa.

ref: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.
text: Ase yɔma ale yiili wa nya junɔi yisuŋta la, yaase nuru waai ate ba pai ate wa a tom tuima ale a yiili tutuna diila,

ref: God has made my days drag on and my nights miserable.
text: dila ba te mi ka chi sii ale kan ta jaaboa ale pai niniga yɔkta a te mi.

ref: I pray for night to end, but it stretches out while I toss and turn.
text: Mi dan doa mi a poli ayen, <Mi ale yiti ka dimpo?> Yɔkku a dari ka dila, ate mi a labri ate vari ga veenti.

ref: My parched skin is covered with worms, dirt, and sores,
text: Mi nyiŋka ka nanzue nyiini, ka lik ale ka pagsa. Mi nyiŋka a ta ka nira a nyini nyaata.

ref: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle. Don't Forget!
text: <<Mi daaŋa a taam kama alege ate yiila a ka, a kpabi a taam ase yɔgrɔ jayɔgim la.

ref: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.
text: Teeri, Wen yaa, ayen mi nyuvunni ka vuusum nyiini. Mi ninaŋa a kan nya suipeentik ŋmana.

ref: I will vanish from sight, and no one, including you, will ever see me again.
text: Num buui ale a nya mi yɔgyɔgla de la a kan ŋman nya mi, fi le gisi mi, alege m kan boro.

ref: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.
text: Ase chiŋmari ale muriŋ a bɛ a cheŋ diila waai ale a siŋ vɔrumu po la a kan ŋmani.

ref: Never will I return home; soon I will be forgotten.
text: Wa kan ŋman jam wa yenni, wa jigini a kan ŋman seba wa.

ref: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?
text: Mi ka nyakpiemu, yaase nya liuŋ po jaaboa ate ba a limisi mu?

ref: I'd rather choke to death than live in this body.
text: ate dila basi ate mi a yaali ayen m ŋmɛ m dek a ko a gaam mi nyiŋka de.

ref: Leave me alone and let me die; my life has no meaning.
text: Mi kan yaali m nyuvunni. Mi kan ŋmaa boro. Basi mu m nyiini, mi daaŋa a ka kiri ya.

ref: What makes you so concerned about us humans?
text: <<Nurubiik ka boa ate wa ta tuilum te fi, ate fi niŋ a bo wa po,

ref: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?
text: ate fi kpesi a nya wa saluik meena ale kasim a chamsi wa?

ref: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?
text: Fi kan maa nya jigi yoŋ abe fi basi mi yaase fi basi m dek m nyiini maga dega?

ref: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?
text: Mi dan nye biem, mi nye fu ka sɛ, nurubisa limisidɔ? Ka boa ate fi a din tiik mi nyiŋŋa? Mi chim ka jibta a te fu?

ref: Bildad from Shuah said:
text: Suya denɔwa Bildad yaa tulisi ayen,

ref: He made your children pay for their sins.
text: Ni bisaŋa ale jam tom kaasi wa la, wa namsi ba kama ku nyiŋ.

ref: So why don't you turn to him
text: Alege fi dan cheem wa jigi a saalim Wen Dii Ale A Niak La,

ref: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.
text: a nye cheri ale nye a magsi, Wen ale jam maari fu abe wa ta fu jam zaani fi jigi maŋka.

ref: Your future will be brighter by far than your past. Our Ancestors Were Wise
text: Dii meena ate fi jɔk la a kan magsi chaab ale Wen ale za wa te fu dii chum la.

ref: Our ancestors were wise, so learn from them.
text: <<Bek kokpieŋsaŋa a nya ba koma ale jam zamsi diila,

ref: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.
text: diila ba biak tama ka deemwa dek, ti be zɛ jaaboa, ate ti daaŋa tɛŋzuk de a nye ase yisuŋ la.

ref: and if the water dries up, they die sooner than grass.
text: Ŋa dan boro a chim ale an ŋari ya, ŋa le kpi mwuli a gaam wuuk.

ref: Such is the hopeless future of all who turn from God
text: Baai ale baŋ Wen wari la a kpeglim ka dila, ba le toalim kan ta Wen la ba yiilaŋa a bɛ ya.

ref: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.
text: Wa a nye ase ka jaab ate ba vuk a zaŋti kantueŋ la, ate wa a teeri naŋsa kadukka po la,

ref: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;
text: Alege ba dan voori wa dula jigini, waai a kan seba ayen jaab poom jam za dula.

ref: their life slips away, and other plants grow there.
text: Chekki wa a kpi kama a muriŋ a bɛ, ate tantaŋa po ŋan yona a ŋman nyini.

ref: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.
text: <<Chekki Wen a kan zɛri nuru waai ale kan ta kaasuŋ la yaase wa basi ate nuru baata nisima a pagra.

ref: And so, he will make you happy and give you something to smile about.
text: Wa diem ayen wa basi ate ka laata a bo fi nɔi po abe suipeentik nuemka a bo fi nɔngbanvaata po.

ref: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.
text: Fi dachaasaŋa chivie ale paari ba, ate nyeka tuem nyama viitaŋa a kan ŋman boro.>>

ref: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.
text: <<Chekki, mi seba kama ayen kude ka wensie. Alege nurubiik ale nye ka sɛ a chim wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ Wen niŋŋa?

ref: Not once in a thousand times could we win our case if we took him to court.
text: Waai a dan poom a yaali ayen wa nak nanpaga ale wa, wa kan baga a tulisi wa bunyi tusidi po.

ref: When God becomes angry, he can move mountains before they even know it.
text: Wa a tusi guuta alege ti zɛ ku nɔi po ale a labri ti ale wa suipuurumu.

ref: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations
text: Wa a choa tɛŋka ka jigini ale basi ate ka zaŋŋa a kpiŋsi.

ref: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.
text: Wa a biisi a te wenbinni ate di kan nyaksi, ale a lik chiŋmarisaŋa bolimu.

ref: God alone stretched out the sky, stepped on the sea,
text: Wa nyiini ale a teeri wenŋmazukku ale a tabi nyakpiemu nyamiisaŋa zuk.

ref: and set the stars in place— the Big Dipper and Orion, the Pleiades and the stars in the southern sky.
text: Wen ale nye chiŋmarisaŋa de meena, Chiisa Nuru ale Gɔlima Gɔlima ale Biak Ale Ka Nyɔnɔ ale Vari Chiŋmarik.

ref: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.
text: Wa a tom ka wakinkagla ŋaai ate nuru a kan miŋi, wakperikaliik sii ale kan ta chiina.

ref: God walks right past me, without making a sound.
text: Wa dan gaam mi a taam, mi kan nya wa, wa dan cheŋ a taam mi kan miŋ.

ref: When God showed his anger, the servants of the sea monster fell at his feet.
text: Wen a kan yik wa suinni, jachichimini ŋaaŋviirɔma poom a ŋɔriŋ ka wa naŋsa po ale yɔgsum.

ref: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God? Though I Am Innocent
text: <<Mi ale nye ka sɛ a nak nanpaga ale wa? Mi ale nya wie ka bɛ a nak nanpaga ale wa?

ref: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
text: M dan poom wi wa ate wa siak, mi a ka siaka ayen wa le wom mu.

ref: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
text: Wa le ŋɔriŋ mu ale viok be wa basi ate m koanika a zuak kinla nyiŋ.

ref: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
text: Wa kan basi ate m ŋman nya m vuusumu alege basi ate ka niniga a paari mu.

ref: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
text: Ku dan ka pagrim wari, wa zuak kama. Ku be dan ka nyemagsika wari, ka wana ale wa wi wa?

ref: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
text: <<Mi poom ka kaasuŋŋoa. Mi niŋ a ka mi dek po. Mi kisi mi dek nyuvunni kama.

ref: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.
text: Ku meena ka wayeŋ, dila ale soa ate mi a weeni ayen, <Wa a kaasi baai ale kan ta kaasuŋ la ale wabaata nyama meena kama.>

ref: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
text: Ase kaasuŋ a dan ta kum jam, wa a la waai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la ale kan ta yiila la kama.

ref: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
text: Ase tɛŋ a dan jo wabaata nyɔnɔ nisa po, wa a lik ka boteerɔma kama. Dan kan daa wa be ka wana?

ref: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
text: Mi nyuvunni a taam kama nna ase ŋaaruŋ kuui ale a kpabi la, nna a wuli ase jiiruk ale fuuri a siŋ suem zuk la.

ref: Sometimes I try to be cheerful and to stop complaining,
text: M dan weeni ayen, <M le baŋ m funfɔblaŋa wari, m le tagri m nyaasimu abe mi a la.>

ref: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.
text: Mi diem a yiili m ninammu meena kama, diila mi seba ayen fi a kan yik mi ayen mi a zɛ wari nɔi po.

ref: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
text: Mi ale toalim nye foolaa la, ka boa ale soa ate mi a gelinti kinla nyiŋŋa.

ref: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
text: Wen ale yuk mu a basi daŋta goluk po ate m gattaŋa a poom kisi mu.

ref: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
text: <<Wa daa nuru ase mi la ayen m baga a tulisi wa, abe ti tu chaab buusa dɔk a biisi.

ref: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
text: Alege waai a karo ayen wa jo ti suŋsuŋŋa, waai karo a bo Mi ale Wen buusa,

ref: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
text: waai a karo a yeeri Wen doani m po a basi ate wa nyigsika a yalima ale mu.

ref: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
text: Ate m yaa baga a biisi abe m kan chali wa yɔgsum, alege ku le ka dii yɔgyɔgla de ale mu la, mi an baga.

ref: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
text: <<Mi jiak kama ale m nyuvunni. Wom m sui kaasuŋ funfɔblaŋa.

ref: Why do you take such delight in destroying those you created and in smiling on sinners?
text: Fi daa namsi mi fi sui a peenti kama, a zɛri waai ate fi nye ale fi nisima, alege a la wabaata nyama zɔŋŋa?

ref: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
text: Fi ta nina ase ka nurubiik la? Fi a nya ase ka nurubiik ale a nya diila?

ref: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
text: ate ku a fɛ ayen fi gisi nya m nye beka abe fi gisi m wabaataŋa mɛ,

ref: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
text: fi poom seba kama ayen mi daa foolaa ate waai karo a vari mi fi nisa po a basi?

ref: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
text: Teeri ayen fi ale mɛ mi ase yak la. Fi yɔgyɔgla de ale ŋman te ti mi a chim tanta?

ref: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
text: Fi an kpiiri mi a basi ase ka biisim la ale labri mi ase biisim kelima la,

ref: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
text: a lik mi ale gbain ale nyiŋ lam ale pai mi a tom chaab ale koba ale jiina?

ref: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
text: Fi te mu nyuvuri ale sak mu ŋmanteka, ate fi nyaasimu po fi nya m chiika zuk.

ref: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
text: M dan tom kaasi fi ti a nya mu kama ate fi kan basi m namsika tom kaasika nyiŋŋa.

ref: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
text: M dan zak m zuk ŋmai fi a siti mu ase ka gbeŋli la abe fi ŋman sak fi pagrim kperika ale ta chaab ale mu.

ref: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
text: Mi daaŋa magka an boro a nueri kama? Cheem abe fi ge mu ate m nya masim fii fiiga,

ref: Zophar from Naamah said:
text: Naama denɔwa Zofar yaa tulisi ayen,

ref: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
text: Fi biik koroku ale basi ate nuruba a sina? Waai ale toariŋ fu ase fi le a nye a la.

ref: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
text: Fi a weeni Wen kama ayen, <Mi siaka a nala kama ate mi nye cheri fi nina po.>

ref: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
text: Abe wa lak sak fu yam wa susuŋŋa, diila wensie yam ka buye. Seba kude: Wen a poom baŋ fi wabaataŋa gela kama.

ref: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
text: Ŋa jueli a gaam wenŋmazukku kama fi baga a nye ka boa? Ŋa limisa a gaam boosuk kpeglimka jigi kama fi baga a seba ka boa?

ref: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?
text: Ŋa magsika a wɔŋŋa a gaam tɛŋka kama ale labsa a gaam nyakpiemu.

ref: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
text: <<Ase wa dan jam a lik fu a basi likka dɔk po ale wi a tigsi a magsi buusa boka, ka wana ale wa ta chaab ale wa?

ref: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
text: Chekki wa a miŋ venta nyam kama, wa be dan nya biem, wa kan kpesi?

ref: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
text: Alege ku toa kama ate beruk a baga a ta yam ase bon waarik biik ale kan baga a biak nuru diila.

ref: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
text: <<Alege fi dan pai fi suinummu a te wa ale teeri fi nisaŋa a te wa,

ref: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
text: a pai wabaataŋa ale bo fi nisaŋa po la a basi ale m basi ate biem a bo fi viuku po,

ref: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.
text: fi yaa le zak zuk a nya ale kan chali chivie, fi le zaani giŋgiŋ a kan chali yɔgsum.

ref: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
text: Fi le sum a baŋ fi daanika, a ŋman teeri ku wari ase nyaata ale chali a taam la.

ref: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
text: Nyuvuri ale nye nna cheri ase kantueŋ suŋsuŋ la, ate legi a nye ase saluik la.

ref: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.
text: Fi le nya likka dii nyiŋla yiila a boro, fi le nya a gilim fidek a vuusi sɔŋsɔŋŋoa.

ref: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
text: Alege gaasa nyama ninaŋa ale nye kpeeri, ate chali beka ale suk ba, ba yiilaŋa ale nueri.>>

ref: Job said to his friends:
text: Ate Job yaa tulisi ayen,

ref: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
text: <<Chichama ka nama ale nuruma, nama dan kpi yam nyam kan ŋman boro.

ref: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
text: Alege mi ta popola kama ase fi la. Mi daa javaliŋ a te fu. Ka wana ale kan seba nyaŋa de meena?

ref: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.
text: <<Mi yaa chim ja laam mi doama jigi, dila meena mi wi Wen kama ate wa tulisi, m ka ja laam kama, dila meena m ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ ale ka kaasuŋŋoa.

ref: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
text: Alege zueba ale baai ale kan ta Wen la a boro ale ka suiyɔgni, ba wenni ka badek pagrimu.

ref: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
text: <<Alege bek duŋsaŋa ate si sak fu yaase wenzuk nuinsaŋa ate si weeni fu,

ref: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
text: Bade meena ba wana ale kan seba ayen ka Naawen ale nye kude?

ref: Every living creature is in the hands of God.
text: Javuk meena nyuvuri ale nurubiik vuusum a bo ka wa nisa po.

ref: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
text: Tunni a kan chamsi wie ase ka giŋgeluŋku ale a lam ŋandiinta diila?

ref: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
text: Yam an bo ale daa baai ale pak la? Nyuvuri woŋ an ta daa miŋka a jamu?

ref: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
text: <<Yam ale pagrim ka Wen ale soa sinsaga ale miŋka ka wa ale soa.

ref: God can hold back the rain or send a flood,
text: Wa dan yik ŋmoruk a ta tɛŋka a ko kama. Wa dan lak wenzukku nyaataŋa a kaasi tɛŋka kama.

ref: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
text: Pagrim ale nakdeka ka wa le soa, waai ate ba a paasi la ale pimpaasirɔ ka wa le soa.

ref: God removes priests and others who have great power—
text: Wa yeeri kaabteerɔba ŋanta ate ba ka jaaboa ale yiak nuru baai ale ta pagrim la.

ref: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
text: Wa basi ate chivie a yik baai ale ta kpaŋta la ale basi ate pagrɔma a jam kpeglim ka jigi.

ref: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
text: Wa basi ate si niŋdeerɔma a chim betta ale basi ate ba butim a cheŋ be a tuinti.

ref: I know and understand every bit of this.
text: <<Mi nina a nya nna meena kama, mi tue abe wom kama alege miŋ.

ref: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
text: Ni le seba diila, mi mɛ seba kama, mi daa javaliŋ a te ni.

ref: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
text: Ase ni meena gum chaab a dan sina. Nama jigi kula ale chim ka yam.

ref: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
text: Ni le baga a biisi luk a te wa? Ni le nak biika nampaŋŋa a te Wen ya?

ref: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
text: Ku le kpeglim nalimnyiini ase wa nin kpesi nya ni? Ni le baga a paasi wa ase ni le a paasi nuruba diila?

ref: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
text: Wa le sum toariŋ ni ase ni nin suk a sak lukka.

ref: and his glorious splendor would make you terrified.
text: Wa nalimu ale basi ate ni kpaziim a nak. Wa kpazinagsuku ale jam ni zuk.

ref: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
text: Ni wamagsimaŋa a ka kiriya ase ka buntuem la, ni nampaŋŋa a wobsa ase ka yak la.

ref: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
text: Nye diki ate mi a biisi, ate dii le a jam la di jam.

ref: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
text: Wa dan poom ko mu mi diem ta yiila ale wa kama, mi ale biisi a vari m dek wa nina po.

ref: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
text: Kude ale cheem a chim m varibasika, diila nuru waai ale kan ta Wen la a kan yaksi a jam wa niŋŋa.

ref: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de ate mi a gomsi mi biika la, mi seba ayen m le nyini du a nyini.

ref: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
text: Waai a ta wie a ŋma mi? Ku dan ka dila, mi ale sina abe m kpi.

ref: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
text: <<Tin te mi wieŋa de ŋayewa nyiini Wen yaa, ate m kan suk ale fu.

ref: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
text: Abe fi yaa wi mu ate m tulisi yaase fi basi ate m biisi ate fi tulisi.

ref: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
text: Ka nyebeka ale wabaata dina ate mi nye? Sak mu m kaasuŋku ale m wabaata.

ref: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
text: Ka boa ate fi a kan nya mi geŋŋa ale pai mu a chim dachiaga?

ref: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?
text: Fi ale namsi va kuui ate viok a fuk basi? Fi le chali a vi vɔtta?

ref: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
text: Dila fi a ŋmarisi ka watuasa wie a dueni a ta chaab ale mi a yaa basi ate mi a teeri m biik po wabaata.

ref: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
text: Fi bobi m naŋsa ale chɔrima, fi kpesi a nya m suitaŋa meena kama, ale a kpesi m naŋtaata.

ref: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
text: <<Nurubiik ate nipok a biak la daaŋa an soa dii ya ŋa be ka daanika nyiini.

ref: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
text: Nurubiik daaŋa ka fi ale poli, fi ale dueni wa chiisaŋa nɔi ale ka diila ale te wa bana wa kan baga a gaamu.

ref: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
text: Dila basi wa nyaasim abe fi ge wadek wa nyiini, ate wa pai wa daaŋa meena a tom ase nuru ate ba pai ate wa a tom tuima la.

ref: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
text: <<Dila yiila a boro kama a te tiib, ba dan che bu a lɔnsi, bu le ŋman tom, ate bu naŋ bulaŋa a kan pusi kpeeri.

ref: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
text: alege nyiam yɔgsuk a dan boro bu le puusi ate va bula a nyini.

ref: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
text: Ase nyiam ale muriŋ a bɛ beli po diila yaase beli naŋ ale kpeeri a ko diila,

ref: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
text: dila nurubiik ale duak tɛŋ a kan ŋman yiti. Ate ku paari diipo ate wenŋmazukku a ga taam la nurubisa a kan yiti yaase ba yiti goom po.

ref: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
text: <<Ka fi nin suk mu vɔrumu po nyiini a suk mu ate fi suipuurumu a ga taam! Ka fi a nin dak mi diipo a yaa teeri m wari!

ref: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
text: Nuru a dan kpi wa le ŋman boro? Mi tuim pagraŋa daaŋa meena m le limisi daa ŋaai ale zunchoŋŋa ate ŋa jam.

ref: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
text: Fi le wi ate m tulisi fu, fi le yaali ayen fi nya waai ate fi nye ale fi nisa la.

ref: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
text: Chekki fi le chiini m laari tabika alege fi kan ta m wabaataŋa.

ref: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
text: Fi le lik m nye kaasika boorik po, fi le lik m wabaataŋa.

ref: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
text: <<Alege ase guuk ale a chiiri a lo diila ale ba le a yeeri piuŋ ku jigi diila,

ref: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
text: ase nyiam ale bilim tintana a ta cheŋ diila ale ŋmoruk pagrik ale ji tanta a ta cheŋ diila, fi a kaasi nurubiik yiila ka dila.

ref: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
text: Fi a nya pagrim wa zuk ka bunyi dekki ate wa cheŋ ferr, fi a tagri wa nimbidiaka kama a te ate wa a cheŋ.

ref: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
text: Ba dan te wa nidoabilisaŋa zula wa zɛ, ba be dan te ba siŋ tɛŋ, wa kan nya.

ref: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
text: Wa seba ka wadek nyiŋka ale a dom a kum a te wadek.>>

ref: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
text: Tema denɔwa Elifaz yaa tulisi ayen,

ref: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
text: Ase fi dan ta fidek suik, waai ate kan chali Wen ya, waai ate kan puusi a te wa.

ref: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
text: Fi wabaataŋa ale a sak fi le a biisi diila, fi a lik fidek ale ka sebika wie.

ref: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
text: Fidek nɔnni ale a kaasi fu, daa mi. Fidek nɔngbanvaataŋa ale bo a mini fu.

ref: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
text: <<Ka fi ale nuru waai ate ba dɛ niŋ a biak la? Ba biak fi ale ge guutaŋa?

ref: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
text: Fi chiak wom Wen ale zɔk diila? Fi pai yam a te ka fidek fi nyiini.

ref: Do you know and understand something we don't?
text: Fi seba ka boa ate tama zɛ? Fi ta ka boan jaab nyaasim ate tama ka?

ref: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
text: Wen suiyɔgni an zuak a te fu, wie ŋaai ale biisi nna balibali a te fu la?

ref: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
text: Wen a dan kan ta siak teka ale wa maarɔma, wenŋmazukku a dan kan poom a nye cheri wa nina po,

ref: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
text: alege ka nurubiik ale pɔsima, waai ale kaasi ale bie, waai ale a nyu biem ase nyiam la.

ref: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
text: <<Wom mi, ate m biisi ku kiri a sak fu, basi ate mi weeni fu mi ale nya diila,

ref: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
text: a te baai nyiini ate tɛŋka ba pai te diipo ate nichaanɔ an va ba po a taam ya.

ref: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
text: Wabaata nyɔnɔ waai ale a namsi nuru yonta la ale bo ninam po wa boka po meena.

ref: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
text: Kpazinagsuk luelita ale sueri wa tueŋa po, diipo ate wie meena a nye nalimnyiini la, zueba yaa siti wa.

ref: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
text: ate duinsa a limisi ayen si dɛ wa nyiŋka. Wa seba ayen legini danni a paari kama.

ref: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
text: Kaasuŋ ale kpazinagsuk ale sueri a daani wa ase naab pagrik ale a limisi ayen wa siti wa la,

ref: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
text: Wa kan nyini legini po a nyini, bolim ŋiak ale dɛ naŋ bulaŋa ale pusi la ate Wen nɔnni vuusumu ale ji wa ta cheŋ.

ref: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
text: Wa le nye ase tiib yɔn bena ale wiiri la, ase tiib puuta ale siiri la.

ref: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
text: Baai ale kan ta Wen la a kan nya ŋaaŋbisa, bolim abe le dɛ ba yie ŋaai ate ba da ba ale ligra ate ba sɛ la.

ref: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
text: Nuruma de ale a zɔk daanika a nye biem la, ba suiniimaŋa a sueri ale ka pimpaasima.>>

ref: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
text: <<Mi wom wie yega kama ase ŋade la, nama meena ka niniga suiyɔgni teerɔba.

ref: But I would offer hope and comfort instead.
text: Alege mi nɔnni ale te ni nyiŋbiiri, mi nɔnni suiyɔgni ale fasiyaa a jam ni jigi.

ref: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
text: <<Mi dan poom biisi, mi nyiŋdommaŋa a kan basi, ate m dan poom basi biik, ŋa kan cheŋ.

ref: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
text: Chekki, Wen yaa fi basi ate m nye kuligi, fi kaasi m yenni meena kama.

ref: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
text: Wen a siti mi kama ale dari mi cheeri ale wa suipuurumu ale a ŋɔbi nyina. Mi dachiaka a nya mi kama ale kisika.

ref: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
text: Wen a tulim mi a te ka nuru baata ale yuk mi a basi wabaata nyam batta po.

ref: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
text: Jaab meena a jam nala kama te mi alege wa lik mi, wa tik ka mi nyiŋ

ref: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
text: wa tɔŋdɔma a gilim mi kama, ba ka jiirimmoa, ba lu ka mi yiimaŋa ale mobi m yaamu a basi tɛŋ.

ref: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
text: <<Mi baali ka boorisa garuk a lik mi nyiŋ gbaŋka ale pai mi dinni a kpi tɛŋ.

ref: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
text: Mi kum kama ate mi ninaŋa a muni ate mi ninaŋa a ji ate mi nina a lo du,

ref: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
text: alege mi nisima an nye vakvak ate mi puusaŋa a nye cheri.

ref: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
text: <<Tɛŋŋa, kan lik mi ziimu. Mi ale kaari a yaali diila a kan nye chorr.

ref: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de pooma mi seerɔwa a bo ka wenŋmazuk, mi maarɔwa a bo ka ŋmazuk.

ref: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
text: Waai ale biisi a te mi la ka mi doa ase mi ale a kum ale ninyaata a te Wen la.

ref: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
text: Nuru nankula po wa a saalim Wen ase ka nuru ale a saalim a te wa doa diila.

ref: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
text: <<Bena magadega ale taam alege ate mi cheŋ suik kuui ale kaa ŋmani la po.

ref: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
text: <<Mi chiika a ŋɔriŋ kama, mi daaŋa a gebi basi kama a gela, boosuk yaa le a limisi mi.

ref: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
text: Chekki baai ale nye mi a la la a gilim mi, mi ninaŋa a nya ka ba kisika.

ref: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
text: <<Wen yaa, tuni a vari mu a basi. Waai karo a tuni vari mu a basi.

ref: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
text: Fi lik ba popolaŋa kama ate ba kan miŋi, dila nyiŋ fi kan basi ate ba nya pagrimoa.

ref: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
text: Nuru a dan zɛri wa doaba tutuna nyiŋ, wa bisaŋa ale nam ku nyiŋ.

ref: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
text: Sui kaasuŋ a basi kama ate mi an ŋman nya a paari, mi nyiŋ diokku meena a nye ase ka yisuŋ la.

ref: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
text: Ku cha baai ale ta wensie la kama ate ba meena a bo a mini mi ayen mi a ka Wen ya.

ref: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
text: Ku dan poom ka dii ya wayɔrisima nyama ale yik ba suitaŋa a ta, ate baai nisima ale nye cheri la ale ta pagrim.

ref: But none of my friends show any sense.
text: <<Alege, ni meena jam, ni ŋman nye nya. Mi a kan nya yam nuru ni po.

ref: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
text: Nuruma de a tulim yok ate ku a chim kantueŋ, legi po ba a weeni kama ayen bolim a moata.

ref: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
text: Ase yie dii ate mi a yiili la dan ka vɔrumu, ate mi dan pati m tiaka legini po,

ref: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
text: ase mi daa wi vɔrumu ayen, <Fi ka m ko,> ale a wi nanzuinni ayen, <M ma,> yaase <M tua.>

ref: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
text: Ŋa le siŋ vɔrumu po? Ti le siŋ tantaŋa po ale chaaba?>>

ref: Bildad from Shuah said:
text: Suya denɔwa Bildad yaa tulisi ayen,

ref: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
text: <<Ka dimpo ate fi le kpeglim biisaŋa de? Ta yam, ate ti baga a biisi.

ref: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
text: Fi waai ale dari fidek a cheeri nna bunabuna ale suipuurum la, ba basi tɛŋka fi nyiŋŋa? Yaase ba zak pinaŋa ŋa jigini?

ref: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
text: <<Wabaata nyɔnɔwa zeuŋku a kpimsi, wa bolim ŋiaka a basi dɛka kama.

ref: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
text: Wa pagrim tabika an ŋman pagra, wadek zɔŋŋa a yuk wa a basi ka tɛŋ.

ref: they are trapped in a net,
text: Baruk ale yik wa nankpanni, baruk ale yik wa naa giŋgiŋ.

ref: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
text: Nyinyigsa nyam ale a nyigsi wa jigi meena, ale va wa naŋsa.

ref: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
text: Ku dɛ wa nyiŋ gbaŋka gela kama, kum ale liŋ biak jabuui la a dɛ wa kama.

ref: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
text: Ba cheeri kama a ta wa nyini wa viuku po ate wa gɔk santiri a cheŋ nyinyigsa naawa jigi.

ref: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
text: Bolim ale bo wa viuku po, bolim mɔnuŋ ale waaŋ wa boka jigini.

ref: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
text: Wa tɛŋ naŋsaŋa a kpi kama tɛŋka ate ŋmazuk naŋsaŋa a kpi.

ref: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
text: Ba yiak wa kama ate wa nyini bolim po a jo legi po ale yiak wa tɛŋzuk de.

ref: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
text: Chekki nuru biok boka ale ka diila ale la, nuru waai ale kan seba Wen la jigini ale ka diila ale la.>>

ref: How long will you torture me with your words?
text: <<Ni le namsi mi a paari ka dimpo abe ni ŋɔriŋ mu ale wie?

ref: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
text: Naŋtuok nɔi pi ale nna ate ni toariŋ mu ale ta chaab ale mu a kan chali chivie.

ref: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
text: Ku dan ka wensie nyiŋ mi cheŋ a be kama, mi nyebeka ti ka mi nyiini niŋ wari.

ref: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
text: Ni dan poom zak nidek ŋmai a gaam mi ale pai mi ale kan daa jaab la a biisi mi,

ref: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
text: yaa be seba ayen Wen ale nye mi a kaasi ale dari wa ŋmiaka a gilim mi.

ref: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
text: <<Mi a kum kama ayen, <Ba nye mu kaasi m kan nya tulisika>, mi a wi a yaali maarika alege nyemagsika ka.

ref: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
text: Wa suinni a dɛ ka nna pɔkpɔk ale mi, wa chiini mi a nyo ka wa dachaasaŋa po.

ref: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
text: Wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma a duŋ kama ale fifiok, ba sɛ ka bimbimi a ta chaab ale mu ale kɔk a gilim m viuku.

ref: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
text: Mi nichamma ale mi dɔkliema a baŋ mi wari kama, ba a nya mi ase ka nichaanɔ la.

ref: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
text: Mi wi mi tomteerɔwa kama, alege wa an tulisi ya, mi ale saalim wa ale m dek nɔi la mɛ.

ref: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
text: Mi vuusumu a daani mi powa kama, mi dek suataŋa a kisi mi kama.

ref: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
text: Nidoabili fiisa a nye mi a la kama, mi dan ga na nyini ba a nye mi a lu kama.

ref: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
text: <<Ni ta jiirim ale mu, m doaba, ni ta jiirim ale mu, diila Wen nisa ale nak mu.

ref: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
text: Ka boa ate ni a vi mu ase Wen ale a vi mu la? Nama an namsi mi a magsi ya?

ref: I wish that my words could be written down
text: <<Mi yaali ayen mi wieŋa ate ŋmarisi doa kama, ŋa ti ŋmarisi doa gbaŋ po,

ref: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
text: Mi seba ayen m Da Tuesirɔwa a boro kama, ate ku kpeglimka wa le zaani tɛŋka zuk.

ref: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
text: Mi nyiŋ gbaŋka abe dan kaasi ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ mi nyiŋ lammu po mi ale nya Wen.

ref: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
text: Mi dek ale nya wa ale m dek nina, ate mi ale seba wa ale ka waai la. Mi suinummu ale yaali a soa diila.

ref: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
text: <<Ni dan weeni ayen, <Ti le ti nye dii a vi wa la, diila daanika piilimka a boka wa jigi,>

ref: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!
text: nama dek a chali gebika, diila suipuurum ale ta gebika namsika a jam, ate ni yaa seba ayen buusa a boro.>>

ref: Zophar from Naamah said:
text: Naama denɔwa Zofar yaa tulisi ayen,

ref: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
text: <<Mi popolaŋa daanika ale choa ate mi a tulisi dii nyiŋla ku daani mi ka yega.

ref: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
text: Mi a wom ka toariŋka ate zula a karo, ate mi dek miŋka po ayen mi tulisi.

ref: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
text: ayen wabaata nyɔnɔwa masimu an soa diiya, waai ale kan ta Wen la suipeentika a kan beni.

ref: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
text: Wa kanjantaŋa a dan poom a paari wenni, ate wa zukku a tiri chiŋmaaŋa,

ref: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
text: wa le kpi taam wuu, ase wadek binta la. Baai ale nya wa la ale weeni ayen, <Wa boka be?>

ref: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
text: Num buui ale nya wa la a kan ŋman nya wa, wa jigini a kan ŋman nya wa.

ref: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
text: Wa bisaŋa ale nye magsi ale ŋanjaksaŋa, wadek nisaŋa ale pai wa jigsika a ŋman te.

text: <<Ka boa ale soa ate wabaata nyam a kasim boro, a kpaŋ alege ate ba pagrimu a kasim a zuak?

text: <<Waai a baga a sak Wen yammoa, wa le toalim a bo baai ale bo wenzuk la buusa la?

text: <<Nuru an baga a ta nyuenta a te Wen ya. Yam nyɔnɔ an poom baga a te wa nyuenta.

text: Fi wabaataŋa a zuak kama. Fi wabaataŋa a ka kpeglimka.

text: M dan poom seba ka m nin nya wa juijui la ate mi poom baga a cheŋ ka wa boka jigini.

text: Tɛŋ kaai ate ŋandiinta a nyini du a jam la, bolim a tagri ka kama tɛŋ,

text: Ate wa yaa weeni nuru ayen, <<Nyɔnɔwa yɔgsum chalika ka yam, fi be dan zɛri biem ka miŋka.>>

text: diipo ate mi niiŋa ale mi buaŋa a te biisim yega la ate pinaŋa po mi nya kpaam yega a nyini kpaam tiisaŋa po la.

ref: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
text: <<Mi ale cheŋ tɛŋka nansuiŋku la a yaa kali nuruma po la,

text: dii nyiŋla mi vari ŋanjaksaŋa ale kaari a yaali maarika la kama a basi, ale baai ale kan ta koba ate ba a maari ba la.

text: Nuru waai ale jam boro a kpi la a niak mi. Mi basi ate pukɔgini a lenni yiila wa suinummu po.

ref: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
text: Mi jam chim ka yeema nina ale gbaruktaŋa naŋsa.

ref: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
text: Mi jam chim ka ko a te baai ale a silim la ale maari nicham ba daanika po.

text: Mi wɛ gaasa nyɔnɔwa nyinaŋa kama ale vari baai ate wa ta la a basi.

ref: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
text: <<Mi poli kama ayen, <Mi le kpi mi dek yenni po, mi daaŋa ale piisi dii ase tintain busuŋ zaa la.

ref: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
text: Mi poli kama ayen mi tɛŋ naŋsaŋa ale siŋ a paari nyiamu, ate maglimu ale lo m ŋmazuk naŋsaŋa zuk yokku meena.

ref: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
text: <<Nuruba a wom mi kama ale a yiili, a sina ale a limisi mi sinsaga.

text: Ba limisi mi kama ase nuruba ale a limisi ŋmoruk la, a yaa nyu mi wieŋa ase tɛŋsik ŋmoruk la.

text: Mi yaa lueri suiku a te ba, ale kali ase naab la wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma suŋsuŋ. Mi jam nye ase ka waai ale a yɔk baai ale a kum la sue la.

ref: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
text: <<Alege yɔgyɔgla de ba nye mi a la kama, nuru baai ale paala a gaam mi, baai koba ate mi tin kan yaali ayen ba maari mi baasa a nya mi piisa zuwa.

text: Ba le jiak ale ŋanyaalinta ale kɔm la, ba nyiem ka tɛŋ kosikka po tɛŋ kaai ale doa kinla la yokku.

ref: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
text: Ba jam yiak ba kama badek nuruma po, a na ba ase zueba la.

text: Ba jam fɛ kama a bo beli naŋ kosikka po, pinaŋa po ale tɛŋka vie po.

text: Ba yaa a wooli tiisaŋa po ale gurum badek ale yɔgsum tiisaŋa tɛŋ.

ref: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
text: A ka kiri nuru baai ale kan ta yuei ya ate ba yiak ba tɛŋka po.

ref: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
text: <<Ate yɔgyɔgla de ba nidoabilisaŋa a pai yiili a nye mi a la. Mi yaa chim ka ja laam ba po.

text: Ba kisi mi kama ale yalima ale mi, ba poom kan kpaliŋ ba chesi tintueta a basi mi nimbie po.

text: Yɔgyɔgla de ate Wen a kaasi mi tommu ate mi a wobsa la ba yaa nye ba le a yaali diila a gilim mi.

ref: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
text: Mi juga geŋ buuni a siti mi, a bari mi batta, a gilim ayen ba ko mi.

ref: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
text: Ba wɛ mi suiku kama, ba nya suik kama a kaasi mi alege waai an maari ba.

ref: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
text: Nyigsika a nya ka pagrim mi zuk, mi zulaŋa a cheŋ kama ase viok la, ate mi ale soa m dek diila a muriŋ bɛ ase chiŋmari la.

ref: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
text: <<Yɔgyɔgla de mi nyuvunni a muriŋ a bɛ kama, ninam daa ale yik mi.

ref: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
text: Yɔkku a chub mi kobaŋa kama, mi kan nya vuusum ale mi nyiŋdommaŋa.

ref: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
text: Wa yuk mi a basi bagta po, ate mi yaa chim tanta ale buntuem.

ref: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
text: <<Mi a kaari a te fu, Wen yaa, alege fi an tulisi ya, mi yiti zaani ŋmai, alege fi an potim a nya mi.

text: Mi seba fi le ta mi siŋ jam kum po, juijui ate fi lueri ate ŋanvuta meena ale cheŋ la.

ref: I mourned for the poor and those who suffered.
text: Mi an jam kum te baai ale bo daanika po la? Ku an daani mi chiika ŋanjaksaŋa nyiŋŋa?

ref: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
text: Alege mi ale jam a yiili a limisi nalim la, biem ale jan jam, mi ale jam a gisi bolim la, legi ale jan jam.

ref: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
text: Choa kaai ale bo mi po la kan maara basi, ninam daa ale a tu mu.

ref: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
text: Mi a nyiem kama nna timtim, alege daa wenbinni ale nye ya, mi za ka tigsuŋku po a kaari a yaali maarika.

ref: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
text: Mi yaa chim ka suemkpatta suok, viuta vaanchoa.

ref: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
text: Mi nyiŋ gbaŋka a sobri kama ale a luenti, mi nyiŋka a dɛ kama ale nyiŋ toliŋka.

ref: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
text: <<Mi nye ka nɔiyeŋ ale mi ninaŋa ayen mi kan nya nipokbili ale kɔrisa.

ref: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
text: Ku daa kaasika a te wabaata nyama, kaasuŋ a te baai ale nye kaasi la?

ref: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
text: Wa kan nya mi suitaŋa, ale a chiini mi naŋsa tabika meena?

ref: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
text: nuru yonta abe dɛ mi ale bori jabuui la, abe ba voori m ŋanborintaŋa.

ref: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
text: <<Ase mi suinummu a dan siak te nipok pimpaasima, yaase m nak waai ale moata mu la tuok,

text: m powa abe num nidoa yoŋ zom, abe nuru yonta a goa ale wa.

ref: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
text: Dila ate le chim ka chivie, wabiok kuui ale magsi buusa boka.

ref: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
text: Ka bolim buui ale a dɛ a ga a kaasi, bu ti dɛ m ŋancheentaŋa.

ref: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
text: Daa wa waai ale nye mi luikku po la ale nye ba? Daa wadek ale daani tama ti mama puusa po?

ref: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
text: <<Ase mi nin zɛri an te ŋanjaksaŋa ba ŋan yaalinta yaase m basi ate pukɔga a dɛ niniga,

text: ase mi nin peri ŋandiinta a te m dek alege an chari ale kpiŋsa,

text: alege a nyini mi biik po mi nya wa zuk kama ase ko la, a nyini m biam po m gani pukɔga.

ref: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
text: ate wa suinum an niak mi mi ale te wa ale m piisaŋa kɔbtaŋa la nyiŋŋa.

ref: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
text: Ase mi nin zak nisa a ta chaab ale kpiŋsa, ale seba ayen mi le biisi buusa dɔkku po a nyini,

ref: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
text: be basi ate m nisimaŋa a passi a lo, basi ate si wɛ si tomaŋa po.

ref: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
text: Diila mi a chali kaasuŋ Wen jigi kama, mi an baga a nye wa ŋala chaaba dii nyiŋla mi a chali ka yɔgsum ale wa nyaksika.

ref: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
text: <<Ase mi a dan naŋ mi dachiak zubiok nyiŋ yaase m sui a peenti daanika ale jam wa zuk la,

text: alege mi an lak mi nɔnni a nye wabiok a ka a te wa.

ref: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
text: Mi an suk m wabaataŋa ase nuruba ale a nye diila, mi an suk m foolaawa m suinum po,

ref: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
text: <<Mi dan ta ka waai ate wa a wom mu. Mi ŋmarisika m yuenni a magsi m varibasika. Wen Dii Ale A Niak La abe tulisi mu. Waai ale a ŋma mu la abe ŋmarisi a nyo gbaŋ po.

text: M le chiini m naŋ tabika meena a te wa. Ase nabiik la m le cheŋ wa jigi.

text: <<Ase mi tɛŋka a dan kaari a ta chaab ale mi ate ka vuutaŋa meena a yɔk ale ninyaata,

text: Mi ponni po a nye ase daam kolini ale lik la, nna se daam bunlɔk paalita ale gomsi naka la.

text: Kan te mi yɔgsum chalika a daani fu. Mi kan ta pagrim fi zuwa.

text: Wa bobi mi naŋsa ale chɔrima, wa kasim a nya mi suita meena kama.>

text: ate ba cheem basi ba nye kaasuŋku abe wa kasi wa wa kanjantaŋa po,

text: a kasi wa chiika vɔrumu po siŋ ka, ale wa nyuvunni ate gebik a kan ko wa.

text: Wa yaa le jam nuruba jigi a weeni ayen, <Mi tom kaasi kama, ale an nye dii ale magsi la, alege mi an nya dii ale magsi mi la.

text: <<Wen ale a nye wieŋa de meena a te nuru buye, poom ka naŋtuok nɔi buta,

text: ayen wa basi ate wa pilim nyini vɔrumu jigi a ŋmani, ate nyuvuri bolimu a nyaksi wa zuk.

text: Diila wa weeni kama ayen, <Ku kan te nuru nyuenta ase wa ale a nye ate Wen sui a peenti.>

text: <<Dila wom mi, nama baai ale a miŋ la. Wen an baga a nye biemmoa, Wen Dii Ale A Niak La a kan nye a kaasi.

text: Ka wana ale lueri wa ayen wa a nya tɛŋzuk de? Ka wana ale ayen wa a nya tɛŋka meena?

text: nurubiik meena ale kpi ate nuru a pilim ŋman tantaŋa po.

text: waai ale kaa luk nabisa ale a sak ŋmanteka ale jigsirɔba ŋanjaksa zuwa, diila ba meena ka wa nisima tuima.

ref: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
text: Ba a kpi ka nna kadi, yok suŋsuŋ, ate nuruma nyiŋsa a gɔk ate ba taam ferr. Nuru kpientaŋa a yeeri kama alege daa nurubisa nisa ale a yeeri ba.

text: Wa a namsi ba kama ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ juijui ate waai meena a baga a nya ba la,

ref: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
text: Wen abe nye fi ale a yaali diila ase fi nin zɛri an tagri ya? Fidek a nye popola, daa mi, dila weeni mi fi le seba diila.

text: Waai a karo a tua a baga a choa ku. Ka wana ale wa baga a zaani ale mi?

ref: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
text: Ka wana ale ta wari ale mi ayen ku a fɛ ayen m tuni? Jaab meena ale bo tɛŋzuk la ka mi ale soa.

ref: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
text: <<Mi kan basi ku naŋsaŋa wie biiga, ku pagrimu ale ku ale soa diila.

ref: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
text: Ka wana ale baga a yeeri ku gbaŋka? Ka wana ale wa cheŋ paari ku ale nɔi baŋŋa?

ref: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
text: Ka wana ale baga a lak ku nɔnni, ale nyina ŋaai ale a nak kpaziim la?

ref: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
text: Ku ŋaaŋka a ta ka kanbieŋsa ate si tom chaab a maŋ chaab nna giŋgiŋ,

ref: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
text: Si tom ka chaab nna giŋgiŋ, si yik ka chaab a kan poori.

ref: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
text: Ku siŋtika a nyaksi ase ka bolim la, ku ninaŋa a nye ase wenbiri ale pusi a jueli la.

ref: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
text: Nyuisa ale a nyini ku yueŋa po ase samɔniŋ ale dik bolim zuk a vaasi la.

ref: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
text: Pagrim ale bo ku ŋinni, waai meena ale a nya ku la kpaziim ale a nak.

ref: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
text: Ku nyiŋ lammu a vi chaab ka nna giŋgiŋ, ti nye ka nna giŋgiŋ a kan choa.

ref: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
text: Ku dan vaari yiti pagrɔma kpaziita ale a nak, ba a ŋmani ka ŋaaŋ alege ate ku a fɔbi.

ref: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
text: Kutuk a nye ase ka kinkari la, ate kutuk mɔnuŋ a nye ase diok poosik la.

ref: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
text: Peema a kan basi ate ku a chali, visiŋ tana a nye ase ka vɔtta la a te ku.

ref: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
text: Doari a nye ku jigi ase ka kinkari la, ku a la gbaluku nuemka kama.

ref: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
text: Ku lɔgni a nye ase ka takaba la, ŋa a gebi tɛŋ yɔksuku ase za fɔbika laarik la.

ref: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
text: Ku a nye ate nyakpiemu a dam ase nyiam ale a vaasi la, ale a nye ate bu a bɔk ase samɔniŋ ale kpaam la.

ref: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
text: Ku a basi ate suik nyiamu po a nyaksi ku ŋaaŋ ale labri nyakpiemu ate bu a chim puuk.

ref: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
text: Ku kan nya duŋ sii ale ta kanjanta la ase ŋanta la, ku ka naab duŋ waarisaŋa meena zuk.>>

ref: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
text: <<Mi seba ayen fi baga a nye wie meena kama, fi zɔŋŋa a kan kaasi.

ref: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
text: Fi begi ayen, <Ka wana ale nna a lik mi sinsaga ale ka sebika?> Chekki mi biisi ka wie ŋaai ate mi an miŋ ya, wakperikaliisa nna yegayega ate mi baga a seba.

ref: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
text: <<Fi weeni ayen, <Wom yɔgyɔgla, ate mi biisi, m le bek fu, ate fi tulisi mu.>

ref: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
text: Mi tueŋa a jam wom fi wari kama alege yɔgyɔgla de mi nina a nya fu kama.

ref: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
text: Naawen ale jam weeni wieŋa de a te Job la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa yaa weeni Tema denɔwa Elifaz ayen, <<Mi sui ale a puuri ale fu ale fi doaba bayewa, dii nyiŋla fi an biisi mi dii ale magsi la, ase mi tomteerɔwa Job ale biisi diila.

ref: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
text: Dila yɔgyɔgla pai lalisa siyopɔi ale padaasa siyopɔi a cheŋ mi tomteerɔwa Job jigi a nye juka tiirim a te nidek. Mi tomteerɔwa Job ale puusi a te ni, ate m siak wa puusa ate m kan nye ale ni a magsi chaab ale ni bettaŋa. Ni an biisi mi wari a magsi ya, ase mi tomteerɔwa Job ale biisi diila.>>

ref: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
text: Dila Tema denɔwa Elifaz ale Suya denɔwa Bildad ale Naama denɔwa Zofar a nye Naawen ale weeni ba diila, ate Naawen a siak Job puusaŋa.

ref: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
text: Job ale puusi a te wa doama la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Naawen yaa basi ate wa ŋman jigsi a te wa le jam ta ŋan baai la naŋtuok nɔi buye.

ref: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
text: Wa suataŋa meena ale wa tuama ale waai meena ale jam seba wa la a jam dɛ ale wa wa yenni po. Ba yaa yɔk wa sui ale daani kaai meena ate Naawen a ta jam wa zuk la, ate ba wanyi meena a te wa kpana ale ligmɔniŋ nifelinni.

ref: The Lord now blessed Job more than ever; he gave him
text: Naawen a jam niak Job ŋaaŋnyiŋ boka kama a gaam piilimka. Wa jam ta ka piisa tusa pi ale ŋanaansi (

ref: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
text: Wa jam maa ta ka nidoabilisa bayopɔi ale lieba bata.

ref: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
text: Juijui a jam ka tɛŋka zuwa ate lieba a nala ase Job liema la, ate ba kowa a te ba nitalim ale ba tuama.

ref: and when he finally died, he was very old.
text: Wa jam kpaŋ kama a ta bena a yaa kpi.

ref: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
text: Suipeentik a bo le ka waai ale a zɛri wabaata nyam sinsaga la jigi, yaase waai ale kan a va wabaata nyam suik la, yaase waai ale kan a kali ale wabaata nyam la.

ref: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
text: Alege a nya ka suipeentik a nyini Naawen sinsaŋŋa po la, alege a poli wa sinsaŋŋa zuk kantueŋ ale yok la.

ref: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
text: Kula nyɔnɔwa a nye ase ka tiib ate ba vuk beli naŋsa nyiam nɔi la ate bu a yɔni yɔna diipo ale magsi la alege ate bu vaata a kan wiiri la. Wa dii meena ate wa a nye la a niak kama.

ref: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
text: Alege ku daa di ale wabaata nyama. Ba a nye ase ka vɔtta ate viok a fuk a basi la.

ref: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
text: Wabaata nyam kan baga a zaani a tu Naawen buusaŋa, yaase wabaata nyam a gum wayɔrisima nyam po.

ref: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
text: Diila Naawen a nya wayɔrisima nyam suiku kama, alege wabaata nyam a bo ka suik po a cheŋ kaasuŋ jigi.

ref: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
text: Ka boa ale soa ate tɛŋsa a zɔk biem, ate nuruba a zɔk kinla?

ref: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
text: Tɛŋka nalimaŋa a yiti zaani kama ate niŋdeerɔma a tigsi a ta chaab ale Naawen ale ta chaab ale Naab waai ate wa Lueri la.

ref: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
text: Ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Basi ate ti gebi ba chɔrimaŋa abe ti yuk ŋa a basi.>>

ref: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
text: Waai ale kali wenŋmazuk naamu zukpaglika zuk la a yaa la. Nyɔnɔwa a nye ba a la.

ref: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
text: Wa yaa toariŋ ba ale wa suipuurumu a basi ate yɔgsum a yik ba ale wa suipuurumu, a weeni ayen,

ref: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
text: <<Mi bobi m naawa kama Zayon zuk, m tuilum guuku.>>

ref: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
text: M le mooli Naawen wieŋa. Wa weeni mi ayen, <<Fi ka M Nidoabili. Jinla m chim ka fi Ko.

ref: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
text: Bek mi wari ate m basi ate tɛŋsaŋa fi tuesi abe tɛŋka kpeglimka jiga fi soa.

ref: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
text: Fi le nya ba zuk ale kuta naam tachek, fi le waaŋ ba chaab ase takaba la.>>

ref: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
text: Nama nalimaŋa, ni wom. Nama tɛŋka niŋdeerɔma ni zamsi wanni de.

ref: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
text: Tom a te Naawen ale yɔgsum chalika, ate ni nyiŋsa a gɔk ale suipeentik.

ref: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
text: Ni puusi Nidoabinni, kan daa di wa sui ale puuri ale ni ate wa kaasi ni, ni suiku po, diila wa suinni a baga a yiti kama nna nwuli. Baai ale a cheŋ wa jigi ayen wa lik ba la sue ale peenti.

ref: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
text: Naawen yaa, nya dachaasaŋa ale piisi diiya! Ba piisi kama a yiti a ta chaab ale mu.

ref: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
text: Yega a weeni mi wari kama ayen, <<Wen a kan vari fu a basi.>>

ref: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
text: Alege fi ka jachɔgsim a gilim mu, Naawen yaa. Fi basi kama ate zula a jam m zuk ale zak mu a zaani.

ref: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
text: Mi kaari kama ate ku jueli a wi Naawen, ate wa tulisi mu a nyini wa tuilum guuku zuk.

ref: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
text: M duak kama a goa ale ŋman yiti, dii nyiŋla Naawen ale ta mu.

ref: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
text: Mi kan chali tusa piisa ale nyini ta chaab ale mi kauk meena la.

ref: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
text: Yiti, Naawen yaa! Vari mu a basi, m dek Wen yaa! Fɔbi m dachaasaŋa meena tapaasa, nak gaasa nyama nyinaŋa a voori.

ref: because you protect and bless your people.
text: Varibasika a nyini ka Naawen jigi. Fi niauŋku abe bo fi nuruma zuk!

ref: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
text: Tulisi mu ase m nin wi fu, m dek wayɔrisima Wen yaa. Te mu vuusum a nyini m daanika po, ta jiirim ale mu abe fi wom m puusa.

ref: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
text: Nuruba, nama ale tulim mi zulaŋa ate ŋa chim chivie a paari ka dimpo? Nama ale yaali pimpaasima abe ni gisi venta bɔgta a paari ka dimpo?

ref: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
text: Ni seba ayen Naawen a gaari baai ale a yaali wa la a te ka wadek. M dan wi Naawen wa le wom mu.

ref: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
text: Fi suipuurum po kan tom kaasi. Ni dan dua ni gaduata zuk, ni kpesi ni suiniimaŋa abe ni nye diki.

ref: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
text: Ni pai kaab maŋsa a te Naawen abe ni ta sebchakka ale wa.

ref: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
text: Yega a bek kama ayen, <<Ka wana ale baga a sak ti wamaŋŋa?>> Basi ate fi nimbidiaka bolimu a nyaksi ti zuk, Naawen yaa.

ref: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
text: Fi basi kama ate masim a sueri m suinummu a gaam ba le nya ŋandiinta ale daam a zuak diila.

ref: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
text: Mi ale duak a goa ale suiyɔgni, diila fi nyiini, Naawen yaa, ale basi ate mi a boro ate wari a kan daani mu.

ref: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
text: Wom m wieŋa, Naawen yaa. Poli abe fi nya m niniŋŋa.

ref: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
text: Wom m le kum a yaali maarika la, m dek Naab ale m Wen yaa, ka fi ate m puusi a te.

ref: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
text: Saluiku po, Naawen yaa, fi ale wom m lueluk. Saluiku m pai mi le a yaali diila a dueni ka fi niŋ ale a limisi ale yiila.

ref: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
text: Fi daa Wen dii ale mariŋ biemmoa, fi jigi wabaata nyama a kan baga a boro.

ref: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
text: Kanjanta nyama a kan baga a zaani fi niŋŋa. Fi kisi baai meena ale nye a kaasi la kama.

ref: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
text: Alege fi ŋmanteka nyiŋ mi le jo fi yenni po. Mi le koori tɛŋ a tuk fi tuilum yenni nyiŋ ale zula.

ref: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
text: Naawen yaa, dɛ m niŋ, a ta mu va fi wayɔrisimaŋa po m dachaasaŋa nyiŋ, basi ate fi suiku a yɔrisi m niŋ.

ref: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
text: Wari a kan nyini ba noa po ate waai a ta siaka ale di. Kaasuŋ ale sueri ba suiniimaŋa po. Ba biika a basi ate ka nuruba a kpi. Ba pai ba noaŋa a biisi ka venta wie.

ref: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
text: Weeni ayen ba nye kaasi kama, m dek Wen yaa. Basi ate ba susuga zɔŋŋa a lɔnsi ba. Yiak ba ba wabaata yegayega nyiŋ, diila ba zɛri fi nɔi kama a ta chaab ale fu.

ref: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
text: Alege baai meena ale jam fi jigi ate fi a lik ba la sue a peenti kama. Ba le kasim a yi ka yiila ale suipeentik. Be lik ba ate baai meena ale a yaali fi yuenni la a ta suipeentik fi nyiŋ.

ref: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
text: Naawen yaa, fi a niak wayɔrisima nyam kama. Fi gilim ba kama ale fi ŋmanteka ase jachɔgsim ate fi pai lik ba la.

ref: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
text: Naawen yaa, kan toariŋ mu ale fi suikaasuŋku yaase fi waali mu ale fi suipuurumu.

ref: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
text: Ta jiirim ale mu, Naawen yaa, dii nyiŋla m jiak kama. Naawen yaa, tebi mu diila m kobaŋa a dom kama.

ref: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
text: Ku a daani m suinummu kama. Ku le beni a soa ka sɛ, Naawen yaa alege ate fi yaa maari mi?

ref: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
text: Naawen yaa, cheem a vari mu a basi. Vari mu a basi fi ŋmanteka nyiŋ.

ref: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
text: Nuru waai a dan kpi wa kan teeri fi wariya. Ka wana ale a pak fu kpiluŋ tɛŋ ka po?

ref: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
text: M yaa jiak kama ale ŋusika, yokku meena mi a yɔk m gaduokku kama ale ninyaata. M dafieluku mɛ a yɔk ale ninyaata.

ref: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
text: Dachaasaŋa a basi kama ate m kum ate m ninaŋa a ji ate mi an ŋman baga a nya.

ref: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
text: Nama baai ale a nye biem la, ni cheŋ niŋ abe ni ge mi, diila Naawen a wom mi kumsa kama.

ref: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
text: Naawen a wom mi ale kum a yaali jiirim la kama. Naawen a siak tuesi m puusaŋa kama.

ref: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
text: Mi dachaasaŋa meena chivie ale yik ba ate ku cha ba. Ba le ŋmani ŋaai ale chivie diirima.

ref: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
text: Naawen yaa, mi Wenni, mi a jam ka fi jigi ayen fi lik mu. Vari mu baai ale a vi mu ayen ba yik la nisima po a basi.

ref: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
text: ase mi a dan nye waai ale kan nye wari la a kaasi yaase m vari m dachiak ate ku an va ku suiwa,

ref: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
text: be basi ate m dachaasaŋa a vi a yik mu. Basi ate ba tabi mu lɔnsi a ko, ate m kpi dua tantaŋa po.

ref: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
text: Naawen yaa, yiti ale fi suipuurumu a ta chaab ale m dachaasaŋa ale ba suipuurumu. Yiti, mi Wen yaa, a sak wensie.

ref: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
text: Dila la nuru baai meena ale gilim fu la, ta ba jam jigi yeŋ a yaa kali wenŋmazuk a nya ba zuk.

ref: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
text: Basi ate Naawen a bo nurubisa buusa. Bo mi buusa, a magsi chaab ale m wayɔrisimaŋa, a magsi chaab ale m nyemagsika. Fi Waai Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La.

ref: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
text: Fi ka wayɔrisima Wen a seba tama ale ta popola ŋaai alege a yaali diila buusa. Kasi wabaata nyama gaasaŋa abe fi te nuru wayɔrisima nyam zaana jigi.

ref: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
text: Wen ka m ligrɔ Waai Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La, wa a vari baai ale ka nuru maŋsaŋa la a basi kama.

ref: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
text: Wen ka wayɔrisima boteerɔ. Wa ka waai ale a sak wa suipuurumu daa meena.

ref: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
text: Ba dan kan tagri ba suitaŋa, Wen ale saasi wa gebika. Wa gori wa tommu kama a gomsi magsi.

ref: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
text: Nuru waai ale a magsi biem lɔgi la, a yik ka daanika puuk a yaa biak venta.

ref: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
text: Nuru waai ale a tu goluk a magsi wa choa lɔ du la ale lɔ du wadek.

ref: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
text: Daani kaai ate wa a nye la ale tulim a jam wadek zuk. Wa vakvakka a jam ka wadek zuk.

ref: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
text: Mi le pai jiam a te Naawen wa wayɔrisimaŋa nyiŋ, abe m yi yiila a pak Naawen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La yuenni.

ref: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
text: Naawen, ti Nyɔnɔ, nya fi yuenni ale zuak tɛŋka meena zuk diiya! Fi basi kama ate fi zulaŋa a bo wenŋmazukku.

ref: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
text: Bimbaansa ale buluata noa po fi basi kama ate pimpauk a boro fi dachaasaŋa nyiŋ. Fi nye dila kama ayen dachaasaŋa, baai ale ta chaab ale fu la a nye diki.

ref: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
text: Mi dan nya wenzukku, fi nisima tuimaŋa, chiika ale chiŋmarisaŋa, ate fi pai ba a nyo ba jiŋŋa la,

ref: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
text: nurubiik ka boa ayen fi ta wa popola, saalɔbiik ka boa ayen fi niŋ a bo wa po?

ref: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
text: Fi ale lueri wa ate wa a nya jaab meena ate fi a nye ale fi nisima la. Fi pai jaab meena kama a basi wa naŋsa po.

ref: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
text: Wa a nya duŋsa ale gɔi duŋsa meena zuk.

ref: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
text: Wa a nya wenzuk nuinsa ale jumaŋa ale bo nyakpiemu po la, ŋan baai meena ale a dɛ nyakpiemu vuutaŋa po a cheŋ.

ref: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
text: Naawen, ti Nyɔnɔ, nya fi yuenni ale zuak tɛŋka meena zuk diiya!

ref: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
text: M le pak fu, Naawen yaa ale m suinum meena. M le weeni fi wakinkaglaŋa meena wari.

ref: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
text: M sui peenti kama ale a naŋ fi nyiŋ. M le yi yiila a pak fi yuenni, Fi Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La.

ref: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
text: Mi dachaasaŋa a cheem ka ŋaaŋ, alege ba nak naŋsa a lɔ kpi fi niŋ.

ref: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
text: Fi ta wensie kama ale fi buusaŋa boka. Fi bo a te mu kama. Fi be kali fi naamu zukpaglika zuk kama a bo wensie buusa.

ref: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
text: Fi toariŋ tɛŋsa kama alege a kaasi wabaata nyama. Fi yeeri ba yue kama basi ate ŋa kan ŋman boro diipo diipo.

ref: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
text: Kaasuŋ kuui ale kan ta kpeglimka la a jam dachiaka zuk. Fi kaasi ba tɛŋsaŋa ate ba baŋ ba wie meena.

ref: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
text: Naawen a kasim a dɛ wa naamu kama a cheŋ diipo meena. Wa nye wa naamu zukpaglika kama a magsi buusa boka.

ref: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
text: Wa le bo tɛŋka buusa ale wensie. Wa le ta nuruma a nya ale nyemagsika.

ref: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
text: Naawen ka jachɔgsim a te baai ate ba a namsi la, waai ale pagra a lik ba diipo ate ba a tu daanika la.

ref: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
text: Baai ale seba fi yuenni la ale ta sebchakka ale fu. Dila, Naawen yaa, fi kan zɛri baai ale a gisi fu la diipo diipo.

ref: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
text: Siak yiila a pak Naawen ale kali wa naamu zukpaglika zuk Zayon la. Ni mooli tɛŋsaŋa po wa le tom diila.

ref: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
text: Wa lala ale a teeri baai ale a nam la wari. Wa kan zɛri ba kumsaŋa alege a namsi baai ale a namsi ba la.

ref: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
text: Naawen yaa, nya m dachaasaŋa ale a namsi mu diila. Ta jiirim ale mu abe fi zak mu a ta nyini kum nansuiŋtaŋa po,

ref: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
text: ate mi zaani Zayon nuruma niŋ a weeni ba, mi ale a pak fu dii nyiŋla. Mi le kasim ta suipeentik fi varibasika nyiŋ.

ref: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
text: Tɛŋsaŋa a lɔ goluk kuui ate ba tu la po. Ŋmiak kaai ate ba pai suk la a yik ba naŋsaŋa.

ref: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
text: Ba seba Naawen kama wa wensie buusaŋa nyiŋ. Wabaata nyama a bari yik badek kama ale ba nisima tuima.

ref: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
text: Wabaata nyama a ŋman cheŋ kpiluŋ, tɛŋ sii meena ale baŋ Wen wari la.

ref: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
text: Alege baai ale a silim ŋanta la wa kan baŋ ba wariya, yaase baai ale a nam la yiila a bɛ.

ref: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
text: Vaari yiti, Naawen yaa, kan te nurubiik a nya pagrimoa. Te ti tɛŋsaŋa nya buusa fi niŋ.

ref: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
text: Basi ate yɔgsum a yik ba, Naawen yaa. Basi ate tɛŋsaŋa demma a seba ayen ba ka nurubisa, ba daa Naawen ya.

ref: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
text: Naawen yaa, ka boa ale soa ate fi za nna niŋniŋŋa? Ka boa ale soa ate fi a suk fidek diipo ate daanika a boro la?

ref: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
text: Wabaata nyɔnɔwa a ta ka kanjanta ale a namsi ŋanjaksaŋa, a yik ba wadek battaŋa ate wa nye la po.

ref: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
text: Wabaata nyɔnɔwa a ta ka kanjanta ale ba biem popolaŋa. Ba biisi niak butuem nyama alege biisi a kaasi Naawen.

ref: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
text: Wabaata nyɔnɔwa niŋ a ka Naawen po. Wa kanjanta nyiŋ wa a poli kama ayen Wen poom daa jaaboa.

ref: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
text: Wabaata nyɔnɔ a nye wari meena ate di a niak kama. Wa kan miŋ Wen buusaŋa. Wa a nya wa dachaasaŋa ale ka kisika.

ref: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
text: Wa a weeni wadek kama ayen, <<Wari kan choa mi. Mi ale kasim ta ka suipeentik alege kan nya daanika.>>

ref: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
