text: Wa nɔnni po a sueri ale ka kikaasa ale venta ale nyinyigsa. Daanika ale biem ale kasim bo wa nɔnni po.

ref: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
text: Wa a limisi ka wa sukka jigini ase gbeŋli la. Wa dua kama a limisi ayen wa yik baai ale kan baga a maari badek la. Wa yik ba kama ale wa baruku a dari ba a ta cheŋ.

ref: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
text: Wa le baga baai la ŋɔriŋ kama a lɔ meena. Wa pagrimu a lɔnsi ba.

ref: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
text: Wa weeni wadek kama ayen, <<Wen a baŋ kama. Wa lik wa ninaŋa kama a kan ŋman a nya.>>

ref: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
text: Vaari yiti, Naawen yaa, zak fi nisa Wen yaa. Kan baŋ niwomma.

ref: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
text: Ka boa ale soa ate wabaata nyɔnɔwa a zɛri Wen yaa, ale a weeni wadek ayen, <<Wa kan namsi mu?>>

ref: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
text: Alege Wen yaa, fi ninaŋa a nya daanika ale ninammu kama, a gomsi ayen fi maari. Waai ale wobsa la a pai wadek kama a te fu, fi kasim a maari baai ale ka kpiŋsa la kama.

ref: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
text: Wɛ wabaata ale biem nyɔnɔwa nisa, namsi wa waba tii ate wa tom la nyiŋ ate nuruba a zɛ la.

ref: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
text: Naawen kasim ka Naab ate ku a cheŋ taam wuu. Tɛŋsa nuruba ale nya kaasuŋ a ta a nyini wa tɛŋka po.

ref: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
text: Naawen yaa, wom baai ale a nam la puusa, te ba nyiŋbiiri, abe fi wom ba kumsa,

ref: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
text: maari baai ale a nam la ale kpiŋsaŋa kumsa, bo te ba ate nurubiik kan ŋman nya daanika.

ref: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
text: Naawen ale a lik mi. Ka boa ate fi a weeni mi ayen, <<Yiri ase nuim la a jueli fi guuku zuk.

ref: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
text: Nya, wabaata nyama a gori ba timaŋa kama a za yisuŋtaŋa po a pai ba timaŋa a tuk wayɔrisima nyam nyiŋ ayen ba tɔŋ.

ref: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
text: Nyubaŋa a dan kaasi wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ ale nye ka sɛ?>>

ref: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
text: Naawen a bo ka wa tuilum yenni po. Naawen a kala ka wa wenŋmazuk naamu zukpaglika zuk. Wa a kpesi a nya saalɔ bisaŋa kama. Wa ninaŋa a nya ba kama.

ref: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
text: Naawen a kpesi a nya wayɔrisima nyama kama, alege wabaata nyama ale baai ale a yaali wɔkwɔk la wa chiika a kisi ba kama.

ref: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
text: Wa le basi ate bolim kaala ale bolim tana a siŋ ba zuk. Wa le namsi ba ale viok tuilik.

ref: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
text: Naawen ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ. Wa a yaali ka wensie. Wensie nyama ale nya wa nimbidiaka.

ref: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
text: Maari, Naawen yaa, ale wensie nyama a ŋman ka. Wensie nyama a muriŋ nuruma po a bɛ kama.

ref: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
text: Waai meena a velim a te ka wa vaanchoa. Ba noaŋa a biisi ka pimpaasima wie.

ref: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
text: Naawen a gebi venta ale kunkuulima noaŋa a basi,

ref: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
text: noa ŋaai ale a weeni ayen, <<Ti le pa ti noaŋa a nak de. Tidek ale soa ti noaŋa. Ka wana ale tama kpagi ya?>>

ref: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
text: Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Niwomma namsika ale baai ale a silim ŋanta la ŋusika nyiŋ, m yaa vaari yiti, mi ale lik ba baai ale a kaasi ba yue la jigi.>>

ref: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
text: Naawen wieŋa ka chekki, ase kpana ate ba yeeri ŋa bolim po la, a soti ŋa ku nɔi buyopɔi la.

ref: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
text: Naawen yaa, fi le yik ti nna ŋmapi abe fi lik ti nuru bala chaab jigi taam wuu.

ref: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
text: Wabaata nyam nyiem cheŋ kama a nak kuusa jigsi ŋaai meena ate nuruba a pak ba biemu la.

ref: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
text: Naawen yaa, ku le beni ka sɛ? Fi le baŋ mi wie ka taam wuu? Fi le suk fidek mi jigi a paari ka dimpo?

ref: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
text: Mi le jɛ ale m popolaŋa a paari ka dimpo ate daa meena m sui kasim kaasi? Mi dachiaka ale nya pagrim m zuk a paari ka dimpo?

ref: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
text: Naawen, midek Wen yaa, nya mi niniga abe fi tulisi mu. Te mu pagrim dan kan daa di m le kpi.

ref: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
text: Mi dachiaka le weeni ayen, <<M nya pagrim wa zuk kama.>> M dachaasaŋa sue ale peenti ase m nin lɔ.

ref: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
text: Alege m ta sebchakka ale fi ŋmanteka kama. M sui peenti kama ale fi varibasika.

ref: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
text: M le yi yiila a te Naawen, diila wa nala kama a te mi.

ref: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
text: Beruk ale a weeni wa suinum po ayen, <<Wen karo.>> Ba daa wensie nyam, ba ta ka gaasa nyeela. Waai karo a nye wamaŋŋa.

ref: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
text: Naawen a bo ka wenŋmazuk a nya saalɔ bisaŋa ase waai a boro a miŋ ya, yaase waai boro a gisi Wen yaa.

ref: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
text: Baai ale a nye biem la a kan maari a zamsi, baai ale a ŋɔbi mi nuruma ase nuruba ale a ŋɔbi boroborok diila a kan maari a wi Naawen.

ref: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
text: Dula jigini yɔgsum ale jam yik ba, diila Wen a bo wayɔrisima nyama suŋsuŋ kama.

ref: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
text: Nama baai ale a nye biem la a kaasi ŋanjaksa sue kama ba zɔga po. Alege Naawen ale ba ligrɔ.

ref: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
text: Mi a yaali ka Izirali demma varibasika a nyini Zayon po a jam. Ba sue ale peenti ase Naawen a nin basi ate ba nya badek. Basi ate Jekob a naŋ abe Izirali sui a peenti.

ref: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
text: Naawen yaa, ka wana ale wa bo fi yenni po? Ka wana ale wa bo fi tuilum guuku zuwa?

ref: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
text: alege ate nuruba wie biisi kaasika a ka wa nɔi po la. Wa kan kaasi wa vaanchoa yuei ya, ale kan biisi a lɛ wa vaanchoa.

ref: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
text: Waai ale a zɛri gaasa nyɔnɔ alege a zuli baai ale a chali Naawen yɔgsum la. Waai ale chiib ta pumpuulima ase ku nin poom jam toa te wa.

ref: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
text: Waai ale pai wa ligra a peem a te ale kan yaali viila, wa be kan basi ate waai a da wa, ale a daani waai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la. Waai ale a nye wieŋa de la, wari a kan choa wa.

ref: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
text: Yik mu ŋmapi, m dek Wen yaa, ale ka fi ale a lik mu.

ref: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
text: Mi weeni Naawen kama ayen, <<Fi ale m Nyɔnɔ, dan kan daa fi nyiŋŋa mi ka wamaŋŋa.>>

ref: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
text: Naawen nuruma ale bo tɛŋka po la, ka bala ale nuruba dek ate mi a mariŋ.

ref: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
text: Baai ale chali a vi wen yona la suipuurumu ale zuak. Mi kan maa pai ba ziimu a kpiiri a nye kaabka yaase m maa wi ba wenaŋa yue.

ref: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
text: Fi tiiritaŋa ka nna kperikperik a te mi. Ti nala ka nna yegayega.

ref: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
text: Mi a pak Naawen dii nyiŋla, wa le a sak mu, dan poom ka yok m suinummu a sak mu kama.

ref: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
text: Mi basi kama ate Naawen a dɛ mi niŋ. Wa le bo mi juga geŋ la nyiŋ, wari a kan nye mu.

ref: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
text: Dii nyiŋ la, fi kan zɛri mu a basi ate m cheŋ kpiluŋŋoa, yaase fi basi ate fi weleŋsa nuruwa a poak vɔrumu po,

ref: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
text: dii nyiŋla fi kan basi mu ate m wari kpiluŋ tɛŋ ka po, yaase fi Weleŋsa Nyɔnɔwa a poagi.

ref: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
text: Fi basi ate m seba nyuvuri suiku kama. Fi le bo le mu la a basi kama ate m ta suipeentik, alege ate nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la masim a bo fi juga nisa po.

ref: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
text: Naawen yaa, wom m saalim maŋka ŋmasi wom m kaarika. Lak turi wom m puusa, daa venta nɔi puusa.

ref: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
text: Be tuni m pamini m dachaasaŋa jigi a te mu. Be basi ate fi ninaŋa abe nya dii ale nala la.

ref: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
text: Fi seba m suinum. Fi jam m jigi yok. Fi jigi m suinummu po a nya kama alege fi an nya popoli baata m po. M nye m popola kama ayen m kan biisi biemmoa.

ref: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
text: Nurubisa nyeela jigi, m yik m dek kama a va chaab ale fi nɔi ale weeni diila ayen m kan va wɔkwɔk suita.

ref: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
text: Wen m puusi a te fu, ate fi le wom mu. Be basi ate fi tunni a wom m puusa.

ref: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
text: Sak fi ŋmante kperika. Fi vari baai ale suk badek fu po la ba dachaasa nisima po a basi kama ale fi juga nisaŋa.

ref: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
text: Lik mu ase fidek numbiri la, suk mu fi kiŋkaŋŋa yisuŋku po.

ref: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
text: Lik mu ate nuru baai nyeka ale tua la kan kaasi mu. Lik mu ate m dachaasaŋa a kan ko mu.

ref: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
text: Ba ka jiirimmoa ale a biisi kanjauŋ.

ref: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
text: Ba gilim mu ate m ka viriŋka jigi ya, a gisi suik ayen ba dari mu a lɔnsi.

ref: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
text: Ba a nye ase ka gbeŋli ate kɔm a ta di ate di a gisi ŋandiinta diila. Ba gu dua kama a limisi ayen ba boani mu munamuna.

ref: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
text: Naawen yaa, vaari yiti a tu chaab ale ba a nak ba a yiak! Pa fi gebika a vari mu nuru baataŋa jigi a basi.

ref: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
text: Naawen yaa, pai fi nisaŋa a vari mu nuru bala chaab nisima po a basi, vari mu nuru baai tutuna ale bo ka tɛŋzuk de nyiini la nisima po a basi. Baai ate fi a yaali la fi basi ate ba a chak kama. Ba bisa a ta zuak kama, a tali zaani ba ŋaaŋbisa mɛ.

ref: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
text: M wayɔrisima po m le nya fi nimbidiaka. M dan yiti goom po a nya fi ale ka diila m le chak.

ref: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
text: Naawen, m pagrɔ, mi a yaali fu.

ref: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
text: Naawen ka m piuŋ ale m ligrɔ ale m varibasidɔ. Mi Wenni ka m piuŋ, wa jigi ate mi a suk, mi jachɔgsim ale m varibasika nyiili, wa ka mi ligrɔ.

ref: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
text: Mi wi Naawen dii ale magsi pimpauk la, ate mi nya varibasika mi dachaasa jigi,

ref: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
text: Kum a jam gilim mu kama, kaasuŋ wuurik ale nya pagrim mi zuk.

ref: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
text: Kpiluŋ miisa ale melim a gilim mi, kum baruk ale jam mi jigi.

ref: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
text: Mi daanika po mi wi Naawen kama. Mi kaari wi m Wenni ayen wa maari mu. Wa yenni po wa wom m lueluku. Mi kumsaŋa a jo wa tue po kama.

ref: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
text: Tɛŋka a choa kama ale kum, guutaŋa nyubaŋa a kpiŋsi. Ba gɔk kama dii nyiŋla wa sui ale jam puuri.

ref: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
text: Wa vuri wenzukku a nyini du a siŋ tɛŋ. Ate chiŋma sobta jam bo wa naŋtaata po.

ref: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
text: Wa dɔ javuk a yiri cheŋ. Wa jam ka nna nwuli vioku kinkaŋŋa zuk.

ref: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
text: Wa basi ate legi a lik wa. Chiŋma sobta ale nyiam a gilim wa.

ref: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
text: Tana ale bolim a nyini ŋmorukku ale a nyaksi la a dɛ wa niŋ a luenti chiŋma sobtaŋa a te wa.

ref: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
text: Naawen a bo wenŋmazuk po a na ase nanpansa la. Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La lueluku a biisi ate ŋmoruk tana ale bolim kaala a siŋ.

ref: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
text: Naawen yaa, fi toariŋ ale vuusi ale fi nyueŋa a nyati nyakpiemu vaasaŋa, ate tɛŋka nyubaŋa a dua jassi.

ref: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
text: Wa nyini ka wenŋmazuk a yik mu a liiri mu nyaliuŋku po.

ref: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
text: Diipo ate m bo daanika po la ba jam a yaali kpaliŋ ale mu, alege Naawen a maari mu.

ref: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
text: Wa ta mu a nyini a zaani peelim kpioŋ po. Wa vari mu a basi dii nyiŋla wa sui yɔk ale mu kama.

ref: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
text: Naawen a tuni mu a magsi chaab ale ka m wayɔrisimaŋa, wa tuni mu a magsi chaab ale ka m nisima ale kan ta daŋta la nyiŋ.

ref: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
text: Dii nyiŋla m va Naawen suiku kama, mi an nye wabiowa, m be an nyini mi Wenni ŋaaŋ ŋmani ya.

ref: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
text: Wa buusaŋa meena a doa ka mi niŋ. M be an zɛri wa ŋmarisika.

ref: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
text: Mi ka kaasuŋ yaase wari wa niŋŋa ale yik m dek a ta nyini biem po.

ref: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
text: Naawen a tuni mu a magsi chaab ale m wayɔrisimaŋa, wa tuni mu a magsi chaab ale ka m nisima ale kan ta daŋta la nyiŋ.

ref: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
text: Wensie nyama fi sak wensie ale ba kama, baai ale kan ta kaasuŋ la fi sak ayen fi ka kaasuŋŋoa.

ref: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
text: Baai ale nye a magsi la, fi sak ba ayen fi mɛ nye a magsi kama, alege nuru baai nyeka ale tua la fi kan dɛ doata ale ba.

ref: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
text: Baai ale a zaab badek la fi vari ba a basi alege pai kanjanta nyama a nyo chivie po.

ref: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
text: Fi basi ate m bolimu a kasim tɔti za a dɛ, Naawen dii ale ka mi Wen la a tulim m legini ate di chim bolim.

ref: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
text: Dan ka Wen tɔga, wa suiku ka chekki, Naawen wanni a ka nyebeka. Wa ka jachɔgsim a te baai meena ale a suk wa jigi la.

ref: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
text: Ka wana ale Wen alege daa Naawen ya? Ka wana be le Piuŋku, ka ti Wenni nyiini?

ref: You give me strength and guide me right.
text: Ka Wen ale te mu pagrim ale basi ate m suiku a nye chekki.

ref: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
text: Wa nye ate m naŋtaataŋa a pagra ase kab naŋtaata la. Wa maari mu ate m baga a zaani guuta zuima.

ref: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
text: Wa zamsi mu kpaliŋ nyeka, wa te mu pagrim ate m baga a tɔŋ kutuk mɔnuŋ tom.

ref: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
text: Fi pai fi varibasika jaligimmu a te mu, fi juga nisaŋa ale vari mu basi, fi koori ka tɛŋ ayen fi nye ate mi a zuak.

ref: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
text: Fi basi ate suik kuui ale bo mi naŋsa tɛŋ la a labsa, ate mi kan sati a lɔ.

ref: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
text: M vi m dachaasaŋa a yik ba kama. Mi an pai ba a basi ya, m kaasi ba meena kama.

ref: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
text: M nak ba kama a lɔnsi ate ba an baga a yiti ŋmai ya. Ba lɔ dua ka m naŋtaata po.

ref: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
text: Fi te mu pagrim a magsi kpaliŋka nyeka, fi basi ate m dachaasaŋa a siak te mu.

ref: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
text: Fi te m dachaasaŋa a cheem ba ŋaaŋ a yiti chali, m kaasi baai ale kisi mu la.

ref: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
text: Ba kaari a yaali maarika alege waai karo a vari ba a basi. Ba kaari ayen Naawen a maari ba alege wa an tulisi ba.

ref: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
text: M nak ba kama a bugsi ase nyuŋ ate viok a ji diila. Mi yuk ba a waaŋ ase ka bagta ale doa suitaŋa po diila.

ref: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
text: Fi vari mu nuru baai ale a yaali ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale mu la nisima po a basi. Fi nye ate m chim tɛŋsa naab. Nuru baai ate m zɛ la a siak te mu.

ref: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
text: Ba meena a jɔk yiila kama, ba nyini ba jigi pagrisaŋa jigi a jam kama ate ba nyiŋsa a gɔk.

ref: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
text: Naawen a vua kama! Mi a pak m piuŋku! M Varibasika Wenni yuei yiti!

ref: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
text: Wa le Naawen dii ale tuni a te mi, waai ale basi ate mi a nya tɛŋsaŋa zuk,

ref: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
text: waai ale vari mu m dachaasa nisima po a basi. Fi zak mu zaani m dachaasaŋa niŋ, fi vari mu nuru baai nyeka ale tua la jigi a basi.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
text: Naawen yaa, kude nyiŋ mi le pak fu tɛŋsa suŋsuŋ, m le lenni yiila a pak fi yuenni.

ref: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
text: Wa a te wa naawa nakdeka nna yegayega, wa a sak ŋmanteka ale waai ate wa lueri la, ale Deevid ale ŋaaŋbisaŋa taam wuu.>>

ref: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
text: Wenŋmazukku a biisi lagri Wen zulaŋa ale ka diila kama. Wenzukku a weeni wa nisaŋa ale tom diila kama.

ref: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
text: Dai ale pa te dai meena a weeni ka Naawen nyeelaŋa. Ate yɔktaŋa meena mɛ a weeni wa sebilaŋa.

ref: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
text: Biik karo ate fi kan wom ba lueluta.

ref: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
text: Ba luelutaŋa a cheŋ ka nna ŋmɔŋ a paari tɛŋka meena, ba wieŋa a cheŋ a paari tɛŋka kpeglimka. Wa ti kusuŋ a te wenbinni wenzuk po,

ref: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
text: ate di pusi a nyini ase nipok fiak nyɔnɔ ale nyini wa yeri po a nyini la. Ase chalidɔ ale za a naŋ ale gomsi magsi chali dɛka la.

ref: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
text: Di pusi nyini konni a taam a siŋ yeniŋka. Jaab karo a suk wadek ale wenbinni nakka.

ref: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
text: Naawen sinsaŋŋa a welema kama, ŋa a te chiika pagrim. Naawen kaamka a ta maarika kama. Ka pai yam a te baai ale jɔk bu la.

ref: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
text: Naawen wieŋa a nala kama, ŋa pai masim a nyo suinum po. Naawen wieŋa ka wensie ŋa a te popola maŋsa.

ref: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
text: Fi dan a chali Naawen yɔgsum ku ka wamaŋ, dila ale kasim boro kama. Naawen a bo ka wensie buusa ŋa ka daŋta.

ref: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
text: Wa buusaŋa boka a nala a gaam ligmɔniŋ kama, ŋa masa a gaam siita, si tii ale nyini samparima po la.

ref: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
text: Ŋa a kaam fi tuimtomdɔwa. Waai ale va ŋa la a tuesi ka tiirim kpioŋ.

ref: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
text: Ka wana ale baga a seba wadek wakaasima? Vɔŋ m nyebeka a te mu.

ref: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
text: Maari mu ate m kan a tom m dek yaalika tuim kaasima. Kan basi ate wakaasima a chim m naaba. Ate m yaa welema, m kan seba kaasuŋ kpioŋ nɔi po.

ref: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
text: Wari dii meena ale nyini m nɔi po a nyini la, abe popoli ŋaai meena ale nyini m suinummu po a nyini la, fi sui peenti ale ŋa. Naawen yaa, fi ka m Piuŋ ale m Da Tuesirɔ.

ref: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
text: Naawen abe tulisi fu ase fi nin bo daanika po. Jekob Wenni yuenni abe lik fu tanla.

ref: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
text: Wa be tom maarika wa boka jigini a te fu. Wa be te fu maari kaai ale nyini Zayon Guuku zuk la.

ref: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
text: Wa be teeri fi tiirimu ate fi pai a te wa la. Wa sui abe peenti ale fi kaabka.

ref: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
text: Wa be te fu fi suinum ale a yaali diila, wa be niak fi popolaŋa meena.

ref: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
text: Ti le nuem ale popeentik ase fi nin nya nakdeka, abe ti zak Wen yuenni a zaani. Naawen abe te fu dii meena ate fi bek wa la.

ref: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
text: M yaa seba yɔgyɔgla de ayen ka Naawen ale vari wa le lueri naab waai la a basi. Wa kali ka wenŋmazukku a tulisi wa, wa vari wa a basi ale wa juga nisii ale pagra la.

ref: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
text: Nuruba gela a kuulim ka ba wusuma ale ŋa torokoba nyiŋ, alege tama pai ti yiila a dueni ka Naawen ti Wenni zuk.

ref: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
text: Ba saari lɔ alege tama vaari yiti a za ka nna giŋgiŋ.

ref: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
text: Naawen yaa, vari Naawa a basi! Ti dan wi fu, tulisi ti!

ref: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
text: Naawen yaa, naawa a ta popeentik ale fi pagrimu. Wa sui peenti ale fi le te wa pagrim ate wa a nak wa dachaasaŋa dɛ la.

ref: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
text: Fi te wa wa suinummu ale a yaali diila, fi be an zɛri wa le lak wa nɔnni a bek fu diila.

ref: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
text: Fi pai niak kpieŋ a te wa tia, a pai ligmɔniŋ zutɔk a vuk wa zukku.

ref: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
text: Wa bek fu ayen fi te wa nyuvuri, ate fi pai nyuvuri woŋ a te wa taam wuu.

ref: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
text: Fi le te wa nakdeka wa dachaasaŋa zuk la a basi kama ate wa yuenni a nya zula yegayega. Fi te wa nyaksika ale zuaka.

ref: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
text: Wensie fi te wa niaka taam wuu ale ŋman nye ate wa ta popeentik ale fidek masimu.

ref: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
text: Naawa a ta sebchakka ale Naawen kama, Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La ŋmanteka nyiŋ, naawa a kan choa.

ref: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
text: Fi nisima ale yik fi dachaasaŋa meena. Fi juga nisimaŋa ale yik fi kisidɔma.

ref: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
text: Fi le kaasi ba ale bolim ŋiak. Naawen le nɛ ba ale suipuurum, ate fi bolimu a dɛ ba.

ref: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
text: Fi le kaasi ba ŋaaŋbisa tɛŋka de zuk, fi le kaasi ba buuni po ate ba kan maa bo saalɔba po.

ref: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
text: Dii nyiŋla fi le gbeeri fi tommu a basi ba zuk ate ba pilim tulim ba ŋaaŋ.

ref: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
text: Naawen yaa, fi yuenni a nya zak zaanika a nyini ka fi pagrimu po, ti le lenni yiila abe ti pak fi pagrimu.

ref: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
text: Mi Wen yaa, mi Wen yaa, ka boa ate fi zɛri mu? Ka boa ate fi yalima a kan vari mu a basi? Ka boa ate fi yalima ale m ŋuunika?

ref: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
text: Mi Wen yaa, daa meena mi a kum, alege fi kan tulisi mu. Mi a kum yok mɛ alege m kan nya vuusummoa.

ref: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
text: Alege ka fi ale kala naam zaŋgɔŋka zuk a chim Naawen weleŋka. Ka fi ate Izirali bisaŋa a pak.

ref: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
text: Ba kum te fu a yaa nya varibasika. Ba ta sebchakka ale fu ate chivie an paari ba.

ref: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
text: Alege mi ka jaab kama m daa nuru biiga, ate nuruba a zɛri mu ale kan chiini mu a gum nuruba po.

ref: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
text: Waai meena a dan ga nya mu, kula nyɔnɔwa a nye mu a la kama, ba nyiem girinti ka zuima a weeni ayen,

ref: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
text: <<Wa ta siaka ale Naawen. Wa te ate Naawen abe vari wa a basi. Wa te ate wa vari wa a basi, wa le tɔlim a mariŋ wa la.>>

ref: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
text: Ka fi abe le soa ate ba biak mu sɔŋsɔŋŋoa. Fi ale te ate m ta siaka ale fu m le ka buluek la.

ref: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
text: Din nyini m biam po m pai m dek a te ka fi. Din nyini m le diem bo m mawa ponni po la, ka fi ale m Wen.

ref: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
text: Kan yalima ale mu, ale wadaanima a moata ate waai karo a maari.

ref: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
text: Dachaasa yegayega ale gilim mu ase lalisa la. Dachiak pagrisa ale gilim mu ase Basan tɛŋka lalik pagrisaŋa la.

ref: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
text: Ba lak ba noaŋa ase ka gbeŋma ale nya ŋa ŋandiinta a boro a dɛ diila.

ref: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
text: M jiak kama ale ka pagrimoa a yaa waaŋ ase nyiam la, ate m kobaŋa a pagri ŋa tomaŋa po. M suinummu a nyaliŋ kama ase kpaam la.

ref: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
text: M pagrimu a kpeeri ka meena ate m giŋgeluŋku a yiti maŋ m laŋtika. Fi pai mu gu kum tantaŋa po.

ref: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
text: Nuru baai ale a nye ase baasa la ale gilim mu, nuru baata bimbauŋ ale kɔk gilim mu, ba vuri m nisima ale m naŋtaata.

ref: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
text: Ba pai m gattaŋa a chari chaab, ate m gattaŋa nyiŋ ba nak gbaŋ.

ref: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
text: Alege Naawen yaa, kan yalima ale mu. M pagrɔ, jam nwuli a maari mu.

ref: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
text: Kan basi ate ba che mu ale gebik a ko, vari m nyuvunni baasa pagrim po a basi.

ref: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
text: Vari mu gbeŋmaŋa nɔi po a basi. Vari mu goa lalikka nyiilaŋa po a basi.

ref: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
text: Mi le wi fi yuenni a sak m suataŋa. Nuru boanni po m le pak fu.

ref: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
text: Nama baai ale a chali Naawen la, ni pak wa! Nama Jekob bisaŋa meena, ni zuli wa! Nama Izirali bisaŋa, ni zuli wa!

ref: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
text: Wa an pai ŋaaŋ te waai ale a nam la yaase wa zɛri waai ale a yaali wa maarika la. Alege wa tulisi wa kama ase wa le wi wa a yaali maarika ka la.

ref: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
text: Nuru boanni ale tigsi za la po ate mi le pak fu. M le zaani ka baai ale a chali fu la niŋ a nye m le puulim diila.

ref: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
text: Ŋanjaksaŋa ale dɛ kama a chak. Baai ale a gisi Naawen la ale pak wa. Naawen be basi ate ba suiniimaŋa a boro taam wuu.

ref: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
text: Tɛŋsa meena ale teeri Naawen wie a yaa tulim jam wa jigi, ate tɛŋsaŋa dem meena ale zuli Naawen,

ref: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
text: dii nyiŋla, naam meena ka Naawen ale soa. Wa ale soa jiga meena zuk a nya.

ref: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
text: Tɛŋka jigsirɔma meena ale dɛ abe ba puusi fu. Kpilima meena ale kpi duna wa niŋ, baai ale kan baga a vuuk la, ale kpi duna wa niŋ.

ref: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
text: Ba le mooli wa wayɔrisimaŋa wie a sak biik sii ate ba an diem biak la, dii nyiŋla, wa le nye dila.

ref: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
text: Naawen ka naapeerik a nya m zuk. M kan silim jaaboa.

ref: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
text: Wa ta mu cheŋ a paari wuyɔgsuk jigi, ale ta mu mɛ a cheŋ ate mi a nyu nyamaŋ.

ref: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
text: Wa a te mu pagrim paalib. Wa yuenni nyiŋ, wa ta mu a va wayɔrisima suita wa yuenni nyiŋ.

ref: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
text: M dan poom a cheŋ legi po, m kan chali yɔgsummoa, dii nyiŋla fi bo ale mu kama. Fi doani ale fi dachekka a lik mu kama wapagra meena po.

ref: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
text: Wa a vari mu nyenyaka po, ale ninam po ale m dachaasa nisima po a basi. Wa tuesi mu a kpiiri kpaam m zuk po ale basi ate m dɛ a chak.

ref: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
text: M be seba chak kama ayen wa nalimu, ale wa ŋmanteka ale bo ale mu m boka meena po. M be le kasim bo Naawen yenni po diipo meena.

ref: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
text: Naawen ale soa tɛŋka ale ka jaab meena. Wa abe le ŋman soa tɛŋka ale waai meena ale bo ka po la.

ref: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
text: Naawen le nye tɛŋka ale nyubi ka nyubini a yaa sɛ ka a zaani nyaataŋa zuk.

ref: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
text: Ka wana ale wa jueli Naawen guuku zuwa? Ka wana ale wa zaani wa tuilum jigini?

ref: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
text: Ka waai nisima ale kan ta daŋta ate wa suinum mɛ a nala la, ka waai ale kan a kaab bɔgta yaase waai ale kan a pɛ ŋmoruk venta wie nyiŋŋa.

ref: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
text: Wa le tuesi niaka Naawen jigi, ate Wen dii ale ka wa varibasidɔwa la ale bɔ te wa.

ref: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
text: Ni lak nansuiŋtaŋa, ni lak tuataŋa ate zula Naawa a taam jɔ.

ref: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
text: Ka wana ale zula Naawa de? Ka Naawen dii ale zuak ale pagra la. Naawen dii ale pagra kpaliŋka po la.

ref: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
text: Ni lak nansuiŋtaŋa, ni lak tuataŋa ate zula Naawa a taam jɔ.

ref: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
text: Ka wana ale zula Naawa de? Ka Naawen dii ale a de Tugurik Tɔŋdɔba Niŋ la, wala ale zula Naawa.

ref: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
text: Naawen yaa, m pai m chiika a te ka fi.

ref: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
text: Wen yaa, m ta sebchakka ale ka fi. Kan te chivie a yik mu, be kan basi mɛ ate m dachaasaŋa a nya nakdeka m zuwa.

ref: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
text: Dak fi suitaŋa a sak mu, Naawen yaa, sak mu fi suitaŋa.

ref: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
text: Wen m varibasidɔ, sak mu ate m va fi wensieŋa, ale m yiila a bo fi po danni ale wɔŋa a soa dii meena la.

ref: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
text: Naawen yaa, teeri fi jiirimu ale fi ŋmanteka ale zuak diila, ale fi ta ba nyini ka dipo.

ref: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
text: Kan teeri m bimbanni po wabaataŋa ale m tukpanni suitaŋa. Fi ŋmanteka nyiŋ, teeri mu ale fi ka Naawen maŋ.

ref: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
text: Naawen ka wamaŋsa ale wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ. Dila nyiŋla, wa sak wabaata nyam ka wadek suitaŋa ayen ba nya.

ref: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
text: Wa pai dii ale nala la a sak baai ale a zaab badek la wa niŋ ale a sak ba wa suiku.

ref: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
text: Naawen suitaŋa meena ka ŋmanteka ale wensie a te baai ale ta wa nɔiyeŋka wieŋa la.

ref: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
text: Naawen yaa, fi yuenni nyiŋ, vɔŋ m biemu a te mu, bu dan poom zuak dii ya.

ref: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
text: Wa le jigsi wa nyuvunni daaŋa po abe wa ŋaaŋbisa a jam soa wa tɛŋka zuk a nya.

ref: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
text: Naawen a dɛ doata ale ka baai ale a chali wa la, ale basi ate ba seba wa nɔiyeŋka.

ref: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
text: Mi nina a kasim tusi ka Naawen nyiŋ, dii nyiŋla, ka wa nyiini ale a gaari baruku m dachaasaŋa po a basi.

ref: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
text: Cheem nya mu abe fi ta jiirim ale mu, ale m ka m dek nyiini a boro a nam.

ref: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
text: M suinummu wadaanimaŋa a yaa piisi kama. Be yeeri mu m ninammu po a basi.

ref: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
text: Poli m ninammu wie abe fi vɔŋ m wabaataŋa meena a te mu.

ref: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
text: Nya m dachaasaŋa ale piisi diila abe fi nya ba le kisi mu nna bakki la.

ref: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
text: Lik mu abe fi vari mu a basi. Kan te suik ate ba nyo mu chivie po, ale m chali a suk ka fi po.

ref: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
text: M wamaŋsaŋa ale m wensieŋa abe lik mu, dii nyiŋla m yiila a bo ka fi po.

ref: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
text: Naawen yaa, biisi a te mu ale mi an tom wari kaasi ya m boka po. M ta sebchakka Naawen kama ate chichama a ka ku po.

ref: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
text: Ale fi ŋmanteka a kasim bo ale mu kama, ate mi a cheŋ diipo meena wuu ale fi wensieŋa.

ref: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
text: M nari nisima kama a sak ayen m zɛ wari nɔi po, ate m baga a jam fi juka kuŋkuŋku niŋ, Naawen yaa,

ref: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
text: Naawen yaa, mi a yaali fi yenni ate fi boro la, jigi dii ate fi zulaŋa a boro la.

ref: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
text: Kan maa kaasi m chiika ale wabaata nyama, kan kaasi m nyuvunni ale baai ale a yaali ziim nyaka la,

ref: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
text: Alege mi boka po a ka dauŋŋoa. Be da tuesi mu a basi abe fi ta jiirim ale mu.

ref: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
text: M naŋtaataŋa a za ka zaana dek jigi. Nuru boanni po, m le pak Naawen.

ref: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
text: Naawen ka m bolim ale m varibasidɔ, mi a chali yɔgsum ale ka wana? Naawen ale m nyuvunni ligrɔ, mi le chali yɔgsum ale ka wana?

ref: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
text: Nuru baata a dan poom a tɔŋ tugurik ale mu, a poli ayen ba kaasi m nyiŋ lammu, m dachaasaŋa ale m kisidɔma a dan poom siti mu, ba le sati a lɔ.

ref: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
text: Tugurik tɔŋdɔba a dan poom gu dua a limisi mu m suinummu nna a kan chali yɔgsummoa. Tugurik a dan poom yiti m zuk diipo mi le ta sebchakka.

ref: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
text: Jayeŋ dekki ate mi a bek Naawen ayen wa nye a te mu, m le a gisi diila ale nna. Ayen m bo Naawen yenni po m nyuvunni daaŋa meena po, a poli Naawen nalimu wie abe mi a gisi wa wa yenni po.

ref: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
text: Da tuasaŋa po wa le lik mu a tanla wa yenni po. Wa le pai mu a suk wa viuku po abe wa pai mu a zaani piuŋ kuui ale bo wenwen la zuk.

ref: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
text: Ate m yaa nya yuei m dachaasaŋa ale gilimmu la zuk. Wa viuku po ate mi ale nye kaabka ale masim nuemka. Mi le lenni yiila a te Naawen.

ref: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
text: Naawen yaa, wom m lueluku ase m nin wi fu. Ta jiirim ale mu abe fi tulisi mu.

ref: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
text: M suinummu a weeni fi wie ayen, <<Gisi wa nimbidiaka!>> Fi nimbidiaka, Naawen yaa, ate mi le gisi.

ref: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
text: Kan suk fidek ale mu, kan pai suipuurum a zɛri fi tomteerɔwa. Fi ale kasim chim m maarɔ. Kan zɛri mu yaase fi banti mu a basi. M varibasidɔ Wen yaa!

ref: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
text: Ase m kowa ale m mawa a dan poom banti mu, Naawen ale tuesi mu.

ref: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
text: Naawen yaa, sak mu fi suiku. De m niŋ a sak mu suyɔrɔsuŋku, m namsidɔma ale a limisi mu la nyiŋ.

ref: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
text: Kan pai mu a te m kisidɔma yiilaŋa ale a yaali diila, ale ka velimvendisa ale vaari yiti a potim m nyiŋ ale kasim a zɔk m kaasika.

ref: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
text: M seba chak ale nya kude kama, mi le nya Naawen wanalisaŋa ŋanvuta tɛŋka po.

ref: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
text: Limisi Naawen. Be pagra abe fi basi ate fi suinum a kali abe fi limisi Naawen.

ref: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
text: Naawen m piuŋŋoa, mi a wi fu. Kan lik fi tueŋa. Fi dan sina ale an tulisi mu, mi le chim ase ka baai ale kpi la.

ref: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
text: Ase ba niŋ ale poom kan bo ale Naawen ale a tom diila ale wa le pai nisa a nye diila, wa le waali ba abe wa kaasi ba, wa be kan ŋman zak ba zaani diipo diipo.

ref: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
text: Pimpauk abe bo Naawen jigi, dii nyiŋla wa wom m le kum a yaali jiirim la.

ref: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
text: Naawen ale m pagrim ale ligrɔ. M ta sebchakka m suinummu po ale wa, ate wa yaa maari mu. Masim a bo m suinum po ate m le lenni yiila a te wa jiam.

ref: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
text: Ka Naawen ale wa nuruma pagrɔ, wa le kpaliŋ a te waai ate wa lueri la ale ŋman chim wa varibasidɔ.

ref: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
text: Vari fi nuruma a basi abe fi niak ŋan baai ate fi soa la. Chim ba naapeerik a kasi ba taam wuu.

ref: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
text: Nama baai ate Naawen a nye wenŋmazukku la, ni te Naawen zula ale pagrim.

ref: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
text: Ni pai zula ŋaai ate wa soa la a te wa yuenni. Ni zuli Naawen wa weleŋsaŋa nalimu po.

ref: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
text: Naawen lueluku a bo nyakpientaŋa zuk kama ate ba a wom, Wen zulaŋa a na ka nanpansa. Naawen a na ka nanpansa nyaataŋa zuk.

ref: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
text: Naawen lueluku a pagra. Naawen lueluku a zuak kama.

ref: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
text: Naawen lueluku a ŋaari ka nyunyoŋta a lɔnsi. Naawen a ŋaari Lebanon nyunyoŋta a lɔnsi nna bunabuna.

ref: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
text: Wa basi ate Lebanon a yɔk a zi ase naabiik la. Wa basi ate Sirion a yɔk a zi ase gɔi lalik paalik la.

ref: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
text: Naawen lueluku a na ase ka ŋmoruk ale nyaksi a kum diila.

ref: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
text: Naawen lueluku a nye ate tɛŋ kosikka a choa. Naawen choa Kades tɛŋ kosikka.

ref: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
text: Naawen lueluku a basi ate tiib kpieŋsa a goalim ale lati si pagtaŋa. Waai meena a yaa kaari wa yeri po a weeni ayen, <<Pimpauk.>>

ref: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
text: Naawen ale kala a chim nyaataŋa naab. Naawen ale Naab diipo meena wuu.

ref: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
text: Naawen ale a te wa nuruma pagrim. Naawen a niak wa nuruma ale ka suiyɔgni.

ref: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
text: M le pak Naawen, ale ka fi ale vari mu kum po a basi, fi abe an basi ate m dachaasaŋa a la mu.

ref: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
text: Naawen, m dek Wen yaa, m wi fu a yaali maarika ate fi a tebi mu.

ref: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
text: Nama wen nuruma, ni lenni yiila a pak Naawen tuilum yuenni.

ref: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
text: Wa sui a kan puuri a ga niŋŋa alege wa nin baasimaŋa boro ka dila taam wuu. Kumsa a baga a boro yok kama alege popeentik ale jam boro saluik.

ref: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
text: M yaa le za zaana dek jigi la, m yaa weeni ayen, <<M kan ŋman choa.>>

ref: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
text: Naawen yaa, ase fi le ta jiirim ale mu la, fi lik mu a ta kama ate m kan choa ase guuk ale kan a choa diila. Alege fi le kan ŋman a nya mu la, m jɔk nyiŋbiiri kama.

ref: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
text: Naawen yaa, ka fi ate mi a wi, ka fi Nyɔnɔ ate m kum a te ayen fi ta jiirim ale mu,

ref: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
text: <<Ka boan jaab nyuenta ale bo m yik kaasika po? Ka boan jaab nyuenta ale bo m kum po? Tantaŋa ale pak fu? Ti le baga a biisi fi wensieŋa wie?

ref: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
text: Fi tagri m kumsaŋa ate si chim gɔgta. Fi yeeri sui kaasuŋ m po a basi ale gilim mu ale popeentik,

ref: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
text: ayen m pai m suinum a lenni yiila a te fu abe m kan sinla. Naawen m dek Wen yaa, m le te fi jiam taam wuu.

ref: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
text: Ka fi po, Naawen yaa, ate m suk m dek, kan te chivie a yik mu. Pa fi wayɔrisimaŋa a vari mu a basi.

ref: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
text: Te fi tunni a wom mu, nye nwuli jam vari mu a basi. Chim piuŋ a lik mu, chim ase kpaliŋ yeri dii ale pagra la a vari mu a basi.

ref: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
text: Ase fi ale ka m piuŋ ale m ligrɔ la, be dɛ m niŋ abe fi a sak mu, fi yuenni nyiŋ.

ref: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
text: M pai m chiika a nyo fi nisima po. Da tuesi mu, Naawen yaa, wensie Wen yaa.

ref: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
text: M kisi baai ale kpari maŋ bɔgta la kama, mi ta sebchakka ale Naawen.

ref: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
text: Fi ŋmanteka ale nye ate m ta popeentik, dii nyiŋla fi nya m ninammu ale seba m wadaanimaŋa.

ref: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
text: Fi an pai mu a te dachiaka alege fi pai mu a zaani ka peelim buui ale nye nna jalɔ la po.

ref: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
text: M boka po m jiak kama ale wadaanima ate m benaŋa mɛ a jiak ale ŋuuniŋ. Ate m pagrimu a nueri m ninammu nyiŋ, ate m kobaŋa a yaa wobsa.

ref: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
text: M dachaasaŋa meena nyiŋ, m le moata baai la nya mu ase ka nuru biok la. M chim ka yɔgsum a te m doaba baai a nyiem ale a nya mu peelim la a chali kama ayen ba nyini vum nyiŋ.

ref: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
text: Ba baŋ m wie kama ase m kpi la. Ase m chim ka takabi la.

ref: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
text: Dii nyiŋla mi a wom nuruba yegayega a waasi a weeni ayen yɔgsum a bo jigi meena. Ba siak teŋteŋŋa ale chaab a poli ayen ba ko mu.

ref: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
text: Alege mi ta sebchakka ale fi Naawen yaa. M weeni ayen, <<Fi ka mi Wen.>>

ref: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
text: Diipo meena m bo fi nisima po. Vari mu m dachaasaŋa nisima po a basi vari mu baai ale a vi mu la nisima po a basi.

ref: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
text: Te fi nina a nya fi tomteerɔwa zuk. Pa fi ŋmanteka a vari mu a basi.

ref: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
text: Naawen yaa, m le kum a te fu la, kan te chivie yik mu. Alege basi ate biem nyama jo chivie po, basi ate ba gu ba.

ref: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
text: Fi pai ba a pobi ta ka fidek yɔgsummu po. Fi pobi ba a ta kama ate nuru baataŋa popolaŋa ale giŋgeluŋtaŋa an baga ba wari a nye.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
text: Pak Naawen, dii nyiŋla wa sak mu wa ŋmanteka ase m dachaasaŋa ale gilim mu la.

ref: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
text: M yɔgsummu po m weeni ayen, <<Fi zɛri mu kama!>> Alege fi wom m le kum a weeni ayen fi ta jiirim ale mu la, m le wi fu ayen fi maari mu la.

ref: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
text: Nama baai ale ka Wen nuruba la, ni yaali Naawen! Naawen a nya baai ale ta siaka ale wa la zuk kama, alege kanjanta nyama wa a waali ba ka nalimnyiini.

ref: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
text: Nama baai ale ta yiila Naawen po la, ni pagra abe ni ta nyiŋbiiri.

ref: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
text: Suipeentik a bo le ka waai ale nya vɔŋteka wa tuim kaasima nyiŋla, ale waai wabaata ate fi lik la.

ref: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
text: Nuru waai ate Naawen a kan chiini wa wabaata la a ta suipeentik kama, ale waai chiik po ate pimpaasima a karo la.

ref: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
text: Kantueŋ ale yok meena fi kasim a namsi mu. Ate m pagrimu a ga nueri ferr ase wulum wen kantueŋ la.

ref: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
text: M yaa pai m biemu a sak fu ale an lik m tuim kaasimaŋa mɛ a dueni ya. M weeni ayen, <<M le tɔk m biemu a sak Naawen.>> Ate fi vɔŋ m biemu a te mu.

ref: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
text: Dila nyiŋla basi ate baai ale ka Wen nuruba la a puusi a te fu ale fi diem moata ba. Ka wensie, daanika a dan poom zuak a yiti, ka kan maa paari ba.

ref: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
text: Fi ka m sukka jigi. Fi le lik mu daanika po abe fi ge gilim mu ale yiila ŋaai ale a te varibasika la.

ref: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
text: Mi le sak fu suik kuui po ate fi le cheŋ la. Mi le sak fu abe m nya fi zuk.

ref: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
text: Kan a nye ase wusum yaase wusumboniŋ ale kan ta yam diila, alege ate ba pai noabaŋsa a dari ba diila kan daa di ba kan jam fi jigi ya.

ref: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
text: Jabioku kikaasaŋa a piisi kama, alege Naawen ŋmanteka a gilim baai ale ta sebchakka ale wa la kama.

ref: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
text: Wayɔrisima nyama, ni lenni popeentik yiila a te Naawen. Ku ka wamaŋ ayen nuru baai ale za wensie po la a pak wa.

ref: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
text: Pak Naawen ale kpanuŋ, lenni yiila ale miisa pi baganiŋka.

ref: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
text: Leni yipaali a te wa. Nak ŋannaŋta ale yam, abe fi a nye popeentik nuemka.

ref: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
text: Naawen a yaali ka wayɔrisima ale wensie buusa boka. Wa ŋmanteka a sueri tɛŋka de zuk kama.

ref: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
text: Naawen wanni ale nye wenŋmazuimaŋa. Wa vuusum nyiini ale pai wenbinni ale chiika ale chiŋmarisaŋa a basi wenŋmazuk.

ref: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
text: Basi ate tɛŋka meena a chali Naawen yɔgsum. Basi ate nuruba meena a zuli wa.

ref: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
text: Wa biisi kama ate jaab meena a nye. Wa weeni kama, ate jaab meena a zaani.

ref: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
text: Naawen a butim tɛŋsaŋa demma zɔŋŋa kama, alege yik nuruba ale poli diila a tulim.

ref: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
text: Tɛŋ kaai Wen ale Naawen la a ta ka suipeentik, nuru baai ate wa lueri a soa ba a nya la.

ref: The Lord looks at the world
text: Naawen a kali ka wenŋmazukku a chuiri a nya saalɔ meena.

ref: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
text: Wa boka jigini wa nya waai meena ale bo tɛŋzuk de la kama.

ref: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
text: Wa waai ale nye jaab meena suinum la, wa seba dii meena ate ti a nye la kama.

ref: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
text: Naab a kan cheŋ ga tɔŋ tugurik a dɛ ka wa le ta tugurik tɔŋdɔ pagrisa la nyiŋŋa, kpaliŋ kpaliŋdɔ a kan nyini vum nyiŋ ka wadek pagrim nyiŋŋa.

ref: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
text: Wusum ate ba ta cheŋ a ga nye kpaliŋsa la an baga vari nuru a basi, bu le bu pagrimu meena bu ka seeli a vari nuru a basi.

ref: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
text: Alege Naawen nimbieŋa a nya baai ale a chali wa yɔgsum la kama, wa a nya baai meena ale bo wa ŋmanteka po la kama,

ref: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
text: Ti a limisi Naawen ale yiila. Wa ka ti maarɔ ale ti ligrɔ.

ref: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
text: Ti suiniima a peenti kama, dii nyiŋla, ti ta sebchakka ale wa tuilum yuenni.

ref: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
text: M chiika ale kuulim Naawen nyiŋ. Basi ate baai ale a nam la a wom abe ba ta popeentik.

ref: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
text: M puusi a te Naawen ate wa tulisi mu, ate wa vari mu m yɔgsummu po meena a basi.

ref: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
text: Baai ale zak a nya wa la nimbidaasaŋa a nyaksi kama, chivie an lik ba nimbidaasaŋa.

ref: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
text: Niwobwa dɛ a wi Naawen ate wa wom wa. Wa vari wa wadaanimaŋa po meena a basi.

ref: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
text: Naawen maarɔwa a nya baai ale a chali wa la zuk kama, ale vari ba a basi.

ref: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
text: Lam Naawen a nya ayen wa nala kama. Waai ale pai wadek a te wa la a nya suipeentik kama.

ref: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
text: Wen nuruma, ni zuli Naawen, ale baai ale a zuli wa la a kan yaali jaab a jɔgi.

ref: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
text: Gbeŋma a baga a wobsa kama ate kɔm mɛ a ta ŋa, alege baai ale a gisi Naawen la kan silim jamaŋŋa.

ref: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
text: Ni jam, m bisa, ni wom mi. Mi ale sak ayen Naawen zulaŋa.

ref: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
text: Ni waai ale a yaali nyuvuri la, ale a yaali ayen wa daa wɔŋa la,

ref: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
text: kan pai fi nɔnni a biisi biem wie abe fi kan a velimu.

ref: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
text: Zɛri biem abe fi a tom wamaŋsa. Gisi suiyɔgni abe fi chali a vi di.

ref: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
text: Naawen nimbie a bo ka wayɔrisima nyama zuk ate wa tueŋa a wom ba puusa.

ref: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
text: Naawen a kisi baai ale a yaali biem tomka la kama, a yaali ayen wa basi ate ba kan ŋman teeri bala chaab tɛŋzuk de.

ref: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
text: Wayɔrisima nyama a puusi a te Naawen ate wa a wom ba. Wa vari ba, ba wadaanima po a basi.

ref: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
text: Naawen a moata baai ale kala ate ba sue a kaasi la kama, a vari baai ale kan ŋman ta yiila la a basi.

ref: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
text: Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa a baga a ta wadaanima ate ŋa a piisi yegayega. Alege Naawen a yeeri wa ŋa meena po kama.

ref: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
text: Wa lik wa kobaŋa meena kama a tara, dinyi mɛ la a kan wɛ.

ref: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
text: Biem ale ko nuru baataŋa. Dachiak sii meena ale kisi wayɔrisima nyama la, Naawen le bo mini ba.

ref: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
text: Naawen a da tuesi wadek tomteerɔma a basi kama. Waai a dan pai wadek a te wa, wa kan bo mini wa.

ref: Shield me and help me.
text: Pa fi kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa a jam maari mu.

ref: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
text: Zak fi kpaani ale fi gbaluku a vi baai ale a vi mu la, weeni m chiika ayen, <<Mi ka fi varibasidɔ.>>

ref: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
text: Basi ate baai ale potim m nyiŋla nya chivie. Basi ate baai ale a gisi m kaasuŋ la a pilim kuli ale sui kaasuŋ.

ref: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
text: Basi ate ba nye ase vɔtta ate viok a ji diila, basi ate Naawen maarɔba a yiak ba a basi.

ref: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
text: Basi ate ba suiku a chim legi abe ku a sati, abe Naawen maarɔba mɛ a vi ba ate ba chali.

ref: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
text: Ba pai ka baruk a bari mu kinla nyiŋ, ale tu goluk ayen ba yik mu,

ref: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
text: ba biem popolaŋa abe tu chaab ale badek. Ba baruku abe yik ba dak, abe ba lɔ badek golukku po.

ref: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
text: Ate m chiika a yaa naŋ Naawen niŋ abe m ta popeentik wa varibasika nyiŋ.

ref: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
text: M nyiŋka meena ale weeni ayen, <<Ka wana ale a neesi fu, Naawen yaa? Fi vari niwobwa pagrɔma nisima po a basi, fi vari jajakka ale baai ale a silim la varidɔma nisima po a basi.>>

ref: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
text: Velimvendisa a jam a bek mu wie ate m zɛ ŋa nɔi po,

ref: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
text: ba pai ka biem a tuni wamaŋsa ate m nye te ba la ale basi ate m jɔ chivie po.

ref: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
text: m kasim nyiem a cheŋ kama a kum ase m jɔk ka m doa yaase m suok la. M pai zuk su tɛŋ a kum ase m ka ma la.

ref: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
text: Nyɔnɔwa, fi a yaali ayen fi kala a nya ate ku beni ka sɛ? Vari mu ba tuemu dɛka po a basi, vari m nyuvuri maŋka gbeŋmaŋa nisima po.

ref: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
text: Mi le te fi jiam tigsuŋ kpioŋku niŋ, mi le pak fu nuru boanni niŋ.

ref: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
text: Kan basi ate m dachaasaŋa a naŋ alege mi an kaasi daa ba tuini. Kan basi ate baai ale kisi mu la a na nina m zuwa.

ref: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
text: Ba maa ka suiyɔgni biiga, alege ka venta nyiini ate ba velim a te baai ale nye chim tɛŋka po la.

ref: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
text: Ba velim a te mu a weeni ayen, <<Ka tama dek ale nya ale ti nimbie.>>

ref: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
text: Naawen yaa, fi nya nyakude kama. Be kan sina. Nyɔnɔ, kan yalima ale mu.

ref: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
text: Bɔ te mu fi wayɔrisimaŋa po, Naawen yaa. M dek Wen yaa kan te ba suik ate ba na nina m zuwa.

ref: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
text: Kan te ba poli ayen, <<Tama ale poom a yaali diila ale la!>> Yaase ba weeni ayen, <<Ti nɛ wa.>>

ref: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
text: Basi ate baai meena ale a naŋ m ninammu nyiŋla tu chaab ale chivie abe ba chim ŋantuinsa. Basi ate baai meena ale a nak kuusiri m zuk la a jo chivie po.

ref: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
text: Baai ale a yaali mi Varibasika la, a naŋ abe ba sue a peenti. Ba kasim a weeni ayen, <<Naawen yuenni a yiti, waai ale a yaali wa tomteerɔwa nyeboka la.>>

ref: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
text: M le lak m nɔnni a biisi fi wayɔrisimaŋa wie abe m biisi fi pimpaukku danni meena.

ref: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
text: Wadek nina po wa a paasi wadek ka nna yegayega ate wa le baga a miŋ yaase wa kisi wa biemu.

ref: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
text: Wa nɔnni po wieŋa ka gaasa ale pimpaasima. Wa basi yam taka kama ale kan nye wamaŋsa.

ref: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
text: Wa gaduokku zuk wa a zɔk ka biem. Wa pai wadek a te ka biem suik, ale kan zɛri dii ale kan nala la.

ref: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
text: Naawen yaa, fi ŋmanteka a paari ka wenŋmazuk, fi wensieŋa mɛ a paari wen.

ref: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
text: Fi wayɔrisimaŋa a nye ase ka guuk kpienta la. Fi wensieŋa a limisa ka nna yegayega. Naawen yaa, fi a lik nurubiik ale duŋsaŋa kama.

ref: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
text: Tutuna a ka fi yaali kaai ale kan a kpeglim la po. Nuru kpienta ale nuru fiisa a suk bo ka fi kiŋkaŋŋa yisuŋku po.

ref: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
text: Ba a dɛ ka ŋan baai yekka ale bo fi yenni po la, fi a te ba nyiam a nyini fi mariŋka benni po.

ref: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
text: Diila fi jigi ate nyuvuri bulika a boro. Fi bolimu po ate ti a nya bolim.

ref: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
text: Kasim ta fi ŋmanteka ale baai ale seba fu la. Fi wayɔrisimaŋa ale baai suiniima ale yɔrisi la.

ref: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
text: Kan basi ate kanjanta nyama a ta chaab ale mu, yaase gaasa nyam nisa a yiak mu a basi.

ref: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
text: Nya waba nyeerisaŋa ale lo dua diila, a yuk ba a lɔnsi, ate ba an baga a yiti.

ref: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
text: Kan te ku a daani fu wabaata nyam nyiŋŋa yaase fi a dɛ nyuri ale baai ale a nye wakaasima.

ref: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.
text: Diila ase wuuk la ba le ko, ase wusobluk la ba le kpi.

ref: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
text: Ta sebchakka ale Naawen abe fi a nye wamaŋsa, bo tɛŋka po abe fi a dɛ masim.

ref: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
text: Ta suipeentik ale Naawen ate wa te fu fi suinummu ale a yaali ŋan baai la.

ref: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
text: Pa fi suiku a te Naawen, ta sebchakka ale wa ate wa nye nna,

ref: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
text: wa le basi ate fi wayɔrisimaŋa a nyaksi ase kantueŋ la, fi wensie suiku ase wenzuk suŋsuŋ wenbiri la.

ref: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
text: Zaani chim Naawen niŋ a chiib limisi wa, kan te ku a daani fu ase nuruba wie a nin nye a niagi, ba nin poom a zɔk biem wie.

ref: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
text: Ba le gebi wabaata nyam a basi alege baai ale ta yiila ale Naawen la ale tuesi tɛŋka.

ref: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
text: Alege baai ale a nye ŋmam la ale tuesi tɛŋka a nya suiyɔgni nna yegayega.

ref: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
text: Wabaata nyama a zɔk kama a ta chaab ale wayɔrisima nyama ale a ŋɔbi nyina ale ba,

ref: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
text: alege Nyɔnɔwa a la wabaata nyama kama diila wa seba ayen ba danni a cheena kama.

ref: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
text: Wabaata nyama a yeeri ka gebik ale gori tom ayen ba dueni ŋanjaksaŋa ale baai ale a silim ŋanta la, ayen ba ko baai ale nye a magsi la.

ref: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
text: Alege ba gebisaŋa ale lu badek suiniima, abe ba timaŋa a wɛ.

ref: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
text: Wayɔrisima nyama a dan ta maga ku zunchoŋ wabaata nyam yega jigsika.

ref: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
text: Wabaata nyam pagrimu ale nueri, alege Naawen a yik wayɔrisima nyama a ta kama.

ref: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
text: Naawen a seba baai ale kan ta kaasuŋ la daaŋa kama, ba le tuesi ŋan baai meena la ale boro taam wuu.

ref: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
text: Diipo ate kaasuŋ a boro la, ba kan kpi. Diipo ate kɔm a boro la ba le nya ŋandiinta yega a dɛ.

ref: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
text: Alege wabaata nyama ale kpi. Naawen dachaasaŋa ale nye ase laŋsa po wuuta puuta nalim la. Naawen ale kaasi ba ate ba le muriŋ bɛ, a muriŋ bɛ ase nyuisa la.

ref: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
text: Wabaata nyama a peem kama alege kan tuni, alege wayɔrisima nyama a te ka yegayega.

ref: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
text: Baai ate Naawen a niak la ale tuesi tɛŋka, alege baai ate wa ka a te la, wa le gebi ba a basi.

ref: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
text: Naawen sui a dan peenti ale nuru nyeka wa a basi ate wa a cheŋ ale ka pagrim.

ref: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
text: Wa dan poom nak naŋ wa kan lɔ, diila Naawen a yik wa kama ale wa nisaŋa.

ref: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
text: Mi jam paala kama alege yɔgyɔgla a kpaŋ, alege mi an nya ale wa zɛri wayɔrisima nyama yaase ba bisa a juisi ŋandiinta.

ref: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
text: Ba kasim a te kama yegayega alege a peem a te ba kan zɛri. Ba bisaŋa a nya niauŋ kama.

ref: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
text: Basi biem nyeka abe fi a nye wamaŋsa, ate fi bo tɛŋka po taam wuu.

ref: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
text: Naawen a yaali wensie nyam kama, wa be kan basi baai ale ta siaka la. Wa le lik ba taam wuu, wabaata nyam bisaŋa wa le gebi ba a basi.

ref: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
text: Wayɔrisima nyama ale tuesi tɛŋka a bo ka po taam wuu.

ref: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
text: Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ a lak nɔi a biisi ka yam ale a biisi dii ale ka wensie la.

ref: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
text: Wa Wenni sinsaŋŋa a bo ka wa suinummu po. Wa naŋsa a kan tabi a sati.

ref: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
text: Wabaata nyama a dua kama a limisi wayɔrisima nyama, a gisi ba nyuvooŋa.

ref: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
text: Alege Naawen a kan pai ba a basi ba pagrimu po, yaase wa basi ate ba bo mini ba ase ba nin boro a bo ba buusa.

ref: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
text: Limisi Naawen abe fi yik wa suiku. Wa le zak fu zaani ate fi tuesi tɛŋka. Wa dan gebi wabaata nyama a basi fi le nya.

ref: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
text: Mi nya wabaata ale gaasa nyɔnɔ kama ate wa nya wadek nna ase tiib ale za tɛŋ maŋ jigi ate bu vaata a sobi la,

ref: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
text: alege wa deri muriŋ bɛ wa ŋman karo, mi a yaali ayen m nya wa alege m kan nya wa.

ref: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
text: Poli waai ale kan ta kaasuŋ la wari, kpesi nya wamaŋsa nyɔnɔwa. Nuru waai ale a yaali suiyɔgni la a ta chum kama.

ref: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
text: Alege ba le kaasi wabaata nyama meena, wa le gebi wabaata nyama chum po a basi.

ref: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
text: Wayɔrisima nyama varibasika a nyini ka Naawen jigi, wa ale ba pagrɔ a yik ba daanika po.

ref: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
text: Naawen a maari ba ale a vari ba a basi, wa a yeeri ba kama wabaata nyama jigi a vari ba a basi, dii nyiŋla ba a suk ka wa jigi.

ref: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
text: Naawen yaa, kan toariŋ mu ale fi suipuurumu yaase fi waali mu ale fi suipuurumu.

ref: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
text: Diila fi peemaŋa a feri mu kama, ate fi nisaŋa a siŋ ji m zuk.

ref: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
text: Fi suipuurumu nyiŋ nyiŋyɔgsa a ka m nyiŋka po, m kobaŋa an soa ŋa dega m biemu nyiŋ.

ref: are so heavy that I am crushed.
text: M kaasuŋku popolaŋa a daani mu kama ase jib dobruk ate m ji la.

ref: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
text: M bettaŋa biemu nyiŋ m niraŋa a ŋoonti kama ale a nyuŋ.

ref: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
text: Mi yaa koori ka tɛŋ a ta m dek a siŋ tɛŋ nna yegayega, danni meena mi nyiem kum a cheŋ kama.

ref: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
text: M ŋaaŋka meena a dom ka nna pɔkpɔk ate nyiŋyɔgsa a ka m nyiŋka po.

ref: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
text: M yaa jiak kama ale nye nna kuligi. Ate mi a ŋusi ale suinum domsik.

ref: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
text: Mi ale a yaali diila meena a lak dua ka fi niŋ, Nyɔnɔ, mi daanika an suk fi jigi ya.

ref: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
text: M suinummu a nak kama ate m pagrimu nye kpeeri, kantueŋ muriŋ a bɛ kama m nina po.

ref: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
text: M doama ale m bandɔma a basi mu kama m tuemu nyiŋ, baai ale moata mu la a yaa yalima ale mu.

ref: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
text: Baai ale a gisi mi nyuvunni la a bari ka batta, baai ale ba nye mi biem la a biisi tuemu ale kaasi mi la wari kama, daa meena ba a zɔk ka pimpaasima.

ref: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
text: Mi a limisi fu kama, Naawen yaa, fi le tulisi, m Nyɔnɔ Wen yaa.

ref: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
text: Mi weeni kama ayen, <<Kan basi ate ba a naŋ yaase ba zak badek a zaani ase mi a nin tabi sati.>>

ref: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
text: Diila m boro a lɔ kama, ate domka a kasim a bo ale mu.

ref: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
text: Mi a weeni m biemu, ale m wabaataŋa ale a daani mu la kama.

ref: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
text: Naawen yaa, kan zɛri mu, kan yalima ale mu, m Wen yaa.

ref: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
text: Jam nwuli a maari mu, m dek Nyɔnɔ Varibasidɔ.

ref: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
text: Mi yaa weeni ayen, <<Mi le kpesi m suitaŋa abe m yik m nɔi ale biem biik, mi ale lik m nɔnni wabaata nyama ale tɔlim bo m tɛŋ la.

ref: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
text: Alege mi ale jam sina ale nye diki la, a kan poom a weeni wamaŋ la, m popolaŋa daanika a ŋmasi a zuak kama.

ref: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
text: Mi suinummu a toliŋ, ate mi le a poli la, bolimu a ŋmasi a dɛ, ate mi yaa biisi ale m nɔnni.

ref: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
text: Sak mu, Naawen yaa, m nyuvunni kpeglimka jigi ale m daaŋa nɔi, basi ate m seba m nyuvunni ale a cheŋ diila.

ref: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
text: Fi nye m daaŋa ase ka nisa nɔi la, mi benaŋa ale dari soa diila ka kinla fi niŋ. Nurubiik meena nyuvuri ka bunyi vuusika.

ref: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
text: Nuru ka chiik ase wa le a ga niŋ a ga ŋaaŋ la. Wa a nye wie ka nwuli nwuli alege dila meena ka koruk. Wa tigsi ŋanta kama a jigsi alege zɛ waai ale wa tuesi la,

ref: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
text: <<Alege yɔgyɔgla de, Nyɔnɔ, mi a nya ka boa? Mi yiila a bo ka fi jigi.

ref: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
text: Vari mu m wakaasimaŋa po meena a basi, kan basi ate m chim ja laam a te betta.

ref: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
text: Mi jam nye ka diki, m kan lak m nɔnni, diila ka fi ale nye kude.

ref: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
