text: Yeeri fi namsika m jigi, fi nisaŋa chubika a baga mu kama.

ref: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
text: Fi a toariŋ ale a waali nuruba ba biemu nyiŋ kama, fi le kaasi ba jigsika ase mɛɛri la. Nuru meena ka bunyi vuusika.

ref: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
text: <<Wom m puusa, Naawen yaa, wom m le kum a yaali maarika la, kan lik fi tue a kan wom m kumsaŋa. Diila mi bo ale fu ase ka nichaanɔ la, nichaanɔ ase m koma ale jam ka diila.

ref: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
text: Kan a nya mi ate ku a daani fu ate m ta suipeentik abe m ge kpi a cheŋ.>>

ref: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
text: Mi yik ka m dek a limisi Naawen, ate wa cheem a wom m kumsa.

ref: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
text: Wa yeeri mu kama goluk kuui ale a sati la po, a yeeri mu bagta po, a pai mu zaani piuŋ zuk a te mu kauk kuui ale zeesa ayen m zaani.

ref: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
text: Wa pai ka yipaali a nyo m nɔi po, pimpauk yiili a te ti Wenni. Nuruba yega ale nya a chali yɔgsum ate ba ta sebchakka ale Naawen.

ref: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
text: Suipeentik a bo le ka nuru waai ale basi ate Naawen a chim wa mariŋka la jigi. Waai ale kan zak a nya kanjanta nyam la, a kan nya baai ale cheem a nya venta wena.

ref: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
text: Naawen mi Wenni, wakinkagla yega ate fi tom. Wie ŋaai ate fi zɔk te ti la, waai karo a baga a chiini a te fu. M dan poom ayen m biisi a weeni ŋa wari, ŋa zuak ka yega ale weenika.

ref: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
text: Kaabka ale tiirim fi an yaali ya, alege lagri mi tueŋa, juka tiirim ale tom kaasika tiirim fi an bek ya.

ref: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
text: Ate mi yaa weeni ayen, <<Mi ale nna, m jam kama, ku ŋmarisi mi wie kama gbaŋka po.

ref: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
text: Mi a yaali ayen m nye ka fi yaalika, m dek Wen yaa, fi sinsaŋŋa a bo ka m suinummu po.>>

ref: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
text: Mi le mooli wayɔrisima wie kama tigsuŋ kpioŋku po. Mi an mum m nɔnni ase fi ale seba la, Naawen yaa.

ref: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
text: Mi kan suk fi wayɔrisimaŋa m suinummu po, mi a biisi fi wensieŋa ale fi varibasika wie kama. Mi kan suk fi ŋmanteka ale fi wensieŋa tigsuŋ kpioŋku jigi ya.

ref: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
text: Kan peri fi jiirimu m jigi ya, Naawen yaa. Basi ate fi ŋmanteka ale fi wensieŋa a kasim a lik mu.

ref: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
text: Daanika a ka chiina ale gilim mu, m wabaataŋa a nya ka pagrim m zuk, ate mi an baga a nya. A piisi a gaam m zukku zuisaŋa, ate m jɔk yiila.

ref: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
text: Te ti fi sui a peenti, Naawen yaa, vari mu basi. Naawen yaa, jam nwuli a maari mu.

ref: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
text: Baai meena ale a gisi ayen ba yeeri mi nyuvunni la a jo chivie ale butimka po, baai meena ale a yaali mi kaasuŋ la a viriŋ a cheŋ ale chivie.

ref: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
text: Baai ale a nye mi a la la, yɔgsum yik ba badek chivieŋa po.

ref: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
text: Alege baai meena ale a gisi fu la sui ale peenti ale fu, baai meena ale a yaali fi varibasika la a kasim a weeni ayen, <<Naawen yuenni abe yiti.>>

ref: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
text: Alege mi jaŋ kama a yaali maarika, Nyɔnɔwa abe poli m wari. Fi ka m maarɔ ale m varibasidɔ, m dek Wen yaa, kan beni.

ref: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
text: Suipeentik a bo le waai ale ta jiirim ale ŋanjaksa la. Naawen a yeeri ba wadaanima po.

ref: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
text: Naawen ale lik ba a tara abe wa te ba vum. Wa te ba paaruŋ ale ŋman vari ba ba dachaasaŋa nisima po a basi.

ref: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
text: Naawen ale maari wa wa nyiŋtuilaŋa po wa gaduokku zuk, wa le tebi wa yuammu wa gaduokku zuk.

ref: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
text: Mi a weeni ayen, <<Naawen yaa, ta jiirim ale mu. Tebi mu ale m nye kaasi fu kama.>>

ref: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
text: Mi dachaasaŋa a biisi ka biem a te mu, ayen, <<Ka dimpo ate wa le kpi ate wa yuenni bɛ?>>

ref: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
text: Waai dan jam ayen wa nya mu wa a biisi ka venta, ale a poli popola baata wa suinum po. Wa yaa dan nyini peelim wa mooli te jigi meena.

ref: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
text: <<Nyiŋtuila pagra a paari wa. Wa kan lati wa tiaka po.>>

ref: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
text: Alege Naawen yaa, ta jiirim ale mu. Te mu nyiŋyɔgsa ate m tuni dachaasaŋa wanyi wanyi.

ref: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
text: M seba ayen fi sui a yɔk ale mu kama dii nyiŋla fi an basi ate m dachaasaŋa naŋ m zuwa.

ref: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
text: Fi vari m nyuvunni a te mu dii nyiŋla m ka daŋta, fi yaa bi dari mu kama a ta paari fi tɛŋ diipo meena wuu.

ref: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
text: Pimpauk abe bo Naawen, Izirali Wenni jigi, waai ale boro ta nyini benaŋa ŋaai ale taam la a cheŋ wuu. Ku abe nye dila.

ref: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
text: Ase nyanyuila ale ta kab ate bu tuinti a yaali nyiam diila, mi mɛ gisi a yaali fu ka dila, Wen yaa.

ref: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
text: Wen dii ale vua la kɔrisa ale ta mu. Ka dimpo ate m le zaani fi niŋŋa?

ref: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
text: Yɔk ale kantueŋ meena, ninyiam ale chim mi ŋandiinta, alege m dachaasaŋa a yaa kasim a bek mu ayen, <<Fi Wenni a bo ka bɛ?>>

ref: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
text: Ka boan nyiŋ ate fi sui a kaasi, m chiiga? Ka boan nyiŋ ate mi ta ninjaga? Pa fi yiila a nyo Wen po, mi le diem pak wa, m Varibasidɔ ale

ref: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
text: m Wen. M chiika a dɛ niniga m po, dila nyiŋla a nyini Jodan tɛŋka m teeri fi wie, mi le zaani Yermon guuk woŋtaŋa, ale Mizar Guuku zuk a teeri fi wie.

ref: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
text: Mi wom nyiamu ale kasim a wuuri ase bu nyamiika ale va m zuk a taam la.

ref: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
text: Kantueŋka po Naawen a kpiiri wa ŋmanteka a basi m zuk, ate yok buuri meena, mi lenni yiila a puusi a te Wen dii ale a te mu vum la.

ref: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
text: M kobaŋa a dom ase m dachaasaŋa ale nye mu a la, ale a weeni ayen, <<Fi Wenni tin bo ka bɛ?>>

ref: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
text: Ka boan nyiŋ ate fi sui a kaasi, m chiiga? Ka boan nyiŋ ate mi ta ninjaga? Pa fi yiila a nyo Wen po, mi le diem pak wa, m Varibasidɔ ale m Wen.

ref: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
text: Wen biisi te mu, abe fi kpaliŋ kpaliŋka ale wabaata nyama a te mu. Vari mu pimpaasima ale nuru baata nyama nisima po a basi.

ref: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
text: Fi ka Wen dii ale chim m pagrɔ. Ka boan nyiŋ ate fi zɛri mu? Ka boan nyiŋ ate mi a kasim a nyiem ale ninyiam ate m dachaasaŋa mɛ a kasim a fɛ mu?

ref: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
text: Basi ate fi bolimu ale fi wensieŋa a kasi mu. Basi ate ba ta mu a jam fi tuilum guuku zuk, juijui ate fi yenni a boro la.

ref: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
text: M yaa le cheŋ Wen kuŋkuŋku jigini, mi le cheŋ Wen jigi ale popeentik. Wen, m Wen yaa mi le pak fu ale kpanuŋ.

ref: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
text: Ka boan nyiŋ ate fi sui a kaasi, m chiiga? Ka boan nyiŋ ate mi ta ninjaga? Pa fi yiila a nyo Wen po, mi ale diem pak wa, Varibasidɔ ale m Wen.

ref: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
text: Wen, tama pa ka ti tue a wom, ti koma a weeni a sak ti, dii ate fi a nye te ba ba vaaŋa po dipo la.

ref: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
text: Fidek ale yiak nuruba ate ba chali ale ge ba tɛŋsa ate tama koma a kali si po. Fi buriŋ nuruma alege basi ate tama koma nya badek.

ref: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
text: Ku jam daa ba gebik nyiŋ ate ba nya nakdeka tɛŋka zuwa, yaase ba nisa pagrim ale te ba nakdeka. Ku jam ka fi juga nisa pagrim, ale fi nimbidiaka nyaksika, diila fi a yaali ba kama.

ref: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
text: Fi ka m Naab ale m Wen, fi pai nakdeka a te Jekob.

ref: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
text: Fi pagrimu nyiŋ, ti tusi ti dachaasaŋa a ta ga ŋaaŋ, fi yuenni nyiŋ, ti tabi ti dachaasaŋa zuk a taamu.

ref: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
text: M ka sebchakka ale m tommu, m gebika be kan vari mu a basi,

ref: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
text: alege fi te ti nakdeka ti dachaasaŋa zuk, fi pai ti kisidɔma a nyo chivie po.

ref: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
text: Wen nyiŋ ale soa ate tama a nak kuusidi danni meena, ti bɛ le pak fi yuenni diipo meena wuu.

ref: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de fi cheem ti basi ka nakpiak ale chivie, fi an ŋman a dɛ ti tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋ a ta ba a cheŋ kpaliŋ po.

ref: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
text: Fi kati ti kama a waaŋ tɛŋsaŋa po ayen ba ŋɔbi ti ase piisa la.

ref: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
text: Fi pai fi nuruma a da ka mɔli ase ba ka ŋankayaata la.

ref: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
text: Fi basi ate chivie a yik ti nuru boari suŋsuŋ. Fi basi ate ba nye ti a la.

ref: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
text: Chivie ale dua m niŋ danni meena, chivie ale ta mu,

ref: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
text: m dachaasaŋa ale a vi mu ale a nye mu biem ale a lɛ mu la nyiŋ.

ref: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
text: Wieŋa de meena ale nye ti la, tama an diem baŋ fi wari ya, yaase ti ka wensie ale fi nɔiyeŋka.

ref: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
text: Ti suiniimaŋa an nyini fi ŋaaŋ nyini ya. Ti an cheŋ fi suiku a bɛ ya.

ref: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
text: Alege fi buriŋ ti a basi ate ti tɛŋka a chim gɔi duŋsa goom jigi. Fi zɛri ti a basi legi kpienni po.

ref: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
text: Ase ti daam dan baŋ Wen yuenni kama, yaase ti pai tidek a te bɔgluk,

ref: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
text: Wen ate poom nya kama, wa le ka waai ale seba nuruba susuga wie ba suiniima po la.

ref: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
text: Alege fi nyiŋ, ti a tu kum danni meena. Tama a nye ase ka pa ŋaai ate ba ayen ba tɔgri la.

ref: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
text: Nyɔnɔ, yiti! Ka boan nyiŋ ate fi dua a goa? Kan zɛri ti taam wuu.

ref: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
text: Ka boa ate fi kan nya ti geŋŋa ale baŋ ti niniŋŋa ale namsika?

ref: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
text: Tama yaa dua ka tantaŋa po. Ate ti nyiŋsaŋa yaa siŋ paari tɛŋ.

ref: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
text: Be yiti zaani a maari ti, yiti zaani a da tuesi ti a basi dii nyiŋla fi ŋmanteka a ka bain ya.

ref: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
text: Wamaŋsa ale sueri m popolaŋa ase mi le a gomsi yiini dɛ a te naawa la. Mi nɔnni a nye ase ka ŋmarisidoa maŋ jaŋmarisim la.

ref: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
text: Fi ka nidoa waai ale nala gaam nidoaba meena, fi nɔnni po, ka yam jiirim nyiini ale nyini du a nyini, ase Wen dek ale niak fu dii taam wuu la.

ref: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
text: Fi naamu po naab ale a dɔ wusum diila, dɔ ale nakdeka. Wensie ale yik m dek ale wayɔrisima nyiŋ basi ate fi juga nisaŋa a tom wakpiema.

ref: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
text: Basi ate fi peema ŋaai ale choarisi la a kali naawa dachaasaŋa suiniima. Basi ate tɛŋsaŋa a lɔ fi naŋsa po.

ref: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
text: Wen, fi naamu zaŋgɔŋka a kpi za ka dila taam wuu. Fi naamu tɛŋka po, fi a bɔ ka wensie buusa.

ref: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
text: Fi a yaali ka dii ale nala la ale kisi dii ale bie la. Dila nyiŋla Wen, fi Wenni a basi kama ate fi zuak a gaam fi chaama meena dii nyiŋla, wa bobi fu naam.

ref: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
text: Fi gattaŋa meena a nyuŋ ka nyum masik ase ŋan baai ate ba a wi ayen, mir ale alos ale kassia la. Nalima yie po ba gomsi ale ka yauk nyina. Kpanuŋta yiila a nye kama ate fi sui a peenti.

ref: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
text: Nalima lieba ale bo fi nipok baai ale ta zula la po. Fi juga geŋ naab pok fiak ale su Ofir tɛŋka ligmɔniŋ za.

ref: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
text: Liewa, lak turi a wom abe fi poli. Baŋ fi nuruma ale fi kowa yenni wie.

ref: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
text: Fi chorɔwa naawa a mariŋ fi nalimu kama, te wa zula ale wa ka fi nyɔnɔ.

ref: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
text: Taaya Liewa ale jam ale tiirim. Jigsirɔba ale nye ate fi mariŋ ba.

ref: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
text: Naab lie kalika jigi, ka nna naliŋnaliŋŋa, wa garukku ba pai ka ligmɔniŋ a yɔk ku.

ref: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
text: Ba jɔ naawa yenni po ale ka popeentik.

ref: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
text: Fi bisa ale tom fi koma naŋkunni po, fi le nye ate ba chim nabisa tɛŋka meena po.

ref: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
text: Mi le te fi yuenni zula buuri meena po, dila nyiŋla tɛŋsaŋa ale kasim a zuli fu taam wuu.

ref: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
text: Wen ka tama ligrɔ ale ti pagrɔ, a maari ti diipo meena.

ref: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
text: Dila nyiŋla, tɛŋka a dan poom choa, ti kan chali yɔgsummoa, ase guutaŋa a nin poom lɔ nyiam liuŋku po.

ref: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
text: Nyiam kpientaŋa a dan poom a wuuri ale a fɔbi nanpansa ale suipuurum, ti kan chali yɔgsummoa.

ref: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
text: Beli ale boro a te Wen tɛŋka popeentik, Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La bo weleŋka jigini ate benni a boro.

ref: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
text: Wen ale bo tɛŋ kala po, nuru abe karo a kaasi ka. Wen ale maari ka ase vari a nin veenti.

ref: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
text: Tɛŋsa kpaziita a nak, naata a lɔ. Wa lak wa lueluku ate tɛŋka a nyaliŋ.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
text: Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a bo ale ti, Jekob Wenni ka ti sukka jigi.

ref: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
text: Ni jam nya Naawen ale tom diila, tuim kaasuŋ kuui ate wa tom tɛŋka zuk la.

ref: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
text: Wa kpimsi kpaliŋsa tɛŋka meena po, wa yik tommu ale gbaluku a wɛ gela ŋaye. Gbain ŋaai ate ba ta a chɔgsi peemaŋa la wa ju basi ya.

ref: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
text: <<Zaani diki, abe fi seba ayen, mi ka Wen. Tɛŋsa nuruba ale zak mi zaani tɛŋsaŋa po, m le nya zak zaanika tɛŋka zuk.>>

ref: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
text: Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a bo ale ti, Jekob Wenni ka ti sukka jigi.

ref: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
text: Nuru meena a nak nichaala ale masim a pak Wen. Nuru meena a nuem popeentik nuemka a pak Wen.

ref: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
text: Wa lueri ti nitalimu a te ti, Jekob kanjantaŋa, waai ate wa a yaali la.

ref: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
text: Wen ale a jueli la yilendɔba ale a nuem ale suipeentik, Naawen ale a jueli la ba a peeri damunsa.

ref: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
text: Ale ka Wen ale chim tɛŋka meena Naab, ni lenni yiila a pak wa.

ref: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
text: Wen a kala ka wa naam tuilum zukpaglika zuk a chim naab tɛŋsaŋa meena zuk.

ref: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
text: Tɛŋsaŋa kpaŋŋa tigsi ka chaab ase Abrayam Wenni nuruba la. Ka Wen ale soa tɛŋzuk de nalimaŋa, ba te wa zuli kpiema.

ref: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
text: Naawen a zuak ka yega ku magsi ayen ti pak wa, ti Wenni wa tɛŋ weleŋka po ale wa tuilum guuku zuk.

ref: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
text: Ka ka tɛŋ naluŋ ale ŋman chim tɛŋzuk de meena masim tɛŋ. Guuk kuui ate ba a wi ayen Zayon la, ale chim Naab kpioŋku tɛŋka.

ref: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
text: Wen dek ale bo Jerusalem kpaliŋ yeeŋa po, Wa le chim Jerusalem ligrɔ.

ref: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
text: Tɛŋka nalimaŋa a dan poom gum chaab, ba dan poom cheŋ niŋ ale chaab,

ref: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
text: ba ale nya ka la, ku cha ba ate ba yiti chali ale yɔgsum.

ref: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
text: Fi kaasi ba ase ka vamuniŋ ale fɔbi Tarsis ŋaaruŋtaŋa a kaasi ti diila.

ref: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
text: Ase ti le wom diila, ti be nya ka dila Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La tɛŋka po, ti Wen tɛŋka po. Wen abe pobi ka diipo meena wuu.

ref: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
text: Ase ti le a puusi fu fi yenni po la, ti kasim a poli ka fi ŋmanteka wie.

ref: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
text: Ase fi yuenni ale ka diila, fi pimpaukku mɛ ka dila tɛŋka meena le dua ga saari la, fi juga nisaŋa a sueri ale ka wayɔrisima.

ref: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
text: Cheŋ Zayon tɛŋka po nya, cheŋ gilim ka a nya, chiini ka yeeŋa.

ref: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
text: Poli ka parik kiblaŋa wie, abe fi zak nya ka diin woŋtaŋa ate ni biisi ba wie a sak buui dii ale bo nama ŋaaŋ la.

ref: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
text: Ale Wenni dɛ ka, tama Wen diipo meena wuu. Wa le chim ti ganidoa a ta ga paari nuerika.

ref: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
text: Nuruba meena, ni wom wanni de. Ni wom de, baai meena ale bo tɛŋka zuk la.

ref: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
text: Nuru kpienta ale nuru poasinsa, jigsirɔba ale ŋanjaksa. Ni wom de.

ref: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
text: M le lak m tueŋa a wom wamagsima. M le pai kpanuŋ a tɔk wie kiri.

ref: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
text: Ka boa ate mi a chali yɔgsum ase da baata dai a nin jam m jigi, ase velimvendi sii ale ta gaasa la a nin gilim mu,

ref: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
text: baai ale ta sebchakka ale ba ŋanta ale a kuulim ŋa nyiŋ la?

ref: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
text: Nuru karo a baga da tuesi waai nyuvuri, yaase wa tuni Wen wa nyuvunni nyiŋŋa.

ref: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
text: Nuru nyuvuri da tuesika daa moali ya. Nuru karo a baga a da wa nyuvunni Naawen jigi a soa di a boro,

ref: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
text: ayen wa boro taam wuu ale kan kpi.

ref: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
text: Dii nyiŋla waai meena a nya ayen nuru baai ale ta yam la a kpi kama, ase betta ale baai ale kan a poli la ale a kpi ale a basi ba paaruŋ diila.

ref: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
text: Ba boositaŋa ale a chim ba yie taam wuu, ba dan poom pai ba yueŋa a te tɛŋsa ate ba soa, ka ba boositaŋa ale a chim ba yie taam wuu.

ref: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
text: Dii ale ku nye baai ale ta mariŋka ale badek la, ale ba ŋaaŋviirɔ baai ale a siak a te ba wieŋa la ale nna.

ref: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
text: Ase piisa la, ka boosuku ale ku soa ba, kum ale pai ba a chim ŋandiinta. Nuru baai ale za chekki la ale nya ba zuk ku kpeglimka po. Ba nyiŋsaŋa ale puak vɔrumu po, ate ku le yalima ale ba yie naliŋsaŋa.

ref: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
text: Alege Wen ale vari m nyuvunni a nyini vɔrumu po. Wa le sum ta mu a jam wadek jigi.

ref: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
text: Kan te ku a daani fu ale nuru waai ale jigsi, ate wa yenni mɛ a kasim nala la.

ref: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
text: Dii nyiŋla, wa dan kpi, wa kan pai jaab ta cheŋŋi. Wa nalimu a kan va wa a siŋi.

ref: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
text: Wa daam le bo tɛŋzuk de la, wa a poli ayen ka wa ale ta niauŋ ate nuruba mɛ a wi wa busena a pak wa, wa jigsika nyiŋ,

ref: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
text: alege wa le gum wa koma gaŋka po, ate ba a kan nya nyuvuri bolimoa.

ref: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
text: Nuru waai ale jigsi ale ka miŋka la a nye ase ka duŋ sii ale kpi la.

ref: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
text: Waai Ale Zuak La, Wen, Naawen a biisi ale tigsi nuruma a ta nyini wenbinni pusika jigini a ta ga paari di siŋka jigini.

ref: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
text: Zayon a nala kama ate Wen a nyaksi a nyini dula.

ref: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
text: Tama Wenni a cheena, wa be kan sina, bolim ŋiak ale bo wa niŋ a dɛ ate vamuniŋ mɛ a gilim wa.

ref: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
text: Wa tigsi wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk de a zaani kama, ayen wa bɔ wa nuruma buusa.

ref: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
text: <<Tigsi mi nuruma m niŋ, baai ale pai kaabka a nye nɔiyeŋ ale mi la.>>

ref: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
text: Ate wenŋmazuk a mooli wa wayɔrisimaŋa dii nyiŋla, Wen dek ale a bɔ buusa.

ref: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
text: <<M nuruba, ni goori wom ate m biisi. Izirali demma, ni zaani ate m weeni ni dii ate ni nye kaasi la. Mi ka Wen, ni Wenni.

ref: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
text: dii nyiŋla gɔi duŋsa meena ale niiŋa ale bo guuta tusa zuk la ka mi ale soa.

ref: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
text: Mi seba nuinsa meena ale bo guutaŋa zuima la kama, ŋanvuta meena tɛŋka zuk ka mi ale soa.

ref: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
text: Kɔm a dan ta mi, mi kan bek ni waai ya, dii nyiŋla tɛŋka ale ka jaab meena ka mi ale soa.

ref: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
text: Mi a ŋɔbi lalisa lanta? Yaase mi a nyu bua ziimoa?

ref: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
text: Fi pai jiam a te Wen ase kaabka tiirita la, fi dan puulim ayen fi nye wari a te mi Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La be nye di,

ref: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
text: abe fi mu da dii dai ate fi bo daanika po la, ate m vari fu a basi ate fi te mi zula.>>

ref: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
text: Alege Wen a weeni nuru baataŋa kama ayen, <<Ka wana ale te ni suik ayen ni maari a weeni mi wieŋa, yaase ni pai m nɔiyeŋka a nyo ni nɔi po?

ref: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
text: Ni kisa m sinsaŋŋa ale pai m wieŋa a basi ni ŋaaŋ.

ref: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
text: Ni dan nya zue, ni nyiem a gum wa po, ale a kali ale kaboŋ nyeerisa.

ref: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
text: Ni noaŋa a biisi ka biem wie, ate ni giŋgeluŋtaŋa a sueri ale pimpaasima.

ref: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
text: Ni kasim biisi a kaasi ni suata ale a velim a te ni mabisa.

ref: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
text: Ni a nye wieŋa de kama alege m nye chim, ni poli ayen mi maari a nye ase ka nama la. Alege m le toariŋ ni abe m ŋma ni, ni nimbie po.

ref: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
text: <<Ni poli kude zuk, nama baai ale baŋ Wen la, kan daa di m le yik ni a dari cheeri nna bunabuna, ate nuru kan boro ale vari ni a basi.

ref: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
text: Waai ale a nye jiam a te Wen ase kaabka tiirita la a zuli Mi kama, ate wa gomsi suik ayen m sak wa Wen varibasika.>>

ref: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
text: Wen yaa, ta jiirim ale mu, a magsi chaab ale fi yaali kaai ale kan a nueri la. Fi ŋmanteka nyiŋ, yeeri m nye kaasuŋku a basi.

ref: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
text: Sugri m kaasuŋku meena a basi, abe fi duisi m biemu a basi.

ref: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
text: Dii nyiŋla, mi seba m wakaasimaŋa ale m biemu a kasim bo ka m niŋ.

ref: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
text: Ka fi nyiini ale m tom a kaasi, m tom biem fi niŋ. Fi dan biisi, wensie boro kama. Fi be dan bo buusa ŋmiŋmaasa a ka.

ref: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
text: Chekki, ba biak mu ale ka biem, m ka biem nyɔnɔ a nyini diipo ate m mawa a ta m lɔgni la.

ref: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
text: Chekki, ka wensie ate fi a yaali a ta nyini m suinummu po, ate fi a sak mu popo yam.

ref: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
text: Sugri mu ale kpaliok ate m nala, sugri mu ate m peenti tektek.

ref: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
text: Basi ate m wom masim ale popeentik. Basi ate koba ŋaai ate fi ŋɔriŋ la, a dɛ masim.

ref: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
text: Suk fi nina a nyini m wabaataŋa zuk, abe fi yeeri m nye kaasuŋku meena a basi.

ref: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
text: Nye m suinummu cheri Wen yaa, abe fi ŋman te mu wamaŋsa nyeka chiik.

ref: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
text: Kan yiak mu Fi niŋ a basi yaase fi pai Fi Chiika a nyini m jigi ya.

ref: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
text: Pilim te mu Fi varibasika masimu, abe fi te mu chiik kaai ale ka basi ate mi a nye fi yaalika la.

ref: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
text: Dila ale te m sak wakaasima nyam fi suiku, ate wabaata nyam a pilim ŋman jam fi jigi.

ref: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
text: Wen yaa, vari mu a ta nyini m nuruba koka kaasuŋku po. Fi ka Wen dii ale vari mu a basi, ate m giŋgeluŋku ale lenni fi wayɔrisimaŋa wie.

ref: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
text: Nyɔnɔ, lak m nɔngbanvaataŋa ate m nɔnni a pak Fu.

ref: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
text: Wen kaabsaŋa ka zaab m dek nyeela. Wen yaa, suinum buui ale zaab bu dek ale ŋman tagri la, Fi kan zɛri bu.

ref: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
text: Fi ŋmanteka nyiŋ nye ate Zayon a jigsi. Sɛ Jerusalem parisaŋa.

ref: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
text: Dila ale te ate wayɔrisima duŋsa kaabka a boro la, kaab kaai ale a ju meena a peenti Fi sui la, ate ba pa lalisa a te Fu, Fi kuŋkuŋku zuk.

ref: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
text: Ka boa ate fi a kuulim biem nyiŋŋa, nuru kpioŋŋoa? Ka boan nyiŋ ate fi a kasim a kuulim danni meena po? Wen ŋmanteka a kasim boro kama danni meena.

ref: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
text: Fi giŋgeluŋku a ta ka yik kaasika. Ku a dɛ ka nna polipoli ase poniŋ la. Fi a tom ka pimpaasima tuima.

ref: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
text: Fi a yaali ka biem a gaam nalim. Fi a yaali venta a gaam wensie kama.

ref: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
text: Velimvendiga, fi a yaali ka wie ŋaai ale ta daanika a jam la.

ref: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
text: Chekki, Wen ale lɔnsi fu tɛŋ, ate fi kan ŋman yiti ŋmai ya. Wa le laari chiak a yik fu cheeri a nyini fi viuku po. Wa le voori fu a ta nyini ŋanvutaŋa tɛŋka po.

ref: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
text: Wayɔrisima nyama ale nya abe ba chali yɔgsum, ba le la wa a weeni ayen,

ref: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
text: <<Nuruwa ale nna yɔgyɔgla, waai ale kan pa Wen ate wa chim wa pagrim, alege goanti a ta sebchakka ale wa jigsika la, ale nya pagrim a kaasi nuruba.

ref: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
text: Alege mi a nye ase ka tiib maŋ ale a chim Wen yenni po la. M ta sebchakka ale Wen ŋmanteka kama taam wuu.

ref: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
text: Mi le pak Fu taam wuu dii ate fi nye la nyiŋ. M le ta yiila Fi yuenni nyiŋ, dii nyiŋla Fi yuenni a nala kama. M le pak fu Fi nuruma niŋ.

ref: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
text: Beruk ale a weeni wa suinum po ayen, <<Wen karo.>> Ba daa wensie nyam, ba ta ka gaasa nyeela. Waai karo a nye wamaŋŋa.

ref: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
text: Wen a bo ka wenŋmazuk a nya saalɔ bisaŋa ase waai a boro a miŋ ya, yaase waai boro a gisi Wen yaa.

ref: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
text: Waai meena a cheem ka kpai a te, ba meena ka nuru kaasinta, nuru ka ba po a tom wamaŋŋa, nuru yeŋ mɛ la ka.

ref: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
text: Nuru baataŋa dek a kan yaali ayen ba maa zamsi moa, baai ale a ko nuruba a ŋɔbi ase ba ale a ŋɔbi boroborok diila ale kan a wi Wen la?

ref: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
text: Dula jigini yɔgsum ale jam yik ba, juijui ale kan magsi ayen ba yɔgsa la. Wen ale kati baai ale a kpaliŋ ale fu la kobaŋa a waaŋ. Fi pa ba a nyo chivie po dii nyiŋla, Wen zɛri ba kama.

ref: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
text: Be te ate varibasika a nyini Zayon a jam te Izirali demma! Wen a dan ŋman pa wa nuruma zumasuku a te ba, basi ate Jekob a dɛ masim abe Izirali sui a peenti.

ref: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
text: Fi yuenni nyiŋ, Wen yaa vari mu a basi, pai fi pagrimu a tuesi mu a basi.

ref: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
text: Wen wom m puusa, wom wieŋa ale nyini m nɔnni po a nyini la.

ref: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
text: Nicham ale cheena ayen ba ta chaab ale mu, nuru baata ale kisi m nyuvunni ale baai ale kan a chali Wen la, ale a yaali ayen ba ko mu.

ref: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
text: Alege Wen ka m maarɔ, ka Nyɔnɔwa ale a maari mu.

ref: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
text: Basi ate biem a viriŋ a ji baai ale velim a te mu la. Fi wensieŋa nyiŋ kaasi ba.

ref: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
text: M le ta m dek mariŋka tiirim a jam nye kaabka a te fu, Naawen yaa, m le pak Fi yuenni dii nyiŋla di nala kama.

ref: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
text: Wa vari mu m daanika po a basi, ale ŋman basi ate midek nina a nya m dachaasaŋa ate fi nak ba ate ba chali waaŋ chaab la.

ref: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
text: Wom m puusa, Wen yaa, kan zɛri m le a saalim a yaali maarika.

ref: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
text: Wom abe fi tulisi mu. M popolaŋa a daani mu kama a ta mu a cheŋ yesiŋsa po.

ref: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
text: Kpazinagsuk ale bo m suinum po, kum yɔgsum a baga mu.

ref: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
text: Yɔgsum ale kpazinagsuk ale yik mu. Nyinyigsa ale nya pagrim m zuk.

ref: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
text: <<A dan pai kinkaŋŋa a te mu ase nangbaŋ la, m te le yiri a cheŋ niŋ a ga vuusi.

ref: I would go and live in some distant desert.
text: M ti ni yiri a cheŋ niŋniŋa a ga bo sagni po a vuusi.

ref: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
text: M le kpabi kama a ta m dek a ga lirim, lirimka dek jigi ate vamuniŋka ale nanpansaŋa a ka nya mu.>>

ref: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
text: Nyɔnɔ, butim gaasa nyama abe fi labi ba biisaŋa, dii nyiŋla m nya ale ka varuk ale kpaliŋ ale bo tɛŋka po.

ref: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
text: Kantueŋ ale yok meena ba gu gilim ba tɛŋka parisaŋa kama. Gaasa ale tuim kaasima ale bo ka po.

ref: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
text: Yik kaasirɔba ale bo tɛŋka po a kaasi a cheŋ, nyinyigsa ale venta ale kasim sueri ka po.

ref: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
text: Dan ka m dachiak ale a lɛ mu nna, m te le baga pik. Dan ka m kaasirɔ ale a fuusi a jueli m zuk nna, m te le suk ate wa kan nya mu.

ref: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
text: Alege fi, ka nuru ase mi la, m vaanchoa, m dek doa mabiik,

ref: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
text: waai ate mi ale wa a jam dɛ masim ale chaab la ase ti nyiem ale va chaab a cheŋ Wen yenni po a puusi la.

ref: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
text: Basi ate kum a jam diiri m dachaasaŋa a pa ba a ta cheŋ. Basi ate ba siŋ vɔrup ase ba ale vua la. Dii nyiŋla biem ale kasim bo ale ba.

ref: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
text: Alege mi ale wi Wen ate Naawen a vari mu a basi.

ref: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
text: Saluik ale kantueŋ ale junɔi m kaari a wi Wen ate Wa a wom m lueluku.

ref: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
text: Wen dii ale kasim kala wa naamu zuk taam wuu la, ale wom ba abe wa namsi ba. Nuru baai ale kan maari a tagri ba suita a kan chali Wen yɔgsum la.

ref: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
text: Wa biika a saala ka nna bɔlibɔli ase kpaam la, alege wa suinummu po, wa ka kpaliŋ kpaliŋdɔ, wa nɔi po wie a saala a gaam kpaŋiak alege ŋa ka gebik a gebi nuruba.

ref: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
text: Pa fi wadaanimaŋa a te Naawen ale wa le lik fu a tara. Wa kan basi ate wayɔrisima nyama a lɔ.

ref: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
text: Alege Fi, Wen yaa, ale basi ate gaasa nyama a siŋ vɔrup kaasuŋku po. Nuru baai ale a yaali ayen ziim a nyini la ale velimvendisa a kan paari ba daaŋa geli ya. Alege dan ka mi, m le ta sebchakka ale fu.

ref: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
text: Yɔgsum a dan ta mu, m le ta sebchakka ale ka fi.

ref: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
text: Wen dii wie ate mi a pak la, m ta sebchakka ale Wa kama, m kan chali yɔgsummoa. Nuru a baga mu a nye ka boa?

ref: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
text: Danni meena ba a labri m nɔi po wie. Ba a gomsi kama ayen ba daani mu.

ref: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
text: Ba jam ka jigi yeŋ ayen ba kpesi a nya m naŋ zakka meena, a yaali ayen ba ko mu.

ref: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
text: Wen yaa, kan basi ate ba yuli bɛ. Pa Fi suipuurum a ko tɛŋ sila demma meena.

ref: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
text: Ŋmarisi m kumsaŋa a dueni. Ŋmarisi a nyo Fi gbaŋka, Fi poom ŋmarisi a dueni ya?

ref: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
text: Ate m dachaasaŋa ale yiti a chali ase m nin wi ayen fi maari mu. Kude ale basi ate m seba ayen ka Wen ale soa mu.

ref: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
text: M ta sebchakka ale ka Wen. M kan chali yɔgsummoa. Nuru ale baga nye mu ka boa?

ref: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
text: Wen yaa, m puulim kama ale Fu. M le ta m jiam tiiritaŋa a jam te Fu.

ref: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
text: Dii nyiŋla, Fi vari mu kum po a basi ale basi ate m kan ja. Dila yaa basi kama ate m baga a paari Wen niŋ ŋanvutaŋa tɛŋka po.

ref: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
text: Wen yaa, ta jiirim ale mu, ta jiirim ale mu, dii nyiŋla ka Fi po ate m chiika a nya sukka jigi. M le suk m dek ka Fi kinkaŋŋa yisuŋku po a ta paari diipo ate kaasuŋ a taam la.

ref: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
text: Wa kali ka wenŋmazuk a tom ayen wa vari mu a basi. Wa a toariŋ baai ale a vi mu nna tuituili la, Wen a tom wa ŋmanteka ale wa wensieŋa.

ref: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
text: M bo ka gbeŋma suŋsuŋ. Mi a goa ale ka duŋ sii ale a ŋɔbi nuruba la, nuru baai nyina ale a nye ase gbatta ale piema la. Ba giŋgeluŋtaŋa a saasi ase ka gebik woŋsa la.

ref: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
text: Wen yaa, be nya zak zaanika a gaam wenŋmazukku. Basi ate Fi zulaŋa a bo tɛŋka meena zuk.

ref: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
text: Ba yuk ka ŋmiak a basi m naŋsa po. M dua ka tɛŋ ale ninam. Ba daam tu ka goluk ayen m lo du, alege badek a tulim lɔ ku po.

ref: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
text: M suinummu za ka nna giŋgiŋ, Wen yaa. M suinummu za ka giŋgiŋ. M ni lenni yiila a pak Fu.

ref: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
text: M chiiga, vaari yiti ŋmai, kpanuŋ ale baganiŋ, ni vaari yiti ŋmai. M le nak saluiku a yiti.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
text: M le pak fu, m Nyɔnɔ, tɛŋsaŋa po. M le siak yiila a seni fu nuruma suŋsuŋ.

ref: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
text: Diila fi ŋmanteka a zuak kama, a jueli a gaam wenzukku, fi wensieŋa a jueli paari chiŋmaaŋa.

ref: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
text: Mi a zak fi yuenni ŋmai, Wen yaa, a gaam wenzukku, be te fi zulaŋa a tagli tɛŋka meena.

ref: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
text: Nama nalima, ni a biisi wensie moa? Ni a bɔ nuruba buusa chekki?

ref: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
text: Ba nyeka a nye ase ka wiiga yaam la, ba yik ba tueŋa a kpari ase ka jinkpaŋ,

ref: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
text: kaai ale ka a wom sampoporik wiik la, wa dan poom ta yam diidii ya.

ref: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
text: Wen yaa voori ba nyinaŋa. Wen yaa, gbegri gbeŋmaŋa nyin woŋtaŋa.

ref: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
text: Basi ate ba nye ase kunkoluk ale a cheŋ ale nyaliŋ a bɛ la, ase nipok ale nak lɔgi a basi ate biika an maa nya wenbinni la.

ref: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
text: Wayɔrisima nyama sue ale peenti ase ba le nya ale Wen a boro a namsi nuru baataŋa. Ase ba nin pa gaasa nyama ziim a sugri ba naŋsaŋa.

ref: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
text: Nuruma ale weeni ayen, <<Chekki, wayɔrisima nyama a nya ba tutuna. Chekki, Wen sum boro a bɔ tɛŋka demma buusa.>>

ref: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
text: Vari mu nuru baata nisima po a basi, abe fi vari mu nuru koorisa nisima po a basi.

ref: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
text: Naawen yaa, nya ba le lɔ a gu dua a limisi mu la, nuru koorisaŋa a nye ka nɔiyeŋ ayen ba ko mu. M be an kaasi ba wari ya.

ref: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
text: Mi an kaasi wari ya, alege ba gomsi kpaliŋ nyeka ale mu. Yiti a wom mu abe fi maari mu.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
text: Naawen yaa, Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni, vaari yiti a namsi tɛŋ baataŋa. Kan ta jiirim ale gaasa nuru baai ale a bobri la.

ref: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
text: Ba ŋman pilim a jam ka junɔi geŋ a ŋuuni a gilim tɛŋka ase baasa la.

ref: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
text: Nya dii ale nyini ba noaŋa po a nyini la, ba biika ka gebisa, ate ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka wana ale a wom ti?>>

ref: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
text: Alege Naawen yaa, fi kala a la ba kama. Fi a nye tɛŋ sila meena a la kama.

ref: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
text: M Pagrɔ, mi zak a nya ka fi, Wen yaa, ka fi ale m yepagrik,

ref: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
text: Alege ti Nyɔnɔ ale ti ligrɔ, kan ko ba. Dii nyiŋla fi dan ko ba, mi nuruma ale baŋ. Pai fi pagrimu a nye ate ba nyiem gilim jigi meena, abe fi yaa ge basi ate ba siŋ tɛŋ.

ref: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
text: pai fi suipuurumu a kaasi ba. Kaasi ba meena ate ba waai a kan ŋman boro. Ate tɛŋka meena a miŋ ayen ka Wen ale soa Jekob zuk a nya.

ref: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
text: Ba ŋman pilim a jam ka junɔi geŋ a ŋuuni a gilim tɛŋka ase baasa la.

ref: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
text: Ba a gilim jigi meena a tuilum ŋandiinta ale a ŋaasi ase baai ale kan chak la.

ref: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
text: Alege mi le lenni yiila a magsi chaab ale Fi pagrimu, saluik po m le lenni yiila a magsi chaab ale Fi ŋmanteka. Dii nyiŋla, ka Fi ale m yepagrik ale m sukka jigi ase m nin bo daanika po.

ref: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
text: M le lenni pimpauk yiila a te m Pagrɔwa. M ŋmanteka Wen yaa, ka Fi ale m yepagrik.

ref: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
text: Wen yaa, Fi zɛri ti kama ale ŋman sak Fi suipuurumu ti zuk. Fi sui a puuri ale ti alege yɔgyɔgla de be ŋman tuesi ti.

ref: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
text: Fi choa tɛŋka kama ale yik ka a nak mobi lagri. Be ŋman lik ka muulisaŋa dii nyiŋla ka a choa kama.

ref: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
text: Fi basi ate ku pagra a te ti. Fi te ti daam ate ti nyu ate ku nye ate ti a ja.

ref: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
text: Fi pai ka tikti a te baai ale a chali fu la, ayen ba zak a sak wensieŋa nyiŋ.

ref: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
text: Vari ti a basi abe fi maari ti ale fi Juga nisaŋa, ate baai Fi a yaali la a nya varibasika.

ref: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
text: Wen a biisi wa dɔkku po ayen, <<Pagrim po m le poori Sikiim abe m pai Sukkot Viaka a chari m nuruma.

ref: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
text: Gilead ka Mi ale soa. Manasa ka Mi ale soa. Ɛfraim ka Mi kuta zukchin. Juda Mi tachek,

ref: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
text: Moab ka Mi chin narinni, Edom zuk Mi tɔŋ m nuensiri, Filistia zuk Mi kaari ale nakdeka.>>

ref: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
text: Ka wana ale wa ta mi jam tɛŋ kaai ale ta parik pagrisaŋa la? Ka wana ale wa dɛ mi niŋ a ta mu cheŋ Edom?

ref: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
text: Te ti maarika ate ti tu dachiaka, ale nurubiik maarika a ka kiri ya.

ref: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
text: Wen nyiŋ ti nya pagrim, ate wa lɔnsi ti dachaasaŋa tɛŋ.

ref: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
text: Wen yaa, wom m kaarika ale m puusaŋa.

ref: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
text: A nyini tɛŋka kpeglimka, mi wi fu kama ate m suinummu a ga jiak. Ta mu a cheŋ piuŋ kuui ale wɔŋa a gaam mu la.

ref: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
text: Fi ale m sukka jigi ate m dan chali a jɔ, m dachaasaŋa an baga a paari mu.

ref: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
text: Mi a yaali kama ayen m kasim boka fi viuku po taam wuu, abe m suk m dek fi kinkaŋŋa po.

ref: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
text: Wen yaa, fi wom m le puulim la kama, ate fi pai baai ale a chali fi yuenni la nitalimu a te mi.

ref: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
text: Gum daa yegayega du a te naawa, basi ate wa benaŋa a paari gaŋsa yegayega.

ref: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
text: Wa abe kasim a bo wa naamu po Wen niŋ taam wuu. Basi ate fi ŋmanteka ale fi wensieŋa a nya wa zuk.

ref: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
text: Dila yaa le basi ate m lenni yiila a pak fi yuenni, abe danni po meena m nye m le puulim ayen m nye diila.

ref: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
text: Wen nyiini jigi ate m chiika a gisi a nya vuusum. M varibasika a nyini ka wala jigi.

ref: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
text: Wala nyiini ale m piuŋ ale m varibasidɔ. Wa ka m yepagrik, ate m nyiŋ a kan gɔgi.

ref: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
text: Ba a pii ka nyiŋ ayen ba nye ate wa jɔk wa zulaŋa. Venta a chim ka masim a te ba. Ba pai ba noaŋa a biisi ka niaka wie, alege a nyini ba suiniimaŋa po, ka kikaasa wie ale boro.

ref: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
text: M chiiga, be nye diki a limisi Wen nyiini. M yiila a nyini ka wala jigi.

ref: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
text: Wa nyiini ale m piuŋ ale m varibasidɔ. Wa ka m yepagrik ate m nyiŋ a kan gɔgi.

ref: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
text: M varibasika ale m zula a nyini ka Wen jigi. Wa ka m piuŋ kpajiak ale m sukka jigi.

ref: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
text: Nuruba, ni ta sebchakka ale wa diipo meena. Ni pai ni suiniimaŋa a te wa, ale ka Wen ale ti sukka jigi.

ref: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
text: Nuru fiisa a daa jaaboa alege ba a nye ase ka nuru koruta la, ate nuru kpienta mɛ daa jaaboa. Ba meena a ka kiri ya ase fi nin magsi ba. Ba meena ka kinla.

ref: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
text: Kan ta sebchakka ale varuwa, yaase fi ta kanjanta ale zum ŋanta. Fi dan poom jigsi yegayega, kan pai fi suinum a dueni fi ŋantaŋa zuwa.

ref: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
text: Wen a weeni ka wayeŋ, m be wom ka wie ŋaye ayen, Fi Wen yaa, fi pagra kama,

ref: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
text: ale ŋman wom mɛ ayen Nyɔnɔ, fi ta ŋmanteka. Chekki, fi le tuni waai meena a magsi chaab ale wa ale tom diila.

ref: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
text: Wen yaa, ka fi ale m Wen, mi a gisi fu ale ninmuna. M chiika a yaali fu ase ka nyanyuila ale ta mu diila, ate m nyiŋka a gisi fu, a nyini tɛŋ kosik kaai ate nyiam a karo la po.

ref: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
text: M nya fu, fi weleŋsa boka jigini, ale ŋman nya fi pagrimu ale fi zulaŋa ale soa diila.

ref: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
text: Fi ŋmanteka ale gaam nyuvuri la nyiŋ, m nɔngbanni ale pak fu.

ref: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
text: M le diem vua la, m le kasim a pak fu, fi yuenni nyiŋ m le zak m nisa wen.

ref: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
text: M chiika ale chak ase ŋandiinta ate m dɛ ate ku paari mu diila. M pai m nɔngbanvaataŋa a lenni yiila a pak fu.

ref: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
text: M le doa m tiaka po la m teeri ka fi wie. Yɔkku meena m kasim doa a poli ka fi wie nyiini.

ref: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
text: Fi le ka m maamaarɔ la nyiŋ, m jo suk a doa ka fi kiŋkaŋŋa po a lenni yiila.

ref: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
text: M chiika a kpari maŋ fu kama. Fi a juga nisaŋa mɛ a yik mu a tara.

ref: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
text: Baai ale kisi m nyuvunni la ale kaasi. Ba ale siŋ tɛŋka a jo vɔrup limisiku po.

ref: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
text: Ba dachaasaŋa ale pai gebisa a ko ba a dueni, ate ba chim ŋandiinta a te gɔi baasa.

ref: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
text: Alege naawa ale dɛ masim a nyini Wen jigi. Ate baai meena ale pɛ Wen yuenni nyiŋla ale pak wa, alege velimvendisa noaŋa ale maali.

ref: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
text: Wen yaa, wom mu ase m le lak m lueluku a fɔbili la. Lik m nyuvunni a nyini dachiaka nyinyigsaŋa po.

ref: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
text: Pai mu suk nyini gaasa nyɔnɔwa popola baataŋa jigi ale nuru baataŋa nuemka po.

ref: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
text: Ba saasi ba giŋgeluŋtaŋa ase ka gebik woŋsa la, ate ba nɔngbaaŋa po wieŋa mɛ ase pein yaama la.

ref: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
text: Ba a te chaab nyiŋbiiri a va chaab ale ba popola baataŋa, ba a biisi ka ba battaŋa suk barika wie. Ba a weeni kama ayen ka wana ale wa nya ti?

ref: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
text: Ba a poli ka biem wie ale a weeni ayen, ti poli ka wamaŋ. Chekki, nuru popola ale wa suinum a sueri ale ka pimpaasima.

ref: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
text: Alege Wen ale tɔŋ ba ale peema. Ba ga a nya la ale ba kɔni kama.

ref: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
text: Yɔgsum ale yik nuru meena. Ba ale mooli Wen tuimaŋa wie, abe ba poli wa ale nye diila.

ref: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
text: Basi ate wayɔrisima nyam a dɛ masim Naawen jigi, abe ba suk badek wa jigi. Te ate baai suiniima ale nala la a pak wa.

ref: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
text: Wen yaa, pimpauk a bo Zayon a limisi fu. Ti le nye ti ale puulim diila a te fu.

ref: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
text: Fi waai a ni a wom puusa la, nuru meena a cheen ka fi jigi.

ref: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
text: Wabaata ale jam gilim ti la, fi jam vɔŋ ti nye kaasika a te ti kama.

ref: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
text: Suipeentik a bo ale baai ate fi a lueri la, ale ta ba jam moata ayen ba bo fi dabaasaŋa po. Ti chak kama ale fi yenni wamaŋsaŋa, ale fi weleŋsa yenni.

ref: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
text: Ti Varibasidɔ Wen yaa, fi pa ka wayɔrisima tuima a tulisi ti, ate tɛŋka kpeglimka meena ale nyakpiemu a ni doa a yalima a soa diila yiila meena a boka fi zuk,

ref: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
text: fi ale nye guutaŋa ale fi pagrimu ale gomsi fidek ale pagrim a za a magsi kpaliŋ.

ref: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
text: Baai ale bo juijui ate ku yalima la, a yɔgsa ale fi wakinkaglaŋa kama. Ta nyini wenbinni pusika a ta ga paari siŋka, fi a wi a yaali ka masim yiila.

ref: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
text: Fi a nya tɛŋka zuk kama ale a zaŋti ka ale nyiam. Fi basi ate ŋandiinta a nye nalimnyiini ka zuk. Wen beli naŋsaŋa a sueri ale ka nyiam ayen nuruma a nya ŋandiinta, ka fi ale weeni ayen dii a nye la, ale la.

ref: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
text: Fi tagli tɛŋka ale ka nyiam ale chalisi ka kunkutimaŋa a soa si chaab la. Fi pai fi ŋmorukku a zaŋti ka ate ka baasa ale niak ka ŋanborintaŋa.

ref: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
text: Fi basi ate benni a nala ale basi ate ŋandiinta a boro nna yegayega.

ref: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
text: Piisa ale bo wuuku po a dɛ, ate ŋandiinta a piisi vaasaŋa po. Ba a nye ka masim nuemka ale a yi yiila.

ref: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
text: Tɛŋka meena, ni nye masim nuemka a te Wen.

ref: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
text: Ni lenni wa zulaŋa yuenni yiila. Ni nye ate wa pimpaukku a ta zula.

ref: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
text: Ni weeni Wen ayen, Wa tuimaŋa ka tuimkperikaliisa. Fi pagrimu a zuak ate dila basi ate fi dachaasaŋa nyiŋsa a gɔk fi niŋ.

ref: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
text: Ni jam nya Wen ale tom diila, wa ale nye wakinkagla ŋaai a te nuruba la.

ref: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
text: Wa labri nyakpiemu ate bu chim tɛŋ kosik, ate ba cheŋ naŋsa nyiamu suŋsuŋ a taam, ni be jam ate ti dɛ masim wa jigi.

ref: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
text: Wa ta ka wa pagrimu a dɛ wa naamu, ate wa ninaŋa a nya tɛŋsaŋa, be kan te ate baai ale a yaali kpaliŋsa nyeka la a yiti ŋmai ya.

ref: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
text: Nuruba, ni pak ti Wenni, ni basi ate ba wom wa pimpaukku nuemka.

ref: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
text: Wa lik ti nyuvooŋa kama ale an basi ate ti naŋsa a tabi a sati.

ref: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
text: Wen yaa, fi chamsi ti kama, a pai ti nyo bolim po a soti ti ase kpana la.

ref: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
text: Fi ta ti kama a jam likka dɔk po ale ŋman pai jibta a vi ti ŋaaŋsaŋa zuk.

ref: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
text: Fi basi ate nuruba a va ti zuima zuk a taam. Ti va bolim ale nyiam po a taam, alege fi ta ti kama a ŋman jam kauk kuui ate ŋanta yegayega a boro la.

ref: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
text: M le jam fi yenni po ale juka tiirita abe m nye m le puulim dii a ni fi la,

ref: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
text: M le kaab duŋ sii ale biigi la a te fu ale tiirim padaasa. M le te fu lalisa ale bua.

ref: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
text: Ni jam wom, nama baai ale a chali Wen la. Ni basi ate m weeni ni wa le nye dii a te mi la.

ref: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
text: Mi pai m nɔnni kama a kaari a wi wa. Wa pimpauk ale jam bo m giŋgeluŋ zuk.

ref: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
text: Ase m dan ta wabiok m suinummu po, Nyɔnɔwa ate an wom ya,

ref: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
text: alege Wen a sum wom kama, ale wom m lueluku puusa po.

ref: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
text: Pimpauk abe bo Wen jigi, waai ale kan zɛri m puusa yaase wa peri wa ŋmanteka a nyini m jigi la.

ref: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
text: Wen abe ta jiirim ale ti abe wa niak ti, abe wa nye ate wa nimbidiaka a nyaksi ti zuk,

ref: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
text: ate nuruba ale miŋ fi suitaŋa tɛŋka zuk, abe tɛŋ kpieŋsa mɛ ale seba fi varibasika wieŋa.

ref: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
text: Wen yaa, nuruma abe sum a pak fu. Nuruba meena abe te ate pimpauk a paari fu.

ref: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
text: Ate tɛŋka a yaa zaani ŋandiinta ate ti che, ate Wen, tama Wenni yaa le niak ti.

ref: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
text: Wen le niak ti, ate waai meena ale bo tɛŋka zuk la a ni chali wa.

ref: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
text: Basi ate Wen vaari yiti ŋmai, ate wa dachaasaŋa a waaŋ chaab. Te ate wa kisidɔma a yiti cheŋ bɛ wa niŋ.

ref: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
text: Fuk ba a basi, ase viok ale a fuk nyuisa a basi diila. Ase samparima ale a nyaliŋ bolim po diila, te ate gaasa nyama a kpi Wen niŋ.

ref: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
text: Ni lenni yiila a te Wen, ni lenni yiila a seni wa yuenni, ni pak waai ale dɔ chiŋmaaŋa la, wa yuenni ale Naawen, ni abe a dɛ masim wa niŋ.

ref: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
text: Wa ka kpiŋsa ko, ale ŋman chim waai ale a maari pukɔga, wa ka Wen dii ale bo wa weleŋsa jigini.

ref: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
text: Wen a yaali ka dɔkdem a te baai ale ka badek ba nyiini la, wa abe ŋman a dɛ baai ate ba lik ba la niŋ ale ka yiila yika. Alege tukpari nyama a ni bo ka kantueŋ tɛŋ po.

ref: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
text: Wen yaa, ase fi ale nyini a dɛ nuruma niŋ la, fi ale gɔk santiri a va tɛŋ kaai ale doa kinla la,

ref: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
text: tɛŋka a choa kama, ate wenzukku a lak ate ŋmoruk a siŋ, Wen niŋ, Waai ale soa Sinai la, Wen niŋ, Izirali Wenni.

ref: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
text: Fi nuruma ale kali ka po, Wen yaa, fi ale te ŋanjaksa a ta nyini fi yegayega po.

ref: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
text: Nyɔnɔwa a mooli wa wanni, ate baai ale chɔgsi a biisi di la a piisi,

ref: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
text: <<Nalima ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba a chali nna nwuli, ŋan baai ate ba kɔlim ba viitaŋa po la, ba pai chari chaab.

ref: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
text: Ni le dua bottaŋa suŋsuŋ a goa la, mi nangbaŋka kiŋkaŋŋa a lik ale ka kpana, ka kɔbtaŋa a lik ale ka ligmɔniŋ kaai ale a nyaksi la.>>

ref: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
text: Wen Dii Ale A Niak La ale waaŋ tɛŋka nalimaŋa la, ku jam nye ase ka ŋmoruk tana ale a lo Zalmon zuk la.

ref: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
text: Basan guutaŋa a nala kama, ti abe bo ka wen nna yegayega.

ref: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
text: Wen wusuma torokoma ka tusa piisa ale tusa tusa. Nyɔnɔwa a nyini ka Sinai a jam wa dɔkku po.

ref: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
text: Fi a ni jueli wenŋmazuk la, fi dɛ ka ligrɔba niŋ. Fi tuesi ka tiirita nuruba jigi, baai ale poom ka a wom fi nɔi la, ayen fi Naawen dii ale ka Wen la yaa be le bo dula.

ref: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
text: Pimpauk abe bo Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Wen ti Varibasidɔwa waai ale a ji ti jibtaŋa daa meena la.

ref: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
text: Chekki Wen ale ŋɔriŋ wa dachaasaŋa zuima, baai ale ta naam zuisa zutɔksa a kasim nye biem a cheŋ la.

ref: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
text: Nyɔnɔwa a weeni ayen, <<M le ta ba nyini Basan a jam. M le ta ba nyini nyakpiemu liuŋku po a jam,

ref: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
text: ate ni pai ni naŋsaŋa a lusi ni dachaasaŋa ziimu po, ate ni baasaŋa giŋgeluŋtaŋa mɛ a nya ti charuk.>>

ref: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
text: Wen yaa, fi chelimu a nyini ka peelim, mi Wenni ale m Naawa ale cheŋ a jo wa weleŋsa bo ka jigini po la a nyini peelim kama.

ref: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
text: Yi yiirisaŋa ale dɛ ba niŋ, ate ŋannagrisa a bo ba ŋaaŋ, ate nipokbilisa a bo ale ba a nak sinyaksa.

ref: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
text: Pak Wen tigsuŋ kpioŋku suŋsuŋ. Pak Naawen Izirali demma tigsuŋku suŋsuŋ.

ref: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
text: Benjamin buuni ale fiisa la ale la, a dɛ ba niŋ ale Juda nabisaŋa ale ka nuru boari, ate Zebulun ale Nafitali nabisaŋa mɛ a pa vi.

ref: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
text: Fi yenni ale bo Jerusalem la nyiŋ, nalima ale ta tiirita a jam te fu.

ref: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
text: Toariŋ gɔi duŋsaŋa ale bo wuwoŋtaŋa po la, ale lalisaŋa ale bo tɛŋsaŋa naabisaŋa po la. Yik m dek, ale ta kpana sandaa a jam. Basi ate tɛŋ sii ale a yaali kpaliŋ la a waaŋ chaab.

ref: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
text: Nuruba ale tom chaab ŋaaŋ a nyini Ejipiti jam. Kus ale siak pai wadek a te Wen.

ref: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
text: Tɛŋzuk dɛ tɛŋsa ate nalima a soa si la lenni yiila a te Wen, ni lenni yiila a pak Nyɔnɔwa,

ref: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
text: waai ale do dipo wenzuk chiŋmaaŋa la, waai ale a na ale lueluk pagrik la.

ref: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
text: Ni mooli Wen pagrimu. Waai ate wa pagrim a bo Izirali zuk la, ate wa pagrimu a bo chiŋmaaŋa po la.

ref: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
text: Wen yaa, fi potim ta zula kama fi weleŋsa bo ka jigini po. Izirali Wenni a te wa nuruma ka pagrim ale nyiŋ pagra. Pimpauk a cheŋ Wen jigi.

ref: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
text: Wen yaa, vari mu a basi, a ni nyiamu a paari ka m ŋiri.

ref: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
text: M siŋ a feri a za ka bag tii ale limisa la po, juijui ate m naŋtaataŋa a kan nya jaab zuk a zaani la. M yaa cheŋ paari ka nya liuŋtaŋa po. Nyaataŋa a mobi gilim mu.

ref: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
text: M jiak kama ale m ni wi a yaali maarika la. M tutɔkku a kɔ a nye ka nira. M ninaŋa an ŋman baga a gisi m Wenni.

ref: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
text: Baai ale kisi mu kinla nyiŋla, a piisi a gaamu m zukku zuisaŋa kama. M dachiak sii ale a gisi mu ayen ba kaasi mu alege mi an kaasi daa tuini la a piisi kama. Ba fɛ mu ate mi a tuni ŋanti baai ate mi an zu la.

ref: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
text: Wen yaa, fi poom seba mi berinni nɔi po kama. M kan suk m nye kaasuŋku ale fu.

ref: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
text: Fi nyiŋ mi siak kama ayen ba nye mu la, ate chivie a lik m nimbidiaka.

ref: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
text: M ka nichaanɔ m dek suata jigi, mi dek mabisaŋa a pai mu chim ka nyiem jam doa.

ref: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
text: Fi yenni wie nyiini ale bo m suinum po a dɛ nna ase bolim la, ate baai ale a le fu la, leetaŋa a siŋ ka mi zuk.

ref: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
text: Ase m dan boro a kum ale a zɛri ŋandiinta, nuruba a ŋman nye mu a la.

ref: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
text: M dan pai garuk woŋ a jo, nuruba a nye mu a la kama.

ref: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
text: Baai ale kali nansuiŋku la a nye mu a la kama, ate m yaa chim yiili a te danyuirisa.

ref: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
text: Naawen yaa, m puusi a te fu, diipo ale magsi la. A nyini fi ŋmante kaai ale zuak la nyiŋ, Wen yaa, tulisi mu ale fi sebchakka varibasika.

ref: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
text: Vari mu bagtaŋa po a basi, kan te ti m siŋ du, vari mu baai ale kisi mu la jigi a basi, abe fi yeeri mu nya liuŋtaŋa po a basi.

ref: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
text: Kan basi ate nya tii ale mobi la a lik mu, yaase nya liuŋtaŋa a lim mu, yaase golukku a lik mu basi du.

ref: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
text: Naawen yaa, fi ŋmante kaai ale nala la nyiŋ tulisi mu. Fi jiirim kpiemu nyiŋ cheem m jigi.

ref: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
text: Kan cheem fi nina a basi jigi yoŋ abe fi ge fi yɔmawa a basi. Tulisi mu nwuli, dii nyiŋla m bo ka daanika po.

ref: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
text: Fi seba ba le valiŋ mu la kama, a nyo mu chivie po ate chivie ta mu, m dachaasaŋa meena a bo ka fi niŋ.

ref: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
text: Ba pai ka ŋantuasa a nyo m ŋandiintaŋa po ale pai kaam a te mu ayen m nyu m nyanyuilaŋa nyiŋ.

ref: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
text: Ŋandiin tii ate ba pai zaani ba niŋ la a chim baruk. Ŋa abe chim namsika ale baruk.

ref: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
text: Basi ate fi suipuurumu a siŋ ba zuk, basi ate fi suipuurumu a jam pai ba a ta cheŋ.

ref: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
text: Basi ate ba boka jigini a duak koruk. Kan te ate nuru a kali ba viitaŋa po.

ref: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
text: Ba a namsi baai ate fi a te ba mula la ale biisi baai ate fi a daani ba la nyiŋdommaŋa la wie.

ref: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
text: Bo a mini ba, a pilim a bo mini ba. Kan te ba ma a nya fi varibasika.

ref: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
text: Ko ba yueŋa nyuvuri gbaŋka po a basi, kan pai ba a gum wayɔrisima nyama po.

ref: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
text: M nyiŋ ale a dom ate ninam mɛ a paari mu. Wen yaa, basi ate fi varibasika a lik mu a tanla.

ref: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
text: M le lenni yiila a pak Wen yuenni abe m pai jiam teka a zuli wa.

ref: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
text: Nya kude ale peenti Naawen sui a gaam lalik kpaaŋ, a gaam lalik ale yiila ale naŋsaba.

ref: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
text: Ŋanjaksa ale nya ate ba sue a peenti, nama baai ale a gisi Wen la, ni suiniima abe kali nalimnyiini.

ref: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
text: Naawen a wom baai ale a silim la kumsa kama, wa abe kan zɛri wa nuru baai ate baa yik ba a ta la.

ref: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
text: Basi ate wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋka ale nyakpiemu ale jaabuuri meena ale bo bu po a cheŋ la a pak wa,

ref: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
text: dii nyiŋla, Wen ale vari Zayon a basi, abe wa ŋman sɛ Juda tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa. Ate nuruba ale kali si po abe ba soa si.

ref: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
text: Wa tomteerɔma bisa ale soa si, ate baai ale ta yaalika ale wa yuenni la, ale kali dula.

ref: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
text: Baai meena ale a gisi ayen ba yeeri mi nyuvunni la a jo chivie ale butimka po, baai meena ale a yaali mi kaasuŋ la a viriŋ a cheŋ ale chivie.

ref: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
text: Baai ale a nye mi a la la, yɔgsum yik ba badek chivieŋa po.

ref: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
text: Alege baai meena ale a gisi fu la sue ale peenti ale fu, baai meena ale a yaali fi varibasika la a kasim a weeni kama ayen, <<Wenni yuenni abe yiti.>>

ref: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
text: Alege mi jaŋ kama a yaali maarika. Wen yaa, nye a wuli a jam m jigi. Fi ka m maarɔ ale m varibasidɔ. Naawen yaa, kan beni.

ref: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
text: Baai meena ale a gisi ayen ba yeeri mi nyuvunni la a jo chivie ale butimka po, baai meena ale a yaali mi kaasuŋ la a viriŋ a cheŋ ale chivie.

ref: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
text: Baai ale a nye mi a la la, yɔgsum yik ba badek chivieŋa po.

ref: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
text: Alege baai meena ale a gisi fu la sue ale peenti ale fu, baai meena ale a yaali fi varibasika la a kasim a weeni kama ayen, <<Wenni yuenni abe yiti.>>

ref: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
text: Alege mi jaŋ kama a yaali maarika. Wen yaa, nye a wuli a jam m jigi. Fi ka m maarɔ ale m varibasidɔ. Naawen yaa, kan beni.

ref: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
text: Ka fi po, Naawen yaa, ate m suk m dek, kan te chivie a yik mu.

ref: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
text: Pai fi wayɔrisimaŋa a vari mu a basi. Te fi tunni a wom mu, abe fi vari mu a basi.

ref: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
text: Chim piuŋ a lik mu, chim ase kpaliŋ yeri dii ale pagra la a vari mu a basi. Dii nyiŋla fi ale m piuŋ ale m yepagrik.

ref: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
text: M Wen yaa, yeeri mu a nyini gaasa nyam nisima po a basi, abe fi kan te biem ale ninpagra nyam a paari mu a yigi.

ref: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
