text: M Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen yaa, ka fi ale chim m yiila ale m sebchakka a nyini m paalim po.

ref: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
text: A din nyini m biam po, m din zak a nya ka fi. Ka fi ale ta mu a nyini m mawa ponni po. M le pak fu diipo meena.

ref: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
text: Mi chim ka daana a te nuru boari, alege ka fi ale m sukka jigi.

ref: and I praise and honor you all day long.
text: Pimpauk ale sueri m nɔnni po, ate mi yaa kasim a mooli fi nalimu wie danni meena po.

ref: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
text: Kan pai mu a basi ase m nin jam kpaŋmu. Be kan zɛri mu ase m pagrimu a nin nueri.

ref: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
text: Ba a weeni ayen, <<Wen a zɛri wa kama. Ni vi yik wa ate ni yik wa ale waai karo tuesi wa a basi.>>

ref: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
text: Basi ate baai ale potim m nyiŋla a dɛ chivie kpi. Basi ate baai ale a yaali ayen ba daani mu la, kanpiinta ale chivie a yik ba.

ref: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
text: M nɔngbanni ale weeni fi wayɔrisimaŋa ale fi varibasika wie, m be poom zɛ ŋa ale a magsi ŋa soa diila.

ref: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
text: M Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen yaa, m le mooli fi wakpiemaŋa ate fi nye la ate ba wom, fi nyiini, wayɔrisimaŋa wie ate mi ale mooli.

ref: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
text: Wen yaa, a nyini m paalim po, fi sak mu kama ate jinla danni, mi a mooli fi wakinkagla tuimaŋa.

ref: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
text: Wen yaa, m dan poom kpaŋmu a ta zupiila, kan zɛri mu, ate ku jam paari diipo ate mi ale weeni fi pagrimu wie a sak gaŋ kaai ale pai a saŋ la ale baai meena ale za ba jam la.

ref: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
text: Wen yaa, fi wayɔrisimaŋa a paari wenzukku kama, fi waai ale nye wakpiema la. Wen yaa, ka wana ale a nye ase fi la?

ref: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
text: Fi basi ate m nya daanika yegayega ale watuasa, fi ale ŋman nye ate m chim m nyiem ale ka diila. A nyini tɛŋka liuŋku po ate fi le ŋman yeeri mu a nyini du a ta mu a jueli ŋmai.

ref: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
text: Fi le nye ate m zulaŋa a zuak abe fi yɔk m suinni a te mu.

ref: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
text: Fi wensieŋa nyiŋ, m Wen yaa, m le nak kpanuŋ a pak fu. M le pai baganiŋ a lenni pimpauk yiila a te waai ate wadek wa nyiini a Welema a bo Izirali la.

ref: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
text: M dan boro a lenni pimpauk yiila a te fu, m nɔnni ale nye masim nuemka ate fi waai ale da tuesi mu la.

ref: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
text: M giŋgeluŋku ale weeni fi wayɔrisima tuimaŋa daa meena, baai ale a yaali ayen ba daani mu la, a jo ka chivie ale butuma po.

ref: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
text: Wen yaa, te naawa fi buusaŋa, abe fi te naawa nidoabinni fi wayɔrisima.

ref: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
text: Wa le bo fi nuruma buusa ale wayɔrisima, abe wa bo fi nuru baai ate ba a namsi ba la ale wensie.

ref: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
text: Guutaŋa ale ta jigsika a jam te nuruma abe pimpitimaŋa a yɔni wayɔrisima yɔna.

ref: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
text: Ase wenbinni ale chiika ale boro diila, wa mɛ ale kasim boro ka dila a ta ga paari gaŋsa meena wuu zuk.

ref: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
text: Wa daaŋa po, wayɔrisima nyama nyiŋsaŋa ale foli. Suiyɔgni yega ale kasim a boro ate ku a ga paari diipo ate chiika a kan ŋman boro.

ref: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
text: Wa le dɛ naam nyakpientaŋa meena zuk, abe wa ŋman dɛ naam a zaani Benni a ta ga paari tɛŋka kpeglimka.

ref: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
text: Buui dii ale nyini tintain busuŋku la ale kpi duna wa niŋ, abe wa dachaasaŋa a mɔk tanta.

ref: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
text: Tarsis nalimaŋa ale tɛŋ sii ale yalima ate nyaata a gilim si la ale ta tutuna a jam te wa. Siiba ale Sɛba nalimaŋa ale ta tiirim tii a jam te wa.

ref: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
text: Nalima meena ale kpi duna wa niŋ, abe tɛŋ kpieŋsa meena ale tom a te wa.

ref: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
text: Wa le yeeri baai ale a silim la ba kumsaŋa po a basi, abe wa maari baai ale a nam ate nuru karo a maari ba la.

ref: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
text: Wa jiirim ale dari ŋanwobisisaŋa ale baai ale a silim la, abe wa vari baai ale a silim la a nyini kum po a basi.

ref: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
text: Wa le yeeri ba a nyini ninam ale wɔkwɔk po, dii nyiŋla ba ziimu a ta ka tuilum a te wa.

ref: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
text: Wa abe goa a beni. Ba abe ta ligmɔniŋ a nyini Siiba a jam te wa. Nuruba abe kasim a puusi a te wa, abe ba kasim a niak wa danni meena po.

ref: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
text: Basi ate ŋandiinta a sueri tɛŋka zuk. Ŋa be poom tagli guutaŋa mɛ zuk. Basi ate ŋa yɔnaŋa a nye nna se Lebanon tiisaŋa yɔnaŋa ale a nye diila, abe si nye ase wuyiiba ale a na pusi kaduk po diila.

ref: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
text: Wa yuenni abe kasim boro taam wuu. Di abe kasim a boro nna se vanni ale a veenti ate wenbinni a pusi diila. Wala nyiŋ tɛŋ kpieŋsa meena ale nya suipeentik, ate ba yaa wi wa ayen suipeentik nyɔnɔ.

ref: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
text: Pimpauk abe bo Naawen dii ale ka Wen la jigi, Izirali Wenni, waai nyiini ale a tom wakinkagla la.

ref: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
text: Pimpauk abe bo wa yuei dii ale ta zula la jigi taam wuu. Tɛŋka meena abe sueri ale wa zulaŋa. Ku be nye dila a ŋman pilim a nye dila.

ref: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
text: Jese nidoabinni Deevid puusaŋa kpeglimka jigi ale dela.

ref: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
text: Chekki, Wen a nala a te Izirali demma, baai suiniima ale ka jassi la.

ref: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
text: Dii nyiŋla m dɛka nyuri ale kanjanta nyama ase m le nya ayen gaasa nyama a jigsi la.

ref: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
text: Ba ka ninammoa. Ba nyiŋsaŋa a ta nyiŋyɔgsa ale pagra.

ref: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
text: Dila nyiŋ kanjanta a yaa chim ba ŋie sotta. Ba pai ka wɔkwɔk ate ku chim garuk ate ba jo.

ref: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
text: Biem ale a nyini ba suiniim baataŋa po. Ba popola baataŋa a zɛ biem basika.

ref: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
text: Ba nye nuruba a la, ale a biisi wabulɔrisa, ba zaani ba kanjantaŋa zuk a nyigsi nuruba.

ref: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
text: Dila nyiŋ ba nuruma a cheem a va ba ale a nya nyiam a nyu ate bu a paari ba.

ref: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
text: Ba a weeni kama ayen, <<Wen ale nye ka sɛ a seba? Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La a seba ku po?>>

ref: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
text: Gaasa nyama ale ka diila ale nna. Ba niŋ a ka wari po. Ba abe kasim a jigsi kama a gum du.

ref: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
text: M nye m suinummu cheri ka kinla. Ku abe ka kinla mɛ ate m nari m nisa alege a poom zɛ wari nɔi po.

ref: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
text: Nyiŋtuila ale kasim a ta mu danni meena po. Ma a tu ka ninam saluik meena.

ref: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
text: Ase mi dan weeni ka wa ŋala chaab, mi ti pai fi bisaŋa a da kama.

ref: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
text: ka mi yaa le jo Wen yenni po la. Ate mi yaa miŋ dii ale di nye ba ku nueri ka po la.

ref: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
text: Chekki, fi pai ba kama a zaani sisatik jigi, a yaa basi ate ba lo a kaasi.

ref: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
text: Ba deri tu ka kaasuŋ nna nwuli, yɔgsum ale yik ba meena a ta cheŋ.

ref: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
text: m jam kan poli ale poom zɛ wari ya. M jam a nye ase ka duŋ fi niŋ la.

ref: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
text: Alege m kasim a bo ale fu kama. Fi pai ka fi juga nisaŋa a yik mu a tara.

ref: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
text: Fi pai ka fi yam wieŋa a gani mu, ate dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ fi le pai mu a ta jo fi zulaŋa po.

ref: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
text: Ka wana ate m ta ate wa bo wenŋmazukku, alege ate ku an chim daa fi? Ate tɛŋzuk de m kan yaali waai ya a ŋman gaam fi.

ref: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
text: M nyiŋ lammu ale m suinummu ale nye kpeeri, alege ka Wen ale chim m suinum pagrɔ ale ŋman chim waai ate m soa diipo meena wuu.

ref: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
text: Baai ale yalima ale fu la ale bɛ meena. Fi a kaasi baai meena ale kan ta wensie ale fu la kama.

ref: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
text: Alege dan ka mi, ku nala kama ate m forisi a moata Wen. Mi pai ka Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen ate wa chim m likka jigi. M le weeni fi tuimaŋa meena a sak nuruba.

ref: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
text: Wen yaa, ka boan nyiŋ ate fi a zɛri ti a basi taam wuu? Ka boan nyiŋ ate fi sui a kab ale pa ŋaai ale a dɛ fi wuuku la?

ref: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
text: Teeri nuru baai ate fi da dipodipo la, teeri buui dii ate fi da tuesi a soa ba la, bala ale Zayon Guuku demma, juijui ate fi jam a boro la.

ref: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
text: Viriŋ fi naŋsa a nya yeeŋa ale chim guuta a doa taam wuu la. Kaasuŋ kude meena ate dachiaka ta jam fi yenni po la.

ref: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
text: Ba pai ka laasa ale pengaasa a che yenni daataŋa a kabri.

ref: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
text: Ba weeni ba suiniima po kama ayen, ti le kaasi ba kama a basi. Ba ju juijui meena ate nuruba jo a zuli Wen tɛŋka zuk la a basi kama.

ref: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
text: Ti an ŋman nya wakinkagla tuima, biisiteerɔba an tali ya, ate ti waai be zɛ nya kude ale za ku beni a soa diila.

ref: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
text: Wen yaa, dachiaka ale nye fu la ate ku a ga paari ka dimpo? Dachiaka ale biisi fu yuenni a kaasi kama taam wuu?

ref: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
text: Alege Fi Wen yaa, a nyini dipodipo ka fi ale m naab. Fi ta varibasika a jam tɛŋka zuk.

ref: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
text: Ka fi ale jam pai fi pagrimu a lab nyakpiemu. Fi mobi ja chichimini zuimaŋa nyiamu po.

ref: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
text: Ka fi ale jam ŋɔriŋ duŋ kperikaliika zuimaŋa nyakpiemu po ale pai ka ate ka chim ŋandiinta a te gɔi duŋ sii ale bo sagni po la.

ref: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
text: Ka fi ale jam te suik ate bulisa ale bela a buli nyaata. Fi nye ate beli ŋaai ale a chali nyaata la a kpieri.

ref: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
text: Kantueŋka ale yokku mɛ, ka fi ale soa. Fi ale nye wenbinni ale chiika.

ref: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
text: Ka fi ale dueni tɛŋka ale doa la banaŋa meena. Ka fi ale nye wenkarik ale yoei wen.

ref: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
text: Naawen yaa, teeri dachiaka ale a la fu diila, ate betta nyam biisi a kaasi fi yuenni diila.

ref: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
text: Kan pai fi nangbaŋka a te gɔi duŋsa ate si ŋɔbi. Kan baŋ fi nuru baai ale a nam la nyuvooŋa wari taam wuu.

ref: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
text: Poli fi nɔiyeŋka ate fi dueni la zuk, dii nyiŋla wɔkwɔk tuima ale sueri tɛŋka juijui ate legi a boro la.

ref: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
text: Kan te baai ate ba ta a namsi la a dɛ chivie. Basi ate ŋanjaksa ale baai ale a silim la a pak fi yuenni.

ref: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
text: Wen yaa, yiti zaani a zɛri fidek nyiŋ. Teeri bettaŋa ale a la fu dii danni meena po la.

ref: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
text: Wen yaa, ta te fi jiam. Ta te fi jiam dii nyiŋla fi Yuenni a moata kama. Nuruba a weeni fi wakinkaglaŋa wie.

ref: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
text: Fi weeni kama ayen, <<Ka mi ale a lueri daaŋa. Ka mi ale a bo wensie buusa.

ref: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
text: Ase tɛŋka ale ka nuruma a dan kpiŋsi, ka mi ale a yik ka zaŋŋa a tara nna giŋgiŋ.

ref: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
text: Mi le weeni kanjanta nyɔnɔwa ayen wa kan ŋman kuulim ale a weeni gaasa nyɔnɔwa ayen wa kan zak wa nyiilaŋa a zaani.

ref: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
text: Kan zak fi nyiilaŋa a tuk wenŋmazuwa. Kan biisi a yeeri ŋiri ya.

ref: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
text: Waai karo a nyini konni po yaase yeniŋka po yaase sagni po a baga a zak nuru a zaani.

ref: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
text: Alege ka Wen ale a bɔ buusa. Wala ale a basi ate waai a siŋ tɛŋ, wala abe le ŋman zak waai a zaani.

ref: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
text: Naawen a ta ka beerik wa nisima po a sueri ale dapuuk ate bu dam chaab ale ŋanti baai nyum ale masa la. Wa kpiiri bu a basi kama, ate gaasa nyama meena ale bo tɛŋka zuk la a yaa tuk bu a nyu ale bu zunzunaŋa meena.

ref: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
text: Alege dan ka mi, m le kasim a weeni ka wanni de taam wuu. M le lenni pimpauk yiila a seni Jekob Wenni.

ref: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
text: M le che gaasa nyama nyiilaŋa meena a basi, alege m le zak wayɔrisima nyama nyiilaŋa a zaani ŋmai.

ref: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
text: Juda tɛŋka a seba Wen kama. Wa yuenni a zuak ya a bo Izirali tɛŋka po.

ref: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
text: Wa viuku a bo ka Salem tɛŋka po, ate wa boka jigini a chim Zayon.

ref: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
text: Wa boka jigini wa yik peinyaama a pɔriŋ, wa yik ba ŋanchɔgsintaŋa ale ba gebisaŋa ale kpaliŋsa kɔlimaŋa a kaasi basi.

ref: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
text: Ba kɔlim suinum pagrik nyama ŋantaŋa, ate ba dua a goa ba kpeglimka goom. Tugurik tɔŋdɔma wanyi mɛ an baga wa nisa a zak ŋmai ya.

ref: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
text: Jekob Wen yaa, fi toariŋka a basi kama ate wusuma ale ŋa torokoba a duak tɛŋ nna chim.

ref: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
text: Ka fi nyiini ale magsi ayen ba a chali fu yɔgsum. Ka wana ale baga a zaani fi niŋa ase fi sui a nin puuri?

ref: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
text: Fi bo ka buusa a nyini wenŋmazuk, ate yɔgsum a yik tɛŋka demma ate ba nye nna diki

ref: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
text: diipo ate fi Wen a yiti zaani ayen fi bo buusa a vari baai meena ale a nam tɛŋka zuk a basi la.

ref: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
text: Chekki, fi suipuurumu a ta ka pimpauk a jam a te fu, ate ku kasi baai ale vuuk nyini fi suipuurumu po la.

ref: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
text: Ni puulim ale Naawen ni Wenni abe ni nye ni ale weeni diila. Basi ate tɛŋ sii ale kala a moata ni la a ta tiirita a jam te Waai ale magsi ayen ba a chali wa yɔgsum la.

ref: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
text: Wala ale a nye ate baai ale a nya tɛŋsa zuk la a ta badek siŋ tɛŋ. Tɛŋka nalima a ta yɔgsum chala ale wa kama.

ref: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
text: M kaari a wi Wen a yaali maarika, m kaari a wi Wen a ayen wa wom mu.

ref: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
text: M le bo ninam po la, m gisi Nyɔnɔwa yokku po, m zak nisa a tuk wen a puusi Naawen a kan jiagi, ate m chiika mɛ a zɛri masim dɛka.

ref: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
text: M teeri fi wie Wen yaa, ate ku daani mu m ŋuuni ate m chiika a cha.

ref: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
text: Fi an basi ate m mum nummoa, m ninammu a zuak ka yega ate mi an baga a lak nɔi a biisi.

ref: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
text: M poli dipo wie, m poli ben ŋaai ale taam la wie.

ref: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
text: <<Nyɔnɔwa ale zɛri mu ka dila taam wuu? Wa kan ŋman ta jiirimmoa?

ref: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
text: Wa ŋmanteka a deri kpeglim kama dila taam wuu? Wa pumpuulimaŋa a deri nueri kama dila taam wuu?

ref: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
text: Wen a deri baŋ jiirim taka kama? Naawen suinni ale a puuri la nyiŋ, wa an ŋma a nya nuruba niniga?>>

ref: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
text: Ate mi yaa weeni ayen, <<Dii ale basi ate mi sui a kaasi la ale nna. Bena ŋaai ale taam la, Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La a jam bo ale ti kama.>>

ref: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
text: M le teeri Naawen tuimaŋa ate wa tom la. Mm, mi le teeri fi wakinkaglaŋa ate fi jam a tom dipo la.

ref: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
text: Wen yaa fi suitaŋa, a welema kama. Ka wen boa ale ŋman boro a zuak gaam Wen yaa?

ref: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
text: Fi ale Wen dii ale a tom wakinkagla la, fi a sak fi pagrimu nuruba tɔgatɔga niŋ.

ref: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
text: Fi pai fi pagrimu a da tuesi fi nuruma a basi, fi da tuesi Jekob ale Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa a basi.

ref: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
text: Wen yaa, nyaataŋa a nya fu. Ti nya fu ate yɔgsum a yik ti. Nya liuŋtaŋa a choa ale yɔgsum.

ref: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
text: Chiŋmaaŋa a ni ŋa nyiamu ate wenni a na nanpansa, fi peemaŋa ate fi a tɔŋ la a cheŋ ka niŋ ale ŋaaŋ.

ref: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
text: Nuruba wom fi naka vamuniŋka po, fi basi ate wenni a nyaksi tɛŋka meena. Tɛŋka a choa.

ref: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
text: Fi cheŋ nyakpiemu po, fi dueni suik nyakpientaŋa po, fi cheŋ va bu po a taam kama alege waai an nya fi naŋtaataŋa.

ref: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
text: Fi dɛ fi nuruma niŋ ase ba ka piisa la, fi basi ate Moosis ale Aaron a kasi ba.

ref: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
text: M nuruba, ni wom m sinsaŋŋa ni chelsi wom m nɔi po wieŋa.

ref: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
text: M le lak m nɔnni a weeni wamagsima a sak ni. M le weeni ni wasusugi ŋaai ale boro a nyini ŋiaka la.

ref: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
text: ti kan pai ŋa a suk ti bisa. Ti ni weeni ŋa a sak gaŋ sii ale pai a saŋ la. Ti le biisi Naawen pimpauk tuimaŋa, wa pagrim tuimaŋa, ale wa wakinkagla tuimaŋa ate wa tom la.

ref: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
text: Wa te Jekob ka kaamka, ale te Izirali demma sinsaŋŋa, a weeni ti kokpieŋsaŋa ayen ba pai ŋa a sak ba bisaŋa,

ref: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
text: Ate ba yaa ta sebchakka ale Wen ate ba kan baŋ wa tuim kperisaŋa, alege ba le kasim a siak a va Wen sinsaŋŋa.

ref: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
text: Ɛfraim nidoama ale ba timaŋa meena, kpaliŋka danni ba le chali ale basi kpaliŋka nyeka.

ref: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
text: Ba zɛri nɔiyeŋka ate ba nye ale Wen la kama. Ba zɛri wa sinsaŋŋa mɛ kama.

ref: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
text: Wa yik nyakpiemu a lab buye a dɛ niŋ ta wa nuruma a va du taam jueli, wa nye ate nyiamu a zaani ase parik ate ba sɛ zaani diila.

ref: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
text: Wa basi ate chiŋmari a dɛ ba niŋ danni po ale basi ate bolim ŋiak a dɛ ba niŋ yokku meena.

ref: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
text: Wa kabri pinaŋa sagni po, a te ba nyiam nna yegayega ase bu nyini nyakpiemu po la.

ref: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
text: Alege dila meena, wa nuruma a diem tom a kaasi wa kama, ba zɛri Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La nɔi sagni po.

ref: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
text: Ba potim seba ale nye Wen nya ale ba le bek wa ŋandiin tii ate badek kɔrisa a bo ale ti la.

ref: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
text: Ba biisi kaasi Wen a weeni ayen, <<Wen dek baga a yaali ŋandiinta a te tama sagni nna po ya?

ref: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
text: Wa ale nak piuŋku la, nyiam ale burinti nyini, ate bela a sueri mobi pimpanta. Alege wa a baga a te ŋandiinta moa? Wa baga yaali lanta a te wa nuruma moa?>>

ref: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
text: Naawen ale wom ba la, wa sui yaa puuri, wa yaa basi ate wa bolimu a lo Jekob zuk, wa pai suipuurum a bo Izirali demma buusa.

ref: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
text: Dii nyiŋla ba ka siaka ale Wen ya, ba ka sebchakka ayen wa ale vari ba a basi.

ref: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
text: Alege wa weeni chiŋmaaŋa, ate wenŋmazukku a lak ku tuataŋa,

ref: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
text: a ni ŋandiinta ate nuruma ayen ba dɛ, wa te ba wenŋmazuk ŋandiinta ayen ba dɛ.

ref: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
text: Nuruba a dɛ Wen maarɔba ŋandiinta, wa tom ŋandiinta ate ti paari ba taŋa.

ref: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
text: Wa weeni koni vioku ate ku a fuk ale pai wa pagrimu a dɛ yeseoku vioku niŋ.

ref: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
text: Wa nye ate si yiri a lo ba suŋsuŋ a gilim viitaŋa meena.

ref: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
text: Ba dɛ ŋandiinta a paari ba paara an ŋmaa yaali dii nyiŋla wa te ba, ba kɔrisaŋa ale bo ale ŋan baai la kama.

ref: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
text: Wa yaa basi ate ba daaŋa chim kinla a te ba, ale basi ate ba benaŋa po ba yɔgsa.

ref: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
text: Wen dan pilim boro a ko ba, ba nyiem yaa ŋman viriŋ a gisi wa nna a wuli.

ref: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
text: Dila ate ba teeri ayen Wen ka ba Piuŋ, ayen Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La ka ba Da Tuesirɔ.

ref: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
text: Alege ka ba noaŋa pai ate ba nye, ba ka velimvendisa.

ref: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
text: Alege wa diem ta jiirim ale ba, wa vɔŋ ba biemu a te ba wa an kaasi ba. Diipo meena wa kasim duŋ wa suinni wa an sak wa suipuurumu.

ref: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
text: Wa teeri ayen ba ka nyiŋ lam ba ka viok kuui ale a taam a kan pilim a ŋmani la.

ref: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
text: Diipo meena ba kasim a zɛri wa nɔi ka dila sagni po ale nye ate wa suinni a dom gɔnni po.

ref: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
text: Ba kasim ta Wen nye a nya kama ale nye ate Izirali Waai Ale Welema La sui a puuri.

ref: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
text: Ba kan teeri wa pagrimu wie ba kan teeri dai dii danni ate wa tuesi ba ba namsidɔma nisima po a basi la.

ref: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
text: Dai dii dai ate Wen a sak wa wakperikaliisaŋa ale wa wakinkaglaŋa Zoan ale bo Ejipiti tɛŋka po la.

ref: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
text: Wa tulim ba belaŋa ate ŋa chim ziim, ate ba an baga a nyu nyiam beli naŋsaŋa po.

ref: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
text: Wa tom kabsa ate si jam namsi ba, ale baŋuuna ate ŋa jam kaasi ba tɛŋka.

ref: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
text: Wa basi ate nanchoŋta a jam dɛ ba kpanni ŋantaŋa ate tintue a kaasi ba laŋsaŋa.

ref: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
text: Wa kaasi ba yɔnaŋa ale ŋmoruk tana, ale ba kinkaŋsaŋa ale ŋmoruk viok.

ref: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
text: Wa ko ba niiŋa ale ŋmoruk tana, ate ŋmoruk a na ba piisaŋa.

ref: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
text: Wa sak wa suipuurumu nna yegayega ale ba, ale basi ate wa suipuurumu a siŋ ba zuk, ate Wen maarɔ boari a jam ba zuk ale kaasuŋ.

ref: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
text: Wa an yik wa suipuurumu, wa abe m vɔŋ ba nyuvooŋa, alege kaasi ba.

ref: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
text: Wa ko bi kpaŋŋa meena Ejipiti tɛŋka po, nidoama ale liŋ biak baai la Yɛm viitaŋa po.

ref: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
text: Alege a ta wa nuruma a nyini ase piisa la, wa ta ba kama ase piisa la a va sagni po a nyini.

ref: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
text: Wa jam gani ba kama, dila nyiŋ ba jam kan chali yɔgsummoa, alege nyakpiemu a lim ba dachaasaŋa.

ref: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
text: Dila nyiŋ Wen yaa ta ba jam wa tɛŋ weleŋka po, wa ta ba jo tɛŋ kaai ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la ale wadek pagrim.

ref: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
text: Wa yiak tɛŋsa ba niŋ, alege chari ba ba tɛŋsaŋa ate ba tuesi. Wa basi ate Izirali dɔkdemma a kali ba viitaŋa po.

ref: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
text: Alege ba nye Wen a nya a kan wom wa nɔi ya a ta chaab ale Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La, ba an ta wa sinsaŋŋa.

ref: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
text: Ase ba koma la, ba jam ka zula ba be ka siaka, ba cheem ŋaaŋ a te ase tom buui ale kan gori magsi la.

ref: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
text: Ba basi ate wa sui a puuri ale ba bɔgtaŋa, ba basi ate wa a dɛ nyuri ale ba bɔgtaŋa.

ref: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
text: Wen ale wom ba wari la, wa sui kasim a puuri nna yegayega, ate wa zɛri Izirali.

ref: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
text: Ate wa basi Siilo viuku, viuk kuui ate wa ti nuruba suŋsuŋ la.

ref: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
text: Wa basi ate ba tuesi nɔiyeŋka dakanni a ta cheŋ. Wa zulaŋa a ga jo dachiak nisa po.

ref: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
text: Wa pai wa nuruma a te gebika, wa sui ale ŋmasi a puuri ale wa nuruma.

ref: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
text: Bolim a dɛ ba nuru paalukku, ate ba kalaasaŋa a ka yalika yiila.

ref: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
text: Dachaasaŋa a ko ba kaabteerɔma ale ka gebisa, ate ba pukɔŋŋa an baga a kum.

ref: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
text: Ate Nyɔnɔwa a nak ti yiti goom po ase nuru ale yiti dabugla po diila.

ref: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
text: Wa nak ate wa dachaasaŋa a ŋmani. Wa pai ba nyo ka chivie po taam wuu.

ref: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
text: Ate wa zɛri Josefi viitaŋa, wa an lueri Ɛfraim buuni.

ref: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
text: Alege wa lueri Juda buuni, Zayon guuku, ate wa a yaali la.

ref: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
text: Wa sɛ wa yenni kama ase wenŋmazuk la. Wa sɛ di kama giŋgiŋ tɛŋzuk de.

ref: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
text: Wa lueri wa yɔmawa Deevid kama, a yeeri wa piisa boka jigi.

ref: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
text: Deevid ale jam boro a nya piisaŋa la, ate wa lueri wa ayen wa dɛ Jekob nuruma, wadek nuruma Izirali demma niŋ.

ref: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
text: Wen yaa, nuruma a vari fi tɛŋka ba taŋ fi tuilum yenni ba nye ate Jerusalem a yaa chim ka guuk.

ref: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
text: Ba pai fi yɔmma nyiŋsaŋa a chim ka nuinsa ŋandiinta. Baai ale siak a te fu la, nyiŋ lantaŋa a yaa chim ka gɔi duŋsa ŋandiinta.

ref: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
text: Ba burinti ziim a waaŋ a gilim Jerusalem ase ka nyiam la. Nuru a be an taliya ayen wa gu kpilimaŋa.

ref: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
text: Pai fi suipuurumu a kaasi tɛŋ sii nuruba ale kan seba fu la, tɛŋ sii ale ka puusi a te fu la.

ref: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
text: Dii nyiŋla, ba ko Jekob, ale kaasi wa tɛŋka meena.

ref: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
text: Kan pai ti koma biemu nyiŋŋa a waali ti, te fi jiirimu a cheŋ paari ti a wuli, ale ti ŋman ka yiila.

ref: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
text: Wen, ti Varibasidɔ, maari ti, fi yuenni zula nyiŋ, vari ti a basi abe fi vɔŋ ti wabaata a te ti fi yuenni zula nyiŋ.

ref: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
text: Ka boa ale soa ate tɛŋsaŋa nuruma a weeni ayen, <<Ba Wenni a bo ka bɛ?>> Te ti nina nya fi le a waali ba, ba le ko fi nuruma la nyiŋ.

ref: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
text: Goori a wom fi nuru baai ate ba yik lik la ale a ŋuuni diila, fi pagrimu nyiŋ vari baai ale ba kpi la a basi.

ref: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
text: Tuni ti kali mɔtidɔma ku naŋtuok nɔi buyopɔi dii nyiŋla ba lɛ fi Nyɔnɔwa ka yegayega.

ref: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
text: Ate tama fi nuruma, tama fi piisaŋa ŋaai ale a dɛ fi wuuku la, yaa pak fu taam wuu. A nyini gaŋsa meena po ti le pak fu.

ref: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
text: Izirali Naapeerika, wom ti, fi ka waai ale a kasi Josefi nuruma ase piisa la fi waai ale kali fi zukpaglik zuk ŋanvutaŋa suŋsuŋ a sak fi nyaksika zulaŋa.

ref: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
text: Ɛfraim ale Benjamin ale Manasa niŋ, yiti ale fi pagrimu a jam vari ti a basi.

ref: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
text: Wen pilim tuesi ti. Ta nin baasima ale ti. Ka dila nyiini ale a basi ate ti a nya varibasika.

ref: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
text: Ninyiam ale chim ba ŋandiinta ate fi pai te ba ate ba dɛ, ninyiam ale chim ba nyiam ate ba nyu.

ref: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
text: Ti yaa ka ŋan nye laanta ti kali mɔtidɔma jigi. Ti dachaasaŋa a nye ti a la kama.

ref: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
text: Fi ta ti nyini Ejipiti po, a yiak nuruba ba tɛŋsa po a basi ale pai tama a kali si po.

ref: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
text: Fi gomsi ka a te ti, ate ti yaa feri naŋsa ka po, yaa taari lik ka.

ref: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
text: Ti chim yɔgsum a lik ka guutaŋa ti chim ka nyunyoŋta teeri naŋsa.

ref: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
text: Ti teeri ti naŋsaŋa a cheŋ paari ka Nyakpiemu yeniŋ geŋ. Ti tɛŋ naŋsa mɛ a paari Benni kori geŋ.

ref: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
text: Ka boa abe le ŋman soa ate fi nak ti parika a lɔnsi ayen nuru baai ale a taam la a zu ti yɔnaŋa?

ref: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
text: Gɔi die a ŋɔbi ŋa, gɔi duŋsa a dɛ ŋa.

ref: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
text: Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, pilim jam ti jigi kali wenŋmazuk a chuiri nya ti ninammu, kpesi a nya fi tiimu zuk,

ref: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
text: naŋ kaai ate fi pai fi juga nisaŋa a vuk ate ka pusi ate fi wuuk a te fidek la.

ref: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
text: Ba che ka a lɔnsi kama a ju ase vaala la. Fi dan toariŋ ba, ba le kpi.

ref: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
text: Te nuru waai ate fi a yaali la pagrim te bi kaai ate fi a wuuk la pagrim.

ref: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
text: Ate ti kan ŋman nyini fi ŋaaŋ a nyini, te ti vum ate ti ŋman wi fi yuenni.

ref: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
text: Leni yiila ale popeentik a te Wen ti pagrɔwa. Na yiila a seni Jekob Wenni.

ref: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
text: Piilim yiilaŋa. Nak sinyaksaŋa, nak kpantaŋa, nak baganiŋ a lenni yimasisa a te Naawen.

ref: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
text: Peeri damuniŋka diipo ate chiik buli a boro la, peeri damuniŋka chiika a nin bo wenzuk suŋsuŋ dai ŋaai po ate ti a dɛ ti tigini la.

ref: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
text: Ka sinsaŋŋa ale la ate Wen a pai te Izirali demma, Jekob Wenni nɔi ale la.

ref: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
text: Wa dueni ŋa a te ka Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa diipo ate ba basi Ejipiti la, mi wom ka biik m zɛ ka kiri ya.

ref: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
text: Wa weeni ayen, <<M tuili ba jimmu ba maŋkpalaŋa zuk a dueni tɛŋ. M yik ni nisimaŋa jibtaŋa a tuili dueni kama.

ref: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
text: Ni ninammu po, ni wi mu ate m vari ni a basi, m nak nyini chiŋmaaŋa po a jam tulisi ni m nye ni nya Meriba nyaataŋa nɔi.

ref: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
text: <<M nuruba, ni wom, ate m kaam ni, m ti le yaali ayen ni wom mu Izirali demma.

ref: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
text: Ni kan ta bɔgluk chaŋsa ni yeeŋa po. Ni kan pai zula a te wen yona.

ref: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
text: Ka Mi ale Naawen ni Wen dii ale ta ni nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini la. Ni lak ni noaŋa ate m nyo ŋanta du a te ni.

ref: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
text: <<Alege mi nuruma a kan wom mu. Izirali demma kan siak a ta badek siŋ tɛŋ a te mu.

ref: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
text: Ate m yaa pai ba a basi ate ba va badek suiniimaŋa ale a yaali diila, ba tukpanni nyiŋ.

ref: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
text: <<Ase mi nuruma a dan poom a wom mu kama, ase Izirali a dan poom va ka mi suitaŋa.

ref: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
text: M le kpabi nwuli a nya pagrim, ni dachaasaŋa zuk. M le cheem a ta chaab ale ni dachaasaŋa.

ref: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
text: Baai ale kisi Naawen la le koori tɛŋ ale yɔgsum wa niŋ, ate ba ninammu le boro ka dila taam wuu.

ref: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
text: Alege m le te ni ŋandiin maŋsa ate ni dɛ, m le lu siita pina zuima a te ni ate ni dɛ.>>

ref: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
text: Wen ale a nya wa dek tigsuŋku zuk. Wa ale a bo wenaŋa buusa:

ref: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
text: Ni biisi maari niwomma ale kpiŋsaŋa; ni bo te ŋanjaksaŋa ale baai ate ba ta ba a namsi la.

ref: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
text: Ni vari niwomma ale silimdɔma a basi ni vari ba nuru baataŋa nisima po a basi.

ref: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
text: <<Ba zɛ wari ya, ba kan miŋ wari ya. Ba bo ka legini po a nyiem a cheŋ, tɛŋka meena nyubini a choa kama.

ref: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
text: <<M weeni ayen, <Ni ka <<wena>>, ni meena ka Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La bisa.>

ref: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
text: Vaari yiti Wen yaa, a bo tɛŋka demma buusa ale tɛŋsaŋa meena ka fi ale soa si.

ref: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
text: Wen yaa, kan sinla. Wen yaa, kan nye chim. Kan nye diki.

ref: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
text: Nya, fi dachaasaŋa a zɛri kama, fi kisidɔma a yeeri ba zuima a zaani.

ref: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
text: Ba weeni chaab ayen, <<Ni jam ate ti kaasi ba tɛŋka ale ka nuruma, ate Izirali yuei kan ŋma wi.>>

ref: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
text: Ba pai popoli yena a poli ba biemu ale chaab. Ba jo chaab a kpaliŋ ale fu.

ref: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
text: Assiria demma mɛ a yiti gum ba po ayen ba maari Lɔti ŋaaŋka a te ba pagrim.

ref: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
text: Nye ni ba ase fi le jam nye ale Midian demma diila, ase fi le jam nye ale Sisera ale Jabin, Kison benni nɔi diila.

ref: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
text: Nye ba niŋdeerɔma ase fi le jam nye Oreb ale Zeeb diila, nye ba nabisaŋa ase fi le jam nye Zeba ale Zalmunna diila.

ref: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
text: Baai ale jam weeni ayen, <<Ni basi ate ti tuesi Naawen tɛŋka a soa ka la.>>

ref: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
text: Wen yaa, kati ba waaŋ ase wuuta la ji ba ta cheŋ ase viok ale a ji vɔtta diila.

ref: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
text: Ase bolim ale a ŋɔbi sagi kpien diila, ase bolim ŋiak ale chɔgsi guuta diila,

ref: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
text: Te chivie a yik ba, ate dila a basi ate nuruba a gisi fi Naawen yuenni.

ref: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
text: Ba chivieŋa a kasim dik ba zuimaŋa po dila taam wuu, ba bi kpi chivie kum.

ref: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
text: Basi ate ba miŋ ayen fi a waai yuenni ale ka Naawen la, ale Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La a soa tɛŋka meena zuk an nya.

ref: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
text: M chiika a yeenti kama ayen ka paari Naawen yenni m suinummu ale m nyiŋ lammu a kaari a wi fi Wen vukku.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
text: Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, m Naab ale m Wen yaa, nuinsa a sɛ yie a boro takaribaleeŋsa a ta tukta a wuuk si bisa a moata fi kaabka kuŋkuŋku.

ref: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
text: Suipeentik a bo le baai ale pai fi yenni a chim ba boka jigi la, ba a pak fu ka diipo meena wuu.

ref: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
text: Fi ale a te baai pagrim la a ta suipeentik kama. Baai suiniima ale a yeenti ayen ba cheŋ paari fu la zuima masa la.

ref: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
text: Ase ba le va Ninyiam Viaka po a taam la, ba tu bulisa ka po. Kpiak ŋmorukku a sueri ka ale nyaata.

ref: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
text: Ba a chim ale nyiŋ pagra a ta jam paari diipo ate ba meena a yaa za Wen niŋ Zayon guuku zuk la.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
text: Naawen yaa, Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, wom m puusa. Wom mu, Jekob Wen yaa.

ref: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
text: Chuiri nya ti ligrɔwa, Wen yaa chuiri nya fi le bobi na waai la ale nin baasima.

ref: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
text: M dan pai dai yeŋ a zuli fu fi yenni po a zunchoŋŋa daa tusidi jigi yoŋ, m dan jɔk chim Wen yenni tuok ligrɔ a zunchoŋ m goa nuru baataŋa viitaŋa po.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
text: Naawen Dii Ale Ka Wen La ka wenbiri ale jachɔgsim. Naawen ale a te ŋmanteka ale zula. Wa kan pai wamaŋ a suk baai ale a cheŋ wa suiku po.

ref: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
text: Naawen, fi sak fi tɛŋka jiirim. Fi pilim pai Jekob paaruŋku a te wa.

ref: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
text: Fi jam vɔŋ nuruma kaasuŋku a te ba, ale lik ba wabaataŋa a dueni.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
text: Wen ti Varibasidɔ, pilim tigsi ti ta jam jigi yeŋ abe fi kan ta sui ale ti.

ref: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
text: Fi kan ŋman te ti pagrimoa? Fi kan ŋman basi ate fi nuruma a ŋman naŋi?

ref: Show us your love and save us!
text: Naawen yaa, sak ti fi ŋmanteka, abe fi te ti varibasika.

ref: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
text: M le goori wom Wen, Naawen ale weeni diila. Wa le nye suiyɔgni ale wa nuruma, wa nuruma abe kan ŋmani a cheŋ betta wie tomka po.

ref: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
text: Wensie wa varibasika a moata baai ale a chali yɔgsum ale wa tom kaasika la kama, ate wa pimpaukku ale sueri ti tɛŋa po.

ref: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
text: Ŋmanteka ale wensie ale tu chaab ate wayɔrisima ale suiyɔgni a puusi chaab.

ref: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
text: Wensie a nyini ka tɛŋzuk de ate wayɔrisima a kali wenŋmazuk a chuiri a nya.

ref: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
text: Naawen le sum te dii ale nala la, ate ti kaduksaŋa ŋandiintaŋa a bɛ.

ref: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
text: Wayɔrisima ale dɛ wa niŋ a cheŋ a gomsi wa suiku a te wa ate wa cheŋ.

ref: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
text: Naawen yaa, fi wom mu abe fi tulisi mu dii nyiŋla m wobsa kama ale jaŋ mɛ.

ref: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
text: Lik m nyuvunni a tanla, dii nyiŋla m pai m dek a te ka fi. Fi ale chim m Wen, be vari fi tomteerɔ waai ale ta sebchakka ale fu la a basi.

ref: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
text: M Nyɔnɔ, ta jiirim ale mu, ale m kasim a wi ka fi yuenni dai meena.

ref: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
text: Te mi fi tomteerɔwa masim dii nyiŋla m pai nyuvunni ate ka fi m Nyɔnɔ.

ref: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
text: Fi ka Nyɔnɔ maŋ ale vɔŋ a te nuruba. Fi ta ka ŋmanteka yega a te baai meena ale a wi fi la.

ref: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
text: Dai dii danni ate ku a miri mu la, m le wi fu dii nyiŋla fi le tulisi mu.

ref: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
text: M Nyɔnɔ, tɛŋsaŋa meena ate fi nye la, ale jam a kali fi tɛŋ a zuli fu, si le pai zula a te fi yuenni,

ref: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
text: dii nyiŋla fi ka tanjaŋini ale a tom wakinkagla. Ka fi nyiini ale Naawen.

ref: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
text: Naawen yaa, sak mu fi suiku, ate m cheŋ fi wensieŋa po, te mu popoli yena, ate m pai zula a te fi yuenni.

ref: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
text: M Nyɔnɔ Naawen yaa, m le pak fu ale m suinum meena. Mi le zuli fi yuenni taam wuu,

ref: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
text: dii nyiŋla fi ta ŋmanteka yega ale mu, fi dari mu kum vɔrup po a yeeri.

ref: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
text: Wen yaa, nuru baataŋa a potim m nyiŋ. Nin pagra nyam a yaa ba ko mu, baai niŋ ale kan bo ale fu la a yaa ba ko mu.

ref: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
text: Alege M Nyɔnɔ, fi ka jiirim nyɔnɔ ale ŋman chim Wen dii ale ta yaalika. Fi sui an kan puuri a wuli. Fi ŋmanteka mɛ a ka bain ya fi wensieŋa mɛ piisi.

ref: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
text: Tulim jam m jigi a ta jiirim ale mu pai fi pagrimu a te fi tomteerɔwa, abe fi vari fi bi kaai ale ta siaka ale fu la a basi.

ref: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
text: Nye wari dek ate m dachaasaŋa a nya ŋa ate chivie a yik ba. Dii nyiŋla, ka fi, Naawen yaa, ale maari mu ale duŋ m sui a te mu.

ref: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
text: Wa nyubi wa tɛŋka nyubini ka guuk weleŋka zuk.

ref: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
text: Naawen a yaali Zayon nansuiŋtaŋa a gaamu Jekob bisaŋa ale bo juijui meena la kama.

ref: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
text: Wen tɛŋaa, ba biisi ka zula wie a te fu.

ref: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
text: <<M le weeni Arayab ale Babilon wie baai ale seba mu la suŋsuŋ, Nya Filistia ale Taaya ale Kus ale weeni ayen, <Ba biak wade ka Zayon tɛŋka.> >>

ref: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
text: M ba le weeni Zayon po ayen, <<Nyawa de ale nyawa de ba biak ba ka Zayon po. Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La dek abe le yik wa a kali.>>

ref: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
text: Naawen le ŋmarisi nuruma yue gbaŋka po ayen, <<Nyawa de ba biak wa ka Zayon po.>>

ref: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
text: Ase ba ale a lenni yiila la ba le gɔk, <<Ti niauŋku meena a bo ka Naawen jigi.>>

ref: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
text: Naawen yaa, fi ale Wen dii ale kasim a vari mu a basi la. Yok ale kantueŋ meena m kaari a wi fu.

ref: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
text: M puusaŋa abe paari fu ate fi lak turi a wom m kaarika,

ref: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
text: dii nyiŋla m chiika a sueri ale ka wamirima ate kum nyiini a yaa moata mu.

ref: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
text: Fi ta mu siŋ gu ka vɔrup po, vɔrup buui ale limisa ale chim legi.

ref: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
text: Fi suipuurum a dobra m zuk, fi suipuurumu a gilim mu ase ka viok la.

ref: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
text: M ninaŋa yaa kum a jiak kama. Naawen yaa, daa meena mi a wi fu m zak nisa a sak fu.

ref: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
text: Fi a tom fi wakinkaglaŋa ka kpieba zuk moa? Baai le kpi la le baga yiti pak fu?

ref: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
text: Baai le kpi la a biisi fi ŋmanteka wie? Ba a biisi fi wensieŋa wieŋa kpiluŋŋoa?

ref: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
text: Ba seba fi wakinkaglaŋa wie juijui ale ka legi la po? Yaa ba seba fi wayɔrisimaŋa tɛŋ kaai nuruba le kpi nueri ate ba baŋ ka wie la po?

ref: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
text: Naawen yaa, ka boan dek chekki nyiŋ ate fi a zɛri mu ale cheem ŋaaŋ a te mu?

ref: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
text: A nyini m buli, mi kasim a nam kama a nye m kpi. M yaa jiak kama ale fi ale namsi mu la, m ŋman ka maarɔ.

ref: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
text: Fi suipuurumu buk mu ka nna kuligi fi wapagriŋa ate fi pai tu mu la a kaasi mu kama.

ref: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
text: Fi basi ate baai ale a bani mu la ale baai ale a yaali mu la meena a zɛri mu, mi ale maliŋ baai la a bo ka legi po.

ref: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
text: M le pai Naawen ŋmanteka a leni yiili taam wuu m le pai m nɔnni a biisi fi wensieŋa wieŋa a sak gaŋsa meena wuu.

ref: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
text: M le weeni sak nuruba ayen fi ŋmanteka a za ka giŋŋ taam wuu, fi wensieŋa mɛ a bo wenŋmazukku dek po.

ref: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
text: Fi weeni ayen, <<Mi nye ka nɔiyeŋ ale waai ate mi lueri la, m pɛ te m tomteerɔwa Deevid,

ref: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
text: Naawen yaa, wenŋmazuk nuruma a pak fu fi wakinkaglaŋa nyiŋ, nuruma a pak fu fi wensieŋa nyiŋ, nuru weleŋsaŋa ale tigsi chaab la niŋ.

ref: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
text: Baai meena ale chim Wen maarɔba tigsuŋ kpioŋku po la a chali Wen yɔgsum ka nna yegayega, ba a chali ka wa lala yɔgsum a gaam baai meena ale za gilim wa la.

ref: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
text: Naawen yaa, Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, ka wana ale ta pagrim ase fi la? Naawen yaa, fi wensieŋa a gilim fu.

ref: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
text: Fi bugsi Arayab ase ka baai ate ba ko la fi pai fi ni sii ale pagra la a kati fi dachaasaŋa a waaŋ.

ref: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
text: Wenŋmazuk ka fi ale soa, tɛŋzuk de mɛ ka dila, jaab meena ale bo tɛŋka po la ka fi la soa, fi le nye ba meena.

ref: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
text: Fi le nye yeseoku ale wiilukku, Tabor guuku ale Yermon guuku a leni yiila ale popeentik a seni fi yuenni.

ref: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
text: Wayɔrisima ale nyemagsika ale chim fi naam zukpaglika nyubini, ŋmanteka ale wensie ale bo fi jigi.

ref: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
text: Suipeentik a bo le ka nuru baai ale seba fi pakka la. Naawen yaa, basi ate ba bo fi bolimu po.

ref: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
text: Ba a naŋ fi yuenni nyiŋ daa meena, ale a pak fu fi wayɔrisimaŋa po,

ref: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
text: dii nyiŋla, ka fi ale ba pimpauk ale ba pagrim fi jiirim nyiŋ ale soa ate ti ta pagrim.

ref: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
text: Wensie ti jachɔgsimu ka Naawen ale soa. Ka Izirali Waai Ale Welema La ale soa ti naawa.

ref: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
text: Gɔdaasima po fi jam biisi ale fi nuruma baai ale a puusi fu la. Fi weeni ayen, mi te tugurik tɔŋdɔwa ka pagrim, m zak ka nuru paalik a nyini m nuruma po.

ref: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
text: M le bobi wa tanla ale wensie, m nisa ale te wa pagrim.

ref: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
text: Dachiak an kan baga a fɛ wa ate wa siak a te wa, nuru biok karo wa fɛ wa.

ref: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
text: M le num wa dachaasa ate wa nina nya abe m nak wa kisidɔma a lɔnsi.

ref: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
text: M wensie ale ŋmanteka ale bo ale wa, abe m pai m yuenni nyiŋ a zak wa pagrimu a zaani.

ref: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
text: M le pai nyiam kpioŋku a nyo wa nisima po, m le pai belaŋa a te wa.

ref: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
text: Wa le wi mu a weeni ayen, <Fi ka m Ko, m Wen, ale chim Piuŋku kuui ale chim m Varibasidɔ la.>

ref: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
text: M le basi ate wa a chim m bikpagi, naab kpioŋ tɛŋzuk meena.

ref: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
text: M le ta m ŋmanteka ale wa diipo meena wuu, nɔiyeŋ kaai ate ti dueni ale chaab la a ka maari a kaasi.

ref: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
text: Mi le basi ate wa ŋaaŋbisa tomini a boro taam wuu, wa naam zukpaglika ale boro ka dila ase wenŋmazuk ale boro diila.

ref: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
text: Wa bisaŋa a dan zɛri m sinsaŋŋa an va m buusaŋa,

ref: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
text: ba dan zɛri m ŋmarisika alege an ta m wieŋa,

ref: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
text: m le namsi ba ba biemu nyiŋ ale doari, ba kaasuŋku ale miiri ba.

ref: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
text: Alege m kan tuesi m ŋmanteka wa jigi, m bɛ kan pai wensieŋa a da diipo diipo.

ref: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
text: M kan kaasi m nɔiyeŋka yaase m basi m nɔnni ale weeni diila.

ref: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
text: M pɛ m weleŋsa nyiŋ, ayen m kan velim a te Deevid.

ref: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
text: Wa tomini ale kasim ka dila a cheŋ, wa naamu ale kasim boro mi niŋ ase ka wenbinni la.

ref: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
text: Alege fi zɛri naab waai ate fi lueri la. Fi sui ale a puuri nna yegayega ale waai ate fi a bobi la.

ref: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
text: Fi pai fi nɔiyeŋka ale wa a te kama, ale taŋ wa naam zutɔkka ale tanta.

ref: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
text: Fi wɛ wa parisaŋa meena a jo a kaasi, wa pari pagrisaŋa meena dueni.

ref: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
text: Baai meena ale a taam la vari wa, baai ale moata wa la a nye wa a la kama.

ref: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
text: Fi zak wa dachaasaŋa juka nisa, fi basi ate wa dachaasaŋa meena a naŋ.

ref: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
text: Fi yik wa gebika nɔnni a tulim fi an maari wa kpaliŋ po.

ref: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
text: Fi basi ate wa zulaŋa a kpeglim ale yuk wa naam zukpaglika a lɔnsi tɛŋ.

ref: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
text: Fi gebi wa bimbain daaŋa a basi, ale pai chivie garuk a lik wa.

ref: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
text: Naawen yaa, fi le suk fidek mi jigi a soa ka sɛ?

ref: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
text: Teeri m nyuvunni ale a kpabi diila. Fi nye nurubiik ate wa ka kiri ya.

ref: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
text: Ka nuru boa ale boro ayen wa kan nya kummoa, yaase wa vari wadek vɔrup pagrim po a basi?

ref: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
text: M Nyɔnɔ, fi nyiem ŋmanteka a bo ka be, kaai ate fi wensie po fi puulim ale Deevid la?

ref: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
text: M Nyɔnɔ, teeri fi tomteerɔma ate ba nye ba a la diila. Mi ale ji tɛŋsaŋa meena nye laka mi suinum po diila.

ref: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
text: Fi dachaasaŋa a nye mu a la la, Naawen yaa, ba nye waai ate fi lueri la a la kama juijui meena ate wa a cheŋ la.

ref: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
text: Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen jigi taam wuu! Ku be nye dila. Ku be nye dila.

ref: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
text: M Nyɔnɔ, fi ale chim ti boka jigi gaŋsa po meena.

ref: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
text: Alege ate fi nye guutaŋa yaase fi nye tɛŋka ale tɛŋzuk meena la, fi ka Wen. Fi kasim boro kama fi be le kasim boro kama.

ref: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
text: Fi tulim nuruba kama ate ba ŋman cheŋ tantaŋa po, a weeni ayen, <<Pilim cheŋ tantaŋa po, saalɔ bisa.>>

ref: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
text: Bena tusidi a nye ase ka dai yeŋ ale taam la fi jigi, yaase yok geli la.

ref: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
text: Fi vaari nuruba a basi kama ase nyiam ale mobi la, ate ba lo goom po, ba a nye ase ka saluik wuuk paaluk la.

ref: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
text: Ku le yiti saluik a chim wuuk paaluk alege ta cheen junɔi ku jak a kpi.

ref: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
text: Fi suipuurumu a kaasi ti kama ate yɔgsum a yik ti fi suipuurumu nyiŋ.

ref: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
text: Fi basi kama ate ti wabaataŋa a bo fi niŋ, fi nya ti waba susuŋŋa kama.

ref: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
text: Ti daaŋa meena a taam kama fi suipuurumu nyiŋ, ti nueri ti benaŋa kama ale kumsa.

ref: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
text: Ti benaŋa meena tɛŋzuk de ka pisiyopɔi yaase pinaanuŋ, dila bi ka ti ni poom ta pagrim, alege ŋa woglimmu a kasim sueri ale ka daanika ale suipuuta, ŋa kan bola a ben ale paarika, ŋa taam ka na nwuli.

ref: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
text: Ka wana ale seba fi suipuurum pagrim ale soa diila? Fi suipuurum pagrimu a zuak ase ka ba le magsi ayen ba chali fu yɔgsum diila.

ref: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
text: Sak ti ate ti chiini ti daaŋa, ti dan chiini ŋa ti le ta yam.

ref: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
text: Basi ate ti chak saluiku ale fi ŋmanteka, ate ti yaa lenni yiila ale suipeentik ti daaŋa meena po a te fu.

ref: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
text: Basi ate ti nya masim a magsi chaab ale da ŋaai ate fi namsi te la, Ale da ŋaai ate ti nya biem la.

ref: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
text: Pa fi nyeelaŋa a sak fi tomteerɔma. Pa fi nalimu a sak ba bisaŋa.

ref: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
text: M Nyɔnɔ ti Wen yaa bi sak fi jiirimu ale ti niak ti nisima tuima, niak ti nisima tuima a te ti.

ref: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
text: Waai ale a kali Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La yɔgsummu po la, ale kasim a vuusi a chak kama Wen Dii Ale A Niak La yisuŋku po.

ref: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
text: Mi le weeni ayen, Naawen ka likka jigi, ale ŋman chim yepagrik a te mu. Fi ka mi Wen dii ate m ta sebchakka ale fu.

ref: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
text: Wensie wa le vari fu a ta nyini batta po a basi, wa le vari fu kum po a basi.

ref: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
text: Wa le pob fu ale wa kinkaŋŋa a tanla, wa wensieŋa ale ŋa chim fi ja kasim ale parik a gilim fu.

ref: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
text: Fi kan chali yok nyigsika, fi be kan chali pein ŋaai ate ba a tɔŋ kantueŋka la,

ref: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
text: yaase nyiŋtuila a nak fu legi po, yaase yuam buui ale a jam fi jigi kantueŋ la.

ref: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
text: Tusidi ale lo fi gauŋ, tusa pi (

ref: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
text: Fi le nya ale ka fi nina nyiini, a nya wabaata nyama namsika.

ref: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
text: Ase fi nin basi ate Naawen dii ale ka mi sukka jigi la. Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La a chim fi boka jigi.

ref: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
text: Dila nyiŋ biem kan paari fu, kaasuŋ a kan jam moata fi viuku.

ref: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
text: Wa le weeni wa maarɔma fi nyiŋ ate ba a nya fi zuk fi suitaŋa meena po.

ref: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
text: Ba le zak fu ta nisa po ate fi kan pai fi naŋ a nak tintain ya.

ref: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
text: Fi le tabi gbeŋli ale jinkpaŋ zuk, fi le tabi gbeŋli kpienni ale waamu.

ref: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
text: Naawen weeni ayen, wa le a yaali mi la nyiŋ, m le vari wa basi, m le lik wa diila, wa siak te mi yuenni kama.

ref: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
text: Wa le wi mi, ate m tulisi wa, m le bo ale wa daanika po, m le vari wa basi abe m zuli wa.

ref: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
text: M le te wa chak ale nyuvu woŋ, abe m sak wa m varibasika.

ref: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
text: Ku nala kama ate ti pak Naawen abe ti lenni yiila a seni Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La yuenni,

ref: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
text: abe ti dan goa yiti saluik ti biisi fi ŋmanteka wie, abe ti dan doa yok ti a biisi fi wensieŋa wie mɛ.

ref: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
text: Dii nyiŋla Naawen yaa, fi tom ka fi tuimaŋa ate ŋa peenti m sui. Fi nisa tuima nyiŋ mi ale lenni yiila ale suipeentik.

ref: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
text: Naawen yaa, fi tuimaŋa a zuak ya, ate fi popolaŋa mɛ a yalima.

ref: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
text: A ka popola nyama a zɛ, betaŋa mɛ a ka miŋka ayen,

ref: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
text: ase nyeka tuem nyama ale a pusi ase wuuta la ate biem nyam a nya boka la, ba le kaasi kama taam wuu.

ref: But you will rule over all of us forever,
text: Alege fi Naawen a nya zak zaan ka taam wuu.

ref: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
text: Naawen yaa, chichama a karo, fi za fi kaasi fi dachaasaŋa kama. Nuru baataŋa le waaŋ chaab.

ref: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
text: Fi te mu ka pagrim ate m pagra ase goa lalik koluk nyiili la. Fi kpiiri ka kpa maŋ a tagli mu.

ref: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
text: M nimbie a nya m dachaasaŋa chala m tue a wom m dachaasaŋa naŋkima.

ref: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
text: Wayɔrisima nyam boka a nye ase ka kpinkparuk la, ba le chim ase ka nyunyoŋ la Lebanon po.

ref: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
text: Naawen yenni po, ba le nya nyeboka tama Wenni dabiasaŋa po.

ref: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
text: Si dan poom kpaŋ, si le diem a yɔn yɔna, si le pusi va paalita.

ref: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
text: Ba yaa mooli ayen, Naawen a nala. Wa ka m piuŋ, wa ka gaasa.

ref: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
text: Naawen a dɛ naam, wa jo ka naam kɔlima. Naawen ta pagrim. Tɛŋka a feri paari kama, ka kan choa.

ref: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
text: Fi naam zukpaglika a boro a nyini ka dila po, fi ka dila taam wuu.

ref: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
text: Naawen yaa, nyakpientaŋa a wuuri, nyamiika a pagra kama.

ref: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
text: Nyakpientaŋa a nuem nyakpiemu nyamiisaŋa a pagra alege Naawen a pagra gaam di.

ref: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
text: Naawen yaa fi kaamka a kan tagri. Fi yenni ale kasim welema taam wuu.

ref: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
text: Naawen yaa, Wen dii ale a namsi la. Wen dii ale a namsi la nyini tuni kanjanta nyama dii ale magsi ba la.

ref: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
text: Yiti ŋmai, tɛŋzuk de buusa boorɔ a waali baai meena ale a nak suinum la ale waali kaai ale magsi ba la.

ref: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
text: Naawen yaa, ba namsi fi nuruma ba ta baai ate fi so la a tom ka kanpiinta.

ref: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
text: Ba a ko pukɔga ale nicham ale kpiŋsa.

ref: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
text: Ba biisi ba nɔngbaaŋa po ayen Naawen a kan nya ba ale a nye diila, ba weeni ayen Jekob Wenni niŋ karo.

ref: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
text: Naawen ale seba nuru popola, wa seba kama ayen ŋa ka kiriya.

ref: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
text: Naawen yaa, nuru waai ate fi a te wa turi darika ale a te wa fi sinsaŋŋa la a ta suipeentik kama.

ref: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
text: Naawen a kan jɛ wa nuruma a basi yaase wa zɛri ba.

ref: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
text: Buusa boka ale ŋman pilim bo a nyini wayɔrisima po, ate baai meena ale ka cheri ba suiniima po la ale va ŋa.

ref: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
text: Naawen a dan kan jam maari mu, ku ate kan beni m ti kpi ya.

ref: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
text: Naawen yaa, ase m dan weeni ayen, <<M sati,>> ka fi ŋmanteka ale a yik mu a ta.

ref: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
text: Daanika ale zuak a bo m po la, ka fi wieŋa ale te m chiika masim.

ref: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
text: Alege Naawen a chim ka yepagrik ale m Wen m piuŋ ate m suk wa po.

ref: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
text: Wa le tuni ba a magsi chaab ale ba biemu. Wa le kaasi ba, ba gaasaŋa nyiŋ. Naawen, tama Wenni ale kaasi ba.

ref: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
text: Ni jam ate ti lenni masim yiila a seni Naawen. Ni basi ate ti nuem a te Piuŋ kuui ale ka ti varibasidɔ la.

ref: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
text: Ni te ti jam wa niŋ ale jiam teka abe ti pak wa ale yiila leŋka.

ref: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
text: Dii nyiŋla Naawen ka Wen Kpienni wa ka Naab kpioŋ a zuak a gaam wena meena.

ref: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
text: Tɛŋka liuŋku a bo ka wa nisima po. Guuk kpientaŋa zukpattaŋa ka wala ale soa.

ref: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
text: Nyakpiemu ka wala ale soa, dii nyiŋla ka wa ale nye bu. Ka wa nisimaŋa mɛ ale nye tɛŋ kosikka.

ref: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
text: Wa ka ti Wen, ate tama chim wa nuruba ale wa piisa ate wa taa nya. Ni dan wom wa lueluku jinla,

ref: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
text: ni kan basi ate ni suiniimaŋa a pagra ase ni le jam nye dii Meriba ale Massaya sagni po la,

ref: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
text: juijui ate ni koma a nye mu nya la, ba be jam nya mi ale nye diila kama.

ref: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
text: Bena pisinaansi ate mi sui a jam puuri ale gaŋ kala. M jam weeni ba ayen, ba ka nuru baai ate ba suiniima an bo ale mi, ba zɛ mi suitaŋa.

ref: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
text: Dila ate m yaa jam ka ale m suipuurumu ayen, ba kan jo m vuusumu jigini.

ref: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
text: Leni yipaali a te Naawen tɛŋ meena demma. Ni lenni yiili a te Naawen.

ref: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
text: Ni lenni yiili a te Naawen. Ni pak wa yuenni. Ni mooli wa varibasika wie daa meena.

ref: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
text: Ni weeni wa zulaŋa a sak tɛŋsa meena po. Ni weeni wa wakinkaglaŋa ate nuru meena a wom.

ref: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
text: Dii nyiŋla Naawen a zuak ka nna yega ale magsi pimpauk. Ku magsi ayen waai meena a chali wa yɔgsum ale wa gaam wena meena kama.

ref: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
text: Dii nyiŋla tɛŋsaŋa meena wenaŋa ka bɔgta alege ka Naawen ale nye wenŋmazuk.

ref: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
text: Zula ale zuaka a bo ale wa kama, pagrim ale nalim a bo wa yenni po.

ref: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
text: Ni pak Naawen tɛŋsa meena tɛŋzuk de ni pak Naawen zulaŋa ale wa pagrimu,

ref: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
text: ni te Naawen zula ŋaai ale magsi wa yuenni la, ni ta tiirim a jam wa niŋ, ni puusi Naawen nalim weleŋsaŋa po.

ref: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
text: Ni puusi Naawen wa nalim weleŋsaŋa po. Nama tɛŋsaŋa meena, ni basi ate ni nyiŋsa a gɔg wa niŋ.

ref: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
text: Ni te ni nyiŋsa a gɔk wa niŋ tɛŋzuk de meena tɛŋka a feri paari kama, ka kan choa. Wa le bo nuruba meena buusa ale wensie.

ref: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
text: Basi ate wenŋmazukku a dɛ masim, basi ate tɛŋzuk de sui a peenti. Basi ate nyakpiemu a pilim nuem ale ŋan baai meena ale bo bu po la.

ref: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
text: Basi ate tattaŋa ale jaab meena ale bo ti po la a naŋ. Ate tiisaŋa meena ale bo sagni po la lenni yiila ale masim,

ref: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
text: Naawen ale cheen la nyiŋ si leni yiila wa niŋ. Wa cheen kama ayen wa bo tɛŋka buusa. Wa le bo tɛŋka buusa ale wayɔrisima ale wensieŋa.

ref: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
text: Naawen ka naab, basi ate tɛŋka a dɛ masim, basi ate satɛŋ sii ale yaalima la dɛ masim.

ref: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
text: Chiŋma ale legi nna kpitɔ ale gilim wa. Wa wayɔrisima ale wensie ale chim wa naam zukpaglika nyubini.

ref: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
text: Ka bolim ale a dɛ wa niŋ, a dɛ wa dachaasaŋa jigi meena.

ref: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
text: Wa nyaksika a nyiem nyaksi a gilim tɛŋka meena kama, ate tɛŋka demma nya ate ba nyiŋsa a gɔk nna pampam.

ref: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
text: Guutaŋa a nyaliŋ ase samparima la Naawen niŋ, waai ale ka Nyɔnɔ tɛŋka meena zuk la niŋ.

ref: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
text: Wenŋmazukku a mooli wa wayɔrisimaŋa wie, nuruma meena a nya wa zulaŋa.

ref: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
text: Baai meena ale a kaab bɔgta ale a kuulim ti nyiŋla ale jo chivie po. Nama wena, ni puusi Naawen.

ref: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
