text: Naawen yaa, Zayon demma a wom ale a dɛ masim, Juda tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa sue a peenti, fi buusaŋa nyiŋ.

ref: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
text: Naawen, ka fi ale Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La tɛŋka meena zuk, fi nya zak zaanika wena meena zuk.

ref: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
text: Basi ate baai meena ale a yaali Naawen la a kisi biem, dii nyiŋla wa nya wensie nuruma zuk ale yeeri ba a nyini nuru gaasa nisima po.

ref: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
text: Wa toati ka bolim ate wayɔrisima nyama, ale te baai suiniima ale nala la masim.

ref: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
text: Ni dɛ masim Naawen po, nama wayɔrisima nyama abe ni pak wa tuilum yuenni.

ref: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
text: Ni leni yipaali a te Naawen, dii nyiŋla wa tom ka wakinkagla, wa tuilum juga nisaŋa a tom varibasika a te wa.

ref: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
text: Naawen a basi ate nuruba a nya wa varibasika tuimaŋa, wa pai wa wayɔrisima tuimaŋa a sak satɛŋsaŋa.

ref: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
text: Wa teeri wa ŋmanteka ale wa wensie wieŋa ate wa tara ale Izirali demma la. Tɛŋka meena ale doa ga saari la a nya tama Wenni varibasika tuimaŋa kama.

ref: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
text: Ni nye nuem ka masim ate Naawen, ni lɔnsi yiila waaŋ ale masim a te wa.

ref: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
text: Ni leni yiila a te Naawen ale kpanuŋ, pai kpanuŋ a leni yiila.

ref: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
text: Peeri damunsa a pai padiak nyiili a nye masim nuemka a te Naawen dii ale ka Naab.

ref: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
text: Basi ate nyakpiemu a nuem, jaab meena ale bo bu po la, tɛŋka ale baai meena ale bo ka po la.

ref: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
text: Basi ate belaŋa a nak nichaala, abe guutaŋa a pilim chaab a lenni yiila ale masim.

ref: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
text: Basi ate ba leni yiila Naawen niŋ ale wa cheena kama ayen wa bo tɛŋka buusa, wa le bo tɛŋka meena buusa ka wayɔrisima po, abe wa bo nuruma buusa wensie po.

ref: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
text: Naawen a dɛ naam, basi ate tɛŋsaŋa nyiŋsa a gɔg. Wa kala wa zukpaglik kpieŋka zuk ŋanvutaŋa suŋsuŋ, basi ate tɛŋka a choa.

ref: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
text: Naawen dii ale bo Zayon tɛŋka la zuak ya, wa nya zak zaanika tɛŋsaŋa meena zuk.

ref: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
text: Basi ate ba pak fi yuei kpienni ale fi yuei naliŋka, wa ale welema.

ref: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
text: Naawa a zuak ya, wa a yaali ka wensie wa basi ate wensie a boro. Fi nye dii ale ka wensie ale nala la kama Jekob po.

ref: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
text: Ni zak Naawen tama Wenni yuei a zaani. Ni zuli wa, wa naam naŋtaata zukpaglika zuk, ale wa welema kama.

ref: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
text: Moosis ale Aaron a jam maa bo ka wa kaabteerɔma po, Samuel a jam maa pilim ka baai ale a wi wa yuenni la po. Ba wi Naawen ate wa tulisi ba.

ref: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
text: Wa kali chiŋmanni po a biisi ale ba, ba va wa sinsaŋŋa ale siak wa wieŋa ate wa te ba la.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
text: Naawen, ti Wen yaa, fi tulisi ba. Fi jam chim ka vɔŋteka Wen a te Izirali, fi poom jam namsi ba kama ba nye kaasuŋku nyiŋ.

ref: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
text: Ni zak Naawen tama Wenni a zaani abe ni puusi wa, wa tuilum guuku zuk, dii nyiŋla, Naawen, ti Wenni a welema kama.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
text: Tɛŋsaŋa meena a nuem ale masim a te Naawen.

ref: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
text: Puusi Naawen ale popeentik. Jam wa niŋ ale yi masik.

ref: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
text: Seba ayen Naawen ka Wen. Ka wa ale nye ti, ale soa ti. Ti ka wa nuruba pa ŋaai ate wa a wuuk la.

ref: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
text: Va wa nansuiŋtaŋa a jo wa dabaasaŋa po ale jiam teka ale pimpauk. Te wa jiam abe fi pak wa yuenni.

ref: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
text: Dii nyiŋla Naawen a nala ate wa ŋmanteka a boro taam wuu. Wa wensieŋa a kasim boro kama ate gaŋsa meena.

ref: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
text: Naawen m le leni yiili a weeni fi ŋmanteka ale fi wensieŋa wieŋa a te fu, m le leni yiili a pak fu.

ref: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
text: Mi ni yik m dek ate m kan tom kaasi fu, ka dai dina ate fi le jam a maari mu. M le bo bomaŋ m yenni po ale suinum weleŋ.

ref: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
text: Waai ale bo tɛŋka po a ta wensie la, m nina ale doa wa zuk ate wa bo ale mu, waai nyiini chelim ate nye kaasuŋ a ka wa jigi la ale wa tom a te mi.

ref: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
text: Nuru waai ale a tom pimpaasima tuima, ale a velim la a kan kali mi yenni po. Nuru karo a biisi venta wie ale a zaani mi niŋŋa.

ref: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
text: Saluik meena m le basi ate nuru baataŋa ale bo tɛŋka po la a nye diki, wabaata nyama buuni m kan te ba suik ate ba maa jo Naawen tɛŋka po.

ref: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
text: Kan suk fi nina ale mu diipo ate m bo daanika po la. Lak turi wom mu m dan wi fu tulisi mu nwuli.

ref: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
text: M daaŋa a muriŋ a bɛ kama ase nyuisa la, m kobaŋa a dɛ ase ka bolim kaala la.

ref: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
text: M suinummu a jak kama a ko ase wuuta la, ate m baŋ ŋandiinta dɛ ka wie.

ref: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
text: M kumsaŋa a basi kama ate m buk a bɛ ale a tali koba nyiini.

ref: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
text: M kan goa, m yaa chim ase ka nuim yeŋ ale kala gboŋ zuk la.

ref: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
text: Danni meena, m dachaasaŋa a le mu kama ayen m sui puuri baai ale kisi mu la a nye mu a la ale ka a te mu.

ref: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
text: M yaa pai ka buntuem a chim m ŋandiinta m pa ninyiam a gum nyiam po a nyu,

ref: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
text: M daaŋa a nye ase ka junɔi yisuŋ la, m jak kama a ko ase wuuta la.

ref: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
text: Alege fi, Naawen yaa, a kala fi naam zukpaglika zuk taam wuu. Fi yuenni ale nya teerika gaŋsa meena po.

ref: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
text: Ka tintanaŋa a nala kama a te fi tomteerɔma. Ka nyuŋku mɛ a nala a te ba.

ref: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
text: Tɛŋsa ale chali Naawen yuenni, ate tɛŋzuk de nalimaŋa meena nyiŋsa ale gɔg wa zulaŋa niŋ.

ref: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
text: Dii nyiŋla, Naawen le pilim sɛ Zayon tɛŋka, abe wa na nyini ale wa zulaŋa.

ref: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
text: Wa le tulisi baai ale a silim ŋanta la puusa. Wa kan zɛri ba puusa.

ref: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
text: Basi ate kude a ŋmarisi a te chum po gaŋka, ate nuru baai ate ba an diem biak la a pak Naawen.

ref: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
text: Naawen a nya tɛŋka a nyini ka wa wen weleŋka jigini po. Wa nya tɛŋka a nyini ka wenŋmazukku,

ref: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
text: ayen wa wom baai ate ba yik lik la kumsaŋa abe wa vari baai ate ba bo mini ba, ayen ba ko ba la a basi.

ref: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
text: ase nuruma ale naataŋa a nin tigsi ayen ba puusi Naawen.

ref: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
text: M nyuvunni po wa wɛ m pagrimu. Wa gebi m daaŋa a basi.

ref: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
text: Mi yaa weeni ayen, kan ko mu m daaŋa suŋsuŋsa po, m Wen yaa. Fi benaŋa a kasim boro kama gaŋsa meena po.

ref: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
text: A nyini piilimka, fi dueni tɛŋka nyubini ate wenŋmazukku a chim fi nisa tuima.

ref: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
text: Ba le kpi alege fi ale chim ka fi denni. Ba meena ale jiak ase garuk la. Ase gatta la ti nalimu ale nyini ate ti yeeri a yuk basi.

ref: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
text: Alege fi ka dila ate fi benaŋa a kan kpeglimu.

ref: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
text: Fi tomteerɔma bisaŋa ale nya boka dek fi jigi. Ba ŋaaŋbisa bisa ale nya zaana fi niŋ.

ref: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
text: M chiiga, pak Naawen, m ponni po ŋantaŋa meena pak wa tuilum yuenni.

ref: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
text: M chiiga, pak Naawen, kan baŋ wa nyuentaŋa meena wie.

ref: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
text: Wa ale vɔŋ fi biemu a te fu, ale tebi fi nyiŋtuilaŋa meena la.

ref: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
text: Wa ale da tuesi fi nyuvunni vɔrumu po a basi ale dari fu vɔrumu po ale te fi ŋmanteka ale jiirim la,

ref: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
text: waai ate fi chak ale fi kɔrisa ŋan maŋsa, dii le ku basi ate bi paalukku a ŋman pagra ase jiiruk la.

ref: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
text: Naawen ale a tom wayɔrisima ale wensie tuima a te baai meena ate ba a namsi la.

ref: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
text: Wa dak wa suitaŋa a sak Moosis, ale basi ate Izirali demma a seba wa le nye diila.

ref: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
text: Naawen ta ka jiirim ale yaalika. Wa sui a kan kpabi a puuri, wa ŋmanteka a zuak kama.

ref: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
text: Wa kan kasim a ŋma ba, ba kaasuŋ ku nyiŋ diipo meena, wa be kan ta sui ale ba taam wuu.

ref: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
text: Ase wenzukku ale yalima ale tɛŋka diila, wa ŋmanteka ka dila ale baai ale a chali wa la.

ref: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
text: Ase konni ale yalima ale yeniŋka diila, wa vɔŋ ti biemu a te ti ate ku nye a se ka dila la.

ref: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
text: Ase ko ale ta jiirim ale wa bisa diila, Naawen mɛ a ta jiirim ale baai ale a chali wa la ka dila.

ref: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
text: Dan ka nurubiik wa daaŋa a nye ase ka wuuk la, wa a nyaksi kama ase puuta ale za kaduk po diila.

ref: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
text: Vioku a dan fuk, ti a wiiri kama, ate waai an baga a teeri ti kuuni diipo diipo.

ref: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
text: Alege ta a cheŋ diipo meena Naawen ŋmanteka a bo ale baai meena ale a chali wa la kama, wa wayɔrisima tuimaŋa a bo ale ba bisaŋa bisa,

ref: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
text: Naawen naam zukpaglika a bo ka wenŋmazuk, ate wa naamu a nya naam meena zuk.

ref: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
text: Pak Naawen nama wa Wen maarɔma, nama baai ale zuak la, baai ale a nye wa yaalika la, baai ale a zuli wa wanni la.

ref: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
text: Pak Naawen baai meena ale bo wenŋmazuk la, nama wa tomteerɔma baai ale a nye wa yaalika la.

ref: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
text: Pak Naawen, wa tuimaŋa a pak wa juijui meena wa pagrimu po. Pak Naawen m chiiga.

ref: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
text: M chiiga, pak Naawen. Naawen yaa, mi Wenni. Fi zuak ka nna yegayega. Fi pai ka nalim ale zula a lik fidek ase garuk la.

ref: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
text: Wa pobi ka wadek ale bolim ase garuk la, wa dari wenŋmazukku ase gbain la.

ref: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
text: Wa dueni wa kiani chibsaŋa nyaataŋa zuk. Wa basi ate chiŋmaaŋa a chim wa toroko ale do vioku kiŋkaŋŋa.

ref: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
text: Wa basi ate vaata a chim wa tintomdɔba, bolim ŋaasa a chim wa tomteerɔba.

ref: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
text: Wa basi ate tɛŋka a za ka nyuba zuk, ka kan choa.

ref: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
text: Fi pai nyaata a lik ka ase garuk la, nyaataŋa a za a gaam guutaŋa.

ref: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
text: Alege fi le toariŋ la nyaata a chali, fi le na la ti yiri ga zi,

ref: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
text: ti chali va guutaŋa zuima, ti chali siŋ vaasaŋa po, juijui ate fi dak ayen ti cheŋ la.

ref: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
text: Fi dueni ka bain ate ti an baga a gaamu, ti kan ŋman lik tɛŋka diipo diipo.

ref: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
text: Wa basi ate nyiam a nyini bulisaŋa po a siŋ vooliŋsaŋa po, a chali a va guutaŋa suŋsuŋ.

ref: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
text: A te tɛŋka gɔi duŋsaŋa meena nyiam, bon waarisaŋa meena a kɔ si nyanyuila kɔm.

ref: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
text: Wenzuk nuinsa a yɔk si tugta nyaataŋa nɔi, a yi yiila tiisaŋa naŋsaŋa po.

ref: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
text: Wa a zaŋti guutaŋa a nyini kiani po, tɛŋka a chak ale wa nisa tuima nyuentaŋa kama.

ref: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
text: Wa basi ate wuuk a nyini ate niiŋa a dɛ ale pa ŋanborinta a te nurubiik ate wa kpa ate ŋandiinta a jam.

ref: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
text: Naawen tiisaŋa a nya zaŋti ka kama nalimnyiini, Lebanon nyunyoŋta ate wa vuk la.

ref: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
text: Dula ate nuinsaŋa a yɔk si tugtaŋa, jumbaliiruku ta ku yenni ka ti sii ale nye nna turɔ la po.

ref: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
text: Guwoŋtaŋa ka gɔi bua ale soa, pinaŋa ka suensa sukka jigi.

ref: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
text: Chiika ale a sak yoei ale wenkarik, wenbinni a seba diipo ate di a siŋ la kama.

ref: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
text: Fi le ta legi a jam, ate di a chim yok, ate tiisaŋa po duŋsa meena a nyiem dikdik.

ref: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
text: Gbeŋmaŋa a wuuri a yaali ŋanta ŋa yik, ŋa a gisi ŋa ŋandiinta Wen jigi.

ref: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
text: Wenbinni a pusi, ate ŋa zu cheŋ, ŋa ŋmani ga duak ŋa goomu jigini.

ref: then we go out to work until the end of day.
text: Ate nurubiik a yaa nyini cheŋ wa tuima jigi, wa bo ka wa tomka jigini a ga paari junɔi.

ref: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
text: Fi tuimaŋa a soa ka sɛ, Naawen yaa, Fi nye ba meena ale ka yam, tɛŋka a sueri ale ka ŋan baai ate fi nye la.

ref: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
text: Nyakpiemu ale la a dua, a labsa nna jabababa, ate fi le nye ŋan baai la a boro a ka chiina, ŋanvu tii ale ka ŋan kpeenta ale ŋan fiisa.

ref: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
text: Dula ate ŋaaruŋtaŋa a cheŋ niŋ ale ŋaaŋ, ate duŋ kperikaliika ate fi nye la a nyiem dula.

ref: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
text: Bade meena a nya ka fi ayen fi te ba ŋandiinta diipo ale magsi la.

ref: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
text: Fi dan te ba, ba tigsi. Fi dan lak fi nisaŋa, ba a chak kama ale ŋanmaŋsa.

ref: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
text: Fi dan suk fi nimbidiaka ku a daani ba kama, fi dan yeeri ba vuusumu ba a kpi kama a ŋmani a cheŋ tantaŋa po.

ref: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
text: Fi le tom fi Chiika la, wa nye ba kama, alege a basi ate tɛŋka a ŋman chim tɛŋ paalik.

ref: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
text: Naawen zulaŋa abe boro taam wuu, Naawen abe a naŋ wa tuimaŋa nyiŋ.

ref: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
text: Wa waai ale a nya tɛŋka ate ka a choa, waai ale a tiri guutaŋa ate ti a nyini nyuisa.

ref: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
text: Mi le yi yiila a te Naawen m boka po meena, mi ale tɔlim vua la, m le yi yiila a pak m Wenni.

ref: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
text: Mi ale a poli diila abe peenti wa sui, ase mi ale a naŋ Naawen niŋ la.

ref: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
text: Alege wabaata nyam abe muriŋ bɛ tɛŋka zuk, ate gaasa nyama kan ŋman boro. M chiiga, pak Naawen. Pak Naawen.

ref: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
text: Te Naawen jiam, a wi wa yuenni basi ate tɛŋsaŋa a seba wa ale nye diila.

ref: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
text: Leni yiila a te wa, leni pimpauk yiila a te wa, weeni wa wakinkagla nyeelaŋa meena te wa.

ref: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
text: Ta suipeentik wa tuilum yuenni nyiŋ, basi ate baai suiniima ale a gisi Naawen la a ta mariŋka.

ref: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
text: Zak nya Naawen ale wa pagrimu, kasim a gisi wa nimbidiaka diipo meena.

ref: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
text: Ni teeri wakperikaliisaŋa ate wa nye la wie, wa wakinkaglaŋa ale wa buusaŋa ate wa weeni la.

ref: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
text: Izirali wa tomteerɔwa ŋaaŋbisa, Jekob waai ate wa lueri la nidoabilisa.

ref: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
text: Wa ka Naawen tama Wen, wa buusaŋa a bo tɛŋzuk de meena kama.

ref: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
text: Wa a teeri wa nɔiyeŋka kama taam wuu, wanni ate wa weeni a te gaŋsa tusa la,

ref: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
text: <<Mi ale pai Keenan tɛŋka a te ni ase kauk kuui ale ku chim ni nitalim la.>>

ref: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
text: Ba ale jam kan soa diila, an sum soa diila, ale chim nicham ka po la.

ref: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
text: Ba jam bo ka tɛŋsaŋa po a tuinti, a nyini naam po a taam m bu po.

ref: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
text: Wa an jam basi ate nuru a daani ba, ba nyiŋ wa toariŋ nalima.

ref: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
text: Wa weeni ayen, <<Ni kan tiri mi ale lueri baai la, kan nye mi biisiteerɔma wari ya.>>

ref: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
text: Wa wi kɔm ate bu siŋ tɛŋka zuk ale kaasi ŋandiin tii ate ba te ba la.

ref: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
text: Ate wa tom nuru ate wa dɛ ba niŋ, Josefi waai ate ba pai da ase yɔma la.

ref: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
text: Ba muli wa naŋsa ale chɔrima, a pai wa ŋinni a su kuta po.

ref: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
text: Ate wa le jam weeni diila a jam nye, ate Naawen wanni a yaa jam sak ayen wa ta wensie.

ref: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
text: Naawa a tom a yeeri wa, nuruma kpagni a lak wa basi.

ref: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
text: Wa basi ate wa chim wa yenni kpagi, a nya wa ŋan baai meena ate wa soa la.

ref: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
text: Ayen wa a sak nabisaŋa wa le mariŋ diila abe wa a sak wa nisɔmma yam.

ref: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
text: Izirali yaa jo Ejipiti, Jekob a jam bo Yɛm tɛŋka ase ka nichaanɔ la.

ref: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
text: Naawen a basi ate wa nuruma a biak. Wa basi ate ba piisi nna yegayega a te ba dachaasaŋa.

ref: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
text: Baai suiniima ate wa tulim ate ba kisi wa nuruma, ayen ba zɔk a ta chaab ale wa tomteerɔwa.

ref: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
text: Wa tom Moosis wa tomteerɔwa ale Aaron, waai ate wa lueri la.

ref: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
text: Ba tom wakperikaliisa ba suŋsuŋ, wakinkagla Yɛm tɛŋka po.

ref: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
text: Wa tom legi a basi ate tɛŋka a sobi diila ba an jam zɛri wa wieŋa?

ref: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
text: Wa tulim ba nyaataŋa ate ti chim ziim, a basi ate ba jumaŋa a kpi.

ref: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
text: Ba tɛŋka a sueri ale buntua, ŋaai ale jo ba kpaŋŋa diin goamaŋa po.

ref: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
text: Wa biisi, ate nanjuŋsa nna vuun a jam, ate bumbuma a sueri ba tɛŋka meena.

ref: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
text: Wa tulim ba ŋmorukku ate ku chim ŋmoruk tana, ale nyaksika tɛŋka meena.

ref: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
text: Wa kaasi ba yɔnaŋa tiisaŋa ale kinkaŋsaŋa, a wɛ ba tɛŋka tiisaŋa.

ref: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
text: Wa biisi ate tintue jam, nanchoŋta a ka chiina.

ref: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
text: Ba dɛ ŋanta ale ta vaata la meena ba tɛŋka po, a dɛ ba tɛŋka ŋanta meena.

ref: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
text: Ate wa ko bi kpaŋŋa meena ba tɛŋka po, ba nidoama ale piilim biak baai la.

ref: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
text: Wa ta Izirali nyini, a ji ba ale kpana ale ligmɔniŋ, ba diinaŋa po waai an nye beya.

ref: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
text: Wa basi ate ka chiŋmari a teeri lik ba, ale bolim ayen bu a nya yok.

ref: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
text: Ba bek, ate wa ta yeŋsa jam te ba, a basi ate ba dɛ wenzuk ŋandiinta a chak.

ref: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
text: Wa lak piuŋku ate nyiam a na nyini, ase beli la bu chali kama gɔnni po.

ref: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
text: Diila wa teeri ka wa tuilum pumpuulimaŋa ate wa te wa tomteerɔwa Abrayam la.

ref: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
text: Wa ta wa nuruma a nyini ale ka suipeentik, baai ate wa lueri la ale suipeentik nuemka.

ref: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
text: Wa pai satɛŋsaŋa tɛŋsa a te ba ate ba tuesi ŋan baai ate nuru yonta a nam nya la,

ref: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: ate ba baga a ta wa wieŋa abe ba a kpesi wa sinsaŋŋa. Pak Naawen.

ref: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
text: Pak Naawen. Ni te Naawen jiam ale wa ka Naawen maŋ, wa ŋmanteka a boro kama taam wuu.

ref: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
text: Ka wana ale baga a mooli Naawen tuim kpiemaŋa, yaase wa weeni wa pimpaukku.

ref: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
text: Suipeentik a bo le ka baai ale ta wensie la, baai ale kasim a tom dii ale nala la.

ref: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
text: ate fi nuruma ate fi lueri la ale nya ŋan baai jigsi la, mi maa dɛ ba ale masim. Ate m maa dɛ ni tɛŋka masimu, a yaa gum baai ate fi tuesi la po a te pimpauk.

ref: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
text: Ti koma ale jam bo Ejipiti la, ba an poli fi wakperikaliisaŋa wari ya, ba an teeri fi jiirimu ale piisi diila, a yaa pai nyakpiemu, Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku nyiŋ a nye tukpari.

ref: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
text: Alege wa vari ba a basi wa yuenni nyiŋ, ayen wa basi ate wa pagrim kpiemu ba seba.

ref: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
text: Wa toariŋ Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku, ate bu kpeeri a ko, wa ta ba va liuŋku po a taam ase gɔi kosik po la.

ref: and drowned every one of their enemies.
text: Nyaataŋa a lik ba dachaasaŋa, ba wanyi mɛ la an vuuk ya.

ref: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
text: Ba yaa ta siaka ale wa pumpuulimaŋa a yaa yi yiila a pak wa.

ref: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
text: Alege ku an beni ya ba deri baŋ wa le nye diila, ale an limisi wa sinsaŋŋa.

ref: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
text: Gɔi kosikka po ba siak te badek yaalika, tɛŋ kaai ate nuruba karo la ba nye Wen a nya.

ref: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
text: Wa yaa te ba ba le bek a yaali diila, alege tom nyiŋtuila ate ŋa jam ba zuk.

ref: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
text: Ba viitaŋa jigini ba jam a dɛ nyuri ale Moosis ale Aaron, waai ate ba pai wa a te Naawen la.

ref: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
text: Tɛŋka a lagri a nɛ Datan, a gu Abiram nuruma.

ref: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
text: Ate bolim tɔti ba ŋaaŋviirɔma suŋsuŋ, bolim ŋiak a dɛ wabaata nyama.

ref: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
text: Yoreb ba nye ka naabiik a yaa puusi bɔgluk kuui ate ba nye ale kutuk la.

ref: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
text: Ba pai ba zulaŋa a tagri lalik mɛɛŋ, kaai ale a ŋɔbi wuuk la.

ref: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
text: Ba baŋ Wen dii ale vari ba a basi la, waai ale nye wa kpiema Ejipiti tɛŋka po la,

ref: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
text: Wakperikaliisa Yɛm tɛŋka po, ale wie ŋaai ale a nak kpaziim Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku nɔi.

ref: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
text: Wa yaa weeni ayen wa le ko ba, dan kan daa Moosis, waai ate wa lueri la, ale zaani wa le ba suŋsuŋŋa ayen wa yik wa suinni ate wa kan ko ba.

ref: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
text: Ate ba yaa zɛri tɛŋ masika, ba ka siaka ale wa pumpuulimaŋa.

ref: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
text: Ba jam a ŋuuni kama ba viitaŋa po, ba an wom Naawen nɔiya.

ref: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
text: Wa yaa zak nisa wen a pɛ ayen wa le basi ate ba kpi a lo gɔnni po.

ref: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
text: Ba pai ba ŋeeŋa a su Peor wenni Baal po ale kaab kaai ate ba kaab a te wena ŋaai ale kan ta nyuvoa.

ref: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
text: Ba gaasa tuimaŋa a basi kama ate Naawen sui a puuri, ate nyiŋtuila a na waaŋ ba suŋsuŋ.

ref: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
text: Alege Fineyas a yiti zaani nyiŋtuilaŋa nyiŋ ate ba kpesi.

ref: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
text: Meriba nyaataŋa jigini ba nye ate Naawen sui a puuri, ate daanika jam Moosis jigi ba nyiŋ.

ref: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
text: Ba jam zɛri kama a ta chaab ale Naawen Chiika, ate suipuurum wie a nyini Moosis nɔnni po.

ref: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
text: Ba an ko tɛŋsaŋa nuruma ase Naawen ale weeni ba diila,

ref: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
text: alege a gum chaab ale tɛŋsaŋa a maara nye ba le a nye ba wie diila.

ref: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
text: Ba jam maara a kaab ba bɔgtaŋa, ate ti jam chim baruk a te ba.

ref: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
text: Ba pai ba nidoabilisaŋa ale ba liema a kaab a te chichirisa.

ref: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
text: Ba basi ate baai ale kan seba wari la ziim a nyini, ba nidoabilisaŋa ale ba liema ziim, baai ate ba kaab a te Keenan bɔgtaŋa, a kaasi tɛŋka ale ba ziimu.

ref: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
text: Ba daŋ badek kama ale ba le nye diila, ba nyeelaŋa a kaasi badek kama.

ref: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
text: Dila nyiŋ Naawen sui yaa puuri ale wa nuruma, a kisi wa le soa baai la.

ref: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
text: Wa yaa pai ba a te tɛŋsaŋa, ate ba dachaasaŋa a nya ba zuk.

ref: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
text: Ba dachaasaŋa a namsi ba a basi ate ba siak te ba pagrimu.

ref: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
text: Ku nɔi yega wa vari ba a basi, alege ba kasim a kan wom wa nɔi ya ate ba cheŋ bɛ ba biemu po.

ref: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
text: Alege wa kpesi nya ba daanika, wa le wom ba kumsaŋa la.

ref: You kept your agreement and were so merciful
text: Ba nyiŋ wa teeri wa nɔiyeŋka, ate wa ŋmante kpieŋka po wa tagri wa popolaŋa.

ref: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
text: Ni kaari a weeni ayen, <<Vari ti a basi, Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la, tigsi ti a vari ti a basi a ta nyini tɛŋsaŋa jigi, ate tama ale te fi tuilum yuenni jiam, ate tama ale ta zula fi pimpaukku po.>>

ref: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
text: Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen, Izirali Wenni jigi, a kasim a cheŋ taam wuu. Ate nuruma meena jam weeni ayen, <<Ku be nye dila,>> ale <<Pak Naawen.>>

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
text: Pai jiam a te Naawen diila wa nala kama, wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila cheŋ.

ref: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
text: baai ate wa tigsi a nyini tɛŋsaŋa po la, a nyini kori ale yeniŋ, a nyini wiiluk ale yeseok.

ref: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
text: Kom ale nyanyuila ale jam ta ba, ate ba a jɔk ba nyuvooŋa.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Ate ba yaa kum wi Naawen ba daanika po, ate wa yeeri ba ta nyini daanika po.

ref: At once he brought you to a town.
text: Wa ta ba va suik yɔrisuŋ a cheŋ tɛŋ po juijui ate ba baga a kali.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: Basi ate ba pai jiam a te Naawen wa ŋmanteka ale wa wakperikaliisaŋa ate wa nye a te nuruba la.

ref: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
text: Wa basi ate nyanyuila ale ta baai la a chak ate kɔm ale ta baai mɛ la a chak ale ŋan maŋsa.

ref: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
text: Ba gela a kali legi po ale legi nna kpitɔ po, ate ligrɔba a nam ale kuta chɔrima,

ref: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
text: diila ba zɛri kama ale ta chaab ale Wen ale weeni diila ale zɛri Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La sinsaŋŋa.

ref: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
text: Wa yaa basi ate ba siak te ninam tuak, ba a nak naŋsa alege waai karo a maari ba.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Ate ba kaari a wi Naawen ba daanika po, ate wa yeeri ba ba daanika po.

ref: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
text: Wa ta ba nyini legi po a nyini legi nna kpitɔ po a nyini ale gebi ba chɔrimaŋa.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: Basi ate ba pai jiam a te Naawen wa ŋmanteka nyiŋ ale wa wakinkaglaŋa ate wa tom a te nuruba la,

ref: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
text: diila wa wɛ ka kutuk mɔnuŋ nansuiŋta alege wɛ kutuk biga a jo.

ref: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
text: Ba gela a ta tukpari nyeka suita a chim betta, a nam ale nyiŋtuila ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ.

ref: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
text: Ba kisi ŋandiinta meena kama ale torisi moata kum nansuiŋtaŋa.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Ate ba yaa kum wi Naawen ba daanika po, ate wa vari ba ba daanika po a basi.

ref: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
text: Wa tom wa wanni a tebi ba, wa vari ba vɔrumu po a basi.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: Basi ate ba pai jiam a te Naawen wa ŋmanteka nyiŋ ale wa wakinkaglaŋa ate wa tom a te nuruba la.

ref: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
text: Basi ate ba nye jiam kaabka tiirim a weeni wa tuimaŋa wari ale suipeentik yiila.

ref: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
text: Ba gela a nyini cheŋ nyakpiemu po kama ale ŋaaruŋta, ba jam ka geruŋdɔba nyakpientaŋa po.

ref: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
text: Ba nya Naawen tuimaŋa kama, wa wakinkaglaŋa liuŋku po.

ref: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
text: Wa biisi kama a siti va pagrika ate ku zak nya miisaŋa wen.

ref: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
text: Ti yiti kama a tigsi jueli wenŋmazuk a ŋman siŋ tɛŋ, ba kaasuŋku po ba nyiŋbiini a deri bɛ.

ref: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
text: Ba jam a ja kama ase dabugrɔba la, ate ba sebika meena jam chim kinla.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Ate ba kum a wi Naawen ba daanika po ate wa ta ba nyini daanika po nyini.

ref: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
text: Wa te ate va pagrika a yɔk ate nya miisaŋa a nye diki.

ref: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
text: Ba sue jam peenti kama ku le yɔk la, ate wa ta ba jam juijui dek ate ba a yaali la.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: Basi ate ba pai jiam a te Naawen wa ŋmanteka nyiŋ ale wa wakinkaglaŋa ate wa nye a te nuruba la.

ref: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
text: Basi ate ba zak wa yuenni zaani nuruma suŋsuŋ abe ba pak wa nisɔmma tigsuŋku po.

ref: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
text: Naawen a basi ate bela a kpeeri meena ale basi ate beli naŋsa nyiam a kan chali.

ref: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
text: Wa tagri tintain busuŋ tɛŋsa ate si ta bulisa ale nyiam tɛŋ kosisa ate si ta beli naŋsa ate ŋa nyiam a chali.

ref: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
text: Wa basi ate kɔm nuruba a kali dula, a sɛ tɛŋ ayen ba boro.

ref: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
text: Ba bori laŋsaŋa po ale vuk tiisa kaduksaŋa po a tigsi ŋanta nna yegayega.

ref: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
text: Wa niak wa nuruma, ate ba nya bisa nna yegayega, a lik ba niiŋa ta ate ŋa kan muuri.

ref: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
text: Ate badek ale soa diila a muuri, ate namsika ale kaasuŋ ale suipuurum a basi ate ba yik badek.

ref: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
text: Waai ale ka a yaali nuru kpienta wie la a basi kama ate ba a nyiem juijui ale kan ta suik la.

ref: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
text: Alege wa yeeri ŋanjaksaŋa ba ninam po ale basi ate ba dɔkdemma a piisi ase piisa la.

ref: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
text: Ate nuru maŋsaŋa nya a naŋ, alege nuru baataŋa a mum ba noaŋa.

ref: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
text: Nuru waai ale ta yam la, wa be wom wieŋa de abe wa poli Naawen ŋmanteka.

ref: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
text: M suinummu za ka nna giŋgiŋ, Wen yaa. M suinummu za ka giŋgiŋ. M ni lenni yiila a pak Fu.

ref: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
text: M chiiga, vaari yiti ŋmai, kpanuŋ ale baganiŋ, ni vaari yiti ŋmai. M le nak saluiku a yiti.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
text: M le pak fu, Naawen yaa, tɛŋsaŋa po. M le siak yiila a seni fu nuruma suŋsuŋ.

ref: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
text: Diila fi ŋmanteka a zuak kama, a jueli a gaam wenzukku, fi wensieŋa a jueli paari chiŋmaaŋa.

ref: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
text: Mi a zak fi yuenni ŋmai, Wen yaa, a gaam wenzukku, be te fi zulaŋa a tagli tɛŋka meena.

ref: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
text: Vari ti a basi abe fi maari ti ale fi juga nisaŋa, ate baai fi a yaali la a nya varibasika.

ref: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
text: Wen a biisi wa dɔkku po ayen, <<Pagrim po m le poori Sikiim abe m pai Sukkot Viaka a chari m nuruma.

ref: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
text: Gilead ka mi ale soa, Manasa ka mi ale soa, Ɛfraim ka mi kuta zukchin, Juda mi tachek,

ref: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
text: Moab ka mi chin narinni, Edom zuk mi tɔŋ m nuensiri, Filistia zuk mi kaari ale nakdeka.>>

ref: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
text: Ka wana ale wa ta mi jam tɛŋ kaai ale ta parik pagrisaŋa la? Ka wana ale wa dɛ mi niŋ a ta mu cheŋ Edom?

ref: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
text: Te ti maarika ate ti tu dachiaka, ale nurubiik maarika a ka kiri ya.

ref: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
text: Wen nyiŋ ti nya pagrim, ate wa lɔnsi ti dachaasaŋa tɛŋ.

ref: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
text: Wen yaa, fi waai ate mi a pak la, kan nye diki,

ref: and hateful things are said for no reason.
text: Ba gilim mi kama ale kisika wie, a siti mu alege daa wari ate m nye.

ref: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
text: Ba pai ka velimteka a tuni mi yaalika, alege mi ka puusa nuru.

ref: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
text: Ba pai ka biem a tuni mi nalimu, ale pai kisika a tuni mi yaalika.

ref: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
text: Lueri nuru biok ate wa ta chaab ale wa, abe waai ale a weeni ayen wa kaasi la a za wa juga.

ref: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
text: Ba dan bek wa, basi ate wa siak wa kaasuŋku, abe wa puusa a nye ale wadek.

ref: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
text: Wa daaŋa a kan soa diiya, nuru yoŋ a tuesi wa kpaŋtaŋa jigini.

ref: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
text: Wa bisaŋa a chim kpiŋsa abe wa powa a chim pukɔgi.

ref: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
text: Wa bisaŋa a chim baai ale nyiem a juisi, abe ba yiak ba ate ba nyini ba yie luemaŋa po a nyini.

ref: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
text: Waai ale pai ŋanta peem te wa a tuesi ŋan baai meena wa ta la, abe nicham a vari wa le nam nya ŋan baai la.

ref: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
text: Waai a kan te ŋmanteka a paari wa yaase wa sak jiirim ale wa bi kpiŋsaŋa.

ref: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
text: Wa ŋaaŋsaŋa ba gebi a basi, ba yueŋa kan maa bo baai ate ba za ba biak la po.

ref: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
text: Naawen a teeri wa koma wabaataŋa, wa mawa wabaataŋa kan maa duisi basi.

ref: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
text: Ba wabaataŋa kasim bo Naawen niŋ, ate wa gebi ba wari tɛŋka zuk basi ate waai kan teeri ba wari ya.

ref: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
text: Diila wa an maara a poli ŋmanteka, alege a vi ko ŋanjaksaŋa ale baai ale a silim ŋanta ale baai sue ale kaasi.

ref: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
text: Wa a yaali ka kikaasa kaka ku jam wa zuk, wa kan yaali niaka te ka, niaka abe yalima ale wa.

ref: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
text: Wa jo ka kikaasa ase garuk la, ate ku jo wa nyiŋka ase nyiam la, a jo wa kobaŋa ase kpaam la.

ref: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
text: Ku nye ase garuk ale vili wa la, ase chiak gbain ale bobi wa chiak taam wuu la.

ref: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
text: Kude chim Naawen tutuna a te baai ale a weeni mi kaasi la, tutuna a te baai ale biisi biem a te mi la.

ref: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
text: Alege fi Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen yaa, nye mu magsi fi yuenni nyiŋ, fi ŋmanteka nalimu po vari mu a basi.

ref: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
text: Mi jaŋ kama ale a silim, ate m suinummu po ku a nye ase m kɔni la.

ref: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
text: Mi muriŋ a bɛ ase ka junɔi yisuŋ la, a kpaanti mi a basi ase tintue la.

ref: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
text: Mi duna a gbariŋ kama ŋandiinta silim nyiŋ. Mi buk kama a tali koba nyiini.

ref: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
text: Naawen, mi Wen yaa, maari mu. Vari mu a basi a ta va fi ŋmanteka.

ref: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
text: Basi ate ba seba ayen ka fi nisa, Naawen yaa, ate fi pai nye ku.

ref: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
text: Dai dii dai ba le ka, alege fi le niak, ba dan siti ba le pai ba a nyo chivie po, alege fi tomteerɔwa ale naŋ.

ref: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
text: Baai ale a weeni ayen mi kaasi la ale jo chivie po, abe chivie a vili ba ase garuk la.

ref: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
text: Mi pai m nɔnni a zak Naawen yegayega, nuru boanni po m le pak wa.

ref: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
text: Naawen a weeni mi Nyɔnɔwa ayen, <<Kali mi juga nisa geŋ ate m ga basi ate fi dachaasaŋa a chim fi naŋsa tabika jaab.>>

ref: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
text: Naawen ale basi ate fi tachek kpieŋka a zaani Zayon teeri cheŋ, fi le dɛ naam fi dachaasaŋa suŋsuŋ.

ref: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
text: Fi tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale siak fi kpaliŋka danni. Ase saluik yokyok maglim la, fi nidoa paalukku ale nyini tuilum guuku zuk a jam fi jigi.

ref: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
text: Naawen a pɛ kama, wa abe kan tagri wa popolaŋa, <<Fi ka kaabteerɔ taam wuu, a ta Melekizedek nyeelaŋa.>>

ref: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
text: Nyɔnɔwa a bo ka fi juga geŋ, wa le ŋɔriŋ nalima wa suipuurumu danni.

ref: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
text: Wa le bo tɛŋsa buusa a pai kpieba a vi chaab alege a ŋɔriŋ tɛŋka meena niŋdeerɔma.

ref: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
text: Wa le nyu nyiam bulik po suiku nɔi, dila nyiŋ wa le zak wa zukku.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
text: Pak Naawen. M le zak Naawen a zaani ale m suinum meena, wayɔrisima nyama suŋsuŋ ale Naawen nuruma suŋsuŋ.

ref: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
text: Naawen tuimaŋa a zuak ka yega, baai ale a yaali ŋa la a poli ŋa wari kama.

ref: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
text: Wa nyeelaŋa ka zula ale nalim nyiini, ate wa wayɔrisimaŋa a boro ka dila wuu.

ref: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
text: Wa basi kama ate ba a teeri wa wakinkaglaŋa, Naawen ka ŋmanteerɔ ale jiirim nyɔnɔ.

ref: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
text: Wa a te baai ale a chali wa yɔgsum la ŋandiinta. Wa kasim a teeri wa nɔiyeŋka ka dila a cheŋ.

ref: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
text: Wa sak wa nuruma kama wa pagrim tuimaŋa, a pai satɛŋ yonsa tɛŋsa a te ba.

ref: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
text: Wa nisima tuimaŋa ka wensie ale nyemagsika tuima, wa wieŋa ka mariŋka wie.

ref: They are true and right and will stand forever.
text: Ŋa za kama giŋgiŋ a kasim a cheŋ wuu, ŋa be a nye ka yɔm ale wensie.

ref: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
text: Wa te wa nuruma ka varibasika, wa dueni wa nɔiyeŋka kama taam wuu. Wa yuenni a welema kama ale ta yɔgsum chalika.

ref: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
text: Naawen yɔgsum chalika ka yam piilimka, baai ale a va wa wieŋa la, a ta ka miŋ maŋ. Wa magsi ka pimpauk taam wuu.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
text: Pak Naawen. Waai ale a chali Naawen yɔgsum la, a ta suipeentik kama. Waai ale a nya masim yegayega a nyini wa sinsaŋŋa po la.

ref: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
text: Wa bisaŋa ale ta pagrim tɛŋka po, wayɔrisima nyama gaŋka ale nya niaka.

ref: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
text: Ŋanta taka ale jigsika a bo ka wa yenni po, ate wa wayɔrisimaŋa a boro ka dila wuu.

ref: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
text: Dan poom ka legi po bolim ale a jam a magsi wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa ale ŋmanteka ale jiirim ale wayɔrisimaŋa nyama.

ref: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
text: Nalim ale jam waai ale a te yegayega ale peem a te nuruba la jigi. Waai mɛ ale a nye wa wie ale wensie la jigi.

ref: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
text: Wensie wala choawa a kan choa, wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ ba kasim a teeri wa wari ka dila a cheŋ.

ref: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
text: Wa kan chali wabaata womka, wa yik wa suinummu kama, ale ta sebchakka ale Naawen.

ref: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
text: Wa kan yiili wa be kan chali yɔgsum, ku kpeglimka meena wa le nya pagrim wa dachaasaŋa zuk.

ref: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
text: Wa yarinti wa tiiritaŋa kama a te ŋanjaksaŋa, ate wa wayɔrisimaŋa a boro ka dila wuu. Ba le zak wa nyiini ŋmai ale zula.

ref: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
text: Gaasa nyɔnɔwa ale nya ate wa sui a puuri, wa le dom nyina abe wa muriŋ a bɛ, ba yiilaŋa a bɛ ka meena.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
text: Pak Naawen. Naawen tomteerɔwa ni pak wa. Pak Naawen yuenni.

ref: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
text: Ni basi ate Naawen yuenni a nya pimpauk yɔgyɔgla ale daaŋa meena.

ref: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
text: A nyini wenbinni pusika a ga paari di siŋka, Naawen yuenni a magsi di nya pimpauk.

ref: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
text: Naawen a zak wadek kama a gaam tɛŋsaŋa meena, wa zulaŋa a gaam wenŋmazukku.

ref: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
text: Ka wana ale a nye ase Naawen tama Wenni la, waai ale kali wa naam zukpaglika zuk wenŋmazuk la,

ref: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
text: waai ale koori a nya wenzukku ale tɛŋka la?

ref: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
text: Wa zagri ŋanjaksaŋa tanta po ale zagri baai ale a silim la buntuem po.

ref: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
text: Wa pai ba kali ale nabisa, ale ba nuruma nabisa.

ref: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Wa basi ate nipok waai ale kaa biak la a kali wa yenni po a chim bisa ma waai sui ale peenti. Pak Naawen.

ref: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
text: Izirali ale nyini Ejipiti a nyini la, Jekob yenni ale nyini nuru baai ale a biisi bi yoŋ po a nyini la.

ref: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
text: Juda a chim ka Naawen yenni, Izirali wadek ale soa.

ref: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
text: Nyakpiemu a nya a yiti chali, Jodan benni a deri basi chalika.

ref: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
text: Guutaŋa a chali ase padaasa la, pinaŋa a yɔk a zi ase pabisa la.

ref: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
text: Ka boa ale nye ya, nyakpiemoa ate fi yiti a chali, Jodan benni, a deri basi chalika,

ref: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
text: guuta, ate ni a chali ase padaasa la, pina, a yɔk a zi ase pabisa la?

ref: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
text: Tɛŋŋa, a choa Nyɔnɔwa niŋ, Jekob Wenni niŋ,

ref: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
text: waai ale basi ate piuŋku a chim bulik la, puŋ pagrika a chim nyiam bulisa la.

ref: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
text: Daa tama, Naawen yaa, daa tama alege fi yuenni a nya zula, fi ŋmanteka ale fi wensieŋa nyiŋ.

ref: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
text: Ka boa ate tɛŋsaŋa a weeni ayen, <<Ba Wenni a bo ka bɛ?>>

ref: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
text: Tama Wenni a bo ka wenŋmazuk, wa a nye ka dii ale a peenti wa sui la.

ref: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
text: Alege ba bɔgtaŋa ka kpana ale ligmɔniŋ, ate nuruba a nye ale ba nisima.

ref: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
text: Ba ta nɔi alege an baga a biisi, nina alege an baga a nya,

ref: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
text: ba ta tue, alege an baga a wom, nyue alege an baga a wom nyum,

ref: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
text: ba ta nisa, alege an baga a tiri jaaboa, naŋsa, alege an baga a cheŋ, yaase ba nye wai ale ba tutɔgtaŋa.

ref: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
text: Baai ale a nye ti la ale nye ase ka bɔgtaŋa la, ale baai meena ale ta sebchakka ale ti la.

ref: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
text: Izirali yeri yaa, ni ta sebchakka ale Naawen. Wa ale ba maarɔ ale ba ligrɔ.

ref: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
text: Aaron yeri yaa, ni ta sebchakka ale Naawen. Wa ale ba maarɔ ale ba ligrɔ.

ref: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
text: Nama baai ale a chali wa la, ni ta sebchakka ale Naawen, wa ale ba maarɔ ale ba ligrɔ.

ref: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
text: Naawen ale teeri ti abe wa niak ti. Wa le niak Izirali yenni, wa le niak Aaron yenni.

ref: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
text: Wa le niak baai ale a chali Naawen la, nuru fiisa ale nuru kpienta.

ref: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
text: Naawen a basi ate ni piisi, nama ale ni bisaŋa meena.

ref: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
text: Naawen, wenzuk ale tɛŋ meena Nyeerɔwa a niak ni.

ref: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
text: Wenŋmazuk niŋniŋŋa ka Naawen ale soa, alege tɛŋka wa pai te ka nurubiik.

ref: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
text: Daa kpieba ale a pak Naawen, baai ale a siŋ nna diki la.

ref: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Ka tama ŋan vuutaŋa ale a zak Naawen a zaani, yɔgyɔgla de ale daaŋa meena. Pak Naawen.

ref: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
text: Wa le cheem pai turi a tuk mi nyiŋla, m le kasim a wi wa kama mi le tɔlim boro la.

ref: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
text: Kum miisa ale liem mi, vɔrup popola daanika ale jam m zuk, daanika ale suipuurum ale nya pagrim m zuk.

ref: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
text: Ate mi yaa wi Naawen yuenni ayen, <<Naawen yaa, vari mu a basi.>>

ref: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
text: Naawen ka ŋmanteerɔ ale wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ, ti Wenni a ta ka jiirim nyiini.

ref: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
text: Be ŋman vuusi, m dek chiiga, diila Naawen a nala kama a te fu.

ref: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
text: Naawen yaa, diila fi ale vari mi chiika kum po a basi, m ninaŋa ninyaata po a basi, m naŋsaŋa naŋsa nakka po a basi,

ref: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
text: ate mi a baga a cheŋ Naawen niŋ, ŋanvutaŋa tɛŋka po.

ref: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
text: Mi ta siaka kama, dila la mi ya weeni ayen, <<Mi nya ka namsika nna yegayega.>>

ref: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
text: Ku le cha mi la po, mi yaa weeni ayen, <<Nuru bisa meena ka velimvendisa.>>

ref: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
text: Mi le nye ka sɛ a tuni Naawen wa wamaŋsaŋa meena ate wa nye te mi la.

ref: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
text: Mi le zak ka varibasika beerika ŋmai a wi Naawen yuenni.

ref: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
text: Mi le tuni m pumpuulimaŋa a te Naawen wa nuruma meena niŋ.

ref: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
text: Dii ale nala Naawen nina po la ale wa bisaŋa kum.

ref: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
text: Naawen yaa, wensie mi ka fi tomteerɔma, mi ka fi tomteerɔma, fi dɔklie biik, fi vari mi kama m chɔrima po a basi.

ref: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
text: M le pai jiam tiirim a kaab a te fu abe m wi Naawen yuei.

ref: I will keep my promise to you when your people
text: Mi le tuni m pumpuulimaŋa a te Naawen wa nuruma meena niŋ.

ref: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Naawen yenni dabaasaŋa po, ni suŋsuŋ, Jerusalem demma. Pak Naawen.

ref: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
text: Pak Naawen nama tɛŋsaŋa meena. Ni zak wa yuenni a zaani, nama nuruba meena.

ref: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Wa ŋmanteka ale ti a zuak ka yega, Naawen wensieŋa abe boro ka dila wuu. Pak Naawen.

ref: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
text: Pa jiam a te Naawen, diila wa nala kama, wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila wuu.

ref: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
text: Basi ate Izirali a weeni ayen, <<Wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila wuu.>>

ref: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
text: Basi ate Aaron yenni demma a weeni ayen, <<Wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila wuu.>>

ref: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
text: Basi ate baai ale a chali Naawen la a weeni ayen, <<Wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila wuu.>>

ref: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
text: Mi daanika po mi kaari kama a wi Naawen, ate wa tulisi mu a vari mu a basi.

ref: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
text: Naawen a bo le mu kama, m kan chali yɔgsummoa. Ka boa ate nurubiik a baga a nye mi?

ref: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
text: Naawen a bo le mu kama, wa ka m maarɔ. Mi ale nya m dachaasaŋa ale ka nakdeka.

ref: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
text: Fi dan suk fidek Naawen jigi a zunchoŋ fi le ta sebchakka ale nurubiik kama.

ref: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
text: Tɛŋsaŋa meena a gilim mi kama, alege Naawen yuenni nyiŋ gebi ba basi.

ref: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
text: Ba gilim mi kama jigi meena, alege Naawen yuenni nyiŋ gebi ba basi.

ref: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
text: Ba nye ka kukuluk a gilim mi ase see la, alege ba kpi nna nwuli ase munsa ba ju la, Naawen yuenni nyiŋ gebi ba basi.

ref: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
text: Ba tusi mi a ta ga ŋaaŋ ate mi boro ayen m lo, alege Naawen a maari mi.

ref: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
text: Naawen ka m pagrim ale m yiili, wa chim ka m varibasika.

ref: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
text: Suipeentik ale nakdeka ale a nuem wayɔrisima nyama viitaŋa po, <<Naawen juga nisaŋa a tom ka wa kpiema.>>

ref: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
text: Naawen juga nisaŋa a zak ka ŋmai. Naawen juga nisaŋa a tom ka wa kpiema.

ref: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
text: M kan kpi alege m le boro kama, a mooli Naawen ale nye diila.

ref: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
text: Naawen a namsi mi kama chekki, alege wa an pai mu a te kummoa.

ref: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
text: Lagri wayɔrisima tuoku a te mu, m le jo a pai jiam a te Naawen.

ref: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
text: Naawen tuoku ale nna kuui ate wayɔrisima nyama a va a jo la.

ref: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
text: Tintain dii ate seerɔma a zɛri la dila ale chim nyubini gugoruku tintain,

ref: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
text: ka Naawen ale nye kude, ku be ka wakperikaliik ti nina po.

ref: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
text: Dai dii dai ate Naawen a nye la ale nna, ni basi ate ti a naŋ abe ti sue a peenti.

ref: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
text: Naawen yaa, vari ti a basi, Naawen yaa, basi ate ti nya tidek.

ref: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
text: Niaka a bo waai ale cheena Naawen yuenni nyiŋ la. Ti a niak fu a nyini Naawen yenni po. (Matiu

ref: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
text: Naawen ka Wen, wa be le basi ate wa bolimu a nyaksi ti zuk. Tiisa vaata ale bo nisa po la, gum baai ale tom chaab la po a ga paari kuŋkuŋku nyiilaŋa.

ref: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
text: Fi ka m Wen, m le pai jiam a te fu, fi ka m Wen, m le zak fi yuenni a zaani.

ref: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
text: Pai jiam a te Naawen, diila wa nala kama, wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila wuu.

ref: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
text: Suipeentik a bo baai ale kan ta wakaasuŋ la jigi, baai ale cheŋ a va chaab ale Naawen sinsaŋŋa la.

ref: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
text: Suipeentik a bo baai ale ta wa kaamka la jigi ale a gisi wa ale ba suiniima meena la.

ref: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
text: Ba kan nye wari a kaasi, ba a cheŋ ka wa suitaŋa po.

ref: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
text: Fi pai ka fi wieŋa a dueni, ŋaai ale magsi ba va ŋa meena la.

ref: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
text: Ku le magsi ayen mi a va wa suitaŋa dii abe m zuli wa ŋmarisika.

ref: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
text: Dila ate m kan jo chivie po ase m nin poli fi wieŋa wie.

ref: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
text: M le pak fu ale suinum weleŋ ase mi ale a zamsi fi buusa maŋsaŋa la.

ref: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
text: M le zuli fi ŋmarisika, kan din bola a zɛri mu.

ref: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
text: Nuru paalik ale nye ka sɛ ate wa boka a welema? Wa nin boro a va chaab ale fi wanni.

ref: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
text: Mi a gisi fu ale ka m suinummu meena, kan basi ate m cheŋ bɛ abe m ge fi wieŋa.

ref: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
text: M pai fi wanni a suk ka m suinum po ayen m kan tom a kaasi fu.

ref: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
text: Pimpauk a cheŋ fi jigi, Naawen yaa, sak mu fi ŋmarisika.

ref: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
text: M pai m nɔnni a weeni buusa ŋaai meena ale nyini fi nɔi po a nyini la.

ref: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
text: Mi a naŋ kama fi kaamka nyiŋ ase waai ale a naŋ jigsika yegayega nyiŋ diila.

ref: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
text: Mi a poli ka fi wieŋa zuk ale a kpesi fi suitaŋa.

ref: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
text: Mi a yaali fi ŋmarisika, mi kan zɛri fi wanni.

ref: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
text: Nye nalim a te fi tomteerɔwa, ate m boro, m le zuli fi wanni.

ref: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
text: Lak m nina ate m nya wakperisa fi sinsaŋŋa po.

ref: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
text: M ka nichaanɔ tɛŋzuk de, kan suk fi wieŋa m jigi ya.

ref: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
text: Fi buusa kɔrisa ale kasim a dɛ m chiika daa meena.

ref: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
text: Toariŋ gaasa nyama, ate ba ka a te ba la ale baai ale nyini fi wieŋa po a nyini la.

ref: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
text: Yeeri mu laata ale kisika po, diila m ta fi kaamka kama.

ref: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
text: Kpaŋŋa a kali kama ale chaab a kaasi mi yuei, fi tomteerɔwa ale poli fi ŋmarisika zuk.

ref: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
text: Fi kaamka ka m mariŋka, ŋa ka m sagrɔba.

ref: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
text: Ba dueni mi ka tɛŋ tantaŋa po, lik m nyuvunni a ta va chaab ale fi wanni.

ref: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
text: Mi weeni m suitaŋa wie kama ate fi tulisi mu, sak mu fi ŋmarisika.

ref: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
text: Basi ate m miŋ fi wieŋa sakka, ate m yaa poli fi wakinkaglaŋa zuk.

ref: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
text: M chiika a jiak kama ale suipuurum, basi ate m ta pagrim a va chaab ale fi wanni.

ref: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
text: Lik mu pimpaasima wie po, ta ŋmanteka ale mu a ta va fi sinsaŋŋa.

ref: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
text: Mi lueri ka wensie suiku, mi pai m suinummu a basi ka fi buusaŋa jigi.

ref: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
text: Mi yik ka fi kaamka giŋgiŋ, Naawen yaa, kan basi ate ba pai mu a nyo chivie po.

ref: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
text: Mi chali a va ka fi wieŋa suiku, diila fi vari m suinummu a basi kama.

ref: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
text: Sak mu, Naawen yaa, ate m va fi ŋmarisika, ate m ta ka a ga paari kpeglimka.

ref: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
text: Te mu miŋka, ate m ta fi sinsaŋŋa abe mi a zuli ŋa ale m suinum meena.

ref: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
text: Dak mu fi wieŋa suiku, dula jigini ate mi a nya suipeentik.

ref: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
text: Tulim m suinummu a va fi kaamka jigi abe bu kan va butuem nyuenta jigi ya.

ref: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
text: Te ti m cheem m nina jigi abe m basi ŋan baai ale kan ta kiri ya, lik m nyuvunni a ta va chaab ale fi wanni.

ref: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
text: Basi ate fi le puulim diila a nye te fi tomteerɔwa, ate wa a chali fu.

ref: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
text: Yeeri chivieŋa ate mi a yiili ale yɔgsum la, diila fi buusa a nala kama.

ref: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
text: Mi ale a yaali fi wieŋa a soa diila, lik m nyuvunni fi wayɔrisimaŋa po.

ref: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
text: Fi ŋmanteka a jam m jigi, Naawen yaa, fi varibasika a jam a va chaab ale fi pumpuulimaŋa.

ref: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
text: Ate mi yaa tulisi waai ale a nye mi a la la, diila m ta sebchakka kama ale fi wanni.

ref: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
text: Kan chiak wensie wanni m nɔi po, diila m pai m yiila a basi ka fi buusaŋa po.

ref: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
text: M le kasim a zuli fi sinsaŋŋa kama a cheŋ wuu.

ref: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
text: M le kasim a cheŋ ka fasiyaa diila mi gisi nya fi wieŋa kama.

ref: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
text: M le biisi fi kaamka nalima niŋ m be kan jo chivie po.

ref: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
text: Diila m mariŋ fi wieŋa kama mi le a yaali ŋa la nyiŋ.

ref: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
text: Mi zak ka nisa a tuk fi wieŋa nyiŋ, ŋaai ate mi a yaali la. Mi a poli fi ŋmarisika zuk kama.

ref: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
text: Teeri fi wanni ate fi te fi tomteerɔwa la, diila fi te mu ka yiila.

ref: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
text: Mi suiyɔgni m ninammu po ale nna. Fi pumpuulimaŋa a lik m nyuvunni kama.

ref: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
text: Gaasa nyama a nye mu a la kama ale kan basi, alege mi kan cheem a basi fi sinsaŋŋa.

ref: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
text: Mi a teeri ka fi dipo buusaŋa, Naawen yaa, m be nya suiyɔgni kama ŋa nyiŋ.

ref: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
text: Suipuurum ale bobi mi wabaata nyama nyiŋ, baai ale zɛri fi sinsaŋŋa la.

ref: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
text: Fi ŋmarisika ale chim mi yiili wazuk juijui meena ate mi a goa la.

ref: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
text: Yɔkku mi a teeri fi wari kama, Naawen yaa, m be le ta fi sinsaŋŋa.

ref: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
text: Mi ale kasim a nye diila ale nna. Mi a zuli fi wieŋa kama.

ref: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
text: Fi ka m charuk, Naawen yaa, mi puulim kama ayen m le va fi wieŋa.

ref: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
text: Mi gisi fi nina kama ale m suinum meena, ta ŋmanteka ale mu a ta va chaab ale fi pumpuulimaŋa.

ref: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
text: Mi poli m suitaŋa kama a yaa tagri m chelimu a va fi kaamka.

ref: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
text: M le kpabi m kan beni a zuli fi wieŋa.

ref: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
text: Wabaata nyama a bobi mi ale ka miisa, alege m kan baŋ fi sinsaŋŋa.

ref: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
text: Yok suŋsuŋ mi a yiti kama a te fi jiam fi wayɔrisima buusaŋa nyiŋ.

ref: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
text: Mi ka baai meena ale a chali fu la doa, baai meena ale a va kaamka la doa.

ref: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
text: Tɛŋka meena a sueri ale ka fi ŋmanteka, Naawen yaa, sak mu fi ŋmarisika.

ref: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
text: Nye nalim a te fi tomteerɔwa, a ta va chaab ale fi wanni, Naawen yaa.

ref: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
text: Sak mu yam ale buusi maŋsa, diila mi ta siaka ale ka fi wieŋa.

ref: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
text: Alege ate mi nya ninam la, mi cheŋ a bɛ kama, alege yɔgyɔgla de mi a zuli fi wanni kama.

ref: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
text: Fi nala kama, fi be le a nye diila a nala kama, sak mu fi ŋmarisika.

ref: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
text: Gaasa nyama a pai ka venta a taari mu, alege mi ta fi wieŋa kama ale m suinum meena.

ref: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
text: Ba suiniimaŋa po ba ka ŋmanteka ale jiirimmoa, alege mi mariŋ ka fi sinsaŋŋa.

ref: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
text: Ku jam nala kama ate mi tu ninam ate m baga a zamsi fi ŋmarisika.

ref: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
text: Sinsaŋŋa ale nyini fi nɔnni po la ta tuilum a te mi kama a gaam kpana ale ligmɔniŋ tusa.

ref: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
text: Fi nisima ale nye mi ale tom mu chaab, te mu miŋka ate m zamsi fi wieŋa.

ref: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
text: Baai ale a chali fu la a dan nya mi ba sue a peenti, diila mi pai m yiila a basi ka fi wanni po.

ref: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
text: Mi seba Naawen yaa, ayen fi buusaŋa ka wayɔrisima, fi be namsi mu kama ale wensie.

ref: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
text: Fi ŋmanteka a chim ka m suiyɔgni, a ta va chaab ale fi pumpuulimaŋa ate fi te fi tomteerɔwa la.

ref: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
text: Basi ate fi jiirimu a jam m zuk ate m boro, diila fi sinsaŋŋa ate m mariŋ.

ref: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
text: Gaasa nyama a jo chivie po ba le nye kaasi mu alege daa wari ate m kaasi la, ale m le poli fi wieŋa zuk.

ref: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
text: Baai ale a chali fi la a cheem a jam mi jigi, baai ale a miŋ fi kaamka la.

ref: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
text: Mi a yaali ka m va fi ŋmarisika nalimnyiini, ate m kan jo chivie po.

ref: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
text: M jiak kama ale fi varibasika yaalika, alege mi pai m yiila a basi ka fi wanni po.

ref: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
text: Mi ninaŋa yaa jiak kama ale fi pumpuulimaŋa nyaasim, mi a weeni kama ayen, <<Ka dimpo ate fi ale yɔk mi sui ya?

ref: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
text: Mi a nye ase ka daam bunlɔk la a bo nyuisa po, mi kan baŋ fi ŋmarisika.

ref: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
text: Fi tomteerɔwa ale limisi a soa ka sɛ? Ka dimpo ate fi ale namsi baai ale a namsi mu la?

ref: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
text: Gaasa nyama a tu ka gola a magsi mu, ate ku kan va fi sinsaŋŋa.

ref: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
text: Ba tali ka maga ate ba yeeri mi tɛŋka zuk, alege mi an zɛri fi wieŋa.

ref: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
text: Lik m nyuvunni a tara a ta va chaab ale fi ŋmanteka, ate m zuli fi nɔnni po kaamka.

ref: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
text: Fi wanni, Naawen yaa, a kan kpegli, di za kama giŋgiŋ wenŋmazukku po.

ref: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
text: Fi wensieŋa a kasim boro ka dila a cheŋ gaŋsa po meena, fi nye tɛŋka kama, ate ka kasim boro.

ref: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
text: Fi buusaŋa a boro kama a jam paari jinla, ŋanta meena a tom a te fu kama.

ref: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
text: Fi sinsaŋŋa dan kan daa ŋaai ate mi a mariŋ, m ti kpi kama m ninammu po.

ref: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
text: Mi kan baŋ fi wieŋa, ka ŋa lala nyiŋ ate fi lik mi nyuvunni.

ref: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
text: Vari mu a basi, ka fi ale soa mu, mi gisi fi wieŋa.

ref: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
text: Wabaata nyama a limisi kama ayen ba ko mu, alege m le poli fi kaamka zuk.

ref: Nothing is completely perfect, except your teachings.
text: Wie meena a ta kpeglimka kama, alege fi wieŋa a boro ka dila.

ref: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
text: Mi ale a yaali fi sinsaŋŋa diila. Mi a poli ŋa zuk ka danni meena.

ref: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
text: Fi wieŋa a basi kama ate m ta yam a gaam m dachaasaŋa, diila ŋa kasim a bo ale mu kama.

ref: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
text: Mi seba ku po ka yega a gaam m sagrɔma meena, diila mi a poli fi kaamka zuk kama.

ref: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
text: Mi ta miŋka yegayega kama a gaam nisɔmma, diila mi a zuli fi wieŋa kama.

ref: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
text: Mi zak naŋsa kama biem suik po meena, ate m baga a zuli fi wanni.

ref: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
text: Mi an basi fi buusaŋa, diila fidek ale sak mi.
