ref: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
text: Mi nya miŋka kama a nyini fi wieŋa po, dila nyiŋ mi kisi biem suita meena kama.

ref: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
text: Fi wanni ka zeuŋ a te m naŋsaŋa, ale bolim a te m suiku.

ref: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
text: Mi pɛ kama alege a siak, ayen m le va fi wayɔrisima buusa.

ref: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
text: Mi nam ka yega, lik m nyuvunni, Naawen yaa, a magsi ale fi wanni.

ref: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
text: Naawen yaa, siak m jiam pimpaukku ale a nyini m nɔi po la, abe fi sak mu fi buusaŋa.

ref: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
text: M nyiem pai m nyuvunni a nyo ka m nisima po, m kan baŋ fi sinsaŋŋa.

ref: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
text: Wabaata nyama a bari ka baruk a magsi mu, alege mi an cheŋ bɛ alege fi wieŋa.

ref: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
text: Fi kaamka ka wie ŋaai ate m tuesi taam wuu, ŋa ka m suinum po masim.

ref: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
text: Mi suinummu a kasim bo ka fi ŋmarisika taka a ga paari kpeglimka.

ref: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
text: Mi kisi popola buye buye nuruba kama, alege mi a yaali fi sinsaŋŋa kama.

ref: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
text: Fi ka m ligrɔ ale m ja kasim, mi pai m yiila a basi ka fi wanni po.

ref: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
text: Nama waba nyeerisaŋa nna, ni cheŋ abe ni ge mi, ate mi a baga a ta m Wenni wieŋa.

ref: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
text: Maari mu a ta va chaab ale fi pumpuulimaŋa, ate m boro, kan basi ate m yiilaŋa a bɛ nna nwuli.

ref: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
text: Yik mu, ate m nya varibasika, m niŋ ale kasim bo fi ŋmarisika po.

ref: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
text: Fi a zɛri waai meena ale a basi fi ŋmarisika la kama, diila ba pimpaasimaŋa ka kinla.

ref: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
text: Tɛŋka zuk wabaata nyama fi a zɛri ba kama ase baai ale kan ta kiri la, dila nyiŋ mi a yaali fi kaamka kama.

ref: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
text: Mi nyiŋ ale a gɔk ate yɔgsum a ta mu, yɔgsum ale ta mu fi buusaŋa nyiŋ.

ref: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
text: Mi nye dii ale chim wayɔrisima ale wensie la kama. Dila la, kan basi mu a te baai ale a namsi mu la.

ref: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
text: Seba fi tomteerɔwa nyeboka, kan te gaasa nyama a namsi mu.

ref: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
text: M ninaŋa a jiak kama, ale mi ale a nya a yaali varibasika la, a nya a yaali fi wayɔrisima pumpuulimaŋa la.

ref: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
text: Nye ale fi tomteerɔwa a ta va chaab ale ŋmanteka, abe fi sak mu fi ŋmarisika.

ref: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
text: Mi ka fi tomteerɔ, te m nya miŋka ate m baga a miŋ fi kaamka.

ref: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
text: Dii nyiŋla mi a yaali fi wieŋa a gaam ligmɔniŋ kama, a gaam ligmɔniŋ naliŋ,

ref: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
text: ale dii nyiŋla mi a poli ayen fi wieŋa meena a nala kama, mi kisi sui kaasuŋ meena kama.

ref: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
text: Fi kaamka ka wakperikaliisa, dila nyiŋ mi a zuli ŋa kama.

ref: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
text: Fi wieŋa ate fi lagri la a te mu ka bolim, ŋa a te baai ale kan seba wari la miŋka.

ref: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
text: Mi lak ka nɔi a vuusi a kpeeri, a yaali fi wieŋa.

ref: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
text: Cheem mi jigi a ta jiirim ale mu, ase fi le kasim a nye dii ale baai ale a yaali fi yuenni la.

ref: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
text: Basi ate m cheŋ a magsi chaab ale fi wanni, kan te wabiok a nya pagrim m zuwa.

ref: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
text: Vari mu nuruba namsika po a basi, ate mi a zuli fi wieŋa.

ref: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
text: Basi ate fi nina a nyaksi fi tomteerɔwa zuk abe fi sak mu fi ŋmarisika.

ref: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
text: Ninyaata ale nyini m ninaŋa a chali, diila ba kan zuli fi sinsaŋŋa.

ref: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
text: Fi ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ, Naawen yaa, fi buusaŋa be ka wamaŋsa.

ref: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
text: Fi kaamka ate fi dueni la ka wayɔrisima, ŋa ka ŋaai ale ta siateka.

ref: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
text: Mi le a yaali diila a basi ate m jiak kama, mi dachaasaŋa a banti fi wieŋa kama.

ref: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
text: Fi pumpuulimaŋa m chamsi kama, tomteerɔwa abe a yaali ŋa kama.

ref: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
text: Ba zɛri mi kama ayen m daa waai ya, m kan baŋ fi wieŋa.

ref: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
text: Fi wayɔrisimaŋa a boro ka dila wuu fi sinsaŋŋa be ka wensie.

ref: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
text: Daanika ale sui kaasuŋ ale jam mi zuk, alege fi wieŋa ate mi mariŋ.

ref: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
text: Fi kaamka ka wayɔrisima a cheŋ wuu, te mu miŋka ate m baga a boro.

ref: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
text: Mi a wi ale ka m suinum meena, tulisi mu, Naawen yaa, ate m va fi ŋmarisika.

ref: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
text: Mi kaari a wi fu kama, vari mu ate m ta fi kaamka.

ref: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
text: Mi a yiti ka saluik yokyokwa a wi a yaali maarika, mi pai m yiila a basi ka fi wanni po.

ref: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
text: Mi ninaŋa lak a nya yokku ka dila ayen m baga a poli pumpuulimaŋa zuk.

ref: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
text: Wom m lueluk a ta va chaab ale fi ŋmanteka, lik m nyuvunni, Naawen yaa, a ta va chaab ale fi buusaŋa.

ref: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
text: Baai ale a zɔk gaasa zɔga la a moata kama, alege ba yalima kama ale fi sinsaŋŋa.

ref: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
text: Alege fi a moata kama, Naawen yaa, fi wieŋa meena ka wensie.

ref: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
text: Dipowa mi zamsi nyini ka fi kaamka po ate fi basi ŋa ayen ŋa boro taam wuu la.

ref: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
text: Nya m ninammu a vari mu a basi, ale mi an baŋ fi sinsaŋŋa wari ya.

ref: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
text: Biisi te mu a vari mu a basi, lik m nyuvunni a ta va chaab ale fi pumpuulimaŋa.

ref: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
text: Varibasika a yalima kama ale wabaata nyama, diila ba kan gisi fi ŋmarisika.

ref: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
text: Fi jiirimu a zuak kama, Naawen yaa, lik m nyuvunni a ta va chaab ale fi buusaŋa.

ref: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
text: Dachaasaŋa ale a namsi mu la a piisi kama, alege mi an basi fi kaamka.

ref: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
text: Mi a nya baai ale kan ta siaka la ale ka kisika, diila ba kan zuli fi wanni.

ref: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
text: Nya mi ale a yaali fi wieŋa diila, lik m nyuvunni, Naawen yaa, a ta va chaab ale fi ŋmanteka.

ref: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
text: Fi wieŋa meena ka wensie, fi wayɔrisima buusaŋa meena a kan kpeglim.

ref: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
text: Kpaŋŋa ale a namsi mu alege mi an kaasi wari ya, alege m suinum a gɔk kama fi wanni nyiŋ.

ref: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
text: Mi sui a peenti kama fi puulimka nyiŋ ase waai ale tuilum ŋanta la.

ref: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
text: Mi kisi venta kama alege a yaali fi sinsaŋŋa.

ref: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
text: Dai yeŋ po mi a pak fu ka naŋtuok nɔi buyopɔi fi wayɔrisima buusaŋa nyiŋ.

ref: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
text: Baai ale a yaali fi sinsaŋŋa la a ta ka suiyɔgni kpienni, jaab abe karo a basi ate ba a nak naŋŋa.

ref: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
text: Mi a limisi fi varibasika kama, Naawen yaa, ale a va fi wieŋa.

ref: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
text: Mi a zuli fi kaamka kama, diila mi a yaali ŋa kama nna yegayega.

ref: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
text: Mi a zuli fi wieŋa ale fi kaamka kama, diila mi suitaŋa meena fi seba kama.

ref: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
text: Basi ate m kumsaŋa a paari fu, Naawen yaa, te mu miŋka a ta va chaab ale fi wanni.

ref: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
text: Basi ate m puusaŋa a jam fi jigi, vari mu a basi a ta va chaab ale fi puulimka.

ref: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
text: Basi ate pimpauk a nyini m nɔi po a nyini, diila fi a sak mu fi ŋmarisika kama.

ref: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
text: Basi ate m nɔnni a pai fi wanni a yi yiila, diila fi wieŋa meena ka wayɔrisima.

ref: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
text: Basi ate fi nisa a gomsi m maarika, diila mi lueri ka fi wieŋa.

ref: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
text: Mi a yaali fi varibasika kama, Naawen yaa, m be mariŋ fi sinsaŋŋa kama.

ref: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
text: Basi ate m boro ate mi a pak fu, abe fi buusaŋa a maari mu.

ref: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
text: Mi cheŋ a bɛ kama ase posuk ale cheŋ a bɛ la. Gisi fi tomteerɔwa, diila mi an baŋ fi wieŋa.

ref: When I am in trouble, I pray,
text: Mi wi Naawen kama m daanika po, ate wa tulisi mu.

ref: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
text: Vari mu basi, Naawen yaa, m nɔi po venta ale pimpaasima po.

ref: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
text: Nama velimvendisaŋa, Naawen le nye ni ka sɛ? Wa le namsi ni ka sɛ?

ref: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
text: Wa le namsi ni ale tugurik tɔŋdɔ pein chɔrisa, ale bolim kaala.

ref: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
text: Mi ale bo ni suŋsuŋ la a bie ase ka m ni bo Mesek la, yaase m le bo ale Kedar nuruma la.

ref: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
text: Mi bo ale nuru baai ale kisi suiyɔgni la a beni ka yega.

ref: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
text: Mi ka suiyɔgni nuru, alege mi dan biisi, ba ta ka kpaliŋ.

ref: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
text: Mi zak zuk a nya ka guuta, mi maarika a nyini ka bɛ a jam?

ref: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
text: Mi maarika a nyini ka Naawen jigi a jam, wenzuk ale tɛŋzuk Nyeerɔwa.

ref: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
text: Wa kan basi ate fi naŋ a sati, waai ale a nya fi zuk la a kan goa,

ref: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
text: waai ale a nya Izirali zuk la, a kan goa a jɔgsi yaase wa goa.

ref: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
text: Naawen ale a nya fi zuk, Naawen ka fi yɔgsum a bo fi juga,

ref: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
text: wenbinni a kan nye fu wari kantueŋŋa, yaase chiika a nye fu wari yowa.

ref: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
text: Naawen ale lik fu biem meena po, wa le nya fi nyuvunni zuk.

ref: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
text: Naawen nya fi jamka ale fi cheŋka yɔgyɔgla de ale daaŋa meena.

ref: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
text: Mi sui a peenti kama ale baai ale weeni mi ayen, <<Te ti cheŋ Naawen yenni la.>>

ref: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
text: Ti naŋsaŋa a za ka fi nansuiŋtaŋa po, Jerusalem.

ref: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
text: Jerusalem ba se ase ka tɛŋ kaai ale yik nna giŋgiŋ a jo chaab.

ref: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
text: Dula ate diinaŋa a cheŋ la, Naawen diinaŋa, ayen ba pak Naawen yuenni a ta va chaab ale wa kaamka ate wa te Izirali la.

ref: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
text: Dula ate naam zukpagliksaŋa ale magsi buusa boka la a za, Deevid yenni naam zukpagliksaŋa.

ref: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
text: Puusi ate suiyɔgni a bo Jerusalem, <<Baai ale a yaali fu la jaab a kan nye ba wari ya.

ref: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
text: Suiyɔgni a bo ni parisaŋa po abe ni nalimaŋa yeeŋa po daanika kan boro.>>

ref: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
text: Mi suataŋa ale m doama nyiŋ, m le weeni ayen, <<Suiyɔgni a bo le ni.>>

ref: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
text: Naawen ti Wen yenni nyiŋ, mi a puusi kama ayen ni nya nidek.

ref: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
text: Mi zak a nya ka fi waai naam zukpaglika ale bo wenŋmazuk la.

ref: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
text: Ta jiirim ale ti, Naawen yaa, ta jiirim ale ti, ti yik tidek ale kisika ka nna yegayega.

ref: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
text: Ti yik tidek ale kanjanta nyama nye laka ka nna yegayega, ale gaasa nyama kisika niŋ yegayega.

ref: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
text: Ase Naawen daam nin kan bo ale ti? Izirali, tulisi,

ref: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
text: Naawen daam dan kan bo le ti ate ti dachaasaŋa a siti ti la,

ref: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
text: ba ti nɛ ti ka vuta ale ba suipuurumu ate ba ta ale ti la,

ref: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
text: nyiamu ate ji ti a ta cheŋ kama, bu ti lik ti kama.

ref: of high and roaring waves.”
text: Nya miisaŋa ate ji ti a ta cheŋ kama.

ref: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
text: Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen jigi, waai ale kan basi ate ba dari ti cheeri ale ba nyinaŋa la.

ref: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
text: Tama maarika a bo ka Naawen yuenni po, waai ale wenzuk ale tɛŋzuk Nyeerɔ la.

ref: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
text: Baai ale ta sebchakka ale Naawen a nye ase ka Zayon Guuku la, kuui ale kaa choa alege a boro taam wuu.

ref: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
text: Ase guutaŋa ale gilim Jerusalem la, Naawen mɛ a gilim wa nuruma ka dila, yɔgyɔgla de ale daaŋa meena.

ref: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
text: Wabaata nyama a kan kasim a nya wayɔrisima nyama tɛŋka zuwa, ba dan nye dila, wayɔrisima nyama dek ale nye biem.

ref: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
text: Naawen yaa, nye nalim a te baai ale chim nuru maŋsa la, a te baai ale a zuli fi sinsaŋŋa la.

ref: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
text: Alege baai ale cheem va biem suita la, Naawen ale yiak ba basi ale wabaata nyama. Suiyɔgni a bo ale Izirali.

ref: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
text: Naawen ale ta ligrɔma a ŋman jam Zayon la, ti jam a nye nna ase ka nuruba ale goa a daasim la.

ref: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
text: Laata ale jam bo ti nɔi po, suipeentik yiila ale jam bo ti nɔi po. Ate ba jam weeni tɛŋsaŋa po ayen, <<Naawen a tom ka wakpiema a te ba.>>

ref: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
text: Naawen a tom ka wakpiema a te ti, a te ti sue a peenti.

ref: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
text: Naawen yaa, basi ate ti ŋman nya tidek, ase Negev beli naŋsa la.

ref: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
text: Baai ale a bori ale ninyaata la ale che ale suipeentik yiila.

ref: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
text: Waai ale ji ŋanbuura a nyini a bori ale a kum la, ale pilim ŋmani ale suipeentik yiila, ale bobi boba a ji.

ref: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
text: Naawen a dan kan sɛ yeri ya, di seerɔma a nam ka kinla. Naawen a dan kan nya tɛŋ zuwa, limisidɔma a za ka kinla.

ref: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
text: Fi le yiti nwuli kinla, a kan jo goom nwuli, a nam a yaali ŋandiinta ayen fi che. Wa a te goom ka baai ate wa a yaali la.

ref: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
text: Bisa ka tiirim a nyini Naawen jigi, bimbaansa ka tutuna a nyini wa jigi.

ref: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
text: Ase peema ale bo tugurik tɔŋdɔ nisa po la, bisa ka dila ate nuru biak wa paalim po.

ref: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
text: Suipeentik a bo ka waai ale ta pee ŋala chaab yega la. Ba kan pai ba a nyo chivie po ase ba nin ta chaab ale ba dachaasaŋa nansuiŋku nɔi ya.

ref: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
text: Suipeentik a bo ale ka baai meena ale a chali Naawen la, baai ale a cheŋ wa suitaŋa po la.

ref: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
text: Fi le dɛ fi ninammu ŋandiinta, niauŋ ale jigsika fi le soa.

ref: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
text: Fi powa ale kasim a nye ase tiib buui ale a yɔn yɔna fi yenni po. Fi bisaŋa ale kasim a nye ase ti paalisa la gilim fi jazaanimu la.

ref: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
text: Nuru waai ale a chali Naawen yɔgsum ate wa niak la ale ka diila ale la.

ref: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
text: Naawen abe niak fu a nyini Zayon daa meena fi boka po. Fi le nya Jerusalem jigsika.

ref: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
text: Fi le boro a nya fi bisaŋa bisa. Suiyɔgni a bo ale Izirali.

ref: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
text: Ba namsi mu ka nna yegayega a nyini m biik po, basi ate Izirali a weeni.

ref: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
text: Ba namsi mu ka nna yegayega a nyini m biik po, alege ba an nya pagrim m zuwa.

ref: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
text: Ba gebi m ŋaaŋka kama a jo a te mu tuem nna ase ba kpa laŋ la.

ref: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
text: Alege Naawen ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ, wa vari mu kama wabaata nyam miisa po a basi.

ref: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
text: Baai meena ale kisi Zayon la, a viriŋ cheŋ ale chivie.

ref: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
text: Ba nye ase wuuk ale za gboŋ zuk la, ku a kpi kama ku kan nya suik a chim.

ref: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
text: Waai a kan nya ku a tigsi yaase wa vaari a bobi.

ref: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
text: Baai ale a taam la a kan weeni ayen, <<Naawen niauŋku a bo fi zuwa, ti a niak fu Naawen yuenni nyiŋ.

ref: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
text: Naawen yaa, m daanika suŋsuŋ m kaari a wi fu.

ref: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
text: Naawen yaa, ase fi a daa chiini wabaata a tara, M Nyɔnɔ, ka wana ale wa baga a zaani?

ref: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
text: Alege fi jigi vɔŋteka a boro kama, dila nyiŋ ba a chali fu kama.

ref: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
text: Mi a limisi Naawen kama, m chiika a limisi kama, m be pai m yiila a basi ka wa wanni po.

ref: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
text: M chiika a limisi Nyɔnɔwa kama a gaam limisidɔba ale a limisi saluik diila, a gaam limisidɔba ale a limisi saluik diila.

ref: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
text: Izirali demma, ni basi ate ni yiila a bo Naawen jigi, diila ŋmanteka a bo ka Naawen jigi. Varibasika meena a bo ka wa jigi.

ref: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
text: Wadek ale wa da tuesi Izirali ba wabaataŋa po a basi.

ref: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
text: Naawen yaa, mi pai kanjanta a basi kama alege cheem ŋaaŋ a te gaasa. Mi niŋ ka wakpiema po yaase wie ŋaai ale tua a te mu.

ref: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
text: Alege mi nina a sueri kama ale wari meena ale ta suiyɔgni. Ase biik ale dua nna diki wa ma nigoruk po la, mi suinummu po a nye diki ka dila.

ref: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
text: Izirali demma, ni ta siaka ale Naawen yɔgyɔgla de ale daaŋa meena.

ref: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
text: Naawen yaa, teeri Deevid wie ale pik ninam buui meena la.

ref: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
text: <<M kan jo m yenni po yaase m ga goom jigi ya.

ref: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
text: ate mi ga nya jigi a te Naawen, boka jigi a te Waai Ale Ka Jekob Pagrim Nyɔnɔwa La.

ref: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
text: Ti wom ku kama Efrata, ti jam ku zuk kama Jaar laŋsaŋa po.

ref: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
text: <<Basi ate ti cheŋ wa boka jigini, basi ate ti puusi wa wa naŋsaŋa tabika zukpaglika niŋ.

ref: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
text: Yiti, Naawen yaa, a jam fi vuusumu jigini, fi ale fi pagrim nɔiyeŋka dakanni.

ref: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
text: Fi kaabteerɔma wayɔrisima a lik ba, fi bisaŋa a yi suipeentik yiila.

ref: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
text: Fi tomteerɔwa Deevid nyiŋ, kan zɛri waai ate fi lueri la.

ref: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
text: Naawen a pɛ kama a te Deevid, wensie pɛ kaai ate wa kan ko basi, <<Fidek ŋaaŋsaŋa wanyi ate m le pai kali fi naamu zukpaglika zuk.

ref: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
text: Fi bisaŋa a dan ta m nɔiyeŋka ale sinsaŋŋa ate m sak ba la, ba bisaŋa ale kali fi naamu zukpaglika zuk taam wuu a cheŋ.

ref: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
text: Naawen a lueri Zayon, wa yaali ka dula a magsi wa boka,

ref: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
text: <<Mi vuusumu jigini ale nna taam wuu a cheŋ, dela mi ale kali naamu zukpaglika zuk, diila mi ale yaali ku.

ref: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
text: M le niak Zayon ale ŋanta teka yegayega, m le basi ate wa ŋanjaksaŋa a chak ŋandiinta.

ref: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
text: Mi le lik wa kaabteerɔma ale varibasika, ate wa bisaŋa a yi suipeentik yiila.

ref: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
text: <<Zayon m le basi ate nyiili a chim a te Deevid abe m zaani zeuŋ a te waai ate m lueri la.

ref: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
text: Mi le lik wa dachaasaŋa ale chivie, alege zutɔkka ale vuk wa zukku po la ale kasim a nyaksi kama.

ref: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
text: Ku le nala ale chim suipeentik dii ase suata a nin bo ale chaab ale nɔiyeŋ.

ref: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
text: Ku a nye nna ase ka tuilum kpaam ate ba pai kpiiri a nyo zuk po ate bu chali a siŋ teeŋka nyiŋla, a chali a siŋ Aaron teeŋka nyiŋla, a chali a siŋ wa garukku ŋinni nyiŋ.

ref: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
text: Ku a nye nna ase ka Yermon maglim ale a lo Zayon Guuku zuk la. Dula ate Naawen a te wa niauŋku la, ku ka nyuvuri taam wuu.

ref: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
text: Pak Naawen, nama Naawen tomteerɔ baai ale a tom yok Naawen yenni po la.

ref: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
text: Ni zak ni nisima wa yenni po a pak Naawen.

ref: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
text: Naawen, wenzuk ale tɛŋzuk Nyeerɔwa ale niak ni a nyini Zayon.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
text: Pak Naawen. Pak Naawen yuenni, pak wa, nama Naawen tomteerɔma,

ref: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
text: nama baai ale a tom Naawen yenni po la, ti Wenni Yenni dabiaka po la.

ref: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
text: Pak Naawen, diila Naawen a nala kama, yi yiila a pak wa yuenni, ale ka dila ale nala.

ref: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
text: Naawen a lueri Jekob ayen wadek soa, Izirali a chim wa tuilum jaab ate wa tara.

ref: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
text: Mi seba ayen Naawen a zuak kama, ayen ti Nyɔnɔwa a zuak kama a gaam wena meena.

ref: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
text: Naawen a nye ka dii ale a peenti wa sui la, wenzukku ale tɛŋka, nya kpientaŋa ale ti liuŋtaŋa po.

ref: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
text: Wa basi ate chiŋma a nyini tɛŋka kpeglimka jiga, a basi ate ŋmoruk a jam ale nyaksika ale basi ate vioku a nyini wa ŋanta yeeŋa po.

ref: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
text: Wa ko Ejipiti bi kpaŋŋa a lɔnsi, nidoaba ale duŋsa bi kpaga.

ref: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
text: Ejipiti demma, wa basi ate wa wakperikaliisaŋa ale wakinkaglaŋa a jam ni suŋsuŋ. Wa ta chaab ale Faaro ale wa tomteerɔma.

ref: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
text: Wa ko tɛŋsa yegayega a lɔnsi ale ko nalim kpiema.

ref: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
text: Amori demma naawa Siyon ale Basan naawa Og ale Keenan nalimaŋa meena,

ref: and gave their property to his people Israel.
text: ale pai ba tɛŋka a te ase nitalim la, nitalim a te wa nuruma Izirali demma.

ref: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
text: Fi yuenni, Naawen yaa, a boro ka taam wuu, fi yuenni, Naawen yaa, a va ka gaŋsa po meena.

ref: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
text: Naawen ale vari wa nuruma a basi abe wa ta jiirim ale wa tomteerɔma.

ref: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
text: Tɛŋsaŋa bɔgtaŋa ka kpana ale ligmɔniŋ, ate nurubisa a pai nisa a nye.

ref: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
text: Ba ta nɔi, alege an baga a biisi, nina, alege an baga a nya,

ref: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
text: ba ta tue alege an baga a wom, yaase vuusum a bo ba noa po.

ref: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
text: Baai ale a nye ti la ale nye ase ka bɔgtaŋa la, ale baai meena ale ta sebchakka ale ti la.

ref: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
text: Izirali yeri yaa, pak Naawen. Aaron yeri yaa, pak Naawen.

ref: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
text: Livai yeri yaa, pak Naawen. Nama baai ale a chali wa la, pak Naawen.

ref: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Pimpauk a nyini Zayon a cheŋ Naawen jigi, waai ale bo Jerusalem la jigi. Pak Naawen.

ref: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
text: Pai jiam a te Naawen, diila wa nala kama. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
text: Pai jiam a te wena meena Wenni. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
text: Pai jiam a te nyama meena Nyɔnɔwa. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
text: A te waai nyiini ale a tom wakinkagla la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
text: Waai ale pai wa miŋka a nye wenzukku la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
text: Waai ale pati tɛŋka nyaataŋa zuk la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
text: Waai ale nye bolim kpienta la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
text: Ayen wenbinni a nya kantueŋka la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
text: Ayen chiika ale chiŋmarisaŋa a nya yokku la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
text: A te waai ale ko Ejipiti tɛŋka bi kpaŋŋa la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
text: Ale ta Izirali a nyini Ejipiti demma po a nyini la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
text: Ale ni sii ale teeri ale pagrim la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
text: A te waai ale poori Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku buye la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
text: A ta Izirali a va bu suŋsuŋ a taam la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka,

ref: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
text: alege a chuiri Faaro ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma a nyo Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku po la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
text: A te waai ale dɛ wa nuruma niŋ a ta ba va gɔnni po la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
text: Waai ale ko nalim kpiema a lɔnsi la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
text: Ale ko nalim pagrisa la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
text: Ale ko Amori demma naawa Siyon la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
text: Ale ko Basan naawa Og la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
text: Ale pai ba tɛŋka a te ase nitalim la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
text: Nitalim a te wa tomteerɔwa Izirali la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
text: A te Waai ale teeri ti wari ba le nak a dɛ ti la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
text: A vari ti ti dachaasaŋa jigi a basi la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
text: Waai ale a te javuk meena ŋandiinta la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
text: Pai jiam a te Wen dii ale bo wenŋmazuk la. Wa ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka.

ref: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
text: Babilon belaŋa gauŋ ate tama kala a kum ti le teeri Zayon wari la.

ref: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
text: Dula jigini niak tiisaŋa zuk ti yaa pai ti kpantaŋa a yik,

ref: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
text: dula baai ale yik ti la a yaa bek ti yiilaŋa, baai ale a namsi ti la ayen ba a yaali suipeentik yiila, ba weeni ayen, <<Ni yi Zayon yiilaŋa dinyi a te ti.>>

ref: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
text: Ti ti nye ka sɛ a yi Naawen yiila tɛŋ chaŋka po?

ref: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
text: M dan baŋ fi wari, Jerusalem, m kan ŋman baga a nak kpanuŋku.

ref: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
text: M dan kan teeri fi wari ya, m giŋgeluŋku a maŋ m laŋtika, ase m nin kaa nya ase Jerusalem ka m suipeentik yegayega la.

ref: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
text: Naawen yaa, teeri Edom demma ale nye dii dai dii danni ate Jerusalem a lo la. <<Dari ka lɔnsi,>> ba le kaari weeni diila ale la, <<Dari ka lɔnsi ate ka lo paari ka nyubini.>>

ref: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
text: Babilon liewa, fi nya ka bominika a tuak kaasuŋ po. Suipeentik a bo le ka waai ale a tuni fu fi le nye ti diila.

ref: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
text: Waai ale vari buluataŋa a pai ba fɔbi pinaŋa la.

ref: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
text: Naawen yaa, m le pak fu ale m suinum meena. Wena niŋ m le yi fi pimpaukku.

ref: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
text: M tuk fi tuilum yenni nyiŋ a koori tɛŋ a pak fi yuenni fi ŋmanteka ale fi wensieŋa nyiŋ, diila fi yiti ŋmai a gaam ka jaab meena fi yuenni ale fi wanni nyiŋ.

ref: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
text: Mi ale wi la, fi tulisi mu kama, fi basi kama ate m tua ale ta suinum pagrik.

ref: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
text: Naawen yaa, tɛŋka zuk nalimaŋa meena a pak fu ase ba nin wom fi nɔnni po wieŋa.

ref: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
text: Ba siak Naawen suitaŋa yiila, diila Naawen zulaŋa a zuak kama.

ref: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
text: Naawen a bo ka ŋmai, alege wa a nya niwomma kama, alege kanjanta nyama an baga a suk wa.

ref: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
text: Mi dan poom a cheŋ daanika po, fi lik m nyuvunni ta kama, fi teeri fi nisa kama a ta chaab ale mi dachaasaŋa suipuurumu. Fi vari mu a basi kama ale fi juga nisaŋa.

ref: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
text: Naawen ale puulim diila wa le nye te mu. Naawen yaa, fi ŋmanteka a ka kpeglimka. Kan basi fi nisima tuimaŋa.

ref: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
text: Naawen yaa, fi kpesi nya mi kama a sebi mu.

ref: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
text: Fi sebi mu kama m nin kala ale m nin yiti, fi nyiem deri ŋaam sebi mi kama.

ref: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
text: Fi a nya m peelim nyinika ale m duaka, fi malim chaab ale m nyeka meena kama.

ref: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
text: Wari a dan ga bo m nɔi po ale fi poom seba di meena kama chessi Naawen yaa.

ref: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
text: Fi yik mu kama niŋ ale ŋaaŋ a tara, fi basi ate fi nisa a bo m zuk.

ref: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
text: Sebi kala ka nna kperikperik a te mu, a zuak gaam m taka.

ref: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
text: Mi ale cheŋ ka bɛ abe m ge fi chiika? Mi ni chali ga ka bɛ abe m ge fu.

ref: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
text: M dan jueli wenŋmazuk, fi bo ka dula, m dan siŋ tɛŋ a duak, fi bo ka dula.

ref: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
text: Mi dan poom yiti kali kantueŋka kiŋkaŋŋa zuk, m dan poom ga kali nyakpiemu po niŋniŋŋa,

ref: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
text: dula jigini fi nisaŋa ale gani mu, fi juga nisaŋa ale yik mu giŋgiŋ.

ref: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
text: Mi dan weeni ayen, <<Wensie legi ale lik mu ate bolimu a chim yok a gilim mu,>>

ref: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
text: legini a kan poom chim legi a te fu, yokku a nyaksi kama ase kantueŋ la, diila legi a nye ase ka bolim la fi jigi.

ref: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
text: Fi ale nye m popo meena, fi ale tom mu chaab m mawa ponni po.

ref: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
text: Mi a pak fu kama dii nyiŋla fi nye mu kama nna kperikperiga ale yɔgsum, fi tuimaŋa ka wakinkagla, mi seba dila a chak kama.

ref: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
text: Mi nyiŋ diokku an suk ale fu, fi le nye mi jigi susugi. Fi le nye mi a gum chaab m mawa ponni po,

ref: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
text: fi nina a nya mi nyiŋka ale kan diem nye la kama. Da ŋaai meena ale nye magsi mi la a jam ŋmarisi kama fi gbaŋka po alege ate dinyi mɛ la an jam ya.

ref: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
text: M Wen yaa, fi popolaŋa a ta tuilum kama. Ŋa piisi ka nna yegayega.

ref: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
text: Ase m dan poom ayen m chiini ŋa, ŋa le piisi a gaam tintain busuŋ. M dan poom yiti, m diem bo le ka fi.

ref: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
text: M Wen yaa, mi dek a yaali ayen fi ti ko m dachaasaŋa kama. Mi a yaali kama ayen gaasa nyama a basi mu m dek m nyiini.

ref: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
text: Ba biisi ka biem a te fu, fi dachaasaŋa a kaasi fi yuenni kama.

ref: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
text: Naawen yaa, mi an kisi baai ale kisi fu la kama yaa, ale kisi baai ale yiti a ta chaab ale fu la yaa?

ref: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
text: Mi din bola a kisi ba kama chekki. Mi a chiini ba ase ka mi dachaasa la.

ref: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
text: M Wen yaa, kpesi a nya mu, a seba m popolaŋa, chamsi mu a nya, ate fi seba m popolaŋa.

ref: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
text: Kpesi a nya ase biem a nin bo m po abe fi yaa gani mu fi suik kuui ale kaa kpeglim la po.

ref: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
text: Naawen yaa, vari mu nuru baata po a basi, lik mu gaasa nyam po,

ref: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
text: baai ale ta biem ba suiniima po a siti kpaliŋsa daa meena.

ref: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
text: Ba basi ate ba noaŋa a tua ase waab la, ate waapiisa yaam a bo ba noaŋa po.

ref: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
text: Lik mu, Naawen yaa, wabaata nyam nisima po, lik mu a ta nyini gaasa nyam baai ale a zɔk ba nye ate m lo la.

ref: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
text: Kanjanta nyam a bari ka baruk a magsi mu, ba dueni ba battaŋa, suiku po ba dueni batta ayen ti yik mu.

ref: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
text: Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen yaa, Naawen dii ale m varibasidɔ pagrɔ, waai ale a lik m zukku kpaliŋ dai,

ref: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
text: Naawen yaa, kan te wabaata nyama ba le a yaali diila. Kan basi ate ba le a zɔk diila a nye, dan kan daa di ba le ta kanjanta.

ref: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
text: Basi ate baai ale gilim mu la zuima a lik ale daani kaai ate ba noaŋa a nye la.

ref: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
text: Basi ate bolim kaala a lo ba zuk, ba yuk ba a basi bolim po, a basi bagta goluk po, ate ba kan yiti diipo.

ref: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
text: Mi seba ayen Naawen a maari niwomma ale a nya ŋanjaksaŋa wensie zuk.

ref: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
text: Wensie wayɔrisima nyama ale pak fi yuenni ate nuru maŋsaŋa ale bo ale fu.

ref: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
text: Naawen yaa, mi a wi fi kama, jam m jigi nwuli. Wom mu ase m nin wi fu.

ref: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
text: Basi ate m puusaŋa a nye ase ŋan baai nyum ale masa la, mi ale a zak m nisaŋa diila a nye ase ka junɔi kaabka la.

ref: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
text: Naawen yaa, basi ate waai a gani m nɔnni, a limisi m nɔngbanvaataŋa.

ref: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
text: Kan basi ate m suinummu a cheŋ biem jigi ya, ate m maa nye wabaata ale nuru baai ale ka nuru baata, kan basi ate mi a maa dɛ ba ŋandiinta tiŋŋa.

ref: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
text: Basi ate wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa a fɔbi mu, ku ka jiirim, basi ate wa toariŋ mu, ka kpaam ale kpiiri m zuk po. Mi zukku a kan zɛri bu. Alege mi puusi kama a kaasi biem nyama tuimaŋa.

ref: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
text: Ba kpaŋŋa ba le yuk ba ate ba nyini ka pinaŋa zuk a jam lo, ate wabaata nyama a miŋ ayen mi wieŋa mi biisi ka chekki.

ref: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
text: Ba weeni ayen, <<Ase waai ale a kpa a labri tɛŋka diila, ti kobaŋa ba kati ŋa waaŋ ka vɔrumu nɔi.>>

ref: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
text: Alege mi nina a kpi ka fi nyiŋ, Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen yaa, fi waai ale ta pagrim la. Fi jigi ate mi a suk, kan pai mu a te kummoa.

ref: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
text: Yeeri mu bari tii ate ba bari mu la po, bari tii ate biem nyam a bari.

ref: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
text: Basi ate wabaata nyama a lo badek neesaŋa po, alege ate mi a taam sɔŋsɔŋŋoa.

ref: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
text: Mi a wi ka Naawen a yaali maarika, mi a saalim wa kama.

ref: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
text: Mi ta m fɔbilika meena a jam ka wa jigi, mi weeni wa kama m daanika meena.

ref: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
text: Mi dan moata siateka, wa seba mi ale m nye diila kama. Suik kuui po ate mi a cheŋ la, mi dachaasaŋa a pai ka baruk a suk ku po a magsi mi.

ref: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
text: Mi dan cheem nya mi gauŋ, waai a karo a maari mu, waai a karo a lik mu. Nuru niŋ a ka mi po.

ref: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
text: Naawen yaa, mi a wi fu kama a yaali maarika. M weeni ayen, <<Fi ale mi ligrɔ, fi nyiini ale waai ate mi a yaali m boka po.>>

ref: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
text: Vari mu m likka po a basi, ate m pak fi yuenni. Ate wayɔrisima nyama tigsi a gilim mu fi wamaŋsaŋa ate fi nye te mu la nyiŋ.

ref: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
text: Naawen yaa, wom m puusaŋa. Fi wayɔrisimaŋa po wom m saalim ka, tulisi mu fi wensieŋa nyiŋ.

ref: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
text: Kan pai mi fi tomteerɔwa a zaani nyenyaka po, waai karo ayen wa zɛ kaasuŋ nɔi po fi niŋŋa.

ref: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
text: Mi dachiaka a vi mi kama a nak mi a lɔnsi. Wa pai mi a basi legi po ate mi a boro ase baai ale kpi dipo la.

ref: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
text: Dila la, mi gomsi magsi ka siateka, mi suinummu po ka daanika nyiini.

ref: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
text: Mi a teeri ka dipo daaŋa, mi a poli ka fi tuimaŋa meena zuk alege a poli mɛ fi nisimaŋa ale tom diila.

ref: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
text: Mi zak ka nisima wen a puusi a te fu, ase tɛŋ kosik la nyanyuila ale ta m chiika.

ref: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
text: Naawen yaa, tulisi mu yɔgyɔgla de. Mi jɔk yiila meena kama. Kan suk fidek m jigi ya, dan kan daa di mi le siŋ kpiluŋ.

ref: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
text: Teeri mu saluik meena fi ŋmanteka wari, diila m sebchakka a bo ale ka fi. Mi puusaŋa a jueli ka fi jigi, sak mu suik kuui ate mi ale cheŋ la.

ref: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
text: Naawen yaa, mi a cheŋ ka fi jigi ayen fi lik mu. Vari mu m dachaasaŋa jigi a basi.

ref: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
text: Fi ka m Wen, sak mu ate mi a nye fi yaalika. Be nala a te mu, abe fi gani mu suik maŋ po.

ref: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
text: Naawen yaa, fi yuenni nyiŋ, fi wayɔrisimaŋa po, ta mu a nyini daanika po a nyini.

ref: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
text: Fi ŋmanteka ale mu nyiŋ, ko m dachaasaŋa abe fi kaasi baai ale a namsi mu la, diila m ka fi tomteerɔ.

ref: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
text: Pak Naawen, mi Piuŋku. Wa a sak mu kama a magsi kpaliŋ ale a gomsi mu a magsi tugurik.

ref: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
text: Wa ka m ŋmanteerɔ ale m ligrɔ, m puŋ ale m varibasidɔ, m jakasim, waai ate mi a suk wa jigi la. Wa ta pagrim kama nuru baai zuk ate mi a nya la.

ref: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
text: Naawen yaa, nurubiik ka boa, ate fi niŋ a bo wa po, nuru mɛ, ate fi niŋ a bo wa po?

ref: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
text: Wa a nye ase ka vuusum la, wa daaŋa a nye ase ka yisuŋ ale a taam la.

ref: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
text: Naawen yaa, lak wenzukku a siŋ tɛŋ, tiri guutaŋa, ate ti kpiiri nyuisa a basi peelim.

ref: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
text: Basi ate bolim nyaksika a jam waaŋ fi dachaasaŋa, tɔŋ fi peemaŋa a basi ate ŋa a cheŋ.

ref: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
text: Nyini wen a paari tɛŋ a dari mu a ta nyin nyaliuŋku po, a vari mu a basi, vari mu nicham pagrim po a basi.

ref: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
text: Baai ale kan maara a weeni wensie alege velim a pɛ.

ref: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
text: M Wen yaa, m le yi yipaali a te fu, m le nak kpanuŋku abe m yi a te fu.

ref: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
text: Fi pai pagrim a te nalima ale vari fi tomteerɔwa Deevid a basi.

ref: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
text: Ti bisaŋa bimbain po ale nye ase ŋanborinta ale chim a pagra la, ti liema ale nye ase ka zaŋŋa la ate ba nye ŋa ayen ŋa basi ate naab yeri a nala la.

ref: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
text: Ti booŋa ale sueri ale ka ŋanta tɔgatɔga. Ti piisaŋa ale piisi a vi tusa, ale tusa piisa ti laŋsaŋa po.

ref: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
text: Ti lalik kpaansaŋa ale dari ŋandobra. Parisa se kasika a kan boro, tɛŋ yonsa yik ta cheŋka a kan boro. Daanika kumsa a kan bo ti suitaŋa po.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
text: Suipeentik a bo ka nuru baai jigi ate wieŋa a chim wensie la. Suipeentik a bo ale ka nuru baai Wen ale ka Naawen la jigi.

ref: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
text: M Wenni yaa, waai ale ka naab la, m le zak fu a zaani. M le pak fi yuenni taam wuu.

ref: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
text: Daa meena mi le pak fu abe m zak fu yuenni a zaani taam wuu.

ref: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
text: Naawen a zuak ka yega, ale magsi pimpauk, wa le zuak diila nuru an baga a miŋi.

ref: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
text: Gaŋ kanyi ale pak fi tuima a te ka choa, ba le weeni fi tuim kpiema a sak.

ref: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
text: Ba le weeni fi naamu zulaŋa ale nalimu mɛ, be poli fi wakinkagla tuimaŋa zuk.

ref: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
text: Ba le biisi fi tuim kpiema wari ate m mooli fi tuim kpiemaŋa a te.

ref: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
text: Ba le dɛ fi wamaŋsaŋa yegayega tigi, abe ba yi fi wayɔrisimaŋa yiila ale suipeentik.

ref: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
text: Naawen ka niarɔ ale ta jiirim, wa sui kan kpabi a puuri ale jigsi ale ŋmanteka.

ref: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
text: Naawen a nala kama a te waai meena, wa ta jiirim kama ale waai meena ate wa nye la.

ref: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
text: Naawen yaa, baai meena ate fi nye la ale pak fu, fi bisaŋa ale zak fi yuenni a zaani.

ref: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
text: Ba le weeni fi naamu zulaŋa abe ba biisi fi pagrimu wie,

ref: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
text: ate waai meena a seba fi pagrim tuimaŋa ale fi naamu zulaŋa nalimu.

ref: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
text: Fi naamu ka naam buui ale boro wuu, fi pagrimu abe boro ka dila a cheŋ gaŋsa meena po. Naawen a ta wensie kama ale wa pumpuulimaŋa meena, ale a yaali baai meena ate wa nye la.

ref: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
text: Waai meena nina a nya ka fi jigi, ate fi a te ba ŋandiinta diipo ale magsi la.

ref: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
text: Fi lak fi nisa kama a basi ate javuk meena a chak.

ref: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
text: Naawen ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ suita meena po ale a yaali baai meena ate wa nye la.

ref: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
text: Naawen a moata baai meena ale a wi wa la kama, baai meena ale a wi wa ale wensie la.

ref: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
text: Baai meena ale a chali wa la, wa a nye ba le a yaali diila kama, wa a wom ba kumsa kama ale a vari ba a basi.

ref: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
text: Naawen a limisi baai meena ale a yaali wa la kama, alege wabaata nyama wa le kaasi ba meena.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
text: Mi nɔnni ale biisi a pak Naawen. Basi ate jaab meena Naawen nye la a pak wa tuilum yuenni taam wuu.

ref: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
text: Mi ale pak Naawen m boka po meena, m le yi yiila a pak m Wenni, m le tɔlim boro la.

ref: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
text: Kan pai fi sebchakka a basi nabisa zuwa, nurubiik zuwa, waai ale kan baga a vari a basi.

ref: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
text: Ba chiisaŋa a dan basi ba, ba a ŋmani a cheŋ ka tɛŋka, dai dila danni dek ba zɔŋŋa ka kinla.

ref: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
text: Suipeentik a bo le ka waai maarɔ ale chim Jekob Wenni la, waai yiila ale bo le Naawen, wa Wenni la,

ref: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
text: waai ale wenzuk ale tɛŋ, ale nyakpiemu, ale jaab meena ale bo ba po la Nyeerɔ, Naawen dii ale ta wensie taam wuu la.

ref: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
text: Wa bo a te baai ate ba a namsi la kama, ale a te kɔm ale ta baai la ŋandiinta. Naawen a vari ligrɔba a basi kama.

ref: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
text: Naawen a te yeeba nyaasim. Naawen a zak baai ale lo la a zaani. Naawen a yaali wayɔrisima nyama.

ref: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
text: Naawen a nya nichamma zuk ale a maari kpiŋsa ale pukɔga, alege a kaasi wabaata nyama suita.

ref: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Naawen a dɛ wa naamu kama taam wuu, nama Wenni, Zayon po a te gaŋsa meena a cheŋ. Pak Naawen.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
text: Pak Naawen. Ku le nala dii ate ti le yi yiila a pak ti Wenni, ku le nala dii ale magsi ayen ti pak wa.

ref: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
text: Naawen ale yik Izirali a zaani, wa le a tigsi Izirali dem baai ate ba yik ta cheŋ la.

ref: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
text: Wa a tebi baai sue ale kaasi ale a bobi ba mula.

ref: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
text: Wa le seba chiŋmarisaŋa nɔi ale a wi kanyi meena yuei.

ref: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
text: Ti Nyɔnɔwa a zuak kama ale ta pagrim nna yegayega, wa miŋka a ka bain ya.

ref: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
text: Naawen a maari baai ale a yik badek la kama, alege yuk wabaata nyama a lɔnsi tɛŋ.

ref: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
text: Ni yi yiila a te Naawen ale jiam teka, pai kpanuŋku a nak yiila a te Wen.

ref: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
text: Wa lik wenzukku kama ale chiŋma, wa a te tɛŋka ŋmoruk ale nye ate wuuk a chim guuta zuk.

ref: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
text: Wa le a te niiga ŋandiinta, ale tagaaruk bisa ase ti nin wi.

ref: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
text: Wa mariŋka a ka le wusum pagrimoa, yaase wa mariŋka a bo ale nurubiik naŋsa,

ref: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
text: Naawen a mariŋ ka baai ale a chali wa la, baai ale pai ba yiila a basi wa ŋmanteka po la.

ref: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
text: Jerusalem, ni zak Naawen yuenni a zaani, Zayon, ni pak ni Wenni,

ref: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
text: Wa basi ate suiyɔgni a bo ni tɛŋ banaŋa alege a te ni ŋanbie maŋsa.

ref: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
text: Wa a te wa wieŋa tɛŋka, ate wa wanni a chali nna nwuli.

ref: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
text: Wa a pati ŋmoruk tanaŋa a waaŋ ase buntuem la.

ref: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
text: Wa basi ate viok a jam ase ziŋa la, waai a kan baga a tu chaab ale ŋootaŋa ate wa tom la.

ref: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
text: Wa tom wa wanni ate di nyaliŋ ba, wa dam wa maglimu, ate nyaataŋa a chali.

ref: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
text: Wa pai wa wanni a sak Jekob, wa ŋmarisika ale wa buusaŋa a te Izirali.

ref: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Wa an nye nna a te tɛŋ yoŋŋoa, ba zɛ wa buusaŋa Pak Naawen.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
text: Pak Naawen. Pak Naawen a nyini wenŋmazuk, pak wa ŋmazuk niŋniŋŋa.

ref: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
text: Pak wa, wa Wen maarɔma meena, pak wa, wa ŋan baai meena ale bo wenŋmazuk la.

ref: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
text: Pak wa, wenbiri ale chiiga, pak wa, chiŋmari sii meena ale a nyaksi la.

ref: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
text: Pak wa, fi wenŋmazukku niŋniŋŋa ale nya tii ale bo wenzukku la.

ref: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
text: Basi ate ba pak Naawen yuenni, diila wa biisi kama ate ba jam.

ref: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
text: Wa pai ba basi ka ba jiŋŋa taam wuu, wa te ka luelik kaai ale kaa taamu.

ref: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
text: Pak Naawen a nyini tɛŋzuk de, nama nyakpiemu ŋantaŋa ale nyakpientaŋa liuŋtaŋa,

ref: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
text: nyaksika ale viok, ŋmoruk tana ale chiŋma, va pagrisa ale a zuli wa biik,

ref: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
text: nama guuta ale pina, yɔna tiisa ale nyunyoŋta meena,

ref: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
text: gɔi duŋsa ale niiga meena, ŋan fiisa ale nuin sii ale a yiri,

ref: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
text: tɛŋka nalima ale tɛŋsa meena, nama nabisa ale tɛŋka kpaga meena,

ref: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
text: nidoa paaluk ale dɔklieba, nidoa kpagsa ale bisa.

ref: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
text: Basi ate ba pak Naawen yuenni, ka wa yuenni nyiini ale a yiti, wa nalimu a yalima gaam tɛŋka ale wenzukku a bo ŋmai.

ref: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Wa basi ate wa tɛŋka a pagra kama, ayen wa nuruma a pak wa, Izirali demma, baai ate wa a yaali nna yegayega la. Pak Naawen.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
text: Pak Naawen. Yi yipaali a te Naawen, wa pimpaukku wa nuruma tuka po.

ref: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
text: Basi ate Izirali sui peenti ba Nyeerɔwa nyiŋ, basi ate Zayon nuruma a ta suipeentik ba Naawa nyiŋ.

ref: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
text: Basi ate ba pak wa yuenni ale gɔgta ba pai sinyaksa ale kpanuŋ a nak yiila a te wa.

ref: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
text: Naawen a mariŋ wa nuruma kama, wa a vuk baai ale a yik badek la zuima ale ka varibasika.

ref: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
text: Basi ate wa nuruma a ta suipeentik zulaŋa dɛ nyiŋ abe ba a yi suipeentik yiila ba gaduataŋa zuk.

ref: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
text: Wen pimpaukku a bo ba noa po, abe gebik nɔi ŋaye a bo ba nisima po,

ref: Take revenge and punish the nations.
text: ate ba tuni tɛŋsa abe ba namsi nuruba,

ref: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
text: abe ba bobi ba nalimaŋa ale chɔrima, ale nuru baai ale ta zula la ale kuta,

ref: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: a ta buusa ŋaai ate ba ŋmarisi a ta chaab ale ba la a nyini. Wa bisaŋa zulaŋa meena ale nna. Pak Naawen.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
text: Pak Naawen. Pak Wen wa weleŋsa boka jigini po, pak wa wa wenŋmazuk tanjaŋini po.

ref: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
text: Pak Wa wa pagrim tuimaŋa nyiŋ, pak wa wa zuak gaamka nyiŋ.

ref: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
text: Pak Wa ale damuniŋ kumsa, pak wa ale kpanuŋ ale baganiŋ.

ref: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
text: Pak Wa ale sinyaksa ale gɔgta, pak wa ale ŋannaŋ tii ale ta miisa ale paampuuŋ.

ref: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
text: Pak Wa ale sinyaara, pak wa ale sinyaara yeksika yegayega.

ref: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Basi a te jaab meena ale a vuusi a pak Naawen. Pak Naawen.

ref: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
text: Deevid biika Solomon, Izirali naawa wamagsimaŋa ale nna.

ref: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
text: Wamagsimaŋa de kiri ale ŋa te nuruba yam ale sinsaga, abe ŋa maari ba ate ba miŋ yam wie.

ref: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
text: Sinsaŋŋa de ale basi ate waai ale jɔk po yiila la a seba. Ŋa le te bi paalukku wie miŋka yam.

ref: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
text: Basi ate baai ale ta yam la a wom wamagsimaŋa de ate ba nya yam yegayega. Abe baai ale miŋ ku kiri la a nya ganika,

ref: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
text: ate ku sak ayen waai meena a baga miŋ yam ale wamagsima ale sunsuelima ale yam wie ale watɔgma kama.

ref: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
text: Naawen yɔgsum chalika ale wie miŋka piilimka, ka betta nyiini ale a zɛri yam ale sinsaga.

ref: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
text: Be wom, m biiga ase fi ko ale a sak fu, kan zɛri fi mawa sinsaga.

ref: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
text: Fi ale a zamsi dii a nyini ba jigi la ale lik fu ale niaka abe ku lik fi nyiŋka ale zula.

ref: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
text: M biiga wabanyeerisa a daa paasi fu, cheem ŋaaŋ a te ba!

ref: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
text: Poli ŋanti baai yega ate ti za ti nya la. Ti za ti pai ŋantaŋa de a basi ka ti yieŋa po.

ref: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
text: Jam a gum ti po, jam ate ti pai ŋa meena a chari a te chaab.>>

ref: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
text: M biiga, kan a cheŋ ale ba. Zaani niŋniŋ a nyini ba suitaŋa po.

ref: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
text: Ba kpabi kama ayen ba tom tuimbaata. Ba a nye ka a wuli ayen ba ko nuru.

ref: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
text: Ase nuim a dan nya baruk ale ku bari, bu a yalima kama ale ku.

ref: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
text: Alege daa nuruma de. Ba gu doa a limisi ka badek. Ba a bari ka badek nyuvooŋa.

ref: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
text: Baai nina ale muni ale ligra ale ka diila ale la. Ku a zu ka ba nyuvooŋa.

ref: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
text: Yam a nuem ka suitaŋa po. Yam a kum ka peelim jigi meena.

ref: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
text: Yam a wi ka nuru boanni ale bo suiduoku po la ale baai ale tigsi za tɛŋ kpieŋka tuoku la.

ref: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
text: Jam de a jam wom mi m le kpiiri m yam chiika a basi fi zuk ate fi ta yam.

ref: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
text: Fi banti m le sak fu diila kama ale zɛri dii ate m ta a sak fu la.

ref: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
text: Ase kaasuŋ ale jam bag fu ase va pagrik la, ate daanika a gilim fu, ate fi daanika ale fi namsika a paari fu.

ref: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
text: <<Ba dan kum a yaali maarika, m kan wom ba. Ba nina a dan poom muni a gisi mu, ba a kan nya mu.

ref: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
text: Dii nyiŋla ba zɛri ka wie miŋka ale an yaali ba sak zula ale Naawen.

ref: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
text: Ba zɛri m le sak ba diila kama ale an poom wom m sinsaŋŋa ate m pai a sak ba la.

ref: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
text: Dila nyiŋ, ba ale nya ba nyeka biem tutuna, abe ba ŋman nam ba biem nyeka nyiŋ.

ref: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
text: Alege baai ale a wom mi la ale ta suiyɔgni, ate yɔgsum a kan chim daanika a te ba.

ref: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
text: M biiga, wom m le a weeni diila, abe fi pai m sinsaŋŋa ate ŋa chim fi nitalim.

ref: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
text: Lak tue wom yam wie abe fi basi ate fi popola a bo wie miŋka jigi.

ref: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
text: Wi a juisi miŋ chakka, abe fi bek miŋ chakka.

ref: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
text: Gisi ase ligra ale bɛ yaase tuilum jaab ale suk ate fi a gisi la.

ref: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
text: Ate fi yaa le miŋ Naawen yɔgsum chalika a chak, abe fi ta Naawen wie miŋka.

ref: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
text: Diila Naawen a te yam kama. Wa a biisi ka wie miŋka yam ale miŋ chakka wie.

ref: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
text: Wa a te wensie nyɔnɔwa ka yam. Wa chim ka jaligim a te baai ale a cheŋ wensie po la.

ref: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
text: Wa a nya wensie suitaŋa zuk kama ale a lik baai ale ta wensie ale wa la.

ref: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
text: Diila yam ale jo fi suinummu po, abe wie miŋka yam a sueri fu ale masim.

ref: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
text: Yam zɔga ale nya fi zuk. Wie miŋka yam ale lik fu.

ref: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
text: Yam ale vari fu a nyini nuru baata po, baai ale biisi a labri la.

ref: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
text: Nuruma de a viriŋ a nyini ka suik maŋka po a ga bo suik kuui ale ta legi la.

ref: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
text: Ba nyeelaŋa a goalim kama, ate ba suitaŋa an nala.

ref: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
text: Yam ale vari fu nyini nipok waai ale kaasi la jigi ale kaboŋsa nipowa ale a biisi a tagri nidoaba popola la.

ref: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
text: Wa zɛri wa chorɔwa kama ale pai nɔiyeŋ kaai ate wa nye Naawen niŋ la a basi.

ref: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
text: Wa yenni po jo ka a ta fu a cheŋ ka kum po. Ka suik kuui ale a cheŋ vɔrup po.

ref: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
text: Nidoa waai ale a cheŋ wa jigi la ka jakpiuk. Wa a kan maa cheŋ paari nyuvuri suitaŋa a nya.

ref: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
text: Va nuru maŋsa naŋkula, abe fi wari a bo wayɔrisima nyam suita po.

ref: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
text: Alege gaasa nyama ba ale yeeri ba tɛŋka zuk, ate nuru baataŋa ale nya kaasuŋ.

ref: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
text: M biiga kan baŋ mi ale sak fu diila. Pai m sinsaŋŋa a nyo fi suinum po.

ref: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
text: Fi dan nye dila, fi ale boro a paari bena nna yegayega, ate fi ale boro ale masim.

ref: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
text: Kan te wensie ale jiirim a basi fu. Pai ŋa a su ase ŋiri baŋ la ŋmarisiŋa a nyo fi suinummu po.

ref: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
text: Ate fi ale nya ŋmanteka Naawen ale nuruba jigi ate fi nya yuei maŋ.

ref: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
text: Ta sebchakka ale Naawen ale fi suinum meena, abe fi kan ta sebchakka ale fidek miŋka.

ref: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
text: Gisi wa yaalika dii meena ate fi a nye la po, ate wa dak fi suitaŋa a sak fu.

ref: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
text: Kan poli ayen fi seba kama, a chali Naawen, abe fi cheem ŋaaŋ a te biem.

ref: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
text: Kude ale te fi nyiŋka nyiŋyɔgsa abe ku te fi kobaŋa pagrim.

ref: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
text: Te Naawen zula ale fi nitalimu ale fi ŋankpaanta baai meena ate fi dɛ niŋ a che la.

ref: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
text: Ate wa ale sueri fi booŋa ale ŋan bie, abe da maŋ a sueri fi samɔnsaŋa a nyini.

ref: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
text: M nidoabili yaa, kan zɛri Naawen waalika yaase fi sui kaasi wa le a toariŋ fu la nyiŋŋa,

ref: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
text: ale Naawen a sak ka waai ate wa a yaali la, ase ko ale a sak biik kaai ate wa a yaali la.

ref: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
text: Yam nyuenta a gaam kpana kama, ate bu tutunaŋa a gaam ligmɔniŋ.

ref: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
text: Yam a nye tuilum kama a gaam tintain mɔnuŋ, ate jabuui ate fi a yaali la a kan magsi chaab ale di.

ref: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
text: Yam a te fu ka nyuvuri woŋ a nyini bu juga nisaŋa po ale a te fu jigsika ale zula a nyini bu gala nisimaŋa po.

ref: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
text: Bu ale gani fu a ta va suipeentik suita, bu suitaŋa meena a magsi kama.

ref: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
text: Yam a chim ka nyuvuri tiib a te baai ale a gbaari bu la. Baai ale a yik bu giŋgiŋ la sue a peenti kama.

ref: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
text: Naawen a pai ka yam a nya tɛŋka, ka yam miŋ chakka nyiŋ ate wa nye wenŋmazukku.

ref: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
text: Wa yam wie miŋka nyiŋ, a basi kama ate nyiam a tɔŋ nyini buli limisitaŋa po a nyini, ale basi ate maglim a lo.

ref: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
text: M biiga, kan jɔk poyiila ale wie kpesi miŋka, gbaari seeri ŋa,

ref: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
text: diila ŋa ale te fi chiika pagrim. Ate ŋa ale nye ase ka sotta a bo fi ŋinni po.

ref: You will walk safely and never stumble;
text: Ŋa a ta fu ka nalimnyiini fi suiku po ate fi kan nak naŋŋa.

ref: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
text: Kan chali yɔgsummoa ase kaasuŋ ale biem ale cheena nuru baata zuwa.

ref: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
text: Ale ka Naawen ate fi le ta sebchakka ale wa ate ba a kan baga a bari yik fu.

ref: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
text: Kan peri nalim a nyini baai ale magsi bu la, ase fi nin ta a maari ba.

ref: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
text: Fi dan baga a maari fi sɔmoa yɔgyɔgla, kan weeni wa ayen, <<Cheŋ abe chum fi jam ate m maari fu.>>

ref: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
text: Kan poli ayen fi nye fi vaanchoa biemmoa, diila baai ale kali moata la a ta mariŋka ale fu kama.

ref: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
text: Kan nye kpaliŋ kosiga, alege ate waai an poom a nye fu wariya.

ref: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
text: Kan dɛ nyuri ale wɔkwɔk nyɔnɔ, yaase fi tomsi wa suitaŋa.

ref: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
text: Naawen a kisi nuru waai ale a tom biem tuima la kama, alege wa ta sebchakka ale waai ale a nye wamaŋsa la kama.

ref: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
text: Naawen kikaasaŋa a bo gaasa nyɔnɔ yenni zuk, alege wa a niak wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ yenni kama.

ref: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
text: Naawen a la baai ale nye nuruba a la la kama, alege wa ta ŋmantiik a te baai ale ta badek a siŋ tɛŋ la kama.

ref: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
text: Zula a chim ka yam nyɔnɔ nitalim, alege betta ale nya ka chivie.

ref: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
text: M bisa ni wom ase ni kowa nin sak ni. Ni chelsi a wom abe ni zamsi yam,

ref: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
text: diila vuuk naliŋsa ate m pai a sak ni. Kan cheem ŋaaŋ a te m sinsaŋŋa.

ref: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
text: Mi mɛ jam chim ka m kowa nidoabili ate m mawa jam a nya m zuk nalimnyiini ase wa bi yeŋ la.

ref: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
text: Wa sak mu ale biisi ale mu ayen, <<Basi ate fi suinummu a ta wieŋa, ta m wieŋa ate fi vua.

ref: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
text: Be ta yam. Te ate fi buusa boka a chim bo maŋsa. Kan baŋ m wieŋa yaase fi cheem ŋaaŋ a te ŋa.

ref: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
text: Kan cheem ŋaaŋ a te yammoa, dii nyiŋla bu ale lik fu. A yaali yam ale bu ale nya fi zuk.

ref: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
text: Jaab a karo a ŋman gaam yammoa. Fi baga a nya ŋanta kama, alege yam maŋ ale gaam jaab meena.

ref: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
text: Fi dan pai yam ate bu chim niŋ nyɔnɔ, bu le nye ate fi chim nuru kpioŋ. Gbaari bu, ate bu ale te fu zula.

ref: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
text: Yam ale nye fi jigi ase ka wuuk puuta ale zutɔk naliŋ ale bo fi zuku po la.>>

ref: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
text: M biiga, wom mu abe fi nye m le a weeni diila, ate fi ale ta nyuvuri woŋ abe fi boka po mɛ a nala.

ref: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
text: M le sak fu yam suitaŋa ale ka diila, abe m de fi niŋ a ta fu cheŋ suik tii ale teenti la po.

ref: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
text: Fi kan cheŋ chelim ate fi wari ŋaaŋŋa. Fi abe kan chali chala a nak naŋŋa.

ref: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
