text: Yik m sinsaŋŋa a ta ŋmapi. Kan te ŋa vari a nyini fi jigi ya. Nya ŋa zuk, dii nyiŋla ŋa ka nyuvuri.

ref: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
text: Kaa nye ase gaasa nyama ale a nye diila, be kan va baai ale a tom biem la suitaŋa.

ref: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
text: Ba a dɛ ka gaasa ŋandiinta ale a nyu wɔkwɔk.

ref: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
text: Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa suiku a nye ase ka vari ale boro a veenti dii ate ku ga a nye jassi la.

ref: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
text: Alege gaasa nyɔnɔwa suiku a nye ase ka legi kpienni la. Ba zɛ dii ale nye ate ba a nak naŋsa la.

ref: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
text: M biiga wom m le a weeni diila. Chelsi a wom m wieŋa.

ref: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
text: Kan yeeri fi nina a nyini ŋa zuwa. Basi ate ŋa jɔ fi suinummu po,

ref: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
text: diila ŋa ta ka nyuvuri a te baai ale a nya ŋa la ale ŋman ta tebika a te ba nyiŋsa meena.

ref: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
text: Wie meena po, yik fi suinum, dii nyiŋla ku baga a paari dii meena ate fi a nye la kama.

ref: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
text: Pai nɔi po biik galiŋsa a dueni nakpiak, abe fi te ate nɔi po biik poosisa a yalima ale fu.

ref: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
text: Dueni suik kuui ale teenti la a magsi fi naŋsaŋa. Bo suik kuui ale nala la po.

ref: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
text: Kan cheŋ bɛ. Yik fidek a nyini biem va ka po.

ref: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
text: M biiga, wom m yammu. Chelsi wom m yam sinsaŋŋa.

ref: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
text: Ate fi ale seba fidek taka. Abe fi nɔnni ale sum sak dii ate fi zamsi la.

ref: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
text: Nipok kaasuŋ nɔngban po wie a masa ase ka siita la, ate wa nɔnni a saala a gaam kpaam.

ref: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
text: Alege ku nuerika po wa a toa ase ka choŋ la, ate wa ta nɔi ase gebik noa ŋaye la.

ref: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
text: Nipowa de choa ale ta fu a cheŋ ka baai ale kpi la jigi, ate wa laari tabika a ta wa a cheŋ vɔrumu po.

ref: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
text: Wa niŋ ka nyuvuri suiku po. Wa cheŋ tuiri kama alege wa zɛ.

ref: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
text: Dila nyiŋ, yɔgyɔgla de, wom mu. Kan zɛri m le za m weeni diila.

ref: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
text: Yalima ale wa. Kan cheŋ moata wa yenni tuoku.

ref: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
text: Fi dan nye dila, fi le jɔk fi zula, ate nuru baai ale kan ta jiirim la ale nye ate fi jɔk ŋan baai meena ate fi ta la.

ref: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
text: Nicham ale dɛ fi ŋanta meena, ate nuru yoŋ ale de masim a nyini fi ŋan baai meena ate fi tom a nya la.

ref: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
text: Fi nyuvunni nuerika po ate fi ale ŋuuni nyiŋdomma ŋuunika, ate nyiŋtuila a dɛ fi nyiŋka.

ref: I paid no attention to my teachers,
text: Ka boa ale soa ate mi an wom m sagrɔma?

ref: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
text: M jueli paari ka kaasuŋ zuk, ate yɔgyɔgla de ku magsi kama ayen m tu peelim chivie.>>

ref: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
text: Bobi fidek powa nyiini a goa ase fi ale a nyu nyiam a nyini fidek liik po diila.

ref: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
text: Ku a magsi fi powa a nyini a yaali nidoaba? Ku a magsi nidoa yoŋta a bobi fi nipowa a goa?

ref: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
text: Wa nala kama ate nuruba nina a doa wa zuk ase kab la. Fi baga a nya kama ate fi chiik a jɔ wa nna yegayega.

ref: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
text: M biiga, ka boa ale soa ate ba pai nipok kaasuŋ a yik fu, yaase fi a yik nipok yoŋ biisa?

ref: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
text: Nuru biok wabaata dek ale a yik wa. Ŋa ka miisa a yik wa a tara.

ref: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
text: Wa ale kpi wa le kan baga wadek a yik la nyiŋ. Wa bettaŋa nyiŋ wa ale cheŋ bɛ.

ref: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
text: Va m le a sak diila ate fi vari fidek a basi, dii nyiŋla fi pai fidek a nyo ka fi doawa nisa po. Nɛ fi kanjantaŋa. Cheŋ ga saalim wa ate wa duisi fi yuenni a basi.

ref: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
text: Kan pai basi. Nye ku yɔgyɔgla de. Fi dan kan ga nye ya, kan vuusi.

ref: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
text: Vari fidek a basi ase kab ale a chali a nyini yaalɔ nisa po la, yaase nuim ale yiri a nyini baruk po diila.

ref: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
text: Zamsi yam a nyini nankeriŋ jigi, fi nyiŋworuk nyɔnɔ. Nya wa suitaŋa a miŋ yam.

ref: but they store up food during harvest season.
text: Ba a tom kama nalimnyiini yoenni po a tigsi ŋandiinta a magsi wenkarika nyinika.

ref: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
text: Alege fi nyiŋworuk nyɔnɔ, fi ale goa a paari ka dimpo? Fi le goa a yiti ka dimpo?

ref: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
text: Goom maga ale goa jɔgsika maga ale nisa gurumka maga.

ref: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
text: Ate jaŋsa ale jam fi zuk ase zue la, ate ŋanta silim ka ale siti fu ase varidɔ la.

ref: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
text: Ba a poli ka biem ba suiniimaŋa po ale kasim a siti daanika.

ref: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
text: Alege ku a kan benni ba ale kpabi a kaasi, ba ale ŋɔriŋ kama ate yiila a poom kan boro a magsi ba tebika.

ref: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
text: Naawen a kisi ka wie ŋayuebi, ate ŋayopɔi a chim kisuk a te wa. Ŋa be ka

ref: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
text: kayeruk ale venta ale waai ale a ko nuru baai ale kan poom seba wari nɔi po la, ale

ref: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
text: waai suinum ale ta popola baata la ale waai ale chali a ga a tom kaasuŋ

ref: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
text: ale venta seerɔ ale waai ale ta butimka a jam nuruba po la.

ref: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
text: Kasim ta ŋa fi suinummu po diipo meena, pai ŋa a bobi yik fi ŋinni.

ref: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
text: Fi daa cheŋ, ba wieŋa ale de fi niŋ. Fi daa goa, ŋa ale nya fi zuk. Fi dan goa yiti, ŋa ale sak fu dii ale magsi ayen fi nye la.

ref: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
text: Diila ba wieŋa a chim ka zeuŋ, ate ba sinsaŋŋa a chim bolim. Ba waalika sinsaŋŋa ka nyuvuri suik.

ref: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
text: Wieŋa de ale sinsaŋŋa de ale yeeri fu a nyini nipok kaasuŋ jigi ale kaboŋsa nipowa biik po.

ref: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
text: Kan te wa nalimu kɔrisa a jo fu. Kan te wa chivie nyaasimu a yik fi popola.

ref: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
text: Nipok waai ale pai wadek a te nidoaba a tuesi ligra la ale ta ka jaŋsa a jam fi jigi, ate fi goa ale nuru yoŋ pok la ale ta ka daanika a jam fi nyuvunni po.

ref: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
text: Nuru ale baga ta bolim ŋiak wa kɔsuk zuk ate bu kan chɔgsi wa garukku?

ref: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
text: Yaase wa ale baga cheŋ bolim kaala zuk ate bu kan dɛ wa?

ref: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
text: Ku ka dila mɛ ate nuru waai ale a goa ale a waai pok la. Waai ale a gbaari wa la a tu ka namsika.

ref: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
text: Ba baga a biisi wie a ŋmani a te zue waai ale zu viirika nyiŋla kama.

ref: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
text: Alege waai ale a nye kaboŋ la ka beruk, diila wa kaasi ka wadek.

ref: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
text: Wa ale kɔni wadek abe wa nya chivie. Wa chivieŋa a kan maa taamu.

ref: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
text: Wa a kan siak a tuesi tutuna. Tiirim a karo ale baga a yɔk wa suinni.

ref: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
text: M biiga, va m le weeni fu diila. Kasim ta m sinsaŋŋa.

ref: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
text: Ta wieŋa ate fi baga boro. Pai m sinsaŋŋa ate ŋa chim fi tuilum nitalim.

ref: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
text: Bob ŋa a maŋ fi nandubsaŋa ate ku chim teerika. Ŋmarisi ŋa a nyo fi suinummu po.

ref: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
text: A yaali yam ase fi toa la. Te ate miŋka a chim fi dɔkdemma po wanyi ate fi a yaali la.

ref: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
text: Te ate ba yeeri fu a nyini nipok kaasuŋ bobi goom po ale kaboŋsa nipok pimpaasima wie po.

ref: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
text: Dai yeŋ ate mi a va m yenni toakpariku a liisi a nya peelim.

ref: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
text: Wenbinni jam a siŋ ate ku piilim a sobri la, ate tɛŋka a sob la.

ref: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
text: Nipowa a cheŋ paari wa, a jo garuk kuui ale a yik wa popola ale pimpaasima wa suinummu po.

ref: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
text: Wa jam ka nipok waai ale ta zupagruk ale kan chali chivie ale kan kali yeri ya.

ref: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
text: Wa nyiem kasim bo ka suitaŋa po ale yabaŋa po ale gugotta meena a gisi nidoaba.

ref: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
text: Wa gbaari wa ale nya nidoawa nina po a weeni ayen,

ref: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
text: <<Mi nye m suiyɔgni tiiritaŋa a nueri kama a tuni m le puulim diila nyiŋ.

ref: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
text: Ka fi ate mi a gisi. M be nyini a nya fu kama, fi be nin nna.

ref: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
text: M pai ka ŋan baai nyum ale masa la a basi gaduokku zuk.

ref: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
text: diila m chorɔwa a ka yeri ya, wa cheŋ ka suik woŋ.

ref: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
text: Wa pai ligra a sueri wa foruku kama, ate wa ale ŋmani ka chiika nuerika.>>

ref: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
text: Dila nyiŋ wa jam baga yik wa ale kperisa nyeelaŋa kama ale ŋman tagri wa popolaŋa ale wa biika.

ref: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
text: Nidoawa yaa jam va nna se lalik ate ba ta a cheŋ ayen ba tɔgri la yaase duŋ ate ba bari yik la.

ref: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
text: A limisi pein dii ale di feri ka suinummu la, wa a nye ase ka nuim ale yiri a nyiem a ta budek a ga jo baruk po la, wa jam zɛ ayen ku ale daani wa nyuvunni.

ref: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
text: M biiga, wom mu abe fi lak tue a wom m wieŋa.

ref: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
text: Kan te ate fi suinummu a cheŋ wa jigi ya. Kan nyiem wa suitaŋa ale kan ta kiri la po.

ref: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
text: Diila wa nye kama ate nuruba yegayega a ka kiri ya. Wa nye kama mɛ ate nuru boari a kpi.

ref: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
text: Wa yenni ka vɔrup suik. Wa gaduokku a chim kum jigi.

ref: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
text: Guuku ale bo suiku jigini la, ate wa wari za suik magsaŋa po la.

ref: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
text: Tɛŋka nansuiŋku tuataŋa, suik kuui ale a jo la ate wa za a kaari ayen,

ref: “I am calling out to each one of you!
text: <<Mi wi ni meena kama. M lak m lueluku a wi ka waai meena.

ref: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
text: A jɔk po yiila nyama a zamsi yam. Betta mɛ a zamsi popola.

ref: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
text: mi ale biisi ka wensie. M nɔngbanni a kisi gaasa wie kama.

ref: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
text: M wieŋa ka wensie. Wari a ka di po a labri yaase a galiŋŋi.

ref: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
text: Mi wieŋa a nye ka jassi a te waai ale a miŋ wie kiri la, ŋa be lagri a doa a te baai ale ta wie miŋka yam la kama.

ref: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
text: Lueri m sinsaŋŋa abe fi basi kpana. Lueri wie miŋka abe fi ge basi ligmɔniŋ.

ref: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
text: Dii nyiŋla yam a ta dobrim a gaam tintain munta kama. Fi ale a yaali jabuui la an baga a magsi chaab ale bu.

ref: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
text: Naawen yɔgsum chalika ale fi kisi biem. Mi a kisi kanjanta ale kayerinni ale biem suik ale bi kaasuŋ kama.

ref: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
text: Wie kiri kpabi miŋka ale nye niaka ka mi ale soa. Popo wie miŋka ale pagrim ka mi ale soa.

ref: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
text: Ka mi nyiŋ ale soa ate nalima a de ba naam. Ate niŋdeerɔba ale a weeni diila a chim wensie.

ref: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
text: <<Baai meena ale a yaali mi la mi mɛ a yaali ba kama. Baai ale a gisi mi la ale sum a nya mu.

ref: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
text: Yam a ta jigsuŋ ale zula kama ale ŋman ta paaruŋ ale wensie.

ref: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
text: M tiiritaŋa a gaam ligmɔniŋ kama, kaai ale nyini bolim po la. M tutunaŋa a gaam kpana.

ref: I always do what is right,
text: Mi a cheŋ ka wayɔrisima po, a ta bo wensie suita po.

ref: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
text: Baai ale a yaali mi la ale nya paaruŋ. M le te ate ba nya ŋanta.

ref: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
text: Naawen a soa mu a nyini ka wa tuimaŋa piilimka po, wa le piilim nye dii dipodipo la.

ref: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
text: Bena ŋaai ale taam la ate ba wi mi, a nyini piilimka po, alege ate tɛŋka a piilim nyeka.

ref: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
text: Ba de ka niŋ a biak mi alege yaa nye nya kpientaŋa alege ate bulisaŋa nyaata a tɔŋ a yiti.

ref: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
text: Ba de ka niŋ a biak mi alege yaa nye gu kpienta ale gu fiisaŋa

ref: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
text: mi ale jam paari a boro la ale wa an diem a nye tɛŋzuk de ate ŋandiinta laŋsa mɛ a karo.

ref: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
text: Mi boro kama alege ate wa nye wenŋmazuk ale nye dindaanuŋ a gilim nyakpiemu.

ref: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
text: Mi boro kama alege ate wa nye chiŋmaaŋa wenzukku po ale nye nya tii ale bo tɛŋka a buli a nyini tɛŋka la.

ref: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
text: Mi boro kama ate wa nye ate nya kpientaŋa kpeglimka jigini, ayen ŋa kan wusi a gaam ŋa banaŋa. Ale boro ate wa nye tɛŋ zuk de nyubaŋa dindaanuŋtaŋa.

ref: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
text: Mi bo ale wa kama ase bi fiik la, wa jam a nya masim a nyini ka mi jigi daa meena, a kasim ta suipeentik a bo wa jigi.

ref: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
text: Ate dila nyiŋ, m bisaa, ni wom mu, dii nyiŋla baai meena ale a va mi suitaŋa la a ta suipeentik kama.

ref: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
text: Wom m wieŋa ate fi ta yam. Kan zɛri ŋa.

ref: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
text: Waai ale a nya yam la, a ta ka nyuvuri ate Naawen nisima a bo wa zuk.

ref: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
text: Baai ale kan ta mi la, a ta ka daanika a jam badek zuk. Baai meena ale kisi mi la a yaali ka kum.

ref: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
text: Yam a sɛ bu yenni. Bu ti bu zaŋŋa ŋayopɔiwa a zaani.

ref: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
text: Bu nye ka ŋandiinta tigi kpienni, a dam daata a magsi nyuka ale zaani ŋandiinta a magsi dɛka.

ref: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
text: Bu tom ka bu tomteerɔma ayen ba ga wi waai meena ate wa jam. Bu zaani ka tɛŋka ŋmazuimaŋa a wi ba.

ref: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
text: <<Jam a dɛ m ŋandiintaŋa, abe ni nyu daamu ate m dam la.

ref: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
text: Basi fi jɔk po yiila nyeelaŋa abe fi piilim boka, a nye dii ale di basi ate fi miŋ wie la.>>

ref: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
text: Fi dan sak waai ale koosi a la nuruba la fi a nya ka leeta, fi be dan toariŋ gaasa nyɔnɔ wa ale lɛ fu.

ref: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
text: Kaa toariŋ waai ale koosi a la nuruba la, wa le nye ate fi sui puuri. Toariŋ nuru waai ale ta yam la ate wa le yaali fu.

ref: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
text: Sak yam nyam, ate ba ta yam a gum ba yammu po. Te wayɔrisima nyama sinsaga ate ba zamsi a ŋman gum du.

ref: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
text: Dii nyiŋla, ka Naawen yɔgsum chalika ale yam nyubini. Fi dan seba waai ale welema la a ta ka buusa maŋsa a jam.

ref: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
text: Yam ale nye ate fi daaŋa a piisi, abe fi nya bena a gum fi nyuvunni po.

ref: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
text: Fi miŋ yam, ku a maari ka fidek. Fi koosi yam a la, ka fidek ale za fi jam a nam.

ref: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
text: Wa kali ka wa tuoku nɔi nna wen wen ya a nya tɛŋ kpieŋka.

ref: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
text: <<Zum nyiam a yɔk ka zuzuk ate ŋandiinta zu dɛka a nala.>>

ref: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
text: Solomon wamagsimaŋa ale nna. Biik kaai ale ta yam la, a ta ka masim a te wa kowa. Bi beruk a ta ka daanika a te wa ma.

ref: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
text: Fi va venta suik po a paari ŋanta la, a ka kiri ya, alege bo maŋ a baga a vari fi nyuvuri a basi kama.

ref: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
text: Naawen a kan basi ate kom a yik wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ, alege wa a kan te suik ate gaasa nyɔnɔ a nya wa ale a yaali dii ya.

ref: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
text: Nyiŋworuk nyam a kpabi a jaŋ kama. Baai ale a tom nalimnyiini la a jigsi kama.

ref: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
text: Biik kaai ale ta yam la, a che kama fanɔi wen, alege waai ale a goa cheka wen la ku ka chivie.

ref: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
text: Niaka ale bo wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ zuk. Gaasa nyɔnɔwa wieŋa a ta ka wɔkwɔk.

ref: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
text: Ti le kasim a teeri nuru maŋsa wie kama, alege gaasa nyɔnɔwa ti le baŋ wa wari.

ref: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
text: Yam nyɔnɔ suinum a tuesi ka sinsaga, alege beruk nɔi po wie a kaasi wa kama.

ref: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
text: Nuru baai ale bo wensie suik po la, a cheŋ ka nalimnyiini alege baai ale va suik goanti ka la ale sati a lɔ.

ref: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
text: Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa wieŋa ka nyuvuri nyiam. Gaasa nyɔnɔwa wieŋa a ta ka wɔkwɔk.

ref: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
text: Kisika a dam ka kpaliŋsa, alege yaalika a lik ka nye kaasuŋ.

ref: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
text: Yam wie a nyini ka nuru baai ale ta miŋ chakka la nɔi po, alege betta ba le nak ale ka doari.

ref: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
text: Yam nyɔnɔ a tigsi ka wie miŋka yam, alege beruk nɔi po wie a ta ka kaasuŋ a jam.

ref: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
text: Jigsirɔ paaruŋ ale chim wa yepagrik. Jaŋsa ale chim jabuui ale a kaasi ŋanjaksa.

ref: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
text: Nuru maŋ ale tom tuima a tuesi wa tutuna diila a ta maarika a te wa kama, alege nuru baata a pai ba ligra a kaasi ka wabaata zuk.

ref: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
text: Nuru baai ale a siak waalika la a bo ka suik maŋ po, alege baai ale a zɛri nyemagsika la a cheŋ a bɛ kama.

ref: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
text: Waai ale ta popo soblum la ka velimvendik, ate waai ale a weeni venta wie a te nuruba la ka beruk.

ref: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
text: Fi dan biisi yegayega fi wabaataŋa mɛ a baga a soa ka dila. Fi a dan ta yam fi ale nye chim.

ref: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
text: Wayɔrisima nyam wie a nye ase ka kpana la, alege beruk suinummu ka kiri ya.

ref: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
text: Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ nɔi po wie a maari ka nuru boari, alege betta a kpi ka ba ale a silim yam la nyiŋ.

ref: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
text: Ka Naawen niauŋ ale a nye ate waai a jigsi, ate wa kan pai niniga a gum du.

ref: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
text: Nye kaasuŋ a nye ase ka diinta la a te beruk, alege yam ka popeentik a te nuru waai ale ta miŋka la.

ref: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
text: Wen nuruma ale nya ba ale a yaali jabuui meena la, alege gaasa nyama ale nya ka ŋan baai ate ba a chali ŋa la.

ref: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
text: Va pagrik a dan jam jaab a kan nye wensie nuruma, alege ku nyiem ji gaasa nyama a ta cheŋ kama.

ref: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
text: Nyiŋworuk nyam a nye kama ate ba kpaga sue a puuri nna se kaam ale a bo nyina po diila yaase nyuisa ale a jo nina po diila.

ref: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
text: Naawen yɔgsum chalika a basi ate fi a goa a beni kama, alege gaasa nyɔnɔ bena a gela kama.

ref: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
text: Wen nuruma yiilaŋa a te ba ka suipeentik, alege gaasa nyama yiilaŋa a kan te ba jaaboa.

ref: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
text: Naawen suiku ka pagrim a te baai ale za wensie po la, alege ku ka kaasuŋ a te tuimbaata nyam.

ref: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
text: Wari a kan daani Wen nuruma, alege ba ale yeeri gaasa nyama a nyini tɛŋka zuk.

ref: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
text: Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ nɔi po wie a te ka yam sinsaga alege giŋgeluŋ kuui ale a paasi la a kan boro.

ref: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
text: Wen nuruma a biisi ka wie ŋaai ale a te maarika la, alege gaasa nyama wieŋa a kasi ka zukzuk.

ref: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
text: Naawen a kisa venta ŋanmagsinta kama alege mariŋ wensie dobrim.

ref: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
text: Kanjanta ale ta nuru a jo chivie po, alege fi dan ta fidek a siŋ tɛŋ, yam ale cheena.

ref: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
text: Wayɔrisima nyam wensie a gani ba kama, alege venta a kaasi baai ate fi ka mariŋka ale ba la.

ref: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
text: Jigsi a kan maari fu buusa danni, alege bo maŋ ale yeeri fu a nyini kum po.

ref: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
text: Wayɔrisima nyama ale kan ta kaasuŋ la ale a yɔrisi ba suitaŋa. Gaasa nyam wabaata ale a lɔnsi ba tɛŋ.

ref: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
text: Nuru maŋsa wayɔrisima a yeeri ba a nyini daanika po kama. Baai ale kan ta mariŋka la, badek kɔrisa ale chim baruk a yik ba.

ref: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
text: Wen nuruma a nya varibasika kama a nyini daanika po, ate ku yaa siŋ gaasa nyama zuk.

ref: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
text: Nuru waai ale kan seba Naawen la, a pai ka wa nɔnni a kaasi wa doaba, alege yam ale wayɔrisima nyam ale nya varibasika.

ref: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
text: Ku dan cheŋ nalimnyiini ale wayɔrisima nyam, tɛŋ demma a de ka masim. Ate gaasa nyama a dan kpi, suipeentik nuemka ale boro.

ref: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
text: Wayɔrisima nyam niauŋ nyiŋ ate tɛŋ a nya ka dek, alege gaasa nyam biik a dari ka a lɔnsi ka tɛŋ.

ref: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
text: Waai ale nya wa mabiik a nueri la a silim ka yam, alege nuru ale ta miŋ chakka la a nye ka diki.

ref: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
text: Bumbobrɔ a biisi ka wa susuga, alege waai ate fi ta mariŋka ale wa la, fi ta sebchakka ale wa kama.

ref: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
text: Yam niŋdeerɔba a dan kan boro, tɛŋ a lɔ kama. Fi dan ta sagrɔba a piisi ku nala kama.

ref: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
text: Ku pagra kama ase fi nin zaani a te nichaanɔ pami. Ku nala kama ase fi nin yeeri fi nisa a nyini du.

ref: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
text: Nipok maŋ a nya zula kama, alege nidoa waai nina ale muni wie zuk la a jigsi kama.

ref: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
text: Nuru waai ale ta jiirim la a nya wa tutuna kama alege gaasa nyɔnɔ ale kaasi ka wadek.

ref: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
text: Nuru baata a kpabi kama a jigsi, alege Wen nuruma tutunaŋa ale boro taam wuu.

ref: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
text: Wen nuruma a nya ka nyuvuri. Nuru baata a nya kum.

ref: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
text: Ba ale namsi nuru baata, alege Wen nuruma bisaŋa ale cheŋ nna fasiyaa.

ref: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
text: Nipok waai ale kan ta kiri la, a nye ase ka deri ate ba pai ligmɔniŋ nifelinni a su di nyueri la.

ref: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
text: Wayɔrisima nyama a nya ka niŋ nyiŋ ayen ba tuesi tutuna, alege gaasa nyama a yiili ka buusa nyiini.

ref: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
text: A te ate fi kasim a jigsi. Ta butuem ate fi ale jɔk meena.

ref: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
text: Waai ale a te nuruba ŋanta la ale jigsi, ate waai mɛ ale a maari nuruba la, ba le maari wa mɛ.

ref: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
text: Nuruba a ka a te baai ale a suk ba ŋanbie la kama, alege ba a niak baai ale pai a da silimka wen la kama.

ref: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
text: Fi daa gisi wamaŋ, fi le nya ŋmanteka, alege fi daa gisi biem, ba le nya fu.

ref: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
text: Waai ale a ta sebchakka ale wa jigsika la a lɔ kama, alege wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa ale chim a nyaksi ase ka tiib va yɔksa la.

ref: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
text: Waai ale a daani wadek yeri la, vioku ale a chim wa nitalim ate beruk ale chim yam nyɔnɔ yɔma.

ref: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
text: Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ yɔna ka nyuvuri tiib, waai ale vari nuruba nyuvoa a basi la ka yam nyɔnɔ.

ref: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
text: Ase wayɔrisima nyam a dan nya ba tutuna tɛŋzuk de, ka boa ale ku nye gaasa nyama ale wabanyeerisa?

ref: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
text: Nuru maŋ a nya ka niauŋ a nyini Naawen jigi, alege wa a kaasi nuru waai ale ta popola baata la kama.

ref: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
text: Gaasa a kan yik fu a zaani alege nye maŋ a ta ka naŋsa a feri a paari tɛŋ.

ref: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
text: Nipok waai ale ta zula la ka wa chorɔwa zuk zak zaanika, alege waai ale ta chivie a jam la a nye ase ka nyiŋdomma a te wa chorɔwa.

ref: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
text: Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa popolaŋa a nala kama. Gaasa nyɔnɔwa sinsaŋŋa ka pimpaasima.

ref: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
text: Gaasa nyam wie doa a limisi ka ziim, alege wayɔrisima nyam nɔi a vari ba a basi kama.

ref: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
text: Gaasa nyama a kpi kama a muriŋ a bɛ alege Naawen bisaŋa a za kama giŋgiŋ.

ref: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
text: Fi dan ta fidek a siŋ tɛŋ a tom tuima, a zunchoŋŋa fi ale nye fidek ase nuru kpioŋ la alege a goa kɔm.

ref: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
text: Baai ale ka wayɔrisima nyam la niŋ a bo ba duŋsa po kama, alege nuru baataŋa a kasim ta ka gaasa.

ref: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
text: Waai ale a tom wa talim po la ale nya ŋandiinta yegayega, alege waai ale chali a vi wakayaata la a ka yammoa.

ref: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
text: Zueba a de ka nyuri ale chaab ba ale zu ŋan baai la nyiŋ, alege wayɔrisima nyama a feri paari kama a za a yɔn yɔna.

ref: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
text: Gaasa nyama nɔi po wie ale chim baruk a yik ba, alege Wen nuruma a kan nya wie ŋala chaaba.

ref: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
text: Nuruba ale nya ba le a biisi diila tutuna kama, abe ba nya ba le a tom diila tutuna.

ref: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
text: Betta suita a nala ka badek nina po alege yam nyam a wom ka sinsaga.

ref: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
text: Betta a kan suk ba suipuurumu, alege yam nyam a kan nya leeta ase wari la.

ref: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
text: Waai ale a weeni wensie la a weeni ka wensie wie, alege velimvendik a weeni ka venta wie.

ref: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
text: Nuruba gela biisa a gebi ka zuzugta alege yam nyama wie a te ka tebika.

ref: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
text: Wensie a boro kama taam wuu, alege venta a kan boro a beni.

ref: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
text: Biem a kan jam nuru maŋsa jigi ya alege gaasa nyama a ta ka daanika nyiini.

ref: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
text: Venta nɔngban ka kisuk a te Naawen, alege wa ta yaalika ale wensie nyam kama.

ref: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
text: Yam nyɔnɔ a kan sak wadek ale wa sebika alege betta a jalisi ba bettaŋa kama.

ref: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
text: Tom ale nyiŋbiiri ate fi ale chim niŋdeerɔ. Chim nyiŋworuk nyɔnɔ ate fi ale chim yɔma.

ref: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
text: Sui kaasuŋ a dan bo nuru suinum po wa baga a bɛ kama, alege nyiŋbiiri a basi ate ka wa sui a peenti.

ref: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
text: Wen nuruma a sak ba doama ka sinsak maŋsa. Gaasa nyam ale ta ba a cheŋ bɛ.

ref: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
text: Nyiŋworuk nyam a kan nya ba ale a yaali diila, alege waai ale ta nyiŋbiiri la a nya wa ŋan silimta ŋanta meena kama.

ref: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
text: Wen nuruma suiku a ta fu a cheŋ ka nyuvuri po. Suik kula a kan ta fu a cheŋ kum po.

ref: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
text: Bi kaai ale ta yam la a siak waali kaai ate wa nyam a te wa la kama. Waai ale a nye nuruba a la la, a kan wom toariŋka.

ref: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
text: Yam biik ale te fu ka ŋandiin maŋsa, alege velimvendik kɔrisa a bo ale ka wɔkwɔk nyeka.

ref: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
text: Baai ale seba ba giŋgeluŋtaŋa yikka la ale goa beni, alege waai ale kaa poli ale a biisi la a kaasi ka jaab meena.

ref: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
text: Nyiŋworuk nyam a yaali ka yegayega, alege ba a nya fii fiiga, alege baai ale a tom la a jigsi kama.

ref: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
text: Wayɔrisima nyam a kisi venta wie kama alege gaasa nyam a ta ka chivie ale niniga a jam.

ref: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
text: Wayɔrisima a maari nuruba ba boka po meena kama, alege baai ale bie la, ba gaasaŋa ale a kaasi ba.

ref: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
text: Ba gela a jaŋ kama alege a nye badek ase jigsirɔba la. Ba gela a jigsi alege a nye badek ase ŋanjaksa la.

ref: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
text: Jigsirɔwa ale pai ligra a tuni wa nyuvunni nyiŋ, alege jajakka kpaziim a poom kan nagi.

ref: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
text: Wen nuruma nyuvooŋa a sueri ale ka bolim ale masim, alege gaasa nyama bolimu ale kpi.

ref: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
text: Kanjanta a ta ka kpaliŋ a jam. Baai ale a wom sinsaga la ka yam nyam.

ref: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
text: Nwuli jigsika a muriŋ a bɛ kama. Alege nyiŋbiiri ŋanta a piisi kama.

ref: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
text: Yiila ŋaai ale ŋmani ŋaaŋ la a te ka suinum nyiŋtuila, alege gɔdaasima ŋaai ale a chim wensie la ka nyuvuri tiib.

ref: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
text: Waai ale a zɛri sinsaga wanni la a ta ka kaasuŋ a cheen wadek jigi, alege waai ale a teeri wanni a nye wamaŋsa la ale nya nyuenta.

ref: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
text: Yam nyɔnɔ sinsaga a nye ase ka nyuvuri nyiam bulik la. Baai ale siak a te bu la a liisi kum barukku kama.

ref: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
text: Nuru waai ale ta popola maŋsa la, ba a zuli wa kama. Waai ale ka venta nuru la a cheŋ tuak ka kaasuŋ po.

ref: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
text: Wari meena po yam nyɔnɔ a poli kama alege a nye, alege beruk a nye wa betta a sak kama.

ref: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
text: Fi dan zɛri sinsaga, jaŋsa ale chivie ale a jam fi zuk. Fi be dan wom sakka, fi ale nya zula.

ref: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
text: Ku ka suipeentik ate fi nya gɔdaasima a nin jam chim wensie, alege betta a kan siak a basi biemmoa ale a tuesi ŋa.

ref: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
text: Cheŋ ale yam nyam ate fi ta yam, gum chaab ale betta ate fi jo daanika po.

ref: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
text: Daanika a vi wabanyeerisa kama, alege ate niauŋ a chim tutuna a te wayɔrisima nyam.

ref: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
text: Nuru maŋsa a basi ba nitalim a te ka ba ŋaaŋbisa, alege wabaata nyam a basi ba paaruŋ a te ka wayɔrisima nyam.

ref: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
text: Jajak laŋ ale nye ŋandiinta nna yegayega, alege ba ale va venta suik po a vari ba meena.

ref: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
text: Baai ale kan siak a pai fiŋ a te ba bisa waalika la, a kan nye ba a magsi. Baai ale a yaali ba bisa la a te ba ka waalika.

ref: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
text: Wayɔrisima nyama a dɛ ka ba suiniima ale a yaali diila, alege gaasa nyɔnɔwa a cheŋ ale ka poi kɔruk.

ref: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
text: Nipok waai ale ta yam la, a gomsi wa yenni kama a ta di, alege beruk ale waai ale pai wa nisa a dari di a lɔnsi.

ref: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
text: Baai ale a va suik maŋka la a chali Naawen kama. Baai ale kaa va suik maŋka la a zɛri wa kama.

ref: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
text: Dii ale nyini beruk kanjanta biik po la ale basi ate ba nak wa ale doari, alege yam nyam nɔi a vari ba a basi kama.

ref: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
text: Fi dan kan ta lalik ate ka pagra, fi a ta ka bui koruk, alege fi dan ta lalik pagrik fi ale nya ŋandiinta nna yegayega.

ref: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
text: Wensie nyɔnɔ a kan velim, alege venta seerɔ a vuusi ka venta wie.

ref: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
text: Waai ale koosi a la nuruba la a gisi yam ka kinla, alege sebika a nye ka moali a te nuru waai ale ta miŋ chakka la.

ref: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
text: Basi betta ale bo juijui la, dii nyiŋla fi a kan nya wie miŋka yam ba jigi ya.

ref: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
text: Yam nyɔnɔ yammu ale wa kpesi nya wa suiku, alege betta betta ale ba paasika.

ref: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
text: Betta a pai nye kaasuŋ ate ku a chim ka laata wari, alege wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ a pai ku a chim ka ninmuna wari ale ŋman a yaali nyemagsika.

ref: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
text: Suinum meena a seba bu biem kama, ate waai a kan maari a dɛ ku masimu.

ref: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
text: Gaasa nyɔnɔwa yenni ale kaasi, alege wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa viuku ale nala.

ref: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
text: Suik kuui a boro kama a nye ase ku nala la a te nuru, alege ku nuerika ku ka kum suik.

ref: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
text: Laata a suk ka sui kaasuŋ, alege laataŋa a dan nueri sui kaasuŋku a ŋman boro kama.

ref: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
text: A jɔk po yiila a ta siaka ale ka wari meena, alege yam nyɔnɔ a poli wari meena zuk kama.

ref: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
text: Yam nyam a kpesi badek kama ale a yik badek a nyini daanika po, alege betta niŋ ale kan bo wari po la ale soa ate ba a jɔ wie po.

ref: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
text: Baai sue ale kaa daliŋ puurika la, a nye ka dii ale kan nala, waai ale a zok biem la ba kisi wa.

ref: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
text: A jɔk po yiila a ta ka wa bettaŋa nyiini, alege yam nyɔnɔ nyuenta ale miŋka.

ref: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
text: Nuru baata a kpi ka duna nuru maŋsa niŋ. Gaasa nyama ale kpi duna Wen nuruma nansuiŋta nɔi.

ref: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
text: Jajak dek sɔm a poom ka yaalika ale wa, alege jigsirɔwa a ta ka doaba a piisi.

ref: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
text: Fi dan zaab fi vaanchoa ku ka wabiok, niaka ale baai ale a maari ŋanjaksa.

ref: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
text: Fi dan poli ayen fi nye biem, fi ale bɛ. Fi be dan poli ayen fi nye nalim, fi ale tuesi yaali kaai ale kan a nueri la ale wensie.

ref: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
text: Tuima tomka a ta ka nyuenta a jam, alege daluŋ kama a ta ka jaŋsa a jam.

ref: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
text: Paaruŋ ale yam nyɔnɔ naam zutɔk. Betta wie meena a chim ka betta.

ref: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
text: Wensie seerɔ a vari ka nuruba nyuvoa a basi, alege venta seerɔ ka bumbobrɔ.

ref: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
text: Naawen yɔgsum chalika a basi ate nuru a ta ka sebchakka wa po, ate wa bisaŋa a nya sukka jigi.

ref: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
text: Naawen yɔgsum chalika ka nya buui ale buli a te nyuvuri, ale basi ate fi a nyini kum baruk po.

ref: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
text: Tɛŋ kaai nuruba ale piisi la ka naawa pimpauk. Tɛŋka nuruma a dan kan piisi ya ka wa chivie.

ref: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
text: Suiyɔgni suinum a basi ate ka nyiŋka a ta nyiŋyɔgsa, alege nyuri a nye ase ka nyiŋtuila ale bo kobaŋa po la.

ref: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
text: Baai ale a namsi ŋanjaksa la, a lɛ ka Waai Ale Nye Ba La, alege baai ale a maari baai ale a silim la a zuli ka Waai Ale Nye Ba La.

ref: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
text: Kaasuŋ a ŋɔriŋ ka gaasa nyam alege nuru maŋsa a nya likka kama ase ba nin kpi.

ref: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
text: Yam a bo ka nuru waai suinum ale a miŋ wie kiri la, alege betta a zɛ yam wie.

ref: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
text: Wayɔrisima a zak ka tɛŋ a zaani, alege wabiok a chim ka chivie a te nuru meena.

ref: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
text: Baliyaa tulisika a yiak ka suipuurum a basi, alege cheti basika a siti ka sue.

ref: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
text: Yam Nyɔnɔ sebika biika a ta ka mariŋka, alege beruk nɔnni a berinti betta.

ref: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
text: Naawen a nya jigi meena, wa a nya gaasa ale nuru maŋsaŋa meena kama.

ref: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
text: Wa baasima ka nyuvuri tiib, alege pimpaasima a ko ka chiik.

ref: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
text: Ka beruk nyiini ale kaa wom wa ko sinsaga, alege waai ale a wom sinsaga la ka yam nyɔnɔ.

ref: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
text: Tuilum ŋanta a bo wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa yenni po kama, alege daanika ale chim tutuna a siŋ gaasa nyɔnɔwa yenni po.

ref: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
text: Yam nyɔnɔ biik a te ka wie yam miŋka. Ku abe daa dila ale beruwa.

ref: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
text: Naawen a kisi gaasa nyam kaabka kama, alege wa ta yaalika ale wayɔrisima nyama puusa kama.

ref: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
text: Gaasa nyɔnɔ suik ka kisuk a te Naawen, alege wa ta yaalika ale waai ale a gisi wayɔrisima la kama.

ref: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
text: Waai ale a zɛri suik maŋka la, le nya waalika. Ate waai ale a kisi sakka la ale kpi.

ref: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
text: Kum ale kaasuŋ an baga a yigi wasusuga Naawen jigi ya. Wa seba nurubiik suinummu a zuak kama!

ref: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
text: Baai ale nye nuruba a la la a kan yaali sakka. Ba a kan begi sinsaga a nyini baai ale ta yam la jigi ya.

ref: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
text: Suinum buui ale a kpesi wie la a gisi ka wie yam miŋka, alege beruk ŋandiinta ale betta.

ref: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
text: Baai sue ale kan peenti la, dai meena a ta ka daanika a jam ba jigi, alege baai sue ale peenti la nyuvuri kasim ka tigi a te ba.

ref: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
text: Fi dan ta maga ale a chali Naawen yɔgsum a zunchoŋŋa jigsika ale butimka.

ref: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
text: Fi dan dɛ jenvaata juijui ate yaalika a boro la, a zunchoŋŋa fi ale a ŋɔbi lanta juijui ate kisika a boro la.

ref: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
text: Nuru waai sui ale kpabi a puuri la a nye ka kpaliŋ, alege waai ale a yik wa suinni la a kpimsi ka kama.

ref: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
text: Nyiŋworuk nyɔnɔ suiku a lik ale ka muŋsa, alege waai ale nye a magsi la suiku a yoarisi kama a cheŋ.

ref: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
text: Nidoabili kaai ale ta yam la a nye ate ka ka kowa sui a peenti, alege nuru beruk a zɛri wa ma kama.

ref: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
text: Berinni a ta ka masim a te baai ale kan ta yam la. Ate waai ale ta yam la a bo suik maŋka po.

ref: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
text: Wie a kan tom a magsi ka sakka ale kan boro la nyiŋ. Sagrɔba yegayega a nye kama ate wie a nye a niak.

ref: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
text: Waai meena a mariŋ tulisi magsika kama, ku nala kama ase fi nin biisi wamaŋ diipo ale magsi fi biisi la.

ref: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
text: Nyuvuri suiku a jueli kama a te yam nyam. Ate ba a basi kum ba ŋaaŋnyiŋ.

ref: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
text: Naawen a kaasi kanjanta nyɔnɔwa yenni kama, alege a lik pukɔga ŋanta.

ref: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
text: Gaasa nyɔnɔ popola ka kisuk a te Naawen, alege nalim wie a welema kama a te wa.

ref: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
text: Dɛ gaamka a ta ka daanika a jam dɔkdem meena zuk, alege baai ale kisa venta ŋanta tuesika la ale boro.

ref: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
text: Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ suinummu a poli ka wa ale wa tulisi diila, alege gaasa nyɔnɔwa nɔi a biisi ka wakaasima.

ref: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
text: Naawen a yalima ale gaasa nyam kama, alege wa a wom wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ puusa kama.

ref: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
text: Suipeentik nyaasim a ta masim a jam suinum po, wapaala maŋsa a te ka nyiŋyɔgsa.

ref: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
text: Nuru waai ale a wom toariŋ kaai ale a niak la, wa le bo yeri ale yam nyama.

ref: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
text: Waai ale a zɛri sinsaga la a kaasi ka wadek, alege waai ale a wom toariŋka la a nya ka yam.

ref: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
text: Naawen yɔgsum chalika a sak ka yam, ate zaab m dek mɛ a de zula niŋ.

ref: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
text: Tama baga a zɔk tidek zɔga kama, alege Naawen ale a tulisi dii ale magsi la.

ref: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
text: Nuru nyeela po meena a nala ka wadek nina po, alege ka Naawen nyiini ale a kpesi ba popolaŋa a nya.

ref: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
text: Pai fi tuima a nyo Naawen nisima po ate wari meena ale nye a magsi a te fu.

ref: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
text: Naawen a nye wari meena a magsi ka wadek popola nyiŋ ate, gaasa nyama a magsi kaasuŋ dai.

ref: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
text: Naawen a kisi kanjanta nyam kama, ba le sum nya namsika.

ref: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
text: Ŋmanteka ale wensie ale a juisi biem duisi basika, ka Naawen yɔgsum chalika ale basi ate nuruba a lɔŋ biem.

ref: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
text: Ase nuru suita a dan peenti Naawen sui, wa ale poom a nye kama ate wa ale wa dachaasa a boro ale suiyɔgni.

ref: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
text: Fi dan ta maga ale wayɔrisima, a zunchoŋŋa fi ale jigsi ale venta.

ref: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
text: Ti baga a zɔk tidek zɔga kama alege ka Naawen ale a zak ti naŋsa.

ref: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
text: Naawen a yaali ka ŋanmagsin maŋsa, wa ale a te magsi kaai ale nala la.

ref: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
text: Naab a zɛri wakaasuŋta kama, wa niŋ dɛka a nyini ka wa nyemagsika po.

ref: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
text: Naab suipuurum ka kum. Waai ale ta yam la ale a yɔk wa suinni.

ref: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
text: Ase Naab a dan la, nyuvuri ale boro. Wa ŋmanteka a yɔk ka nyiŋ ase tɛŋsik ŋmoruk la.

ref: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
text: Yam taka a gaam ligmɔniŋ, ate buusa maŋsa a gaam kpana.

ref: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
text: Fi dan zaab fidek a bo ale ŋanjaksa a zunchoŋŋa fi ale chari kpaliŋ po ŋanta ale kanjanta nyam.

ref: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
text: A waai ale a va sinsaga la a nya ka wamaŋsa, ate a waai mɛ ale a ta sebchakka ale Naawen la a nya ka suipeentik.

ref: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
text: Ba seba yam nyam ka ba miŋ chakka po. Ba le a biisi wie ŋaai la a tagri ka popola.

ref: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
text: Yam nyeela ka nyuvuri nyiam a te waai ale ta bu la, alege turi darika ka kaasuŋ betta jigi.

ref: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
text: Yam nyam a poli kama alege a biisi. Ba ale a weeni diila a ta ka popola tagrika a jam.

ref: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
text: Jiirim wamaŋsa a nye ase ka siita la, a masa a te chiika ale chim nyiŋyɔgsa a te nyiŋka.

ref: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
text: Nuru waai ale kan ta kiri la a poli ka biem wie, ate wa le a biisi diila a beeri ase bolim la.

ref: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
text: Kpaliŋ kpaliŋdɔ a bori ka kpaliŋ bie, bumbobrum a poori doa maŋsa.

ref: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
text: Wɔkwɔk nuruba a ta ba vaanchaab a cheŋ a bɛ kama, a ta ba a cheŋ suik kuui po ale ta daanika la.

ref: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
text: Seba nuru baai ale a la ale a kamsi nina ale fu la, ba ta ka popola baata.

ref: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
text: Zupiila ka zula naam zutɔk. Ku ka nyuenta ase fi ale boro ale wayɔrisima.

ref: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
text: Chichiiba a zunchoŋ pagrim kama. Fidek yikka mɛ a zunchoŋŋa fi le nya nakdeka tɛŋ kpieŋ zuk.

ref: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
text: Nuruba a nak ka gbaŋ a nye ba popola, alege tulisaŋa a nyini ka Naawen jigi.

ref: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
text: Fi dan de ŋandiin kosa ale ta suiyɔgni a zunchoŋŋa, kauk kuui ate ŋandiinta a sueri du alege kpaliŋsa a boro la kama.

ref: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
text: Tomteerɔ waai ale ta yam la ale nya wa kpagni bi kaai ale a nyo wa chivie po la zuk, abe wa maa nya wa bisaŋa nitalimu charuku.

ref: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
text: Ba pai ka bolim a chamsi ligmɔniŋ ale kpana a nya, alege ka Naawen ale a chamsi suiniima meena a nya.

ref: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
text: Baai ale a nye ŋanjaksa a la la a lɛ ka ba nyeerɔwa. Waai ale a dɛ masim a waai zuk biok nyiŋla ale tu chaab ale ninam.

ref: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
text: Ŋaaŋbisa ka ŋan kpagsa zula ase bisa zula ale ka ba nyam la.

ref: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
text: Wamaŋsa biik a kan magsi beruk wa, venta biik a kan magsi kpagi ya.

ref: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
text: Yaalika a jigsi kama ase fi nin vɔŋ te kaasuŋ, alege fi dan ta di fi suinum po di a poori ka doaba.

ref: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
text: Toariŋka bunyi dekki a niak nuru waai ale a miŋ wie la kama, a gaam ba nin miiri beruk ŋaaŋ a paari kook.

ref: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
text: Nuru baata nyiŋsa a gɔk kama a yaali kpaliŋsa, alege ba le namsi ba ate ku jɔ ba nyiŋ.

ref: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
text: Nuru a dan tu gɔi biak kaai ate ba pai ka bisa la a zunchoŋ, fi nin tu chaab ale beruk wa betta po.

ref: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
text: Fi dan pai biem a tuni nalim, biem a kan basi fi yenni.

ref: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
text: Kpaliŋ piilimka a nye ase ka nyiam lakka la, dila nyiŋ basi wanni abe fi ge ate nanpaga a yiti.

ref: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
text: Waai ale nye kaasi la pai basika ale waai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la namsika, Naawen a kisi kula buyewa kama.

ref: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
text: Yam karo ase fi nin tuni ligra ayen ba sak beruk wa, wa toalim ka popola ŋaai ale a zamsi la.

ref: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
text: Doa a kasim a sak ka yaalika, ate ba biak suok ayen wa a maari diipo ale a silim la.

ref: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
text: Nuru waai ale a yaali kpaliŋ la, a yaali ka biem. Waai mariŋka ale bo parik woŋta jigi la a wi ka kaasuŋ.

ref: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
text: Nuru waai suinum ale kan daa ŋmam la a kan nya wa dega. Waai ale a velim la a yɔk a zi ka daanika po.

ref: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
text: Ku ka sui domsik ase fi nin chim beruk ko, fi dan chim tukpari nyɔnɔ ko masim a ka ku po.

ref: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
text: Waai sui ale peenti la ku a nye ase ka tiim maŋ la, alege sui kaasuŋ a kpeeri ka nyiŋ pagrim.

ref: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
text: Gaasa nyɔnɔwa a suk a tuesi ŋanta kama a nyiem yaa yik wensie boteka a tulim ate ku chim venta.

ref: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
text: Yam nyam a pai ba nina a basi ka yam wie zuk, alege beruk popola ale a weeni wa diila la ale wa a nye.

ref: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
text: Ku an nala ayen fi namsi wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ wa tuimaŋsa nyiŋŋa, yaase fi yik niŋdeerɔba a miiri ba ayen ba wensie nyiŋŋa.

ref: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
text: Waai ale a yik wadek biik po la a ta ka yam, ate waai ale a yik wadek la a ta miŋ chakka.

ref: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
text: Nuru baai ale kaa yaali nuruba maŋka la, niŋ a bo ale ka badek nyiini wie. Waai a dan poom seba wari ate ku nala ba kan siagi.

ref: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
text: Wari miŋka a ka kiri a te beruwa alege wa a sak ka wa popola ale ka diila.

ref: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
text: Ku an nala ayen fi maari waai ale nye kaasi la, yaase fi bo mini waai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la.

ref: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
text: Betta nɔi po wie a kasim ta ba a jo ka kpaliŋ po, ba a bek a yaali ka nakka.

ref: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
text: Beruk nɔi po biik a kaasi wa kama, ate wadek nɔi po wie a chim baruk a yik wa.

ref: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
text: Ŋaaŋzum nyɔnɔ wie a nye ase ka ŋandiin masa ale a siŋ a waai suinum po diila.

ref: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
text: Nyiŋworuk nyɔnɔ a bie ase ka waai ale a kaasi tuima la.

ref: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
text: Naawen yuenni ka yie pagrik, ate wayɔrisima nyam a chali a nya sukka di po.

ref: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
text: Ka boan chivie, ka boan koansa, ate fi tulisi alege a bek ayen fi miŋ wanni kiri ya.

ref: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
text: Nuru chiik ale yik wa a tara nyiŋtuila po alege chiik kaai sui ale kaasi la ka wana ale baga a pigi?

ref: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
text: Waai ale dɛ niŋ a biisi buusa dɔk po la, a nye nna se wa ta wensie kama la, ka fi nin wom a nyini nwala mɛ jigi.

ref: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
text: Gbaŋ nakka a ta ka nanpaga nakka a jam nuerika. Kula ale a gaari nuruba baye kpaliŋ.

ref: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
text: Doa waai ate fi nye kaasi wa la, ku toa kama ate fi nye wa a magsi. Nanpaga a poori ka nuruba ase tuok ate ba pai kuta a lik diila.

ref: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
text: Yam wie a te ka chakta ase ŋandiin maŋsa la. Wie maŋsa a ta ka chakta a jam.

ref: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
text: Nɔi biik a ta ka kum yaase nyuvuri a jam. Baai ale a yaali biik la a che ka ninam.

ref: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
text: Waai ale a nya nipok la, a nya ka ja maŋ ale ŋman nya ŋmantiik a nyini Naawen jigi.

ref: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
text: Jajakka a saalim a yaali ka jiirim. Jigsirɔwa a tulisi ale ka leeta.

ref: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
text: Doaba gela a boro kama a kaasi chaab, alege doa maŋ a gaam ma biik suata kama.

ref: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
text: Fi dan jaŋ ale ta wensie a zunchoŋŋa fi nin kan ta wensie ale chim beruk.

ref: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
text: Fi daa yaali wari nye alege sebika an gum du ku an nala, yeentika a ta ka nye beka a jam.

ref: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
text: Nuruba a pai ka betta nyeka a kaasi badek ale basi ate ba sue a puuri ale Naawen.

ref: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
text: Jigsika ta ka doa paalisa a jam, alege jajak doaba a zɛri wa kama.

ref: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
text: Jajak dek nuruba a dan zɛri wa. Wa doaba a yaa le zɛri wa a paari ka bɛ. Wa le poom a saalim ba alege ba ale cheŋ.

ref: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
text: Waai ale a miŋ yam la a yaali ka wadek chiika. Ate waai ale ta miŋka la a nya ka wamaŋsa.

ref: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
text: Ku an nala ayen beruk a bo masim po, yaase yɔma a nya nabisa zuwa.

ref: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
text: Naab suipuurum a nye ase ka gbeŋli ale na la alege wa ŋmanteka a nye ase ka maglim ale bo wuuk nyiŋla.

ref: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
text: Nidoabi beruk ka kaasuŋ a te wa ko, ate nipok kpaliŋ kpaliŋdɔ sui puurika a nye ase ka ŋmoruk ale kasim a minisi la.

ref: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
text: Koba baga a te ba bisa yie ale jigsika nitalim kama, alege ka Naawen nyiini ale a te nipok waai ale a miŋ wie kiri la.

ref: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
text: Nyiŋworuk a ta fu a jo ka goom po, ate a ka tuini a tom a ta kɔm a jam.

ref: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
text: Yik m sinsaŋŋa a tara ate fi nyuvunni ale bo fi jigi, fi dan zɛri ŋa fi a cheŋ ka kum po.

ref: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
text: Fi dan maari jajak, fi piem a te ka Naawen, ate wa ale tuni fu fi ale pai dii a te la.

ref: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
text: Te fi bisa waalika ale yiila a diem boro. Dan kan daa di fi ale kaasi ba.

ref: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
text: Baai sue ale kaa daliŋ puurika la ale nya ka badek tutuna, fi dan poom vari ba a basi bunyi, fi ale nye dila kama ŋmana.

ref: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
text: Ta kaamka ale sinsaŋŋa meena ate fi baga a ta la, ate fi ta yam fi boka po meena.

ref: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
text: Nurubiik ale a zɔk dii wa popolaŋa po la a piisi kama, alege ka Naawen yeŋka ale a nye.

ref: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
text: Wensie ale te ate nuru a ta kiri. Fi dan jaŋ a zunchoŋŋa fi nin chim venta nyɔnɔ.

ref: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
text: Naawen yɔgsum chalika a ta fu a cheŋ ka vum po, ate waai ale ta bu la ale vuusi a chak, ninam a chali wa kama.

ref: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
text: Nyiŋworuk nyam a pai ba nisa a nye ŋandiinta kama a kan ta jueli ba noa.

ref: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
text: Nak baai ale koosi a la nuruba la, ate a jɔk po yiila nyama a zamsi yam. Sak waai ale ta miŋ chakka la, ate wa ta yam.

ref: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
text: Fi dan zɛri sinsaga wom ka m biiga, fi pai ka ŋaaŋ a te yam.

ref: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
text: Venta seerɔ a nye wensie a la kama, ate gaasa nyɔnɔ nɔi a dɛ biem.

ref: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
text: Naab suipuurum a nye ase ka gbeŋli ale a na la, waai ale a nye ate wa sui a puuri la a jɔk wa nyuvunni kama.

ref: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
text: Ku ka zula a te nuru ayen wa yik wadek a nyini kpaliŋ po. Ka betta nyiini nyiŋsa ale a zak ale kpaliŋ.

ref: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
text: Fi dan ta nyiŋworuk kpari wen, fi kan nya ŋandiinta cheka wen ya.

ref: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
text: Nuru suinummu po yaalika a limisa ase ka nyiam ale limisa diila, alege nuru waai ale ta miŋ chakka la ale nya yam dula.

ref: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
text: Nuruba yegayega ale a weeni ayen ba ka wensie doaba, alege ka wana ale wa baga a nya waai ate fi ale ta siak teka ale wa?

ref: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
text: Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ waai ale a cheŋ wensie suik po la, wa bisa ale nya suipeentik.

ref: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
text: Ka wana ale wa baga a weeni ayen, <<Mi nye m suinummu ka cheri. M welema kama a nyini m wabaataŋa po?>>

ref: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
text: Venta dobrim ale ŋanmagsin tii ale kan daa wayeŋ la, Naawen a kisi tiyewa meena kama.

ref: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
text: Fi miŋ bisa a nyini ka ba nyeela po, ase ba nyeka a nye cheri ale nala ya.

ref: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
text: Tue a wom ate a nina a nya, ka Naawen ale nye ba nɔi bayewa.

ref: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
text: Fi daa yaali goom, jaŋsa ale jam fi zuk. Lak fi ninaŋa ate ŋandiinta ale piisi a boro a te fu.

ref: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
text: Yam wie a ta dobrim a gaam ligmɔniŋ ale tintain mɔnta yegayega kama.

ref: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
text: Waai a dan chim beruk ayen wa zaani ate nichaanɔ a tuesi pami jaab, wa magsi wa pai ka wadek nitalim a zaani a magsi pamini tuesika.

ref: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
text: Zum boroborok lamka a masa, alege ku nyiem labri a chim ka ziŋa fi nɔnni po.

ref: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
text: Sinsak maŋsa ale soa ate wie a nye a magsi. Kan cheŋ kpaliŋ po alege ate ba an pai yam wie a weeni ale fu.

ref: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
text: Fi dan lɛ fi ko yaase fi ma, ba ale pai fi bolimu a basi legi kpien po.

ref: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
text: Fi dan kpabi a nya jigsika fi boka po, ku daa niauŋ ku kpeglimka po.

ref: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
text: Kan weeni ayen, <<Waai a dan nye fu kaasi, fi nye wa mɛ a tuni.>> Limisi Naawen ate wa nya wanni zuk.

ref: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
text: Naawen a kisi magsika tɔgatɔga buye kama. Wa sui an peenti ale venta ŋanmagsinta.

ref: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
text: Naawen ale a nya ti laari tabika zuk, dila nyiŋ ka boa ale soa ate fi a yaali fi miŋ wari meena suiku po?

ref: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
text: Kan kpabi a nye puulimka ate Naawen a pai fidek a nyo baruk po, alege an kpesi dii ate fi weeni ayen fi ale nye la.

ref: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
text: Naawen bolimu ale a nya nurubiik chiik, a ta wa susugi meena a nyini peelim.

ref: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
text: Yaalika ale wensie ale a lik naab a tara. Yaalika ale a basi ate wari a kan daani wa naam zukpaglika.

ref: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
text: Nuru paalisa zula ale ba pagrim, alege nisɔm nalim ale ba zupiila.

ref: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
text: Nyiŋka po namsika a duisi ka biem a basi. Waali kala choa a kogsi ka suinummu.

ref: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
text: Naab suinum ka buboalik nyiam Naawen nisa po, wa te bu a va ka juijui ate wa a yaali la.

ref: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
text: Nurubiik suita po wie meena a nala ka wadek nina po, alege ka Naawen ale a kpesi suiniima meena a nya.

ref: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
text: Ate fi tom wayɔrisima ale wensie tuima la a nala a te Naawen a gaam kaab te ka kama.

ref: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
text: Kayeruk ale kanjanta ale biem nyeela meena ka wabaata.

ref: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
text: Popola maŋsa ale nyiŋbiiri ale ta a cheŋ jigsika po, alege yientika a ta fu tuak ka jaŋsa po.

ref: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
text: Fi dan velim a jigsi, ŋantaŋa a muriŋ a bɛ kama a nyini fi jigi ase pik la ale ŋman a chim kum baruk.

ref: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
text: Gaasa nyama dek wɔkwɔk ale vaari ba ta cheŋ, dii nyiŋla ba zɛri kama ayen ba kan nye dii ale ta wensie la.

ref: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
text: Nye kaasirɔwa a va ka suik goantika, alege waai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la a va ka suik kuui ale yoarisi la.

ref: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
text: Fi gboŋ gugoruk po a zunchoŋŋa ase fi nin bo yeri po ate nipok kpaliŋ kpaliŋdɔ a boro.

ref: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
text: Nuru baata a yaali ka biem, ba vaanchaab a kan nya jiirim a nyini ba jigi ya.

ref: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
text: Wayɔrisima Nyɔnɔwa a kpesi gaasa nyɔnɔwa yenni kama. Wa ale dari gaasa nyɔnɔwa a lɔnsi tɛŋ ate wa kaasi.

ref: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
text: Waai ale kaa lak tue a wom ŋanjaksa kumsa la, wa mɛ ale kum a yaali maarika alege waai a kan wom wa.

ref: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
text: Susugi tiirim a yɔk ka suipuurum, fi deri suk te waai jaab dila a kpimsi ka suipuurum yegayega.

ref: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
text: Chekki tuima ka masim a te wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ, alege ku chim daanika a te biem nyam.

ref: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
text: Nuru waai ale kaa miŋ wie kiri la ale nya wadek ale ka kpilima.

ref: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
text: Baai ale a yaali masim la jaŋsa ale yik ba. Baai ale a yaali daam ale masim ŋanta la a kan jigsi.

ref: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
text: Ba a namsi gaasa nyam a tagri ka wayɔrisima nyam ale a namsi bumbobrɔba a tagri baai ale chim wensie nyam la.

ref: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
text: Fi dan bo gɔi po fidek fi nyiini a zunchoŋ fi ale bo ale nipok waai ale a yaali kpaliŋsa ale funfɔbla.

ref: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
text: Yam nyama a ta ka ŋanta ale masim, alege betta a dɛ ka jaab meena ate ba a nya la.

ref: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
text: Waai ale a gisi wayɔrisima ale yaali maŋ la ale nya ka nyuvuri ale wayɔrisima ale zula.

ref: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
text: Yam nyɔnɔwa a nya nakdeka pagrɔwa tɛŋka zuk kama ale a lɔnsi ba yie pagraŋa ate ba ta mariŋka ale ŋa la.

ref: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
text: Waai ale a yik wa nɔnni ale wa giŋgeluŋku la, a yeeri ka wadek a nyini daanika po.

ref: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
text: Koosi laarɔba ka kanjanta ale nyanueriŋ nyam, jaab karo a kasi ba ate ba kan kuulim.

ref: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
text: Nyiŋworuk nyam ale a yaali diila ale a ko ba, diila ba kan siagi ayen ba pai nisa a tom tuini.

ref: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
text: Nuru biok kaabka ka kisuk, be poom ka wa nin ta popola baata a nye kaabka.

ref: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
text: Venta seerɔ ba le gebi wa a basi, alege wensie seerɔ ba le te wa suik ate wa biisi.

ref: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
text: Gaasa nyam a sak ka badek ale ba tuima, alege waai ale za dekki la a poli kama ale a tom wa tuima.

ref: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
text: Nurubiik yam ale sebika ale zɔga an baga a nye Naawen wari ya.

ref: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
text: Wusummu a gomsi magsi kpaliŋka kama, alege nak dɛka bo ka Naawen jigi.

ref: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
text: Dak suik maŋka a sak fi bisaŋa ate ba dan jam pak, ba kan pai ku a basi.

ref: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
text: Ase jigsirɔ ale a nya jajak zuk diila, dila mɛ ate peemdɔwa a chim yɔma a te peemteerɔwa.

ref: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
text: Baai ale a bori venta la a che ka kaasuŋ, ate ba wɔkwɔkka ale jam kpeglimka.

ref: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
text: Nuru waai ale a te la ale nya niaka, dii nyiŋla wa a te ŋanjaksaŋa ka ŋandiinta.

ref: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
text: Yiak waai ale a la nuruba la ate wa cheŋ, ate kpaliŋ a maa va cheŋ. Kpaliŋsa ale leeta ale muriŋ bɛ.

ref: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
text: Waai suinum ale peela la, ate yaalika a bo wa biisa po la, ale ta ka naab ase wa doa la.

ref: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
text: Naawen a nya wensie nyama zuk kama, alege wa a yiak venta nyama a basi.

ref: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
text: Nyiŋ wɔrukku nyɔnɔwa a weeni kama ayen, <<M dan nyini peelim, m le zik gbeŋli suiku po ate di ko mu.>>
