ref: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
text: Ba nuru kpientaŋa a kan ta jaab dula a nak kuusidi ayen ba tɛŋŋa, ate ba nabisaŋa meena ale muriŋ bɛ.

ref: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
text: Muŋsa ale chim a vari ba nalima yieŋa, ate muŋsa tiisa ale chim a vari ba tɛŋka parisaŋa. Gɔi baasa ale nya wa a pai chim kɔk. Abe ka chim viita yeri.

ref: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
text: Gɔi duŋsa ale tu chaab ale piina, ate walisa ale kum a gisi chaab, ate yok ŋanta ale kali dula, ate dula ale chim ba vuusum jiga.

ref: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
text: Viuku ale yɔk ku tuk dula a lob jena. Ku ale wɔgri a pai ku kinkaŋŋa a lik ku bisaŋa. Dula mɛ ate kpaluŋ chaasa meena ale tigsi chaab jigi yeŋ, jaduok ale jasari.

ref: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
text: Nya Naawen gbaŋka po a karim. Ŋade kunyi mɛ la a kan nyini du a nyini bɛ. Ba wanyi mɛ la a kan silim wa vaanchoa. Diila ka wa nɔnni ale biisi wanni, ate Naawen Chiika ale tigsi ba meena a jam jigi yeŋ.

ref: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
text: Gɔnni ale tɛŋ kosikka ale nya suipeentik. Gɔnni ale de masim abe di busum. Ase puuta la,

ref: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
text: ti ale na pusi a nala. Ti ale dɛ masim nna yegayega abe ti a nye masim nuemka. Lebanon zulaŋa ale cheŋ ka jigi, ate Karmel ale Saaron nalimu ale cheŋ si jigi. Ba ale nya Naawen zulaŋa ale ti Wenni nalimu.

ref: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
text: Te ni sii ale wobsa la pagrim ale duna ŋaai ale a te suik la a kan baga a choa.

ref: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
text: Azekaya yaa jam tuesi nuruma ale sak ba jaabuuri meena ale bo wa ŋanta duenika jigini la, ŋa jam ka kpana ale ligmɔniŋ ale ŋan baai ate ba pai a nyo jenta po la ale kpa naliŋ ale wa tugurik kɔlimaŋa ale jaab meena ate fi le nya wa jigi la. Jaab ka wa naab yenni po ale naamu meena po ate Azekaya an pai sak ba.

ref: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
text: Dila po Babilon naawa Baladan nidoabinni Merodak Baladan a jam ŋmarisi ka gbaŋ ale tiirim a tom te Azekaya, dii nyiŋla wa jam wom wa yuammu ale wa nyiŋyɔgsa nyaka kama.

ref: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
text: Ate Wen biisiteerɔwa Azaya yaa cheŋ naab Azekaya jigi a bek wa ayen, <<Nuruma a jam weeni ayen ka boa, ba abe nyini ka bɛ?>> Azekaya yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ba nyini ka Babilon, tɛŋ kaai ale yalima.>>

ref: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
text: Ate Azaya yaa weeni Azekaya ayen, <<Wom Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La wanni.

ref: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
text: Ku cheena ate jaabuuri meena ale bo fi naab yenni po la ale jaabuuri meena ate fi koma a yaali dueni a jam paari jinla de la, ba ale ji a ta cheŋ Babilon. Jaab a kan tali, ka Naawen ale a weeni.

ref: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
text: Ate fi ŋaaŋsa gela, fidek nyiŋka ale fidek ziimu baai ate ba za ba biak a te fu la, ba le ta ba a cheŋ, abe ba jɛ ba ate ba bo Babilon naawa yenni.>>

ref: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
text: Azekaya yaa tulisi ayen, <<Naawen wanni ate fi biisi la a nala kama.>> Diila wa poli kama ayen, <<Mi boka daaŋa po suiyɔgni ale likka ale boro.>>

ref: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
text: Ni yɔk, ni yɔk m nuruma sue, ni Wenni ale weeni.

ref: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
text: Biisi baliyaa a te Jerusalem, a mooli te ka ayen wa tuim pagraŋa a nueri kama, ba tuni wa biemu nyiŋ kama, ayen wa tuesi a nyini Naawen nisa po wa biemu nyiŋ buye.

ref: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
text: Nuru lueluk ale boro a wi ayen, <<Gomsi suik gɔnni po a te Naawen. Nye ate suiku a doa yɔrr sagni po, suik duok a te ti Wenni.

ref: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.
text: Palinti viak meena a sueri, a nye ate guuk meena ale pina meena a siŋ tɛŋ, golaŋa meena a si, ate jigi dii ale lɔrima la ale nala.

ref: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
text: Ate Naawen zulaŋa ale nyini peelim, ate nuru meena ale nya ŋa. Diila ka Naawen nɔnni ale biisi.

ref: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
text: Lueluk ale boro a weeni ayen, <<Kaari ate ku nyini peelim.>> Ate mi yaa weeni ayen, <<M kaari ayen boa? Nuru meena a nye ase ka wuuta la, ate ba zulaŋa meena a nye ase puuta ale bo talim po diila.

ref: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
text: Wuutaŋa a kpi kama, ate puutaŋa a lɔ, dii nyiŋla Naawen vuusumu ale a fuk ti. Chekki nuruma ka wuuta.

ref: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
text: Wuutaŋa a kpi kama, ate puutaŋa a lɔ, alege Wen wanni ale kasim boro kama taam wuu.>>

ref: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
text: Fi waai ale ta wapaala a jam Zayon la, ni jueli guwoŋ zuk. Nama baai ale ta wapaala a jam Jerusalem po la, a lak ni luelutaŋa a nuem ate ku jueli, ni te ku jueli, ni kan chali yɔgsummoa. Ni weeni Juda tɛŋsaŋa ayen, <<Ni Wenni ale nna.>>

ref: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
text: Nya, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen a cheena ale pagrim, ate wa nisaŋa a nya wie meena zuk a te wa. Nya, wa tutunaŋa a bo ale wa kama ate wa ale vari baai a basi la ale bani wa.

ref: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
text: Wa a nya wa piisaŋa zuk ase ka naapeerik la. Wa ta pabisaŋa ka wa nisa po ale pai si a pɛ. Wa a nya sii ale diem ta bisa la zuk ka nna baliyaa.

ref: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
text: Ka wana ale pai wa nisa a magsi nyiamoa, yaase a pai wa nisa a magsi wenŋmazukku? Ka wana ale baga a pai tɛŋzuk de nyuŋ a nyo busik po yaase wa baga a pai ja magsim a magsi pinaŋa ale guutaŋa?

ref: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
text: Ka wana ale baga a miŋ Naawen popolaŋa yaase wa dak wa ayen wa nye wari ase wa sagrɔ la?

ref: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
text: Naawen a bek ka wana ayen wa sak wa? Ka wana abe le sak wa suik miŋka? Ka wana ale jam sak wa sebika yaase wa sak wa wie miŋka suik wa?

ref: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
text: Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa a nye ase ka nyanyuila la. Ba a nye ase ka paasuk ale bo ja magsim po diila. Wa magsi tɛŋ sii ale gilim nyiam la kama ate si a nye ase paasuk la.

ref: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
text: Lebanon a ka daata a paari kuŋkuŋ bolim cheemka, yaase ka duŋsaŋa a paari juka tiirita nyeka.

ref: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
text: Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa meena daa jaab wa niŋŋa. Wa niŋ tɛŋsaŋa meena ka kinla, wa jigi si ka kiri ya.

ref: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
text: Dan ka bɔgluk, ka nuru ale peesi ku, ka nuru ale pai ligmɔniŋ a taari ku, ale pai kpana chɔrima a gomsi ku.

ref: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
text: Nuru waai ale ŋmasi jaŋ an baga tiirim bula choa a te la, luk ka da tii ale ka a puak la a te. Wa gisi peesirɔ ate wa nye bɔgluk ate ku kan baga a lɔ.

ref: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
text: Fi a zɛ? Fi an wom ya? Ba an weeni fi a nyini piilimka? Fi an miŋ chagi a nyini tɛŋka piilimka?

ref: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
text: Wa kali ka wa naam zukpaglika zuk a bo wenŋmazukku ate tɛŋ gigilukku a bo wa tɛŋ, ate ka nuruma a nye ase nanchoŋta la. Wa lagri wenŋmazukku kama nna se viuk la ale lati ku ase garuk pali ayen wa bo ku po.

ref: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
text: Wa nye ate nabisa a ka kiri ya ale nye ate niŋdeerɔba tɛŋzuk de a ka kiri ya.

ref: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
text: Ku an beni ya ate ba vuk, ku an beni ya ate ba bori, ku kan beni ba le feri tɛŋ naŋsa, ate wa fuk ba ase viok la ate ba wiiri, ate va pagrik a ji ba a ta cheŋ ase vɔtta la.

ref: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
text: Zak nya wenŋmazukku. Ka wana ale nye ŋantaŋa de meena? Wala waai ale nye ate chiŋmarisaŋa kanyi kanyi ale si yue kanyi kanyi la. Wa pagrim buui ale zuak la ale wa pagrim kpiemu nyiŋ, ba wanyi mɛ la a kan yuli a bɛ.

ref: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
text: Jekob, ka boan nyiŋ ate fi a biisi. Izirali, ka boan nyiŋ ate fi a fɔbili ayen, <<Mi suiku a suk kama a nyini Naawen jigi ya, mi suitaŋa Wen a cheem ka kpai a te ti?>>

ref: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
text: Fi a zɛ? Fi an wom ya? Naawen ka Wen dii ale boro taam wuu. Wa ka tɛŋka kpeglimka Nyeerɔ. Wa kan jiagi yaase wa pagrim a nueri, ate waai karo a miŋ wa popolaŋa ale ka diila.

ref: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
text: Bi paaluk a jiak kama ate ba pagrim a nueri, nidoa paaluk nyiŋsa ale gɔk ate ba lɔ.

ref: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
text: Alege baai ale ta yiila ale Naawen la ale nya pagrim paalik. Ba ale yiri ale kiŋkaŋŋa ase jiirita la. Ba le chali ba kan jiagi, ba le cheŋ ba kan cha vuusummoa.

ref: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
text: <<Tɛŋ sii ate nyiam a gilim si la a nye chim mi niŋ. Basi ate tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa a ŋman nya pagrim paalik. Basi ate ba jam niŋ a biisi. Basi ate ti tu chaab buusa boka jigini.

ref: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
text: Wa a vi ba kama alege jaab an nye wa. Wa va ka suik kuui ate wa an diem va ku a nya ya.

ref: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
text: Ka wana ale nye nna la ale ta ku a ga taamu ale a wi gaŋ sii ale nyini piilimka la? Mi Naawen ale piilimka, ka mi ale kpeglimka mɛ.>>

ref: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
text: Tɛŋ sii ate nyiam a gilim si la, a nya kama ale yɔgsa. Tɛŋka meena nyiŋsa a gɔk kama. Ate ba paari chaab a jam niŋ.

ref: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
text: Wanyi meena a maari wa choa ale a weeni wa suok ayen, <<Bi pagra.>>

ref: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
text: Peesirɔwa a te choabiika nyiŋbiiri, ate waai ale pai kuk doaguri a salisi la a te waai ale a nak kutuk la nyiŋbiiri. Wa a weeni waai ale a tom kuta chaab la ayen, <<Ku nala kama.>> Wa a nak bɔglukku ale peema a feri tɛŋ ayen ku kan lɔ tɛŋŋa.

ref: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
text: <<Alege fi, Izirali, m tomteerɔ Jekob, waai ate m lueri fu la, a nyini Abrayam mi doawa ŋaaŋbisaŋa po la,

ref: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
text: Mi pai fu kama a ta nyini tɛŋka kpeglimka, a nyini ka gugottaŋa ale yalima la po, mi wi fu kama. Mi weeni kama ayen fi ka m tomteerɔ mi lueri fu kama mi an zɛri fu.

ref: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
text: Dila kan yɔgsa, ale mi bo ale fu kama. Kan jɔk nyiŋbiiri, diila mi ale fi Wen. M le te pagrim abe m maari fu. M le pai m wayɔrisima juga nisaŋa a yik fu.

ref: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
text: <<Baai meena ale ta chaab ale fu la chivie ale yik ba. Baai ale kaa siak a te fu la kan ta kiri ya abe ba kpi.

ref: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
text: Fi dan poom a gisi fi dachaasaŋa, fi a kan nya ba. Baai ale a nye kpaliŋ ale fu la meena a kan bola a ta kiri ya.

ref: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
text: Dii nyiŋla mi ka Naawen, fi Wen dii ale yik fi juga nisaŋa ale a weeni fu ayen, kan yɔgsa. M le maari fu.

ref: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
text: Kan yɔgsa, Jekob ale Izirali tɛŋ kaai ale pɔsima la, diila mi dek ale maari ni,>> Naawen ale a weeni dila, fi Da Tuesirɔwa, Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali la.

ref: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
text: <<Nya, m le nye fu ŋanta fɔbika laarik ale nɔi paali dii ale a de la ale nyina nna yegayega. Fi le ŋɔriŋ pinaŋa abe guutaŋa a chim vɔtta.

ref: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
text: Fi ale yali ti, ate viok ale pai ti, ate va pagrik ale ji ti a ta cheŋ. Alege fi ale de masim Naawen niŋ abe fi nya zula Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali po la.

ref: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
text: <<Ŋanjaksa ale baai ale a silim la a gisi ka nyiam, alege bu karo. Ba giŋgeluŋtaŋa a kɔ kama ale nyanyuila. Alege mi Naawen ale tulisi ba. Mi Izirali Wenni a kan zɛri ba.

ref: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
text: M le nye ate bela a bo gu tii ate jaab a karo la zuk, abe benaŋsa a bo vaasaŋa po. M le labri gɔnni ate di chim bela, ate tɛŋ kosikka a chim benaŋsa.

ref: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
text: M le pai nyunyoŋ ale siik ale puuta tiisa ale kpaam tiisa a basi gɔnni po. M le te ate dapeelita tiisa ale kinkaŋ peruk ale damɔnta tiisa a gum chaab a bo tɛŋ koroku po.

ref: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
text: Ate dila a basi ate nuru a baga nya abe ba seba, abe ba poli, abe ba miŋ ayen ka Naawen nisa ale nye nnawa, ayen ka Waai ale Welema Izirali po la ale nye dila.

ref: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
text: Naawen a weeni kama ayen, <<Jam weeni fi ale ta wari diila.>> Jekob Naawa ayen, <<Ta fi nanpaŋŋa a jam.>>

ref: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
text: <<Ta fi bɔgtaŋa a jam ate ti weeni ti dii ale za ku nye la. Weeni ti wakpagsaŋa ale jam ka diila, ate ti poli a nya ate ti nya ŋa ale za ŋa nye diila. Yaase weeni sak ti wie ŋaai ale za ŋa nye la.

ref: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
text: Weeni chum po wie ate ti miŋ ayen ni ka wena. Ni nye wari, ku dan poom ka biem yaase nalim ate ti jɔk nyiŋbiiri ate yɔgsum a sueri ti.

ref: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
text: Alege ni ka ŋankayaata ate ni tuimaŋa a ka kiriya. Waai ale a lueri ni la a ta ka kisuk.

ref: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
text: <<M choa ka waai ate wa nyini konni po a cheena. Wa nyini ka wenbinni ale a pusi juijui la, wa ka waai ale a wi mi yuenni. Wa a tabi kpaga nna se ba ka tanta ate ba bu la ase mɛɛrɔ ale a tabi yak diila.

ref: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
text: Ka wana ale weeni kude a nyini piilimka ate tama ale ti seba, yaase ti ŋaan seba ate ti ale weeni ayen, <Wa ta wensie?> Waai an weeni nya kude, waai abe poom ŋaan weeni ku, nuru waai an wom wie a nyini fi jigi ya.

ref: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
text: Mi ale waai ale dɛ niŋ a weeni Zayon ayen, <Nya, ba ale nna.> M tom ka nuru ale wapaala a te Jerusalem.

ref: None of these idols are able to give advice or answer questions.
text: Mi gisi kama alege nuru ka. Nuru a ka ba po ayen wa sak ba. M dan bek ba wari nuru karo ale tulisi.

ref: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
text: Nya, ba meena ka venta nyam. Ba tuimaŋa a jam chim ka kinla. Ba ŋanmɛɛntaŋa daa jaaboa alege ka viok ale butimka.

ref: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
text: <<M tomteerɔwa ale nna, waai ate mi a maari la, waai ate m lueri a ta popeentik ale wa la. M le pai m Chiika a basi wa zuk ate wa ale ta nyemagsika a jam tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po.

ref: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
text: Wa kan nuemu yaase wa kaari yaase wa lak wa lueluku suitaŋa po.

ref: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
text: Wobi dii ale koani la, wa kan kaasi di, ate boom buui ale kan nya a paari la, wa a kan kpimsi. Wensie po wa ale ta nyemagsika a jam.

ref: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
text: Dii ate Wen, Naawen a weeni la ale nna, wa waai ale nye wenŋmazukku ale nye ate ku lagri la, wa waai ale lak tɛŋzuk de la ale ŋan baai meena ale nyini ka po a nyini la, waai ale a te ka nuruma vuusum ale a te baai ale a cheŋ ka po la nyuvuri.

ref: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
text: <<Mi, Naawen, a wi fu kama wayɔrisima po. M le yik fi nisa. M le ta fu abe m nye ate fi chim nɔiyeŋ a te nuruma. Abe fi chim bolim a te baai ale kan daa Izirali dem la,

ref: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
text: <<Ka Mi ale Naawen m yuenni ale la. M kan pai m zulaŋa a te waai ya yaase m pai m pimpaukku a te bɔgta.

ref: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
text: Nya wakpagsaŋa a poom boro a nye kama, wapaala ate mi a weeni. Alege ate ŋa nyini boro la ka mi ale mooli ŋa a te fu.>>

ref: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
text: Ni lenni yipaali a te Naawen. Wa pimpaukku a nyini tɛŋka kpeglimka. Nama baai ale a siŋ nyakpiemu tɛŋka la ale ŋan baai meena ale bo bu po la, nama tɛŋ sii ate nyiam a gilim si la ale baai meena ale bo bu po la.

ref: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
text: Naawen ale gɔk santiri ase nuru pagrik la. Ase nakdeerɔ la, wa nyiŋ ale zeenti a yaali kpaliŋ nyeka. Wa ale nye nuemka ate ka chim kpaliŋ kaarik, ate wa ale nya pagrim wa dachaasa zuk.

ref: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
text: <<M nye ka chim ate ku beni, m nye chim kama ale yik m dek a ga ŋaaŋ. Alege yɔgyɔgla de, m le kaari ase nipok ale boro a biak diila. M kaari kama a lak nɔi a vuusi a kpeeri.

ref: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
text: M le de yioba niŋ a ta ba va suik kuui ate ba poom zɛ la. Suik tii ate ba zɛ ti la m le gani ba. M le labri legi ate di chim bolim ba niŋ, abe jigi ŋaai ale zaksa la, m le nye ate ŋa saala. Wieŋa de ate mi za ayen m nye. M kan zɛri ba.

ref: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
text: Alege baai ale ta sebchakka ale bɔgta ale a weeni ŋanmɛɛnta ayen, <Ni ka ti wena la,> ale viriŋ a jɔ ka chivie po.

ref: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
text: <<Wom de, fi tuikpari nyɔnɔ. Nya de, fi yiewa abe fi nya!

ref: who sees and hears so much, but pays no attention.
text: Fi nyaka ŋanta nna yegayega alege fi niŋ karo. Fi tueŋa a lak kama alege fi kan wom wari ya.>>

ref: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
text: Ku a peenti Naawen sui kama wa wayɔrisimaŋa nyiŋ ayen wa nye ate wa sinsaŋŋa a zuak abe ŋa ta zula.

ref: Why won't his people ever learn to listen?
text: Ka ni po wana ale a wom nya kude yaase wa kpesi a wom chum diipo?

ref: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
text: Ka wana ale pai Jekob a te ate ba zu ba, wana abe le basi ate ba kɔlim Izirali? Daa Naawen, waai ate ti tom kaasi wa la? Dii nyiŋla ba an va wa suitaŋa. Ba an wom wa sinsaŋŋa.

ref: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
text: Dila nyiŋ wa yaa kpiiri wa suipuurum buui ale a dɛ ase bolim la ale wɔkwɔk kpaliŋ a basi ba zuk. Bu lik ba ase ka bolim ŋiak la, alege ba an miŋ ku kiriya. Bu dɛ ba kama alege ba an pai a nyo ba suiniima po.

ref: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de, Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna. Wa waai ale nye fi Jekob la. Wa waai ale nye fi Izirali la ayen, <<Kan chali yɔgsummoa, diila m da tuesi fu a basi kama. Mi ale wi fi yuenni. Ka mi ale soa fu.

ref: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
text: Fi dan va nyaataŋa po. M le bo ale fu. Fi abe daa va belaŋa po ŋa kan ji fu a ta cheŋ. Fi dan poom va bolim po, bu kan dɛ fu. Bolim ŋiaka a kan baga a chɔgsi fu.

ref: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
text: Dii nyiŋla Mi ale Naawen fi Wenni, Waai ale Welema Izirali po la, fi varibasidɔwa. M pai Ejipiti a te ka fi varibasika nyiŋ ale pai Kus ale Sɛba a tagri fu.

ref: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
text: Ni ale toalim ta dobrim ale zula mi nina po la, mi ale a yaali ni la nyiŋ, m le pai nidoaba a tagri ni, abe m pai nuruba a tagri ni nyuvooŋa.

ref: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
text: Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa, diila m bo ale ni kama. M le ta ni bisaŋa a nyini konni po, abe m tigsi ni a nyini yeniŋka.

ref: I will say to the north and to the south, “Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.
text: M le weeni wiilukku ayen, <Pai ba a te.> Abe weeni yeseoku ayen, <Kan peri a tara.> Ta m nidoabilisaŋa ale bo niŋ la ale m liema ale bo tɛŋka kpeglimka la a jam.

ref: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
text: Baai meena ale a wi mi yuenni la, baai ate m nye ba a magsi m zulaŋa la, baai ate m gomsi ale nye ba la.>>

ref: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
text: De baai ale ta nina alege yi la niŋ ale baai ale ta tue alege kan wom la niŋ.

ref: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
text: Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa meena ale tigsi la ate nuruma jam jigi yeŋ la, ka ba wana dek ale weeni nyakude ale weeni ti wakpaksa? Basi ate ba ta seerɔba a jam sak ayen ba nye magsi kama, ate nuru yonta a wom a weeni ayen, <<Ku ka wensie.>>

ref: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
text: Naawen a weeni kama ayen, <<Nama ka mi seerɔba ale m tomteerɔba, ayen ni seba abe ni ta siaka ale mi, abe ni miŋ ku kiri ayen ka mi ale wala. Wen a karo a bo mi niŋŋa yaase di choa mɛ la ale bo mi ŋaaŋŋa.

ref: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
text: Mi, poom ka Mi ale Naawen, mi tɔga varibasidɔ wa choa a ŋman karo a gum mi po.

ref: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
text: Mi pai sak kama ale vari basi ale mooli. Mi, daa wen chaŋŋa ale bo ale ni. Naawen a weeni kama ayen, <<Nama ka baai ale mi seerɔba ayen, mi ka Wen la.

ref: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
text: Mm, a nyini ŋiaka mi ale la. Waai karo a baga a vari a nyini mi nisa po. M dan nye wari, ka wana ale baga a yik di a labri?>>

ref: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
text: Naawen fi Da Tuesirɔwa, Waai ale Welema Izirali po la ayen, <<Fi nyiŋ m le tom ate ba cheŋ Babilon po, ate ba ale ta Kaldiya demma meena a siŋ tɛŋ ale ba ŋaaruŋtaŋa ate ba ta kanjantaŋa ti nyiŋla.

ref: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
text: Mi ale Naawen, fi Waai ale Welema la, Izirali Nyeerɔwa, fi Naawa.>>

ref: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna. Wa waai ale jam nye suik nyakpiemu po ale suik nyapagrisaŋa po la.

ref: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
text: Wala ale waai ale jam yiak wusuma ale ŋa torokoba ale tugurik tommu ale maarɔba a gum ba po ate ba lɔ dula, an ŋman yiti ya ase zeuŋ bolim ale kpi la.

ref: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
text: <<Ni baŋ wakpagsaŋa. Ni kan kali wie ŋaai ale nye taam la ŋaaŋŋa.

ref: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
text: Nya, m boro a nye ka wapaali. Yɔgyɔgla ku boro a yiti kama. Nama a poli a miŋ ku? M boro a nye ka suik gɔnni po ale beli naŋsa tɛŋ koroku po.

ref: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
text: Duŋ waarisa ale gɔi baasa ale viuta a zuli mi kama, dii nyiŋla m basi ate ka nyiam a bo gɔnni po, ale benaŋsa a bo tɛŋ koroku po, a te m nuruma ale baai ate m lueri la nyiam.

ref: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
text: Nuru baai ate mi a nye ba a te m dek la, ayen ba weeni m pimpaukku.

ref: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
text: <<Alege fi Jekob an wi mi. Fi Izirali an jiak fidek a te mi.

ref: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
text: Fi an da ŋan baai juka nyum ale masa la a te mi, yaase fi nye kaabka ale duŋ kaai ale biigi la a te mi. Alege fi te ate ka fi wabaataŋa a chim jib a te mi ale te ate m jiak ale fi nye kaasuŋku.

ref: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
text: <<Mi, poom ka mi waai ale duisi fi kaasuŋku a basi m dek nyiŋla, m kan ŋman teeri fi wabaataŋa diipo meena.

ref: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
text: Teeri mu wakpagsaŋa. Te ate ti gum chaab a nak nampaga wanni zuk. Ŋmarisi fi ale kan seba dii nɔi po la a dueni.

ref: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
text: Dila nyiŋ fi nuru kpientaŋa ale bo fi yenni po la a bo chivie po, abe m gomsi Jekob a magsi kaasika, abe Izirali a chim ja laam.

ref: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
text: <<Alege yɔgyɔgla de wom, Jekob m tomteerɔ, Izirali waai ate m lueri la.

ref: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
text: Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna. Wa waai ale nye fu la, waai ale nye fu fi mawa ponni po la. Wala ale waai ale wa maari fu. Kan chali yɔgsummoa Jekob m tomteerɔ, Jesurun, waai ate m lueri la.

ref: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
text: Ba le chim ase wuuk ale a jueli diila, ase niak tiisa ale za buboalik nɔi la.

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
text: <<Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna, Izirali Naawa ale ba Da Tuesirɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ la. Mi ale piilimka mi abe le kpeglimka. Dan kan daa mi, Wen di choa a karo.

ref: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
text: Ka wana ale a nye ase mi la? Basi ate wa mooli. Basi ate wa weeni a dueni mi niŋ, dii ale nye a nyini diipo ate m nye ŋiak nuruma la, ale dii ale diem za di jam la mm, basi ate wa ŋaam weeni dii ale di jam la.

ref: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
text: Kan te fi nyiŋ a gɔgi, be kan chali yɔgsummoa. Mi mooli kude ale ŋaam weeni ku wari ka dipo. Ni ka baai ale chim mi seerɔba. Wen di choa a boro a gum mi po? Aaya, Piuŋ ku choa a ŋman karo. Mi zɛ kunyi nɔi po.>>

ref: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
text: Baai meena ale a nye bɔgta la a ka kiriya, ate ba ale pai ba popola a dueni ŋan baai zuk la a ka kiriya. Baai ale biisi a te ba la a yi kama. Ba ale kan seba wari nɔi po la a te ba ka chivie.

ref: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
text: Ka wana ale a peesi wen ya, be ka wana ale a nye bɔgluwa, ku kan te wa nyuenta?

ref: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
text: Wa ale wa vaanchaama meena ale nya chivie. Peesirɔma a ka kiriya alege ka nuruba kama. Basi ate ba meena a jam ba zaana jigi. Ba ale siŋ tɛŋ ate kpazinagsuk ale chivie a yik ba.

ref: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
text: Choa biik a pai ka jaab a nyo bolim kaala po a tom. Wa a pai ka kutuk a nak a nye bɔgluk. Wa a nye ku ale ka wa nigiri. Wa sui nyiem puuri ate wa jɔk wa pagrimu. Wa kan nyu nyiamoa ate jianta a paari wa.

ref: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
text: Danagrɔwa a pai ka miik a magsi. Wa pai ka liaka a chiisi ale pai jaab a kpesi nya. Wa a peesi ku ase ka nuru la ku nalimu meena po, ate ku bo wa tangbanaŋa po.

ref: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
text: Wa che nyunyoŋta a lɔnsi, yaase dai dii dai wa pai damɔnta tiisa yaase tiib kpiensa. Wa basi ate bu maa bo tiisaŋa po a chim a bo gɔnni po, yaase wa vuk kinkaŋ peruk, ate ŋmorukku a nye ate ku a chim.

ref: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
text: Ka nuru ale pai ku a cheem bolim. Wa pai ku gela a cheem bolim a ŋuuŋ wadek ale pai ku mɛ a cheem bolim a sɛ boroborok. Alege pai ku a nye wen a kaab ku. Wa pai ku a nye bɔgluk a koori tɛŋ a te ku.

ref: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
text: Waai karo a basi polika. Waai a ka yam wie miŋka yaase wa ta miŋka a weeni ayen, <<M pai ku gela a cheem bolim. M poom pai ku bolim kaalaŋa a sɛ boroborok ale pai ku a sɛ lam a ŋɔbi. M pai dii ale tali la a nye kisuk jaaboa? M koori tɛŋ a zuli dokoluwa?

ref: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
text: Wa a dɛ ka buntuem, ate suinum buui ale kaasi la a ta wa cheŋ be. Wa an baga a vari wadek a basi, yaase wa weeni ayen, <<Jaamu de ale bo m juga nisa po la daa venta?>>

ref: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
text: Jekob, teeri ŋantaŋa de, diila fi ka m tomteerɔ Izirali. Mi ale nye fu, fi ka m tomteerɔ. Izirali, m kan baŋ fu.

ref: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
text: M duisi fi nye kaasuŋku a basi ase ka chiŋmari la ale nye ate fi wabaataŋa a muriŋ bɛ ase saluik pik la. Ni pilim ŋman jam mi jigi dii nyiŋla m da tuesi ni a basi kama.

ref: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
text: Wenŋmazukku a yi masim yiila, diila ka Naawen ale nye nna. Tɛŋ zuk de a nye nuemka. Guutaŋa ale gɔnni ale tiisaŋa lɔnsi yiili mob, diila Naawen a da Jekob a tuesi kama. Wa a sak wa zulaŋa Izirali po kama.

ref: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Fi Da Tuesirɔ waai ale nye fu fi mawa ponni po la. Mi ale Naawen dii ale nye jaab meena la. Waai ale lagri wenŋmazukku. Mi dek ale waai ale nye ate tɛŋka a teeri la.

ref: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
text: Waai ale weeni ayen nya liuŋku kpeeri la, ate m sum a nye ate fi buboalisaŋa a kpeeri.

ref: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
text: <<Dii ate Naawen a weeni waai ate wa bobi la ale nna, Sairus waai ate m yik wa juga nisa a ta la, ayen wa nya pagrim tɛŋ kpieŋsa zuk abe wa vari kpaliŋsa kɔlima a nyini nalima jigi, abe wa lak tuata wa niŋ ate nansuiŋtaŋa kan ligi.

ref: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
text: M le de fi niŋ a cheŋ abe m nye ate guutaŋa a palinti a magsi chaab. M le wɛ nansuiŋ kuta mɔntaŋa abe m gebi kuta chibsaŋa a taam.

ref: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
text: M le te fu legi nitalimu ale paaruŋ kuui ale suk jigi ŋaai la ate fi ale miŋ ayen Mi ale Naawen, Izirali Wen dii ale pai fi yuenni a wi fu.

ref: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
text: Jekob m tomteerɔwa nyiŋ, Izirali waai ate m lueri la, fi zɛ mi alege dila meena zuk, mi pai ka fi yuenni a wi fu ale pai zula a basi fi zuk.

ref: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
text: Mi ale Naawen, waai a ŋman karo. Wen a ŋman ka jigi ya a gum mi po. Fi a miŋ mi alege dila meena zuk, m le nye ate fi pagra,

ref: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
text: a ta nyini wenbinni pusika a ta ga a paari di siŋka jigi, nuruba ale seba ayen waai karo a gum mi po. Mi ale Naawen, waai a ŋman karo.

ref: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
text: Mi ale nye bolim ale nye legi, mi ale ta paaruŋ a jam ale nye kaasuŋ. Mi, Naawen ale nye ŋantaŋa de meena.

ref: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
text: <<Fi wenŋmazukku ale bo ŋmai la, ni wayɔrisima a basi tɛŋ. Basi ate chiŋmaaŋa a ni a basi tɛŋ. Basi ate tɛŋ zuk de a lagri, basi ate varibasika a tɔŋ jueli ŋmai, basi ate wayɔrisima a chim ale ku. Mi, Naawen ale nye ku.

ref: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
text: <<Ku ale toa a te waai ale ta chaab ale wa Nyeerɔwa la, fi ka samɔniŋ ale maa bo ale samɔnsa ate ba pai tanta a nye. Yak ale baga a weeni mɛɛrɔwa ayen, ka boan nyiŋ ate fi a nye mu nna? Dii ate fi nye la ale weeni ayen, Wa ka nisa?

ref: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
text: Ku ale toa a te waai ale a weeni wa ko ayen, Ka boa ate fi biagi? Yaase wa weeni wa ma ayen, <Ka boa ate fi biagi?

ref: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
text: <<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna, Waai ale Welema Izirali po la, ate wa chim wa Nyeerɔ la. A ta va ŋan baai ale za ŋa jam la, fi a bek mi wie a ta va m bisaŋa nyiŋŋa, yaase fi dak mi wie a ta magsi chaab ale m nisima tuima?

ref: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
text: Ka mi ale waai ale nye tɛŋzuk de ale nye nurubiik a basi ka zuk la. M nisaŋa ale teeri wenŋmazukku. Mi ale nye ate chiŋmarisaŋa a bo wenzukku.

ref: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
text: M le zak Sairus a zaani ŋmai m wayɔrisimaŋa po. M le nye ate wa suitaŋa meena a yoarisi. Wa ale ŋman sɛ m tɛŋ kpieŋka, abe m nuru baai ale basi ba tɛŋka la wa ale vari ba a basi, alege ba kan tuni jaaboa yaase ba tuesi jaaboa, ka Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni.>>

ref: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Ejipiti nyuentaŋa ale Kus geruŋku ŋantaŋa ale Siiba demma baai ale wɔŋa la, ba le jam fi jigi ate fi soa ba. Ba le jiak a vi fi ŋaaŋ ale chɔrima. Ba ale koori tɛŋ fi niŋ, abe ba saalim fu ayen, <Wensie Wen a bo ale fu kama ate waai a karo. Wen di choa a ŋman karo.>>

ref: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
text: Wensie fi ka Wen dii ale a suk wadek, Wen ale Izirali Varibasidɔ.

ref: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
text: Bɔgluk nyeerisa meena chivie ale nyatika ale yik ba. Ba ale gum chaab a cheŋ ale chivie.

ref: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
text: Alege Naawen ale vari Izirali a basi ale taam wuu varibasika. Fi a kan nya chivie yaase nyatika bena ŋaai ale cheen la a ta ga a paari diipo meena.

ref: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
text: Kude nyiŋ ate Naawen a weeni ayen, Wa waai ale nye wenzukku la, wa ka Wen, wa ale gomsi ale nye tɛŋzuk de, wa ale nye ka. Wa an nye ayen ku boro koruwa, alege wa nye kama ayen ba bo ka po. Wa a weeni kama ayen, Mi ale Naawen ate waai a karo.

ref: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
text: Mi an zaani tɛŋka legi po a suk biisi ya. Mi an weeni Jekob ŋaaŋbisaŋa ayen, ba a gisi mi kinla. Mi Naawen, a biisi ka wensie. Mi a weeni ka dii ale chim wensie la.

ref: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
text: Weeni dii ale magsi di nye la, pai te. Basi ate ba jam jigi yeŋ a pai yam a sak chaab. Ka wana ale dɛ niŋ a weeni kude dipo la, ka wana ale weeni ku a nyini niŋniŋ ŋa? Ku jam daa mi, Naawen. Wen a karo a gum mi po, wayɔrisima Wen ale Varibasidɔ, waai a ŋman karo alege ka mi nyiini.

ref: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
text: <<Viriŋ a jam mi jigi ate fi nya varibasika, nama baai meena ale bo tɛŋzuk de jigi meena la. Diila mi ka Wen, ate waai a ŋman ka.

ref: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
text: Ba ale weeni m wari ayen, <<Naawen nyiini jigi ate wayɔrisima ale pagrim a boro.>> Baai meena ale a nye kpaliŋ ale wa la ale jam wa jigi ate chivie a yik ba.

ref: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
text: Alege Naawen jigi ate Izirali ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale nya wayɔrisima ale masim dɛka.

ref: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
text: Bel wenni a kpi ka duna, ate Nebo wenni a koori tɛŋ. Ba bɔgtaŋa a chim ka jibta a te duŋsa. Ŋanmɛɛntaŋa ate ba ji la a chim ka daanika ale jibta a te baai ale jiak la.

ref: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
text: Ba gum ka chaab a koori ale kpi duna. Ba an baga a vari badek a nyini jimmu po. Badek ale cheŋ yɔntidi po.

ref: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
text: <<Wom mi, Jekob yeri ya, Izirali yeri dem baai ale tali la, fi waai ate m ta fu a nyini diipo ate ba yik fi puuk la ale pai fu a nyini diipo ate ba biak fu la.

ref: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
text: A poom ta jam paari fi kpaŋsa po ale fi zupiila taka. Mi ale la, mi ale waai ale wa maari fu. Mi ale nye fu ate m le pai fu. M le maari fu abe m vari fu a basi.

ref: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
text: Ba gela a kpiiri ka ligmɔniŋ a nyini ba boorisaŋa po ale magsi kpana ŋanmagsinta zuk. Ba pai ka choabiik ate wa pai ŋa a nye wen, ate ba a koori tɛŋ ale a puusi di.

ref: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
text: Ba a zak a vi ba ŋmankpalaŋa zuk a ji di. Ba pai di a zaani ka di jigini, ate di za dula. Di ale za juijui la, di an baga a cheŋŋi. Waai a dan poom kum a wi di, di kan tulisi. Di an baga a vari wa a basi a nyini wa daanika po.

ref: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
text: <<Teeri kude, pai nyo fi popola po, pai nyo fi suinum po, nama baai ale kaa siak a te wie la.

ref: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
text: Teeri wie kpagsaŋa, ŋaai ale jam boro dipodipo la. Mi ale Wen. Waai a karo a gum mi po. Mi ale Wen. Waai a karo a nye ase mi la.

ref: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
text: M wi ka duiŋ konni po ate ka cheena. A nyini tɛŋ kaai ale yalima la ate m wi nuru ayen wa nye dii ate m ta m popola po la. Mi ale weeni diila, ate m za m ta jam. Mi ale zɔk diila ate m le nye.

ref: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
text: Wom mi, fi waai turi ale kpari ale ta suinum pagrik la, fi waai ale yalima ale wayɔrisima la.

ref: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
text: M ta m wayɔrisimaŋa a moata kama ku an yalima, ate m varibasika a kan beni. M le te Zayon varibasika, abe m te Izirali m nalimu.

ref: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
text: <<Cheŋ tɛŋ, kali paasuku po, Babilon Liewa nipok Kaliaka kali tɛŋka abe fi kan ta naam zukpaglika Kaldiya demma liema po. Ba a kan ŋman wi fu ayen fi baasa yaase fi ta ka a toa.

ref: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
text: Pai niri a num zom. Yeeri fi garuk nyaara nyaaraŋa. Zak fi mankutaŋa ŋmai, kan su nuesa, abe fi gaam buboalisaŋa a taam.

ref: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
text: Ba le nya fi chaboalaŋa, ate fi chivieŋa a kan ligi. Mi ale nye a tuni. M kan basi waai ya.

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
text: Ti Da Tuesirɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale wa yuenni, Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali la.

ref: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
text: Kali tɛŋ chim, cheŋ legi po, Kaldiya dem liewa, ba kan ŋman wi fu ayen naata nipok naaba.

ref: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
text: Mi sui a jam a puuri ale m nuruma ate m kaasi m nitalimu. Ate m pai ba a nyo fi nisa po alege fi an sak jiirim ale ba. Baai ale poom kpaŋ la fi pai ka niiga diok kuui ale dobra la a vi ba zuk.

ref: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
text: Fi weeni kama ayen, <M le kasim a chim ka nipok naab taam wuu.> Alege fi an poli wieŋa de, yaase fi poli ayen ka boa ale ku nye.

ref: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
text: <<Yɔgyɔgla de, wom de, fi waai ate nidoa boari a sebi fu la, fi bo ka fi sukka jigini ale a weeni fidek ayen, <Ka mi, ate waai a karo a gum mi po. M kan chim pukɔgi yaase m jɔk bisa.>

ref: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
text: Bade meena ale jam fi zuk dai yeŋ po. Bisa jɔkka ale pukɔgini. Fi le fi sampoporinni ale fi tinaŋsa meena po, daanika de ale jam fi zuk ate ku paari fu.

ref: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
text: Fi ta ka sebchakka ale fi gaasaŋa ale weeni ayen, <Waai a kan nya mu.> Fi yammu ale yam wie miŋka a ta fu cheŋ a bɛ kama ase fi ale a weeni fidek ayen, <Ka mi ate waai karo a gum mi po.>

ref: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
text: Sinsak ŋaai meena ate fi tuesi la a nye kama ate fi jiak. Basi ate baai ale seba chiŋmarisa wie a jam niŋ, baai ale a porisi chiik po meena la. Basi ate ba vari fu a ta nyini dii ale cheen fi zuk la.

ref: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
text: Wensie nyiŋ ba a nye ase ka kinkaa la. Bolimu chogsi a dɛ ba. Ba an baga a vari badek a nyini bolim ŋiaka pagrimu po. Bolim kaala a ka dela a toliŋ waai nyiŋŋa. Bolim a ka dela ate waai a kali bu tɛŋ ŋa.

ref: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
text: Dii meena ate ba baga a nye a te fu la ale la. Ŋade ate fi a tom ale gerim a nyini fi bi fiisa po. Ba meena a nye bɛ kama. Ba waai an baga vari fu a basi.

ref: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
text: <<Jekob yenni a wom kude, fi waai ate ba a wi fu ayen Izirali ate fi nyini Juda dɔkdemma po la, fi a nye pɛka Naawen yuenni nyiŋ ale a wi Izirali Wenni, alege ku daa wensie yaase wayɔrisima po.

ref: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
text: Nama baai ale a wi nidek ayen tuilum tɛŋ nuruba ale pai ni yiila meena a basi Izirali Wenni zuk la. Wa yuenni ale Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La.

ref: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
text: Mi liŋ a weeni wakpagsaŋa kama dipo, m nɔnni ale mooli ŋa ale nye ate waai meena a seba ŋa, ate mi deri nye ate ŋa sum a jam boro.

ref: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
text: Fi wom ŋade wie kama. Nya ŋa meena. Fi a kan siak a te ŋa? <<A nyini yɔgyɔgla de a cheŋ, m le weeni fu ŋan paala wie, ŋan susuga ŋaai ate fi zɛ ŋa.

ref: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
text: Fi an wom ya yaase fi poom miŋ di kiri ya. A nyini dipo fi tueŋa an lagri ya. M seba fi bobrika nɔi po kama. Ba jam a wi fu ka a zɛri wie a nyini fi biam po.

ref: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
text: <<M dek yuenni nyiŋ ate m beni m suipuurumu. M pimpaukku nyiŋ ate m yik ku a basi ŋaaŋ a nyini fi jigi. Ayen m kan gebi fu a basi.

ref: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
text: <<Nya, m soti fu kama, ku be daa se kpana la. M chamsi fu nya kama a nyini ninam bolim po.

ref: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
text: Mi dek nyiŋ, mi dek nyiŋ ate mi a nye kude. Mi tin nye ka sɛ a kaasi m dek yuenni? M kan pai m zulaŋa a te waai ya.

ref: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
text: <<Jekob, wom mi, Izirali waai ate m wi la. Ka mi ale la. Mi ale dɛ niŋ mi abe le ŋman wari ŋaaŋ.

ref: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
text: Mi dek nisa ale dueni tɛŋzuk de nyubini, ate m juga nisaŋa a nye ate wenzukku a lagri cheŋ. Ase mi ale wi ŋa la, ŋa meena a jam zaani ka jigi yeŋ.

ref: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
text: <<Ni jam jigi yeŋ, ni meena a jam wom. Ka bɔgtaŋa kuna ale dɛ niŋ a weeni wieŋa de? Naawen ale lueri doa waai la ale ta wa ale a yaali diila a ga nye Babilon. Wa nisaŋa ale ta chaab ale Kaldiya demma.

ref: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
text: Mi, poom ka m dek ale biisi, mm, mi wi wa kama. M le ta wa a jam, ate wa ale za wa nye diila ale nye magsi.

ref: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
text: <<Cheŋ paari mi a wom nya kude. <<A nyini piilimka moolika mi an biisi suk ya. Diipo ate ku nye la ale mi boro kama. <<Ate yɔgyɔgla de Nyɔnɔwa Naawen a pai wa chiika a tom mi.

ref: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
text: Nye kude ate Naawen fi Da Tuesirɔwa, Waai ale Welema Izirali po la a weeni ayen, <<Mi ale Naawen fi Wenni, Dii ale a sak fu dii ale nala la ale a dak fu suik kuui po ale magsi ayen fi va la.

ref: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
text: Fi dan jam wom ka m sinsaŋŋa, fi suiyɔgni ate le jam nye ase ka benaŋ la, ate fi wayɔrisimaŋa a nye ase nyakpiemu nya miisaŋa la.

ref: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
text: Fi ŋaaŋbisaŋa ate le nye ase ka tintainbusuŋ la, ate fi bisaŋa a kan ta chiina ase ŋanbie la. Ba yuenni ate kan bɛ diipo diipo yaase ba kaasi a ta nyini mi niŋŋa.>>

ref: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
text: Basi Babilon, yiri nyini Kaldiya demma jigi. Mooli nya kude ale masim nuemka abe fi weeni ku. Te ku cheŋ paari tɛŋka kpeglimka. Weeni ayen, <<Naawen a da tuesi wa tomteerɔwa Jekob kama.>>

ref: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
text: <<Naawen a weeni kama ayen, <<Suiyɔgni a karo a te gaasa nyama.>>

ref: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
text: Wa nye m nɔnni ase ka gebik kaai ale ta nɔi la ale pai mu a suk wa nisa yisuŋku po. Wa nye mu ase ka pein dii ale a nyaksi la ale pai mu a su wa namarika po.

ref: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
text: Wa weeni mu ayen, <<Izirali, fi ka m tomteerɔ, waai po ate m le sak m nalimu.>>

ref: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
text: Alege mi weeni kama ayen, Mi tom kama nna kinla. M pai m pagrimu a tom ka koruk ale an nya jaaboa. Alege mi ale magsi ayen m nya diila a bo ka Naawen nisa po, ate m tutunaŋa a bo ale m Wenni.>>

ref: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
text: Ate yɔgyɔgla de Naawen a weeni kama, ayen wa waai ale nye mi m mawa ponni po, ayen m chim wa tomteerɔ la, a ŋman ta Jekob a jam te wa abe wa tigsi Izirali a ta jam wadek jigi dii nyiŋla mi nya zula kama Naawen nina po, ate m Wenni a chim m pagrim.

ref: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
text: Wa weeni kama ayen, <<Ku ka wa fiik ate fi chim m tomteerɔ ayen fi ŋman pai Jekob dɔkdemma a zaani ba nyiem ale ka diila po, abe fi ŋman ta Izirali baai ate m ta la a jam. M le ŋman nye ate fi chim bolim a te baai ale kan daa Izirali dem la, ate fi ale ta m varibasika a jam tɛŋzuk de meena.>>

ref: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
text: Nya kude ate Naawen, Da Tuesirɔwa ale Waai ale Welema Izirali po la a weeni a te waai ate tɛŋ kpieŋ a zɛri wa ale kisi wa la, a weeni a te kpaŋŋa tomteerɔwa ayen, <<Nalima ale nya fu a yiti zaani ŋmai, nabisa ale nya fu a koori tɛŋ, Naawen ale ka wensie nyɔnɔ la nyiŋ. Waai ale Welema Izirali po la, wala ale lueri fu.>>

ref: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<M ŋmanteka vaaŋa po m le tulisi fu, ate varibasika danni po m le maari fu. M le yik fu a tara abe m nye ate fi chim nɔiyeŋ a te nuruma, ate m ŋman sɛ tɛŋka a te fu ale ka ŋantaŋa meena ate fi ŋman kali kaai ale chim tɛŋ koruk la po,

ref: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
text: a weeni baai ate ba yik ba la ayen, <Nyini peelim a jam.> Ate baai ale bo legi po la ayen, <Ni nye fasiyaa.> Ba ale de suitaŋa nɔi abe ba nya wuuk yɔksuk gu tii ale kan ta jaab la zuk.

ref: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
text: Kɔm yaase nyanyuila a kan yik ba, yaase gɔnni tuilukku a nak ba yaase wenbinni a nak ba zuk. Waai ale ta jiirim ale ba la ale kasi ba abe wa de ba niŋ a ta ba cheŋ nya buui ale a buli la jigi.

ref: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
text: Nya ba ale nyini niŋniŋ a jam. Ba gela ale nyini wiilukku geŋsa, ate ba gela ale nyini yeniŋka geŋsa, abe gela ale nyini Aswan tɛŋka.>>

ref: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
text: Wenŋmazukku a nuem ale masim. Tɛŋzuk de a de masim. Guutaŋa abe lɔnsi yiili mobi? Diila Naawen a yɔk wa nuruma sue kama, ale ta jiirim ale wa nuru baai ale a nam la.

ref: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
text: Alege Zayon a weeni kama ayen <<Naawen a zɛri mi kama, Nyɔnɔwa a baŋ mi kama.>>

ref: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
text: Ma ale baga a baŋ wa biluak kuui ale a ŋoosi la wari a ka jiirim ale biika ate wa biak la? Dai dii dai wa baga a baŋ kama, mi a kan baŋ fu.

ref: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
text: Nya, m ŋmarisi Jerusalem a nyo ka m nitanni po. Fi saasaŋa a kasim bo ka m niŋ.

ref: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
text: Fi nidoabilisaŋa a kpabi ŋman cheena ka fi jigi, ate baai ale nye ate fi doa jassi la a cheŋ ale ge fu.

ref: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
text: Lak fi ninaŋa a nya gilagilawa. Fi nidoabilisaŋa meena a tigsi kama a jam fi jigi. Naawen a weeni kama ayen, Ase mi ale sum vua la, fi le su ba meena ase ŋiri sotta la, fi le su ba ase nipok fiak la.

ref: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
text: Fi tɛŋka a kaasi kama ale doa kɔruk ale ka kiri ya, yɔgyɔgla de fi le fiisa kama a te fi nuruma ate baai ale jam a nɛ fu la, ale yalima ale fu.

ref: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
text: Bi sii ate ba biak ba diipo ate ku ko fu la ale weeni ate fi wom ayen, <<Dela jigini a fiisa kama a te ti. Te ti peelim yega ate ti boro.>>

ref: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
text: Ate fi ale weeni fi suinum po ayen, <<Ka wana ale biak bade a te mi? Ku jam ko mi kama ate m ŋman chim kirik. Ba jam yiak mu kama ale zɛri mu. Ka wana ale wuuk bade? Ku jam tali ka mi dek nyiini, alege bade a nyini ka be?>>

ref: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
text: Nalima ale chim ni koba, ate nalima pooba ale chim ni maba a nya ni zuk. Ba ale kpi duna ni niŋ ate ba dieŋa ale kpi tɛŋ. Ba ale leeli ni naŋtaata paasuk. Ate ni ale miŋ ayen mi ka Naawen. M kan paasi baai ale ta yiila ale mi la.>>

ref: Is it possible to rescue victims from someone strong and cruel?
text: Ba baga a kɔlim ŋanta tugurik tɔŋdɔba jigi ya yaase baai ate ba yik la nakdeerɔ jigi ya?

ref: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
text: Mi ale nye ate baai ale a namsi ni la a ŋɔbi bade nyiŋlam. Ba ale nyu badek ziim ase daam la. Ate nurubiik meena ale miŋ ayen mi, Naawen, m ka ni Varibasidɔ ale ni Da Tuesirɔ Waai Ale Ka Jekob Pagrim Nyɔnɔwa la.

ref: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
text: Mi pai ka legi a chim garuk a jo wenzukku ale pai boorisa garuk chim ku likka.>>

ref: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
text: Nyɔnɔwa Naawen a te mi ka sakka giŋgeluŋ ayen m seba wa dii ale a maari baai ale jiak la. Wa nak mi a yiti ka saluik meena ale a lak m tueŋa ate mi a wom ase waai ate ba sak la.

ref: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
text: Nyɔnɔwa Naawen a lak m tueŋa kama ate mi an nye tukpari a te wa. Mi an ŋmani ŋaaŋŋa.

ref: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
text: Mi cheem ka kpai a te baai ale a nak mi la ale pai m tieŋkuruku a te baai ale a dari m tieŋka la. Mi an pai m nimbidiaka a suk baai ale nye mi a la ale a chesi tintueta a basi m nina po la.

ref: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
text: Dii nyiŋla Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale maari mu la nyiŋ, ba kan nyati mu. Ate mi yaa nye m nimbidiaka a pagra ate m seba ayen m kan jo chivie po.

ref: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
text: Ka Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale waai ale a maari mi. Ka wana ale wa bo mini mi? Ba meena kaasi ase gattiak la. Kpayari ale dɛ ba.

ref: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
text: Ka wana ale bo ni po a chali Naawen ale ta tuewomma a te wa tomteerɔwa wanni? Basi ate waai ale a cheŋ legi po la ate wa ka bolim la, a ta sebchakka ale Naawen yuenni abe wa pai wa yiila a basi wa Wenni zuk.

ref: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de, nama baai meena ale a toati botta la ale a nye zeuŋta a te nidek la, ni a cheŋ ni bottaŋa po ale ni zeuŋta bottaŋa ate ni toati la. Ni ale za ni tuesi dii a nyini mi nisa po la ale nna. Ni ale dua tɛŋ a nam yega.

ref: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
text: <<Wom mi, nama baai ale chali a vi wayɔrisima ale a gisi Naawen la. Ni nya piuŋ kuui ate ba gebi fu a nyini du la, ale tanaŋa ate ba mobi a yeeri fu la.

ref: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
text: Nya Abrayam, fi kowa ale Saara, baai ale biak fu la. Diipo ate mi a wi wa la, wa jam ka wanyi, ate mi a niak wa ale nye ate wa biak a piisi.

ref: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
text: Naawen ale nye ate Zayon sui a yɔk, abe wa pai wa jiirimu a nya wa jigi kaasuŋku meena zuk. Wa ale nye ate wa gɔnni a nye ase Eden la, ate wa tɛŋ koruta a nye nna se Naawen kaduk la. Masim ale suipeentik ale bo ale wa ale jiam teka ale yiila lennika.

ref: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
text: <<Mi nuruma ni wom mi. M tɛŋ kpieŋka, ni wom mu. Sinsaŋŋa ale nyini mi jigi a cheŋ. Mi nyemagsika ale chim bolim a te tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa.

ref: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
text: Mi wayɔrisimaŋa a forisi a paari ka nna nwuli, ate m varibasika a bo suik, ate m nisa ale ta nyemagsika a jam tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po. Tɛŋ sii ate nyiamu a gilim la a zak nya mi abe ba limisi m nisaŋa ale yiila.

ref: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
text: Zak fi ninaŋa a nya wenŋmazukku, abe fi chuiri nya tɛŋzuk de. Wenŋmazukku ale muriŋ bɛ ase nyuisa la, ate tɛŋ zuk de ale kaasi ase garuk la, ate ka nuruma a kpi nna se nanjuŋsa la. Alege mi varibasika ale boro taam wuu, ate m wayɔrisimaŋa a kan nye wari a kpeeri.

ref: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
text: <<Nama baai ale seba dii ale nala la, ni wom mi ale nama nuru baai ale ta m sinsaga ni suiniima po la. Ni kaa chali nuruba toariŋka yaase ni yɔgsa ale ba lieta.

ref: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
text: Kpayari ale dɛ ba ase gatta la. Nanzuiri ale nɛ ba ase kɔbta la. Alege mi wayɔrisimaŋa ale boro taam wuu, ate m varibasika ale kasim boro a te gaŋ sii meena ale cheen la.>>

ref: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
text: Naawen nisaŋa a yiti ŋmai a pai pagrim a jo ase garuk la, yiti ase da ŋaai ale taam la, ase ŋiaka gaŋ sii ale jam boro la. Daa fi ale jam gebi Arayab nna bunabuna ale chub jachichimini la?

ref: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
text: Naawen ale da tuesi baai a basi la ale ŋman pilim jam. Ba ale jo Zayon ale yiila lennika. Taam wuu masim ale chim naam zutɔk ba zuimaŋa zuk. Suipeentik ale masim ale paari ba ate sui kaasuŋ ale niniga ale cheŋ.

ref: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
text: <<Ka mi, poom ka mi ale waai ale a yɔk fi sui. Fi ka wana a chali nuru waai ale kaa boro taam wuu, ate wa chim nuru biiga, wa daa jaaboa alege wa ka wuuk,

ref: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
text: ate fi a baŋ Naawen fi Nyeerɔwa, waai ale lagri wenŋmazukku ale dueni tɛŋka nyubaŋa la, ate fi a kasim bo yɔgsum po daa meena ayen namsidɔwa suipuurumu nyiŋŋa, waai ate kaasuŋ a dɛ la? Namsidɔwa suipuurumu yaa bo ka bɛ?

ref: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
text: Baai ate ba lik la, ku kan beni ba ale lak ba a basi. Ba a kan kpi likka dɔkku po yaase ba a silim ŋandiinta.

ref: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
text: Dii nyiŋla mi ka Naawen fi Wenni, waai ale a choa nyakpiemu ate bu nya miisaŋa a wuuri la. Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale wa yuenni.

ref: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
text: Mi pai m wieŋa a nyo ka fi nɔnni po ale pai m nisa yisuŋku a lik fu. Mi waai ale nye ate wenzukku a boro ale dueni tɛŋka nyubaŋa ale waai ale weeni Zayon ayen, <Ni ka mi nuruba la.> >>

ref: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
text: Jerusalem, yiti, yiti! Zaani ŋmai fi nyuka nyini ka Naawen nisa po, wa suipuurum beerika, Fi waai ale nyu zunzunaŋa meena la, beerik kaai ale nye ate nuruba a cheŋ a ja la.

ref: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
text: Wa nidoabilisaŋa meena ate wa biak la, ba waai karo a cheŋ ale wa. Wa nidoabilisaŋa meena ate wa wuuk la, ba waai karo a yik wa nisa.

ref: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
text: Fi nidoabilisaŋa a cha ka vuusum. Ba doa ka suik duak meena po, ase ŋmiak ale yik kab diila. Naawen suipuurumu ale sueriba ale fi Wenni toariŋ ka.

ref: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
text: Be wom nya kude, fi waai ale a nam la, fi buk kama alege daa daam ate fi nyu.

ref: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
text: Fi Nyɔnɔwa Naawen, fi Wen dii ale a maari wa nuruma la weeni ayen, <<Nya, m pai beerik kaai ale bo fi nisa po a nye ate fi a ja la a nyini fi jigi kama. Fi a kan ŋman nyu a nyini m suipuurumu beerika po.

ref: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
text: Zayon yiti, pai pagrim a jo fidek ase garuk la. Pai fi garuk naliŋsaŋa a jo. Jerusalem, tuilum tɛŋka. Baai ate ba an gebi ba yua la ale baai ale daŋ la a kan ŋman jo fi po.

ref: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Ba an pai jaab a da fu, ba ka ligri a da tuesi fu.>>

ref: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
text: Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna, <<Piilimka mi nuruma a cheŋ ka Ejipiti ayen ba boro, ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Assiria a namsi ba.

ref: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
text: Dila nyiŋla mi nuruma ale seba m yuenni. Dila dai dila danni ba ale miŋ ayen ka mi ale ŋaam weeni ku. Mm, ku ka mi.>>

ref: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
text: Nya waai ale bo guutaŋa zuk a ta wamaŋsa a jam la naŋtaata ale nala soa dii ya. Waai ale a mooli suiyɔgni ale suipeentik wamaŋsa ale waai ale a mooli varibasika wie ale a weeni Zayon ayen, <<Fi Wenni a dɛ naam!>>

ref: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
text: Ni wom de, fi limisidɔma a lak ka ba luelutaŋa. Ba gum ka chaab a nuem ale masim. Ase Naawen a dan ŋman pilim jam Zayon. Badek nina ale nya ku.

ref: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
text: Ni gum chaab a lɔnsi masim yiila, nama Jerusalem ale chim guura la, diila Naawen a yɔk wa nuruma sue kama ale da Jerusalem a tuesi.

ref: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
text: Naawen ale dueni wa tuilum nisaŋa tɛŋ kpieŋsa meena niŋ, ate tɛŋzuk de kpeglimka meena ale nya ti Wenni varibasika.

ref: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
text: Basi dula, basi dula, cheŋ nyini dula jigini? Kan tiri jabuui ale daŋ la. Cheŋ nyini ku po ate fi nye cheri, nama baai ale a ji Naawen ŋantaŋa la.

ref: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
text: Alege fi kan yeenti a basi dula yaase fi nyiŋ a gɔgi. Diila Naawen ale de fi niŋ, Izirali Wenni ale cheŋ ale fu.

ref: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
text: Nya m tomteerɔwa ale tom ale yam. Ba ale zak wa a zaani ate wa ale bo ŋmai, ate wa le nya zak zaanika nna wenwen ya.

ref: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
text: Ase nuruba ale jam piisi a yɔgsa ale wa na nyinika la, ba jam kaasi wa nyiŋka kama ate wa kan nye ase nurubiik la, ate wa nyiŋka a kaasi gaam nurubiik miŋka.

ref: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
text: Dila nyiŋ wa abe le yarinti tɛŋsa nna yega, ate nalima ale mum ba noaŋa wa nyiŋ. Dila ba le kan weeni ba diila, ba le nya. Ba ale kan wom diila ba le miŋ di kiri.

ref: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
text: Ka wana ale ta siaka ale ti wanni? Naawen abe yeeri wa nisa a sak ka wana?

ref: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
text: Wa chim wa niŋ ase ka tiib buli la, ate bu naŋsaŋa a feri tɛŋ kosik po. Nalim yaase kpaŋta a jam ka wa jigi ayen ku nye ate ti nina a cheŋ wa jigi ya, jaab a ka wa jigi ayen ti yaali.

ref: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
text: Nuruba a jam valiŋ wa kama ale zɛri wa ate wa chim niniga nuru ale tu chaab ale ninam. Wa nye ase ka nuru waai ate nuruba a suk ba nina a nyini wa jigi. Ba jam valiŋ wa kama alege ate ti an pai wa a chim jaaboa.

ref: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
text: Wa sum pai ti nyiŋtuilaŋa ale ji ti niniŋŋa, alege ti nya se ka Wen ale namsi wa ale nak wa ale daani wa la.

ref: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
text: Ti meena a nye a se ka piisa la, a cheŋ bɛ. Ti wanyi meena a va ka wa suik. Ate Naawen a pai ti meena biemu a basi wa zuk.

ref: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
text: Ba jam daani wa kama ale ŋman namsi wa, alege wa an jam lak nɔi ya. Ba jam ta wa a cheŋ ase ka pabiik la ayen ba te tɔgridɔwa, ase posuk ale za pondɔwa niŋ la, wa jam nye ka chim, wa an jam a lak nɔi ya.

ref: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
text: Ba jam namsi wa kama ale bo wa buusa ale ta wa a cheŋ. Be ka wana ale wa biisi wa ŋaaŋbisa wari ya? Diila ba jam yeeri wa a nyini ŋanvuta tɛŋka po kama. Mi nuruma nye kaasuŋku nyiŋ ale soa ate ba ko wa.

ref: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
text: Alege ku jam ka Naawen yaalika ayen wa ŋɔriŋ abe wa nye ate wa nam, Naawen nye wa nyuvunni ka foolaa tiirim, wa ale nya wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa abe wa daaŋa a wɔŋa, ate Naawen yaalika ale jigsi wa nisa po.

ref: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
text: Wa ninammu ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa ale nya nyuvuri bolimu ate wa ale chak. Wa yam wie miŋka ale m tomteerɔma wayɔrisimaŋa nyiŋ ale ta vɔŋteka a jam nuru boari jigi, ate wa ale tuesi ba biemu.

ref: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
text: <<Nipok kirigaa, lenni yiili, fi waai ale kan biak biik nya la. Fɔb yiili mobi, nuem a yaali mariŋka, fi waai ale kan dom puuk nya la, diila nipok waai ale kala a ka biik la, bisa a piisi gaam waai ale ta chorɔ la kama,>> ka Naawen ale weeni.

ref: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
