ref: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
text: <<Mi a kan namsi ni liema ase ba nin pai badek a te taabugni yaase ni sampooma ase ba nin nye kaboŋsa, dii nyiŋla nidoama dek ale cheŋ a paari taabuksaŋa ale a nye kaabka ale tangbana taabuksa. Nuru baai ale kan ta miŋka la ale kaasi.

ref: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
text: <<Izirali, fi nye ka kaboŋ, kan te Juda a nye foolaa. Kan cheŋ Gilgal. Kan cheŋ jueli Bet Aven. Kan pɛ, <Ase Naawen ale vua la.>

ref: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
text: Izirali demma turi a kpari kama nna se naab sari la. Naawen ale nye ka sɛ a nya ba zuk ase pabisa ale bo wuuk po la?

ref: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
text: Ɛfraim a ga gum ka bɔgta po. Basi ba!

ref: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
text: Ba daamu a dan poom yiinti, ba diem gum du kama a nye ba taabugni. Ba niŋdeerɔma a pai ka chivie suita a chim ba niŋ wari.

ref: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
text: Va pagrik ale vaari ba a basi, ate ba kaabka ale ta chivie a jam te ba.

ref: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
text: <<Wom de, nama kaabteerɔba! Ni kpesi wom, nama Izirali demma! Wom, Naab yeri demma! Buusaŋa de a bo ka ni zuk. Ni chim ka baruk a bo Mizpa ale ŋmiak a teeri Tabor guuku zuk.

ref: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
text: Kpaliŋsa nyama a bo ka togrika po. M le dari ba meena tue.

ref: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.
text: Mi seba Ɛfraim ale ka dii meena la kama. Izirali an suk nyini mi jigi ya. Ɛfraim, yɔgyɔgla de fi cheem fidek a te ka taabugni Izirali a kaasi kama.

ref: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
text: <<Ba tuimaŋa a kan te ba suik ate ba a cheem a cheŋ ba Wenni jigi ya. Taabugni chiik ale bo ba suiniimaŋa po. Ba kan miŋ Naawen.

ref: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.
text: Izirali kanjantaŋa dek ale ta chaab ale ba. Izirali demma, poom ka Ɛfraim, a ja kama ba wabiokku po. Juda mɛ a ja ale ba.

ref: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
text: Ase ba dan ta ba duŋsaŋa a cheŋ ayen ba gisi Naawen, ba kan nya wa. Wa yeeri ka wadek a nyini ba jigi.

ref: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
text: Ba ka wensie ale Naawen ya. Ba ale biak bi sii la daa badek bisa. Ba Chiik Paalika tiŋŋa ale nɛ ba ale ba kaduksaŋa meena.

ref: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
text: <<Peeri damuniŋka Gibea po ale nyiili damuniŋka Arama po. Nye kpaliŋ kaarika Bet Aven po. Benjamin, dɛ niŋ.

ref: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
text: Namsika danni Ɛfraim ale doa koruk. Izirali buuni po ate mi a weeni diila ale za di nye.

ref: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
text: Juda niŋdeerɔma a nye ase ka baai ale a yeeri bana tana la. M le kpiiri m suipuurumu a basi ba zuk ase nyiam ale mobi diila.

ref: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
text: Ɛfraim a nam kama, ate buusa a tabi va ba zuk a taam, ba ale a va bɔgta la nyiŋ.

ref: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
text: Mi a nye ase ka kpayari a te Ɛfraim ale a nye ase puaka la a te Juda nuruma.

ref: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
text: <<Ase Ɛfraim ale jam nya wa nyiŋtuilaŋa, ate Juda a nya wa niraŋa, ate Ɛfraim yaa jam cheŋ Assiria jigi, a yaa tom ayen naab kpioŋku a maari wa. Alege wa an jam baga a tebi fu, wa an jam baga a ko fi niraŋa.

ref: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
text: Diila m le nye ase ka gbeŋli la a te Ɛfraim, abe m nye ase gbeŋ kpienni la a te Juda. M le dari ba a cheeri nna bunabuna abe m cheŋ. M le ji ba a basi ate waai a kan boro ayen wa tuesi ba.

ref: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
text: Mi yaa le ŋman cheŋ m jigini ate ku paari diipo ate ba ale siak ba kaasuŋku la. Ate ba ale gisi mi ale ninmuna ba niniŋŋa po.

ref: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
text: <<Jam, ate ti ŋman cheŋ Naawen jigi. Wa gebi ti ka nna bunabuna alege wa ale ŋman tebi ti. Wa kɔni ti kama alege wa ale bobi ti mulaŋa.

ref: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
text: Daa ŋaye ŋaaŋnyiŋ wa ale tagri ti. Daa ŋatawa danni wa ale ŋman pai ti a zaani ti nyiem ale ka diila, ate ti ale bo wa niŋ.

ref: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
text: Basi ate ti miŋ Naawen. Basi ate ti kasim a yaali ayen ti miŋ wa. Ase wenbinni ale a jueli diila, wa za wa nyini kama. Wa ale jam ti jigi ase ŋoota wen ŋmotta la ale tɛŋsik ŋmotta ale a zaŋti tɛŋzuk de diila.>>

ref: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
text: <<Ɛfraim, mi ale pai ni a nye ka boa? Juda, mi ale pai ni a nye ka boa? Ni yaalika a nye ase ka saluik pik ale maglim nyiem ale kpaanti diila.

ref: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
text: Dila nyiŋ m pai ka m biisiteerɔma a gebi ni nna bunabuna, m pai ka m nɔnni wieŋa a ko. M buusaŋa a nyaksi ase ka bolim la ni zuk.

ref: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.
text: Diila mi a yaali ka jiirim, alege daa kaabka ale a yaali Wen miŋka a gaam juka tiirita.

ref: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
text: Ase Adam la, ba kaasi nɔiyeŋka kama. Ba jam ka wensie ale mi dula jigini.

ref: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
text: Gilead ka tɛŋ kpieŋ kaai ale ta gaasa nuruba, ate ziim a maŋ ba naŋsaŋa ale a tabi juijui la.

ref: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
text: Ase zue ale suk doa jigi a limisi nuru diila, kaabteerɔma a nye ka dila. Ba zaani ka suiku po a ko nuruba a cheŋ Sikiim ale a nye chivie tuim kaasima.

ref: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
text: Mi nya ka dii ale lɔrima Izirali yenni po. Ɛfraim a pai ka wadek a te taabugni ate Izirali a taŋ wadek.

ref: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
text: <<Fi Juda mɛ cheka dai a boro kama a te fu. Ase diipo ate mi za m pai m nuruma zumasuku a te ba la.

ref: and to heal its wounds. But then I see the crimes in Israel and Samaria. Everyone is deceitful; robbers roam the streets.
text: Diipo meena ate mi ale tebi Izirali la, Ɛfraim wabaataŋa nyiem nyini ka peelim ate Samaria tuim kaasimaŋa a nye jassi. Ba a nye ka venta tuima, ate zueba a wɛ a jo yie po. Varidɔba a vari nuruba suitaŋa po.

ref: No one realizes that I have seen their sins surround them like a flood.
text: Alege ba kan miŋ ayen mi a teeri ba tuimbaataŋa meena. Ba wabaataŋa a gilim ba kama. Ba biemu a kasim bo ka mi niŋ.

ref: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
text: <<Ba pai ka ba gaasaŋa a nye ate naawa sui a peenti ale a peenti nabisaŋa sui ale ba ventaŋa.

ref: Everyone burns with desire— they are like coals in an oven, ready to burst into flames.
text: Ba meena ka kaboŋ nyeerisa, a dɛ ase boroborok dɔk bolim buui ate boroborok seerɔwa an magsi wa choa a nyoro ate boroboroku a ga magsi beka.

ref: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
text: Naawa tigini danni nabisaŋa a jam jo daam po ate bu chɔgsi ba ase bolim ŋiak la, ate wa pai wa nisa a gum baai ale nye nuruba a la la po.

ref: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
text: Ba meena a tuila kama nna se boroborok dɔk la. Ba a nɛ ba kpaŋŋa kama. Ba nalimaŋa meena a lo kama, ate ba waai a kan wi mi.

ref: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
text: <<Ɛfraim a dam ka wadek ale tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa. Ɛfraim a nye ase ka maasi paglak la di kan labri.

ref: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
text: Nicham a dari wa pagrimu kama, alege wa kan miŋi. Zui piila ale bo wa zukku po meena, alege wa zɛ.

ref: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
text: Izirali kanjantaŋa a ta ka chaab ale wa, alege kude meena po wa kan cheŋ Naawen wa Wenni jigi yaase wa gisi wa.

ref: Israel is a senseless bird, fluttering back and forth between Egypt and Assyria.
text: <<Ɛfraim a nye ase ka nangbaŋ la, ate ba a paasi wa nna nwuli ale ka yammoa a yaaba wi Ejipiti ale a cheem Assiria jigi.

ref: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
text: Ase ba dan cheŋ, m le yuk ŋmiaka a basi ba zuk. M le dari ba ase nuinsaŋa ale bo wenzukku la. Ase m dan wom ayen ba va chaab a cheŋ, m le yik ba.

ref: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
text: Ba kan kum a wi mi a nyini ba suiniima po, alege a kaari ba gaduataŋa zuk. Ba a tigsi kama a yaali ŋanbie ale da paalik alege cheem kpai a te mi.

ref: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
text: Mi ale sak ba ale te ba pagrim, alege ba a zɔkka biem a te mu.

ref: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
text: Ba kan cheŋ Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La jigi ya. Ba a nye ase ka tom ale kan nala la. Gebik woŋ ale lɔnsi ba niŋdeerɔma tɛŋ ba kanjanta wieŋa nyiŋ. Nya kude nyiŋ ba ale ta ba a la Ejipiti tɛŋka po.

ref: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
text: <<Pai damuniŋka a maŋ fi nɔngbanvaataŋa! Jiiruk ale bo Naawen yenni zuk, dii nyiŋla nuruma a kaasi m nɔiyeŋka kama ale zɛri m sinsaŋŋa.

ref: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
text: Izirali a kaari a wi mi kama, <Ti Wen yaa, ti miŋ fu kama!>

ref: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
text: Alege Izirali a zɛri ka dii ale nala la. Dachiak ale vi wa.

ref: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
text: Samaria, ni yuk ni naabiik bɔglukku a basi. M suinni a puuri kama ale ba. Ku ale beni soa ka sɛ ate ba kan baga a nye cheri?

ref: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
text: Ba nyini ka Izirali! Naabiika de daa Wen ya. Ka peesirɔ ale nye ku. Samaria naabiik kala ale wɛ nna bunabuna.

ref: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
text: <<Ba bori ka viok a che va pagrik. Kinkaaŋa ka zuima. Ŋa kan ta zom a jam mu. Ŋa dan nye ŋanbie, nicham ale nɛ ŋa meena.

ref: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
text: Diila ba cheŋ jueli ka Assiria ase boniŋ kaai nyeka ale toa la a tuinti wadek wa nyiini. Ɛfraim a pai ka wadek a da te baai ale a yaali wa la.

ref: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
text: Ba poom ŋaam pai badek a da te ka tɛŋ kpieŋsa, m yaa le tigsi ba. Ba ale piilim a buk a bɛ naab kpioŋku namsika nyiŋ.

ref: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
text: <<Ɛfraim a poom jam sɛ ka kuŋkuŋta yega a magsi biem tiirita, ti de a chim ka kuŋkuŋta a magsi wabaata nyeka.

ref: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
text: Mi ŋmarisi ŋanta yega m sinsaŋŋa po kama a te ba, alege ba nya ŋa kama ase ŋan chaŋsa la.

ref: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
text: Ba jam nyeka kaabka a te mi ale ŋɔbi lammu, alege Naawen sui an peenti ale ba. Yɔgyɔgla de wa le teeri ba gaasaŋa a namsi ba, ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ. Ba ale ŋman cheŋ Ejipiti.

ref: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
text: Izirali a baŋ wa Nyeerɔwa kama ale sɛ nalima yie. Juda a nye kama ate tɛŋsa yega a pagra. Alege m le basi ate bolim a lo ba tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa zuk ate bu dɛ ba yie pagrisaŋa.>>

ref: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
text: Izirali, ni kan dɛ masimmoa. Ni kan ni a naŋi ase tɛŋ kpieŋ sinsila la. Diila ni ka wensie ale ni Wenni. Ni a yaali ka taabuksa tutuna ŋan fɔbinta dabiak meena po.

ref: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
text: Ba a kan wari Naawen tɛŋka po. Ɛfraim ale ŋman cheŋ Ejipiti a dɛ ŋandiin tii ale daŋ la Assiria po.

ref: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
text: Ba kan kpiiri daam tiirita a te Naawen yaase ba kaabka a peenti wa sui ya. Kaab sila ale nye ase ka kumsa boroborok a te ba. Baai meena ale a ŋɔbi la a kan welema. Ŋandiintaŋa de ka badek ale soa. Ti kan jam Naawen yenni po.

ref: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
text: Ni ale nye ka boa dai dii dai ate ni lueri a magsi ni tiŋŋa la, Naawen tiŋŋa daaŋa po?

ref: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
text: Ba dan poom baga a suk a nyini kaasuŋ po, Ejipiti ale tigsi ba, ate Memfis ale gu ba. Wuuta ale chim a lik ba kpanaŋa ate ba dueni la, ate muŋsa ale zigri a gaam ba viitaŋa.

ref: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
text: Namsika daaŋa a cheena, tutuna daaŋa a bo ka nisa po. Basi ate Izirali a miŋ nya kude. Dii nyiŋla ni wabaataŋa a piisi ka nna yegayega ate ni biemu a zuak nna yegayega ale a nya Naawen biisiteerɔwa nna se beruk la ale a nya waai ale sueri ale Naawen wanni la ase yesiŋ la.

ref: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
text: Wen biisiteerɔwa ale mi Wenni ale chim limisidɔwa a nya Ɛfraim zuk, alege baruk ale a limisi wa, wa suitaŋa meena po ate biem a bo wa Wen yenni po.

ref: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
text: Ba jo ka kaasuŋ po nna yega ase Gibea daaŋa po la. Wen ale teeri ba gaasaŋa abe wa namsi ba ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ.

ref: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
text: <<Ase mi ale jam nya Izirali la, ku jam nye nna se mi nya ka yɔna gɔi po la. Ase mi ale jam nya ni koma la, ku jam nye nna se mi a nya ka kiŋkama kinkaŋ zuk la. Alege ase ba ale jan jam Baal Peor la, ba jam pai badek a te ka chivie bɔglukku ale bie nna se jabuui ate ba jam a yaali la.

ref: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
text: Ɛfraim zulaŋa ale yiti cheŋ abe ŋa ge ba nna se nuim la, ate biam a kan ŋman boro, ate puuk a kan ŋman boro, ate puuk yikka a kan ŋman boro.

ref: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
text: Ba dan poom wuuk bisa, m le ko ba meena. Ku ale toa a te ba ase mi nin cheem kpai a te ba.

ref: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
text: Mi nya Ɛfraim ase ka Taaya ate ba jam vuk jigi naliŋ diila. Alege Ɛfraim ale ta wa bisaŋa a jam koorɔwa jigi.

ref: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
text: Naawen yaa, te ba. Ka boa ate fi ale te ba? Te ba luik tii ale biak a kaasi la ale biisi jaksa.

ref: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
text: <<Ba gaasa meena ate ba nye Gilgal la nyiŋ, mi jam kisi ba kama dula. Ba tuimbaataŋa nyiŋ, m le yiak ba m yenni po. Mi a kan ŋman yaali ba. Ba niŋdeerɔma meena a nye ka tukpari.

ref: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
text: Ɛfraim a kaasi kama. Ba tɛŋ naŋsaŋa a kpi kama, ate ba kan yɔni. Ba dan poom biak bisa, m le ko ba bi sii ate ba kan siak ba nyiŋla.

ref: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
text: Mi Wenni ale zɛri ba dii nyiŋla ba an wom wa nɔi ya. Ba ale bo ka tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po a tuinti.

ref: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
text: Izirali jam ka tiib buui ale a teeri. Wa jam a yɔni ka yɔna a te wadek. Ase wa yɔnaŋa ale jam piisi la, wa jam sɛ ka kuŋkuŋta yega. Ase wa tɛŋka ale jam jigsi la, wa jam gomsi wa tuilum tanaŋa kama.

ref: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
text: Pimpaasima ale bo ba suiniimaŋa po, ate ba yaa le ji badek foolaa. Naawen ale kaasi ba kuŋkuŋtaŋa abe wa kaasi ba tuilum tanaŋa.

ref: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
text: Ba yaa le weeni ayen, <<Ti ka naaba dii nyiŋla ti an zuli Naawen. Alege ti dan poom ta naab, wa ate le baga a nye ka boa a te ti?>>

ref: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
text: Ba a biisi ka wakotta ale a pɛ pɛ kayaata, ale a nye nɔiyeŋsa. Ate dila nyiŋ nye kaasika a yiti nna se wubiok ale bo kaduk po diila.

ref: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
text: Nuru baai ale bo Samaria la a yɔksa kama Bet Aven naabiik bɔglukku nyiŋ. Ka nuruma ale kum ku nyiŋ, ate ku kaabteerɔba bɔgluk kaabdɔma ale gum du ale baai ale dɛ masim ku nalimu nyiŋla, dii nyiŋla ba pai nyini ka ba jigi a ta cheŋ jigi yoŋ.

ref: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
text: Ba ale ji ta cheŋ Assiria ase tiirim la a te naab kpioŋku. Ɛfraim ale jo chivie po. Chivie ale yik Izirali wa daata bɔgtaŋa nyiŋ.

ref: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
text: Ba ale ji Samaria ale ka naawa a ta cheŋ ase diok ale bo nyiam zuk diila.

ref: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
text: Ba ale kaasi gaasa pimpitimaŋa zuk. Ku ka Izirali wabaata. Muŋsa ale wuuta ale chim a lik ba kuŋkuŋtaŋa. Ba yaa le weeni pinaŋa ayen, <<Lik ti!>> ale guutaŋa ayen, <<Lo ti zuk!>>

ref: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
text: Izirali, a zaani Gibea daaŋa po, fi nye ka wabiok a yaa wari bo dula. Kpaliŋ an jam pai Gibea waba nyeerisaŋa?

ref: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
text: Ase m sui a dan peenti, m le namsi ba tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa ale tigsi a jam ba zuk a bobi ba ba wabaataŋa ate ba nye buyewa la nyiŋ.

ref: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
text: Ɛfraim ka naab sari ate ba sak di ate di a yaali zaa fɔbika. Ate m le pai diok a vi wa ŋmankpalaŋa zuk. M le dam Ɛfraim, ate Juda a za wa kpa, ate Jekob a magsi wa guti tɛŋka.

ref: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
text: Bori wayɔrisima a te nidek, abe ni che yaali kaai ale kan a nueri la yɔna abe ni guti ni tɛŋka ate ba an kpa nya la. Diila ku paari ka Naawen gisika, ate wa ga jam a pai wayɔrisima a basi ti zuk.

ref: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
text: Alege ni bori ka gaasa ale che biem ale dɛ pimpaasima yɔna. Dii nyiŋla ni pai ni sebchakka a basi ka nidek pagrim zuk ale ni tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale piisi la.

ref: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
text: Kpaliŋ kaarik a cheen ni nuruma zuk, ate ni yie pagrisaŋa meena ale kaasi ase Salman ale jam kaasi Bet Arbel kpaliŋka danni la, ase maba ale jam lo tɛŋ ale ba bisa diila.

ref: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
text: Betel, be ka dila ale di nye fu, dii nyiŋla fi gaasaŋa a zuak kama. Ase dai dila danni a dan jam Izirali naawa ale kaasi.

ref: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
text: <<Ase Izirali ale jam ka biik la, mi jam yaali wa kama, a nyini Ejipiti po ate mi jam wi mi nidoabinni.

ref: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
text: Alege mi ale a wi Izirali a soa diila, dila dek ate ba cheŋ a yalima ale mi. Ba jam nye ka kaabka a te Baal bɔgtaŋa ale jam a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa la a te ŋan mɛɛnta.

ref: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
text: Ka mi ale jam a sak Ɛfraim chelim ale pai ba ale m nisa, alege ba an miŋ ya, be jam ka mi ale jam tebi ba.

ref: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
text: Mi ale jam dɛ ba niŋ ale jiirim ale yaalika miik. Mi ale jam yeeri niiga diokku ba ŋieŋa zuk a ju ku a pai dik ŋandiinta a te ba.

ref: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
text: Ba a kan ŋman cheŋ Ejipiti, Assiria a kan nya ba zuwa, ba ale zɛri ayen ba kan tagri la nyiŋŋa?

ref: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
text: Mi nuruma a poli kama ayen ba basi mi. Ba dan poom wi Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La, wa kan zak ba a zaani.

ref: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
text: <<Ɛfraim, mi ale nye ka sɛ a pai ni a te? Izirali, mi ale nye ka sɛ a pai ni a te? Mi ale nye ka sɛ a nye ni ase Adma la? Mi ale nye ka sɛ a nye ni ase Zeboiim la? Mi suinummu a tagri kama m po. M jiirimu a yiti kama nna yegayega ni zuk.

ref: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
text: M kan pai m suipuurumu a nyini peelimmoa yaase m kaasi Ɛfraim. Diila mi ka Wen, alege daa nuru biiga. M ka Waai Ale Welema La a bo ale ni. M kan jam ale suipuurummoa.

ref: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
text: Ba ale va Naawen ŋaaŋ. Wa ale kaari ase gbeŋli la. Ase wa dan kaari, wa bisaŋa ale nyini yeniŋ geŋsa a jam ale nyiŋ gɔkka.

ref: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
text: Ba ale jam ate ba nyiŋsa a gɔk ase nuinsa ale nyini Ejipiti la ale nangbaŋsa ale nyini Assiria la. M le te ate ba bo ba yieŋa po.>> Ka Naawen ale weeni.

ref: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
text: Ɛfraim a gilim mi ale ka venta, ate Izirali yenni ale paasika. Juda a ta ka chaab ale Wen, wa poom ta ka chaab ale wensie nyɔnɔwa Waai Ale Welema La.

ref: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
text: Ɛfraim a dɛ ka vioku. Wa a vi ka kori geŋsa vioku danni meena ale te ate venta ale wɔkwɔk a kasim a piisi. Wa a nye nɔiyeŋ ale Assiria ale a tom kpaam a te Ejipiti.

ref: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
text: Naawen a ta ka wari a cheena Juda zuk. Wa ale namsi Jekob a magsi chaab ale wa suitaŋa abe wa ŋman tuni wa a magsi chaab ale wa tuimaŋa.

ref: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
text: Wa mawa luikku po ate wa jam yik wa suoku naŋ kpai. Ase nuru la wa jam jɛ ale ka Wen.

ref: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
text: Wa jam jɛ ale maarɔwa kama a nya nak dɛka wa zuk. Wa jam kum kama a saalim wa a yaali wa ŋmantiika. Wa jam ga nya wa ka Betel a biisi ale wa dula.

ref: So return to your God. Patiently trust him, and show love and justice.
text: Alege fi magsi kama ayen fi ŋman cheŋ fi Wenni jigi. Kasim ta yaalika ale nyemagsika abe fi kasim a limisi fi Wenni.

ref: Israel, you enjoy cheating and taking advantage of others.
text: Geruŋdɔwa a ka wensie ŋanmagsinta. Wa a yaali ka dɛ gaamka.

ref: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
text: Ɛfraim a kuulim kama ayen, <<Mi jigsi kama nna yegayega. M yaa chim ka jigsirɔ. Ale m jigsika meena ba kan nya nye kaasuŋ yaase wabiok mi jigi ya.>>

ref: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
text: <<Mi ale Naawen fi Wenni, dii ale ta fu nyini Ejipiti po la. M le nye ate fi ŋman bo viita po ase ni tiŋŋa daaŋa ale jam ka diila.

ref: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
text: Mi weeni m biisiteerɔma kama ale te ba gɔdaasima yega ale va ŋa nyiŋ a weeni wamagsima.>>

ref: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
text: Gilead a ta ka gaasa? Ka nuruma a ka kiri ya! Ba a kaab ka lalisa Gilgal po? Ba kuŋkuŋtaŋa ale nye ase ka tain puula ale bo kaduk po diila.

ref: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
text: Naawen a jam pai ka biisiteerɔ a ta Izirali a nyini Ejipiti, wa jam va ka biisiteerɔ zuk a nya ba zuk.

ref: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
text: Ase Ɛfraim ale jam biisi la, nidoaba nyiŋsa ale jam a gɔk. Wa jam nya ka zak zaanika Izirali po. Alege wa jam nye ka foolaa Baal puusika nyiŋ a yaa kpi.

ref: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
text: Ba yaa jam a nye biem nna yegayega. Ba pai ka ba kpanaŋa a nye bɔgta a te badek, ŋan mɛɛnta ate ba pai sebika a nye, ka mɛɛrɔba tuima ale ti meena. Ba jam weeni nuruma de wari kama ayen, <<Ba pai ka nuruba a nye kaabka ale a gbaari naabisa bɔgtaŋa.>>

ref: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
text: Dila nyiŋ ba ale nye ase ka saluik pik la ale saluik maglim ale muriŋ a bɛ diila ale vɔtta ate viok a ji a ta nyini ŋanta fɔbika jigi a basi la ale nyuisa ale va tuokparuk a nyini diila.

ref: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
text: Alege Mi ale Naawen fi Wen dii ale ta fu a nyini Ejipiti po la, kan ta Wen alege ta mi, be kan ta Varibasidɔ alege ta mi.

ref: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
text: Mi jam nya ni zuk kama gɔnni po, tɛŋ kaai ate ka tuiluk a dɛ la po.

ref: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
text: Ase mi ale jam te ba ŋandiinta la, ba jam chak kama. Ase ba ale jam chak la, kanjanta ale jam jo ba, ate ba jam baŋ mi.

ref: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
text: Ate m le jam ba zuk ase gbeŋli la, m le suk a doa suiku po ase yɔŋni la.

ref: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
text: Ase piuk ate ba vari ku ŋandiinta la, m le siti ba a lak ba a zaani nna jassi. M le nɛ ba ase gbeŋli la. Duŋ kaai ale waara la ale dari ba a ŋasi.

ref: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
text: <<Izirali, ni kaasi kama, dii nyiŋla ni ta ka chaab ale mi, ni ta ka chaab ale ni maarɔwa.

ref: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
text: Ate m pai sui a te ni naab, ate m suipuurum nyiŋ m pai wa a nyini ni jigi.

ref: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
text: Ɛfraim foolaawa a doa kama, ate wa wabaataŋa a ŋmarisi doa.

ref: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
text: <<Mi ale da tuesi ba a nyini boosuku pagrimu po. Mi ale da wa a tuesi nyini kum po. Kummoa, fi namsika a bo ka bɛ? Boosukwa, fi kaasuŋku a bo ka bɛ? <<Mi a kan ta jiirimmoa,

ref: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
text: wa a yiti kama wa suataŋa po. Naawen ale basi ate viok a nyini kori geŋsa a jam, a fuk a nyini gɔnni po ate wa bulika ale wa vinni a kpeeri. Ŋan baai ale bo duenika yenni po la ale di nitalimu meena la, ba ale kɔlim.

ref: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
text: Samaria nuruma a magsi kama ayen ba siak ba kaasuŋku, dii nyiŋla ba nye kaasi ba Wenni kama. Gebik woŋka ale dueni ba tɛŋ. Ba le ko ba bisaŋa, ate ba ale mobi ba nipok puusaŋa.>>

ref: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
text: Izirali, ŋman pilim cheŋ Naawen ni Wenni jigi. Ni wabaataŋa ale ta ni luetaŋa a jam.

ref: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
text: Assiria an baga a vari ti a basi. Ti a kan zaani wusuma a magsi kpaliŋŋa. Ti kan ŋman weeni ayen, <Ti wenaŋa> a te ŋan baai ate ti pai ti nisa a nye la, diila ka fi jigi ate baai ale kan ta koba la a nya jiirim.>>

ref: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
text: <<M le tebi ba tukpanni abe m yaali ba nna fasiyaa, diila m suipuurumu a basi ba kama.

ref: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
text: Mi ale nye ase ka maglim la a te Izirali. Wa ale busum ase puuta la. Ase Lebanon nyunyoŋ la wa tɛŋ naŋsaŋa ale siŋ tɛŋ a feri paari.

ref: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
text: Wa naŋ bulaŋa ale pusi a chim. Wa nalimu ale nye ase ka kpaam tiib la. Wa nyummu ale nye ase ka Lebanon nyunyoŋ la.

ref: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
text: Nidoaba ale ŋman bo wa yɔgsummu po. Wa ale piisi ase ŋanbie la. Wa ale chim ase tiib la, ate wa yuei ale yiti ase Lebanon daam la.

ref: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
text: Ɛfraim, mi ale ŋman ta ka boan wari a nye ale bɔgta? M le tulisi wa abe m nya wa zuk. Mi a nye ase dapeelita tiib ale ta vaata la. Fi yɔna nyeka a nyini ka mi jigi.>>

ref: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
text: Ka wana ale ta yammoa? Wa ale nya ŋantaŋa de kiri. Ka wana ale a miŋi? Wa ale miŋ ŋa kiri. Naawen suitaŋa ka wensie. Wayɔrisima nyama a cheŋ ka ti po, alege tukpari nyama a nak ka naŋsa ti po.

ref: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?
text: Nama nisɔmma, ni abe wom nya kude. Baai meena ale bo tɛŋka po la abe wom. Wanni de choa a diem nye ni daaŋa po a nya, yaase ni kokpieŋsaŋa daaŋa po?

ref: Tell our children! Let it be told to our grandchildren and their children too.
text: Weeni sak ni nidoabilisaŋa, ate ni nidoabilisaŋa a weeni sak ba mɛ nidoabilisaŋa, ate ba mɛ nidoabilisaŋa a weeni sak ŋaaŋnyiŋ gaŋka.

ref: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
text: Tɛŋ ale jam vari jo m tɛŋka po, ka be pagra kama ale piisi. Ka ta ka gbeŋli nyina ale gbeŋ nubi nyina.

ref: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.
text: Ka nye kama ate kadukka a doa kinla ale kaasi m kinkaŋsaŋa. Ka lati si paktaŋa kama a yuk basi ale ge peeluk.

ref: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
text: Kum ase nipok kaliak ale jo boorisa garuk a kum wa chorɔ paalik nyiŋla.

ref: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
text: Ŋanbie tiirita ale nyuka tiirita a ŋman ka Naawen yenni po. Kaabteerɔ baai ale tom a te Naawen la a kum kama.

ref: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.
text: Laŋsaŋa a kaasi kama, ate tɛŋka a kɔ. Ŋanbieŋa a kaasi kama. Da paalika a kpeeri kama, ate kpaamu a karo.

ref: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
text: Talimu a kɔ kama ate kiŋkaŋka a kpi. Ti yɔnsaŋa ale tiisaŋa meena ale bo kadukka po la a kpi kama. Nurubiik masimu a muriŋ bɛ kama.

ref: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
text: Kaabteerɔma, ni jɔ boorisa gatta abe ni kum. Nama baai ale a tom kuŋkuŋku niŋ la, ni kum. Nama baai ale tom a te mi Wenni la ni jam jɔ boorisa gatta yokku po. Dii nyiŋla ba peri ŋanbie ale nyuka tiiritaŋa a ta kama ni Wen yenni po.

ref: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
text: Weeni ate nuruma a bobi nɔi. Wi ate ba jam jigi yeŋ. Te nisɔmma ale nuruma meena ale bo tɛŋka zuk la a cheŋ Naawen fi Wenni yenni a kaari wi Naawen.

ref: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
text: Ba an pai ŋandiinta a nyini ti nina po ale ŋman yeeri masim ale suipeentik nyini ti Wen yenni po?

ref: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
text: Bieŋa a kpi kama tɛŋ kosikka po. Duenika yieŋa a kaasi kama. Booŋa a lo dii nyiŋla ŋanbie karo a dueni ŋa po.

ref: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
text: Nya niiŋa ale a ŋuuni dii ya! Ate duŋsa a butim dii nyiŋla wuyɔgsuk karo a te si. Piisa mɛ a poom a nam.

ref: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
text: Naawen yaa, ka fi ate mi a wi, diila bolim ale dɛ wuyɔgsuku ale bo peelim la ate bolim ŋiak a dɛ tiisaŋa meena ale bo kaduksaŋa po la.

ref: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
text: Gɔi duŋsaŋa mɛ a poom lak ka nɔi a yaali fu. Beli naŋsaŋa nyaataŋa a kpeeri kama ate bolim a dɛ wuyɔgsuku ale bo peelim la.

ref: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
text: Peeri damuniŋka Zayon po. Te ate ba choa chioku m tuilum guuku zuk. Basi ate baai meena ale bo tɛŋka zuk la kpaziita a nak ale Naawen danni a cheena. Ku moata kama.

ref: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
text: Di ale chim ka legi ale sui kaasuŋ dai, di ale chim ka chiŋma ale sobluk dai. Tugurik tɔŋdɔba ale piisi a nyini peelim ase varivientidi ale a lik guuta diila. Ate wa dila choa an diem a nye nya ya yaase di choa a poom za di nye a nya.

ref: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
text: Ba va guutaŋa a taam ate ku a nye ase wusuma torokoba ale a taam la ale a nye ase bolim ale a dɛ wuuk diila ale a nye ase tugurik tɔŋdɔba ale yiti a cheŋ kpaliŋ po diila.

ref: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
text: Ba a yeenti kama a cheŋ tɛŋka po. Ba chali va ka siaka zuk. Ba meli kama a jo yieŋa po. Ba va tuokpattaŋa a jo nna se zueba la.

ref: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
text: Tɛŋzuk de a choa kama ate wenzukku a choa, ate wenbinni ale chiika a sobri, ate chiŋmarisaŋa a kan ŋman a nyaksi ba niŋŋa.

ref: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
text: Naawen a na wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni kama. Wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma a piisi ka nna yegayega ate baai ale a wom wa la a zuak nna yega. Naawen danni a zuak kama ale ŋman pagra. Ka wana ale wa baga a pigi?

ref: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
text: Naawen weeni ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de, ŋman pilim jam mi jigi ale ni suiniima meena ale nɔi bobika ale kumsa.

ref: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
text: Ni dari ni suiniimaŋa a cheeri alege daa ni gattaŋa. Ni ŋman pilim cheŋ Naawen ni Wenni jigi, diila wa ka waai ale a yaali teka ale ŋman ta jiirim, ate wa sui a kan kpabi a puuri ale ta ŋmanteka nna yegayega ale a tagri a kan ta biem a jam.

ref: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
text: Ka wana ale seba? Da dii dai wa ale cheem a ta ŋmantiik abe wa basi niauŋ ŋaaŋ ale ŋanbie ale nyuka tiirita a te Naawen fi Wenni.

ref: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
text: Peeri damuniŋka Zayon po abe fi weeni ate ba nye weleŋsa nɔi bobika, abe nuruma a jam jigi yeŋ.

ref: Make sure that everyone is fit to worship me. Bring adults, children, babies, and even bring newlyweds from their festivities.
text: Tigsi nuruma abe fi gomsi ba. Ta nisɔmma a jam jigi yeŋ, abe fi tigsi bisaŋa ale biluak tii ale diem a ŋoosi la. Basi ate nidoa waai ale diem faari nipok la a basi wa dɔkku.

ref: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
text: Basi ate kaabteerɔma ale bo Naawen yenni nansuiŋku ale kuŋkuŋku suŋsuŋ a tom la a kum. Basi ate ba weeni ayen, <<Naawen yaa, <Pai fi nuruma a basi. Kan nye ate ba pai fi nuruma a chim laata tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po. Boan nyiŋ ate ba ale weeni nuruma suŋsuŋ po ayen, ba Wenni a bo ka bɛ?> >>

ref: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
text: Ate Naawen yaa le ta nyuri ale wa tɛŋka a sak jiirim ale wa nuruma.

ref: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
text: Naawen yaa le tulisi ba ayen, <<M ta ŋanbie ale da paalik ale kpaam a cheena ayen m te ate ku paari ni. M kan ŋman nye ate tɛŋ kpieŋsa a nye ni a la.

ref: An army attacked from the north, but I will chase it into a scorching desert. There it will rot and stink from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean.” The Lord works wonders
text: M le yiak wiiluk geŋsaŋa tugurik tɔŋdɔma ate ba yalima ale ni. M le tusi ba a basi tɛŋ kosik ale tɛŋ kaai ale kan nye jaab la po. Ate ka niŋka jigini a cheŋ nyakpiemu kori geŋsa. Ate baai ale bo ŋaaŋka la a basi yeniŋ geŋsa. Ate bu nyummu ale kasim a nyuŋ yegayega.>> Chekki wa sum nye wakpiema kama.

ref: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate
text: Tɛŋ demma, ni kan yɔksa. Ni sue a peenti abe ni a dɛ masim. Chekki Naawen a nye ka wakpiema.

ref: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
text: Gɔi duŋsaa, ni kan yɔksa, diila wuuk tii ale bo peelim la a boro a sobri kama. Tiisaŋa a yɔni. Kiŋkaŋka ale ti buui ale a melim la mɛ a yɔni si yɔnaŋa kama.

ref: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
text: Zayon demma, ni te ate ni sue a peenti, abe ni dɛ masim ale Naawen ni Wenni, diila wa te ni tɛŋsik ŋmoruk kama wayɔrisima nyiŋ. Wa basi kama ate ŋmoruk a ni nna yegayega yoenni po meena ase dila po wa la.

ref: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
text: Fɔbika dabaasaŋa ale sueri ale ŋanbie. Samɔnsaŋa ale sueri ale da paalik ale kpaam a waaŋ.

ref: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
text: Ni ale ta nna yegayega a magsi dɛka, ate ni yaa le pak Naawen ni Wenni, dii ale tom wakinkagla a te ni la. M nuruma a kan ŋman nya chivie.

ref: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
text: Ate ni yaa le miŋ ayen m bo Izirali abe ni ŋman miŋ ayen Mi ale Naawen ni Wenni, ate waai a ŋman karo a gum mi po. M nuruma a kan ŋman nya chivie.

ref: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
text: <<Ate kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ, m le pai M Chiika a nyo nuru meena po. Ni nidoabilisaŋa ale ni liema ale mooli Wen wie. Ni nuru kpagsaŋa ale gɔdaasim, ate ni nuru paalukku ale nya gɔdaasima po wie.

ref: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
text: M le sak wakinkagla wenŋmazukku ate ziim ale bolim ale nyuisa ale bo tɛŋzuk de.

ref: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
text: Ate Naawen Dakpienni ale da pagrika danni a jam la, wenbinni ale chimka legi ate chiika a chim ziim.

ref: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
text: Ate waai meena ale a wi Naawen la ale nya varibasika. Diila a nyini Zayon Guuku zuk ale Jerusalem po ate varibasika ale boro ase Naawen ale jam weeni diila ayen, a nyini ŋanvutaŋa la po ate Naawen a wi.

ref: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
text: <<Da ŋala ale va ŋala po, ate m le ŋman pai Juda ale Jerusalem paaruŋku a te ba.

ref: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
text: M le tigsi tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa meena a ta si a siŋ jam Jeyosafat viaka po. Dula ate m yaa le bo ba buusa a va m nuruma Izirali ale ka m nitalim la, diila ba jam kati m nuruma kama a waaŋ tɛŋ kpieŋsa po ale lab m tɛŋka a te chaab.

ref: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
text: Ba nakka gbaŋ m nuruma nyiŋ ale pai nidoabilisa a da te taabuksa ale pai nipokbilisa a da daam nyiŋ ayen ba nyu.

ref: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
text: Diila ni jam pai ka m kpanaŋa ale m ligmɔniŋka ale ŋman ji m jigsika ŋantaŋa a ta cheŋ ni puusika yieŋa.

ref: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
text: Ni jam pai Juda ale Jerusalem demma a da te Girik demma, ayen ni nye ate ba yalima ale ba tɛŋka.

ref: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
text: <<Ni nya, m za m te ba nyini ka juijui ate ni pai ba a da la a jam ate ba jam ni zuk a nye ni dii ate ni jam pai nye ba la.

ref: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
text: Naawen a weeni kama ayen, <<M le pai ni nidoabilisaŋa ale ni liema a da te Juda demma, ate ba mɛ a pai ba a da te Siiba demma, tɛŋ kaai ale yalima.>>

ref: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
text: Mooli nya kude tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po ayen, Gomsi a magsi kpaliŋ! Gomsi tugurik tɔŋdɔma! Basi ate nuru baai ale a kpaliŋ la meena a forisi paari a siti.

ref: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
text: Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa meena ale bo jigi meena la a jam nwuli a tigsi chaab dula. Naawen yaa, ta fi tugurik tɔŋdɔma a jam!

ref: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
text: Yulum goatuku dii nyiŋla ŋantaŋa ŋarika a paari kama, abe fi tabi yɔnaŋa dii nyiŋla daamu ŋmiaka jigi a sueri kama ate samɔnsaŋa a sueri a waaŋ. Ba gaasaŋa mɛ a zuak ka dila!>>

ref: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
text: Nuru boari, nuru boari ale bo popola luerika viaka po! Naawen danni a moata kama popola luerika viaka po.

ref: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
text: Wenbinni ale chiika ale sobri ate chiŋmarisaŋa a kan ŋman nyaksi.

ref: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
text: Naawen ale wuuri a nyini Zayon abe wa ŋman na a nyini Jerusalem. Tɛŋzuk ale chiŋmaaŋa ale choa. Alege Naawen ale chim ka sukka jigi a te wa nuruma ale yie pagrik a te wa nuruma Izirali.

ref: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
text: <<Ate ni yaa ale miŋ ayen Mi Naawen ka ni Wen a bo Zayon, m tuilum guuku. Jerusalem ale ta tuilum, ate nicham a kan ŋman vari jɔ ka po.

ref: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
text: <<Dai dila danni da paalik ale nyini guutaŋa zuk a siŋ ate biisim ale nyini gu fiisaŋa po a nyini. Nyiam ale chali va Juda beli naŋsaŋa meena, nyiam ale buli a nyini Naawen yenni po a zaŋti Sittim ale bo viaka po la.

ref: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
text: Alege Ejipiti ale kaasi, ate Edom ale chim tɛŋ kayiok, dii nyiŋla wɔkwɔk kaai ate ba jam pai nye Juda demma la. Baai tɛŋ po ate ba jam ko nuru baai ale kan nye wari a kaasi la.

ref: but Judah and Jerusalem will always have people.
text: Juda ale boro taam wuu ate Jerusalem ale kasim boro gaŋsa meena po.

ref: I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion. I will punish the guilty and defend the innocent.
text: Ba nuruma ko ka ale te ate ba nye foolaa ate mi ale kan vɔŋ a te ba la, m yaa le vɔŋ a te ba.>> Naawen a bo ka Zayon.

ref: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
text: Amos waai ale jam ka Tekoa pawuurɔma po wanyi la wieŋa ale nna. Wa ale jam nya diila ale nna a ta va Izirali ku bena ŋaye, ale ge ate tɛŋka choaka a jam, diipo ate Yuzaya a jam chim Juda naab la ate Joas nidoabinni Jeroboam a jam chim Izirali naab.

ref: and I said: When the Lord roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown. Judgment on Syria
text: Wa jam weeni kama ayen, <<Naawen a wuuri a nyini Zayon ale a na a nyini Jerusalem. Naapeerisaŋa wuyɔgsuku a ko kama, ate Karmel tɛŋka guuku wuutaŋa a kpi.>>

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Damasikus demma wabaataŋa a dan ka tita yaase tinaansi, mi kan basi m suipuurumu ale ba. Dii nyiŋla ba jam a namsi Gilead tɛŋka demma ase ka ba ale a fɔbi zaa diila.

ref: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
text: Mi ale basi ate bolim a chɔgsi Yazael yenni abe bu maa dɛ Ben Yadad yie pagrika mɛ.

ref: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
text: Mi ale wɛ tuok kpioŋku ate ba pai a lik Damasikus tɛŋka la a lɔnsi abe m kaasi naab waai ale bo Aven Viaka po la, ale waai ale ta Bet Eden tɛŋka naamu tachekka la. Araam tɛŋka demma ba ale yik ba a ta cheŋ Kir tɛŋka.>> Naawen ale weeni.

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Gaza tɛŋka wabaataŋa dan poom ka tita yaase tinaansi mi kan vɔŋ a te ba. Dii nyiŋla, ba pai ka tɛŋ pumi dem a da te Edom demma.

ref: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
text: Mi ale basi ate bolim a chɔgsi Gaza tɛŋka parisaŋa abe bu dɛ ba yie pagrisaŋa a kaasi.

ref: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
text: Mi ale kaasi Asdod naawa ale waai ale ta Askelon naamu tachekka la. Mi ale pai m pagrimu a kaasi Ekron a ga paari diipo ate mi ale ko Filistia demma meena la.>> Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni.

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
text: Dii ate Naawen weeni la ale nna: <<Taaya a dan poom ta wabaata tita yaase tinaansi mi kan vɔŋ a te ba. Dii nyiŋla ba pai ka tɛŋsa nuruba a da te Edom demma ale basi mabinni nɔiyeŋ kaai ate ba ta ale chaab la.

ref: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
text: Mi ale basi ate bolim a chɔgsi Taaya tɛŋka parisaŋa abe bu dɛ ba yie pagrisaŋa.>>

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Edom a dan poom ta wabaata tita yaase tinaansi, mi kan vɔŋ a te ba. Dii nyiŋla, ba vi ba suataŋa Izirali demma ale ka gebik ale poom ka jiirim ale ba. Ba sueŋa a kasim a puuri kama ale ba, ate wa suinni a kasim a dɛ ale kan yɔgi.

ref: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
text: Mi ale basi ate bolim a chɔgsi Teman tɛŋka abe bu dɛ Bozra tɛŋka yie pagrisaŋa a kaasi.>>

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Ammon demma wabaataŋa dan poom ka tita yaase tinaansi, mi kan basi m suipuurumu ale ba. Dii nyiŋla ba mobi nipok puusaŋa ale bo Gilead tɛŋka la. Ba a nye dila kama ayen ba lagri ba tɛŋka banaŋa.

ref: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
text: M le basi ate bolim a chɔgsi Arabba parisaŋa abe bu dɛ ka yie pagrisaŋa. Kpaliŋ kumsa ale boro kpaliŋ dai, ate wɔkwɔk viok ale boro va pagrika danni.

ref: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Tɛŋka naawa ale wa kpaŋŋa ba za ba fɛ ba kama ta ba a ga basi tɛŋ yoŋ po.>> Naawen ale weeni.

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Moab wabaataŋa dan ka tita yaase tinaansi, mi kan basi m suipuurumu ale ba. Dii nyiŋla ba yeeri Edom tɛŋka naawa kobaŋa kama vɔrumu po a ju ate ŋa chim buntuem.

ref: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
text: Mi ale basi ate bolim a chɔgsi Moab tɛŋka abe bu dɛ Keriot yie pagrisaŋa a kaasi. Moab demma ale kpi ka kpaliŋ po ate ku nye nna ŋaglam ase kpaliŋ kaarisa la ale damuniŋ peerika la.

ref: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
text: Mi ale ko ba tɛŋka kpagni ale wa nisɔmma meena.>> Naawen ale weeni.

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Juda wabaataŋa a dan ka tita yaase tinaansi mi ale namsi ba kama. Dii nyiŋla ba zɛri Naawen sinsaŋŋa ale an yik wa ŋmarisika mɛ. Dii nyiŋla ba va ka venta wena, ba kokpieŋsaŋa wena ate ba jam va a cheŋ bɛ.

ref: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
text: Mi ale basi ate bolim a chɔgsi Juda ate bu kaasi Jerusalem yie pagrisaŋa meena.>>

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Izirali demma wabaataŋa dan poom ka tita yaase tinaansi mi a kan basi m suipuurumu ale ba. Dii nyiŋla ba yik ka wayɔrisima nyama ale ta ba pama alege an baga a tuni la, a da a tuesi kpana, alege yik ŋanjaksa ale ta ba pama ale an baga a tuni la a da tuesi nuensa.

ref: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
text: Ba a tabi ŋanjaksa zuk ase ka tɛŋka la ale kan nye nuru baai ate ba a namsi la a magsi. Ko ale wa biik ta ka nipokbili yeŋ a bobi a goa. Ba a kaasi ka mi tuilum yuenni.

ref: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
text: Ba a duak ka kuŋkuŋ meena tɛŋ, pumpuulima garuk tii ate ba tuesi nuruba jigi ayen ba ta ba pama ale an baga a tuni la zuk. Ba Wenni yenni po ba a nyu ka da buui ate ba pai a tuni tuim kaasima nyiŋla.

ref: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
text: Mi yaa jam kaasi Amori demma ba niŋ wa ale wa woglimmu ase nyunyoŋ la ale wa pagrimu ase niak la. Mi jam kaasi bu yɔnaŋa alege tu bu tɛŋ naŋsaŋa kama.

ref: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
text: M yeeri ni kama ta nyini Ejipiti a dɛ ni niŋ gɔnni po bena pisinaansi ayen m pai Amori demma tɛŋka a te ni.

ref: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Mi basi ate ni nidoabilisaŋa po a yiti chim mi biisiteerɔba ate ni nidoabili paalukku a chim Naziriba. Kude daa wensie Izirali demma?>> Naawen ale weeni.

ref: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
text: <<Alege ni te ate Nazirima a nyu da pagrik ale basi ate m biisiteerɔma an biisi m wanni.

ref: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
text: <<Yɔgyɔgla de, m le ŋɔriŋ ni ase toroko ale ji za bie a ŋɔriŋ diila.

ref: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
text: Waai ale korisi la kan bɛ ate waai ale pagra la kan nya wa pagrimu. Ate kpaliŋ kpaliŋdɔ ale jɔk wa nyuvuri.

ref: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
text: Ate tɔŋdɔ a kan baga a zaani a kpaliŋ. Tugurik tɔŋdɔba yegayega a kan chali bɛ. Baai ale a kpaliŋ ale naab wusuma la a kan vari ba nyuvooŋa a basi.

ref: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Waai ale tua a nye kpaliŋsa la ale chali kama ale chaboala dai dila danni.>> Naawen ale weeni.

ref: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
text: Izirali tɛŋka demma meena ni wom Naawen ale weeni dii a ta va ni nyiŋla, mi ta ni kama a nyini Ejipiti po.

ref: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
text: <<Tɛŋka po meena ka nama ate mi a lueri, dila nyiŋla mi ale namsi ni kama ni wabaataŋa nyiŋ.>>

ref: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
text: Nuruba baye baga a cheŋ ale chaaba, ka ba nin siak a te chaaba?

ref: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
text: Gbeŋli a kaari gɔi po alege an nya jaab ayen di yigri? Gbeŋli a ŋuuni di boka jigi kinla alege an yik jaaboa?

ref: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
text: Nuim a jo baruk po alege an nya ŋandiinta? Baruk a yiri a che kinla ate jaab karo a yigri?

ref: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
text: Damuniŋ a dan peeri tɛŋ kpieŋ po, nuruba kpaziita a kan nagi? Kaasuŋ a dan nye tɛŋ kpieŋ po, daa Naawen ale nye ya?

ref: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
text: Chekki, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen a kan nye wari ale kan pai a sak wa tomteerɔma, Wen biisiteerɔma.

ref: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
text: Gbeŋli a dan kaari, ka wana ale kan yɔgsa? Nyɔnɔwa Naawen a biisi kama. Ka wana ale wa zɛri wa wanni weeni ka?

ref: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
text: Mooli a te Asdod ale Ejipiti nalimaŋa yie pagrisaŋa. <<Ni tigsi nidek Samaria guuku zuk, ate ni nya butimka tuimaŋa ale namsika ale bo wa nuruma suŋsuŋ la.>>

ref: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
text: <<Ba zɛ wamaŋ nyeka. Ba a tom ka tuim kaasima ale a vari nuruba ŋanta a basi ba yie pagrisaŋa po.>> Naawen ale weeni.

ref: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
text: Dila la Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna, <<Dachiak ale gilim ni tɛŋka. Wa ale kaasi ni jigi pagrisaŋa abe wa vari ni yie pagrisaŋa.>>

ref: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
text: Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna, <<Ase naapeerik ale a vari duŋ naŋsa koba ŋaye yaase ka turi gbeŋli nɔi po diila, Izirali demma ale nya varibasika ka dila. Baai ale kali ba gaduata noawaa zuk Samaria po la ale baai ale kali ba zukpagliksa zuk Damasikus po la,

ref: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
text: wom kude abe fi weeni a te Jekob yenni demma.>> Nyɔnɔwa Naawen, Wen dii ale a dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni.

ref: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
text: <<Dai dii dai ate mi za ayen m namsi Izirali ba wabaataŋa nyiŋla, mi za m kaasi Betel tɛŋka kaabka kuŋkuŋtaŋa kama. Kuŋkuŋku nyiilaŋa ale gebi a lo tɛŋ.

ref: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Mi ale kaasi yie fiisa ale yie kpiema meena, yie ŋaai ate ba pai yauk nyina a gomsi la mɛ mi ale kaasi ŋa.>> Naawen ale weeni.

ref: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
text: Ni wom wanni de, nipok baai ale a nye ase Basan tɛŋka niiŋa a bo Samaria guuku zuk la. Ni a namsi ŋanjaksa ale a vari baai ale kan ta la. Ale a weeni ni chorɔba ayen, <<Ni ta daam a jam te ti!>>

ref: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
text: Nyɔnɔwa Naawen abe pɛ kama a ta va wa weleŋsaŋa nyiŋ. <<Dai a cheena ate ba ale yik ni ase ba ale pai goatik a yik juma diila.

ref: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
text: Ni wanyi wanyi ale va tɛŋka parisaŋa vieŋa po a nyini, ate ba dari ni a ta va Yarmon geŋ a cheŋ.>> Ka Naawen ale weeni.

ref: Come to Bethel and Gilgal. Sin all you want! Offer sacrifices the next morning and bring a tenth of your crops on the third day.
text: <<Ni cheŋ Betel a ga tom wabaata, abe ni ŋman cheŋ Gilgal a ga tom wabaata yegayega a gum du. Ni ta ni kaabka a jam saluik meena. Daa ŋata po ni ta ni ŋantaŋa piika po bunyi a jam te.

ref: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
text: Ni pai dabinta boroborok a nye kaabka a te Wen jiam, abe ni ta kanjanta ale nidek yaalika po tiiritaŋa, ni kuulim dila nyiŋ, nama baai ale ka Izirali dem la. Ale ka nidek ale poom a yaali diila ale la.>> Ka Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen la ale weeni.

ref: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
text: <<Ni tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa meena mi basi kama ate kom a jam, ate ŋandiinta silimka a jam ni tɛŋ fiisaŋa mɛ po, alege ni an ŋman jam mi jigi ya.>> Ka Naawen ale weeni.
