Dii nyiŋla, Abrayam ka tama meena ko

ref: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
text: Wa jam ka chichama ale Wen pumpuulimaŋa. Wa siaka jam te wa ka pagrim ate wa a te Wen zula.

ref: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
text: Wa jam seba chak kama ayen Wen baga a nye wa ale puulim ayen wa nye diila kama.

ref: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
text: Ba ale ŋmarisi dii Wen gbaŋka po ayen m nye ate Abrayam chim wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ la, ba an ŋmarisi kama a te wadek wa nyiini,

ref: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
text: alege tama mɛ nyiŋ, ate ku le gum du te ti la, ase baai ale ta siaka ale wa la, waai ale nak Yeezu ti Naawenni a yiti kum po la,

ref: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
text: Waai ate wa pai wa a te ti tom kaasika nyiŋ la, ale nak wa yiti kum po ti nyemagsika nyiŋ la.

ref: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
text: Dila nyiŋla, ku ka ti siaka nyiŋ ale soa ate Wen baga nye ate ti chim wayɔrisima nyam. Dila abe le soa ate tama va Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa nyiŋ ate tama ale Wen a yaa ta suiyɔgni ale chaab.

ref: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
text: Ti siaka ale Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ mɛ abe le soa ate ti baga a nya Wen niaka nyeka ate wa ta ale ti la. Wa te ti ka yiila ale ŋmanteka ayen dai yeŋ po Wen ale tama le jam maa chaab a ta Wen zulaŋa.

ref: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
text: Wen pai wa Chiika nyo ka ti suiniima po nalimnyiini. Chiika abe ale Wen tiirim ate wa pai te tama. Wa be va ka Chiika de nyiŋ a pai wa yaalika a sueri ti suiniimaŋa. Dila ale soa ate yiila ŋaai ate ti ta la daa kinla nyiŋŋa.

ref: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
text: Nuru dan chim nuru maŋ, da dii dai nuru wa choa a baga a siak kama ayen wa zaani wa naŋkula po a kpi te kula nyɔnɔwa. Alege ku pagra kama ate nuru nye dila.

ref: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
text: Alege tama baai mɛ ale ka wabaata nyam la, Kirisita zaani ka tama naŋkula po a kpi te ti. Nya kude abe a sak ka Wen ale ta yaalika nalimnyiini ale ti diila.

ref: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
text: Ti jam ka Wen dachaasa, alege yɔgyɔgla de, wa va ka wa nidoabinni kummu nyiŋ a nye ate ti ŋman chim wa doaba. Wa nidoabinni abe dan baga a nye nya kude, ka boa le ku kasi ate yɔgyɔgla de wa ale vua la wa an baga a te varibasika?

ref: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
text: Biem liŋ jam boro kama ale ge ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate Wen yaa pai wa Sinsaŋŋa a te ba. Wa sinsaŋŋa ale kan diem jam boro diipo la, wa an jam a chiini wabaata.

ref: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
text: Alege a ta nyini diipo ate Adam boro la, a ta jam paari diipo ate Wen jam pai wa sinsaŋŋa a te Moosis la, nuruba jam a kpi kama. Baai mɛ ale jam poom kan zɛri Wen nɔi ase Adam ale nye diila, ba mɛ jam a kpi kama. Alege Wen jam poli kama ayen Adam nyeka a sak ti wari a magsi chaab ale waai ale wa jam la.

ref: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
text: Wen tiirimu ale Adam ale zɛri wa nɔi diila a daa bunyi. Ase sɛ la? Nuru yeŋ ale zɛri Wen nɔi la nyiŋ ale soa ate nuru boari kpi. Alege Wen ŋmanteka a gaam ka nna yegayega. Wa tiirim buui ate wa pai te nuru boari la, wa va ka nuru yeŋka Yeezu Kirisita ŋmanteka nyiŋ a te wa tiirimu nuru boanni.

ref: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
text: Adam ale jam tom biemu la, ka boan ale nye ya? Be ka boan jaab ale nye ase Wen ale va wa niaka nyiŋ a te ti wa tiirimu la? Be nya, Adam zɛri Wen nɔi kama ate Wen a bo ba buusa. Wen be ale va wa nyemagsika nyiŋ a te ti wa tiirimu la, wa yaa weeni ayen nurubiik yaa a chim wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ Yeezu nyiŋ.

ref: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
text: Nuru yeŋka ale zɛri Wen la nyiŋ ale soa ate kum a jam. Alege nuru yeŋka Yeezu Kirisita ale nye dii a te nurubiik la a zuak gaam taam kama. Baai meena abe ale a tuesi wa ŋmanteka yegayega ale wa ale nye ate nuruba a chim wayɔrisima nyam la, ka wa tiirim ale la ate wa pai te ba. Bala abe le va ka Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ a ta nyuvuri. Ba le chim ka nalima mɛ.

ref: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
text: Suik kula po, nuru yeŋka ale zɛri Wen nɔi ate dila basi ate Wen a bo ba buusa, suik kula po dekdega ate nuru yeŋ waai ale siak a te Wen nɔnni la a basi ate waai meena a baga a chim wayɔrisima nyam a nya nyemagsika ale nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.

ref: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
text: Nuru yeŋ ale jam zɛri Wen nɔi vaka la, dila basi kama ate nuru boari chim tuimbaata nyam wala nyiŋ. Nuru yeŋ mɛ ale jam va Wen nɔi la dila basi kama ate Wen nye ate nuru boari chim wayɔrisima nyam.

ref: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
text: Wen te wa sinsaŋŋa Juuma kama ayen ba seba ayen ba ale kasim jam a nye wie ŋaai la ba a zɛri ka wa nɔi. Alege nurubiik biemu ale ŋmasi chim a gum du la, Wen ŋmanteka mɛ a ŋmasi chim a gum du kama.

ref: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
text: Dila nyiŋla, biem ale va ka kum nyiŋ a soa nurubiik la, Wen ŋmanteka mɛ a va ka wayɔrisima nyiŋ a soa nurubiik dii nyiŋla, ka wa niaka nyiŋ ale soa ate ti chim wayɔrisima nyam. Dila abe basi kama ate ti yaa va Yeezu Kirisita ti Naawenni nyiŋ a nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.

ref: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
text: Ku be dan ka dila, ti le weeni ka boa? Ku magsi ayen ti kasim a tom tuimbaata taam wuu ate Wen kasim ta wa ŋmanteka ale ti a gum du?

ref: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
text: Aaya. Dii nyiŋla, biem jigi, ti kpi kama. Dila nyiŋla, ku an magsi ayen ti ŋman a nye ase biem jigi ti vua kama la.

ref: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
text: Mi a yaali kama ayen ni seba ayen ba ale te ti soka ayen tama ale Yeezu Kirisita chim bunyi la, ku a nye ase tama ale wa maa chaab a kpi kama la.

ref: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
text: Ba ale te ti soka la, ku a nye ase ba gu tama ale wa a gum ka chaab la. Alege Wen ti kowa a nak Kirisita a yiti kum po kama ale Kowa zulaŋa. Tama mɛ abe yiti kum po kama ayen tama mɛ ta nyuvuri paali. Ti ŋman ka ti nye kpakka.

ref: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
text: Tama be seba kama ayen ti nye kpakka a maa chaab a kpi kama ale Yeezu wa jabarimu nyiŋ ayen pagrim buui ale soa ate ti nye kpakka de a tom biem tuima la a yaa kaasi ate ti kan ŋman chim biem yɔmma.

ref: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
text: Diila waai ale kpi la, biem a ka pagrim wa zuwa.

ref: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
text: Tama ale Kirisita abe ale maa chaab kpi la, ti ta siaka kama ayen wa ale vua la, tama mɛ vua kama.

ref: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
text: Wen ale nak Kirisita yiti kum po. Tama mɛ abe seba kama ayen Yeezu abe kan ŋman kpi. Kum be ŋman ka pagrim wa zuwa.

ref: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
text: Wa kpi ka bunyi dekki. Wa be kpi kama ayen biem kan ŋman ta pagrim. Yɔgyɔgla de, wa vua kama ate Wen soa wa.

ref: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
text: Suik kula po, ni ta ku ni zuima po ayen biem jigi, ni kpi kama. Wen jigi mɛ, ni vua kama Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ.

ref: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
text: Ni kan basi ate biem soa ni, bu le nye kama ate ni a nye ni nyiŋsaŋa ale a yaali waba tii la.

ref: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
text: Ni be kan pai ni nyiŋsaŋa juijui ya a te biem ate bu nye ate nyiŋka kabta a tom tuimbaata. Alege, ku a fɛ kama ayen ni pai nidek a te Wen ase nuru baai ale nyini kum po a nyini vum po diila, a pai ni nyiŋka kabta a te Wen ate wa pai ni a tom wayɔrisima tuima.

ref: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, biem a kan ŋman chim ni nyɔnɔ a soa ni dii nyiŋla, ni an boro ka Moosis Sinsaŋŋa ale a weeni ni ayen ni a nye diila nyiŋŋa, alege, ni boro ka Wen ale va wa ŋmanteka nyiŋ a nye jabuui a te ni la nyiŋ.

ref: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
text: Ku be dan ka wensie ayen ti an boro ka Moosis Sinsaŋŋa ale a weeni ti ayen ti nye diila, ku be nala kama ate ti kasim a tom tuimbaata ale ge a poli ayen ti boro ka Wen ŋmanteka nyiŋŋa? Aaya.

ref: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
text: Ni jam ka biem yɔm, alege yɔgyɔgla de, mi a nye Wen jiam nalimnyiini boan nyiŋŋa, ni siak kama ale ni suiniima meena a te wensie sinsak ŋaai ate ni nya la.

ref: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
text: Wen vari ni kama biem nisa po a basi ale ge ate ni yaa chim wayɔrisima yɔm.

ref: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
text: Mi a biisi ase ka nurubiik la, dii nyiŋla ni wobsa kama nyiŋka po. Dila ale soa ate m pai yɔmawa ale wa nyɔnɔwa a magsi a sak ni la. Ni nya de, dipo, ni jam pai ka nidek meena ase yɔm la a te tuimbaata ale gaasa tuima. Suik kula po dekdega, ku a fɛ kama yɔgyɔgla de ayen ni pai nidek meena ase yɔm la a te wayɔrisima tuima ate ni sum chim nuru weleŋsa.

ref: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
text: Ni ale jam ka biem yɔm la, wayɔrisima an jam soa ni.

ref: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
text: Ku be ale jam ka dii ni jigi la, be ka boan jaab nyuenta ate ni jam nya? Ni jam nya ka chivie nyiini. Wieŋa de ŋaai abe ale basi ate ni yaa ta chivie la, wa ŋala abe le ŋa basi ate ni kpi ase ni nin diem a tom ŋa.

ref: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de, Wen vari ni a ta nyini biem po a nyini kama. Ni ka wala yɔm yɔgla. Ni nyuentaŋa abe le boa? Nyuentaŋa ale, ni yaa sum chim ka wa yɔm baai ale welema la. Ni be le nya ka nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.

ref: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, biem tutuna ale kum. Alege Wen tiirimu ale nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la Yeezu Kirisita ti Naawenni nyiŋ.

ref: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
text: M suata, nama baai ale seba sinsaŋŋa la, ni basi ate m bek ni wanni de ayen, nuru waai ale kpi la sinsaŋŋa a diem soa wa kama? Aaya. Ŋa an ŋman soa wa.

ref: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
text: Sinsaŋŋa a weeni kama ayen nipok dan yali chora, ku a fɛ kama ayen wa ale wa chorɔwa a boro ale chaab. Alege wa chorɔwa dan kpi wa yaa ta suik kama a yali chora wa choa.

ref: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
text: Wa chorɔwa dan boro ale ge ate wa ŋman goa ale nidoa wa choa, nuruba le wi wa ayen wa ka kaboŋ nyeerik. Wa chorɔwa be dan kpi, sinsaŋŋa ŋman ka pagrim wa jigiya. Wa dan yali chora wa choa, wa daa kaboŋ nyeeriga.

ref: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
text: M suata, ase nipowa chorɔwa ale kpi ate wa ta suik a yali nidoa wa choa la, dila dekdega mɛ Sinsaŋŋa jigi, ni yaa kpi kama ate ni yaa gum chaab ale Yeezu. Sinsaŋŋa an ŋman soa ni. Yɔgyɔgla de, Yeezu Kirisita waai ate Wen nak wa yiti kum po la, ale soa ti. Wen nye dila kama ayen ti a tom tuimaŋsa a te wa.

ref: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
text: Diipo ate ti jam boro a va tidek suiku la, Sinsaŋŋa kasim jam basi kama ate ti nyiŋsaŋa kabta tɔgatɔgaka ale a yaali diila a jam bo ti nyiŋsaŋa po ayen ti a tom tuim ŋaai le ŋa basi ate ti kpi la.

ref: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de, Moosis Sinsaŋŋa ŋaai ale jam yik ti a ta nna giŋgiŋ la, an ŋman soa ti. Dii nyiŋla, Sinsaŋŋa jigi tama kpi kama. Ŋa an ŋman soa ti. Dila nyiŋla, yɔgyɔgla de, ti kan ŋman a va Sinsaŋŋa su kpakka ale a weeni ti diila a tom a te Wen ya, alege ti a va ka Wen Chiika su paalukku ale a weeni diila a tom a te Wen.

ref: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
text: Ku be dan ka dila ti be le weeni ka boa? Ti baga a weeni ayen Moosis Sinsaŋŋa an nala? Aaya. Alege Moosis Sinsaŋŋa a daam dan kan jam ya, m daam ate an baga a miŋ ayen m jam a tom ka wabaata. Basi ate m pai m dek a magsi ayen, Sinsaŋŋa a daam dan kan sak mu ayen m kan a yaali m vaanchoa jaaboa, m te an baga a miŋ dila.

ref: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
text: Biem a yaa be va ka sinsak ŋaai nyiŋ ate m weeni la a nya suik a basi ate ŋan yaalik popola meena tɔgatɔga a yaa jam mi jigi. Boan nyiŋŋa, sinsaŋŋa a daam dan kan karo biem a nye ase ka jakpiuk la.

ref: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
text: Diipo ate mi jam zɛ sinsaŋŋa wensieŋa chak la, dipo m vua kama. Alege sinsaŋŋa ale jan jam la ate biem yaa yiri vua,

ref: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
text: ate mi yaa kpi. Sinsaŋŋa dekdega ŋaai ale ayen ŋa le te mu vum la ŋala dekdega abe ale ta kum a jam mi jigi.

ref: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, biem va ka sinsak ŋala nyiŋ a nya suik a paasi mi a yaa ko.

ref: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
text: Dila nyiŋla, Sinsaŋŋa meena welema kama. Ŋa welema kama ale chim wayɔrisima ale ŋman chim wamaŋ mɛ a te nuruba.

ref: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
text: Nya kude abe a sak kama ayen wa dii ale chim wamaŋ la ta ka kum a jam mi jigi ya? Aaya. Ku ka biem nyiini ale nye dila. Bu pai ka jaab maŋka a nye ate kum jam mi jigi. Suik kula po, biem abe va ka sinsaŋŋa po ayen ŋa sak ayen biem a sum ka biem.

ref: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
text: Ti seba ayen Sinsaŋŋa va ka Wen Chiika ale a yaali diila, alege mi kasim va ka m dek nyiŋka ale a yaali diila. Mi ka biem yɔma.

ref: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
text: Mi zɛ mi dek ale a tom diila. Mi an baga a nye wa dii ate mi a yaali ayen m nye la, alege m goanti a nye ka wa dii ate mi kisa a kan yaali di nyeka la.

ref: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
text: Dila nyiŋla, yɔgyɔgla de, m be dan a nye dii ate m kan yaali ayen m nye la, m siak kama ayen Sinsaŋŋa ka wamaŋsa.

ref: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
text: Dila nyiŋla, ku a sak ase daa mi ale nye wa dila la, alege ka biem buui ale bo m po la ale a nye dila.

ref: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
text: Mi seba kama ayen wamaŋ ka mi nyiŋka po. Boan nyiŋŋa, m kasim a yaali kama ayen mi a tom wamaŋsa alege mi an baga a nye.

ref: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
text: M be dan a tom dii ate m kan yaali ayen m tom la, ku a sak ase daa mi ale a tom dila la, alege ka biem buui ale bo m nyiŋka po la ale a tom dila.

ref: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
text: Dila nyiŋla, ku a nye ase nyeka de a yaa ale a tom tuima mi nyiŋka po la. Mi dan a yaali ayen m nye wamaŋ, wabiok nyiini ate mi a nye.

ref: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
text: Mi popola po, ku a te mu ka popeentik ayen mi a tom sinsaŋŋa ale a weeni diila.

ref: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
text: Alege m nya ale ka nye ka choa ale boro a tom m nyiŋka po. Nyeka de ka biem nye kaai ale a nye kpaliŋ ale nye kaai ate mi popolaŋa a yaali la, a yaa basi ate m chim ŋa yɔma.

ref: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
text: Oo, ka boan jaab chivie ale a de mu nna! Ka wana ale wa vari mu a ta nyini nyiŋka de ale basi ate mi a kpi la po?

ref: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
text: M va Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa nyiŋ a nye Wen jiam. Ku abe ale ka diila ale la. Mi dek jigi, m popola po, mi a tom sinsaŋŋa ale a weeni diila kama, alege mi nyiŋka a tom ka biem sinsaŋŋa ale a weeni diila.

ref: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de, baai ale Yeezu Kirisita ale ka bunyi la, Wen a kan te ba waalika,

ref: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
text: boan nyiŋŋa, biem ale kum nyeka a daam yik ti a lik kama. Alege yɔgyɔgla de, Wen Chiika nyeka vari ti basi kama. Wen Chiika de va ka Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ a te mu vum.

ref: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
text: Wen nye dii ate Sinsaŋŋa an jam baga a nye la kama. Ŋa an jam baga a nye dila dii nyiŋla, tama dek nyiŋka ale a yaali diila a basi kama ate ka wobsa. Wen tom ka wadek biika ate wa siŋ jam tɛŋzuk de a neensi nurubiik a yaa nye ate biem ŋman ka pagrimoa.

ref: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
text: Wen nye dila kama ayen tama baai ale a va Wen Chiika ale a yaali diila, a kan a va tama nurubiik nyeka ale a yaali diila, alege ka ti a va wayɔrisima wieŋa ate Sinsaŋŋa a weeni ayen ti nye la.

ref: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
text: Baai ale a va badek nurubiik nyeka ale a yaali diila, a pai ba popola meena a te ka popola ŋala chaab. Baai mɛ ale a va Wen Chiika nyeka la, pai ba popola meena a te ka Wen Chiika wie.

ref: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
text: Waai abe dan basi ate nurubiik nyeka yaalika a soa wa popola meena, dila ku ta wa a cheŋ ka kum po. Waai mɛ abe dan basi ate Wen Chiika a soa wa popolaŋa meena, dila a ta ka vum ale suiyɔgni a jam wa jigi.

ref: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
text: Alege nama kan va daa nurubiik nyeka yaalika ale a weeni diila. Nama va ka Wen Chiika ale a weeni ni diila, ase ku dan sum ka wensie ayen wa bo ni suiniima po. Waai ale kan ta Kirisitawa Chiika la, Kirisitawa an soa wa.

ref: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
text: Alege Kirisitawa a dan bo fi suinum po, nyiŋka kpi kama biem nyiŋ, alege fi chiika vua kama wayɔrisima nyiŋ.

ref: Yet God raised Jesus to life! God's Spirit now lives in you, and he will raise you to life by his Spirit.
text: Ase Wen dii ale nak Yeezu a yiti kum po la, Wen Chiika a dan bo ni suiniima po, Wen mɛ le va ka wa Chiika waai ale bo ti suiniima po la nyiŋ a te ni tɛŋzuk de nyiŋsaŋa vum.

ref: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
text: Dii nyiŋla, ni dan a va dila, ni le kpi kama. Alege ni dan pai Wen Chiika pagrimu a ko nidek nurubiik nyeka yaalika, ni le vuuk kama.

ref: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
text: Baai ate Wen Chiika de ba niŋ a sak ba la, ka Wen bisa.

ref: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
text: Ti be dan ka wa bisa, dai yeŋ po, ti be le jam soa ŋan baai meena ate wa puulim ayen wa le pai te ti la kama. Tama ale Kirisita abe le jam maa ka chaab a soa ŋan baai ate wa puulim ayen wa le pai te wa la. Yɔgyɔgla de, tama abe dan maara a nam Kirisita ninammu, dai yeŋ po, tama ale wa le maa chaab a nya wa zulaŋa.

ref: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
text: Mi a poli ayen nam kaai ate tama a nam yɔgyɔgla de la, ti an baga pai ka a magsi chaab ale Wen zula ŋaai le ŋa nyini peelim dai yeŋ ate ti nya ŋa la.

ref: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.

ref: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
text: Wen ale te mi tiirim buui la nyiŋ ale soa ate mi a weeni ni meena ayen ni kan nya nidek ase nama gaam ni ale ka diila. Alege ku a fɛ kama ayen ni a poli ale yam abe ni wanyi wanyi a bo nidek buusa a magsi chaab ale Wen ale te ni siaka ate ka soa diila.

ref: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
text: Nurubiik nyiŋ ta ka kabta tɔgatɔga nna yegayega. Kabtaŋa meena kunyikunyi a tom ka tuima tɔgatɔga.

ref: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
text: Suik kula po, tama mɛ piisi kama alege ti meena a nye ase ka nyiŋ yeŋ ale Kirisita la. Ti ka wanyi wanyi alege ti meena soa ka chaab.

ref: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
text: Dila nyiŋla, tama abe pai ti tiirita tɔgatɔgaka ate Wen va wa nyemagsika nyiŋ a te ti la a tom tuima. Ti tiirimu dan ka ti chim Wen biisiteerɔba a weeni wa tuntomika, ti a weeni a magsi chaab ale ti siaka ale soa diila.

ref: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
text: Be dan ka ti chim tomteerɔba, ti tom a te. Be dan ka ti chim sagrɔba, ti a sak.

ref: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
text: Be dan ka ti a te nuruba nyiŋbiiri ba tuima po ale ba nyeboka po, ti a nye dila, be dan ka wa te wa vaanchoa jaab, ku a fɛ kama ate wa nye dila ale wa suinum meena, be dan ka wa chim niŋdeerɔ, ku a fɛ kama ayen wa a tom wa tuimaŋa nalimnyiini, be dan ka wa ta jiirim ale nuruba, wa a nye dila ale suipeentik.

ref: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
text: Ku a fɛ kama ate ni ta wensie yaalika ale nuruba. Kisi wa dii ale kan daa wamaŋ la, abe ni ŋmasi yik wa dii ale ka wamaŋ la.

ref: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
text: Ni kan ta nyiŋworuk ale Naawen vaka. Tom a te wa ale ninmuna nalimnyiini.

ref: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
text: Yiila ŋaai ate ni ta la, ni basi ate ŋa kasim a te ni suipeentik. Nyenyaka dan jam ni jigi ni ta chichiiba. Ni kasim a puusi Wen daa meena.

ref: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
text: Ni be niak baai ale a namsi ni la, ni ale ka Kirisita bisa la nyiŋ. Ni kan ka te ba.

ref: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
text: Baai sue dan peenti ni basi ate nama mɛ sue peenti ale ba. Baai mɛ sue ale kaasi la ni basi ate nama mɛ sue kaasi ale ba.

ref: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
text: Ni be pii nyiŋ meena ate ni boro ale masim ale waai meena.

ref: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
text: Kɔm a dan ta fi dachiak te wa ŋandiinta, nyanyuila a dan ta wa, te wa nyiam. Dii nyiŋla, fi dan nye nyaŋa de a te wa, fi pai ka bolim kaala a vi wa zuk. (Wamagsima

ref: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
text: Ni kan basi ate wabaata nya suik a nak ni yiagi, ni basi ate wamaŋsa nak wabaata yiak basi.

ref: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
text: Ku a fɛ kama ayen waai meena siak baai ale ka tɛŋka kpaga la noa, dii nyiŋla, Wen dan kan te suiwa, nuru karo a baga a chim kpagiya. Dila nyiŋla, kpaga ŋaai ale boro yɔgyɔgla de nna la, ka Wen ale pai ba basi du.

ref: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.
text: Waai abe dan zɛri kpaŋŋa de noa, kula nyɔnɔwa a zɛri ka baai ate Wen lueri zaan du la noa. Ku be a fɛ kama ayen nuru wala choa nya waalika.

ref: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
text: Ba ka Wen tomteerɔba a tom ayen nalim jam ni jigi. Alege ni dan nye wari kaasi, ni basi ate yɔgsum yik ni boan nyiŋŋa, ku daa kinla nyiŋŋa ate ba ta ba pagrimu. Ba ka Wen tomteerɔba a tagri Wen zuk a te baai ale a tom tuim kaasima la waalika dii nyiŋla, kaasuŋku a te Wen ka suipuurum.

ref: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
text: Ku a fɛ kama ayen ni a zuli kpaŋŋa noa. Ku daa Wen suipuurum waalika nyiini nyiŋŋa, alege ku ka wa dii ate nama dek popola a weeni ni mɛ la.

ref: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
text: Dila nyiŋ ale soa ate ni a tuni lampoo, dii nyiŋla, kpaŋŋa ka Wen tomteerɔba a tom ba tuimaŋa.

ref: Pay all that you owe, whether it is taxes and fees or respect and honor. Love
text: Dila nyiŋla, ni dan ta waai pami ni tuni wa. Ni dan ta ka lampoo pami ni tuni. Te nuru baai ale magsi ni te ba zula la.

ref: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
text: Ni teeri Moosis Sinsaŋŋa ale a weeni diila ayen, <<Kan nye kaboŋsa, kan ko nuru, kan zu, kan yaali fi vaanchoa jaaboa,>> (Nyinika

ref: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
text: Nuru waai ale ta yaalika ale wa vaanchoa la, a kan nye wa a kaasi. Dila nyiŋla, waai a dan ta yaalika wa va Sinsaŋŋa meena kama.

ref: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
text: Ni a nye wieŋa de meena dii nyiŋla, nama dek seba ku ale ka dii yɔgyɔgla de la kama. Vanni veenti kama ate ku a fɛ ayen ni yiti ni goomu po yɔgyɔgla de a zaani ŋmai. Dii nyiŋla, diipo ate ti le nya varibasika la a poom moata kama a gaam diipo ate ti liŋ jam ta siaka la.

ref: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
text: Ku a nye ase yokku a boro a taam kama ale ge ayen vari veenti la. Ni basi ate ti basi legi po tuimaŋa tomka abe ti gomsi tidek ale tuimaŋsa tomka ate ti nak legi po tuimaŋa a yiak basi.

ref: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
text: Ni basi ate ti boka a magsi ate ku a sak nuruba ayen ti ka daa legi po. Ti kaa nyu daata bugi a yibi, ti kan chim nipok yaalisa, yaase daŋta tuima, ti kaa nye kpaliŋsa, abe ti kaa de nyuri ale nuruba.

ref: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
text: Ni basi ate Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa nyeboka choawa a soa ni nalimnyiini abe ni kan nye wa dii le di te nyiŋka koarisa suiwa.

ref: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
text: Nama po wanyi siaka a dan kan pagra yegayega, ni kan a nak nanpaga ale wa dii ale nala ale dii ale kan nala a magsi nyeka la. Ni basi ate nuru wala choa a maa gum ni po.

ref: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
text: Waai boro kama a baga a weeni ayen wa ta siaka a baga a de jaab meena. Alege waai mɛ siaka ale kan pagra la, a de ka jenvaata nyiini. Wa kan ŋɔbi lammoa.

ref: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
text: Suik karo ate ni baga a bo nuru tomteerɔ buusa. Ku ka tomteerɔwa nyɔnɔwa ale ta suik a weeni ayen wa tomteerɔwa ale tom diila ku nala yaase ku an nala. Wa be le baga a tom nueri kama nalimnyiini, dii nyiŋla, ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita baga a nye kama ate wa a tom a nueri nalimnyiini.

ref: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
text: Nuru le weeni ayen danni de yaase danni de a chim da maŋ a gaam daaŋa meena kama. Wa choa mɛ le weeni ayen daaŋa meena ka bunyi. Ku a fɛ kama ayen waai meena a seba chak wa popola po ayen wa dii ate wa a nye la ka wamaŋ.

ref: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
text: Ti wanyi mɛ la an boro ka tidek nyiŋŋa. Ti wanyi mɛ la abe kan kpi ka tidek nyiŋŋa.

ref: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
text: Ti dan vua, ti vua kama a zuli te Naawen, ti be dan kpi mɛ ka ti Naawenni ate ti a zuli. Dii nyiŋla, ti vua yoo ti an vua yoo, ka wala ale soa ti.

ref: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
text: Dila nyiŋ ale soa ate Kirisita kpi a ŋman yiti kum po a vua la ayen wa chim ŋanvuta ale kpilima Naawen.

ref: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
text: Ase ku ale ŋmarisi ayen, <<Ase mi ale ka Naawen dii ale vua la. Duna meena ale kpi tɛŋ mi niŋ. Mi nyiŋ nɔi meena ale pak Naawen.>> (Azaya

ref: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
text: Dila nyiŋla, ti meena ti wanyi wanyi le zaani ka Wen niŋ a weeni sak wa wie ŋaai meena ate ti nye la ale dii nyiŋ ale soa ate ti nye ŋa la.

ref: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
text: Mi popolaŋa ale Yeezu ti Naawenni ale ka bunyi diila a basi kama ate m seba chak nalimnyiini ayen jadiim meena tidek a chim ka jaab weleŋ. Alege waai dan poli ayen ba an welema, ba an sum welema a te wa.

ref: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
text: Ni dan a de jaab ate ku a te ni Kirisita biik choa daanika, ni ale a nye diila kan sak ayen ni ta yaalika ale wa. Kan basi ate ŋandiin tii ate fi a de la, a kaasi nuru waai ate Kirisita kpi te la siaka.

ref: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
text: Kan basi ate jabuui ate ni a poli ayen wa nala la a nya yuei kaasuŋŋoa.

ref: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, ku daa ni ale a de jabuui la, yaase ni ale a nyu jabuui la ale Wen naamu wie. Alege bu ka wayɔrisima nyeka, suiyɔgni boka ale suipeentik. Nyaŋa de meena abe a nyini ka Wen Chiika jigi.

ref: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
text: Waai abe ale va suiku de po a tom a te Kirisita la, ku a basi kama ate Wen ale nuruba sue a peenti ale wa.

ref: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
text: Ni kan va ŋandiinta nyiŋŋa a kaasi Wen ale a nye diila. Ti baga a de ŋandiinta meena kama alege ku an magsi ayen nuru de jabuui le wa basi ate wa Kirisita biik choa tom wabiok la.

ref: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
text: Ku a magsi kama ayen ti kan a ŋɔbi lanta yaase ti a nyu daamoa, yaase ti nye wa dii le di basi ate nuru waai mɛ ale ta siaka la a tom wabiowa.

ref: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
text: Siak kaai ate fi ta magsi chaab ale wieŋa de la, basi ate ka bo fidek ale Wen suŋsuŋ po. Suipeentik bo ka waai ale weeni wadek ayen wa an nya kaasuŋŋoa ale wa dii ate wa poli ayen di nala a magsi wa nye di la.

ref: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
text: Wen dii ale a te nuruba chichiiba ale a te ba nyiŋbiiri mɛ wie po la, le basi ate nama baai ale a va Yeezu Kirisita la a boro ale nɔiyeŋ ale chaab a tomsi a nye wa nyeka

ref: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
text: ate ni meena pai nɔiyeŋ a te ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita Wenni ale wa Kowa zula.

ref: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
text: Ni basi ate m weeni sak ni ayen Kirisita a chim ka Juuma tomteerɔ ayen ku sak ba ayen Wen wensieŋa ale wa ale jam puulim dii dipo wa ale ba kokpieŋsaŋa la, a sum jam chim ka wensie,

ref: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
text: abe ku basi mɛ ate baai ale kan daa Juuba la a te Wen pimpauk wa jiirimu nyiŋ ase ti ale karim Wen gbaŋka po dii ayen, <<M le maa bo ka nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la po a pak fu, a lenni yiila a seni fi yuenni.>> (

ref: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
text: Azaya mɛ ŋmarisi ayen, <<Jese ŋaaŋbiik le jam. Wen le zak wa zaani ate wa soa nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la. Bala mɛ abe le ta yiila wa jigi kama.>> (Azaya

ref: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
text: Wen dii nyiŋ ate ni ta yiila la, le va ni siaka ale wa nyiŋ a basi ate ni boro ale suipeentik nalimnyiini ale suiyɔgni ate yiila ŋaai ate ni ta wa jigi la, le va Wen Chiika pagrimu nyiŋ a chim a nyoro.

ref: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
text: Mi dek abe seba chak kama, m suata, ayen nama dek ka tuimaŋsa tomka nyiini. Ni be ta sebika nalimnyiini kama a baga a te chaab sinsaga.

ref: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
text: ate m chim Kirisita tomteerɔ a tom a te nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la. Ku a nye ase m ka Wen yenni kpaŋŋa la a yaa a sak nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la Wen wamaŋsaŋa ate Wen Chiika nye ate ba welema ate m yaa pai ba ase kaab ka la a te Wen ate wa yaa siak a tuesi ba.

ref: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
text: Be ka Yeezu Kirisita ale mi ale chim bunyiwa la nyiŋ ate mi ta kanjanta ale m le tom dii te Wen la.

ref: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
text: Wa basi kama mɛ ate m nye wakperikaliik pagrisa ayen ku sak ayen m pagrimu nyini ka wala jigi. Be ka Wen Chiika pagrimu nyiŋ ate nyaŋa de meena nye. Dila nyiŋla, zaani Jerusalem a nyiem a jam paari Ilirikum tɛŋka, mi sak Wen wamaŋsaŋa meena a magsi chaab ale Kirisita ate ŋa tagli ka jigi meena.

ref: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
text: Mi kasim pii ka nyiŋ a poli ayen m sak Wen wamaŋsaŋa juijui ate nuru an diem wom Yeezu Kirisita wie la. Boan nyiŋŋa, mi kan yaali ayen m deri zaani juijui ate nuru wa choa liŋ tom la a yaa deri piilim tom a cheŋ.

ref: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
text: Ase ba ale ŋmarisi Wen gbaŋka po ayen, <<Baai ate ba an weeni wa wari a sak ba la ale nya, ate baai ale kan wom la ale miŋ.>> (Azaya

ref: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
text: Mi ale boro a tom tuini de la nyiŋ ale soa ate mi an baga a jam ni jigi ya.

ref: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
text: M poom kasim pii ka nyiŋ ayen m jam alege nye kpeeri. Alege yɔgyɔgla de ate jigi a ŋman ka jigini de po ate mi a tom la, ale m kasim a yaali nna yegayega ate ku paari bena dii choa ayen m jam nya ni la,

ref: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
text: mi a poli ayen m le jam yɔgyɔgla de. Mi a yaali kama ayen m dan a cheŋ Supeeni tɛŋka m mobi a nya ni abe mi a taam. M dan goa ale ni maga dega ate ku masa, ni maa maari mu ate m baga cheŋ dula.

ref: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, Kirisita tigini demma baai ale bo Masidoniya ale Akaaya la a poli kama nya ale ku nala ate ba yaa maa chaab a cheesi tiirim ayen m ta ga te Kirisita tigini demma baai ale ka niwoba a bo Jerusalem la.

ref: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
text: Tuini de ate mi ta ayen m te ba ligraŋa la, m dan te ba a ga nueri, m le mobi nya ni diipo ate mi a taam Supeeni la.

ref: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
text: M dan jam ni jigi, m seba chak kama ayen m le jam ale ka wamaŋsa nna yegayega a nyini Yeezu Kirisita jigi.

ref: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
text: Mi a saalim ni m suata Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa nyiŋ ale yaali kaai ate Wen Chiika a te la nyiŋ ayen, ni maa je m jiaka a te mu ale Wen puusika.

ref: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
text: Ni a puusi ayen baai ale bo Judia tɛŋka ate ba ka siaka ale Yeezu la ayen ba kan nye wabiok m jigiya. Ni maa a puusi mɛ ayen tuin dii ate m le tom te Jerusalem tɛŋka Kirisita bisaŋa la, ba le tuesi di nalimnyiini ale suipeentik.

ref: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
text: Ate Wen dan maari abe m jam ni jigi ale suipeentik nalimnyiini a goa ale ni a nya masim.

ref: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
text: Wen dii ale a basi ate nuruba a boro ale suiyɔgni la le bo ale ni meena. Ku be nye dila.

ref: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
text: Mi a yaali ayen m weeni a sak ni ka Fiibi ale ka waai la. Wa ka ti toa Yeezu yuenni nyiŋ. Wa ka Kenkrea Kirisita tigini demma maarɔ.

ref: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
text: Ni ŋmasi yik wa a ta nalimnyiini ale ka ti Naawenni ale soa wa. Ku ale magsi ayen Kirisita tigini demma a nye diila ale nna. Ni a te wa maari kaai meena wuu ate wa a yaali ni jigi la. Boan nyiŋŋa, wa mɛ dek maa maari nuruba ka nna yegayega. Wa maa maari mi mɛ kama.

ref: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
text: Mi a puusi Pirisila ale Akiila. Bala ale mi ale jam maa chaab a tom a te Yeezu Kirisita.

ref: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
text: Puusi Kirisita tigini demma baai ale a nye tuka ba yenni po la. Puusi m dek doa maŋka Epanetus. Ka wala ale dɛ niŋ a ta siaka ale Kirisita Asia po.

ref: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
text: Puusi Mɛɛri, waai ale jam a tom nna yegayega a te ni la.

ref: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
text: Puusi m Juu chaama Andironikus ale Junias baai ale jam maa bo likka dɔkku po ale mu la. Tuimtomdɔma seba ba kama nalimnyiini. Bade niŋ a chim Kirisita bisa kama ale ge mi.

ref: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
text: Puusi Ampiliyatus waai ate m ta yaalika ale wa la, dii nyiŋla wa ka Kirisita biik.

ref: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
text: Puusi Yurubanus waai ate ti jam a tom Kirisita tuimaŋa ale chaab la. Mi a puusi m dek doa maŋka Sitakus.

ref: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
text: Puusi Apeles waai ale sum va Yeezu Kirisita la. Puusi Arisitobulus dɔkdemma a te mu.

ref: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
text: Puusi Ayerodiyan m Juu choawa. Mi a puusi baai ale chim Kirisita bisa a bo Naasisus yenni po la.

ref: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
text: Puusi nipooma de, Turufina ale Turufosa baai ale a tom nna yegayega a te Naawen la. Mi a puusi tidek toawa Perisis waai mɛ ale jam a tom tuima nna yegayega a te Naawen la.

ref: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
text: Puusi Arufusi waai ale kan ta choa ale wa ale a tom dii a te Naawen la. Puusi wa mawa waai ale a nye mi jigi ase m ka wadek biik la.

ref: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
text: Puusi Asinkiritus ale Filegon ale Yemes ale Paturobasi ale Yemas ale Kirisita bisaŋa ale boro ale ba la.

ref: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
text: Puusi Filologus ale Juliya ale Neriyas ale wa toawa ale Olimpas ale Kirisita be sii meena ale boro ale ba la.

ref: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
text: Ni puusi chaab nalimnyiini. Kirisita Tiŋŋa meena demma dela jigini a puusi ni.

ref: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
text: Waai meena seba kama ayen ni siak a te ka Wen wamaŋsaŋa ale a biisi diila. Nya kude abe basi kama ate m sui peenti ale ni. Mi a yaali kama mɛ ayen ni ta yam ale wie ŋaai ale nala la, alege ni kan poom maa seba wie ŋaai ale ka wabaata la, nɔi po.

ref: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
text: Wen dii ale a basi ate nuruba a boro ale suiyɔgni la, le kaasi Sitaana pagrimu yɔgyɔgla de ate ni va wa zuk a taam. Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa niaka bo ale ni.

ref: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
text: Timoti, waai ale mi ale a tom ale chaab la, a puusi ni. Lusiyas ale Jeesin ale Sosipeeta m Juu chaama a puusi ni.

ref: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
text: Mi Tetiyas waai mɛ ale ka Kirisita biik ate Pɔɔl yik ŋmarisi gbaŋka de la a puusi Naawen yuenni nyiŋ.

ref: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
text: Ku a fɛ kama ayen ti te Wen pimpauk boan nyiŋŋa, wa a te ni ka pagrim, ase mi ale nuruba ba chaab sinsaŋŋa po ate ti nyiem a sak nuruba Yeezu Kirisita wie ayen wa te ti pagrim diila. Sinsaŋŋa de a liŋ jam suk kama.

ref: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
text: Wen dii nyiini ale ka yam nyɔnɔ wie meena po la, ti a te wa pimpauk Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ daa meena wuu. Ku be nye dila.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
text: Gbaŋka dɛ a nyini ka mi Pɔɔl waai ate Wen a wi mu ale wadek yaalika ayen m chim Yeezu Kirisita tuimtomdɔ la, ale m Kirisita biik choawa Sositenisi jigi.

ref: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
text: M ŋmarisi a te ka nama baai ale ta siaka ale Wen a bo Korinti tɛŋka la, ate Wen a gaari ni ayen ni chim wa nuru weleŋsa la, ale baai ale a tu chaab jigi meena a puusi a wi Yeezu Kirisita waai ale ka nama ale tama meena Naawen la yuenni.

ref: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Mi a puusi a te Wen ti Kowa ale Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa ayen wa te ni ŋmanteka abe wa te ni suiyɔgni.

ref: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
text: M be kasim a te Wen dii ate mi va la jiam kama a te ni, dii nyiŋla, wa le va Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ a ŋmante ni.

ref: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
text: Yeezu Kirisita wieŋa ate ba sak ni la, ni ta siaka ale ŋa kama nna pagri pagriga,

ref: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
text: dila nyiŋ ni an jɔk tiirim ale magadek mɛ, ase ni ale a limisi da dii dai ate Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa ale sak wa pagrimu ale ka diila.

ref: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
text: Mi a yaali ayen m weeni m Kirisita bi chaama, Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa yuenni nyiŋ, ayen ni ta nɔiyeŋ ate ni kaa poori chaaba. Ni gum chaab ale popola yena,

ref: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
text: diila Kolo yenni dem ale lagri weeni sak mu, ayen ni kasim ta ka nanpaga ale chaab.

ref: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
text: Ni a nye nna ase Kirisita ma a piisi kama daa wanyi la. Ba an kpi daa mi Pɔɔl jabarimu zuk ni wabaataŋa nyiŋŋa. Ba be an te ni soka ase ka mi ŋaaŋviirɔba la.

ref: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
text: Dila nyiŋ ni waai kan baga a weeni ayen ba te ni soka ase ka mi ŋaaŋviirɔba la.

ref: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
text: M te Sitifanus ale wa dɔkdemma soka mɛ, alege mi an baga a teeri waai ate m te wa soka.

ref: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
text: Kirisita an tom mu ayen mi a te ka nuruba soka. Wa tom mu kama ayen m mooli wa wamaŋsaŋa a te nuruba, abe m kan mooli ŋa a va nurubiik yammoa ate Yeezu kummu jabarimu zuk a chim kinla.

ref: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
text: Baai meena abe ale bɛ Wen suiku la, a poli kama ayen Kirisita kummu jabarimu zuk wieŋa ka kinla, alege tama baai ale nya varibasika la, ŋa ka Wen pagrim ti jigi.

ref: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
text: Ku ŋmarisi ayen, <<M le kaasi yam nyama yammu, abe m kaasi sebrɔma sebika.>> (Azaya

ref: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
text: Dila nyiŋla, tɛŋka de yam nyama, ale gbaŋ sebrɔma, ale nanpaga nagrisa a ka wamaŋ a weeni a magsi chaab ale Wen pagrimu ale wa yammu. Wen abe a sak kama ayen tɛŋka de demma yammu ka betta yam.

ref: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
text: Wen abe ka yam nyɔnɔ, ate wa yaa basi ayen nuruba a kan baga a pai badek yam a seba wa. Wa nye dila kama ayen wie ŋaai ate tama a mooli ate nuruba a weeni ayen betta wie la, wa va ŋala a vari baai ale ta siaka la a basi.

ref: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
text: Juuma abe a yaali ka wakperikaliisa nya ka. Baai ale kan daa Juuba la a yaali yam.

ref: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
text: Dan ka tama, ti a mooli ka Kirisita kummu jabarimu zuk, wa dii ale chim leeta a te Juuma ale chim betta a te baai ale kan daa Juuba la.

ref: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
text: Wari dii ate nuruba a poli ayen di ka betta Wen jigi la, di gaam nurubiik yam kama. Dii mɛ ate nuruba a poli ayen di ka wobsim Wen jigi la, di pagra a gaam nurubiik pagrim kama.

ref: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
text: M suata, ni teeri ni le jam ka nuru baai chaab alege ate Wen a wi ni la. Nurubiik popola po daa ni yega ale jam ta yam yaase pagrim yaase nuru kpienta.

ref: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
text: Wen a potim lueri ka baai ate tɛŋka demma a pai a chim betta la ayen wa sak yam nyama ayen ba sum ka yammoa. Wa be ŋman lueri ka baai ate tɛŋka demma a nya ba ase niwoba la ayen wa sak pagrɔma ayen ba sum ka pagrimoa.

ref: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
text: Wa lueri ka tɛŋka demma ale nya ŋan baai nueri ale a zɛri ba la, ale a poli ayen ŋa ka kiri la, ate wa baga a kaasi ŋan baai ate tɛŋka demma a poli ayen ŋa ka ŋanta dek la.

ref: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
text: Ate dila nyiŋ nuru kan baga a kuulim Wen jigi ya.

ref: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
text: Ku jam ŋmarisi kama ayen, <<Basi ate waai ale a kuulim la, a kuulim Naawen nyiŋ.>> (Jeremaya

ref: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
text: M suata, mi ale jam ni jigi ayen m mooli Wen wensie wie ŋaai ate yɔgyɔgla de ti yaa seba la, mi an biisi wie ŋaai ale pagra ale ni miŋ ka.

ref: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
text: M be ale jam bo ale ni la, mi a poli kama ayen m kan sak wayoŋ a gaam Yeezu Kirisita wie ale wa kummu jabarimu zuwa.

ref: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
text: M nyiŋka kasim jam a gɔk nna ase m yɔgsa ale wobsa kama la.

ref: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
text: Dila nyiŋla, daa nurubiik yam ale basi ate ni ta siaka ale Kirisita, alege ka Naawen pagrim nyiŋ.

ref: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
text: Ti be a mooli ka yam wie a te baai ale a miŋ Chiika wensie wieŋa la. Alege daa tɛŋzuk de yammoa yaase baai ale ta kpaŋta tɛŋzuk de la. Ba za ba jam a jɔk ba pagrimu kama.

ref: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
text: Yammu dɛ ate ti a sak la, ka Wen yam susugi dii ate wa pai suk ale nurubiik la, alege Wen poli ayen wa ale ŋaam pai sak ti tama zula nyiŋ alege nye tɛŋka meena.

ref: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
text: Tɛŋzuk dɛ kpaŋŋa waai a zɛ yammu dɛ. Ba dan seba kama, ba ti an kpi Yeezu waai ale ta Wen zulaŋa la jabarimu nyiŋ ŋa.

ref: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
text: Ase ku le jam ŋmarisi ayen, <<Dii ate nuruba an nya la, ba abe an wom la, ba abe an poli ayen di ale baga a nye la, dila dek ate Wen a gomsi a magsi baai ale a yaali wa la.>> (Azaya

ref: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
text: Wen yaa abe va ka wa Chiika jigi a pai wa susugini dɛ a sak ti. Diila Chiika a seba wari meena kama ale Wen popola po meena.

ref: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
text: Nuru waai an baga a seba wa choa popola, alege ka nuru wala dek Chiika ale seba. Ku be ka dila ate waai an baga seba Wen popola, ka Wen Chiika nyiini ale seba wa popola.

ref: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
text: Ti abe a miŋ tiirim tii ale nyini Wen jigi la kama, dii nyiŋla, wa an te ti Velimvendika chiiga, alege wa te ti ka wadek chiika.

ref: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
text: Nuru waai ate Chiika an bo ale wa la an baga a tuesi tiirim tii ale a nyini Wen Chiika jigi la. Nuru wala choa an baga a miŋ ŋa, diila ŋa ka betta wa jigi. Be ka Chiika nyiŋ ate waai baga a miŋ ŋa kie.

ref: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
text: Waai mɛ ate Wen Chiika a bo ale wa la, a baga a miŋ wari meena kiri kama, alege nuru waai an baga a bo wa buusa.

ref: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
text: Dila <<Ka wana ale seba Naawen popola? Ka wana abe le wa baga a sak wa?>> (Azaya

ref: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
text: M suata, mi jigi togni, m kan baga a sak ni ase baai ate Wen Chiika a bo ale ba la. Alege m le sak ni ase ka baai ale ta tɛŋka de wie popola la. Ni a nye nna ase ni ka baai ale diem piilim a bo Wen suiku po la.

ref: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
text: M jam a te ni ka biisim ayen ni a nyu, diila, ni an jam baga a de ŋandiinta, ni be an poom diem baga a de.

ref: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
text: Ni diem a nye ase ka baai ale kan daa Kirisita bisa la. Diila nyuri ale kpaliŋsa ale bo ni suŋsuŋ, ni kan nye ase ka nuruba kama la?

ref: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
text: Ni ba gela ayen ni a va ka Pɔɔl, ba gela ayen ba a va ka Apolos. Ni nyeka a nye nna ase ka baai ale kan daa Kirisita bisa la.

ref: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
text: Mi bori kama, ate Apolos a zaŋti, alege Wen a basi ate ŋantaŋa a chim.

ref: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
text: Be daa waai ale bori la yaase waai ale zaŋti la ale wari ya, alege ka Wen, dii nyiŋla wa ale basi ate ŋantaŋa a chim.

ref: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
text: Waai ale bori la ale waai ale zaŋti la ka bunyi, alege Wen ale tuni ba a magsi chaab ale ka ba ale tom diila.

ref: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
text: Tama meena ka baai ale gum chaab a tom a te Wen, ni abe a nye ase ka kaduk la, ate Wen a tom du, ale a nye mɛ ase yeri la ate Wen a sɛ.

ref: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
text: Ŋmante kaai ate Wen a te mi la, ate mi baga a tom ase seerɔ maŋ la, a sɛ nyubini ate nuru yoŋ a yaa sɛ nyubini zuk. Alege waai meena a kpesi wa ale a sɛ diila.

ref: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
text: Wen ale tuni waai ate wa tuimaŋa bolimu an baga a dɛ kaasi la.

ref: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
text: Alege waai tuima ate bolimu a dɛ a kaasi la a kan nya tutuna, alege bolimu a kan dɛ wa dega ate ku a nye nna ase ba vari wa bolimu po a basi la.

ref: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
text: Ni a nye ase ka dɔk ate Wen a soa la, ate wa chiika a boro la.

ref: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
text: Dila nyiŋ waai abe dan kaasi dɔk kuui ate Wen a soa la, Wen ale kaasi wa. Wen nyiini ale soa wa dɔkku, nama abe le wa dɔkku.

ref: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
text: Waai abe kan paasi wa dega, nuru a dan bo ni po a poli ayen wa ta yam tɛŋka de zuk, wa be chim beruk ate wa baga a ta yam.

ref: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
text: Dii ate tɛŋzuk demma a pai a chim yam la ka betta Wen jigi, ase ku ale ŋmarisi ayen, <<Wen a pai ka yam nyam nyeka a yik ba.>> (Job

ref: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
text: Ku ŋman pilim ŋmarisi ayen, <<Naawen a seba ayen yam nyama popolaŋa ka kiriya.>> (Yiila

ref: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
text: Pɔɔl ale Apolos ale Sifas a tom a te ka nama. Tɛŋzuk de yaase nyuvunni de yaase kum yaase yɔgyɔgla de yaase chum po, ka nama ale soa ŋade meena

ref: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
text: ate Kirisita mɛ a soa nama ate Wen mɛ a soa Kirisita.

ref: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
text: Ni meena abe a nya tama ase Kirisita tomteerɔba la, ate ti ta suik a mooli Wen wensie ŋaai ale kan jam nyini peelim la.

ref: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
text: Dii ale magsi ayen tomteerɔ a ta la ale wa ta siaka ale wa nyɔnɔwa tuima jigi.

ref: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
text: Alege mi jigi, mi niŋ ka ale ni nin a bo mi buusa yaase waai a nin bo m buusa. Mi dek an poom a bo m dek buusa.

ref: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
text: Mi dek a zɛ wa kaasuŋ kuui ate m tom, alege kula a kan sak ayen m sum zɛ. Naawen ale waai ale wa bo m buusa.

ref: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
text: Dila nyiŋ ni be kan bo waai buusa alege ate ku danni a paari. Naawen a dan jam wa ale wa bo buusaŋa, abe wa lak wa susugi ŋaai meena ale bo nuruba popola po ale ba suiniima po la a sak ate waai meena a tuesi pimpauk Wen jigi.

ref: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
text: M suata, nama nyiŋ ate mi pai m dek ale Apolos a magsi ayen ni baga a miŋ dii ate ba ŋmarisi Wen gbaŋka po la. Ni be kan pai zula a te nuru m wa ale kan pai m wa a chim jaaboa.

ref: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
text: Ka wana ale basi ate fi gaam fi chaaba? Daa Wen ale te fi jaabuuri meena ate fi ta la? Dila la, fi ale nye ka sɛ a kuulim ase fi ale ta jabuui meena la daa Wen ale te fu la?

ref: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
text: Ni be poom a deri jigsi kama a ta yegayega a dɛ? Ni poom a deri chim ka nalima alege tama? Mi a yaali ayen ni dan chim ka nalima nna ate ti dɛ naamu ale ni.

ref: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
text: Mi abe a poli kama ayen Wen a te ti ka tomteerɔba tuini ase nuru baai ate ba bo buusa a mini ba ayen ba ko ba la, ate nurubiik meena tɛŋka po ale Wen maarɔma a nya ti.

ref: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
text: Kirisita abe le soa ti la nyiŋ tama a nye ase ka betta la, alege nama a chim yam nyam Kirisita nyiŋ. Tama wobsa kama alege nama a pagra. Ba a zuli ni kama alege kan zuli tama.

ref: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de nna, kom ale nyanyuila ale kasim ta ti, ti gattaŋa a cheeri, te ka yeri a goa, nuruba a nak ti mɛ,

ref: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
text: ti abe a tom ka nna yegayega ayen ti baga a nya a dɛ. Nuruba a dan ka te ti, tama a niak ba kama. Ba dan a namsi ti ti a chiibi kama.

ref: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
text: Ba a dan biisi ti a kaasi, ti a tulisi ba ale ka wamaŋsa. Ti yaa nye ka nna se yaata la a ta jam paari yɔgyɔgla de.

ref: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
text: M kan ŋmarisi gbaŋka de ayen m pai ni nyo ka chivie po, alege ka m basi ate ni miŋ ase m dek bisa a te mu a yaali la.

ref: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
text: Ni be a dan poom a ta sinsak sagrɔba tusidi, ni ka da ko boari ya. Mi chim ka ni ko Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ m le mooli Wen wanni ate ni nya varibasika la.

ref: and I want you to be like me.
text: Mi a saalim ni, ni a nya mi nyeka a va.

ref: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
text: Kude nyiŋ ate mi a tom Timoti m biika ni jigi waai ate m mariŋ ate wa ta wensie ale Naawen la. Wa ale teeri sak ni mi nyeka ale Kirisita ale ka diila. Dila ate maa sak Kirisita bisa ale tigsi bo jigi meena la.

ref: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
text: Ni ba gela a ta ka kanjanta dii nyiŋla, ni a poli kama ayen m kan jam ni jigi ya.

ref: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
text: Dan ka Naawen yaalika m ni jam ni jigi ate m baga a seba ase ka kanjanta nyama de pagrim nyiŋ yaase ka nɔi po biik.

ref: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
text: Ba a nya Wen naamu ka nuruba nyeka po da ba biik po.

ref: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
text: M dan cheena ni jigi, m jam ale fiŋ ya m jam a sak jiirim ale yaalika?

ref: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de m wom kama ayen nipok yaalik tuima ale bo ni suŋsuŋ a bie nna yegayega ate baai ale kan daa Kirisita bisa la a kan nye. Ba weeni mu kama ayen nuru ale a goa ale wa ma ŋaaŋchoa.

ref: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
text: Dila nyiŋla ni le nye ka sɛ a ta kanjanta, ni magsi ni a kum wanni de nyiŋ kama, abe ni yeeri nuru waai ale nye wanni de choa la ni suŋsuŋ.

ref: I am with you only in my thoughts. But in the name of our Lord Jesus I have already judged this man, as though I were with you in person. So when you meet together and the power of the Lord Jesus is with you, I will be there too.
text: Ni dan tu chaab Yeezu ti Naawenni yuenni nyiŋ ate mi bo le ni chiika po, ate Yeezu ti Naawenni pagrimu a bo le ti,

ref: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
text: ni basi wa a te Sitaana a kaasi wa nyiŋka ate Yeezu ti Naawenni a dan pilim jam abe wa vari wa chiika a basi.

ref: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
text: Ni kunkuulimaŋa an nala. Ni seba ayen dabinta magadega ale a basi ate boroborok a fuusi.

ref: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
text: Ni be basi ate ti dɛ Gaambasika Tigini ale weleŋsa ale wensie, ku la a nye ase ka boroborok ate ba an pai dabinta a nyoro la. Ni kan te ti ta wabaata ale gaasa, ku la a nye ase ka boroborok ate ba pai dabinta a nyoro la.

ref: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
text: Gbaŋ kaai ate m ŋmarisi a te ni la, m weeni ayen ni kan pai nidek a gum nidoa yaalisa ale nipok yaalisa po.

ref: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
text: M kan weeni ka baai ale kan daa Kirisita bisa a chim nidoa yaalisa ale nipok yaalisa la, yaase wa a yaali nuruba ŋanta la, yaase zueba la, yaase ba a kaab bɔgta la. Ni dan kan pai nidek a gum ba po, se ni yeeri nidek tɛŋka zuk.

ref: Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members?
text: Ku da mi tuini ayen m bo baai ale kan daa Kirisita bisa la buusa. Nama magsi ni bo ka Kirisita bisaŋa buusa.

ref: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
text: Wen ale wa bo baai ale kan daa Kirisita bisa la buusa. <<Ni yeeri nuru bioku ni suŋsuŋ.>> (Teerika

ref: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
text: Ase ni waai a dan ta biik ale wa Kirisita biik choa, ku a magsi ayen ni ta cheŋ boteerɔ baai ale kan daa Kirisita bisa la jigi, alege kan basi ate Wen nuru weleŋsa a biisi biika a niagi?

ref: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
text: Ni ŋman seba kama ayen tama Kirisita bisa ale ti bo Wen maarɔma buusa. Dila nyiŋla ti baga a biisi wa fiisa a niak chaab kama.

ref: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
text: Ku magsi chivie ale ta ni kama, yam nyɔnɔ a ka ni suŋsuŋ ate Kirisita bisa a dan ta wari ale chaab abe wa yik ba a niak chaaba?

ref: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
text: Kirisita biik a kan ta wa choa a cheŋ boteerɔ baai ale kan daa Kirisita bisa la jigi ate ba a bo ba buusa.

ref: But instead, you cheat and rob other followers.
text: Alege ni goanti nye ka chaab a kaasi ale a vari chaab ŋanta.

ref: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
text: Ni be seba ayen gaasa nyam a kan maari dɛ Wen naamu. Ni be seba kude chak, ayen nidoa yaalisa ale nipok yaalisa yaase bɔgluk kaarisa yaase kaboŋ nyeerisa yaase nidoa baai ale a goa ale chaab,

ref: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
text: yaase zueba yaase butuem nyam yaase dabugrisa yaase velimvendisa yaase varidɔba. Bade waai a kan maari a dɛ Wen naamu.

ref: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
text: Ni ba gela a be jam a nye ka wieŋa de. Alege Wen a sugri ni wabaataŋa ate ni yaa chim nuru weleŋsa, ale chim wayɔrisima nyam Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa nyiŋ ale Wen Chiika nyiŋ.

ref: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
text: Nuru waai a baga a weeni kama, ayen, <<Wa baga a nye wari meena ate wa yaali la kama.>> Alege daa wari meena ale a maari. Nuru baga a weeni kama ayen mi baga a nye wari meena ate mi a yaali la kama, alege mi a kan siak ate jabuui a basi ate mi a chim wa yɔma.

ref: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
text: Nuru waai mɛ ale weeni ayen, ŋandiinta ale soa poi, ate poi mɛ a soa ŋandiinta. Alege Wen ale jam kaasi ba la meena. Ku an magsi ayen waai a pai wa nyiŋka a tom nidoa yaalik ale nipok yaalik tuima alege ka wa pai a tom a te Naawen diila Naawen ale soa nyiŋka.

ref: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
text: Wen ale basi ate Yeezu ti Naawenni a yiti kum po, wa be le basi ate tama mɛ yiti kum po ale wa pagrimu.

ref: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
text: Nama zɛ ayen ni nyiŋsaŋa ale Kirisita nyiŋka ka bunyi? Mi a kan basi ate mi nyiŋka ate Yeezu soa la ale nidoa yaalik nyiŋ a chim bunyi. Kula a kan baga a nye.

ref: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
text: Ni be sum seba ayen waai ale a goa ale nidoa yaalik la, ka bunyi ale wa. Ase wa le weeni la, <<Bala bayewa yaa chim ka bunyi.>> (Piilimka

ref: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
text: Nuru waai ale Naawen ale a chim bunyi la, ka bunyi ale Chiika.

ref: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
text: Ni basi nidoa yaalik ale nipok yaalik tuima. Wabiok meena ate nuru a tom la a ka wari a nye ale wa nyiŋka, alege nidoa yaalik ale nipok yaalik tuimaŋa, fi a tom a kaasi ka fidek nyiŋka.

ref: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
text: Ni abe seba mɛ ayen ni nyiŋsaŋa a nye ase ka yeri a te Wen Chiika la, waai ate Wen a te ate wa bo ale ni. Nama abe m soa ni dega ka Wen ale soa ni.

ref: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
text: Wen a da ni kama a tuni. Ni abe pai ni nyiŋsaŋa a tom a te Wen pimpauk.

ref: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
text: Yɔgyɔgla de mi a yaali ayen m biisi ka wie ŋaai ate ni ŋmarisi a te mu la wie. Ku nala kama ayen nidoa kan tiri nipowa.

ref: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
text: Alege nidoa yaalik ale nipok yaalik tuimaŋa yegayega ale boro la nyiŋ nuru meena a ta wadek pok, abe nipok meena a ta wadek chora.

ref: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
text: Nipowa an soa wa nyiŋka alege ka wa chorɔwa, chorɔwa mɛ an soa wa nyiŋka alege ka wa powa.

ref: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
text: Ni abe kan gaari chaaba, nin ka ni a nin nye nɔiyeŋ ayen ni gaari chaab a puusi a te Wen, alege kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ ni ŋman gum chaab ate Sitaana a kan ta nye nyaka a jam ni jigi ya, ase ni a nin kan baga a chiibi ale chaab goomoa.

ref: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
text: Mi a kan fɛ ni kama alege ka sinsaga ate mi a sak ni.

ref: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
text: Dan ka mi nyiini mi a weeni ayen ni meena a nye ase ka mi la, alege Wen a te waai meena ka tiirim, m wa wa tiirim, m wa mɛ wa tiirim.

ref: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de mi a yaali ayen weeni baai ale kan ŋman ta pooba ale baai ale kan ŋman ta chorɔba la ayen ku nala kama ale ba ale deri boro dila ase mi la.

ref: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
text: Alege waai a dan kan baga a chiibi, wa abe faari nipok yaase wa yali chora, kula ale zunchoŋ a gaam kɔrisa ale a dɛ fu.

ref: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
text: Baai ale faari ale baai ale yali la, mi ta ka sinsaga, daa mi sinsaga alege ka Naawen, ayen nipok a kan basi wa chora,

ref: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
text: alege wa abe dan basi wa chorɔwa, wa abe kan yali, yaase wa ŋmani wa chorɔwa jigi, abe nuru waai a kan yiak wa powa.

ref: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
text: M ta ka sinsaga mɛ, ŋa da Naawen sinsaga ayen m te ni, ayen Kirisita biik kaai pok a dan kan daa Kirisita biiga alege ate nipowa a siak ayen wa bo ale wa, wa kan yiak wa.

ref: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
text: Nipok waai mɛ a dan ta chora ate wa daa Kirisita biiga alege ate nidoawa a siak ayen wa bo ale wa, wa kan basi wa.
