ref: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen dela abe le Chiika, Chiika abe le a bo juijui meena la varibasika a boro kama.

ref: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
text: Tama meena abe a nyagsi kama a sak Naawen zulaŋa ale nimbidiak sii ale kan lik la, ate zula ŋala dek ale a nyini Naawen jigi la, waai ale ka Chiika la a tagri ate ti a neensi wa.

ref: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
text: Wen dii ale ta jiirim ale ti la, a lueri ti kama ayen ti a sak nuruba wieŋa de. Ti kan pai ŋaaŋ a te tuim ŋaai ate wa pai a te ti la.

ref: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
text: Tama kan suk a tom tuimbaata ate ti nya chivie. Ti kan a paasi nuruba, ale a pai tidek sinsaga a gum chaab ale Wen ale sak ti diila. Ti kasim a sak nuruba peelim niŋ wa wensieŋa ayen waai meena a siak ba suiniima po ayen ti ka Wen ŋaaŋviirɔba.

ref: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
text: Nuru boari a kan wom Wen wamaŋsaŋa ŋaai ate tama pai a sak ba la. Wen le jam nya ba kaasuŋku kama abe wa basi ate ba kan ta kiri ya.

ref: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
text: Tɛŋka de zuk wenni a lik baai ale kan ta siaka la popolaŋa kama, ate ba kan baga a nya Kirisita zulaŋa wanni ale ka bolim la, waai ale a neensi Wen la.

ref: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
text: Tama kan sak nuruba ka tidek wie. Ti a sak ba ka Yeezu Kirisita wie, waai ale ka ti Naawenni la. Wala nyiŋ ate ti chim ni tomteerɔba.

ref: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
text: Wen ale jam nye tɛŋka dila po la, wa jam weeni kama ayen, <<Basi ate legini a chim kantueŋ.>> Wa biika Kirisita a pai Wen zulaŋa a sak ti kama. Nna a nye se danni kantueŋka a nya ti suiniimaŋa po kama la.

ref: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
text: Ti a nam ka yegayega daa meena, alege ti baga a siak a te ti ninammu kama. Ti zɛ suik kuui ate ti a va la, alege dila kan daani ti.

ref: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
text: Dachaasa ale gisi ti, alege Wen a kan yaali ayen ti lo ba nisima po. Nuruba dek mɛ a nak ti kama a lɔnsi, alege ba kan ko ti.

ref: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
text: Daa meena ti kasim bo ka kum nisima po Yeezu nyiŋ, ayen ku sak nuruba ate ba seba ayen wa vuusumu buui ale bo ti suiniima po la ale a nya ti zuk.

ref: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
text: Dila nyiŋ, kum ale a tom tuima tama po, alege nyuvuri a tom tuima nama po.

ref: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
text: Ku ŋmarisi ayen, <<M jam biisi ale wen kama, dii nyiŋla, m jam ta siaka ale wa kama.>> Wen Chiika ale basi ate ti ta siaka ale wa, ayen ti a sak nuruba wa wie.

ref: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
text: Tama seba ayen Wa waai ale nak Yeezu ti Naawenni kum po a yiti la, ale nak tama mɛ a yiti kum po ase Yeezu la, abe wa basi ate tama ale nama a tigsi chaab a zaani wa niŋ.

ref: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
text: Ti a nam nna ka Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma nyiŋ. Wen ŋmanteka abe le a paari nuruba yegayega la ba puusi a te wa zula ale jiam.

ref: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
text: Wieŋa de nyiŋ ale soa ate ti kan jɔk nyiŋbiiri. Ti nyiŋsaŋa a boro a kpaŋ kama, alege daa meena Wen a gum wa nyuvuri dii ate wa pai a te ti la kama.

ref: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
text: Ti niŋ ka ale tɛŋzuk de ŋan baai le kan a beni la. Ti niŋ bo ka ŋan baai ate Wen le pai te ti dai yeŋ la. Ŋantaŋa dɛ a le kasim boro kama taam wuu.

ref: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
text: Ti nyiŋsaŋa a nye ase ka viita ate nuruba a ti zaani la. Ti dan jam kaasi, Wen le pai ti kama a ta cheŋ wenŋmazuk a ga te ti nyiŋpaalisa sii ate wadek a nye la. Ti le ta nyiŋsaŋa de kama taam wuu.

ref: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de tama a kum ale a yaali ka nna yegayega ayen Wen pai ti a ta cheŋ wenŋmazuk a ga te ti nyiŋpaalisa dula.

ref: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
text: Wa dan nye dila, ti chiisaŋa a kan jɔk nyiŋsa.

ref: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de nyiŋ sii ale a nye se viita la, ale basi ate ti a nya ninammu. Ti kan yaali ayen ti basi ti yɔgyɔgla de nyiŋsaŋa nwuli, alege ti kasim a yaali kama ayen Wen le pai nyiŋ paalisaŋa a te ti ate ti zaani si naŋkula po. Wa dan nye dila, yɔgyɔgla de nyiŋsaŋa le si jam kpi la, ale si chim wa nyiŋ paalisaŋa la. Si ta ka nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.

ref: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
text: Wen ale nye ti ayen ti tuesi wa nyiŋ paalisaŋa. Wa pai wa Chiika a te ti kama ayen Chiika a liŋ chim wa tutuna ŋaai ate wa le tuni ti la, ate ku sak ayen wa le sum tuni ti kama.

ref: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
text: Dila ti ta nyiŋbiiri kama ale seba ayen ti le diem vua yɔgyɔgla la, ti diem yalima kama ale wenŋmazuk yenni.

ref: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
text: Ti boro ka siaka nyiŋ alege daa ti ale a nya diila nyiŋŋa.

ref: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
text: Mi a weeni ayen, ti ta nyiŋbiiri kama ayen ti dan yalima ale ti nyiŋsaŋa de ale bo yeri ale Naawen a zunchoŋ kama.

ref: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
text: Ti dan bo dula yaase ti moata wenŋmazuk, ku a fɛ kama ayen ti nina muni ate ti a nye ate Wen sui a peenti.

ref: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
text: Ti dan kpi, ti meena le cheŋ ga zaani ka Kirisita niŋ ate wa bo ti buusa. Ti le tom tuimaŋsa a yaa se tuimbaata ale ti yɔgyɔgla de nyiŋsaŋa la, wa le tuni ti kama ŋa nyiŋ.

ref: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
text: Ti le a chali ti Naawenni la nyiŋ, ale soa ate mi a yaali ayen m sak ni ayen ti a tom Wen tuimaŋa ale ka wensie. Wadek seba ayen ti a tom wa tuimaŋa ale ka wensie. M seba ayen nama mɛ le nye ka dila.

ref: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
text: Ti an ŋman a yaali ka yuei a te ti dega. Ti a te ni ka suik ayen ni ta kanjanta tama nyiŋ, ate ni baga a biisi sak baai ale a nya nuruba peelim tuima alege kan nya ba suiniima po la.

ref: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
text: Ti daa biisi nna, ni ba gela a poli ayen ti a yesiŋ kama yaa? Ti daa yesiŋ kama, ti a yaali ayen ti a te zula ka Wen di nyiŋ. Ni ba gela a poli ayen ti ta nyiŋyɔgsa? Ti dan ta nyiŋyɔgsa, ku ka nama nyiŋ.

ref: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
text: Kirisita mariŋ ti ka nna yegayega. Tama seba ayen wa zaani ka nuru meena naŋkula po a kpi ba nyiŋ. Wa le mariŋ ti dila la nyiŋ, ale soa ate ti nina muni ale wa tuimaŋa tomka.

ref: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
text: Wa kpi ka dila, ayen baai ale ta wa nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la a kan ŋman va badek yaalika, alege ba le va ka waai ale kpi ale ge yiti kum po bala nyiŋla.

ref: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
text: Dila ale soa ate tama an ŋman a bo nuruba buusa a se tɛŋzuk nuruma la. Ti jam a bo Kirisita buusa ka dila, alege yɔgyɔgla de, ti an ŋman a bo wa buusa.

ref: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
text: Nuruba a dan tagri ba popola a va Kirisita, Wen a tagri ba popolaŋa kama ale ge a nye ba ate ba chim nuru paalisa. Ba popola kpagsaŋa a ŋman karo diipo, diipo.

ref: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
text: Wen nye wieŋa de meena a te ka tama. Kirisita kummu nyiŋ ale soa ate Wen a ŋman a yaali ayen wa nye nɔiyeŋ ale tama. Wen ŋman a yaali kama ayen ti a weeni wa wie a sak nuruba, ate wa ale bala mɛ a ŋman nye nɔiyeŋ.

ref: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
text: Kirisita kummu nyiŋ ale soa ate Wen a nya suik a basi ayen wa ale nuru meena a ŋman nye nɔiyeŋ, ate wa kan ŋman a teeri ba tuimbaataŋa. Wa wamaŋsaŋa de ate wa pai a nyo tama nisima po ayen ti a sak nuruba.

ref: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
text: Kirisita ale tom tama ni jigi, ayen Wen baga a biisi wie a sak ni. Ti a saalim ni kama Kirisita nyiŋ, ayen nama ale Wen a nye nɔiyeŋ a nueri.

ref: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
text: Wen a nye kama ayen waai ale kan seba biem la a chim biem tama nyiŋ, ate wa nyiŋ ti baga a chim Wen wayɔrisimaŋa.

ref: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
text: Tama ale maari chaab a tom Wen tuimaŋa ale a saalim ni ayen ni pai Wen ale maari ni diila a tom tuima a te wa,

ref: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
text: diila wa weeni ayen, <<Diipo ale magsi m tuesi ni la m wom ni kama. Varibasika danni m maari ni kama.>> (Azaya

ref: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
text: Ti kan yaali ayen waai a nya ti tuimaŋa kaasuŋŋoa ate ti a kpesi tidek ayen ti kan nye wari ate ku kaasi nuruba suita.

ref: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
text: Ti tuimaŋa meena a kasim a sak nuruba kama ayen ti ka Wen tomteerɔba. Ba a nye kama ate ti a nam nna yegayega, alege ti siaka a te ti ninam kama ale chichiiba.

ref: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
text: Ti ka weleŋsa nyam, ti be seba Wen nalimnyiini ale ta chichiiba mɛ ale nuruba, ale ge seba tidek yikka, ti be ta Wen Chiika ti suiniima po kama, ti be ta yaalika nalimnyiini ale ti vaanchaab,

ref: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
text: ale maari a sak nuruba ale Wen pagrimu wa wensie wieŋa. Wieŋa de meena a sak nuruba kama ayen ti ka wa tomteerɔba. Ti ta ka weleŋsa ase kpaliŋ jaab la ayen ti baga a kpaliŋ vari tidek a basi.

ref: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
text: Nuruba a te ti zula ale a basi ate ti a nya chivie. Ba a pak ti kama ale ge a le ti mɛ. Ti a biisi ka wensie ale ge ba a weeni ayen ti ka velimvendisa.

ref: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
text: Ti daa nuru kpienta alege waai meena seba ti noa po kama. Ti a nye se ka kpieba la, alege ti ta nyuvuri kama. Ba a nye kama ate ti a nya ninam, alege ba an diem ko ti.

ref: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
text: Ti sue kasim kaasi kama, ale ge ŋa peenti kama yegayega. Tama ka ŋanjaksa ale ge ti a maari nuruba ate ba a jigsi. Nuruba a poli kama ayen tama ka jaab jaaboa, alege, tama dek seba ayen ti soa ka ŋanta meena.

ref: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
text: Yɔgyɔgla de ti a yaali ayen ti biisi ale ni kama ase ni ka ti bisa la. Ni sak ase ni a yaali ti kama mɛ ase tama ale a yaali ni diila. Nama mɛ lak ni suiniima a te tama mɛ.

ref: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
text: Nama ale baai ale kan ta siaka ale Naawen la, ni kan a tigsi chaab a tom tuima ale ba. Tuimbaata ale tuimaŋsa kan gum chaaba. Legi ale kantueŋ mɛ a kan gum chaaba.

ref: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
text: Kirisita ale Belial a baga a nye nɔiyeŋŋa? Nuru baai ale ta siaka ale Wen la, ale nuru baai ale kan ta siaka ale wa la, a baga a nye nɔiyeŋŋa?

ref: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
text: Tama ka Wen dii ale boro la yeri. Ti be dan ka dila, tama ale bɔgta ale nye ka sɛ boro ale chaaba? Ase Wen ale weeni ayen, <<Mi ale m nuruma ale boro ka dila a ta a cheŋ, ale ge ate m chim ba Naawen ate ba mɛ a chim m nuruba.>> (Kaabka

ref: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
text: Naawen be ŋman weeni ayen, <<Ni poori nidek a ta nyini baai ale a kaab bɔgta la po, ate ni kan maa tiri ba ŋanta. Ni daa nye dila, mi dek ale tuesi ni. (Azaya

ref: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
text: M le chim ni ko, ale ge ate nama mɛ chim m bisa. Mi, Naawen, waai ale soa ŋanta meena pagrim la, ale a weeni nna.>>

ref: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
text: M dek doaba, wieŋa de ka Wen pumpuulima ate wa jam puulim ale ti. Ni basi ate ti yeeri tidek wie ŋaai ale a basi ate ti a chim nuru daŋtisa la, abe ti chim nuru weleŋsa a te Wen zula.

ref: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
text: Ni lak ni suiniimaŋa a te ti. Ti an jam nye ate waai a tom kaasi ya. Ti be an jam yaali degaamka yaase ti jam paasi nuru waai ya.

ref: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
text: Ti kan weeni nna a sak ni ayen ka ti nya ni kaasuŋŋoa. Ti poom weeni a sak ni ti ni a yaali ni nna yegayega la. Ti dan poom kpi a yaase ti vua, ti le diem ta ni ka ti suiniima po.

ref: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
text: Ti ta siaka ale ni ka nna yegayega dii nyiŋla ti ta kanjanta kama ni nyiŋ. Ni a deŋsi ka ti kpa ti ninammu po, ate ti sue a peenti daa meena.

ref: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
text: Ti le jam paari Masidoniya tɛŋka la, ti an jam nya vuusum. Jigi meena ate ti jam cheŋ la, ti kasim jam a nya ka daanika ale kpaliŋsa ale kpazinagsuk.

ref: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
text: Alege Wen dii ale a te nyiŋbiiri baai ale a nam la, ale jam tom Titus la ayen wa jam deŋsi ti kpa.

ref: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
text: Ti sue a jam peenti kama ale ti le jam nya wa ale wom wa wapaalaŋa ale ni le jam deŋsi wa kpai diila. Wa weeni ti ayen ni a yaali ayen ni nya ti ka nna yegayega. Wa weeni sak ti mɛ ayen ni sue a kaasi kama, ale ku le jam daani ni diila. Wa weeni sak ti mɛ ni niŋ ale bo le ti diila. Kude basi kama ate m sui a ŋmasi peenti nna yegayega.

ref: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
text: M le liŋ jam ŋmarisi gbaŋ kaai a te ni la, ni sue a jam kaasi ka nna yegayega, alege m le jam wom ayen ni sue a jam kaasi beni la, dila a ŋman jam peenti m sui kama.

ref: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de mi sui ale peenti la, daa m le nye ate ni sue kaasi la nyiŋ ŋa alege ka ni sueŋa kaasika ale basi ate ni tagri ni nyeka la. Wen dek abe le pai ni sueŋa kaasika a tagri ni. Dila la mi an kaasi wari ya.

ref: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
text: Sui kaasuŋ kuui ale ka Wen yaalika la a ta ka tagri kaai ale a te varibasika ate fi kan ŋma fi dega, alege tɛŋzuk de sui kaasuŋku a ta ka kum a jam.

ref: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
text: Ni le basi ate Wen a kaasi ni sue la nyiŋ ale soa ate ni a yaali ayen ni sak ayen dii meena ate ni a nye la ka wamaŋsa. Ni sue abe kasim a puuri kama alege ate ku cha ni nna yegayega ate ni kasim a yaali ayen wie a nye a magsi. Ni chiib a sak kama ayen wanni de ni nye magsi kama.

ref: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
text: Ti an jam ŋmarisi gbaŋka ayen ti le ka waai ale tom wabiokku la, yaase waai ate wa nye wa kaasi la. Ti jam ŋmarisi kama mɛ ayen Wen sak ni le diem ta yaalika ale tama diila.

ref: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
text: Ni te ti nyiŋbiiri ka nna yegayega ale weeni ti ni le te wa nyiŋbiiri diila, ti sue a jam peenti kama a gaam ŋa le poom liŋ peenti diila.

ref: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
text: Titus ale jam basi dula ayen wa cheena nama jigi la, ti jam weeni kama ayen ti ta ka kanjanta ni nyiŋ. Nin jam basi ate ti nya chivie. Ti kasim jam a biisi ka wensie wie ale ni. Ti le jam weeni Titus dii mɛ la, a jam ka wensie.

ref: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
text: Wa a teeri ka ni le jam tuesi wa dii ale jam pai nidek a te wa ale ge gomsi nidek ayen ni va wa nɔi la. Yɔgyɔgla de wa a yaali ni kama dila nyiŋ a gum du.

ref: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
text: M sui peenti ka nalimnyiini ate m ta siaka ale ni nna.

ref: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
text: M suata, ti a yaali ayen ka ni seba Wen ale ŋmante baai ale bo Masidoniya tɛŋka po a va Yeezu la.

ref: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
text: Ba jam nya ninam yegayega, alege ninammu dɛ po, ba sue diem peenti kama nalimnyiini. Ba ka ŋanjaksa nalimnyiini alege ba pai ka ba ŋan fiisaŋa gela a te nuruba.

ref: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
text: Mi ka ba seerɔ. Ba jam pai ba ŋantaŋa a te ka ba vaanchaab a poom gaam ku le magsi dii te ka la. Ba jam te ale ka badek yaalika.

ref: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
text: Ba jam saalim ti kama ayen ti tuesi ba tiiritaŋa ate ti baga maari Wen nuruma ale bo niŋniŋ la.

ref: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
text: Ba tiiritaŋa a jam zuak gaam tama le jam a poli diila kama. Ba liŋ jam pai ka badek a te ti Naawenni ale ge pai badek a te tama mɛ a va Wen ale a yaali diila.

ref: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
text: Ni be jigsi kama ale ŋan baai meena ate ni ta la. Bala le ni siaka ale ni ale seba biik la, ale ni ale ta yam la, ale ni ale a maari nuruba la, ale ni ale a yaali tama diila. Ti a yaali kama ayen ni a te yegayega.

ref: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
text: Diila ni seba ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ŋmanteka kama, ayen wa jam jigsi kama, alege nama nyiŋ wa chim jajak, ate nama ale va wa jaŋsaŋa nyiŋ a jigsi.

ref: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
text: Ni tom dii ate ni piilim ayen ni tom la a nueri. Ni jam piilim di ale ka nin muni. Ni be diem basi ate ni nina muni ate ni tom ni le baga dii a tom la a nueri.

ref: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
text: M kan yaali ayen m nye ate ku toa, yaase m nye mɛ ate ku chim mɔli a te baai ate ni a maari la.

ref: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
text: Yɔgyɔgla de, ni ta ka ŋan bori. Dila ale soa ate ku nala ayen ni pai ni ŋantaŋa ba gela a maari baai ale a yaali ba la. Ba dan ta ŋanta piisi ate nama mɛ a yaali, ba le maari ni kama. Ku dan nye nna, ni ni ta soa ase chaab la.

ref: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
text: Ase ku ale ŋmarisi ayen, <<Nuru waai ale tigsi yegayega la an ŋmasi nya gaam taam ya, nuru waai me ale tigsi magi dek la an ŋmasi jɔk ya.>> (Nyinika

ref: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
text: Ti a pak Naawen ayen Titus a jam pii ka nyiŋ ayen wa maari ni ase tama ale jam pii nyiŋ dii ayen ti maari ni la.

ref: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
text: Ti a tom ka ti suoku wanyi ayen wa va wa a jam ni jigi. Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma meena a te ti suoku ka zula yegayega, dii nyiŋla, wa sak nuruba yegayega Naawen wamaŋsaŋa.

ref: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
text: Ba lueri wa kama ayen wa ale tama a pai ni tiiritaŋa a ta cheŋ ga te Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma baai ale bo Judia la. Nna le te ti Naawenni ka zula, ate ku sak nuruba ayen ti a yaali ayen ti maari ba kama.

ref: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
text: Ti kan yaali ayen ti nye wari ate waai a fɔbili ayen tama an pai tiirimu a nye wamaŋa.

ref: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
text: Ti a yaali ayen ti nye ka wari dii ale magsi ti Naawenni ale nuruba niŋ la.

ref: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
text: Ti a tom ka nuru wa choa, a saari baye ate ba jam ni jigi. Wa va ale Titus ale ti suok kunkula a cheŋ. Ti nye wa nya kama dii choa ate ti yaa seba ayen wa pii ka nyiŋ a yaali ayen wa maa maari ti ale ti tuimaŋa. Wa seba ayen m seba ni chak kama nalimnyiini. Dila ale soa ate wa pii nyiŋ a yaali ayen wa gum mbala po a jam maa maari ni nalimnyiini.

ref: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
text: Titus ka waai ale a tom ale mi ate mi ale wa a maari nama meena. Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab jiga tɔgatɔga la ale tom mbala bayewa. Ba be a te Kirisita ka zula.

ref: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
text: Ku an magsi m ŋman ŋmarisi gbaŋ a te ni a weeni ni le ni a maari Wen nuruma diila.

ref: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
text: M seba ni ale a yaali ayen ni maari ba diila. M weeni Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma ale bo Masidoniya tɛŋka po la, ayen ba suataŋa nama baai ale bo Akaaya tɛŋka po la, a piilim ba cheesika ka diimwa. Ba le jam wom ale ni pii nyiŋ a yaali nna nyeka la, ba gela mɛ a maa chaab a cheesi.

ref: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de, mi a tom ti suataŋa dɛ ni jigi kama ayen ti kunkuulimaŋa a kan chim kinla. Alege ba ale ba jamka ale ni gomsi ayen ni maari.

ref: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
text: Mi ale Masidoniya demma gela a dan jam nya ale nin nye wari ya, ti le ta siaka ale ni diila ale tagri chim ka chivie. Nama mɛ le nya ka chivie nna yegayega.

ref: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
text: Mi abe poli kama ayen ku magsi ka ti suataŋa de mi niŋ a jam ni jigi a tuesi tiirim buui ate ni puulim la. M dan ga jam ale ni gomsi magsi ate ku sak ayen ba an fɛ ni kama alege ka nidek yaalika.

ref: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
text: Nama meena seba ayen kpaarɔ a dan bori maga, wa a che ka maga, alege wa dan bori yegayega wa a che ka yegayega.

ref: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
text: Waai meena a te a magsi chaab ale wadek popola. Wa kan te wa tiirimu ase ku ka fifiok ayen wa te la. Wa be kan te abe wa ŋman pilim a ŋma wa dega. Wen a yaali ka baai ale a te ale suipeentik la.

ref: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
text: Ni daa a nye dila, Wen le ŋman te ni kama a gum du ate ku zuak gaam ate ni kasim ta yegayega nidek a be ni a te nuruba mɛ.

ref: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
text: Wen ale a pai ŋanbieŋa a te kpaarɔma ayen ba bori ŋa ate ba nya ŋandiinta. Dila dekdega ate wa le pai wa ŋantaŋa a te ni a gum du ate ni baga a maari ni vaanchaab.

ref: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
text: Wa kasim a yaali kama ayen ni pai ni ŋanbɔnni po ate wa te ni la a maari ni vaanchaab. Nama a dan pai ni tiiritaŋa a te baai ale a yaali ni la, ba le pak Wen kama nama nyiŋ.

ref: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
text: Ni a maari ba kama ba ninam yegayega po ale ge ate ba mɛ, a te Wen pimpauk yegayega.

ref: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
text: Ni daa a maari nna yegayega, ni a sak nuruba ayen nama a va ka Wen wamaŋsaŋa ŋaai ale a biisi Kirisita wie nalimnyiini la. Ba le te Wen zula yegayega, dii nyiŋla, ni a maari ba kama ale nuru meena yegayega.

ref: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
text: Ba le ta yaalika ale ni abe ba puusi Wen a te ni dii nyiŋla wa ŋmanteka yegayega ate wa pai sak ni la.

ref: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
text: Ni ba gela a weeni chaab kama ayen mi dan bo ale ni m seba m dek yik kama, alege m dan yalima ale ni, mi a ŋmarisi ka wa pagrisa a te ni. Kirisita a yaali kama ayen m seba m dek yik ka ale ni. Dila ale soa ate mi, Pɔɔl, a saalim ni yɔgyɔgla ayen,

ref: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
text: M dan jam ni jigi, ni kan ni fɛ mu ayen mi a biisi ka wa pagrisa a sak ni. M dan jam tu chaab ale baai ale a weeni ayen ti a va ka tidek ŋan yaalik la, m le biisi ka wa pagrisa a sak ba.

ref: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
text: Ŋan baai ate tama a pai a nye ti kpaliŋka la daa tɛŋzuk ŋanta alege ka Wen ale a te ŋanta bala, bala abe le wa pagrimu ate ti pai a kaasi ŋan pagrisa meena.

ref: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
text: Ti pai kama a kaasi nanpaga ale kanjanta nyeka meena ale a kasi nuruba ate ba kan seba Wen la. Alege a yik ba popolaŋa ate ba a zuli Kirisita.

ref: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
text: Ni ba gela a nya ka ti nimbidaasa po nyiini, alege kan nya ti suiniima po. Ni ba gela a poli ayen ka Kirisita ale soa ni? Ni be maari a poli ayen wa soa tama mɛ ase ka wa le soa nama mɛ diila.

ref: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
text: Ti Naawen ale pai wa pagrimu a te ti ayen ti a maari ni abe ti kan a te ni waalika. Ti dan poom ta kanjanta kude nyiŋ chivie a kan yik ti.

ref: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
text: Nuru waai ale weeni ayen m dan yalima ale ni m gbaŋsaŋa a sueri ale ka wa pagrisa alege m dan bo ale ni m ka wari ya m abe kan biisi wa pagrisa.

ref: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
text: Nuru baai ale a weeni nna la, mi a yaali kama ayen ba seba ayen m dan jam ni jigi, m le pai ka m gbaŋsaŋa po wa pagrisaŋa a biisi sak ni.

ref: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
text: Tama kan pai tidek a magsi chaab ale baai ale a poli ayen ba ka nuru kpienta la. Nuruma de ka betta. Ba dueni ka badek sinsaga a yaa pai badek a magsi chaab ale ba sinsaŋŋa alege pai ŋa a bo badek buusa.

ref: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
text: Tama kunkuulimaŋa a kan ŋmasi gaam a taamu. Ti a kuulim ka Wen ale te ti tuim ŋaai ayen ti tom la nyiŋ. Kude be maa gum ka nama ale nya varibasika ti tuimaŋa nyiŋla.

ref: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
text: Ti be kan kuulim gaam a taam diila ti poom biisi Kirisita wie a sak ni kama.

ref: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
text: Tama kan kuulim nuruba tuima nyiŋŋa ase ka tama ale tom la. Alege tama yiilaŋa ale, ni le ta siaka ale wa ate nama ale tama tuimaŋa a piisi a gum du.

ref: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
text: Nama meena dan a va dila, tama ale nama le baga a tu chaab a mooli sak satɛŋ sii ale moata nama la Wen wamaŋsaŋa. Ti dan nye dila, waai a kan baga weeni ayen ti a yaali kama ayen ti nya nyuenta nuruba tuima nyiŋŋa.

ref: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
text: Ni dan poom weeni ayen nama ka nuru maŋsa ku ka kiri ya, ka Naawen a nin weeni ayen ni ka nuru maŋsa.

ref: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
text: Mi a yaali ni ka nna yegayega ase Wen ale a yaali ni diila. Ni a nye se ka nipokbili ale kan diem seba nidoa la ate m puulim ayen m pai wa a te nuru yeŋ nyiini, wala abe le Kirisita.

ref: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de mi a chali ka yɔgsum waamu ale paasi yik ni popola ase wa le jam paasi Iiv diila, a chali yɔgsum mɛ ni ale tagri ni popolaŋa a basi Kirisita va ka la.

ref: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
text: Diila waai a dan jam ni jigi a mooli Yeezu yoŋ wie alege daa Yeezu waai wie ate tama mooli la, yaase ni tuesi chiik yoŋ alege daa kaai ate nama tuesi la, yaase wapaali yoŋ alege daa wa dii ate nama siak la, ni deri siak nna chaalima la an magsi ya.

ref: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
text: Ni a poli kama ayen sagrɔma de a gaam mi kama. Mi be kan siak a te ni.

ref: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
text: Ku ka wensie ayen mi an baga a biisi nalimnyiini nuruba niŋa, alege m kan kpeeri yam. Daa meena mi a nye kama ate ku sak ni ayen nya kude ka wensie.

ref: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
text: Dai yeŋ po ate mi ligra a yaa nueri, alege mi an jam bek ni ayen ni maari mu. M suataŋa baai ale bo Masidoniya tɛŋka po la, a jam pai ŋan baai meena ate mi jam a yaali la, a ta jam te mu. M jam kpesi ka m dek ayen m kan jam a yaali ayen ni a nya m zuwa. Ku le chim ka nna chum diipo mɛ.

ref: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
text: Mi a weeni ni ka wensie, dii nyiŋla Kirisita a bo ka m suinum po. Baai meena ale bo Akaaya la, le wom ayen daa nama ale a nya mi zuwa.

ref: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
text: Nama a poli ayen m kan yaali ni kama ale soa ate m yaa nye nna ya? Wen seba ayen mi a yaali ni ka nna yegayega.

ref: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
text: M kan tagri m ni a nye dii nna la, ate sagrɔma de a nya suik a weeni ayen ba tuimaŋa ale tama tuimaŋa ka bunyi.

ref: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
text: Ba daa Wen wensie tuimtomdɔba. Ba ka velimvendisa, dii nyiŋla ba a paasi ni kama ayen ba sinsaŋŋa ale tama sinsaŋŋa ka bunyi. Ba tagri ka badek ayen ni poli ayen Kirisita ale tom ba ni jigi.

ref: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
text: Sitaana mɛ a baga a tagri wadek kama, ate nuruba poli ayen wa ka Wen maarɔma baai ale a nyaksi la wanyi.

ref: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
text: Sitaana a be dan baga a nye dila, kun toa ate wa tomteerɔma a tagri badega, ate ni a poli ayen ba ka Wen tomteerɔba. Wen a dan jam ayen wa bo ba buusa, wa le nya ba kaasuŋku kama abe wa basi ate ba kan ta kiri ya.

ref: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
text: M poom ŋmarisi a weeni ayen ni ba gela a poli kama ayen yam ka m biika po. M be ŋman diem a saalim ni kama ayen ni ta chichiiba ale mu. Yɔgyɔgla de, ni basi ate mi mɛ a yaali yuei maga a te m dek.

ref: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
text: Ti Naawen an jam sak ti ayen ti a yaali yuei a te ti dega. Ka betta nyiini ale a nye dila.

ref: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
text: Ni a poli kama ayen ni ta ka yam nna yegayega, alege ni kan beni ale a wom betta sinsaŋŋa de.

ref: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
text: Ni basi kama ate nuruma de a nye ni se yɔm la, ale a nye a dɛ ale a zu ni ale a fɔbi ni.

ref: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
text: Mi a chali chivie kama ale m le weeni ayen ti wobsa ale dila nyeka. Ba daa kuulim mi mɛ baga a kuulim kama alege ku la ka betta.

ref: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
text: Ba ka Juuba? Mi mɛ ka Juu. Ba ka Izirali demma? Mi mɛ ka Izirali denɔ. Ba ka Abrayam ŋaaŋbisa? Mi mɛ ka ba po wanyi.

ref: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
text: Ba a weeni nama kama ayen ba ka Kirisita Tomteerɔba? Ni le poli kama ayen mi a yesim kama, alege mi a yaali ayen m weeni ni kama ayen mi ka wa tomteerɔ nalimnyiini a gaam ba meena. Mi tom tuima ka nna yegayega a te wa. Nuruba a jam yik mi a lik ate ku paari ka dii choa, ale pai fiŋsa a miiri mu. M be jam tali ka maga ate m kpi. M gaam ba kama yegayega ale wieŋa de meena.

ref: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
text: Nuruba mɛ a jam pai doa a nak mu ka buta. Nuruba mɛ a jam pai tintana a yuk mu. Ba jam nye nna ka bunyi. M be jam jo ŋaaruŋta po mɛ ate viok kpioŋ jam fuk a yaa chiak ti a ta jueli pina zuima ate ŋaaruŋtaŋa a yaa kaasi. Nya kude a saari ka buta. Dan di dai, ate mi jam wari nyakpiemu po yok ale kantueŋ meena.

ref: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
text: M jam tom ka nna yegayega a ga gaam taam, ale ge jam basi m goom mɛ ate ku paari diichoa. Nyanyuila ale kom a jam yik mu mɛ. M be jam ka gatta mɛ a piisi ya. Daa meena m jam ka vuusum jigiya m be ka ŋandiinta mɛ.

ref: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
text: Waai a dan ka a va wa nalimnyiini, ku a daani mu kama. Waai a daa tom tuimbaata, m sui ale kasim a kaasi ale nuru bala chaab.

ref: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
text: Mi dan poom a kuulim, mi a kuulim ka wie ŋaai ale a sak ayen mi wobsa la nyiŋ.

ref: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
text: Wen dii ale ka ti Naawenni Yeezu Ko la, a seba kama ayen m daa velimvendika. Ni basi ate ti a te wa pimpauk taam wuu.

ref: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
text: Ku magsi ka m le kuulim alege kunkuulimaŋa ka maarika. Alege m le weeni Naawen ale pai wie ŋaai meena a sak mu la.

ref: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
text: M dan jam ni jigi ku yaa nye ka m naŋtuok nɔi buta. M dan jam tu ni, m kan yaali ayen ni pai jaab a te mu. Mi a yaali ka nidek daa ni ligra. Ni a nye se ka m bisa la. Bimbaansa kan nya ba nyam zuwa, alege ka ba nyama ale a nya ba zuk.

ref: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
text: Wa ale jam ga jo dula la, wa jam wom ka wie, ŋaai ale chim wakperikaliisa ate wa an baga a weeni.

ref: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
text: Ku magsi ka m ti a kuulim nuruwa de nyiŋ, alege daa m dek nyiŋŋa. M din bola a yaali kama ayen m weeni m le wobsa diila.

ref: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
text: M dan weeni ni le ka diila, ni kan ni a weeni ayen yam ka m ni a biisi diila po. Mi a weeni ni ka wensie. M kan yaali ayen nuruba seba ayen m ka nuru kpioŋ a gaam ba, dii nyiŋla Wen ale nye dii a te mu la. Mi a yaali kama ayen ba bo mi buusa m tuimaŋa ale wieŋa nyiŋ.

ref: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
text: Wen an jam a yaali ayen m ta kanjanta wa le basi ate m wom bi kperikaliika la nyiŋŋa. Dila ale soa ate wa yaa pai tuem a te mu ate m nyiŋka a kasim a dom daa meena. Ku a nye ase ka Sitaana ale a nak mu la.

ref: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
text: Mi jam saalim ti Naawenni ka buta wanni de nyiŋ ayen wa nye ate tuemu basi mu.

ref: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
text: Alege wa weeni mu ayen, <<Mi ŋmanteka ale a magsi fu. Diipo ate fi wobsa la, mi pagrimu zuak kama nna yegayega a bo fi jigi.>> Dila la mi sui peenti kama ale m nin ta kanjanta m wobsimu nyiŋ. Dila nyiŋ m seba kama ayen Kirisita pagrimu a lik mu kama.

ref: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
text: Dila ale soa ate Kirisita nyiŋ, mi mariŋ wobsim kama ale leeta ale ninam ale namsika ale wapagra. Diipo ate mi wobsa la dila po ale mi pagra.

ref: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
text: Ni daani mu kama dila ale soa ate mi a ŋmarisi nna ase m ka beruk la a te ni. Ka boan nyiŋ ate ni ba gela a kan te mu zula? M dek pagrimu ka pagrim kayiok, alege m kan va sagrɔma de baai ale a velim ate ni a poli ayen ba ka tuimtomdɔba a gaam mi la.

ref: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
text: M le jam bo dula ale ni la, ni jam ka chichama a se mi ka Wen wensie tuimtomdɔ. Wa jam a maari mu kama ate mi a tom tuimkperikaliisa nna yegayega ale chichiiba a te ni.

ref: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
text: Mi nye ni kaasi kama alege an nye Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab a bo jigi ŋa chaab la, kaasi ya. M dan poom nye wari ka m le kan weeni ayen ni maari mu la. Ku be dan ka dila ni vɔŋ a te mu.

ref: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
text: M gomsi kama ale suipeentik ayen m kaasi jabuui meena ate m ta la ale m dek mɛ meena ate m baga a maari ni. Mi a yaali nama kama, alege nama a kan yaali mi.

ref: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
text: Nama dek seba chak kama ayen diipo ate m jam bo ale ni la, mi an nya nama ayen ni Maari mu. Nuru waai ale weeni ayen mi a velim kama ale a paasi ni.

ref: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
text: M vari ka ni ŋanta ale m ni tom baai ni jigi la.

ref: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
text: M jam saalim Titus kama ayen wa jam ni jigi. Wa le jam siak la, m jam tom ka wala ale ti suoku wanyi ni jigi. Titus jam vari ni ŋanta kama? Nama zɛ ayen Titus ale mi suiniimaŋa ale a poli diila ka bunyi?

ref: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
text: Nama a poli kama ayen tama a yaali ka yuei gbaŋka de po? Dila daa wensie Wen ale soa ti ate ti ŋmarisi wie ŋaai ate Kirisita a jam pai a te ti la. M dek doaba, ti tuimaŋa meena le maari ni kama.

ref: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
text: Mi a poli kama ayen m dan jam ni jigi, ni kan ni a nye dii ate mi a yaali ayen ni a nye la. Nama mɛ a kan yaali mi ale a nye diila. Mi a poli kama ayen ni ale kasim a nak ka nanpaga ale chaab ale a dɛ nyuri ale chaab ale a ta sui ale chaab, ale a ta butuem, ale a lɛ chaab ale a bobri ale a ta kanjanta ale a zɛri ni kpaŋŋa noa.

ref: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
text: Mi a poli kama ayen m dan jam ni jigi, Wen le basi ate m yik m dek ni niŋ. M sui le kaasi kama, dii nyiŋla ni yegayega a kan yaali ayen ni basi ni kaboŋsa tuimaŋa ale ni nipok yaalik ale nidoa yaalik tuimaŋa, ale ni tuim daŋtisaŋa yegayega.

ref: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
text: M yaa cheena ni jigi nna a nyeka buta. <<Fi dan a yaali ayen fi biisi gaam nuru waai, ku a fɛ kama ayen fi ta nuruba baye yaase nuruba bata ate ba chim fi seerɔba.>> (Teerika

ref: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
text: Diipo ate m jam ni jigi a nye buyewa la, m jam kaam nama baai ale a tom tuimbaata la kama. Alege yɔgyɔgla de ate m yalima ale ni la, m diem a kaam ni kama ale waai meena mɛ. M boro a gomsi kama ayen m jam te ni waalika yegayega.

ref: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
text: M dan jam ni jigi ni le seba nalimnyiini ayen Kirisita a va mi nyiŋ biisi a te ni. Dila la m dan jam te ni waalika ni ale seba ayen mi an wobsa alege ka Kirisita ale a sak wa pagrimu ni suŋsuŋ.

ref: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
text: Ba le jam yik wa a kpi jabarimu nyiŋ ayen wa kpi la, wa jam ka pagrim. Alege yɔgyɔgla de wa ŋman vua kama, dii nyiŋla Wen pagrimu nyiŋ ate wa nak wa a yiti kum po. Tama ale wa ale ka bunyi la nyiŋ ate ti wobsa, alege tama ale nama ale ka bunyi la ti le maa chaab a nya pagrim buui ale basi ate wa vua la.

ref: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
text: Ni a nye nidek a nya ase ni ta siaka ale Yeezu Kirisita nalimnyiini ya. Nama seba ayen wa bo ka ni suiniimaŋa po, ni be dan kan ta wa ni suiniima po ni be an tagri ya.

ref: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
text: Mi seba kama, ayen nama mɛ dek seba kama ayen wa bo ti suiniimaŋa po.

ref: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
text: Ti a puusi a te ka Wen ayen ni ka a tom dii ale kan nala la, daa ti sak ayen ti baga wamaŋsa kasim a nye alege ni a tom a magsi ase tama a nin poom nye wie a kpeeri.

ref: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
text: Ti kan baga a nye wari a kaasi Wen wensieŋa alege ti a nye a magsi chaab ale ka wa wensieŋa.

ref: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
text: Nama a dan poom pagra alege tama a wobsa, ti sue peenti kama dila nyiŋ. Ti be a puusi kama ayen ni chiib za ale pagrim.

ref: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
text: M ni kan bo ale ni la ale soa ate m ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ni ayen ni tagri, ate m dan jam abe m kan te ni waalika ale Naawen pagrimu ate wa a te mu la. Wa pai pagrimu de a te mu kama ayen m maari ni daa ayen m kaasi ni.

ref: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
text: Ti suata, yɔgyɔgla de, ti a yaali ayen ti ŋmarisi ti gbaŋka a kpeglim ka dela. M weeni ni kama ayen ni gomsi wie ŋaai ale kan yɔrisi la a magsi. Ni ta nɔiyeŋ ale chaab, abe ni boro ale suiyɔgni. Wen dii ale a yaali ni la ale a basi ate ni a boro ale suiyɔgni la, le maari ni ate ni nye wieŋa de.

ref: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
text: Ni a puusi chaab nalimnyiini a te ti.

ref: From the apostle Paul and from all the Lord's followers with me. I was chosen to be an apostle by Jesus Christ and by God the Father, who raised him from death. No mere human chose or appointed me to this work. To the churches in Galatia:
text: Mi ale m Kirisita bisa sua tii meena ale bo dela la a maa chaab a puusi Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab tɔgatɔga a bo Galatia po la.

ref: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Ti Kowa Wen ale Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa le ŋmante ni abe ba te ni suiyɔgni.

ref: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
text: Yeezu Kirisita a jam va ka ti Kowa Wen yaalika a yaa kpi tama nyiŋ ayen wa vari ti tɛŋka biemu po a basi.

ref: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
text: Ni basi ate ti a te Wen dii ale ta zula yegayega la taam wuu, pimpauk dila nyiŋ. Ku be nye dila.

ref: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
text: Nuruba ba gela tagri Wen wamaŋsaŋa ŋaai ale a biisi Kirisita wie la kama ale ge a kasim a daani ni. Ni basi ate m sum weeni a sak ni ayen Wen sinsaŋŋa ka bunyi nyiini, wamaŋsaŋa de chaab a ŋman ka jigiya.

ref: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
text: Ku daam dan poom ka Wen maarɔma ale nyini wenŋmazuk a siŋ, yaase tama dek daam dan poom jam sak ni tuntomiŋ kaai ale kan a nye ase Wen wamaŋsaŋa ate tama a liŋ jam sak ni la, waai a dan nye dila, Wen le waali kula nyɔnɔwa kama.

ref: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
text: M poom liŋ weeni ni nya kude kama. Yɔgyɔgla de m le weeni ni ayen waai a dan sak ni wie ŋaai ale kan a nye ase Wen wamaŋsaŋa ate nama a jam wom ale siak ayen ka wensie la, Wen le waali kula nyɔnɔwa kama.

ref: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
text: Nama a poli ayen mi a yaali ayen m nye ate ka nuruba te mu pimpaukwa? Aaya, mi a yaali ayen m peenti ka Wen nyiini sui. M daam dan a yaali ayen m peenti ka nuruba sue, m te kan baga chim Kirisita tomteerɔ.

ref: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
text: M suata, mi a yaali ayen m weeni sak ni kama ayen Naawen wamaŋsaŋa ate m liŋ jam sak ni la, ŋa an nyini daa nurubiik jigi ya.

ref: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
text: M be an tuesi ŋa daa nuru jigi ya, ka Kirisita dek ale jam a pai ŋa a sak mu.

ref: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
text: Nama dek seba ayen diipo, ate mi jam va Juuma suiku la, m jam te Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma waalika ka nna yegayega. M jam ka jiirim ale ba. M jam a yaali kama ayen m kaasi ba meena.

ref: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
text: Mi jam va Juuma suiku nalimnyiini kama a poom gaam m vaanchaama. Mi nina jam muni ka nna yegayega me ayen m va ti kokpieŋsaŋa suiku.

ref: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
text: wa yaa basi ayen m seba wa biika Yeezu, ate mi a sak baai ale kan daa Juuba la wa wamaŋsaŋa. Mi an jam bek daa waai ya ayen kula nyɔnɔwa sak mu m le m nye diila,

ref: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
text: m be an jam cheŋ Jerusalem tɛŋka mɛ ayen m ga baai ale liŋ chim tuimtomdɔba ale ge mi la jigi ya. Alege mi deri jam cheŋ ka Arabia tɛŋka alege yaa pilim ŋmani Damasikus tɛŋka.

ref: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
text: Bena ŋata ale taam la, ate m yaa jam cheŋ Jerusalem ayen m nya Sifas. M jam goa ale wa ka da pi ale ŋanu.

ref: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
text: Wie ŋaai meena ate mi ŋmarisi nyo gbaŋka de po la, ka wensie. Wen seba m kan velim.

ref: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
text: Mi ale jam basi Jerusalem la, m jam nyiem gilim Siriya ale Silisiya tɛŋsaŋa ka meena.

ref: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
text: Dila powa, Judia Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la a diem jam zɛ mi.

ref: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
text: Naawen dek ale jam weeni sak mu ayen m cheŋ dula. Tama ale Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma ale jam bo dula la, kpaŋŋa nyiini ale jam tu chaab ate mi weeni sak ba m le sak baai ale kan daa Juuba la Wen wamaŋsaŋa. M jam kan yaali ayen ba poli ayen tuim ŋaai ate m jam a tom a te Wen la ka tuim kayaata.

ref: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
text: Titus waai ale jam maa va mi la, a jam ka Girik denɔ, alege ba an fɛ wa ayen wa gebi wa yɔni ate ku sak ayen wa sum ka Juu.

ref: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
text: Nuruba ba gela baai ale jam a weeni ayen ba ka Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔba la, a jam a yaali kama ayen wa gebi wa yɔni, alege ba jam a velim kama ayen ba ka Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔba. Ba jam suk kama a maa jo tama po ayen ba nya ti le ti nye dii a ta nɔiyeŋ ale Yeezu ate ti chim bunyi la. Ba jam a yaali kama ayen ba nye ate tama chim ase yɔm la.

ref: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
text: Alege tama ale jam a yaali ayen ti nye ate Wen wamaŋsaŋa wensieŋa a boro a te ni la, ti an jam bola siak a te ba ale fiik fiik mɛ la.

ref: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
text: Alege kpaŋŋa de nya kama ale Wen pai tuini de a te mi ayen mi a sak nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la wa wamaŋsaŋa, ase wa ale basi ate Piita a sak Juuma wamaŋsaŋa de la.

ref: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
text: Dii nyiŋla, Wen jam pai wa pagrimu a te mi kama ayen m chim wa tuimtomdɔ a sak nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la ase wa ale basi ate Piita mɛ a sak baai ale ka Juuba la.

ref: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
text: Jeemsi ale Sifas ale Jɔɔn baai ate mi jam a poli ayen bala ale kpaŋŋa la, a jam miŋ kama ayen ka Wen ale pai tuini de a te mi. Dila nyiŋ, ba yaa jam diak Banabas ale mi nisima ayen ku sak ayen ti meena a tom ka tuin yeŋka. Ti meena yaa jam siak ayen Banabas ale mi a maa chaab boro ale nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la a tom ti tuimaŋa abe ba mɛ bo ale Juuma a tom ale ba mɛ.

ref: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
text: Ba yaa jam weeni wari dii ate mi potim a yaali ayen m nye la, ayen ti a teeri ŋanjaksaŋa ale maa boro ale ba Jerusalem tɛŋka la.

ref: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
text: Wensie, tama dek potim ka Juuba. Ti daa baai ale kan daa Juuba ate ba a wi ba ayen wabanyeerisa la.

ref: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
text: Ase mi a dan weeni ayen sinsaŋŋa a kan basi ate ti a chim wayɔrisima nyama, ka boa ale soa ate mi ŋman a va Sinsaŋŋa. Mi a dan nye dila mi a nye a kaasi ka Sinsaŋŋa.

ref: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
text: Dila abe ale soa ate mi dek an ŋman vua m dek nyiŋla. Nyuvuri dii ate mi ta tɛŋzuk de yɔgyɔgla la, ka Kirisita vummu ale bo m po. M vua kama dii nyiŋla, m ta siaka ale Wen Nidoabinni waai ale ta yaalika ale mi a yaa jɔk wa nyuvunni mi nyiŋla kama.

ref: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
text: M zɛri kama ayen mi kan ŋman a weeni ayen mi kan yaali Wen ŋmanteka. Alege waai a dan poli ayen ka sinsaŋŋa nyiŋ ale soa ate wa chim wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ, dila a sak kama ayen Kirisita kpi ka kinla nyiŋ.

ref: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
text: Nama Galatia demma ka betta. Ka wana ale pai wa pagrim a te nama ayen ni basi Wen suiku vaka? Tama an nyini peelim a sak ni Yeezu Kirisita ale kpi wa jabarimu nyiŋ diila? Nama be an jam siak kama ayen ti wieŋa ka wensie?

ref: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
text: Dila nyiŋ, ku a fɛ kama ayen ni miŋ chak baai ale ta siaka ale Naawen la, bala ale sum ka Abrayam ŋaaŋbisa.

ref: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
text: Ba jam ŋmarisi Wen Gbaŋka po ayen, chum diipo ku le jam chim ka nuruba siaka ale wa nyiŋ ale ku basi ate Naawen nya baai ale kan daa Juuba la ayen ba ka wayɔrisima nyam. Gbaŋka de po ba ŋman pilim ŋmarisi ayen Naawen jam weeni Abrayam ayen, <<Ka fi nyiŋ ate m le niak nurubiik meena ale bo tɛŋzuk de la.>> (Piilimka

ref: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
text: Dila nyiŋla, ase Abrayam ale jam ta siaka dii a nya niaka la, suik kula po mɛ, Wen a niak waai meena ale ta siaka ale wa la kama ase Abrayam la.

ref: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de ti yaa seba kama ayen nuru karo a kasim va sinsaŋŋa a chim wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ Wen jigi dii nyiŋla, ku ŋmarisi ayen, <<Wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa a vuuk kama wa siaka nyiŋ.>> (Yabakkuk

ref: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
text: Kirisita a da tuesi ti sinsaŋŋa kikaasa po a basi kama a yaa chim kikaasa a te tama, diila ku ŋmarisi ayen, <<Kikaasa a bo waai meena zuk ate ba yik a kpi tiib nyiŋla.>> (Teerika

ref: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
text: Yeezu Kirisita be nye dila kama ayen baai ale kan daa Juuba la a maa nya niak kaai ate Naawen puulim ayen wa le nye te Abrayam la ayen ti siaka nyiŋ ti le nya Wen Chiika ate Wen puulim ayen wa le te la.

ref: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
text: Suik kula po, ku be ka dila ale Wen ale jam nye nɔiyeŋ kaai ale Abrayam la. Dila po wa Wen jam nye ka pumpuulima ale Abrayam ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa. Wen Gbaŋka be kan weeni a sak ti kama ayen Wen nye puulimka de a magsi chaab ale ka ŋaaŋbiik boari ya. Ku ka ŋaaŋbiyeŋ. Bi yeŋka de abe ale Kirisita.

ref: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
text: Ku daam dan ka Sinsaŋŋa nyiŋ ale soa ate Wen te Abrayam tiirim bula, ku yaa be te sak kama ayen ŋman daa wa ale puulim la nyiŋ ale soa ate wa nye dila a te wa. Alege ku ale ka diila tama seba chak kama ayen, ku ka Wen pumpuulimaŋa ate wa jam puulim ale Abrayam la nyiŋ ale soa ate Wen lak poi te wa tiirimu.

ref: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
text: Ku be dan ka dila, Sinsaŋŋa kiri abe le boa? Sinsaŋŋa a gumdu kama ayen ŋa sak wakaasima ale ka diila, abe ŋa boro a ta ga paari diipo ate Abrayam ŋaaŋbiika ale jam la. Be ka ŋaaŋbiik kala ate Wen nye pumpuulimaŋa a te la. Wen jam pai sinsaŋŋa a nyo ka wa maarɔma nisima po ayen nuru a yaa be chim Wen ale nurubiik sanyigmoa.

ref: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
text: Alege ku an poom magsi ayen sanyigmoa bo ti suŋsuŋŋa dii nyiŋla, yigma a bo ka nuruba baye suŋsuŋ alege ka nuru yeŋ ale boro, Wen ka wanyi dekki.

ref: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
text: Dila nyiŋla, Sinsaŋŋa ale jam soa ti a ga paari diipo ate Yeezu jam la, ayen siaka ale wa ale ku basi ate tama yaa chim wayɔrisima nyam Wen jigi.

ref: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
text: Yɔgyɔgla ate ti ta siaka ale Yeezu Kirisita la, sinsaŋŋa an ŋman soa ti.

ref: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de ate nama tuesi soka la, nama ale Yeezu Kirisita ka bunyi. Dila nyiŋ, ni yaa be a nye ase Yeezu Kirisita ale ka diila.

ref: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
text: Dila nyiŋla, fi ka Juu yoo, fi daa Juu yoo, ni daa tɔgatɔga. Fi ka yɔma yoo fi daa yɔma yoo, ni daa tɔgatɔga. Fi ka nidoa yoo, fi ka nipok yoo, ni meena ka bunyi. Dii nyiŋla, nama meena ka bunyi ale Yeezu Kirisita.

ref: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
text: Yeezu Kirisita abe dan soa ni, ni be ka Abrayam ŋaaŋbisa. Ni be le nya Wen ale puulim ayen wa te Abrayam jabuui la kama.

ref: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
text: Diipo ate biika diem ka biik la, wa kowa ale a nya ka zuk, a tom wa wie a te wa, ate ku ga paari diipo ate wa kowa a yaali la.

ref: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
text: Ku be ka dila tama mɛ jigi. Ti jam ka chichirik pagri sii ale soa tɛŋka a nya la yɔm, alege ate ti jam pagra ale Yeezu Kirisita.

ref: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
text: Alege dai dii danni ate Wen dek dak ate di jam la, wa yaa tom wa Nidoabili yeŋka ayen wa jam tɛŋzuk de. Nipok ale jam biak wa. Wa be va Sinsak ŋaai meena ate Wen jam pai te Juuma la kama nalimnyiini.

ref: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
text: Dii ale a sak ayen ni ka wa bisa la ale, Wen basi kama ate wa Biika Chiika jo ti suiniima po. Chiika de abe ale basi ate ti wanyi wanyi kaari a wi Wen ayen, <<M dek koa!>>

ref: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
text: Dila nyiŋla, fi ŋman daa yɔma, fi ka Wen biik. Fi be ale ka wa biik la, Wen le pai jaabuuri meena ate wa tara ayen wa pai te wa nidoabinni la a te fu kama.

ref: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
text: Diipo ate ni diem jam zɛ Wen la, ni jam ka bɔgluk tii ale kan ta pagrim ase wen la yɔm.

ref: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
text: M suata, mi a saalim ni kama ayen, ni a nye ase mi la, ase mi ale a nye ase nama diila. Ni an nye mu wari a kaasi ya.

ref: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
text: Ni baga a teeri diipo ate m liŋ jam sak ni Wen wieŋa la? Dii nyiŋ ate m jam a goa ale ni la ale dipo m jam ka nyiŋyɔgsa.

ref: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
text: Alege m baga a weeni kama ayen, m nyiŋtuilaŋa jam daani ni kama alege, ni jam tagri mi zuk kama a nya ninam m tuemu nyiŋ. Ni an jam zɛri mu yaase ni pai mu chim nuru kayiokwa. Alege ni tuesi mu kama nalimnyiini ase ni tuesi ka Wen maarɔ la. Wensie, ni tuesi mi nna ase ni tuesi ka Yeezu Kirisita dek la.

ref: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
text: Ni sue jam peenti ka nna yegayega mi nyiŋ. Alege ka boa ale ŋman nye? Mi dek a baga a weeni kama ayen ku dan poom siak a nye kama ni ti yeeri ni ninaŋa a te mu kama.

ref: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
text: Mi ale weeni ni wensieŋa la, ku basi kama ate mi yaa chim ni dachiaga?

ref: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
text: Nuru bala chaab ale a sak ni la a nye ni jigi ase ba a yaali ni kama la, alege popola ŋaai ate ba ta magsi chaab ale ni la, ka popola baata. Dii meena ate ba a yaali ayen ba nye la ale, ba poori mi ale nama tɔgatɔga, ate ku basi ate mi ta ba popola nalimnyiini ase ba ale ta nama popola nalimnyiini diila.

ref: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
text: M dan baga kama ate m boro ale ni ate m seba m le nye ni diila. M bola zɛ m le m weeni ni ka diila.

ref: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
text: Ba ŋmarisi Wen Gbaŋka po ayen, Abrayam jam ta ka nidoabilisa baye. Wa jam biak wanyiwa ale ka wa powa Saara yɔma wa. A biak wanyi wa mɛ ale Saara. Wala jam daa yɔma. Nipok yɔmawa yue jam ale Aga.

ref: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
text: Aga jam biak wa biika kama alege ku an jam va daa Wen ale puulim ale Abrayam diila. Saara jam biak wa biika a ta va ka Wen ale jam puulim dii ale Abrayam la.

ref: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
text: Wanni de abe a sak ti ka wakpienni dii ale ka wensie. Di kiri ale, nipooma de Aga ale Saara a ta ka nɔiyeŋsa buye ate Wen jam nye. Nipok yɔmawa Aga tagri ka nɔiyeŋ kaai ate Naawen jam nye ale Moosis Sinai guuku zuk la. Ni teeri ayen nipowa de bisaŋa meena ka yɔm.

ref: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
text: Alege Jerusalem waai ale bo wenŋmazuk la, a daa yɔma. Wa ka ti ma.

ref: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
text: Dii nyiŋla, ku ŋmarisi ayen, <<Nipowa, fi waai ale kan maa biak la, basi ate fi poi peenti. Fi waai ale kan maa biak biik nam nya la, kaari ale popeentik ate ku jueli wen, dii nyiŋla, nipok waai ate wa chorɔwa jam zɛri la, wala le nya bisa nna yegayega a gaam nipok waai ale boro ale wa chorɔwa la.>> (Azaya

ref: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
text: Dila powa, Aga ale jam biak wa biika alege ka jam daa Wen pumpuulima biik la, biika jam a namsi bi kinkala waai ate ka mawa va Wen Chiika pagrimu nyiŋ yaa biak ka la kama. Ku be din diem ka dila ale jinla me.

ref: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
text: Ase ba ale ŋmarisi Wen Gbaŋka po ayen, <<Yiak nipok yɔmawa de ale wa nidoabinni ate ba nyini. Dii nyiŋla, nipok yɔmawa biika a kan nya ka kowa jaab jaaboa. Ka nipok waai ale kan daa yɔma la nidoabinni le ka nya ŋanta.>> (Piilimka

ref: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
text: Dila nyiŋ, m suata, nya kude a sak kama ayen, ti daa nipok yɔmawa bisa. Ti ka nipok waai ale kan daa yɔma la bisa.

ref: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
text: Ni soa ka nidek yɔgla. Dii nyiŋla, Kirisita yeeri ti kama a ta nyini yɔmma po a nyini. Dila nyiŋ ni be ŋmasi yik nidek ate ni kan ŋman chim yɔmba.

ref: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
text: Nama baai ale a poli ayen Wen pai ni chim wayɔrisima nyam ni ale a va sinsak ŋaai ate wa pai te Juuma la, ni seba ayen, ni a zɛri ka Kirisita dila. Wamaŋ kaai ate Kirisita nye te ni la, abe ŋman daa wamaŋ a te ni.

ref: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
text: Ase waai ale Yeezu Kirisita a dan chim bunyi, kula nyɔnɔwa gebi yoari yaa wa an gebiya, ba daa tɔgatɔga ale chaaba. Ba ka bunyi. Wari dii nyiini ale ka wamaŋ la ale ti ta siaka ale Kirisita kama ale ta yaalika ale chaab mɛ ate ku sum a sak ayen ti ta yaalika ale Kirisita kama.

ref: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
text: Ku daa Wen dii ale wi ni ayen ni chim wa nuruba la ale nye dila.

ref: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
text: Alege tama ale ti Naawenni ale ka bunyi la, m ta siaka kama nalimnyiini ayen ni popolaŋa ale mi popolaŋa ka bunyi. M be seba chak kama mɛ ayen baai ale a daani ni la, Wen le te ba waalika kama.

ref: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
text: Mi a yaali kama ayen baai ale a daani la, ba dan poom a yaali ba yeeri ba kolaŋa.

ref: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
text: M suata, Wen wi ni kama ayen ni kan ŋman chim Moosis Sinsaŋŋa yɔmma. Ni be ale ŋman kan daa yɔm la, ku a fɛ ayen ni kan poli ayen ni nye wari dii meena ate ni a yaali la. Ni basi ate yaalika bo ni suŋsuŋ ate ni a tom a te chaab.

ref: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, sinsaŋŋa meena a gum chaab ka Sinsak yeŋ. Sinsak yeŋka de ale, <<Yaali fi vaanchoa ase fi ale a yaali fidek diila.>> (Kaabka

ref: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
text: Alege ni daa nye chaab ase ni ka gɔi duŋsa la, a kpaliŋ chaab a te chaab tueta, ni kpesi ate ni kan kaasi chaab meena.

ref: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
text: Wen Chiika abe dan dɛ ni niŋ wie meena po, ku a sak se sinsaŋŋa ŋman karo a soa ni la.

ref: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
text: bɔgta kaabka ale sampoporinni tuima ale kisi chaab tuima ale kpaliŋsa ale nyuri dɛka ale suipuurum ale degaamka ale poori chaab ale nyanueriŋ ale

ref: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
text: ninŋmaarima ale daam bukka ale kanjanta ale wieŋa chaab meena. Mi a yaali ayen m ŋman kaam ni kama ase m le poom liŋ kaam ni diila, baai meena ale a tom nyaŋa de chaab la a kan maa nya Wen Naamu.

ref: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
text: zaab m dek ale yik m dek. Sinsaga karo a weeni ayen nuru kan nye wieŋa de.

ref: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
text: Be ka Wen Chiika ale te ti nyuvuri. Ni be basi ate wa soa ti ale wie meena wuu ate ti a nye la.

ref: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
text: Ni kan basi ate ti ta kanjanta, abe ti a nye ate chaab sue a puuri yaase ti a yaali chaab ŋanta.

ref: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
text: Ni a ji chaab jibta, ate suiku de po ni nye Kirisita sinsaŋŋa ale a weeni diila.

ref: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
text: Nuru waai a dan poli ayen wa ka nuru dek alege wa daa jaaboa, kula nyɔnɔwa a paasi ka wadek.

ref: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
text: Ni basi ate ni wanyi wanyi a magsi wadek tuima a nya. Ŋa dan nala wa basi ate wa sui peenti ale wadek ale a nye diila. Alege ku kan sak kama ayen wa tom gaam ka wa choa.

ref: We each must carry our own load.
text: Basi ate waai meena ji wadek jib.

ref: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
text: Ni kan a paasi ni dega dii nyiŋla, nuru karo a baga a nye Wen a la. Nuru ale a bori jabuui la wa a che ka wala.

ref: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
text: Waai abe ale nye wari wadek nyiŋka po masim nyiini nyiŋla, dila tutunaŋa ale kum. Alege waai ale a nye wari Wen Chiika nyiŋ la, wa le nya ka nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka ate Wen Chiika a te la.

ref: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
text: Dila nyiŋla ni kan basi ate jianta yik ni ale wamaŋsa tomka. Ti dan kan jiaya, a ta cheena ku kpeglimka po ti le nya dii le di nye la.

ref: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
text: Ni nya mi dek ŋmarisika ale soa dii nna kpienta kpienta ate m ŋmarisi ale m dek nisa la.

ref: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
text: Nuru baai ale kasim a fɛ ayen ni gebi ni yoaŋa la ale nuru baai ale a yaali ayen ba a nak kuusa ba peelim tuima nyiŋla. Ba a nye dila kama ayen nuruba kan nya suik a te ba waalika ba ale a sak nuruba ayen Kirisita kpi jabarimu nyiŋla.

ref: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
