text: Alege mi, togni ka wari ate m le nak kuusidi di nyiŋŋa, alege ka kum buui ate ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita kpi jabarimu nyiŋla nyiini ate mi le nak kuusidi. Wa kummu de mɛ nyiŋ ate tɛŋzuk de ŋantaŋa a ŋman ka kiri te mi. Ku a nye ase ba maa pai ba kpi ka jabarimu nyiŋ ale Yeezu Kirisita la. Mi me dek jigi ku a nye se mi maa kpi ka jabarimu nyiŋ ale tɛŋzuk de ŋantaŋa la.

ref: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
text: Nuru gebi wa yoari yoo, wa an gebi yoo. Ku daa wari ya. Wamaŋka meena ale, Wen ale nye ate ti chim nuru paalisa la.

ref: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
text: Baai meena ale va nyuvuri paalika de wieŋa la, bala baai mɛ ale ka Wen wensie nuruba la Wen ta jiirim ale ba abe ba boro ale suiyɔgni.

ref: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
text: Dii ate mi a yaali ayen m weeni kpeglim la ale, m kan yaali ayen waai a ŋman daani mu, dii nyiŋla, laŋ tii ale doa m nyiŋka la a sak kama ayen mi ka Yeezu tomteerɔ.

ref: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
text: M suata, mi a saalim kama ayen ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita le ŋmante ni meena. Ku be nye dila.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
text: Mi Pɔɔl waai ate Wen va wadek yaalika a lueri mu ayen m chim Yeezu Kirisita tuimtomdɔ la ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te nama baai ale bo Efisos la. Nama mɛ a va Yeezu Kirisita ka nalimnyiini.

ref: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
text: Ti Kowa Wen ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita le ŋmante ni abe ba te ni suiyɔgni.

ref: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
text: Pimpauk a cheŋ ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita Kowa Wen jigi, waai ale niak ti ale Chiika po niauŋ meena wenŋmazukku po Kirisita nyiŋ la.

ref: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
text: Wa liŋ lueri ti a te wadek kama, tama ale Yeezu Kirisita ale ka bunyi la, yaa alege nye tɛŋzuk meena, ayen ti chim nuru weleŋsa baai ale kan ŋman ta kaasuŋ Wen nimbie po la.

ref: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
text: Ni basi ate ti a te wa pimpauk, wa ale ŋmante ti nna yegayega la nyiŋ, ale pai wadek bi yeŋka a te ti tiirim la nyiŋ.

ref: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
text: Wa le jam a poli diila meena a dan jam nueri, wa le cheesi ŋan baai meena ate wa nye ate ba bo wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk de la, nyo jigi yeŋ, ate Kirisita yaa chim ba meena naab,

ref: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
text: Ni basi ate tama baai ale liŋ ta yiila Yeezu Kirisita jigi la, a pak Wen dii ale ta zula la nna yegayega.

ref: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
text: Ase nuruba ale jam boro a sak ni Wen wamaŋsaŋa ŋaai ale ta wensie la, wieŋa, ni wom ba sinsaŋŋa kama ate Wen yaa vari ni ni wabaataŋa po a basi ate ni yaa ta siaka ale Kirisita. Ka dila nyiŋ ale soa ate Wen a pai wa Chiika ate wa puulim ayen wa te ni la a te ni ate ku sak ayen wa soa ni kama.

ref: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
text: Ti be ale ta Wen Chiika la nyiŋ ale soa ate ti seba chak ayen ti nya Wen ale jam liŋ puulim ayen wa le nye dii te ti la, wa le sum nye kama. Ti ŋman seba mɛ kama ayen Wen le da tuesi ti ate ti soa tidek meena. Ni be basi ate ti te wa pimpauk.

ref: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
text: Dila nyiŋla, M wom nama ale ta siaka ale ti Naawenni Yeezu ale ni ale ta yaalika ale Wen nuruma meena diila kama.

ref: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
text: Mi kasim a te ka Wen jiam ale a puusi a te ni,

ref: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
text: ayen wa waai ale ka ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita Ko a ta zula nna yegayega la, a pai wa Chiika a te ni ate wa te ni yam abe wa pai Wen a sak ni, ate ni baga a seba wa nalimnyiini.

ref: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
text: M be ŋman a puusi a te wa kama ayen wa basi ate ni popola a lagri ate ni nya wa bolimu ate ni nya wa ale wi ni ayen ni ta yiili ŋaai la abe ni seba ayen ŋan baai ate wa puulim ayen wa pai te wa nuruma la a zuak kama nna yegayega.

ref: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
text: M be ŋman a puusi a te wa kama ayen ni seba wa pagrimu yegayega ate wa pai te tama baai ale ta siaka ale wa la. Pagrimu de ale pagrim kpioŋku,

ref: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
text: ate wa pai nak Kirisita kum po a yiti ale basi wa ate wa jueli a kali wa juga nisa geŋ wenŋmazuk po la.

ref: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
text: Kirisita bo ka dula jigini yɔgyɔgla de a nya wenŋmazuk chichirik pagrisaŋa ale jaabuuri meena ale ta pagrim ale bo wenŋmazuk po ale tɛŋzuk de meena ale tɛŋ kaai meena ale bo ŋaaŋ cheena la zuk.

ref: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
text: Wen pai jaabuuri meena nyo ka Kirisitawa nisima po. Wa ŋman pai mɛ a te ka Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la meena ayen wa chim ba wie meena niŋdeerɔ kpioŋ.

ref: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
text: Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la meena a nye se ka wa nyiŋka la, wa be kasim sueri nyiŋka de po kama ase wa ale kasim sueri tɛŋzuk de meena diila.

ref: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
text: Dila powa, ni kasim jam va ka tɛŋzuk de meena demma wabaataŋa suiku ale chichirik baataŋa naawa. Wala ale soa tɛŋzuk de demma baai ale kan a zuli Wen la meena zuk a nya ba.

ref: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
text: sak si Wen jam nya ti ka nna se kpieba la ti ale kan a zuli Wen la nyiŋ. Alege wa jam vari ti ti wabaataŋa po a basi kama ale nak ti kum po a yiti ase wa le jam nak Kirisita yiti kum po la. Nya kude be ka Wen ŋmanteka nyiŋ ate ti nya varibasika.

ref: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
text: Wa nak Yeezu Kirisita a yiti kum po kama ayen wa ŋman pilim jueli wenŋmazukku po. Ku a nye se tama ale wa a poom a deri kala ale chaab kama dula jigini la, dii nyiŋla tama ale wa ka bunyi.

ref: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
text: Wen ŋmanteka nyiŋ ale soa ate ni nya varibasika ni siaka nyiŋ, daa ni dek nyiŋŋa, ka Wen tiirimu nyiŋ.

ref: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
text: Ku daa tuima nyiŋŋa ate waai baga a kuulimu.

ref: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
text: Wen abe ale nye ate ti chim ti ale ka dii yɔgyɔgla de la. Tama ale Yeezu Kirisita abe ale ka bunyi la, wa nye kama ayen ti a tom tuimaŋsa a te wa. Wa be poom gomsi tuimaŋa de a magsi kama a te ti.

ref: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
text: Dila powa, ni jam zɛ Yeezu Kirisita wie. Ni jam ka nicham, dii nyiŋla, ni jam maa daa nuru baai ate Wen lueri te wadek la po. Ba an jam a maara a chiini nama a nyo baai ale Wen ale nye nɔiyeŋka pumpuulimaŋa ale chaab la po. Ase nama ale jam boro diila, ni jam zɛ Wen ya. Ni be jam ka yiila wa jigi mɛ.

ref: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de, nama baai ale jam kan moata wa la, yaa moata wa kama Kirisita kummu nyiŋ.

ref: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
text: Wa yaa ŋman yik Sinsak ŋaai ate Wen a te ba la mɛ a tagri, ayen wa baga nye ate Juuma ale baai ale kan daa Juuba la a chim bunyi a te wadek. Wa dan nye dila, ba kan ŋman ta dachaani ale chaaba, ba le boro ale ka suiyɔgni.

ref: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
text: Kirisita ale jam kpi jabarimu nyiŋla, wa jam tigsi ba kama, a ta jam jigi yeŋ a basi ate ba ale Wen a yaa ta nɔiyeŋ ale chaab. Dila basi kama mɛ ate ba dachaani ale chaab a ŋman karo.

ref: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
text: Dila nyiŋla, nama baai ale kan daa Juuba la, ni ŋman daa nicham, dii nyiŋla nama ale Wen nuruma a yaa tigsi ka chaab a chim bunyi Wen jigi.

ref: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
text: Be ka Kirisita ale yik yenni meena a tara nna giŋgiŋ a yaa nye a te di a chim Wen puusika yeri weleŋ a te ti Naawenni.

ref: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
text: Wen Chiika ale basi ate nama a gum baai ale Yeezu Kirisita ale ka bunyi la po ayen ni meena a chim yeri dii ate Wen ayen wa boro la.

ref: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
text: Ni seba kama ayen ka Wen ŋmanteka nyiŋ ale soa ate wa pai tuini de a nyo mi nisima po ayen di maari ni. Ku a fɛ ate ni seba.

ref: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
text: Wen a liŋ pai ka wa le jam a poli diila a suk, alege yaa ŋman pai di a sak mi. Mi be poom a liŋ ŋmarisi nya kude kama a te ni.

ref: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
text: Nama be dan ŋman karim gbaŋ kaai ate mi ŋmarisi a te ni la, ni le baga a miŋ dii ale soa ate mi seba Kirisita wie ŋaai ale suk la, kiri kama.

ref: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
text: Ni basi ate m sak ni ŋa kiri. Baai ale kan daa Juuba la a dan ta siaka ale Wen wamaŋsaŋa, bala ale Juuma ale maa chaab chari tiirim buui ate Wen a pɛ ayen wa le te Juuma la. Baai ale kan daa Juuba la ale Yeezu Kirisita ka bunyi. Dila nyiŋla, ba le nya ŋan baai meena ate Wen pɛ ayen wa le te baai ale ta siaka ale Yeezu Kirisita la.

ref: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
text: Mi jigi ku a nye se mi ka wa nuruma meena po baaŋ la, alege wa lueri mi kama ayen m ga sak baai ale kan daa Juuba la wa wamaŋsaŋa wie. Wen wamaŋsaŋa a sak ti ka Kirisita wamaŋsaŋa yegayega ŋaai ale kan ta kpeglimka la wie.

ref: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
text: Wen be ŋman lueri mi kama ayen mi a sak nuru meena wa wasusugni suiku ale a va diila. Wa le jam piilim nye jaabuuri meena la, wa liŋ jam pai ŋa suk kama dipo meena.

ref: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
text: Wen nye nya kude a ta va ka wa ale poli diila. Be ka ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ ale soa ate wa nya wa popolaŋa de kiri.

ref: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
text: Dila nyiŋla, ti ta siaka ale Yeezu kama, tama ale wa ale ka bunyi la, ti ta popo pagrim kama a baga cheŋ ga a zaani Wen niŋ.

ref: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
text: Mi bo dela jigini a nam ka nama nyiŋ, alege m kan yaali ayen ni suiniima kaasi dila nyiŋŋa. Mi ninammu de le basi ate ni nya ku nyuenta.

ref: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
text: Ŋanta meena ale bo wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk de la ka wala ale a te ba yue.

ref: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
text: Ate Kirisita jam bo ŋa po dii nyiŋla ni ta siaka ale wa kama. Wa pagrimu a dan bo ni suiniimaŋa po nalimnyiini, nama le ta yaalika ale wa abe ni ta yaalika mɛ ale chaab a gum du,

ref: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
text: ate nama ale Wen nuruma baga seba Kirisita ale a yaali ti dii nna yegayega la.

ref: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
text: Mi a yaali kama ayen ni sum seba Kirisita ale a yaali ti diila. Ti an baga a miŋ wa yaalika kiri a nueri meena, alege mi a yaali kama ayen wa yaalika a sueri ni meena, ate ni jam chim nuru maŋsa ase Wen dek ale ka diila.

ref: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
text: Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la ale Yeezu Kirisita waai ale ka ba niŋdeerɔ la, le kasim a te Wen zula diipo meena wuu. Ku be nye dila.

ref: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
text: Mi waai ate ba yik mu a lik ti Naawenni ŋaaŋ vaka nyiŋla, ale a saalim ni ayen ni a va wa a magsi dii ale magsi ayen ni a va wa la. Wen ale wi ni ayen ni a va wa dila.

ref: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
text: Wen Chiika ale basi ate ni ta nɔiyeŋ ale chaab, ale ŋman basi ate ni boro ale suiyɔgni ale chaab mɛ. Ni nyiem be kasim pii nyiŋ ate ni a nye dila ale chaab.

ref: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
text: Wen Chiika ka kanyi dekki. Baai meena mɛ ale ta siaka ale Yeezu la ka nuru yeŋ. Wen be lueri ni kama me ayen ni ta yiila wa jigi, yiila ŋaai ale chim yiili yena la.

ref: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
text: Wen, waai ale ka wanyi dekki la, ka nurubiik meena Ko. Wa be ka waai meena Wen. Wa bo ale waai meena kama a pai ba meena a tom tuima.

ref: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.
text: Ti wanyi wanyi potim tuesi ŋmanteka kama a magsi chaab ale Kirisitawa tiirimu ale ka diila.

ref: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
text: Dila ale soa ate ku weeni ayen, <<Wa ale jam a jueli wenŋmazuk la, wa a dɛ ka baai ate ba jam yik ba ale wa lik la niŋ a ta ba yiti jueli wenŋmazuk niŋniŋa. Wa ŋman te nurubiik meena ka tiirita.>> (Yiila

ref: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
text: Dila nyiŋ, waai abe ale siŋ tɛŋzuk de la, ka wala dekdega abe ale ŋman jueli wenŋmazuk niŋniŋka, a gaam taam dula jigini ayen wa sueri tɛŋzuk de meena.

ref: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
text: Ase ti dan ta siaka ale Wen nidoabinni a gumdu yegayega a jam seba wa nalimnyiini, ti meena le ta nɔiyeŋ ale chaab kama. Ase ti dan a va dila, ti le chim Kirisita biik sii ale pagi magsi ale ta yam yegayega la abe ti ŋman chim ase Kirisita ale kasim ka nuru maŋ meena diila.

ref: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
text: Alege, ku a fɛ ate ti chim nuru pagrisa, ate sagrɔma de a kan ŋman baga a daani ti. Kirisita ale ti niŋdeerɔ. Ni basi ate ti nyiem a biisi wensie abe ti a yaali chaab, ate ti chim ase wadek la.

ref: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
text: Ti a nye se ka wa nyiŋka la. Wala ale waai ale yik ti a tom chaab ase kunaŋa ale yik nyiŋka a tom chaab diila. Nyiŋka kabtaŋa meena abe dan a tom dii ale magsi la ale yaalika, ka a chim kama a ta pagrim.

ref: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
text: ba ka popola maŋsa mɛ. Ba tue kpari ka nna yegayega ate ba an baga a miŋ Wen ya. Dila nyiŋ ale soa ate wa an baga a pai wa nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la a te ba.

ref: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
text: Ba le sak ni wa wie la, ba weeni ni wa wensieŋa wie kama, ate nama wom ale ta siaka ale ŋa a va wa.

ref: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de ni pai ni nye kpakka a basi, dii nyiŋla kala ale a basi ate ni a va nidek pimpaasima yaalika ale pai ni a zaani suik kuui po ale ta ni a cheŋ kaasuŋ jigi la.

ref: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
text: Ni nye paalik kaai ate Wen pai te ni la, le basi ate ni chim ase wadek la. Wen ka wensie dek weleŋsa nyɔnɔ.

ref: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
text: Ni sue dan puuri ni kan nye biemmoa. Ni kan te wenni siŋ ale ni sue diem a puuri.

ref: and don't give the devil a chance.
text: Ni kan te jabioku suiwa ayen wa a nye ate ni a tom tuimbaata.

ref: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
text: Ni dan ka zueba, ni be basi ni zummu, abe ni a dɛ nidek nyiŋ wulum ŋanta. Ni dan a nye dila, ni le baga pai ŋanta bala a maari niwomma.

ref: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
text: Ni kan a biisi biem wie a te chaaba, alege ni basi ate dii meena ate nama a biisi la a ta ŋmanteka ale nyiŋbiiri, ate ku maari baai ale a wom ni la.

ref: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
text: Ni be pai ni suipuurumu ale ni popo soblimu a basi. Ni basi nuemka ale nuruba leeta. Ni kan kisi chaaba.

ref: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de ni ka Wen nuruba. Kula abe kan ŋman a magsi ayen ni a biisi nipok yaalik ale daŋta tuima ale butuem wie ale chaaba.

ref: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
text: Ni seba nalimnyiini kama ayen baai meena ale ka nipok yaalisa ale tuim daŋtisa nyam ale butueta nyam la a kan baga a jo Wen ale wa nidoabinni Kirisita naamu po. Butueta nyam a nye se ka nuru baai ale a kaabi bɔgta la ase ba nin yaali ba ŋantaŋa a gaam Wen.

ref: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
text: Ni kan a wom betta nyam wie ŋaai ale ŋa paasi ni la. Wen sui ale puuri ale bala chaab. Wa le jam te ba ka waalika dai yeŋ po, dii nyiŋla, ba kan zuli wa.

ref: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
text: Dila nyiŋla, ni kan te ni niŋ bo ale baai ale a biisi bi sila chaama la po.

ref: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
text: Ase nama ale jam kan seba Wen diipo la, ni bo ka legi po, alege yɔgyɔgla de nama ka Naawen nuruba, ni yaa bo ka danni kantueŋka po. Ka dila ale soa ate ku a fɛ ayen ni bo danni kantueŋka po la.

ref: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
text: Ku ka chivie ate nuru weeni ba ale suk a nye ŋaai la.

ref: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
text: Wenbinni a dan ga pusi legini a kan ŋman a boro. Dila ale soa ate nuru wanyi weeni ayen, <<Nama baai ale doa a goa la, ni yiti kum po, ate Kirisita a nyaksi ni zuk.>>

ref: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
text: Ni kan a nye se ni ka betta la, alege ni a gisi dii ate Wen a yaali ayen ni a tom a te wa la.

ref: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
text: Ni kan pai nidek a te daamoa ate bu kaasi ni, alege ni pai ni dek meena a te Wen Chiika.

ref: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
text: Ni kasim a yi yiila ŋaai ate Wen Chiika a te ni ayen ni a yi la abe ni a te ti Naawenni pimpauk ni suiniima po.

ref: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
text: Ti kowa Wen a tom tuima ka nna yegayega a te ti. Dila nyiŋ la, ni kasim a te ti Kowa Wen jiam ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita yuenni nyiŋ.

ref: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
text: Pooba, ni siak a te ni chorɔba ase ni ale a siak a te ti Naawenni diila.

ref: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
text: Chorɔwa ta pagrim kama wa powa zuk ase Kirisita ale ta pagrim Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la meena zuk diila. Bala a nye se ka wa nyiŋka la ate wa yaa vari ba ba tuimbaataŋa po a basi.

ref: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
text: Kirisita a nye wieŋa de kama, ayen wa baga Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la meena ale ba nalimu ale ba weleŋsaŋa ale ba ale chim nuru maŋsa la a te wadek, ate wa kan ŋman nya ba kaasuŋku.

ref: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
text: Ku a fɛ kama ate chorɔba ta yaalika ale ba pooba ase ba nidoama ale a yaali badek diila. Wa dan ta yaalika ale wa powa, ku a nye se wa a yaali wadek mɛ kama la.

ref: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
text: Waai an kisi wadek nyiŋŋa, wa a nya ka zuk ale a te ka ŋandiinta kama. Kirisita mɛ abe a nya Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la zuk ka dila.

ref: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
text: <<Dila nyiŋla, ku a fɛ kama ate nidoa basi wa ko ale wa ma, abe wa gum chaab ale wa powa, ate bayewa a chim nyiŋ yeŋ.>> (Piilimka

ref: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
text: Ku be ka dila nama mɛ jigi ayen, ku a fɛ kama ate chorɔba a yaali ba pooba ase ba ale a yaali badek diila abe, pooba mɛ a te ba chorɔma zula.

ref: “Obey your father and your mother,
text: <<A zuli fi ko ale fi ma.>> (Nyinika

ref: and you will have a long and happy life.”
text: <<Ate wie cheŋ nalimnyiini a te fu ate fi goa tɛŋzuk de a beni.>> (Nyinika

ref: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
text: Koba, ni kan nye ate ni bisaŋa sue a puuri. Alege, ni a nya ba zuk abe ni a sak ba, abe ni a kaam ba ase ti Naawenni ale sak ti diila.

ref: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
text: Yɔm, ni a wom ni tɛŋzuk de kpaŋŋa noa ale zula ale yɔgsum chalika, ale wensie a nyini ni suiniima po ase ni ale a zuli Kirisita diila.

ref: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
text: Yɔm gela a kasim a tom ka nna yegayega ba nyama nimbie po, alege ba dan ga basi ba ale cheŋ, ba kan ŋman a tomu. Ku a fɛ kama ayen ba kan a nye dila. Ni be seba ayen ka Kirisita ale soa ni yɔgyɔgla de. Dila nyiŋla ni kasim pii nyiŋ a tom dii ate wa a yaali la a te wa.

ref: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
text: Ni a tom ni tuimaŋa ale suipeentik, dii nyiŋla ni kan tom a te daa nurubisa nyiini, alege ka ti Naawenni maara.

ref: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
text: Ni be seba ayen ni dan poom ka yɔm yaase ni daa yɔmma alege ni a tom tuimaŋsa a te wa, wa le tuni ni ni tuimaŋa nyiŋ.

ref: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
text: Nama baai mɛ ale ka yɔm nyam la, ni a poli ayen nama ale ni yɔmma meena a ta ka nyɔnɔ wanyi waai ale bo wenŋmazuk la. Dila nyiŋla, ku a fɛ ate ni a nya ba zuk nalimnyiini abe ni kaa a nyigsi ba. Buusa boka jigi, Wen daa waai ale a yaali nuruba gela ale a basi gela la.

ref: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
text: Dii nyiŋla nama ale ti Naawenni ale ka bunyi la, ni baga kama a tuesi wa pagrimu yegayega gela.

ref: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
text: Ni dan kasim a nya pagrim buui ate Wen pai a te ni la jigi, jabioku a kan baga a paasi ni diipo diipo.

ref: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, ti kan yaali Wen pagrimu ayen ti a kpaliŋ ale ka nuruba, alege ti a yaali ayen ti a kpaliŋ ale ka chichirik pagrisaŋa ale pagritaŋa tɔgatɔga ale a tom tuim kaasima a bo wenŋmazuk la.

ref: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
text: Dila nyiŋ, ni kpesi yik Wen pagrimu a tanla nalimnyiini, ate dabioku a dan jam abe ni baga a nak dɛ dachiaka meena.

ref: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
text: Dila nyiŋ, ni gomsi nidek giŋgiŋ ale wensie ase chiak gbain ale bobi ni chaasa la, abe ni basi ate weleŋsa lik ni kuusa,

ref: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
text: Diipo meena wuu, ni basi ate ni siaka a chim jachɔgsim ate ni pai lik nidek ate jabioku dan tɔŋ wa piemaŋa abe ŋa kan nye ni wari ya.

ref: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
text: Abe ni pai ni varibasika ate ni nya la, a chim zukchin, abe Wen wanni mɛ a chim gebi kpieŋ kaai ate Wen Chiika a te ni la. Ŋala ale basi ate ni nak a dɛ ni dachaasaŋa.

ref: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
text: Nuruba ale yik mi a lik Wen wamaŋsaŋa de nyiŋ alege m za ka Yeezu naŋkula po. Ku be magsi kama ayen mi a sak baai meena ale bo dela jigini la Wen wamaŋsaŋa wie meena abe m kan peri dinyi mɛ la yaase m chali yɔgsum.

ref: I want you to know how I am getting along and what I am doing. This is why I am sending Tychicus to you. He is a dear friend, as well as a faithful servant of the Lord. He will tell you how I am doing, and he will cheer you up.
text: Ka dila ale soa ate mi a tom wa ni jigi ayen wa weeni ni tama ale a tom diila ate ku te ni nyiŋbiiri ate nama mɛ a tom ni tuimaŋa a cheŋ.

ref: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
text: Ti Kowa Wen ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita le basi ate ni meena ale ni vaanchaama meena ate ni ta siaka ale ba nalimnyiini, a boro ale suiyɔgni abe ni ta yaalika ale siaka ale chaab nna yegayega.

ref: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Wen ŋmanteka le boro ale baai meena ale ta yaalika ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita la, yaali kaai ale kan ta kpeglimka la.

ref: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
text: Mi Pɔɔl, ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ni. Mi ale Timoti ale chim Yeezu Kirisita tomteerɔba la a puusi nama ale ni kpaŋŋa ale ni maarima baai meena ale ka Wen nuruba a bo Filipai tɛŋka la.

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
text: Ti Kowa Wen ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita le ŋmante ni abe ba te ni suiyɔgni.

ref: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
text: Mi kasim a poli ni wie kama ale a puusi Wen a te ni.

ref: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
text: Mi dan boro a puusi a te ni, mi sui a nyiem a kasim a peenti kama.

ref: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
text: Dii nyiŋla, a ta nyini diipo ate nama a wom Wen wamaŋsaŋa wie la, ni nyiem a kasim jam a maari mu kama ate mi a weeni nuruba wa wie.

ref: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
text: Mi ta sebchakka kama kude nyiŋ, wa waai ale piilim tuim maŋka ale fu la ale ta di a ga paari nuerika alege ate Yeezu Kirisita danni paari.

ref: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
text: Ku nala kama ate mi kasim ta ni wie m suinum po nnala, dii nyiŋ la mi ta yaalika kama ale ni nalimnyiini. Ba dan yik mu a ta ga lik yaase mi ale za Wen wamaŋsaŋa ŋaaŋ a sak nuruba ayen ŋa ka wensie la, nama meena ale mi a maari chaab nya Wen ŋmanteka kama.

ref: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
text: Wen ka mi seerɔ ayen mi a biisi ka wensie, ase m nin weeni ayen yaali kaai ate m ta ale ni la a nyini ka Yeezu Kirisita suinum po.

ref: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
text: ate ni nyiem a baga a lueri wa wensie suiku abe ni a va ku. Ni daa nye dila ate Kirisitawa a ŋman pilim jam, ni le baga a tu wa ale weleŋsa ale kan ta kaasuŋŋoa wa jigi ya.

ref: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
text: Kirisita ale maari ni ate ni chim nuru maŋsa nna yegayega. Nuruba ale nya nama tuima ale ka diila a yaali ayen ba a pak abe ba a te Wen zula.

ref: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
text: M suata, mi a yaali kama ayen m weeni a sak ni ayen ba le yik mi a lik diila a basi kama ate Wen wamaŋsaŋa a tagli nuruba yegayega jigi.

ref: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
text: Siiza tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale a limisi mi la ale baai meena ale bo dela la a seba kama ayen ba yik mi a lik ka mi ale a va Kirisita la nyiŋ.

ref: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
text: Nya kude nyiŋ, Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma ba yega a jam ta suinum pagrik ayen ba a sak nuruba Wen wamaŋsaŋa wie.

ref: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
text: Nuruba gela baai ale ta nyuri ale mi la, a sak nuruba kama Kirisita wie, alege baai mɛ ale kan ta nyuri ale mi la a sak nuruba wa wie a maari mu.

ref: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
text: Baai ale a maari mu la a yaali mu kama ale seba ayen ka Wen ale pai mi a zaani dela jigini ayen m za wa wamaŋsaŋa wieŋa ŋaaŋ.

ref: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
text: Baai mɛ ale ta nyuri ale mi la, a sak nuruma Kirisita wie ale ka ba noa po wie nyiini. Ba ka butueta nyam ale a yaali ayen ba nye ate m ŋmasi a nam yegayega a gum m ninammu de po likka dɔkku de po.

ref: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
text: Alege dila a kan kaasi. Ba gela a sak nuruba Kirisita wie kama ale ba popo meena, alege ba gela mɛ a sak ba wa wie ale ba noa po wie nyiini. Ku peenti mi sui kama, dii nyiŋla nuruma de meena buyewa a basi kama ate nuruba wom Kirisita wie.

ref: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
text: Ku be ŋman peenti m sui dii nyiŋla, mi seba kama ayen ba le jam a yeeri mi likka dɔkku de po a basi boan nyiŋŋa nama puusaŋa ale Yeezu Kirisita Chiika maarika le basi kama ate ba yeeri mu.

ref: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
text: M le potim a yaali dii ale m suinum meena ale ta yiila ale di la ale m kan tom m tuimaŋa a kpeeri diipo diipo. Mi a yaali kama diipo meena wuu ayen ale yɔgyɔgla de, m kasim ta nyiŋbiiri nna yegayega a tom ate ku ta zula a jam Kirisita jigi dii meena wuu m kpi yoo mi an kpi yoo.

ref: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
text: Ale ge ate m boro la, ka Kirisitawa nyiŋ, m be dan kpi ku ka nyuenta.

ref: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
text: Alege mi dan boro nyiŋka de po, kude kiri ale m tuimaŋa le cheŋ nalimnyiini a te mu, mi zɛ mi a nin m lueri di dii dek la.

ref: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
text: Wieŋa de ŋayewa a daani mu kama nna yegayega m suinum po. M kasim a yaali kama ayen m kpi a ga bo ale Kirisita. Kula a zunchoŋŋa m tɛŋzuk de boka kama,

ref: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
text: M seba ayen ku a magsi kama ate m bo ale ni ate m baga a maari ni ate ni ta siaka ale Kirisita abe ni sue a peenti nna yegayega.

ref: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
text: M be dan jam ayen m ŋman bo ale ni, nama ale zak m zuk a zaani abe ni a te Yeezu Kirisita pimpauk mi nyiŋ.

ref: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de, wamaŋka ale, ni basi ate ni boka a va ale Kirisitawa sinsaŋŋa ale a weeni diila ate m dan poom a jam ni jigi nwuli a yaase m beni ale ni wie womka, m le seba ayen ni ta nɔiyeŋ kama ale chaab ale kpesi za magsi mɛ. M le ŋman seba mɛ ayen ni nina a muni ka nna yegayega ayen ni a sak nuruba Wen wamaŋsaŋa ŋaai ale basi ate ba a ta siaka ale wa la.

ref: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
text: Ni kan pooma a chali ni dachaasaŋa yɔgsum ale magadek me la. Nya kude ale sak ba ayen Wen dek ale jam dai yeŋ po a nya ba kaasuŋku abe wa nye ate ba kan ta kiri ya. Ku le sak nama mɛ ayen wa le jam a vari ni ni tuimbaataŋa po a basi kama meena.

ref: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, Wen an basi kama ate ni ta siaka nyiini ale Kirisita alege wa basi kama mɛ ate ni a nam wa nyiŋ.

ref: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de ni gum mi po ate ti nye kpaliŋka, kpaliŋ kaai ate nama a wom ale mi a kpaliŋ la. Be ka kala ale la ate mi diem a kpaliŋ.

ref: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
text: ni be basi ate m suipeentika a zuak ni ale ta popola yena ale Kirisita, ale ta wa yaalika, ale ta chiik yeŋ ale popola yena la.

ref: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
text: Ni kan a poli nidek ŋanta nyiini wie, alege ni a poli ni vaanchaab ale ba ŋanta jigi wie.

ref: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
text: Ku a fɛ ate ni ta popola ŋaai chaab ate Yeezu Kirisita jam ta la:

ref: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
text: Wa jam ka Wen alege wa kan jam a yaali ayen wa ta pagrim a soa ase wa le jam ka diila ate ba chim bunyi.

ref: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
text: Wa jam pai wa le ka diila kama a basi ŋaaŋ alege a chim tomteerɔ ase nurubiik la.

ref: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
text: Wa jam ka nuru waai ale seba wadek yikka la ale a zuli Wen nɔi a kpi jabarimu nyiŋ.

ref: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
text: Dila nyiŋ ale soa ate Wen a zak wa a zaani ŋmai ale te wa yuei dii ale zuak a gaam yue meena la,

ref: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
text: ate Yeezu yuenni dan wi duna meena kpi tɛŋ, wenŋmazuk po ale tɛŋzuk de ale kpiluŋ tɛŋ,

ref: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
text: ate noa meena a weeni ayen, Yeezu Kirisita ka Naawen, ate Kowa Wen a nya zula.

ref: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
text: Dila nyiŋla, m dek doaba, ase mi ale jam bo ale ni la, ni a zuli mi nɔi, alege yɔgyɔgla de ate mi ŋman karo ale ni la, ku magsi ka ni diema a zuli mi nɔi nalimnyiini. Ni pii nyiŋ nalimnyiini a tom wa tuimaŋa ale kpazinagsuk ate wa vari ni ni tuimbaataŋa po a basi.

ref: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
text: Dila ale basi kama ate ni welema ni suiniima po abe ni kan ta kaasuŋ Wen nimbie po, dii nyiŋla ni ka wa bisa. Baai ale ka tuim kaasima nyam a kasim a tom tuimbaata nna yegayega la, a boro a gilim ni kama. Ni basi ate ni tuim maŋsaŋa a nyaksi ba suŋsuŋ ase chiŋmarisaŋa ale a nyaksi diila.

ref: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
text: A sak ba ayen Wen a yaali kama ayen wa pai wa nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la a te ba. Ni daa nye dila ate Yeezu Kirisita a ŋman jam, ni le zak mi zuk a zaani. Dii nyiŋla, tuim ŋaai meena ate mi a tom a te ni la, a kan chim kayiokwa.

ref: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
text: Mi a dan poom kpi nama siaka nyiŋ, ku a nye ka nna ase m pai m dek a kaab te ka Wen la. Ku be dan ka dila mi ale nama meena ta ka suipeentik.

ref: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
text: Suik kula po ku a fɛ kama ate nama jam gum mi po ate ti maa chaab a ta suipeentik.

ref: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
text: Ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita dan te suik, ku kan beni alege ate m tom Timoti ni jigi ate wa dan ŋman pilim jam mi jigi, abe wa ta ni wie a jam paali a sak mu, ate ku te mu nyiŋbiiri.

ref: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
text: Wala nyiini ale bo ale mi dela ate wa niŋ a maa bo ale ni a gum mi po.

ref: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
text: Baai ale tali bo dela ale mi la, niŋ a bo ale ka badek wie po, alege ba niŋ ka ale Yeezu Kirisita wieŋa.

ref: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
text: Alege ni meena seba Timoti ale ka nuru maŋ la kama. Ni be ŋman seba mɛ mi ale wa ale a maa chaab a tom dii nna ase biik ale ka ko la a sak nuruba Wen wamaŋsaŋa wie la.

ref: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
text: Dila nyiŋla, m dan ga seba wie ale ŋa nye dii ni jigi la, m kan beni alege tom wa ni jigi ya.

ref: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
text: M ta siaka ale Naawen kama ayen ku kan beni alege ate mi dek a baga jam ni jigi ya.

ref: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
text: Mi a poli kama ayen m tom Epaforodaitus ni jigi, wa ka mi suok ale m tuimtomdɔ choa ale m tugurik tɔŋdɔ choa, waai ale ka nama me tintomdɔ la, waai ate ni tom ayen wa maari mu la.

ref: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
text: Wa kasim a yaali kama ayen wa ŋman jam ni jigi a nya ni. Ku jam kasim a daani wa kama wa popola po nama ale wom ayen wa jam ka nyiŋyɔgsa la.

ref: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
text: Ka dila nyiŋ ale soa ate mi a yaali ayen m tom wa ate wa jam ni jigi yɔgyɔgla de la. Wa dan jam ate ni nya wa ni sue ale peenti abe mi mɛ dek sui kaasuŋku a bɛ.

ref: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
text: Wa be dan jam ni jigi ate ni nya wa, ni tuesi wa nalimnyiini ale masim ti Naawenni nyiŋ. Ni a te nuru baai meena ale a nye ase wala la zula,

ref: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
text: dii nyiŋ la wa pai ka wa nyuvuri da a tali maga ate wa kpi Kirisita tuimaŋa nyiŋ ayen ku te mu maari kaai ate nama dek an baga a te mi la.

ref: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
text: M suata, ni basi ate ni sue a peenti ti Naawenni nyiŋ. Mi liŋ ŋmarisi weeni ni ka wari alege mi a yaali ayen m ŋman ŋmarisi ka dila dekdega, ku be kan daani mi, dii nyiŋla, ku le maari ni kama ate ni kan lo.

ref: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
text: Ni kpesi nidek ale baai ale gebi ba yoaŋa ale a tom tuimbaata alege ba a yaali ayen ba gebi nama mɛ yoaŋa la.

ref: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
text: Ase ku dan ka wensie ayen, nyaŋa de nyeka ka wamaŋsa nalimnyiini, mi dek ate ta siaka ale ŋa kama a gaam waai meena.

ref: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
text: Mi nyini ka Izirali buuni po, Benjamin dɔkku biik, dila la m kowa ka Juu. Ase ba le jam a biak mi ate mi a nya daa naaniŋ la, ale ba gebi mi yɔni. Mi yaa le jam a chim la, ate mi yaa a chim nuru baai ate ba a wi ba ayen Farisiiba la po wanyi. Nuru bala a jam ka baai ale jam a va Juuma kisitaŋa nalimnyiini la.

ref: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
text: Mi yaa ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ Wen niŋ m le ta siaka ale Kirisita la nyiŋ. Ku be daa wari ate m nye nyiŋŋa yaase Juuma kisitaŋa vaka nyiŋŋa. Yɔgyɔgla alege ta siaka ale Kirisita la nyiŋ ate Wen weeni ayen mi ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ.

ref: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
text: M be ŋman a yaali kama ayen m seba Kirisita dek abe m ta pagrim buui ate Wen a pai nak wa a yiti kum po la. M be ŋman a yaali mɛ ayen m nam a kpi ase Kirisita la,

ref: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
text: ate Wen a nak mi mɛ a yiti kum po ate m ga bo ale wa.

ref: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
text: Mi kan weeni kama ayen mi poom deri nya wieŋa de meena ate mi a poli ayen m nya la kama. M be kan weeni kama ayen m deri ka nuru weleŋ alege, m chali a dɛ ka niŋ ayen nya ŋantaŋa de, dii nyiŋla ka dila nyiŋ ate Yeezu Kirisita dek a yik mu a nyo wa nisima po.

ref: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
text: Mi popola a bo ka niŋ ayen m nya wanni de, be ka Wen wiik Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ ayen m nya nyuvuri dii ale bo wenŋmazuk la.

ref: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
text: Tama baai ale pak Wen suiku po la a magsi ayen ti ta ka popolaŋa de chaab. Alege baai a dan ta popola yɔna Wen ale basi ate ni miŋ.

ref: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
text: Wakpienni meena ale ni basi ate ti meena a va Kirisita ase ti ale poom a va wa dii a ta jam paari jinla la.

ref: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
text: M suata, ku a fɛ ate ni a tomsi mi ale a va Kirisita ŋaaŋ diila. Ti le jam bo ale chaab la, ti jam sak ni wa wie kama nalimnyiini. Ka dila ale soa ayen ni a tomsi mi dila.

ref: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
text: Mi poom weeni nama wieŋa de a paari ka ku nɔi di choa ayen nuruba yegayega a zɛri Kirisita jabarimu wie sinsaŋŋa kama. Yɔgyɔgla de, m be ŋman a weeni nya kude a sak ni kama ale sui kaasuŋ.

ref: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
text: Wen a za ayen wa kaasi bala chaama kama, dii nyiŋla ba nyiŋka kɔrisaŋa a chim ka ba bɔgta. Ba ale magsi ayen ba a chali chivie ale wie ŋaai la ba ta ka kanjanta ale ŋa. Ba a poli ka tɛŋzuk de wie nyiini.

ref: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
text: Dila nyiŋ, m suata, nama baai ate mi a yaali ale poli ayen m nya ni la, m suipeentik ale m naam zutɔk, ni le ni zaani dii giŋgiŋ ale Naawen la ale la, m dek doaba.

ref: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
text: Mi a saalim ti toama Yuodia ale Sintiki ale a va Naawen la ayen ba ta nɔiyeŋ ale chaab.

ref: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
text: Mi ale fi abe ale maa chaab a tom ale chaab la, mi a saalim ayen fi a maari nipooma de, dii nyiŋla, mi ale bala ale maa chaab mɛ a nam ase ti ale sak nuruba Wen wieŋa la. Kelement mɛ ale baai meena ale va tama ŋaaŋ la, a nye ka dila dekdega. Wen be ŋmarisi ba yueŋa a nyo ŋanvuta yue gbaŋka po kama.

ref: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
text: Ku kan beni ate Naawen ŋman pilim jam. Dila nyiŋ ku a fɛ ate ni seba nidek taka ale nuruba.

ref: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
text: Ni kan basi ate wie a daani ni, alege ni puusaŋa meena po ni a te Wen jiam ate wa pai ŋan baai meena ate nama a yaali la a te ni.

ref: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
text: Ni dan a nye dila, Wen le basi ate suiyɔgni dii ate nuru biik an baga miŋ di kiri a chak la a jam ni suiniima po. Nama baai ate Yeezu Kirisita soa la, a dan ta suiyɔgni de, wabiok an baga a jam ni jigi ya.

ref: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
text: Ku kpeglimka, m suata, wa dii ale ka wensie la, wa dii ale ta zula la, wa dii ale magsi la, wa dii ale welema la, wa dii ale nala la, wa dii ale ta mariŋka la, wari a dan ŋmasi nala ale magsi pimpauk ni be poli ŋala wie.

ref: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
text: Ase mi ale jam bo ale ni diipo la, ni wom mi sinsaŋŋa kama ale nya m tuimaŋa me ale jam ka diila. Ni ba a poli mi sinsaŋŋa wie abe ni a tom ni tuimaŋa ase dila la. Ni be a tom dila, ate Wen dii ale a te suiyɔgni la, le boro ale ni.

ref: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
text: Ti Naawen dii ale bo ale mu la, a basi kama ate m sui peenti nna yegayega, dii nyiŋla ni ŋman sak mu kama ayen ni popola a diem bo ale mu kama. Ni jam a liŋ maari mu kama ate ku beni, alege ate yɔgyɔgla de ni yaa ŋman nya suik ayen ni maari mu.

ref: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
text: M seba m dek yikka kama ase nyeboka a nin baasa. M be seba m dek yikka kama ase nyeboka a nin pagra mɛ. Juijui meena ate mi boro la m seba kom taka kama ale chakta mɛ taka.

ref: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
text: Mi baga a nye wari meena kama Kirisita nyiŋ waai ale a te mu pagrim la.

ref: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
text: Alege ku nala ka nna yegayega ale ni ale maari mu daani kaai po ate m boro la.

ref: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
text: Nama Filipai demma, ni seba kama ayen diipo ate mi liŋ sak nuru baai le jam bo Masidoniya po la, Wen wamaŋsaŋa wie alege basi dula la nama nyiini ale maari mu suiku po. Nama mɛ ale nya maarika mi jigi.

ref: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
text: Mi ale jam bo Tesalonika po la, ni tom tiirim ŋanta a te mi kama a paari dii choa.

ref: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
text: Mi kan potim a yaali ka ni tiirimu alege mi a yaali ka Wen le wa te ni nyuen tii a magsi chaab ale ni tiirimu ate ni te mi la.

ref: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
text: Ni tiirim buui ate ni pai te Epaforodaitus ate wa ta jam a te mi la, a deri gaam mi ale a yaali diila kama. Nama ale nye diila a basi kama ate Wen sui a kasim peenti nna yegayega. Kula a nye se ka Juuma ale yik duŋsaŋa a kaabi a te Wen la.

ref: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
text: Mi Wenni ale te ni ni ŋan yaalinta meena a magsi chaab ale wa zula jigsika Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ.

ref: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
text: Wen dii ale ka ti Ko la, a ta zula kama yegayega a ta a cheŋ diipo meena wuu. Ku be nye dila.

ref: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
text: Mi a puusi Wen nuruma baai ale Yeezu Kirisita ale ka bunyi la. Ti suataŋa baai ale bo ale mi dela jigini la, mɛ a puusi ni.

ref: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
text: Wen nuruma baai mɛ ale bo tɛŋka de po la, a puusi ni ale baai meena ale a tom Siiza yenni po la, mɛ a puusi ni.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
text: M be ŋman a saalim ayen ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ŋmanteka a bo ale ni meena.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
text: Mi Pɔɔl waai ale ka Yeezu Kirisita tuimtomdɔ Wen yaalika nyiŋ la ale ŋmarisi gbaŋka de, ate mi ale ti suoku Timoti

ref: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
text: a puusi ti suataŋa ale welema ale ta siaka ale Kirisita a bo Kolose la. Wen ti Kowa ŋmanteka ale wa suiyɔgni a bo le ni.

ref: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
text: Ti wom ni siaka ale Yeezu Kirisita ale soa diila kama ale ni yaalika ale Wen nuruma meena ale soa dii mɛ la kama.

ref: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
text: Wen tomtomiŋ maŋka ale liŋ jan jam ni jigi diipo la ni jam wom yiila ŋaai ate ŋa jam pai te ni la kama. Dila nyiŋla ka ni siaka nyiŋ ale soa ate ni a limisi jabuui ate ni le nya la. Jabula abe bo ka wenŋmazuk. Jaab jaab abe kan kaasi wa.

ref: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
text: Ase diipo ate ni liŋ wom Wen ŋmanteka wie ate ni sum seba ayen ku sum ka wensie la, a zaani dipo a jam paari jinla, Wen tomtomiŋ maŋka a kasim ta ka wamaŋsa nyiini a jam tɛŋzuk de meena ase tomtomiŋ maŋka ale kasim a nye dii a te nama a ta nyini da dii danni ate ni liŋ wom ka la.

ref: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
text: Ni be wom Wen niauŋku wie kama ti tomteerɔ choawa jigi. Wa ka waai abe ale sum ka Kirisitawa tomteerɔ maŋ a yaa tagri tama zuk a tom la.

ref: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
text: Wa be weeni a sak ti mɛ Wen Chiika ale basi ate ni ta yaalika ale chaab diila.

ref: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
text: Dila nyiŋla, diipo ate tama wom ni wie la, tama kasim a puusi Wen a te ni ka dila. Ti a juisi Wen kama ayen wa le basi ate ni sum ta miŋ chakka ale wadek yaalika ale ka diila. Abe wa sueri ni ale yam buui ale miŋchak kaai ate Wen Chiika a te ni la.

ref: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
text: Dila abe dan nye, ni le baga a boro a kasim a nye dii meena ate Naawen a yaali ate ku a te wa popeentik la. Ni nyeboka po, ni le kasim a nye ka wamaŋsa nna yegayega tɔgatɔga ate ni a chim abe ni seba ayen ni sum seba Wen kama.

ref: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
text: Ti a saalim wa kama ayen wa le pai wa pagrim kpiemu a te ni ate ni baga zaani wie meena po ale chichiiba nalimnyiini.

ref: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
text: Abe ni kasim a te Wen ti Kowa jiam ale popeentik dii nyiŋla, ka wala ale basi ayen ni nya suik a maa nya ŋan baai ate Wen nuruma le nya la. Nuruma de abe bo ka Wen naamu po juijui ate legi karo la.

ref: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
text: Wen vari ti kama a ta nyini legini po a ta ti nalimnyiini a ga jo wa naam buui ate wadek nidoabinni a soa la.

ref: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
text: Dii nyiŋla, Wen va ka wala nyiŋ a nye jaab meena tɛŋzuk de ale wenŋmazuk, ŋan baai ate ti baga a nya ale ŋan baai ate ti an baga nya. Nyaba de meena gum chaab ale ka chichirik pagrisaŋa ale pagrita tɔgatɔga. Wen va ka Yeezu Kirisita a nye wieŋa de meena. Wa be nye ba te ka wala.

ref: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
text: Kirisitawa de a liŋ boro kama alege ate Wen nye jaab meena. Jaab meena abe nye ka nɔiyeŋ ale wa a yaa boro tɔgatɔga.

ref: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
text: Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la ale Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋka ate wadek yaa chim ba kpagi a yaa ta ba vummu. Wala ale a nye ase Wen bikpagi la ate wa nak wa a yiti kum po la. Wa nye dila kama ayen wa dɛ jaabuuri meena niŋ.

ref: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
text: Biika de nyiŋ abe ale soa ate Wen yaa poli mɛ a ta tɛŋka meena wadek. Wen va ka biika de kummu nyiŋ jabarimu zuk, a basi ate nyemagsika ale nurubiik a yaa boro. Wa va ka wa kummu mɛ nyiŋ a ŋman pilim soa jaabuuri meena tɛŋzuk de ale wenŋmazuk.

ref: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
text: Dila powa, ni an jam moata Wen ya ate dila jam basi ate ni chim Wen dachaasa dii nyiŋla, ni jam a tom ka wabaata ale ta popola baata mɛ.

ref: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de, wa biika kummu nyiŋ ate Wen yaa dɛ doata ale ni ayen ku basi ate ni chim nuru weleŋsa wa niŋ.

ref: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
text: Ni dan nye dila, ku a fɛ kama ayen, ni ŋmasi yik ni siaka nalimnyiini a zaani abe ni ta yiila ŋaai ate ni tara a ta nyini diipo ate ni wom Wen tomtomika la. Ku be ka Wen tomtomiŋ maŋka de nyiŋ ale soa ate mi Pɔɔl yaa chim tomteerɔ. Tɛŋka meena abe ale doa a ga saari la, a wom tomtomiŋ maŋka de kama.

ref: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de, mi poi peenti ka nna yegayega ale ninam buui ate mi a nam a te ni la. Ka mi ninammu nyiŋ ale bu basi ate ni baga nueri Kirisita ninam buui ate wa nam te Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la.

ref: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
text: Tuntomiŋ maŋka de abe jam chim ka wasusugi dila po, ate wa nye nurubiik jigi. Alege yɔgyɔgla de, wa yaa be basi kama ate di nyini peelim a sak wa nuruma.

ref: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
text: Ba jigi Wen poli kama ayen wa basi ate baai ale kan daa Juuba la a seba wasusugni jigsika zulaŋa, ŋaai ale ka Kirisitawa a bo ni po la, zula ŋaai ate ni a yiili la.

ref: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
text: Ni basi ate m weeni sak ni mi ale tom nna yegayega a te nama ale nuru baai mɛ ale bo Laodisia la ale baai meena ale kan seba mi dek la.

ref: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
text: Mi a weeni nya kude a sak ni kama ayen ku deŋsi ba kpa ate ba jam jigi yeŋ ale yaalika. Dila dan nye, wensie miŋ chakka le basi ate ni sum seba nya kude chak nalimnyiini. Nya kude abe dan nye, ba le seba Wen wasusugni ale ka diila. Wasusugni de abe ale Kirisitawa dek.

ref: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
text: Alege boan nyiŋŋa, m karo ale ni, alege m boro ale ni kama Wen Chiika nyiŋ. M sui be peenti ka nna yegayega ate m nya ni kasim chiib zaani nalimnyiini dii ale ni siaka ale Kirisitawa la.

ref: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
text: Ase ni ale siak a te Yeezu Kirisita ayen wa ka ni Nyɔnɔ la, ni be kasim chim bunyi ale wa.

ref: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
text: Ni basi ate ni nina muni ale wa, ni pai ni nyeboka meena a te wa, abe ni basi ate ni siaka ale wa a pagra ase ba ale jam sak ni diila. Ni abe kasim a te wa jiam mɛ.

ref: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
text: Ni be kpesi nidek ate waai a kan pai nurubiik pimpaasima yam buui ale nyini nuruba jigi ale tɛŋzuk ale wenŋmazuk chichirisa jigi la ate ni chim yɔm. Ni pai yam buui nyiini ale nyini Kirisitawa jigi la.

ref: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
text: Ni be ta nyuvuri kama nalimnyiini ni le chim bunyiwa ale wa la nyiŋ. Wa ta pagrim ka nna yegayega a gaam chichirisa meena ale pagra la.

ref: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, diipo ate ni tuesi soka la, ku a nye ase ba maa gu nama mɛ ale Yeezu Kirisita kama la. Ku be ŋman a nye ase ni ŋman maa yiti kum po kama ale Yeezu Kirisita la. Be ka ni siaka ale Wen pagrimu ale soa diila ate wa nak wa yiti kum po la.

ref: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
text: Ti waba tii meena ale ŋmarisi doa ale ŋa sinsaŋŋa meena la, Kirisitawa ko ŋa meena a basi kama a pai ŋa kpi maŋ Kirisitawa kummu jabarimu nyiŋ.

ref: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
text: Jabarimu de zuk ale Kirisitawa basi ate chichirisa pagrim ale kpaga pagrimu a chim kinla nyiŋ, a yaa basi ate waai meena nya ba chivie a sak ase wa ale ta pagrim la.

ref: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
text: Dila nyiŋ, ni kan basi ate nuru a te sinsaŋŋa a magsi chaab ale jabuui ate ni le dɛ yaase ni nyu, yaase da ŋaai ale welema ale ŋaai ale kan welema yaase Chi Paalika Tigini yaase wari a magsi chaab ale Vuusum Danni.

ref: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
text: Nyaŋa de meena ka chum da dii dai wie yisuŋta. Wensie wieŋa bo ka Kirisitawa jigi.

ref: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
text: Wala choa abe pai Kirisitawa waai ale soa nyiŋka meena a nya la a basi kama. Kirisitawa ale soa Kirisita bisaŋa ale a nye ase wa nyiŋka la meena a nya ate ka a chim nalimnyiini ale ka kunaŋa ale kobaŋa ate ŋa a chim ase Wen ale a yaali ayen nyiŋka a chim diila.

ref: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
text: <<Kan ta jaamu de>> yaase <<Kan lam jaamu de a nya>> yaase <<Kan tiri jaamu de yaase nwala?>>

ref: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
text: Sinsaŋŋa de chaab a biisi a magsi chaab ale ka jaabuuri meena wuu ate fi dan ga pai wa tom tuini, wa ŋman ka kiri diila. Ŋala meena ka nurubiik dek ale dueni wa sinsaŋŋa a sak ŋa.

ref: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
text: Sinsak ŋala chaab a nye ase ka ba yam buui ate ba tara a fɛ ayen nuruba a puusi Wen maarɔba abe ba a paasi badek ayen ba a zaab ka badek. Sinsaŋ ŋala maari a basi kama ate nuruba a namsi ba nyiŋsa nalimnyiini. Ŋa an baga a nye ate fi a fɛ fi nyiŋka ate fi kan tom wabiowa.

ref: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
text: Ni yiti kum po kama ale Yeezu Kirisita. Dila nyiŋ, ni basi ate ni popola bo ale ŋan baai nyiini ale bo wenŋmazuk la. Dula jigini ale Kirisitawa kala Wen jigi juga geŋ.

ref: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
text: Dila nyiŋ ku a fɛ kama ayen ni pai ni popola meena a basi dula jigini, ni kan pai ŋa a basi tɛŋzuk de.

ref: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
text: Dii nyiŋla, nama ale Kirisitawa a maa ka chaab a kpi ate ni nyuvooŋa a yaa bo wa jigi Wen jigi.

ref: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
text: Ni vummu dek abe ale Kirisitawa. Wa be dan pilim ŋman jam, nama mɛ le pilim ŋman jam kama ale wa a maa nya zula ŋaai ate wa me le nya la.

ref: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
text: Wieŋa de chaab nyiŋ ate Wen le ta suipuurum ale baai meena ale kan a zuli wa nɔi la.

ref: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
text: Dila powa, nama dek kasim jam va ka nyaŋa de chaab a ate ŋa jam soa ni.

ref: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
text: Alege yɔgyɔgla de, ku a fɛ kama ayen ni pai ŋa meena a basi. Wie ŋala chaab ase, suipuurum ale chaab kisika venta biisa ale bibuloarisa meena wuu a kan nyini ni nɔi po a nyini.

ref: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
text: Ni kan a velim a te chaaba dii nyiŋla, ni yuk ni nye kpakka ale ka biem nyeelaŋa a basi la

ref: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
text: alege yaa pai nye paalik a tara ale a nye ale sebika ate ka kasim paala a neesi ka nyeerɔwa.

ref: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
text: Dila nyiŋla, waai ale kan daa Juu ale waai me ale ka Juu, ku daa tɔgatɔga, waai ale gebi wa yoari ale waai ale kan gebiya, ba ka bunyi, nicham ale baai ale bo gɔi po ale yɔm, ale baai ale kan daa yɔm, bala meena Kirisitawa soa kama. Wa be bo ale ba meena kama.

ref: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
text: Nyaŋa de meena zuk, ni pai yaalika a vi du. Dii nyiŋla, yaalika ale a yik wie meena a niak chaab.

ref: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
text: Suiyɔgni dii ate Kirisitawa a te ni la, dila ale di maari ni ale wie ŋaai meena ate ni ta a poli ayen ni nye la. Boan nyiŋŋa, ka suiyɔgni de choawa ate Wen wi ni a pai nyo jigi yeŋ ayen ni a nye ase ni ka nyiŋ yeŋ la. Abe ni a nye Wen jiam.

ref: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
text: Ku a fɛ kama ayen Kirisitawa tomtomika ale ka masimu meena a bo ni suiniima po. Ni pai yam a sak chaab abe ni a kaam chaab. Ni pai Wen wanni a yi yiila, ni a yi yi ŋaai ale a pak Yeezu la ale yi ŋaai ate Wen Chiika a te ni ale ni suiniima a nye Wen jiam.

ref: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
text: Wie meena ate ni a nye yaase ni a biisi, ni pai Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita yuenni a nye ase ni ale pai wa yuenni a nye Wen ti Kowa jiam diila.

ref: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
text: Pooba, ku a fɛ kama ayen, ase Kirisita bisa la, ni a te ni chorɔma zula nalimnyiini.

ref: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
text: Chorɔba, nama mɛ ku a fɛ kama ayen ni a yaali ni pooma abe ni kan biisi ba a kaasi.

ref: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
text: Nyama, ni kan a nye ate ni bisaŋa sue a puuri. Ni dan a nye dila ba a jɔk ka nyiŋbiiri wie nyeka po.

ref: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
text: Yɔmma, nama mɛ a te baai ale soa ni la zula wie meena po. Ku daa ka ba ale a nya ni ase ni nin boro a tom tuini ayen ba ale a nya ni la abe ni tom ate ba yaali ni, alege ni a tom ale ni suiniima meena dii nyiŋla, ni ale a te Naawen zula la nyiŋ.

ref: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
text: Dii meena ate ni a tom la, ni a tom ale ni suiniima meena ase ni a tom a te ka Naawen la alege daa nuruba.

ref: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
text: Ni a teeri Naawen ale wa pai tutuna ŋaai a te wa nuruma la, ŋala dekdega ate wa le pai te nama mɛ. Dii nyiŋla, Kirisitawa sum ale Naawen ate ni tom a te.

ref: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
text: Yɔmma nyama, ku a fɛ kama ayen ni ta nyemagsika ale wensie dii meena ate ni a nye ni yɔmma jigi la. Nama mɛ abe a teeri ayen ni ta Nyɔnɔ mɛ kama wenŋmazuk.

ref: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
text: M ŋman diem weeni a sak ni kama ayen, ni kan basi Wen puusika, abe ni kpesi nidek ale ni puusaŋa, a nye Wen jiam.

ref: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
text: Ni maa puusi a te tama mɛ ayen Wen le te ti suik naluŋ ate ti baga a sak nuruba wa tomtomiŋ kaai ale a biisi a magsi chaab ale Kirisitawa waai mɛ ale chim wasusugi a te nuruba la. Boan nyiŋŋa, ka sinsaŋŋa de nyiŋ abe ale soa ate mi bo likka dɔk nna la.

ref: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
text: Ni basi ate ŋmanteka a bo ni biika po, abe ka masa, ate ni seba ni le nye dii a tulisi waai meena la.

ref: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
text: Tidek suoku Tikikus, waai ale ta wensie tuima meena po a maa tom a te Naawen la, wala le weeni ni dii meena ale boro la magsi chaab ale mi

ref: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
text: ka dila ale soa ate mi a tom wa ni jigi ayen wa weeni a sak ni tama mɛ ale bo dela a nye diila ate ku te ni popeentik.

ref: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
text: Tidek suok maŋka Onesimos waai ale ka nama po wanyi a ta siaka nna yegayega la a maa va Tikikus cheena kama. Bala ale maari chaab a weeni ni dii meena ale a nye dela la.

ref: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
text: Arisitaakus waai ale bo likka dɔk ale mi la, a puusi ni. Banabas suoku Maak mɛ a puusi ni. Mi a poli ayen m poom liŋ weeni ni ayen dai dii dai Maak a dan jam ni jigi, ni tuesi wa nalimnyiini.

ref: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
text: Josua waai yuei di choawa ale Jasitus la, a puusi ni. Nuruma de batawa, Arisitaakus ale Maak ale Josua nyiini ale Juuba a va Kirisitawa suiku a maari a tom Wen naamu tuimaŋa. Ba be kasim a maari mu ka nna yegayega.

ref: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
text: Epafiras waai ale ka ni po wanyi ale chim Yeezu Kirisita tomteerɔ la a puusi ni. Wa kasim a jɛ ka jiak wa puusa po a te ni, ayen ni zaani giŋgiŋ Kirisita yaalika meena po, ate ni pak abe ni seba chak.

ref: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
text: Mi dek pai nina maa nya wa tuimaŋa ate wa tom nalimnyiini dii Laodisia ale Erapolis tɛŋsaŋa po la kama.

ref: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
text: Ti tebirɔwa Luuk ale Diimas maari chaab a puusi ni.

ref: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
text: Puusi ti suataŋa ale bo Laodisia la, nalimnyiini a te mu. Mi a puusi Nimfa ale Kirisita bisaŋa ale a nye tuka wa yenni po la nalimnyiini.

ref: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
text: Ni dan karim gbaŋka nueri, ni pii nyiŋ ate ni basi ate Kirisita bisaŋa ale bo Laodisia la maari wom ka wieŋa. Fi dan nye dila mɛ, tuesi gbaŋ kaai ate Laodisia demma mɛ le te fu la a karim.

ref: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
text: Abe fi weeni Akipus mɛ ayen mi weeni wa ayen, <<Seba chak ate fi nueri tuin dii ate Naawen te fu ayen fi tom la a nueri.>>

ref: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
text: Ni a teeri chɔrimaŋa ate ba pai bobi mu la wie. Mi Pɔɔl dek ale pai m nisima a ŋmarisi wieŋa de ayen, Pɔɔl a puusi ni. M be ŋman a saalim ayen ti Wenni ŋmanteka a bo ale ni.

ref: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Mi Pɔɔl ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de ate mi ale Silas ale Timoti a puusi nama baai ale a va Yeezu Tesalonika tɛŋka po la. Ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ale ti Kowa Wen ale soa ni. Ŋmanteka ale suiyɔgni a bo ale ni.

ref: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
text: Ti a te Wen jiam ale a puusi a te wa kama daa meena nama nyiŋ,

ref: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
text: ti kasim a teeri ti Wenni ale ti Kowa niŋ kama ni siaka ale basi ate ni tom tuim ŋaai la, ale yaalika ale basi ate ni nam diila ale yiila ale choa ni ate ni chiibi dii meena ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋla.

ref: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
text: Ti suata, ti seba ayen Wen a yaali ni kama, ate wa lueri ni a te wadek dii nyiŋla,

ref: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
text: ti ale liŋ a sak ni Wen wamaŋsaŋa la, ku jam daa tama dek noa po wie nyiini ate ti weeni sak ni. Wen Chiika ale pai pagrim a nyo ŋa po. Dila ale soa ate ni wanyi mɛ la a jam ka chichama ale ŋa. Ni jam nya ti ale boro ale ni diila kama nama nyiŋ,

ref: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
text: ate ni tomsi tama ale ti Naawenni. Nuruba jam basi kama ate ni jam a nam nna yegayega dii nyiŋla, ni ale jam siak a te Wen wamaŋsaŋa la. Alege Wen Chiika a jam basi ate ni sue a peenti ka yegayega.

ref: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
text: Ni ale jam ta ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita wamaŋsaŋa a cheŋ ga weeni sak ba wa wie la, baai meena ale jam bo dula jigini ale jigi meena la, a wom ni wie kama ni ale jam siak a te Wen diila. Ti be kan ŋman a yaali ayen ti weeni ni wari a sak nuruba

ref: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
text: dii nyiŋla, badek a weeni sak ti kama ayen ti ale jam ni jigi la, ni jam tuesi ti kama ale wom ti wieŋa ale basi bɔgta kaabka ale a va Wen dii ale ka wensie nyɔnɔ ale kasim boro taam wuu la,

ref: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
