text: ale a tom wa tuimaŋa ale a limisi wa nidoabinni Yeezu waai le wa basi wenŋmazuk abe wa ŋman pilim jam tɛŋzuk de la. Ka Wen ale jam nye ate wa yiti kum po. Wa ka waai ale a vari ti a basi Wen le za wa te nuruba waalika la po.

ref: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
text: Ni seba, m suata ayen ti le jam ni jigi la jam daa kinla nyiŋŋa.

ref: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
text: Ti poom jam nam kama ate ba lɛ ti Filipai tɛŋka, ase ni ale seba la, alege ti Wenni maarika nyiŋ ti nya nyiŋbiiri a biisi wa wamaŋsaŋa daanika meena po.

ref: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
text: Wamaŋsaŋa ŋaai ate tama a jam saalim ni ayen ni wom ŋa la, ŋa meena a jam ka wensie. Ti popolaŋa mɛ a jam ka popola maŋsa. Ti be kan jam a yaali ayen ti paasi ni.

ref: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
text: Ti an jam a yaali pimpauk ni jigi ya, yaase nuruba ba chaab jigiya.

ref: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
text: Ti dan jam a yaali ayen ti nye pagrim ni jigi a nya ŋanta, ti te jam baga a nye dila kama, dii nyiŋla, ti ka Kirisita tuimtomdɔba. Alege ti ale jam bo ale ni la, ti jam a nya ka tidek zuk ale jaabuuri meena alege jam ta ni ale jiirim ase nipok ale a nya wa bisa zuk ale jiirim diila.

ref: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
text: Dii nyiŋla, ti jam mariŋ ni ka nna yegayega. Ku jam daa Wen wamaŋsaŋa nyiini ate ti jam a yaali ayen ti pai sak ni. Ti jam poom a yaali mɛ ayen ka ti pai tidek nyuvooŋa a te ni. Ni jam bo ti suiniima po ka nna yegayega.

ref: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
text: Ti suata, ni baga a teeri ti ale jam a tom yok ale kantueŋ dii ate ti ga jiak la, ti jam a nye dila ayen ka ti jam baga a sak ni Wen wamaŋsaŋa ate ti kan jam daani ni ale ŋandiinta yaase jaab jaaboa.

ref: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
text: Nama ale Wen ale tama seerɔba ayen, ti ale jam boro ale ni la, ti an jam nye ni wari ayen ni baga nya ti kaasuŋŋoa.

ref: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
text: Ti jam a nya ni zuk kama wanyi wanyi ase koba ale a nya ba bisa zuk diila.

ref: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
text: Ti jam te ni ka nyiŋbiiri ale deŋsi ni kpa ale maari weeni ayen ni a tom tuim ŋaai le ŋa peenti Wen sui la. Wa wi ni kama ayen ni jam jo wa naamu ale wa nyaksika yegayekka po.

ref: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
text: Ti suata, wie ŋaai ale nye Wen ale Yeezu Kirisita ŋaaŋviirɔma jigi baai ale bo Judia la, ŋala dek ale nye nama mɛ jigi dula. Nama dek nuruba ale jam daani ni nna yegayega ase Juuma ale jam daani Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma Judia tɛŋka po la.

ref: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
text: Juuma liŋ jam ko ka Wen biisiteerɔma alege yaa ko ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita. Ba gela jam basi kama ate ti nya ninam nna yegayega ale vi ti a yiak ti basi. Nuruma de an peenti Wen sui ya. Ba ka nuru meena dachaasa

ref: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
text: dii nyiŋla, tama jam a yaali kama ayen ti sak baai ale kan daa Juuma la Wen wamaŋsaŋa ate Wen vari ba ba tuimbaataŋa po a basi, alege Juuma a jam pii ka nyiŋ a kasim a daani ti ayen ti basi ti sinsaŋŋa. Ba ale a zɛri nna la, ba ŋmasi a tom ka tuimbaata yegayega a gum ba ale liŋ tom tuim ba tii la po. Alege yɔgyɔgla, Wen mɛ sui ale a puuri ale ba.

ref: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
text: Ku ale jam a fɛ ayen ti basi chaab tɔgatɔga la, ti sue a jam kaasi ka nna yegayega. Ku be beni maga kama alege ti an diem baga a ŋman nya chaaba. Alege ti diem a poli ni wie kama. Ni kasim bo ka ti suiniima po, ate ti yaa pii nyiŋ yegayega ayen ti ŋman jam a nya ni.

ref: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
text: Diila ka boa ale ti yiila yaase ti kuulimka ase ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita a nin jamu? Ku kan chim daa nama?

ref: You alone are our glory and joy!
text: Diila ka nama ale ti zula ale ti masim.

ref: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
text: Dila powa ti jam limisi kama a jiak alege ti an jam wom ni wari ya. Dila nyiŋla, tidek jam poom gomsi kama ayen ti wari Atens tɛŋka po,

ref: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
text: alege yaa tom ti suoku Timoti ayen wa jam ni jigi. Mi ale wa maari chaab a tom ka Wen tuimaŋa ale a weeni a sak nuruba Wen wamaŋsaŋa ŋaai ale a biisi Yeezu Kirisita wie la. Ti tom Timoti ayen ka wa jam deŋsi ni kpa abe wa a maari ni ate ni ta siaka nalimnyiini ale Yeezu, abe

ref: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
text: ni kan pai ni ŋaaŋ a te Wen suiku vaka nuruba ale a daani ni la nyiŋŋa. Nama dek seba ayen ku a fɛ kama ayen baai ale a va Wen suiku la a nam kama.

ref: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
text: Tama ale jam bo ale ni la, ti liŋ jam weeni ni kama ayen Wen le te nuruba suik ate ba basi ate ni nya ninam. Dila sum nye kama ase ti ale poom jam a weeni ni diila.

ref: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
text: Timoti be jam ni jigi kama ale ŋman pilim jam tama jigi. Wa ale ta wapaali ŋaai a jam weeni sak ti la, ŋa masa te ti kama. Wa jam weeni sak ti ni ale ta siaka ale Yeezu dii ale a yaali nuruba mɛ la. Wa weeni sak ti ni ale diem a teeri ti wie dii ale a yaali mɛ ayen ni nya ti ase tama ale a yaali ayen ti nya nama mɛ diila.

ref: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
text: Ti suata, ti diem bo ka daanika ale ninam po, alege ni ale ta siaka diila a te ti ka nyiŋbiiri ate tama mɛ a tom.

ref: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
text: Ni ale ŋmasi zaani ale ni siaka ale ti Naawenni nalimnyiini dila te ti ka nyiŋ pagra ale nyuvuri.

ref: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
text: Yɔgyɔgla de ti zɛ ti le ti nye Wen jiam diila, dii nyiŋ la ti dan biisi ni wari ale wa, te sui a kasim a peenti kama daa meena.

ref: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
text: Yɔk ale kantueŋ meena ti a puusi a te ka Wen ale ti suiniima meena ayen wa maari ate ti ŋman jam nya ni, ate ti ŋman sak ni a gum du ase ti ale liŋ jam sak ni Yeezu vaka diila.

ref: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
text: Ti Kowa Wen ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita a dan te ti suik ti le jam ni jigi.

ref: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
text: Ti Naawen le maari ni ate ni ta yaalika a zuak nna yegayega ale chaab ale nuru meena ase tama ale a yaali nama diila.

ref: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
text: Ni dan a yaali chaab dila, ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita le maari ni ate wa ale wa maarɔma meena a dan jam, ni le baga a zaani ti Kowa Wen niŋ ale suiniim weleŋsa, ate wa kan nya kaasuŋ ni jigiya.

ref: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
text: Ti suata, tama jam sak ni ni le ni nye dii a va Wen ate wa sui peenti la kama. Ni be kasim va dila. Alege ti a saalim ni ti Naawenni Yeezu yuei nyiŋ ayen ni kasim ŋman a va wa dila nalimnyiini a gum du.

ref: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
text: Nama baga teeri ti ale jam pai ti Naawenni Yeezu pagrimu a sak ni diila?

ref: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
text: Ni kan a yaali nipooba kinla nyiŋŋa ase baai ale kan seba Wen la.

ref: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
text: Wen an lueri ti ayen ka ti a tom tuimbaataŋa de chaaba, alege wa lueri ti kama ayen ti chim nuru weleŋsa.

ref: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
text: Dila nyiŋla, waai ale a zɛri ti sinsaŋŋa de la, wa kan zɛri ka nuruba ale a sak diila, alege wa a zɛri ka Wen dii ale pai wa Chiika a te ni la.

ref: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
text: Ku an magsi ayen m ŋman ŋmarisi te ni a weeni ni le ni nye dii a ta yaalika ale chaab la, dii nyiŋla, Wen a liŋ jam sak ni kama.

ref: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
text: Ti seba ayen ni a yaali Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma baai meena ale bo Masidoniya tɛŋka po la, alege ti a saalim ni kama ayen ni a nye dila nalimnyiini a gum du,

ref: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
text: abe ni nye ni popola ate ni boro nna chim. Ni kan pai nidek a nyo ni vaanchaab wie po. Ni a dɛ nidek nyiŋ wulum ŋandiinta mɛ ase ti ale liŋ jam sak ni diila.

ref: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
text: Ni dan a va nyeka de, baai ale kan ta siaka ale Yeezu la, le te ni zula, ate ni kan ŋman a nya nuruba ayen ba te ni ŋanta.

ref: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
text: Ti suata, ti a yaali ayen ka ni seba ku wensieŋa a magsi chaab ale baai ale kpi la, ate ni popola a kan kaasi ase baai ale kan ta yiila Yeezu jigi la.

ref: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
text: Tama abe ta yiila kama boan nyiŋŋa, ti ale ta siaka ayen Yeezu kpi kama ale ŋman yiti kum po la. Dila dekdega ate Wen le nye ate baai ale ta siaka ale Yeezu alege kpi la, a yiti kum po ate ba maa chaab a boro ale Yeezu.

ref: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
text: Ti a sak ni ka ti Naawenni ale sak ti diila. Dai yeŋ po, ti Naawenni le ŋman pilim jam. Wa dan jam, tama baai, ale vua la, ku a fɛ kama ayen ti kan dɛ baai ale kpi la niŋŋa.

ref: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
text: Da dila danni, nuruba le wom ti Naawenni lueluku ale Wen maarɔma kpagi kpienni lueluku ale Wen damuniŋka peerika ate ti Naawenni dek nyini wenŋmazuk a siŋ cheena ate baai ale jam ta siaka ale wa alege kpi la, a yiti kum po.

ref: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
text: Wa yaa le deri tigsi tama baai ale tali a vua la, ate tama yaa yiri a jueli chiŋmaaŋa po a tu ti Naawenni dula. Ti le kasim bo ka wa jigi taam wuu.

ref: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
text: Ti suata, ku an magsi ayen ti ŋmarisi a weeni ni diipo ate wieŋa de meena le nye la,

ref: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
text: dii nyiŋla, nama dek seba chak kama ayen dai dii ate ti Naawenni le ŋman pilim jam la, ku le nye ase ka zue ale a jam yɔk diila.

ref: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
text: Alege nama ti suataŋa a seba Yeezu ale wa ŋman pilim jam la kama, dila ale soa ate ku kan cha ni ase zue jamka ale a cha ni diila.

ref: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
text: Dii nyiŋla, tama meena ka daa legi po, ti bo ka kantueŋ po.

ref: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
text: Alege tama ka nuru baai ale a tom ti tuimaŋa kantueŋ la. Dila nyiŋla, ni basi ate ti yik tidek. Ase tugurik tɔŋdɔba ale a gomsi badek a cheŋ kpaliŋ po diila, ku a fɛ kama ayen ti gomsi tidek ale siaka nalimnyiini ale yaalika, abe ti ta yiila ayen Wen le vari ti a basi.

ref: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
text: Yeezu kpi ka tama nyiŋ, ayen wa dan ŋman pilim jam, tama meena baai ale diem vua la, yaase baai ale kpi la, tama ale bala meena le ta ka nyuvuri a bo ale wa.

ref: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
text: Dila nyiŋ ni be a te chaab nyiŋbiiri abe ni a maari chaab ate ni siaka a pagra ase ni ale a nye dii pooma la.

ref: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
text: Ti suata, ti a saalim ni ayen ni a zuli nuru baai ate ti Naawenni a lueri ayen ba chim ni kpaga a tom nalimnyiini a te ni abe ba a kaam ni la.

ref: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
text: Ni a te ba zula yegayega abe ni a yaali ba tuimaŋa ate ba a tom la nyiŋ. Ni ta nɔiyeŋ ale chaab mɛ.

ref: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
text: Ti suata, ti a weeni ni kama ayen ni kaam nyiŋworuk nyama, abe ni a te baai ale a chali yɔgsum la nyiŋbiiri, abe ni a maari baai siaka ale kan soa diila, abe ni ta chichiiba ale nuru meena.

ref: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
text: Ni wanyi mɛ la kan tom tuimbaata a tuni tuimbaata. Ni pii nyiŋ ate ni kasim a tom tuimaŋsa nyiini a te chaab ale nuru meena.

ref: Always be joyful
text: Ni ta suipeentik daa meena.

ref: and never stop praying.
text: Ni kasim a puusi diipo meena.

ref: Don't turn away God's Spirit
text: Ni kan a kasi Wen Chiika tuimaŋa.

ref: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
text: Ni chamsi wari meena a nya. Ni yik dii ale nala la.

ref: and don't have anything to do with evil.
text: Ni zɛri biem buuri meena.

ref: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
text: Mi a puusi a te ka Wen dii ale a basi ate ti a boro ale suiyɔgni la, ayen wa le basi ate ni chim nuru weleŋsa wie meena po, abe wa nya ni chiisaŋa ale ni nyiŋsaŋa zuk ate ni kan ta kaasuŋŋoa diipo ate ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita a ŋman pilim cheena la.

ref: Friends, please pray for us.
text: Ti suata, ni a puusi Wen a te ti meena,

ref: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
text: abe ni puusi ti suataŋa meena nalimnyiini.

ref: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
text: Mi, Pɔɔl ta ka ti Naawenni pagrimu ate mi a weeni ni ayen ni karim gbaŋka de a sak Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma meena baai ale bo dula la.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
text: Ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ŋmanteka bo ale ni.

ref: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Mi Pɔɔl ale ŋmarisi gbaŋka de ayen mi ale Silas ale Timoti a puusi nama baai ale a va Yeezu Tesalonika tɛŋka po la. Ti Kowa Wen ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ale soa ni.

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
text: Bala ale ba a niak ni abe ba basi ate ni boro ale suiyɔgni.

ref: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
text: Ti suata, daa meena ku a fɛ kama ayen ti a te Wen jiam ni nyiŋ. Ku be magsi kama ayen ti a nye dila, dii nyiŋla ni siaka a kasim a zuak ka nna yegayega ate ni yaalika ale chaab mɛ a zuak nna yegayega.

ref: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
text: Dila ale soa ate ti a weeni Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma jigi meena ate ti a cheŋ la ayen ti ta kanjanta ale ni kama. Dii nyiŋla nuruba nye kama ate ni a nya ninam nna yegayega alege ni diem yik nidek kama a ta siaka nalimnyiini ale Wen.

ref: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
text: Wieŋa de meena a sak kama ayen Wen buusaŋa ka wensie buusa. Ni be yik nidek nalimnyiini ni ninammu po diila, Wen le weeni kama ayen ni yaa magsi wa naam buui nyiŋ ate nuruba basi ate ni a nam la po joka kama.

ref: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
text: Wa le pai waalika a te nuru baai ale jam soa ate ni a nam la. Wa ale wa maarɔ pagrɔma ale maa chaab

ref: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
text: a jam ale bolim ŋiak. Nya kude a dan nye Wen yaa le basi ate baai ale a zɛri Wen ale kan va wa wamaŋsaŋa ŋaai ale a biisi ti Naawenni Yeezu wie la, a nya waalika.

ref: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
text: Wen le yeeri ba wa boka jigini ale wa zuli pagrika jigini ate ba nya ninam buui ale kan ta kpeglimka la.

ref: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
text: Dila ale soa ate daa meena ti a puusi Wen ayen wa gomsi ni a magsi nye bo kaai choa ate wa wi ni ayen ni boro la. Ti a puusi mɛ a te wa kama ayen wa le pai wa pagrimu a nye ate ni popola ŋaai ate ni a poli ayen ni chim nuru maŋsa la, ale ni siak kaai ale a basi ate ni a tom tuimaŋsa la meena a ŋmasi chim wensie nalimnyiini.

ref: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
text: Suik kula po ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita yuei le nya zula nama nyiŋ ate nama mɛ a nya zula wa nyiŋ. Nya kude ale nye kama dii nyiŋla, ti Wen ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita a ta ŋmanteka ale ni kama.

ref: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
text: Mi a yaali ayen m ŋman weeni yɔgyɔgla a sak ni ka diipo ate ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita le ŋman pilim jam ate tama ale wa a tu chaab la wie. Ti suata, ti a saalim ni,

ref: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
text: ayen nuruba a dan weeni ayen ti Naawenni Pilim Jamka Danni a paari kama ni kan basi ate ku deri daani ni ni popola po yaase ni sue. Nuru bala chaab a dan weeni ni ayen ka Wen ale weeni ba ayen ba weeni ni dila, yaase ba sak ni dila yaase ba karim ka gbaŋ ate ka weeni ayen ka tama ale ŋmarisi ka ayen Naawen Pilim Jamka Danni a paari kama, ni kan wom ba biiga.

ref: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
text: Ni baga a teeri diipo ate m jam boro ale ni la? M jam weeni ni wieŋa de meena kama.

ref: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
text: Alege jaab ale boro a nye ate wieŋa de an diem nye ya. Nama dek seba jaamu de kama. Da dii ate Wen a lueri la a dan paari, wa le pai wadek a sak.

ref: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
text: Nuruba a deri poom boro a tom ka tuimbaata, alege nuruba yegayega a zɛ ku kiri ya. Dii ale cheen ayen di nye la, a kan nye yegayega yɔgyɔgla ase ka jabuui ale a kasi di nyeka yegayega la a nin cheŋ

ref: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
text: alege ate gaasa nyɔnɔwa a yaa nya suik a nyini. Alege ti Naawenni Yeezu a dan ŋman pilim jam, wa le ko wa ale wa nɔnni po vuusumu. Wa nyaksika ale kaasi wa mɛ.

ref: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
text: Gaasa nyɔnɔwa ale liŋ pai ka Sitaana pagrimu a tom pimpaasima wakperikaliisa nna yegayega,

ref: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
text: abe wa pai pimpaasima meena a paasi baai ate Wen seba ayen ba le kpi la, dii nyiŋla ba ale ba va wensie suiku ate ba nya varibasika la ba zɛri kama.

ref: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
text: baai meena ale zɛri wensieŋa alege ate ba sue a peenti ale tuimbaata tom ka la, wa le bo mini ba ate ba kpi.

ref: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
text: Ti suata, ku a magsi ti a nye Wen jiam kama daa meena Naawen ale a yaali ni la nyiŋ. Wen dɛ niŋ a lueri ka nama a yaa basi ate Wa Chiika pagrimu a vari ni basi ale basi ate ni chim nuru weleŋsa ni siaka ale wensie nyiŋ.

ref: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Ti ale jam sak ni Wen wamaŋsaŋa la, wa jam wi ni kama ayen ni nya varibasika de ate dai yeŋ ni ta ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita zulaŋa.

ref: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
text: Ti suata, dila nyiŋla, ni ŋmasi za giŋgiŋ abe ni va wensie sinsak ŋaai ate ti jam bo ale ni a sak ni ale nɔi a yaase ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate ti ŋmarisi gbaŋ a sak ni la.

ref: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
text: Ti Kowa Wen a yaali ti kama ale kasim a te ti nyiŋbiiri taam wuu ale basi mɛ ate ti ta yiila nalimnyiini wa ŋmanteka nyiŋ.

ref: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
text: Ni a puusi Wen mɛ ayen wa vari ti a ta nyini nuru baai ale a tom tuimbaata la nisa po, dii nyiŋla, nuruba yegayega a ka siaka ale wamaŋsaŋa.

ref: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
text: Alege ti Naawenni ka wensie nyɔnɔ. Wa le pai wa pagrimu a te ni abe wa vari ni jabioku jigi a basi.

ref: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
text: Ti Naawenni abe basi kama ate tama seba chak ayen ni a tom ka dii ate ti weeni ni la, ni abe le kasim a tom ka dila.

ref: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
text: Ti Naawenni ale basi ate ni miŋ wa yaalika ale chichiibaŋa ate wa te ni la nalimnyiini.

ref: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
text: Ti suata, ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita yuenni nyiŋ ate ti a weeni ni wieŋa de meena. Ni kan pai nidek a gum chaab ale baai ale ta nyiŋworuk, ale kan va sinsak ŋaai ate ti sak ni la.

ref: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
text: Nama dek seba kama nalimnyiini ayen ku magsi ka ni a tom dii ate ti jam bo ale ni a tom la. Ti jam ka nyiŋworukwa.

ref: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
text: Ti jam a tom ka nna yegayega yok ale kantueŋ meena, ayen ti dɛ tidek nyiŋ wulum ŋanta. Ti an jam a yaali ayen ni a nam tama nyiŋŋa. Dila ale soa ate ti nyiem tuni ŋandiin tii meena ate ni jam a te ti la.

ref: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, ti wom ayen ni ba gela ka nyiŋworuk nyam a pai nidek a nyo nuruba wie po.

ref: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
text: Ti a weeni ba kama ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita yuei nyiŋ ayen ba basi ate ba nina muni ate ba a dɛ badek wulum ŋanta abe ba a tom ba tuimaŋa chim.

ref: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
text: Ti suata, ni kan jiak ale tuimaŋsa tomka.

ref: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
text: Nuru a dan bo ni po ate wa kan yaali ayen wa va dii ate ti ŋmarisi gbaŋka de po la, ni ŋmasi nya wa chak. Ni kan basi ate wa maa gum ni po, dila le basi ate wa nya chivie.

ref: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
text: Ni kan nye wa jigi ase wa ka ni dachiak la, alege ni pii nyiŋ ate ni tagri wa popola ate wa va ni suiku ase wa ka ni suok la.

ref: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
text: Ti a saalim ti Naawenni dii ale ka suiyɔgni nyɔnɔ la, ayen wa le bo ale ni meena ate ni kasim boro ale masim wie meena po.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
text: M be ŋman a saalim ayen ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ŋmanteka a bo ale ni meena.

ref: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
text: Mi, Pɔɔl ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de. Baai ale lueri mu ayen m chim tuimtomdɔ la, ale, Wen dii ale ka ti Varibasidɔ la ale Yeezu Kirisita waai ate ti ta yiila wa jigi la. Bala ale maa chaab a lueri mu.

ref: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
text: Mi a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ka fi, Timoti m biika waai ate mi a sak fu ate fi ta siaka ale Yeezu Kirisita la. Wen ti Kowa ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ale ŋmante fu abe ba ta jiirim ale fu abe ba basi ate fi boro ale suiyɔgni.

ref: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
text: Weeni ba ayen ba pai sunsuelimaŋa ale ba daa meena kokpieŋsa wie sinsaŋŋa a basi, dii nyiŋla, ba sinsaŋŋa a nye ate ka nuruba a nak nanpaga ale chaab daa meena. Ba ale a nye diila, a kan basi ate nuruba a tom ale siaka Wen ale te ba dii ayen ba tom la.

ref: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
text: Nuruba ba gela basi nya kude meena kama alege daa meena a kasim a nak nanpaga kayaata.

ref: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
text: Bala chaab a yaali kama ayen nuruba a jam ba jigi a bek ba Wen sinsaŋŋa wie ate ba yaa sak ba. Alege, badek zɛ wie ŋaai ate ba a biisi ale sebchakka la kiriya.

ref: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
text: Ti seba ayen Moosis Sinsaŋŋa nala kama, ase nuruba a nin pai ŋa a tom ŋa ale a weeni diila.

ref: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
text: Wen an pai wa sinsaŋŋa a te ka baai ate wa nye ate ba chim wayɔrisima nyam la. Wa pai ŋa a te ka nuru baai ale kan a va ŋa ale a zɛri Wen nɔi la baai ale kan a yaali Wen wie womka ale baai ale kan daa weleŋsa nyam la ale baai ale a ko nuruba ale maara a ko badek koba ale ba maba,

ref: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
text: ba a bobi nipooba a goa ale a yaali nidoaba bobi goom, a yik nuruba a ta cheŋ ga a da a nyiem a biisi venta wie, ale a pɛ a velim ale a tom tuim ŋaai meena ale kan a va wensie suiku sinsaŋŋa la.

ref: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
text: Wensie sinsaŋŋa a bo ka Wen wamaŋsaŋa po, ate Wen a pai te mi ayen m mooli Wen dii ale a ta zula ale a niak nuruba la wie.

ref: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
text: Mi a te Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita jiam, dii nyiŋla, wa jam seba mu a chak kama ate wa yaa lueri mu ayen m chim wa tomteerɔ. Wa pai wa pagrimu mɛ a te mu ayen mi a tom wa tuimaŋa.

ref: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
text: Dila po mi jam a kaasi ka wa yue, ale a lɛ wa ale a daani wa yegayega. M jam ka siaka ale wa. Dila ale soa ate m jam zɛ m ale jam a nye diila. Alege Wen a jam ta jiirim ale mu,

ref: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
text: ale a maari mu yegayega ti Naawenni ŋmanteka nyiŋ ayen m siak a te wa ate ku nye ate m ta yaalika ale nuruba. Siaka de ale yaalika de abe nyini ka Yeezu Kirisita jigi, dii nyiŋla, tama ale wa a yaa ka bunyi.

ref: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
text: Ka wensie ale magsi mɛ ayen nuruba siak a te nya kude ayen Yeezu Kirisita a jam tɛŋzuk de meena ayen wa vari ka nuruba ba tuimbaata po a basi ate ba va Wen. Mi dek jam a tom ka tuimbaata a gaam nuru meena

ref: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
text: alege, yɔgyɔgla de Wen a yaa ta jiirim ale mu kama. Ka boan nyiŋ ate wa nye dila mi tuimbaata naawa jigi ya? Wa nye kama ayen Yeezu Kirisita ale ta chichiiba nalimnyiini ale mi diila, ku le sak ka baai ale ba jam ta siaka ale wa la ayen wa le nye ka dila dekdega ba jigi ate ba mɛ nya wa nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.

ref: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
text: Basi ate ti a pak Wen daa meena abe ti a te wa zula. Wa ka ti Naab waai ale kasim boro diipo meena wuu la. Wa ka wanyi dekki. Nuru an baga a nya wa. Ku be nye dila.

ref: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
text: Abe fi siak te wa nalimnyiini a va wa ale popola maŋsa. Nuruba gela an va wa ale popola maŋsa ate ba pai ŋaaŋ a te ŋa ate ba siaka a deri kaasi.

ref: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
text: Nuruba bayewa Yimeniyus ale Alezanda a jam maa ka ba po. Mi ale pai ba a nyo Sitaana nisima po ayen ba zamsi yam ate ba kan a lɛ Wen ya.

ref: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de mi a yaali kama ayen ni a nye Wen jiam abe ni a saalim wa a puusi a te waai meena

ref: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
text: ale nalima ale baai meena ale a nya ti zuk la. Puusi Wen ayen wa maari ba ate ti meena a boro ale suiyɔgni abe ti a va Wen nalimnyiini abe ti a zuli wa.

ref: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
text: Ti dan nye nna meena ku a peenti Wen ti Varibasidɔwa sui kama.

ref: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
text: Wa a yaali ayen ka waai meena ate nya varibasika ba tuimbaata po ate ba jam va wa a seba wa wensieŋa.

ref: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
text: Dii nyiŋla Wen ka dinyi. Ka sanyigmoa yeŋ mɛ ale bo Wen ale nurubiik suŋsuŋ. Nuru wala abe ale Yeezu Kirisita.

ref: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
text: Dila ale soa ate wa lueri mi ayen m chim wa tuimtomdɔ a ga sak nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la. Ayen m ga a sak ba ate ba ta siaka ale wa abe ba seba wa wensieŋa. Wie ŋaai ate mi a biisi la ka wensie. Mi daa velimvendika.

ref: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
text: Dila nyiŋ ate mi a yaali ayen jigi meena nidoama ale va Wen nalimnyiini la, a zak nisim weleŋsa wen a puusi abe ba kan ta suipuurum ale nanpaga nakka ale chaaba.

ref: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
text: Mi a yaali mɛ ayen nipooma a kan a jo gatta ase nidoa yaalisa la, alege ba a jo ba gattaŋa ale yam. Ba kan pai ligra yegayega a da ŋanta a bobi ba zuk zuisaŋa, abe ba kan a su ni felima ŋaai diak ale pagra la, abe ba kan a jo garuk tii diak ale pagra la.

ref: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
text: Alege ku nala kama ate ba basi ate tuimaŋsa a tagri ba nalimu yaalika kɔlimaŋa. Dii nyiŋla, ba a va ka Wen.

ref: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
text: Ku a fɛ kama ate nipooba a seba badek yikka nalimnyiini abe ba nye nna chim a wom sinsaŋŋa.

ref: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
text: Mi kan siak ayen nipooba a sak nidoaba yaase, ba ta pagrim nidoaba zuwa. Ba a nye chim.

ref: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
text: Dii nyiŋla Wen a liŋ nye ka Adam alege ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ a nye Iiv.

ref: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
text: Sitaana an jam paasi Adam, ka nipowa ate wa jam paasi ate wa kaasi Wen sinsaŋŋa.

ref: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
text: Alege nipok a dan boro a biak bisa, Wen a nya wa zuk kama ase wa nin kasim ta siaka ale wa ale ta yaalika ale suinum weleŋ ale seba nyemagsika.

ref: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
text: Ku a fɛ ayen wa kan chim danyuirik ale tugurik nyɔnɔ, abe wa kan a yaali ligra ale wa popola meena ku a fɛ ayen wa seba wadek yikka daa meena, abe wa chim suiyɔgni nyɔnɔ.

ref: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
text: Abe wa baga a nya wa dɔkdemma zuk nalimnyiini ate wa bisaŋa a siak wa nɔi abe ba a zuli wa.

ref: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
text: Nuru a dan kan baga a nya wa dɔkdemma zuwa, wa le nye ka sɛ a nya baai ale a va Yeezu Kirisita la?

ref: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
text: Waai mɛ ale chim Kirisita biik ate ku an diem beni la, kan chim Kirisita bisa kpagiya. Wa dan deri chim kpagi nwuli, wa a ta ka kanjanta ate Wen a bo mini wa ase jabioku la.

ref: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
text: Ku a fɛ kama mɛ ayen ni lueri nuru waai ale a nya zula nuru baai ale kan a va Yeezu Kirisita la jigiya. Kan daa di, chum diipo wa le nya chivie ate wa pai wadek a nyo jabioku baruku po.

ref: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
text: Alege ku a fɛ ayen ba a ta popola yena ale wensie ŋaai ale jam suk ate Wen a yaa nye ate ŋa nyini peelim la.

ref: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
text: Kirisita bisaŋa a liŋ zamsi ba a nya, ate ba dan kan ta wari ya ba yaa chim ba maarɔba.

ref: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
text: Suik kula po ku a fɛ kama mɛ ayen ba pooma nyeka a nala, ba kan chim bumbobrɔba, ba yik badek nalimnyiini abe ba ta wensie wie meena po.

ref: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
text: Ku a fɛ ate maarɔ a ta nipok yeŋ nyiini abe ba a nya ba dɔkdemma zuk nalimnyiini.

ref: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
text: Baai ale a tom a te nalimnyiini la, le nya zula ate ba kan a chali yɔgsum ale nuruba biisi te ka, ba siaka ale Yeezu Kirisita ale ka diila.

ref: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
text: Mi a yiili kama ayen m jam fi jigi daaŋa de po, alege mi a ŋmarisi wieŋa de a te fu kama

ref: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
text: alege m dan beni, mi a ŋmarisi kama ate fi seba waai ale wa a yik wadek dii Wen yenni po la, dii ale ka Wen dii ale vua la yeri la, a chim zaŋŋi ale a nya Wensie zuk la.

ref: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
text: Wensie ŋaai ale jam suk ate Wen a yaa nye ate ŋa nyini peelim la, tama abe siak kama ayen wensieŋa de ka wa kpienni: Yeezu Kirisita a jam chim ka nurubiik ate Wen Chiika a sak nuruba ayen Yeezu ka wensie nyɔnɔ. Wa pai wadek a sak Wen maarɔma ate ba nya wa ate Wen yaa a nye ate wa yiti kum po a jueli wenŋmazuk Wen jigi. Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a biisi wa wamaŋsaŋa ate ŋa tagli tɛŋka meena ate nuruba a ta siaka ale wa.

ref: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
text: Wen Chiika a nyini ka peelim a weeni ayen chum diipo, nuruba ale basi ba siaka, abe ba wom chichirisa venta wie abe ba va chichirik baata sinsaga.

ref: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
text: Sinsaŋŋa de chaab pimpaasima nyam ale velim ate ŋa tagli jigi meena. Ba popolaŋa a kpi kama, nna ase ba a pai kutuk tuiluk a ji ba zuimaŋa la.

ref: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
text: Ŋanta meena ate Wen a nye la, a nala kama. Dila nyiŋla, fi dan nya jaab ate fi yaa nye Wen jiam jaamu nyiŋ, kan chali yɔgsum, tanla.

ref: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
text: Ti dan nye dila, Wen wanni ale tama puusaŋa le basi kama ate jaab wala chim jaweleŋ a te ti.

ref: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
text: Fi dan pai wensie sinsaŋŋa de a sak fi suataŋa Kirisita bisaŋa fi le chim ka Yeezu Kirisita tomteerɔ maŋ. Wie ŋaai ate fi va ŋa ale siak a te wensieŋa sinsaŋŋa mɛ la, ŋala meena le basi kama ate fi siaka a chim a gumdu.

ref: As the saying goes, “Exercise is good for your body, but religion helps you in every way. It promises life now and forever.” These words are worthwhile and should not be forgotten.
text: Ka wensie ate nuruba weeni nya kude, ku be magsi ka nuruba siak nalimnyiini ayen ku ka wensie.

ref: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
text: Ti a tom ti tuimaŋa yegayega a te ka Wen dii ale sum boro la. Dii nyiŋla, ti ta yiila wa jigi kama. Wa ka waai meena Varibasidɔ alege wa potim a vari ka baai ale ta siaka ale wa la a basi.

ref: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
text: A weeni abe fi a sak nuruba wieŋa de.

ref: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
text: Basi ate fi boka po ale fi biik po, ale fi tuim naliŋsa po ale fi yaalika ale fi siaka ale fi weleŋsa, a sak Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma ba le ba nye dii a va Wen la. Fi diem ka bi paaluk alege fi daa nye dila nuru kan nya suik a pai fi chim biiga.

ref: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
text: Basi ate fi nina muni ate fi a karim Wen gbaŋka ate waai meena a wom. Saalim ba ate ba va Wen suiku. Pai ka mɛ a sak nuruma Wen wie ate m jam.

ref: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
text: Kan baŋ tiirim buui ate Wen a pai a te fu diipo ate Wen biisiteerɔma a biisi Wen pagrim nyiŋ ate Kirisita bisa kpaŋŋa a yaa pai ba nisaŋa a vi fu zuk la.

ref: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
text: Basi ate tuimaŋa de a bo fi suinum po ate fi va ŋa, ate nuruba meena a nya fi ale a tom tuimaŋsa dii a gumdu la.

ref: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
text: Kpesi fidek fi boka jigi ale fi ale a sak nuruma diila. Fi dan va wieŋa de nalimnyiini, dai yeŋ Wen le jam vari fidek ale baai ale wom fi nɔi la tuimbaata po a basi.

ref: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
text: Kan biisi jakpak a kaasi, alege biisi ale wa ase wa ka fi ko la. A biisi ale nidoabilisaŋa ase ba ka fi suata la,

ref: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
text: ale nipok kpagsaŋa ase ba ka fi maba la ale nipokbilisaŋa ase ba ka fi toaba la ale weleŋsa.

ref: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
text: A te zula pukɔga ŋaai ale kan ta nuruba ate ba a nya ba la.

ref: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
text: ) Ba ŋman pilim ŋmarisi ayen, <<Ku a fɛ kama ayen tomteerɔ a tuesi wa tutunaŋa.>> (Luuk

ref: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
text: Pukɔgi dii ale sum ka pukɔgi ale ka nuru ate wa a nya wa zuk la, ta yiila Wen jigi kama a yaa a puusi wa yok ale kantueŋ a nya wa maarika.

ref: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
text: Alege pukɔgi dii ale kasim va wadek suinum yaalika suita la, a poom kpi kama ale vua.

ref: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
text: Nuru waai a dan kan a nya wa nuruba zuwa, baai ale ŋmasi ka wa dɔkdem la, ku a sak ase wa basi wa siaka kama la. Wa poom chim nuru biok a gaam waai ale kan seba Wen la kama.

ref: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
text: Kan pai pukɔgi dii ale kan paari bena pisiyuebi a maa gum pukɔŋŋa po. Dii ale gum du la, waai ale yali bunyi dekki,

ref: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
text: Pukɔgi dii a dan kan paari bena pisiyuebi, kan ŋmarisi wa yuenni a nyo gbaŋka po dii nyiŋla, da dii dai wa a yaali kama ayen wa yali chora paalik. Wa kan ŋman ta ku wa suinum po ayen wa a tom ka Yeezu tuima.

ref: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
text: Wala choa mɛ a zamsi ka nyiŋworuk ale a togli nuruba yie a pai wadek a nyo ba wie po ale a bobri ale a biisi wie ŋaai ale kan magsi wa a biisi la.

ref: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
text: Mi a yaali ayen pukɔga baai ale diem ka nipok paalisa la, a yali chorɔba a biak bisa a nya ba dɔkdemma zuk ate ti dachaasaŋa kan nya suik a biisi gaam ti.

ref: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, pukɔgi paalisaŋa ba gela a deri basi Wen suiku kama ale a va Sitaana.

ref: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
text: Nipok waai a dan ka Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔ ate wa ta pukɔga wa dɔkdemma po ku a fɛ ayen wa a nya ba zuk. Wa kan basi ate Kirisita bisaŋa a ji jimmu de. Ka pukɔga ŋaai ale kan ta nuruba la, ate Kirisita bisaŋa a nya ba zuk.

ref: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
text: Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la kpaŋŋa ale a nya ba nuruma zuk nalimnyiini la, ale baai dek ale a sak Wen wieŋa nalimnyiini la, ku a fɛ ate bala a nya tutuna nna yegayega.

ref: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
text: Ba ŋmarisi Wen gbaŋka po ayen, <<Kan bobi naab buui ate fi yik a fɔbi zaaŋa la nɔi ya.>> (Teerika

ref: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
text: Baai ale a tom tuimbaata la, pii nyiŋ ate fi biisi ba a kaasi nuruma niŋ ate yɔgsum yik waai meena.

ref: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
text: Wen ale Yeezu Kirisita ale Wen maarɔma baai ate wa lueri la meena ale mi seerɔba ate m za a weeni fu ayen fi va mi sinsaŋŋa de, ate fi kan a yaali nuruba gela abe fi a zɛri ba gela.

ref: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
text: Kan kpabi pai fi nisa a vi nuruba zuk ayen ba chim ti Naawenni tomteerɔba dii nyiŋla, ti dan nye dila ate ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate ba a tom tuimbaata, fi mɛ maa bo ba tuimbaataŋa po kama. Dila nyiŋ yik fidek daa meena ale suinum weleŋ.

ref: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
text: Kan fi a nyu nyiam nyiini, a nyu daam magadek fi ponni ale kasim a daani fu la nyiŋ. Fi dan nye dila, ku le maari fu.

ref: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
text: Nuruba gela a kan suk a tom ba tuimbaataŋa. Ate Wen ale bo ba buusa.

ref: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
text: Ku a fɛ ayen baai ale ka yɔm la, a te ba nyama zula nalimnyiini ate nuru kan baga a kaasi Wen yue a weeni ayen ti sinsaŋŋa ka sinsak kayaata.

ref: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
text: Ba nyama a dan ka Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔba, ku a fɛ ayen ba kan weeni ayen ba nyama ale ka Kirisita bisa la nyiŋŋa ba kan te ba zula. Alege ba a tom a te ba nalimnyiini dii nyiŋla, baai ale a nya nyuenta ba tuimaŋa po la ka ba Kirisita bisa chaab baai ate ba ta yaalika ale ba la. A sak fi nuruma wieŋa de, abe fi a saalim ba ate ba va ŋa.

ref: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Baai meena ale a zɛri ayen ba kan siak a te ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita wensie wieŋa ŋaai ate ti a va nalimnyiini alege a pai ba dek sinsaŋŋa a sak nuruba la,

ref: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
text: ba ta ka kanjanta alege ba zɛ jaaboa. Daa meena ba a yaali ka nanpaga yegayega nakka, a yaali ayen ba a nye kpaliŋsa wie zuk, ate bala dek ale baai ale a wom ba wieŋa la yaa a de nyuri ale a waaŋ chaab ale a kaasi chaab yue. Ba mɛ ta ka chichama baata ale chaab.

ref: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
text: Bala meena popolaŋa a kan ŋman a tom. Wensieŋa abe ŋman ka ba jigiya. Daa meena ba a kpaliŋ ka chaab ale a poli ayen ba dan va Wen suiku ba le chim ka ligra nyam.

ref: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
text: Ku ka wensie ayen fi dan va Wen suiku ate fi sui peenti ale ŋan baai ate fi ta la, fi jigsi kama.

ref: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
text: Dii nyiŋla, ba ale biak ti la, ti an jam ta jaab a jam tɛŋzuk de. Ti be dan kpi, ti an diem baga le pai jaab a ta cheŋ.

ref: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
text: Dila nyiŋla, ti dan ta ŋandiinta a dɛ ale gatta a jo dila magsi ti kama.

ref: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
text: Alege baai ale a yaali ayen ba chim jigsirɔba la, Sitaana le jam a paasi ba abe wa bari ba ba betta tuimaŋa po ale ba tuimbaata yaalika ate ba jam kaasi nna yegayega.

ref: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
text: Dii nyiŋla, tuimbaata meena tɔgatɔga piilimka a nyini ka ligra yaalika yegayega jigi a jam. Nuruba gela a ta ku ba suiniima po ka nna yegayega ayen ba ti nya ligra. Dila ale soa ate ba a basi Wen suiku ate ba suiniima a kaasi nna yegayega la.

ref: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
text: Alege fi Timoti, waai ale va Wen la, kan a tom tuimbaataŋa de ate m poom weeni fu la. Basi ate fi nina muni ale tuimaŋsa tomka abe fi a va Wen nalimnyiini. Ta siaka ale wa abe fi ta yaalika ale nuru meena, yik fidek. A nam fi ninammu.

ref: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
text: M za ka Wen niŋ waai ale te ŋanta meena nyuvuri la, ale Yeezu Kirisita waai ale nyini peelim a biisi wensieŋa ale Pontios Paalɔt la niŋ,

ref: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
text: a weeni fu ayen, fi va dii ate m sak fu la. Ta suinum weleŋ, ate waai kan baga a kaasi fi yue alege ate ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita a ŋman pilim jam.

ref: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
text: Wen ale basi ate ku nye diipo ate wadek a yaali la, Wen dii ale ta niauŋ ale a nya wari meena zuk la, ale chim nalima meena Naab ale wena meena Wen la.

ref: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
text: Wen nyiini ale boro diipo meena wuu ale bo wa jigini juijui ale a nyaksi a gaam wenbinni la. Nuru an baga jo ku jigini. Nuru an diem nya Wen yaa, yaase wa baga a nya wa. Wa pagrimu ale wa zulaŋa a boro ka diipo meena wuu. Ku be nye dila.

ref: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
text: A sak nuru baai ale ta ŋanta yegayega la ayen ba kan a yaali yue ba ŋantaŋa nyiŋŋa. Ba kan ta yiila ba ŋantaŋa nyiŋŋa, a poli ayen ba ale kasim a nya ka masim ba nyiŋŋa. Da dii dai ba le jam a kaasi kama. Alege weeni ba ayen ba ta yiila Wen jigi waai ale a te ŋanta meena ate ti sue a peenti la.

ref: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
text: Ŋanta yegayega nyama de weeni ba ayen, ba jigsi mɛ ale tuimaŋsa tomka abe ba a yaali ayen ba pai ba ŋantaŋa a chari nuruba ba chaab.

ref: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
text: Dii nyiŋla, nuruba gela a jam va ba kama alege basi Wen wensie suiku vaka. Wen ŋmanteka le bo ale ni meena.

ref: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
text: Mi a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ka fi Timoti m dek biika Yeezu Kirisita yue nyiŋ. Ti Kowa Wen ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita le ŋmante fu abe ba ta jiirim ale fu abe ba basi ate fi boro ale suiyɔgni.

ref: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
text: Mi a te Wen dii ate mi a tom a te ale popola maŋsa ase ti kokpieŋsaŋa ale jam a tom diila jiam daa meena fi nyiŋ. Yɔk ale kantueŋ m dan boro a puusi a te fu mi a nye Wen ka jiam fi nyiŋ.

ref: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
text: Mi a teeri diipo ate fi jam a kum la kama. M be ŋman pilim a yaali ka nna yegayega ayen m nya fu, ate m suipeentik yegayega.

ref: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
text: M seba ayen fi makpieŋka Loyis ale fi mawa Yunis ta siaka yegayega kama ale Yeezu. Mi a teeri ayen fi mɛ ta wensie siaka kama ale wa ase bala la.

ref: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
text: Dila ale soa ate mi a yaali ayen fi teeri diipo ate m jam pai m nisaŋa a vi fi zuk la, Wen ale jam pai wa tiirimu a te fu. Yɔgyɔgla m be ŋman a weeni fu kama ayen fi pai fi tiirimu a tom tuima.

ref: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
text: Kan chali yɔgsum ayen fi weeni a sak nuruba ti Naawenni Kirisita wie. Kan chali chivie mɛ ale mi nuruba jigiya, dii nyiŋ la, ba le jam yik mi a lik dɔk po Kirisita nyiŋla. Ku nala kama ate fi mɛ maa nam Wen wamaŋsaŋa nyiŋ ate Wen a yaa pai wa pagrimu a te fu fi ninammu po.

ref: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
text: Wen wi ti kama ayen ti chim wa nuru weleŋsa ate wa vari ti ti tuimbaata po a basi ate ti va wa. Daa tama dek tuima nyiŋ ate wa nye dila. Alege, ku jam ka wadek yaalika a ta nyini diipo ate wa an diem nye ŋanta meena tɛŋzuk dela ayen wa va Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ a ŋmante ti.

ref: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
text: Yɔgyɔgla de, ŋmanteka de ate wa a ŋmante ti la, wa yaa basi kama ate ka va ti Varibasidɔwa Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ ate ka nyini peelim ate ti nya ka. Kirisita a jam nya pagrim kama kum zuk. Bu ŋman ka pagrimoa. Wa pai Wen wamaŋsaŋa a sak ti ka wa nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.

ref: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
text: Wen ale lueri mi ayen m chim wa tuimtomdɔ a cheŋ ga sak nuruba wa wamaŋsaŋa.

ref: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
text: Tuimaŋa de nyiŋ abe ale soa ate mi a nam la. Alege m suinummu a diem pagra kama ate mi a sak, dii nyiŋla, m seba waai ate m ta siaka ale wa la kama. M be seba ayen wa baga nya dii ate m pai nyo wa nisa po la zuk kama a ta ga paari dai dii dai ate wa le ŋman pilim a jam la.

ref: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
text: Mi ale jam bo ale fu la, m jam sak fu Wen wensie wieŋa ayen fu va ŋa. Yɔgyɔgla de ŋmasi yik m wensie sinsaŋŋa de nalimnyiini, ale siaka, ale yaalika, nyaŋa de ŋayewa ate Yeezu Kirisita a te ti la.

ref: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
text: Wen Chiika waai ale bo ti suiniima po la ale pai wensie sinsaŋŋa a nyo ti nisima po. Be ŋmasi yik ŋa nalimnyiini.

ref: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
text: Fidek seba ayen baai meena ale bo Asia tɛŋka po ale mi la a basi mi kama. Ba be ka Figelus ale Yemogenes.

ref: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
text: Onesiforus ale deŋsi mi kpai a paari dii choa. Dila nyiŋla, ti Naawenni le ta jiirim ale wa ale wa dɔkdemma. Wa an jam chali chivie ale mi ba le jam yik mi a lik la nyiŋŋa.

ref: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
text: Fi mɛ seba chak wa le jam maari mi yegayega dii Efisos tɛŋka la. Naawen le ta jiirim ale wa dai dii danni ate wa le ŋman pilim a jam la.

ref: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
text: M nidoabiliga, ku ka Wen ŋmanteka nyiŋ ate tama ale Yeezu Kirisita a chim bunyi. Dila nyiŋla, be ta pagrim.

ref: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
text: Sinsak ŋaai ate mi a pai sak fu nuru boari suŋsuŋ la ba wom kama. Fi mɛ pai sinsak ŋala dek a sak nuru baai ale ka wensie nyam ate ba mɛ baga a pai ŋa a sak ba vaanchaab ate ku tagli a cheŋ.

ref: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
text: Tuesi fi ninammu ase tugurik tɔŋdɔ waai ale a tom wa tuimaŋa nalimnyiini la, dii nyiŋla, fi ka Yeezu Kirisita tugurik tɔŋdɔ.

ref: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
text: Yaase kpaarɔ waai ale a tom nalimnyiini wa talim po la, wala ale soa bie ŋaai ale liŋ a abe la alege ate cheka a yaa paari.

ref: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
text: A poli m le a weeni fu nna la. M seba chak kama ayen ti Naawenni le wa a maari fu ate fi miŋ m wieŋa a chak.

ref: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
text: A teeri Yeezu Kirisita waai ale jam ka Deevid ŋaaŋbiik la wie ayen wa yiti kum po kama. Wamaŋsaŋa de ate mi kasim a weeni a sak nuruba diipo meena ate mi a sak nuruba la.

ref: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
text: Wen wamaŋsaŋa nyiŋ ate ba yik mi a pai chɔrima a bobi mu ayen m nam ase tuim kaasima nyɔnɔ la. Alege ba an baga a bobi wa wanni.

ref: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
text: Dila ale soa ate m ta suinum pagrik ale m ninammu, ayen nuru baai ate Wen a lueri la a nya varibasika. Varibasika de a basi kama ate bala ale tama meena ale Yeezu Kirisita a chim bunyi ate ti yaa a nya zula ŋaai ale kan ta kpeglimka la.

ref: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
text: Ti dan siak a te ti ninammu ale ti suiniima meena, dai yeŋ tama ale wa le chim nalima. Ti be dan pagsi ayen ti zɛ wa, wa mɛ le pagsi ayen wa zɛ ti.

ref: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
text: Tama dan kan daa wensie nyama, wa kasim ka wensie nyɔnɔ diipo meena. Wa kan maari a chim nɔi buye nyɔnɔ.>>

ref: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
text: Teeri fi nuruma wieŋa de meena abe fi kaam ba ale nin muna Wen niŋ ayen ba kan a nak nanpaga kayaata ale wamaŋ a kan nyini nanpaga kayaataŋa de chaab po a nyini, ŋa goanti a kaasi ka nuru baai ale a wom la popola.

ref: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
text: Pii nyiŋ a tom Wen tuimaŋa nalimnyiini, ate wa pak fu ate fi kan chim tomteerɔ waai le wa nya chivie la, alege waai ale a sak wensie wamaŋsaŋa ate ku a magsi la.

ref: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
text: Ba ale kasim a biisi diila, ku a nye ase ka naworuk ale bo nuru nyiŋ a dɛ wa la. Yimeniyus ale Filitus a maa ka ba po.

ref: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
text: Nuruba bayewa de a basi Wen wensie suiku kama ate nuruba gela mɛ ale ta siaka ale Kirisita va ka la a basi wa va ka, dii nyiŋla ba a sak kama ayen diipo ate nuruba le yiti kum po la, taam kama.

ref: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
text: Alege nyubi dii ate Wen a nyubi la, di pagra ka nna yegayega, a kan choa. Wa ŋmarisi dueni di nyiŋ ayen, <<Naawen seba baai ate wa soa la kama,>> (Chiinika

ref: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
text: Taasa ale ŋanta tɔgatɔga yegayega ale bo yeri po la, ba pai ka ŋan baai ale a nyaksi a nye, ŋa gela ba pai ligmɔniŋ a nye, gela ba pai daata a nye, gela ba pai yak a mɛ. Ba gela ba pai zaani magsi ka nicham ŋanta nye teka, ba gela badek daa meena pai tomka.

ref: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
text: Waai a dan kan ta daŋta ale tuimbaataŋa de meena ate m liŋ weeni la, ase taasaŋa nyɔnɔwa ale pai taasi maŋsaŋa a nye nicham ŋanta la, Wen mɛ abe le pai nuru wala choa mɛ a tom ka tuimaŋsa meena.

ref: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
text: Ku a fɛ ayen ti Naawenni tomteerɔ kan a nye kpaliŋŋa. Ku a fɛ ate wa a te nuruba zula, abe wa chim sagrɔ maŋ waai ale ta suduŋni la.

ref: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
text: Nuruba a dan a zɛri wa sinsaŋŋa alege wa a yaali ayen wa sak ba, ku a fɛ ayen wa yik wadek. Da dii dai, Wen le te ba suik ate ba tulim a va wa abe ba seba wa wensieŋa.

ref: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
text: Ba dan nye dila, ba le baga a pilim a jam nya yam ate ba baga chali bɛ jabioku jigi waai ale jam bari yik ba a ta la ate ba yaa va Wen nɔi.

ref: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
text: A teeri fidek ayen tɛŋka a dan moata kpeglimka, ku le tua kama nuruba jigi.

ref: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
text: Nuruba le jam chim butuem nyam, ligi yaalisa, a yaali yuei nna yegayega, kanjanta nyam, abe ba a lɛ nuruba, abe ba a zɛri ba koba ale ba maba noa, nuru a dan nye wari a te ba ba sue kan peenti, ba kan yaali Wen wie womka,

ref: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
text: Ba ale puusi Wen ale ka ba noa nyiini alege a zɛri wa wensie pagrimu. Yeeri fidek nuru bala chaab po.

ref: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
text: Ba gela a suk kama a jo yie po a paasi nipooba, baai ale ta suinum baasinsa ate badek tuimbaata a daani ba la, ate badek ŋan yaalik mɛ a dari ba a ta a cheŋ jigi meena la.

ref: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
text: Nipooma de chaab a nyiem kasim a yaali sinsaga womka alege ba an baga wensieŋa a miŋ a chagi.

ref: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
text: Waai meena a nya Janes ale Jamberes ale ka betta diila kama. Ase waai meena ale nya ba bettaŋa diila ku kan beni alege ate dila dekdega a nye nidoa baai ate m poom liŋ a biisi ba wie la jigi ya.

ref: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
text: Yɔgyɔgla de va m sinsaŋŋa ale m nyeelaŋa ale m popolaŋa ale m siaka ale m suiduŋni ale m yaalika, ale m chichiibaŋa ale

ref: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
text: m namsika ale m ninammu, ŋade ale nye mu Antiok ale Ikoonium ale Lisitira, namsi kaai meena ate m chiibi, ate ku meena po Naawen a vari mu a basi.

ref: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
text: Nuru baai ale a yaali ayen ba pai badek a te Yeezu Kirisita a yaa va Wen la, nuruba basi ate ba nya ka ninam.

ref: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
text: Alege pimpaasirɔba baai ale a tom tuimbaata la, le jam tom tuimbaata a gumdu. Ba a paasi ka badek ale nuruba.

ref: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
text: Alege fi Timoti a va Wen wensie suiku kama. Fi seba baai ale jam ka fi sagrɔba la kama kasim ta siaka yegayega.

ref: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
text: Fi mɛ seba weleŋsa wieŋa Gbaŋsaŋa kama a ta nyini fi bi fiik po, sii ale a sak ayen nuru waai a dan ta siaka ale Yeezu Kirisita ku la nyɔnɔwa le nya varibasika kama la.

ref: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
text: Wen wieŋa meena ka Wen dek ale pai te a magsi sakka ale toariŋka, ale nye niaka ale zamsika wayɔrisima po,

ref: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
text: ate Wen nuruwa a gomsi paari a baga tuimaŋsa meena a tom.

ref: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
text: Yeezu Kirisita le bo ŋanvuta ale kpieba buusa. Wa abe le jam kama a chim naab.

ref: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
text: Wala ale Wen ale mi seerɔba ate mi a kaam fu ale nin muna ayen fi a sak nuruba Wen wamaŋsaŋa ale nin muna diipo meena wuu. Ku dan poom masa yaase ku tua, basi ate ba seba chak ase diipo meena ba nin kaasi wari, abe fi a kaam ba ale nin muna, abe fi a deŋsi ba kpa wie po, abe fi a sak ba ale suduŋni nalimnyiini.

ref: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
text: Dii nyiŋla, di danni a cheena kama ate nuruba a kan lak tue a wom Wen wensie sinsaŋŋa, ba le jam va ka badek yaalika, abe ba a tu chaab ale sagrɔ baai ale ba jam a sak ba dii ate ba poom gomsi a kala a yaali ayen ba wom la.

ref: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
text: Ba le jam basi Wen wensie sinsaŋŋa kama abe ba a yaali ayen ba a wom sunsuelima.

ref: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
text: Alege fi, kpesi fidek wie meena po. A nam fi ninammu abe fi a sak nuruba Wen wamaŋsaŋa, abe fi a teeri ayen fi ka Wen wieŋa moolidɔ ate fi a tom fi tuimaŋa meena nalimnyiini a te Wen.

ref: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
text: Alege mi diipo ate nuruba le ko mu Wen wamaŋsaŋa nyiŋla a moata kama.

ref: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
text: M be je jiaka a nueri kama. M be chali chalaŋa a nueri kama mɛ. Alege a diem ta siaka ale Wen.

ref: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
text: Ti Naawen a dan ŋman pilim jam ayen wa bo wensie buusa a te ti, wa le pai ka chali dɛ ka tiirimu a te mu, daa mi nyiini alege baai meena ale a yaali wa ale a limisi ayen wa ŋman pilim jam la.

ref: Come to see me as soon as you can.
text: Pii nyiŋ fidek a jam nwuli.

ref: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
text: Dii nyiŋla, Diimas waai ale a yaali tɛŋzuk de ŋanta nna yegayega la a basi mi kama alege cheŋ Tesalonika tɛŋka. Keresens mɛ cheŋ ka Galatia tɛŋka. Titus mɛ cheŋ ka Damatiya tɛŋka.

ref: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
text: Ka Luuk nyiini ale bo ale mu. Te Maak a jam ale fu ase fi nin cheena. Dii nyiŋ la wa ta ka maarika yega wa ale tom a te mu.

ref: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
text: M tom ka Tikikus ate wa cheŋ Efisos.

ref: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
text: Fi dan cheena pai m garuk jueŋku ate m jam pai basi Torowas tɛŋka po Kaapus jigi la a ta jam te mu. Tuesi ku ale m gbaŋsaŋa mɛ ale gbanaŋa dek ate ba ŋmarisi si la a ta jam te mu.

ref: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
text: Chiok kuridɔwa Alezanda a jam daani mu nalimnyiini. Ti Naawen ale tuni wa a magsi chaab ale wa ale nye diila.

ref: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
text: Kpesi fidek ale wa dii nyiŋla, tama ale jam bo dula la wa kasim jam a zɛri ti sinsaŋŋa kama ale pagrim.

ref: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
text: Alege ka Naawen ale jam zaani m ŋaaŋ a pai wa pagrimu a te mu, ate m jam baga a biisi Wen wamaŋsaŋa a sak baai ale kan daa Juuma la. Ti Naawen mɛ a jam maa yeeri mu a ta nyini ate ba an baga a ko mu.

ref: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
text: Ti Naawen mɛ le yeeri mu a ta nyini tuimba tii ate nuruba a poli ayen ba nye mu la, ate m jo wa naamu po buui ale bo wenŋmazuk la. Wa le nya zula ŋaai ale kan ta kpeglimka la. Ku be nye dila.

ref: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
text: Mi a puusi Pirisila ale Akiila. M maari a puusi Onesiforus dɔkdemma.

ref: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
text: Erasitus a wari ka Korinti tɛŋka. Alege m basi Torofimus ka Militus tɛŋka po. Dii nyiŋla, wa jam ka nyiŋyɔgsa.

ref: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
text: Pii nyiŋ ate fidek jam alege ate ŋoota wein paari. Yubulus ale Pudens ale Linus ale Kilɔdiya ale Kirisita bisaŋa meena ale bo dela la a puusi fu.

ref: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
text: Ti Naawen a bo ale fu. Wen ŋmanteka le bo ale ni meena.

ref: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
text: Mi Pɔɔl, waai ale ka Wen tomteerɔ ale Yeezu Kirisita tuimtomdɔ la, ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de. Wen ale lueri mu alege tom mu mɛ baai ale ta siaka ale Wen la nyiŋ, abe m sak ba ate ba seba wensie ŋaai le ŋa basi ate ba va Wen la.

ref: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
text: Mi ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te fi m biika Titus waai ale ta siaka nalimnyiini ale Wen ase mi ale ta diila. Kowa Wen ale Yeezu Kirisita ti Varibasidɔwa le ŋmante fu, abe wa basi ate fi boro ale suiyɔgni.

ref: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
text: Mi ale jam basi fu Kariti tɛŋka po la, fi jam wari dula kama ayen fi nye dii ale magsi fi nye la abe fi lueri kpaga Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la tɛŋsaŋa meena a te ba. A teeri m le jam weeni dii a sak fu la.

ref: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
text: Nuruma yegayega a kan siak a te Kirisita bisa kpaga. Ba pai ka ba wakayaataŋa a paasi ba suata. Nuru baai dek ale a sak ayen ku a fɛ kama ate Kirisita bisaŋa a va Juuma sinsaŋŋa la,

ref: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
text: Badek biisiteerɔma po wanyi dipo ale jam bo Kariti tɛŋka po la, a weeni ayen, <<Kariti demma a kasim ka velimvendisa ale duŋ baata ale nyiŋworuk puusa nyam.>>

ref: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
text: Wa wieŋa de abe ka wensie. Ku a fɛ kama ayen fi toariŋ ba ale nin muna ate ba yik Wen wensieŋa nalimnyiini.

ref: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
text: Ku a fɛ ate ba kan a wom Juuma sunsuelimaŋa, yaase sinsak ŋaai ate nuru baai ale a zɛri wensieŋa la a sak la.

ref: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
text: Nuru baai ale nye cheri la jigi, wie meena ka cheri, alege baai ale taŋ badek la ale ka siaka la, jaab an nye cheri, alege ba popolaŋa a taŋ kama.

ref: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
text: Nuru bala chaab a weeni kama ayen ba seba Wen, alege ba tuimaŋa a kan sak ayen ba seba wa. Ba a zɛri wa nɔi kama. Ba ale a tom dii mɛ la, Wen kan yaali. Ba an baga a tom tuimaŋsa.

ref: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
text: Alege fi Titus ku a fɛ kama ayen fi pai Wen wensie sinsaŋŋa a sak nuruba.

ref: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
text: Suik kula po, sak nipok kpagsaŋa ayen ku a fɛ ate ba chim nipok weleŋsa ba tuima meena po. Ku a fɛ ayen ba kan a biisi wie ŋaai ale a kaasi nuru yuei la, ba kan pai badek a te daam nyuka. Ba a sak sinsak maŋsa,

ref: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
text: abe ba a sak nipok kalaasaŋa ate ba ta yaalika ale ba chorɔma ale ba bisaŋa.

ref: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
text: A sak ba mɛ ate ba ta yam abe ba welema, abe ba chim nipok baai ale seba dɔk po tuima, abe ba ta jiirim abe ba a wom ba chorɔba noa, ate ku kan basi ate waai nya suik a pai yue kaasuŋ a te Wen wamaŋsaŋa.

ref: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
text: Suik kula po mɛ, ku a fɛ ayen fi a sak bi paalukku ate ba ta yam.
