text: Naawen nyiŋ ni siak a te baai ale ka kpaga a nya ni zuk la, ni siak a te naab kpioŋku waai ale ta pagrim la,

ref: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
text: ale kpaga ŋaai ate wa lueri ayen ba a waali tuimkaasima nyam la abe ba a pak baai ale a nye wamaŋsa la.

ref: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
text: Dii nyiŋla, Wen dek a yaali kama ayen ni basi ate ni tuimaŋsaŋa a kpimsi bettaŋa ale a biisi ba betta biisaŋa la.

ref: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
text: Nuru an soa ni, alege ni teeri ayen ni ka Wen yɔm. Ni be kaa poli ayen nuru ale kan soa ni la abe ni pai kula a yaa a tom ni yaalika, alege ni pai ni boka meena a te Wen.

ref: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
text: Ni a te waai meena zula. Ni ta yaalika ale ni Kirisita bi chaama. Ni a chali Wen abe ni a zuli ni naab kpioŋku.

ref: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
text: Nama tomteerɔma, ni a zuli ni nyama abe ni a va ba noa nalimnyiini. Daa baai nyiini ale ta jiirim ale popola maŋsa la ale magsi ni va ba noa, baai mɛ ale poom ka gaasa nyama la, ni a zuli ba abe ni a va ba noa.

ref: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
text: Ba dan a namsi ni kinla nyiŋ alege ni kan weeni wari ya ni ale seba Wen yaalika la nyiŋ, wa le te ni niaka dila nyiŋ.

ref: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
text: Alege, fi dan kaasi wari ate ba a nak fu dila nyiŋ, ka boan nyuenta ale bo ku po? Alege fi dan chiibi a nam fi wamaŋsa nyiŋ Wen ale niak fu.

ref: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
text: Ku be jam ka ninammu de nyiŋ ate Wen wi ni, dii nyiŋla, Kirisita dek a nam ka dila a te ni ayen ku sak ni ate ni tomsi wadek ale nye diila.

ref: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
text: Wa an jam tom tuimbiowa. Nuruba be an jam wom venta wa nɔi po. (Azaya

ref: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
text: Ba ale jam lɛ wa la, wa an jam lɛ ba mɛ a tuni ya. Ba le jam basi ate wa nam la, wa an jam nyigsi ba ayen wa mɛ le basi ate ba nam. Alege wa jam pai ka wadek a nyo Wen dii ale wensie boteerɔ la nisa po.

ref: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
text: Kirisita ale jam kpi jabarimu nyiŋla, wa pai ka tama tuimbaataŋa a ji wadek zuk ayen ti kan ŋman a tom tuimbaata abe ti boro ale weleŋsa. Wa mulaŋa ale basi ate ti nya nyiŋyɔgsa.

ref: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
text: Ni jam a nye ase ka piisa ale cheŋ bɛ la. Alege yɔgyɔgla de, ni ŋman jam ka Kirisita jigi. Wa a nye se wa ka ni Naapeerik la. Wa le Wa A Nya ni chiisaŋa zuk.

ref: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
text: Pooba, ku a fɛ kama ate nama mɛ a va ni chorɔma noa, ate ba gela a dan kan ta siaka ale Wen wamaŋsaŋa, ba le tagri ba popola a va ŋa, ni ale a tom diila nyiŋ. Ni daa nye dila, ku an poom ŋman magsi ayen ni lak noa a weeni ba wari ya,

ref: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
text: dii nyiŋla, ba le nya ni nyeka ale welema ale nala diila.

ref: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
text: Ni kan kasim a yaali ni zuima bobika, abe ni a su nifelima ŋaai ale a nyaksi ate ŋa diak a pagra la abe ni a jo garuk naliŋta ayen ni nala.

ref: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
text: Alege, popo nalimu ale nalim, buui ale kaa nyini, bula be ka ŋmam ŋmam nyeka ale chim chim nyeka, bula abe le nalim dek Naawen nina po.

ref: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, dila po nipok baai ale jam a va Wen suiku ale ta yiila wa jigi la, bala nalimu jam ale, ba ale siak ba chorɔma noa nalimnyiini la.

ref: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
text: Bala po wanyi jam ale Abrayam powa Saara. Wa jam a va wa chorɔwa nɔi ka nalimnyiini a yaa a wi wa ayen wa nyɔnɔ. Dila nyiŋ la, nama mɛ abe ka nipowa de lieba ase ni ale a tom wamaŋsa a kan chali yɔgsum ale jaab jaaboa.

ref: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
text: Suik kula po mɛ, chorɔba, ku a fɛ kama ayen nama mɛ ale ni pooma a boro ale chaab ale yam. Ni ta pagrim a gaam ba kama. Dila ale soa ate ku a fɛ ayen ni a te ba zula. Nama ale ba a poom tuesi Wen nyuvuri dii ale kan ka kpeglimka la kama. Ni dan kan a nye dila, ni puusaŋa a kan paari Wen jigi ya.

ref: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
text: Basi ate m pai wieŋa de meena a sak ni. Ni basi ate ni nyeka a chim bunyi, abe ni ta popola yena. Ni ta yaalika ale chaab ase suata la. Ni a zuli chaab abe ni ta jiirim ale chaab.

ref: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
text: Nuruba a daa nye ni biem, ni kan pai biem a tuni ba. Ba dan ka te ni, nama mɛ kan ka te ba. Alege, ni weeni ba ayen Wen le maari ba. Dii nyiŋla, Wen ale jam lueri ni la, wa jam puulim kama ayen wa le te ni niaka.

ref: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
text: Dii nyiŋla, <<Waai a dan a yaali ayen wa nya suipeentik, ku a fɛ kama ayen wa kaa biisi wabulɔrisa abe wa a velim wie.

ref: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
text: Abe wa basi wa tuimbaataŋa tomka abe wa a tom tuimaŋsa, abe wa pai wa yaalika ale wa suinum meena ayen nuruba boro ale suiyɔgni.

ref: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
text: Ni dan kasim a yaali ayen ni a tom tuimaŋsa, ka wana dek ale wa nye ni biemmoa?

ref: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
text: Alege, nuruba dan poom basi ate ni a nam ni tuimaŋsaŋa nyiŋ, ni basi ate ni sue peenti yegayega. Ni kan basi ate yɔgsum yik ni ale waai ya. Ni be kan basi mɛ ate wie a daani ni ate ni a yiili,

ref: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
text: alege ni ta Yeezu Kirisita ni suiniima po, abe ni a zuli wa ase Naawen la. Ni gomsi nidek ate nuruba a dan bek ni, ni ale ta yiila wa jigi diila, abe ni weeni a sak ba.

ref: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
text: Alege ni kpesi nidek ate ni tulisika po, ni te ba zula abe ni seba nidek yikka. Ni ta popola yena ale Wen, ate nuruba a dan le ni, ni ale chim Kirisitawa ŋaaŋviirɔba a tom tuimaŋ sii a te wa la, abe chivie yik nuru bala chaab.

ref: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
text: Boan nyiŋŋa, ku zunchoŋ kama ate nuru nya ninam tuimaŋsaŋa nyiŋ, ase ku nin ka Wen yeŋka a gaam nuru ale nam tuimbaata nyiŋ.

ref: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
text: Dii nyiŋla Kirisita dek a jam kpi ka bunyi ni tuimbaata nyiŋ, ayen wa pai ni a ta cheŋ Wen jigi. Kirisita jam ka waai ale ka tuimaŋsa nyɔnɔ la. Wa jam zaani ka tama baai ale ka tuimbaata nyam la zaana jigi. Ba yaa jam ko wa kama, alege Wen Chiika a jam nak wa yiti kum po.

ref: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
text: A yaa basi wa ate wa cheŋ ga biisi a sak baai chiisaŋa ate ba yik lik la.

ref: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
text: Chiisaŋa de an jam va Wen nɔi ya. Si jam boro ka diipo ate Nowa jam boro a nye wa ŋaaruŋku la. Va ŋala po, nuruba naaniŋ nyiini ate Wen a vari ba basi.

ref: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
text: A magsi chaab ale dila, soka teka yɔgyɔgla de a vari ni a basi kama, daa ayen ka nyiŋ daŋta yeerika, alege mi a saalim ka Wen ale popola maŋsa Yeezu Kirisita ale yiti kum po la nyiŋ.

ref: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
text: Kirisitawa de waai ale yiti kum po a yaa jueli wenŋmazuk la a kali ka wa juga geŋ a yaa nya Wen maarɔma meena ale pagrɔ baai meena ale bo wenŋmazuk la.

ref: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
text: A ta nyini jinla a cheŋ, ni a va Wen ale a yaali diila, alege daa nama dek nyiŋsaŋa ale a yaali diila.

ref: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
text: Dila po wa, nama ale baai ale jam kan pai nidek a te Wen la, ni meena jam boro a nye ka wie ale chaab. Ni jam a tom tuima ale chaab ate ku beni ka nna yegayega. Ni jam a tom ka daŋta tuima, nipok yaalik tuima, a buk daata, a nye ŋandiin kpienta tiga, a nye daata tiga ale a kaab bɔgta.

ref: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
text: Alege Wen a dan jam ayen wa bo ŋanvuta ale kpilima buusa, wa le bek ba kama ba ale tom dii ale diila.

ref: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
text: Dila ale soa ate kpilima jam maa wom Wen wamaŋsaŋa sinsaŋŋa la, bala baai ate Wen bo ba buusa ale ge ate ba kpi la ale baai mɛ ale poom kan diem kpi la. Ba jam wom di kama ayen bala baai ale kpi la, ba chiisaŋa a ta nyuvuri a se Wen ale vua diila.

ref: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
text: Tɛŋka kpeglimka a moata kama. Ku a fɛ ayen ni seba nidek yikka be ni gomsi nidek a puusi Wen.

ref: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
text: Ku ka wamaŋ ayen ni basi ate ni nina muni ale chaab yaalika yegayega, dii nyiŋla yaalika ale chaab a basi kama ate biem wie kan piisi.

ref: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
text: Ni basi ate nuruba a jam ni yeeŋa abe ni kan a fɔbili.

ref: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
text: Wen a pai wa tiirita tɔgatɔgaka a te ka baai ale va wa la. Ni nya tiirim buui ate wa pai a te ni la abe ni pai bu a maari ni vaanchaab. Ni meena a daa nye dila, Wen ŋmanteka ale bo ale ni ka nna yegayega.

ref: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
text: M dek suata, ni kan basi ate ku cha ni ale nye nya kaai ale a jam ate ni a nam nna yegayega la. Ni kan basi ate ku nye ni jigi nna ase wari diirini la.

ref: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
text: Alege ni pai ku ase ka Kirisita le nam diila ate ni a nam, ate ku te ni masim diipo ate wa a nya wa zulaŋa ale wa nalimu la.

ref: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
text: Nuruba a daa le ni, ni ale a va Kirisita la nyiŋ, ni basi ate ni sue peenti. Dila a sak kama ayen Wen pai wa Chiika waai ale ta wa zulaŋa yegayega la a nyo ka ni suiniimaŋa po.

ref: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
text: Ni wanyi abe daa nam, ku a fɛ kama ayen ku kan chim nuru koka wari yaase zum, yaase biem nyeerɔ, yaase fi pai ka fidek a nyo nuruba wie po.

ref: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
text: Yɔgyɔgla Wen a gomsi kama ayen wa bo tɛŋzuk nuru meena buusa. Wa dan jam wa le liŋ bo ka baai ate wa soa la buusa abe wa bo baai ale kan ta siaka ale wa wamaŋsaŋa la. Wa be dan piilim ale tama, ku le chim ka sɛ bala jigi ya?

ref: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
text: Dila nyiŋla, ku ale ka, Wen yaalika ayen ba a nam la, ba a tom tuimaŋsa abe ba pai badek a nyo Wen dii ale nye ŋanta meena la nisa po. Wa ka wensie nyɔnɔ.

ref: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
text: Mi a yaali ayen m saalim nama baai ale ka Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma kpaŋŋa la ayen, mi mɛ ka kpagi. M be ka Kirisita ninammu seerɔ. Wa dan ŋman pilim jam, mi ale maa nya wa zulaŋa ale wa nalimu kama.

ref: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
text: Ni chim Wen piisaŋa naapeerisa ate ni a nya ŋa zuk la, ni a tom ase nyaarɔba la alege daa fifeowa, ka ni yaalika ase Wen ale a yaali ayen ni chim la. Ni kan tom a yaali ligra alege nama ale a yaali tomka la nyiŋ.

ref: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
text: Ate Kirisitawa waai dek ale ka naapeerisaŋa kpagi kpien la a dan ŋman pilim jam, wa le pai wa zula ŋaai ale kan a kaasi la a te ni.

ref: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
text: Suik kula po, ku a fɛ kama mɛ ayen, nama bi paalukku a va ŋankpagsaŋa noa. Abe ni seba nidek yikka. Ku a fɛ kama mɛ ayen ni a tom a maari chaab, dii nyiŋla, <<Wen a zɛri kanjanta nyɔnɔ kama alege ta ŋmanteka ale waai ale a yik wadek la.>>

ref: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
text: Dila nyiŋ, ni a yik nidek abe ni pai nidek a nyo Wen nisa po ate wadek ale a yaali diipo la abe wa zak ni a zaani.

ref: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
text: Ni dachiaka jabioku a nye se ka gbeŋli dii ale a na a nyiem la. Di a gisi ka nuru ayen di yik a ŋɔbi. Dila ale soa ate ku a fɛ ayen ni gomsi abe ni kpesi nidek a limisi di.

ref: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
text: Ni zɛri jabioku. Ni ta siaka yegayega ale Wen abe ni zaani ale suinum pagrisa. Dii nyiŋla, nama seba ayen ni vaanchaama ale bo jigi meena ate ba ta siaka ale Wen la, a nam a se ka nama mɛ la.

ref: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
text: Ŋmanteka meena Wenni, waai ale wi ni ate ni jam wa zula ŋaai ale kaa kpeglim jigi Kirisita nyiŋ la, ni dan nam maga ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wadek ale yeeri ni abe wa basi ate ni pagra.

ref: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
text: Wa pagrimu ale kasim boro kama taam wuu. Ku be nye dila.

ref: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
text: Silvanus ale maari mu, waai ate mi a zuli ase m wensie suok la, ate m ŋmarisi gbaŋ gelik ka de a deŋsi ni kpa ale a weeni ayen Wen wensie ŋmanteka ale nna. Ni be za giŋgiŋ.

ref: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
text: Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma baai ate wa lueri a te wadek ate ba bo Babilon la, a maa chaab a puusi ni. M suoku Maak, a puusi ni mɛ.

ref: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
text: Ni a puusi chaab nalimnyiini. Wen le basi ate nama baai ate Kirisitawa soa la meena boro ale suiyɔgni.

ref: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
text: Mi Simon Piita, waai ale ka Yeezu Kirisita tomteerɔ ale tuimtomdɔ la ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te baai ate ti Wenni ale ti Varibasidɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ayen badek weleŋsa nyiŋ ate ba nya siak kaai ale chim siak maŋ ase tama la.

ref: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
text: Wen ale te ni ŋmanteka ale suiyɔgni ni ale seba wa ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita la nyiŋ.

ref: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
text: Ti seba waai ale wi ti ayen ti maa nya wa zulaŋa ale wa nalim yegayega la kama. Dila abe ale soa ate wa pai wa pagrimu a te ti ayen ti baga chali bɛ ale tɛŋzuk de tuimbaataŋa abe ti a tom tuimaŋsa a te wa.

ref: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
text: Wen abe le puulim ayen wa le te ti tiirim tii la, wa sum te ti ka tiirim maŋsa nalimnyiini. Wa be te tiiritaŋa kama ayen ti baga liisi tuim kaasim ŋaai ale bo tɛŋzuk de la a basi abe ti a neensi wa ale ka diila.

ref: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
text: Ni nina abe dan muni ayen ni ta wieŋa de meena nalimnyiini, ni le baga va ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita kama nalimnyiini.

ref: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
text: Waai nina abe ale kan muni ayen wa nya wieŋa de meena la, kula nyɔnɔwa a nye ase wa ka yio la, ate wa kan nya a yaa baŋi Naawen ale vɔŋ wa wabaataŋa a te wa la.

ref: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
text: M suata, Naawen a lueri ni kama ayen ni va wa. Ni be pii nyiŋ ate ni nina muni ate lueri ka de boro ale ni taam wuu. Ni dan baga nye dila, ni kan baga basi ni siaka ale wa.

ref: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
text: Ni dan nye dila, wa ale te ni suik ate ni jo ti Nyɔnɔwa ale ti Varibasidɔwa Yeezu Kirisita naam buui ale kasim boro taam wuu la po.

ref: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
text: Mi kasim a teeri ni kama wieŋa de alege m poom seba kama ayen ni poom seba ŋa kama. Ate ni kasim pii nyiŋ a yik wensie ŋaai ate ni jam wom ale tuesi la.

ref: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
text: Alege mi a poli kama ayen m le diem vua la, ku magsi ka m ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ni, ate ni ŋman teeri ŋa wie.

ref: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
text: M seba ayen ku kan beni ale ge ate m kpi a se ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ale jam weeni mu diila.

ref: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
text: M dan kpi, m gbaŋka de ale te ni suik ate ni a teeri wieŋa de meena.

ref: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
text: Ti le jam sak ni dii ayen ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita le ŋman pilim jam kama ale wa pagrimu la, ti an jam weeni ka sunsuelima sak ni. Ti jam weeni sak ni ka dii ate tama a jam nya ale tidek nina la. Ti jam nya ka wa pagrimu yegayega.

ref: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
text: Tama ale jam bo dula ale wa la, ti jam wom lueluku ale nyini wenŋmazuk a siŋ la kama.

ref: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
text: Dila nyiŋla, wie ŋaai ate Wen biisiteerɔma a jam biisi dila po, la ka wensie wie. Ku magsi ka ni a wom ŋa nalimnyiini. Dii nyiŋla, ba wieŋa a nye se ka bolim ate ba toati zaani legi po la, ku a nye ka dila a ta cheena diipo ate Yeezu Kirisita le ŋman pilim jam ate wa bolimu a yaa nya nna wentaleŋ ni suiniimaŋa po.

ref: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
text: Wieŋa de meena po wakpienni ale, ni teeri ayen biisiteerɔ karo a baga tɔgi a lagri wa ale weeni dii Wen Gbaŋka po la.

ref: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
text: Dii nyiŋla, Wen biisiteerɔma wieŋa an jam nyini ka nuruba dek nɔi po. Alege ka Wen Chiika ale jam pai wa wieŋa a te ba ayen ba ŋoa a sak nuruba.

ref: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
text: Dila po, venta biisiteerɔba ale jam kan seba Wen ya, a bo ale Wen nuruma a paasi ba. Venta sagrɔba ale ba jam bo ale nama mɛ. Sagrɔ baai mɛ ale jam kan seba Wen la, le suk a gum ni po. Ba le ta venta sinsaga a jam sak ni abe ba nyini ba Nyɔnɔwa waai ale vari ba a basi la, ŋaaŋ a nyini. Dila ale soa ate Wen le ta kaasuŋ jam ba jigi nna nwuli.

ref: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
text: Alege, nuruba yegayega ale diem va ba kama a tom kaboŋsa tuima. Ba be le ba a nye diila le ku basi ate nuruba nya suik a kaasi Wen wensie suiku yuei.

ref: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
text: Wen maarɔ baai ale tom wabaata la, Wen an pai ba basi ya, wa yuk ba basi ka ninam jigi, juijui ate wa basi ate ba pai chɔrima a bobi ba a zaani legi po ayen ba bo dula ate ku ga paari diipo ate Wen le jam bo ba buusa la.

ref: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
text: Tɛŋzuk nuruma baai ale jam boro dila po, a jam a tom tuimbaata yegayega la, wa jam basi ate ka nyiam a sueri tɛŋzuk meena ayen ba kpi. Baai nyiini ate wa jam vari basi la ale Nowa ale nuruba ba chaab bayopɔi. Nowa jam a sak ka wensie sinsaga a magsi chaab ale Wen.

ref: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
text: Wen abe jam basi ate ka bolim mɛ a dɛ Sodom ale Gomora nuruma. Wa jam nye dila kama ayen ku sak wa le wa jam nye baai ale a tom tuimbaata diila.

ref: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
text: Daa meena wa kasim jam a nya ale a wom nuruma de tuimbaataŋa tii ale jam basi ate wa sui jam a puuri nna yegayega la.

ref: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
text: Dila nyiŋla, Naawen seba wa le wa nye dii a vari baai ale a va wa nalimnyiini la ninam po a basi. Wa seba mɛ wa le wa nye dii ate gaasa nyam a kasim bo ninam po ate ku ga paari diipo ate wa le jam bo nuruma buusa la kama.

ref: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
text: Baai dek ale a tom tuimbaata tii ate ba nyiŋsaŋa a yaali ale ge an pai Wen pagrimu a chim jaab la. Venta sagrɔma de kan chali yɔgsum, ba ka kanjanta nyam, ba be kan zuli Wen maarɔma. Ba goanti a lɛ ba kama.

ref: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
text: ) ale <<Ba dan yik deri a sugri di, di nyiem ŋman pilim cheŋ ga a bilim ka fifataŋa po.>>

ref: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
text: Alege nuruma de a nye se ka gɔi duŋ kpien sii ale boro ate nuruba a yik si a ko la. Ba kan poli ase ba ka nuru bisa la. Wie ŋaai ate ba zɛ ŋa kiri la, ba a le ŋa kama. Dila ale soa ate Wen mɛ a weeni ayen wa le ko ba ase ba ka gɔi duŋsa la.

ref: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
text: Ba ale nye ate nuruba nam diila, ba mɛ le nya ninam ate ku tuni ba ba ale nye dila la nyiŋ. Ba sue peenti kama ate ba a zaani nuruba niŋ kantueŋ a tom tuimbaata tii ate ba nyiŋsaŋa a yaali la. Nama ale bala a dan tigsi chaab ayen ni dɛ ŋandiinta, ba nyiem kasim a nye ka dila ate chivie a yik ni, ale ge bala a nya masim ba pimpaasima suitaŋa po.

ref: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
text: Daa meena ba kan yaali ayen ba nya wayoŋ a gum chaab ale nipok baai ale a tom kaboŋsa tuima la po. Ba kan maari a chak ale tuimbaata tomka. Ba kasim a nye kama ate baai siaka ale kan zuak la, a tom tuimbaata. Ba suiniimaŋa a kasim sueri ale ka butuem. Dila ale soa ate Wen yaa ka te ba la.

ref: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
text: Ba zɛri Wen suiku vaka kama ale ge zɛ juijui ate ba a cheŋ la. Ba a nye se ka Balaam la. Balaam kowa yuei jam ale Biio. Balaam jam boro ka dila po, a jam a tom tuimbaata a nya ligra ŋa nyiŋ.

ref: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
text: Alege dai yeŋ ate boniŋ a yaa jam biisi ale wa ate wa tagri a yaa basi tuimbaata tomka.

ref: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
text: Sagrɔma de a nye se ka beli dii nyiam ale kpeeri la, ale chiŋma ŋaai ale kan ta ŋmoruk la. Naawen tali jigi legini po a te ba kama.

ref: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
text: Ba a biisi ka kanjanta ale betta biisa. Ba pai ba nyiŋsaŋa a tom ka wie ŋaai ale a dari nuru baai ale a piilim ba nyini tuimbaata po a nyini la.

ref: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
text: Nuruba abe dan seba ti Nyɔnɔwa ale Varibasidɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ate wa vari ba a basi ate ba kan ŋman a va tɛŋzuk de wakaasimaŋa, ale ge ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ba dan ŋman tagri ba popola a maa bo wie ŋala chaab po, ku le pagra ka nna yegayega ate bala chaab a gaam ba ale poom liŋ ka diila.

ref: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
text: Dila abe dan nye nuru jigi, ku ti zunchoŋ kama ate wala choa daam kan poom maa seba weleŋsa suiku a gaam wa nin seba alege ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate wa ŋman zɛri weleŋsaŋa sinsaŋŋa ate ba sak wa la.

ref: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
text: Ba ale nye diila a sak kama ayen wamagsimaŋa ate ba magsi la ka wensie. Ba magsi ayen, <<Biak a dan chiiri, ka ŋman pilim a ŋmani kama a ga a dɛ ka dek chichiitaŋa,>> (Wamagsima

ref: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
text: Mi a yaali kama ayen ni a teeri wie ŋaai ate Wen biisiteerɔma a jam biisi dila po la. Ni maara teeri ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ale Varibasidɔwa ale pai tuimtomdɔma a sak ti wie ŋaai la.

ref: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
text: Dii abe le dɛ niŋ la ale, ku a fɛ kama ayen yɔgyɔgla de, ni seba ayen tɛŋka a moata ka kpeglimka. Nuru baai nyeboka ale ka kasim va badek nyiŋ yaalik nyeka la, le jam kama. Ba dan jam, ba le nye ni a la kama,

ref: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
text: abe ba bek ni ayen, <<Ti Wen an jam puulim kama ayen wa le ŋman pilim jam? Wa bo ka bɛ? Wen ale nye tɛŋka ale jaab meena la, ti nyama a kpi kama, alege wari an diem tagriya.>>

ref: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
text: Ba kan yaali ayen ba seba ayen dila powa Wen a jam biisi ka wie a nye wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋ. Wa jam nye kama ate tɛŋka a nyini nyiam po a nyini,

ref: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
text: be ŋman ka nyiam ate wa pai kaasi dila po tɛŋka.

ref: Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as
text: Alege m doaba, ni kan baŋ ayen Naawen a nya dai yeŋ ale bena tusidi ase ŋa ka bunyi la. Naawen jigi ŋa meena ka bunyi.

ref: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
text: Alege dai dii danni ate Naawen le bo nuruba buusa la, le jam ase ka zue ale jam nuru yeri diila. Dai dila a dan paari, wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋ le nye ka wai nna yegayega ate wenŋmazuk ale ŋan baai meena ale bo du la a bɛ ale ge ate bolim dɛ tɛŋka mɛ. Ate jaabuuri meena ale bo tɛŋzuk la a deri muriŋ bɛ.

ref: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
text: Wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋ ale kaasi ka dila, ku a fɛ ayen nama chim ka boan nuruba? Ku a fɛ kama ayen ni chim nuru weleŋsa a va Wen nalimnyiini.

ref: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
text: Abe ni a limisi ate ni nya Wen jamka ale tɛŋzuk buusaŋa boka, abe ni a yaali ayen ŋa jam nwuli. Dai dila danni bolim le bu dɛ wenŋmazukku ate bolim tuilum a nye ate jaabuuri meena a nyaliŋ bɛ.

ref: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
text: Alege Wen a puulim kama ayen wa le nye wenŋmazuk paalik ale tɛŋ paalik ate wa weleŋsa nyiini a kasim bo jigi meena. Tama abe kasim a limisi ka dila.

ref: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
text: Dila nyiŋla, m dek doaba, ase ni ale a limisi dai dila danni la, ni pii nyiŋ ate ni chim nuru weleŋsa, abe ni kan ta wari Wen jigi ya ate ni boro ale wa ale suiyɔgni.

ref: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
text: Ni a teeri ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ale te nuruba suik yɔgyɔgla dii ayen ba basi ba tuimbaataŋa abe ba va wa la. Wen dek ale jam pai wa yammu a te Pɔɔl ayen wa ŋmarisi dila a te ni.

ref: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
text: Alege m dek doaba, nama poom seba wieŋa de kama. Ni kpesi ni dek abe ni kan siak ate sagrɔ baai ale a kaasi Wen wamaŋsaŋa la a jam paasi ni a tagri ni popola ate ni basi Wen wensie suiku vaka ate ni lo.

ref: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
text: Alege, ni basi ate ti Nyɔnɔwa ale Varibasidɔwa Yeezu Kirisita a maari ni ate ni seba wa ŋmanteka ale wa yammu. Wa zulaŋa ale kasim boro ka dila taam wuu. Ku be nye dila.

ref: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
text: Mi, Jɔɔn, ale ŋmarisi gbaŋka de ayen m sak ni Nyuvuri Wanni wie. Wa boro kama a nyini ku piilimka po ale chim nyuvuri meena nyɔnɔ. Tama wom wa lueluku ale nya wa ale ti nimbie mɛ ale pai ti nisima a tiri wa.

ref: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
text: Ti Kowa Wen ale tom nyuvuri meena nyɔnɔwa de ate wa siŋ jam tɛŋzuk de. Tama a nya wa kama ale chim wa seerɔba ayen ti a weeni nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la wie a sak ni. Di kasim a bo ale ti Kowa Wen kama ate nyuvuri meena nyɔnɔwa a yaa pai di a sak ti.

ref: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
text: Tama a yaali kama ayen ti sak ni wie ŋaai meena ate wa nye la. Dii nyiŋla tama dek a nya kama ale wom ŋa. Tama ale ti Kowa Wen ale Wa Nidoabinni Yeezu Kirisita a ta ka nɔiyeŋ ale chaab ate tama mɛ a yaali ayen nama a jam gum ti po.

ref: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
text: Tama a yaali kama ayen ni sue a peenti nna yegayega. Ka dila ale soa ate tama ŋmarisi wieŋa de a te ni la.

ref: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
text: Dii ate Yeezu a sak tama wadek wie ate tama a pai a sak ni la ale nna. Wen a nye se ka bolim la. Legi magadek mɛ an baga a moata wa.

ref: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
text: Tama abe dan weeni ayen wa ale tama ta ka nɔiyeŋ ale chaab ale ge bo legini po, tama ka velimvendisa ti biik po ale ti nyeka po.

ref: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
text: Alege tama daa cheŋ bolimu po ase midek ale bo bolimu po diila, dila a sak kama ayen tama ale ti vaanchaab a ta nɔiyeŋ ale chaab kama ate Wen Nidoabinni Yeezu ziimu a vari ti a basi wabaata meena po.

ref: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
text: Tama a dan weeni ayen ti ka wabiowa, ti a paasi ka tidek. Wensie ka ti jigi ya.

ref: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
text: Ti dan weeni ayen tama an diem tom wabiowa, ti a weeni ayen Wen ka velimvendik. Ti be pai ka ŋaaŋ a te wa wieŋa.

ref: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
text: M dek bisa, mi a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ka nama ayen ni ka a tom wabaata. Alege waai a dan tom wabiok, ti ta ka nuru wanyi waai ale wa saalim ti Kowa Wen a te ti la. Wala ale, Yeezu Kirisita waai ale ka Wamaŋsa Nyɔnɔ la.

ref: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
text: Wala a kpi ka ti wabaataŋa nyiŋ ayen Wen baga vari ti ti wabaataŋa po a basi. Be daa tama wabaataŋa nyiini nyiŋŋa, alege wa kpi ka tɛŋka meena demma wabaataŋa nyiŋ.

ref: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
text: Ase ti daa va Wen sinsaŋŋa meena, ti le sum a seba ayen ti seba wa kama.

ref: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
text: Ase nuru waai a dan weeni ayen wa seba Wen alege a kan va wa sinsaŋŋa meena, wa a velim kama. Wensie a ka wa jigi ya.

ref: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
text: Nuru waai abe daa va wa sinsaŋŋa, wa sum a yaali wa kama nalimnyiini. Ti daa a va dila, ti le seba ayen tama ale wa a sum ka bunyi.

ref: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
text: Ase nuru a dan weeni ayen wa bo ale ka Wen, ku a fɛ ate wa va wa ase Yeezu ale va wa diila.

ref: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
text: M dek doaba, ku daa sinsak paala ate mi a ŋmarisi a te ni. Di diem ka sinsak kpagsaŋa ate nama a wom a ta nyini ku piilimka po la.

ref: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
text: Alege ŋa diem ka wapaala yɔgyɔgla, dii nyiŋla, sinsak paani de a nye ase ka yok ale a tagri danni kantueŋ la. Be ka Yeezu ale jam va di ale ge ate nama mɛ a yaa maa va di.

ref: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
text: Nuru waai abe dan weeni ayen wa bo ka danni kantueŋka po ale ge kisi wa choa. Ku a nye ase wa diem bo ka legi po la.

ref: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
text: Waai a dan ta yaalika ale wa choa, wala a nye ase wa bo ka danni kantueŋka po la. Wari a ka wa jigi a baga a nye ate wa a tom tuimbiowa.

ref: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
text: Nuru waai a dan kisi wa choa, ku a nye ase wa diem a bo ka legini po ale zɛ juijui ate wa a cheŋ la. Legini a lik ka wa ninaŋa ate wa a nye ase yio la.

ref: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
text: M bisa, mi a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ka nama, dii nyiŋla Wen a va ka Yeezu nyiŋ a vɔŋ nama wabaataŋa a te ni.

ref: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
text: Nisɔmma mɛ, mi a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ka nama, dii nyiŋ la nama a poom seba waai ale boro a nyini ku piilimka po la kama. Nama bi paalukku mi a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ka nama, dii nyiŋla, nama nak dɛ jabioku kama.

ref: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
text: M bisa, mi a ŋmarisi a te ka nama dii nyiŋla, nama poom seba waai ale boro a nyini ku piilimka po la kama. Nisɔmma mɛ, mi a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ka nama, dii nyiŋla nama seba Wen kama waai ale boro a ta nyini ku piilimka po la. Nama bi paalukku mɛ ta pagrim kama ale diem ta Wen wieŋa ni suiniimaŋa po. Ka dila ale soa ate ni baga nak dɛ jabioku la.

ref: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
text: Ni kan a yaali ayen ni a va tɛŋka meena demma ale a va diila. Nama a daa yaali tɛŋka meena demma ŋantaŋa, ku a sak kama ayen ti Kowa Wen yaalika a ka ni jigi ya.

ref: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
text: Ŋan baai ate nuruba nyiŋsa a yaali la ale ŋan baai ate ba ninaŋa a yaali ayen ba a nya la abe ba yik ba a nyo ba nisa po a ta kanjanta ale ba la, ŋantaŋa de meena an nyini daa ti Kowa Wen jigi ya. Bala meena ka tɛŋzuk de ŋanta.

ref: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
text: Tɛŋka meena ale ŋan baai meena ate tɛŋzuk de demma a yaali la, a kan beni, alege waai ale a va Wen yaalika la, le jam tuesi ka nyuvuri dii ale kan ka kpeglimka la.

ref: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
text: M bisa, tɛŋka meena kpeglimka danni a moata kama. Ni wom ayen da ŋala po Yeezu Kirisita dachiaka ale jam. Ti seba ayen tɛŋka meena kpeglimka danni a moata kama, dii nyiŋla wa dachaasaŋa po ba yega poom boro kama.

ref: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
text: Nuruma de ba gela a poom jam bo ale ti kama, alege ba daa tama po. Ase ba dan jam ka tama po, ba ti diem bo ale ti kama, alege ba le basi tama diila a sak kama ayen ba daa tama po.

ref: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
text: Alege Yeezu potim lueri ni kama a basi ate Wen Chiika a bo le ni ayen ni meena seba ku wensie ale ka diila.

ref: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
text: Mi a kan ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te nama ayen ka nama ale kan seba wensieŋa la, alege ka ni ale seba wensieŋa la nyiŋ ale soa ate mi a ŋmarisi a te ni. M be ŋman seba kama ayen venta kan nyini wensie jigi ya.

ref: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
text: Be ka wana ale venta nyɔnɔ? Ka waai ale a weeni ayen daa Yeezu ale waai ate Wen a tom la. Wala choa ka Kirisita dachiak. Wala a zɛri ka Kowa ale wa Nidoabinni.

ref: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
text: Nuru waai abe ale kan ta siaka ayen Yeezu ka Wen Nidoabinni la, wala mɛ a zɛri ka Wen dila. Nuru waai ale ta siaka ayen Yeezu ka Wen Nidoabinni la, wala mɛ a seba wa Kowa Wen kama.

ref: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
text: Nama abe kan baŋ ba le liŋ sak ni diila. Ni dan kasim a ta ku dila ale a teeri ku mɛ, nama ale ti Kowa Wen ale wa Nidoabinni Yeezu le jam a gum chaab.

ref: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
text: Mi a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a kaam ni ayen ni seba baai ale a paasi ni la.

ref: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
text: Alege nama, Yeezu Kirisita a pai Wa Chiika a nyo ka ni suiniimaŋa po. Wa Chiika abe le bo ale ni la, ni kan ŋmaa yaali waai ayen wa sak ni. Wa Chiika ale sak ni wari meena. Wa a sak ka wensie daa venta. Ni be va sinsaŋŋa de ate ni le Kirisita chim bunyi.

ref: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
text: M bisa, ni basi ate ti a va Wen Chiika, ate Yeezu a dan ŋman pilim jam abe ti ta nyiŋbiiri ti kan chali yɔgsummoa ate chivie a yik ti ate ti suk ti dega.

ref: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
text: Nama a poli ti Kowa Wen ale a yaali ti nna yegayega diila. Wa yaalika ale ti a zuak ka nna yegayega ate wa yaa a wi ti ayen Wen bisa. Ti be sum ka wa bisa. Baai abe ale a va tɛŋzuk de demma suiku la a zɛ tama, dii nyiŋla ba zɛ Wen dega.

ref: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
text: M dek doaba, yɔgyɔgla de tama yaa ka Wen bisa. Alege, Wen an diem sak ti ti le ti chim nuru baai chaab la. Alege ti seba ayen Yeezu a dan ŋman pilim jam, ti za ti a nye ase ka wadek la. Ti be le nya wadek ale sum ka diila ale ti nimbie dai yeŋ po.

ref: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
text: Baai meena abe ale ta nya kude yiila la, bala le chim nuru weleŋsa ase Yeezu ale ka diila.

ref: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
text: Baai meena ale a tom tuimbaata la, kan va Wen sinsaŋŋa. Nya kude abe nye a kaasi ka sinsaŋŋa.

ref: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
text: Baai meena ale ka bunyi ale Kirisitawa la, bala a kan ŋman a tom tuimbaata. Alege, baai meena ale kasim a tom tuimbaata la, a nye dila kama, dii nyiŋla ba zɛ wa.

ref: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
text: M doaba, ni kan basi ate nuru waai a paasi ni. Baai meena ale a tom tuimaŋsa la, bala ka nuru weleŋsa ase Yeezu la.

ref: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
text: Baai meena ale a tom tuimbaata la, bala ka jabioku bisa. A nyini ku piilimka po a ta jam paari jinla, jabioku a kasim a tom ka tuimbaata. Ka dila ale soa ate Wen a tom Wa nidoabinni ate wa siŋ jam tɛŋzuk de meena ayen wa yik jabioku tuimaŋa a kaasi.

ref: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
text: Baai meena ale ka Wen bisa la, a kan tom wabaata dii nyiŋ la, Wen ale ka diila a bo ale kula nyɔnɔwa kama. Wen abe ale ka wa ko la nyiŋ ale soa ate ku a fɛ ayen kula nyɔnɔwa a kan a tom tuimbaata.

ref: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
text: Suiku de po ni le baga a miŋ baai ale ka Wen bisa la ale baai mɛ ale ka jabioku bisa la. Baai ale kaa a tom tuimaŋsa la ale baai mɛ ale kan a yaali ba chaab la, bala meena a daa Wen bisa.

ref: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
text: Wen sinsaŋŋa ate nama a liŋ a wom la ale, ti a yaali ti chaab.

ref: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
text: Ku a fɛ kama ayen ni kan a nye ase Keen la. Wala a jam ka jabioku biik, dii nyiŋla wa jam ko ka wa suoku Abel. Nama a seba jabuui nyiŋ ale soa ate Keen a ko wa la? Wa ko wa kama, dii nyiŋ la wadek a jam a tom ka tuimbaata alege wa suoku a jam a tom tuimaŋsa.

ref: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
text: M suata, ase baai ale a va tɛŋzuk meena demma suiku la a dan kisi ni, ni wamaŋsa nyiŋ, ni kan basi ate kula cha ni.

ref: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
text: Tama seba kama ayen tama basi kum kama ale nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ka kpeglimka la. Tama seba kama dii nyiŋla, tama ta yaalika ale ti chaab kama. Nuru waai abe ale kan ta yaalika la, a diem bo ka kum po.

ref: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
text: Baai ale kisi ba chaab la, a nye ase ka nuru koorisa la. Nama seba ayen nuru bala chaab a ka nyuvuri dii ale kan ka kpeglimka la.

ref: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
text: Ase nama a dan poom ka ŋanta nyam alege ate ni nya ni choa ale wa a nam alege ni kan maari wa, kula a sak kama ayen Wen yaalika a ka ni jigi ya.

ref: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
text: M bisa, ni kan basi ate ti a yaali ti chaab ale ti nɔi po wie nyiini, alege ni basi ate ti sum a yaali ba abe ti a tom tuimaŋsa a te ba.

ref: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
text: Kude ale ku basi ate ti seba ayen ti va wensieŋa kama. Ale a basi ate ti seba a chak ayen Wen a bo le ti.

ref: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
text: Tama popola abe dan kaasi ate ti jɔk nyiŋbiiri ti seba ayen Wen a gaam wie meena kama ale seba wie meena.

ref: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
text: Dila nyiŋla, m dek doaba tama popola abe dan kan kaasi ya, ti ta nyiŋbiiri kama ayen Wen a bo ale ti.

ref: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
text: Ti dan juisi jaab wa jigi, wa le te ti, dii nyiŋla tama ale a va wa nɔi ale a tom tuim ŋaai ale a peenti wa poi la.

ref: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
text: Suik kula po, Wen ale a weeni ti ayen ti nye diila ale, ti ta siaka ale Wa Nidoabinni Yeezu Kirisita abe ti a yaali chaab ase wa ale poom a weeni ti diila.

ref: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
text: Baai meena ale a va Wen nɔi la a bo ale wa kama ate wa mɛ a bo ale ba. Ti seba ayen nya kude ka wensie, dii nyiŋla wa pai ka wa Chiika a nyo ti suiniimaŋa po.

ref: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
text: M dek doaba, nuruba gela a dan weeni ayen ba ta Wen Chiika ni kan deri kpabi siak a te ba. Ni kpesi nidek ale ba, dii nyiŋla ba gela ka velimvendisa a piisi nna yegayega a tagli jigi meena.

ref: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
text: Waai abe ale kan ta siaka ale Yeezu la, Wen Chiika a ka kula nyɔnɔ jigi ya. Kula nyɔnɔwa abe ka Kirisitawa dachiak mɛ. Ni be wom ayen Kirisitawa dachiaka ale jam tɛŋzuk de meena. Wa be sum jam kama.

ref: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
text: M bisa, Wen ale soa ni ate wa pai wa Chiika a te ni. Ni be nak dɛ ba kama. Pagrim buui ale bo ni po la a pagra kama a gaam Kirisita dachaasaŋa pagrim buui ale bo ba po la.

ref: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
text: Biisiteerɔma de, baai ale ka jabiok la ale tɛŋka meena demma ka bunyi. Ka dila ale soa ate ba a wom ba wieŋa la.

ref: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
text: Alege ka Wen ale soa tama. Dila nyiŋ baai meena ale seba wa la a wom tama ale a weeni ba diila kama. Baai mɛ ate Wen an soa la, bala kan wom tama sinsaŋŋa. Dila ale soa ate ti baga a miŋ baai ale ta wensie ale baai ale a velim la.

ref: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
text: M dek doaba, ni basi ate ti a yaali chaab, dii nyiŋla, yaalika a nyini ka Wen jigi. Waai ale a yaali wa choa la, wala ka Wen biik ale seba wa mɛ.

ref: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
text: Waai abe ale kan ta yaalika la, a zɛ Wen yaa dii nyiŋla, Wen ka yaalika nyɔnɔ.

ref: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
text: Wen ale tom wa bi yeŋka ate wa siŋ jam tɛŋzuk de meena, ayen tama a baga a nya nyuvuri. Kula a sak ti ka Wen ale a yaali ti a soa diila.

ref: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
text: Tama an liŋ yaali Wen yaa, alege ka Wen dek ale liŋ yaali tama a yaa tom wa nidoabinni ayen wa siŋ jam tɛŋzuk de a kpi a vari ti ti wabaata po a basi. Wa le nye diila a sak ti kama ayen wa sum ta yaalika ale ti kama.

ref: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
text: M dek doaba, ase Wen a daa yaali ti nna la, ku be a magsi kama ayen tama mɛ a yaali chaab.

ref: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
text: Nuru waai an diem a nya Wen yaa, alege ti dan a yaali chaab, wa le bo ale ti abe wa a maari ti, ate tama a yaali wa.

ref: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
text: Ti seba ayen Wa bo ale ti kama ate tama mɛ a bo ale wa, dii nyiŋla Wa Chiika ate wa pai te ti la a bo ti suiniima po kama.

ref: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
text: Tama abe nya kama a weeni sak nuruba ti Kowa Wen ale tom wa Nidoabinni ayen wa jam chim tɛŋka meena demma Varibasidɔ la.

ref: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
text: Baai meena ale ta siaka ayen Yeezu ka Wen Nidoabinni la, Wen a bo ale ba kama ate ba mɛ a bo ale wa.

ref: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
text: Tama dek abe seba nalimnyiini ayen wa a yaali ti kama ale ta siaka ayen wala ale yaalika nyɔnɔwa. Baai meena ale a yaali ba chaab la a bo ale Wen kama ate wa mɛ dek a bo ale ba.

ref: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
text: Yaalika ale yɔgsum kan va chaaba. Yaali maŋ a yiak yɔgsum kama a basi. Dila nyiŋ waai ale yɔgsa la a kan baga a ta yaali maŋŋa. Yɔgsum ale namsika ale a va chaab.

ref: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
text: Nuru waai a dan weeni ayen wa a yaali Wen ale kisi wa choa, kula nyɔnɔ ka velimvendik. Ase wa dan kan ta yaalika ale wa choawa waai ate wa a nya wa la, kula nyɔnɔ abe wa nye ka sɛ a ta yaalika ale Wen dii ate wa kan nya wa la?

ref: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
text: Kirisitawa a sak ti nya kude kama ayen ase waai a daa yaali Wen, ku a fɛ kama ate wa a yaali wa choa mɛ.

ref: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
text: Nuru waai ale ta siaka ayen Yeezu ale Kirisitawa la ka Wen Biik. Ase nama a dan ta yaalika ale nuru waai, ni a yaali ka wa bisa mɛ dila.

ref: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
text: Dila nyiŋ, tama daa yaali Wen ale a va wa sinsaŋŋa, ti seba kama ayen ti a yaali wa bisaŋa mɛ.

ref: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
text: Waai ale a yaali Wen la a va ka wa nɔi. Wa ale a yaali ayen tama a va wa diila an tua.

ref: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
text: Dii nyiŋla, baai meena ale ka Wen bisa ale ta siaka ale wa nalimnyiini la, a baga a nak Yeezu dachaasaŋa a de kama.

ref: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
text: Waai abe ale ta siaka ayen Yeezu ka Wen Nidoabinni la nyiini ale wa baga nye dila.

ref: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
text: Yeezu Kirisita ale siŋ a jam tɛŋzuk de la, ba an jam a te wa soka ale nyiam nyiini. Ba ale jam ko wa la, wa ziimu a yaa jam nyini gum du kama. Wen Chiika dek waai ale ka wensie nyɔnɔ la, a jam ale wa soka de ale wa kummu meena seerɔ.

ref: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
text: Wen Chiika ale nyiam ale ziim ate batawa a ta nɔiyeŋ.

ref: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
text: Ti poom a liŋ wom nuruba ale a biisi Yeezu wie diila kama, alege Wen ale a biisi wa Biika wie diila a gaam mbala kama nna yegayega.

ref: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
text: Waai abe ale ta siaka ale Wen Nidoabinni la, a ta dii ate Wen a biisi wa wie la kama wa suinum po, ate kula nyɔnɔ a baga a seba Wa Nidoabinni nalimnyiini. Waai mɛ abe ale kan ta siaka ayen Yeezu ka Wen Nidoabinni la, kula nyɔnɔwa a weeni kama ayen Wen ka velimvendik, dii nyiŋla wa ka siaka ale dii ate Wen a biisi Wa Nidoabinni wie la.

ref: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
text: Waai ale Wen Nidoabinni abe ale boro ale chaab la, wala a ta nyuvunni de kama. Waai ale Wen Nidoabinni abe ale kan daa bunyi la, wala a maa ka nyuvunni de.

ref: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
text: Mi a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ka nama ayen nama baai ale ta siaka ale Wen Nidoabinni la ayen ni seba ayen ni ta nyuvuri dii ale kan ka kpeglimka la kama.

ref: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
text: Ti seba ayen baai ale ka Wen bisa la a kan kasim a tom tuimbaata, dii nyiŋla, Wen Nidoabinni ale a nya wa zuk ate jabioku an baga wa wari a nye.

ref: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
text: Tama seba ayen ti ka Wen bisa. Baai meena ale kan daa Wen bisa la, a bo ka jabioku nisima po.

ref: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
text: Ti be ŋman seba ayen Wen Nidoabinni Yeezu a siŋ jam tɛŋzuk de ayen wa lagri ka ti ninaŋa, ate ti baga a seba Wen dii ale ka wensie nyɔnɔwa la. Tama ale Wa Nidoabinni Yeezu Kirisita boro ka bunyi. Wala mɛ ale Wen maŋka dek waai ale pai nyuvuri dii ale kan ka kpeglimka la a te ti.

ref: Children, you must stay away from idols.
text: M dek bisa, ni yeeri nidek bɔgta po.

ref: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
text: Mi nisɔmawa nna ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te nipok waai ate Wen a lueri la ale wa bisaŋa baai ate m ta yaalika nna yegayega ale ba la. Daa mi nyiini ale ta yaalika ale ni, alege ka baai meena ale seba Wen wensie wieŋa la mɛ ale a yaali ni,

ref: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
text: dii nyiŋla, wensie ŋala a bo ti meena suiniima po kama a ta a cheŋ diipo meena wuu.

ref: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
text: Mi a saalim kama ayen ti Kowa Wen ale wa Nidoabinni Yeezu Kirisita le ŋmante ti meena abe ba ta jiirim ale ti abe ba te ti suiyɔgni, ate ti baga a va wensie ŋala nalimnyiini abe ti a yaali chaab.

ref: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
text: Mi sui a peenti ka nna yegayega, dii nyiŋla, mi nya fi bisaŋa ba gela kama ale ba a va wensieŋa ŋaai ate ti Kowa Wen a weeni ti ayen ti a va la.

ref: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
text: Dila nyiŋla, mi a saalim fu kama m dek tua ayen, fi a va Wen sinsak ŋaai ate ti wom a ta nyini ku piilimka po la. Ŋa po dinyi a weeni ti kama ayen ku nala kama ate ti a yaali chaab.

ref: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
text: Yaalika de ate mi a ŋmarisi la a sak kama ayen ti a zuli Wen sinsaŋŋa. Sinsak ŋaai ate ni meena a wom a ta nyiini piilimka po la ale ni meena a boro ale yaalika.

ref: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
text: Daaŋa de po pimpaasima nna yegayega ale boro. Ba kan siak ayen Yeezu Kirisita a siŋ jam tɛŋzuk de kama ase nurubiik la. Nuru baai ale kan a siak dila la ka pimpaasima nyam ale chim wa dachaasa.

ref: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
text: Dila nyiŋla, ni kpesi nidek nalimnyiini ate ni kan ŋman a basi tama ale sak ni diila. Ate ni kan jɔk tama ale tom diila ate ni tuesi ni tutunaŋa meena.

ref: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
text: Waai abe ale kan a va dii ate Kirisitawa sak ti la, alege pai wadek wie a gum du la, nuru wala choa daa Naawen nuru. Alege waai ale va sinsaŋŋa la, a ta Wen Kowa ale wa Nidoabinni Yeezu kama.

ref: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
text: Baai ale a zuli wa la, bala mɛ a tom ka tuimbaata ase wala dek la.

ref: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
text: M ta ka wie nna yegayega ayen m weeni a sak ni, alege m kan ŋman a yaali ayen m ŋmarisi yɔgyɔgla de. Mi a yaali kama ayen m dek jam ni jigi ate ti baga biisi ŋa wie ale chaab. Ti dan nye dila ti meena suiniima le peenti nna yegayega.

ref: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
text: Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la, a puusi ni.

ref: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
text: Mi, nisɔmawa nna, ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te m dek doawa Gayus ate m sum a yaali wa nna yegayega la.

ref: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
text: M dek doa, mi a saalim kama ayen Wen a te fu nyiŋyɔgsa, ate fi a tom fi tuimaŋa nalimnyiini. M seba ayen fi a va Wen ka nalimnyiini.

ref: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
text: Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma ba gela ale jam a weeni mi ayen fi sum a va Wen wensie suiku kama ale fi suinum meena. Mi le ga wom dila la, ku yaa deri peenti m sui nna yegayega.

ref: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
text: Mi nyiem ale wom ayen m bisaŋa a va Wen wensie suiku kama la, m suinum a nyiem a kasim a yɔk ka nna yegayega a gaam jabuui meena.

ref: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
text: M dek doa, ku nala kama ale fi ale tuesi Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma ale a maari ba diila. Ba ka nicham ate fi zɛ ba alege, fi diema a tuesi ba.

ref: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
text: Ba biisi fi wie kama ale Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab a bo dela la, ale pak fu fi ale a yaali ba diila. Mi a saalim fu kama ayen ba nyiem a dan boro a gomsi ayen ba basi fu abe ba nyiem, te ba maari kaai ale ka peenti Wen sui la ate ba nyiem.

ref: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
text: Dii nyiŋla, ba a sak ka nuruba Yeezu wie. Ba be kan tuesi baai ale kan daa Kirisita bisa la jaaboa.

ref: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
text: Dila nyiŋla, ku nala kama ayen tama Kirisita bisaŋa a maari bala chaab ate ti maa chaab a tom ate ti va wensieŋa.

ref: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
text: Mi ŋmarisi ka gbaŋ a te Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab a bo fi tɛŋka po la, alege Diyɔtifiz ale a yaali ayen wa chim ba kpagi la, a zɛri dii ate mi a ŋmarisi m gbaŋka po la vaka kama.

ref: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
text: Dila nyiŋla, m dan jam ni jigi, ti le kali tɛŋ a biisi ale chaab ate nuruba wom wie ŋaai meena ate wa nye la, ale wa ale kasim a velim a te mi diila. Wa dii dek ale ŋmasi gaam taam ate wa a nye la ale, wa kan tuesi Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma baai ale nyiem a jam wa yenni la. Wa be kan basi mɛ ate wa doama a tuesi ba a ta a jo ba yeeŋa po. Ase ba dan tuesi ba ayen ba ta jo, wa nyiem a yaali kama ayen wa yiak ba ate ba nyini Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma po a nyini.

ref: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
text: M dek doa, kan tomsi maara nye wie ŋaai ale kan nala la, alege tomsi a tom wie ŋaai ale nala la. Waai abe ale tom wamaŋsa la, Wen soa ka wala. Waai mɛ abe ale a tom wakaasima yaase wabaata la, Wen an soa wala choawa.

ref: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
text: Waai meena a pak Dimetirus kama. Wa wensieŋa mɛ dek a sak wa nyemagsika kama. Tama dek a weeni a gum du ate nama mɛ seba ayen ti ale a weeni diila ka wensie.

ref: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
text: M ta ka wie nna yegayega ayen m weeni a sak fu alege m kan yaali ayen m ŋmarisi ŋa dueni.

ref: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
text: Mi a poli ayen ku kan beni alege ate m nya fu. Ti dan tu chaab, ti le biisi wieŋa de meena ale chaab.

ref: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
text: Wen le te fu suiyɔgni. Fi doama baai meena ale bo dela la, a puusi fu. Be puusi ti doama baai ale bo ale fu la, a te ti.

ref: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
text: Mi Juud, ka waai ale ka Yeezu Kirisita tomteerɔ ale Jeemsi suok la. Mi ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te ni. Ti Kowa Wen ale lueri ni ale a yaali ni, ate Yeezu Kirisita a nya ni zuk.

ref: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
text: Wen le ta jiirim ale ni abe wa ta yaalika ale ni, abe wa basi ate ni boro ale suiyɔgni nna yegayega.

ref: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
text: M dek doaba, m daam poom a yaali ayen m ŋmarisi a weeni sak ni ka Wen ale vari nama ale tama ti tuimbaata po a basi dii ale ayen ti a va wa la. Yɔgyɔgla ku a fɛ kama ayen m ŋmarisi a te ni nyiŋbiiri ayen ni kpaliŋ a ta siaka nalimnyiini ale wamaŋsaŋa ate Wen a pai ŋa te ni bunyi dekki la.

ref: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
text: Ni ta siaka nalimnyiini ale ŋa dii nyiŋla, nuruba gela ale kaa a va Wen la, a suk kama a jam gum ti po. Ba tagri Wen wamaŋsaŋa de ŋaai ale a sak ti Wen wie ale a maari ti mɛ diila kama. Ba be zɛri Yeezu Kirisita waai nyiini ale ka ti Nyɔnɔ la kama mɛ. Ba a nye nna ayen ka ba baga a tom kaboŋsa tuima. Wen wieŋa a poom weeni sak ti kama dila po, ayen Wen a jam bo ba buusa kama a nya ba kaasuŋku.

ref: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
text: Ni be ŋman a teeri Wen maarɔma ale jam pai ba pagrimu a chim paanueka a zɛri ba boka jigini la. Wen a yik ba kama ale wa pagrimu a bobi ba a zaani legi jigi ayen ba za dula ate da kpien dii ate wa le bo ba buusa la a jam paari ate wa bo mini ba.

ref: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
text: Nuruma de mɛ a jam a nya ka wie nna ase gɔdaasima la. Wieŋa de abe jam basi kama ate ba pai ba nyiŋsaŋa a tom tuimbaata. Ba a nye Wen pagrimu a la kama ale a le Wen maarɔma ale bo wenŋmazuk la.

ref: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
text: Wen maarɔma kpagi kpienni Maakil dek an nye dila. Wa ale jabioku ale jam nak nampaŋŋa ale chaab ayen ba zɛ ba waai le wa soa Moosis nyiŋka la, Maakil an lɛ jabioku, wa goanti weeni wa kama ayen, <<Wen le te fu waalika.>>

ref: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
text: Alege wie ŋaai ate nuruma de zɛ ŋa kie la, ba a lɛ ŋa kama. Wie ŋaai ate ba seba ayen ŋa le kaasi ba la, duŋsa seba gaam dila kama, wa ŋala chaab dekdega le jam kaasi ba kama.

ref: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
text: Ku le jam toa ka nna yegayega te ba. Ba tom ase ka ti kokpieŋka Keen la. Ligra nyiŋ ate ba pai badek a te wakaasima ŋaai ate Balaam jam a tom la. Nuru ale jam boro ate ba a wi wa ayen Koora. Ba a nye ase ka wa ale jam nye diila. Ba be ale jam tomsi wa la, Wen jam ko ba kama.

ref: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
text: Nuruma de ka nuru baata a bo nuruma suŋsuŋ ase ba a nin boro a dɛ ŋandiinta. Ba goanti a nya ka badek zuk nyiini. Ba a nye ase ka ŋmoruk viok chiŋma la, ŋa ka nyiam. Buye po ba a nye se ka tiib sii ale kan ta yɔna la. Ba a nye ase ka tiib sii ate nuruma tu gebi si tɛŋ naŋsaŋa ale ge ate si kpi la.

ref: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
text: Ba a nye ase ka nya kpiem nyamiisa la. Ase nyamiisaŋa puuku ale kan suk la, ba tuimbaataŋa mɛ a nyini ka peelim ase nya puutaŋa la. Ba a nye ase ka chiŋmarisaŋa ate Wen pai si nyo legi po ate si kasim bo dula taam wuu la.

ref: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
text: Ɛnok jam ka Adam ŋaaŋbisaŋa po wanyi. Wala ale jam saari Adam ŋaaŋbisaŋa po buyopɔi. Wa jam biisi nuruma de wie dila po, a weeni ayen, <<Nyɔnɔwa ale wa maarɔma ale paari tusa ale tusa la a dan jam,

ref: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
text: wa le bo ka nuru meena buusa. Baai meena ale tom tuimbaata ale biisi Wen a kaasi la, wa le waali ba kama wieŋa de nyiŋ.>>

ref: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
text: Nuruma de a kasim a ŋuuni ale a fɔbili kama ale a toariŋ ba vaanchaab wie nyiŋ. Ba kasim a va ka badek wabaata yaalika tuima nyiini ale a nak kuusa badek nyiŋ, ale a pak nuruba ale ba noa nyiini ayen ba va ba abe ba a te ba ligra.

ref: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Alege m dek doaba, ni teeri dii ate ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita tomteerɔma a liŋ jam sak ni dila po la,

text: ayen diipo ate tɛŋka a moata kpeglimka la, dan paari, baai ale a va badek tuim kaasima yaalika la, le jam a la ni kama, ni ale a va Wen suiku la nyiŋ.

ref: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
text: Nuruma de chaab a nye kama ate nuruba a waaŋ chaab. Bala chaab a va ka badek ŋanyaalik wie nyiini. Ba be ka Wen Chiika ba suiniima po.

ref: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
text: Alege, m dek doaba, ni va Wen nalimnyiini, ate ni siaka a pagra. Ni basi ate wa chiika a maari ni ate ni a puusi a te Wen.

ref: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
text: Abe ni basi ate Wen yaalika lik ni ase ni ale a limisi ayen ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita a va wa jiirimu nyiŋ a te ni nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.

ref: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
text: Ni ta jiirim ale baai ale ta chichama la,

ref: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
text: abe ni vari baai ale bo bolimu po la a basi. Ni ta jiirim abe ni a chali yɔgsum ale ba gela mɛ, alege, baai mɛ kaboŋsa tuimaŋa ale basi ate ba gattaŋa daŋ la, ni kan tiri gattaŋa.

ref: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
text: Wen dii ale ka wadek wa nyiini, a chim ti Varibasidɔ Yeezu Kirisita ti Nyɔnɔwa yuenni nyiŋla, ta ka zula ale pagrim yegayega a gaam jaabuuri meena a ta nyini ku piilimka po a jam paari jinla ale ta dila taam wuu. Ku be nye dila.

ref: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
text: Mi Jɔɔn ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de po wie ŋaai ate Yeezu Kirisita a pai sak mu la. Wen ale pai wieŋa de meena a te wa ayen wa pai sak wa tomteerɔma dii ale za ku nye la. Ku kan beni. Yeezu Kirisita abe tom ka maarɔ ayen wa weeni wieŋa de a sak mu ate m seba.

ref: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
text: Mi be a weeni ka dii meena ate mi a nya la. Bi kaai ale nyini Wen jigi ale wensie ŋaai ate wa pai sak la ale nna ate mi a weeni.

ref: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
text: Nuru baai ale ba karim gbaŋka de abe ba weeni a sak ba suata la, ale nuru baai mɛ ale a wom dii le di nye ate ba va m wieŋa la, ba sue ale peenti ka yegayega. Diipo ate wieŋa de le nye la a moata kama.

ref: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
text: Mi, Jɔɔn, ale a ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab tɔgatɔga buyopɔi a bo Asia tɛŋka po la. Wen jam boro kama ale boro ale boro diipo meena. A nyini chiisa siyopɔiwa ale bo naam zukpaglika niŋ la,

ref: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
text: ale Yeezu Kirisita waai ale sak ti Wen wensieŋa ale liŋ nak wa yiti kum po tama meena niŋ la, ba meena ale ba maari ni abe ba te ni boro ale suiyɔgni.
